    import {WORLD, UNITS, BUILDINGS, TECHS, AGE_COSTS, FACTIONS, DIFFICULTIES, MISSIONS, seededRandom} from './data.js';
    
    const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
    export const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
    const CELL=2, GRID=WORLD/CELL;
    
    export class Simulation {
      constructor(options={}) {
        this.options={mode:'skirmish',faction:'alder',difficulty:'normal',map:'highlands',seed:2026,...options};
        this.rng=seededRandom(this.options.seed);this.entities=[];this.nextId=1;this.time=0;this.revision=0;
        this.listeners=[];this.events=[];this.ended=null;this.wave=0;this.nextWave=90;this.hold=0;this.enemyHold=0;this.wonderTime=[0,0];
        this.stats={gathered:0,kills:0,lost:0,built:0,trained:0};this.tutorialStep=0;this.tutorialFlags={};this.grids={};
        this.explored=new Uint8Array(80*80);this.visible=new Uint8Array(80*80);this.fogClock=0;this.aiClock=0;this.nextAttack=DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty].attack;
        this.mission=MISSIONS.find(m=>m.id===this.options.mode);if(this.mission?.map)this.options.map=this.mission.map;
        this.players=[this.makePlayer(this.options.faction),this.makePlayer(this.options.faction==='raven'?'sun':'raven')];
        this.initialize();
      }
      makePlayer(faction){return {faction,resources:{food:550,wood:550,gold:250,stone:250},age:0,tech:{economy:0,attack:0,armor:0,ranged:0,fortification:0,husbandry:0},agePending:false};}
      on(fn){this.listeners.push(fn);}
      emit(type,data={}){const event={type,...data};this.events.push(event);for(const fn of this.listeners)fn(event);}
      get(id){return this.entities.find(e=>e.id===id&&e.hp>0);}
      owned(owner,kind,type){return this.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===owner&&(!kind||e.kind===kind)&&(!type||e.type===type));}
      faction(owner){return FACTIONS[this.players[owner].faction];}
      initialize(){
        const m=this.options.mode,mission=this.mission, peaceful=m==='sandbox'||m==='tutorial', survival=m==='survival'||mission?.survival;
        this.players.forEach(p=>p.age=mission?.age||0);
        if(m==='sandbox'){this.players[0].resources={food:6000,wood:6000,gold:6000,stone:6000};this.players[0].age=3;}
        if(survival){this.players[0].resources={food:1000,wood:1100,gold:600,stone:800};this.players[0].age=Math.max(1,this.players[0].age);}
        this.addBuilding('towncenter',0,-39,30,true);
        this.addBuilding('house',0,-48,20,true);this.addBuilding('house',0,-30,40,true);
        this.addBuilding('mill',0,-49,36,true);
        this.addBuilding('barracks',0,-27,24,true);
        const startWorkers=mission?.age?12:8;
        for(let i=0;i<startWorkers;i++)this.addUnit('villager',0,-43+(i%4)*2.4,43+Math.floor(i/4)*2.4);
        this.addUnit('scout',0,-27,33);
        if(survival||mission?.age){for(let i=0;i<8;i++)this.addUnit(i%3?'spearman':'archer',0,-23+i%4*2,34+Math.floor(i/4)*2);this.addBuilding('range',0,-47,10,true);}
        if(!peaceful&&!survival){
          this.addBuilding('towncenter',1,40,-34,true);this.addBuilding('house',1,51,-26,true);this.addBuilding('house',1,29,-43,true);this.addBuilding('barracks',1,28,-24,true);this.addBuilding('mill',1,49,-44,true);
          for(let i=0;i<(mission?.age?12:8);i++)this.addUnit('villager',1,33+i%4*2,-43-Math.floor(i/4)*2);
          const count=mission?.enemies??5;
          for(let i=0;i<count;i++)this.addUnit(this.players[1].age>=2&&i%4===0?'knight':this.players[1].age>=1&&i%3===0?'archer':'spearman',1,25+i%6*2,-35-Math.floor(i/6)*2);
          if(mission?.age>=1)this.addBuilding('range',1,52,-12,true);
          if(mission?.age>=2){this.addBuilding('stable',1,37,-13,true);this.addBuilding('blacksmith',1,58,-38,true);}
          if(mission?.fortress){
            this.addBuilding('keep',1,35,-49,true);this.addBuilding('tower',1,18,-20,true);this.addBuilding('tower',1,53,-4,true);
            for(let x=15;x<=62;x+=3)if(Math.abs(x-36)>4)this.addBuilding('wall',1,x,-5,true);
            this.addBuilding('gate',1,36,-5,true);
          }
        }
        // Mirrored resources give both starting settlements the same opportunities.
        const clusters=[[-57,15,'wood',20],[-13,49,'wood',22],[-53,51,'food',7],[-24,15,'gold',5],[-57,30,'stone',5],[-58,-32,'wood',25],[-25,-40,'gold',7],[-16,-16,'stone',6],[-14,13,'food',7],[-65,64,'wood',18]];
        for(const [x,z,type,count]of clusters)for(const sign of [1,-1])for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
          const nx=clamp(x*sign+(this.rng()-.5)*(type==='wood'?18:7),-75,75),nz=clamp(z*sign+(this.rng()-.5)*(type==='wood'?18:7),-75,75);
          if(this.entities.some(e=>e.kind==='building'&&distance(e,{x:nx,z:nz})<e.r+3)||this.isWater(nx,nz))continue;

      tone(freq,duration=.15,type='sine',gain=.15,delay=0){if(!this.context||this.settings.volume<=0)return;const t=this.context.currentTime+delay,o=this.context.createOscillator(),g=this.context.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,t+.015);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(this.master);o.start(t);o.stop(t+duration+.02);}

        if(name==='order'){this.tone(240,.08,'triangle');this.tone(320,.1,'triangle',.1,.06);}
        if(name==='coin'){this.tone(920,.18,'sine',.08);this.tone(1300,.18,'sine',.07,.1);}
        if(name==='complete'){[392,494,587].forEach((f,i)=>this.tone(f,.4,'triangle',.1,i*.1));}
        if(name==='alarm'){[146,146,196].forEach((f,i)=>this.tone(f,.35,'sawtooth',.055,i*.4));}
        if(name==='attack'&&Math.random()<.12)this.tone(70+Math.random()*60,.07,'triangle',.07);

        <main class="landing-main"><div class="eyebrow"><span class="short-rule"></span> BUILD A KINGDOM. WRITE YOUR LEGACY.</div><h1>Crowns <em>of the</em><br>Frontier<span class="title-dot">.</span></h1><p class="intro">From the first timber to the final siege.<br>Raise your kingdom in a living, three-dimensional world.</p><div class="main-actions"><button class="primary" data-mode="skirmish">Begin your reign <span>➜</span></button><button class="secondary" data-action="campaign">The campaign <span>↗</span></button></div><button id="resume" class="resume hidden" data-action="resume">↶ &nbsp; Resume saved kingdom</button><div class="landing-note"><span class="status-dot"></span> ORIGINAL REAL-TIME STRATEGY <span class="separator">/</span> SINGLE PLAYER</div></main>
        <div class="scene-caption"><span class="caption-line"></span><span>THE ALDER FRONTIER<small>Where every empire begins.</small></span><span class="coordinates">38° N · 27° E</span></div>
        <nav class="mode-strip" aria-label="Game modes">${MODES.filter(m=>m.id!=='skirmish').map((m,i)=>`<button class="mode-card" data-mode="${m.id}"><span class="mode-number">0${i+1}</span><span class="mode-title">${m.name}</span><span class="mode-tag">${m.tag} <span>↗</span></span></button>`).join('')}</nav>
        <footer class="landing-footer"><span>ECONOMY · WARFARE · EMPIRE</span><span>Made for mouse & touch <span class="tiny-diamond">◆</span> Best played in landscape</span></footer>
      </div>
      <div id="hud" class="hidden">
        <header class="game-header"><button class="game-brand" data-action="pause" title="Pause / menu (Esc)"><span>♜</span> CROWNS</button><div id="resource-bar"></div><div class="time-controls"><span id="age-label"></span><span id="game-time">00:00</span><button data-action="speed" id="speed-button" title="Game speed">1×</button><button data-action="pause" title="Pause / menu (Esc)" aria-label="Pause">Ⅱ</button></div></header>
        <aside id="objectives" class="objective-panel"></aside><div id="alert-line"></div>
        <div id="health-layer"></div><div id="selection-box"></div><div id="toasts" aria-live="polite"></div>
        <div class="bottom-hud"><aside class="map-panel"><div class="map-heading"><span>THE FRONTIER</span><button data-action="home" title="Center on town (H)">⌖</button></div><canvas id="minimap" width="200" height="200" aria-label="Minimap: tap to move camera"></canvas><div class="map-footer"><span id="army-count"></span><span id="map-label"></span></div></aside><section id="selection-panel" class="selection-panel"></section><aside class="command-panel"><div class="command-heading">COMMAND</div><div class="command-buttons"><button data-action="army" title="Select army (M)">⚔<span>Army</span></button><button data-action="idle" title="Select idle villagers (.)">♟<span>Idle</span></button><button data-action="build" title="Construction (B)">⌂<span>Build</span></button><button data-action="attackmove" id="attackmove" title="Attack move (A)">➶<span>Attack</span></button><button data-action="stop" title="Stop (S)">■<span>Stop</span></button><button data-action="help" title="Controls (?)">?<span>Help</span></button></div><div class="control-hint" id="control-hint"></div></aside></div>
        <div id="build-panel" class="hidden floating-panel"></div><div class="game-bottomline"><span id="order-hint">Select units to issue orders.</span><span>SHIFT · queue orders &nbsp; CTRL + 1–9 · groups</span></div>
      </div>
      <div id="modal-root"></div><div id="rotate-hint"><span>↻</span><strong>A wider world awaits</strong><p>Rotate your phone to landscape<br>for the best battlefield view.</p><button data-action="dismiss-rotate">Continue in portrait</button></div>
    `;
    
    let view,sim,playing=false,paused=false,speed=1,selection=[],buildType=null,attackMove=false,groups={},modal=null,uiTime=0,fogTime=0,accumulator=0,last=performance.now(),lastAutosave=0;
    let pointer=null,hover=null,keys=new Set(),touches=new Map(),pinch=null,portraitDismissed=false,setupOptions={faction:'alder',difficulty:'normal',map:'highlands',seed:Math.floor(Math.random()*999999)};
    const touchDevice=matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;
    try {view=new WorldView($('#world'),settings);sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',seed:8642});view.attach(sim);view.zoom=52;view.angle=-.35;view.focus(-32,28);view.updateCamera();} catch(error){$('#world').innerHTML=`<div class="webgl-error"><h2>3D graphics could not start</h2><p>This game needs a browser with WebGL 2 enabled. Try an updated Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox with hardware acceleration enabled.</p><small>${esc(error.message)}</small></div>`;console.error(error);}
    $('#resume').classList.toggle('hidden',!read('crowns-save',null));
    
    function toast(message,tone=''){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className=`toast ${tone}`;el.textContent=message;$('#toasts').append(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),4800);}
    function setSelection(ids){selection=[...new Set(ids)].filter(id=>sim.get(id));view.selection=new Set(selection);audio.play('select');renderSelection();}
    function selected(){return selection.map(id=>sim.get(id)).filter(Boolean);}
    function workers(){return selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='villager').map(e=>e.id);}
    function closeModal(){if(modal==='pause'||modal==='settings-game'||modal==='help-game'||modal==='codex-game')paused=false;modal=null;$('#modal-root').innerHTML='';}
    function showModal(content,kind='info',wide=false){modal=kind;$('#modal-root').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-backdrop"><section class="modal ${wide?'wide':''}" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><button class="modal-close" data-action="close" aria-label="Close dialog">×</button>${content}</section></div>`;$('#modal-root').querySelector('button')?.focus();}
    function showSetup(mode){const m=MODES.find(m=>m.id===mode)||MISSIONS.find(m=>m.id===mode);showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">${m.chapter?`CHAPTER ${m.chapter} · THE FRONTIER CHRONICLES`:m.label}</div><h2>${m.name}</h2><p class="modal-intro">${m.desc}</p><div class="setup-grid"><div><label class="field-label" for="faction">YOUR CIVILIZATION</label><select id="faction">${Object.entries(FACTIONS).map(([id,f])=>`<option value="${id}" ${id===setupOptions.faction?'selected':''}>${f.name}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="faction-description" class="faction-description"></div></div><div><label class="field-label" for="difficulty">CHALLENGE</label><select id="difficulty">${Object.entries(DIFFICULTIES).map(([id,d])=>`<option value="${id}" ${id===setupOptions.difficulty?'selected':''}>${d.name}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="difficulty-description" class="faction-description"></div></div><div><label class="field-label" for="map">BATTLEFIELD</label><select id="map" ${m.map?'disabled':''}><option value="highlands">Emerald highlands</option><option value="valley" ${m.map==='valley'?'selected':''}>The river crossing</option><option value="desert">Sunlit steppe</option></select></div><div><label class="field-label" for="seed">WORLD SEED</label><input id="seed" type="number" min="1" max="999999999" value="${m.seed||setupOptions.seed}"></div></div><div class="mission-brief"><span>VICTORY CONDITION</span><p>${m.objective}</p><small>${m.time||'A campaign chapter'} · Mouse & touch supported</small></div><button class="primary full" data-start="${mode}">${mode==='tutorial'?'Start the tutorial':'Enter the frontier'} <span>➜</span></button>`, 'setup');updateSetupDescriptions();}
    function updateSetupDescriptions(){if($('#faction')){$('#faction-description').textContent=FACTIONS[$('#faction').value].desc;$('#difficulty-description').textContent=DIFFICULTIES[$('#difficulty').value].desc;}}
    function showCampaign(){showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">THE FRONTIER CHRONICLES</div><h2>A kingdom in the making.</h2><p class="modal-intro">Five chapters. A settlement, a crossing, a fortress, a sacred valley, and a final siege. Play any chapter in any order.</p><div class="chapter-list">${MISSIONS.map(m=>`<button class="chapter" data-mode="${m.id}"><span class="chapter-number">${m.chapter}</span><span><strong>${m.name}</strong><small>${m.desc}</small></span><span class="chapter-status">${progress[m.id]?'✓':'↗'}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`, 'campaign',true);}
    function startGame(options,save=null){if(!view)return;closeModal();setupOptions={...setupOptions,...options};sim=save?Simulation.restore(save):new Simulation(options);view.attach(sim);sim.on(onEvent);playing=true;paused=false;speed=1;groups={};selection=[];view.selection=new Set();buildType=null;attackMove=false;accumulator=0;lastAutosave=sim.time;$('#landing').classList.add('hidden');$('#hud').classList.remove('hidden');$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');view.angle=Math.PI/4;view.zoom=touchDevice?67:58;view.updateCamera();audio.unlock();renderHUD();renderSelection();updateRotate();toast('Your kingdom awaits. Select a villager or your town center.');if(sim.options.mode==='tutorial')toast('Start with the objectives in the upper-left corner.');if(sim.ended)showEnd(sim.ended);}
    function onEvent(e){
      if(e.type==='notice')toast(e.message,e.tone);
      if(e.type==='complete'){toast(`${BUILDINGS[e.entity.type].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='trained'){audio.play('complete');if(e.entity.type==='villager'&&!e.entity.order)sim.assignWorker(e.entity);}
      if(e.type==='research'){toast(e.tech==='age'?`${AGES[e.age]} reached. New troops and buildings unlocked.`:`${TECHS[e.tech].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='order'){audio.play('order');}
      if(e.type==='sound')audio.play(e.name);
      if(e.type==='alarm'){$('#alert-line').innerHTML='<span class="alert-pulse"></span> YOUR KINGDOM IS UNDER ATTACK';audio.play('alarm');setTimeout(()=>$('#alert-line').innerHTML='',7000);}
      if(e.type==='raid')toast('Scouts report an enemy army on the move.','warning');
      if(e.type==='wave'){toast(`Wave ${e.wave} · ${e.count} enemies approach. Supplies have arrived.`,'warning');audio.play('alarm');}
      if(e.type==='capture'){toast(e.owner===0?'An ancient shrine is under your control.':'The enemy has captured a shrine.',e.owner===0?'':'warning');audio.play('complete');}
      if(e.type==='attack'||e.type==='death'){view.effect(e);if(e.type==='attack')audio.play('attack');}
      if(e.type==='end')showEnd(e);
    }
    function saveGame(automatic=false){try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-save',JSON.stringify(sim.serialize()));if(!automatic)toast('Your kingdom has been saved on this device.');}catch{if(!automatic)toast('This browser could not store the save. Free storage or enable local storage.','warning');}}
    function showEnd(result){paused=true;buildType=null;view.hideGhost();if(result.won){progress[sim.options.mode]=true;try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-progress',JSON.stringify(progress));}catch{}audio.play('victory');}showModal(`<div class="result-crest">${result.won?'♛':'⚔'}</div><div class="eyebrow">${result.won?'A LEGACY WRITTEN':'THE CROWN HAS FALLEN'}</div><h2>${result.won?'Victory.':'Defeat.'}</h2><p class="modal-intro">${esc(result.reason)}</p><div class="result-stats"><div><strong>${formatTime(sim.time)}</strong><span>TIME IN BATTLE</span></div><div><strong>${sim.stats.kills}</strong><span>ENEMIES DEFEATED</span></div><div><strong>${Math.round(sim.stats.gathered)}</strong><span>RESOURCES GATHERED</span></div><div><strong>${sim.stats.built}</strong><span>BUILDINGS RAISED</span></div></div><div class="result-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="restart">Play again ↗</button><button class="secondary" data-action="menu">Return to menu</button></div>`,'end');}
    function showPause(){paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">A MOMENT OF RESPITE</div><h2>The kingdom can wait.</h2><p class="modal-intro">${AGES[sim.players[0].age]} · ${formatTime(sim.time)} · ${DIFFICULTIES[sim.options.difficulty].name}</p><div class="pause-actions"><button class="primary full" data-action="close">Return to battle <span>➜</span></button><button class="secondary full" data-action="save">Save kingdom</button><button class="secondary full" data-action="settings">Settings</button><button class="secondary full" data-action="help">Controls & strategy</button><button class="secondary full" data-action="fullscreen">Enter fullscreen</button><button class="text-button" data-action="menu">Save & return to menu</button></div>`,'pause');}
    function showSettings(){if(playing)paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">MAKE IT YOURS</div><h2>Settings.</h2><label class="field-label" for="quality">GRAPHICS QUALITY</label><select id="quality"><option value="high" ${settings.quality==='high'?'selected':''}>High · full shadows & sharp rendering</option><option value="medium" ${settings.quality==='medium'?'selected':''}>Balanced · recommended for phones</option><option value="low" ${settings.quality==='low'?'selected':''}>Performance · shadows off</option></select><label class="field-label" for="volume">VOLUME</label><input type="range" id="volume" min="0" max="1" step=".05" value="${settings.volume}"><label class="toggle"><input id="music" type="checkbox" ${settings.music?'checked':''}> Ambient music</label><label class="toggle"><input id="fog" type="checkbox" ${settings.fog?'checked':''}> Fog overlay <small>Enemy visibility rules remain active.</small></label><p class="settings-note">Use landscape on phones. Pinch to zoom, drag to pan, and tap to select or command. Saves are stored on this browser and device.</p><button class="primary full" data-action="apply-settings">Apply settings <span>✓</span></button>`,playing?'settings-game':'settings');}
    function showHelp(){if(playing)paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">THE COMMANDER'S HANDBOOK</div><h2>Every empire starts small.</h2><div class="help-grid"><div><h3>Mouse & keyboard</h3><p>Click to select. Drag a box to select a group. Shift-click adds units. Double-click selects nearby troops of the same type.</p><p><b>Right-click</b> to move, attack, gather, build, repair, heal, or set a building's rally point. <b>Shift + right-click</b> queues orders.</p><p><b>WASD / arrows:</b> pan · <b>Q/E:</b> rotate · <b>Wheel:</b> zoom · <b>Middle drag:</b> pan · <b>H:</b> town · <b>M:</b> army · <b>B:</b> build · <b>A:</b> attack move · <b>S:</b> stop · <b>.:</b> idle worker · <b>Esc:</b> pause/cancel</p><p><b>Ctrl + 1–9:</b> store group · <b>1–9:</b> recall group · <b>Space:</b> focus selection</p></div><div><h3>Phone & tablet</h3><p>Play in landscape. Tap your units to select. With a unit selected, tap open ground to move, an enemy to attack, or a resource to gather.</p><p>Drag the battlefield to pan. Use two fingers to pinch-zoom. The <b>Army</b> button selects every soldier. The <b>Idle</b> button selects idle workers.</p><p>Tap <b>Build</b>, choose a building, then tap open land. Select walls and drag to create a wall line. Gates allow friendly troops through.</p><p>Tap the minimap to move the camera. Training and research appear when you select a completed building.</p></div></div><div class="strategy-tip"><b>A good first five minutes</b><p>Keep training villagers. Build houses before reaching the population cap. Place gathering camps near resources. Mix spearmen with archers, advance your age, and bring siege weapons against fortifications. Add healers to preserve expensive troops.</p></div><button class="secondary" data-action="codex">Open the complete field guide ↗</button>`,playing?'help-game':'help',true);}
    function showCodex(tab='units'){if(playing)paused=true;const lists={units:UNITS,buildings:BUILDINGS,technologies:TECHS};showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">KNOWLEDGE IS POWER</div><h2>Field guide.</h2><nav class="codex-tabs">${Object.keys(lists).map(t=>`<button class="${t===tab?'active':''}" data-codex="${t}">${t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1)}</button>`).join('')}</nav><div class="codex-list">${Object.entries(lists[tab]).map(([id,d])=>`<article class="codex-item"><span class="codex-icon">${ICONS[id]||'✧'}</span><div><h3>${d.name} <small>${AGES[d.age]}</small></h3><p>${d.desc}</p><span class="cost">${costText(d.cost)} ${d.hp?` · ${d.hp} base HP`:''} ${d.time?` · ${d.time}s`:''}</span></div></article>`).join('')}</div><div class="strategy-tip"><b>Unit counters</b><p>Spearmen → cavalry · cavalry → archers · archers → spearmen · armored infantry → light troops · siege → buildings. Troops gain strength with each age. Research stacks with civilization bonuses.</p></div>`,playing?'codex-game':'codex',true);}
    function toggleBuild(){if(buildType){cancelBuild();return;}const ws=workers();if(!ws.length){const free=sim.owned(0,'unit','villager').filter(e=>!e.order);setSelection((free.length?free:sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')).slice(0,2).map(e=>e.id));}if(!workers().length)return toast('Train a villager before constructing buildings.','warning');
      const age=sim.players[0].age;$('#build-panel').classList.remove('hidden');$('#build-panel').innerHTML=`<div class="floating-heading"><span>RAISE YOUR KINGDOM</span><button data-action="cancel-build" aria-label="Close construction">×</button></div><div class="build-grid">${Object.entries(BUILDINGS).map(([id,d])=>`<button class="build-option ${age<d.age?'locked':''}" data-build="${id}" ${age<d.age?'disabled':''} title="${esc(d.desc)}"><span class="build-icon">${ICONS[id]}</span><strong>${d.name}</strong><small>${age<d.age?AGES[d.age]:costText(sim.cost(d.cost,0,'building'))}</small></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="build-footnote">Select a building, then choose open land. Drag to place connected walls. Shift keeps the tool active.</p>`;
    }
    function cancelBuild(){buildType=null;$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');view?.hideGhost();$('#world').classList.remove('placing');$('#order-hint').textContent='Select units to issue orders.';}
    function renderSelection(){if(!playing)return;selection=selection.filter(id=>sim.get(id));view.selection=new Set(selection);const list=selected(),panel=$('#selection-panel');
      if(!list.length){panel.innerHTML=`<div class="empty-selection"><span class="empty-crest">♜</span><div><span class="eyebrow">YOUR KINGDOM, YOUR COMMAND</span><h3>Select a unit or building</h3><p>${touchDevice?'Tap your units. Drag to pan. Pinch to zoom.':'Click to select · Drag to select a group · Right-click to command'}</p></div></div>`;return;}
      const first=list[0],data=UNITS[first.type]||BUILDINGS[first.type]||{name:first.type,desc:first.kind==='shrine'?'Military units capture this shrine in 18 seconds. It generates gold while controlled.':'Assign villagers to gather this resource.'};
      const icon=ICONS[first.type]||'✧';const hp=Math.round(first.hp),max=Math.round(first.maxHp);const mine=first.owner===0;
      panel.innerHTML=`<div class="selection-title"><span class="selection-portrait ${mine?'':'enemy'}">${icon}</span><div><span class="eyebrow">${list.length>1?`${list.length} UNITS SELECTED`:mine?FACTIONS[sim.players[0].faction].name:first.owner===1?'RIVAL KINGDOM':'THE FRONTIER'}</span><h3>${list.length>1?'Your company':data.name}</h3><div class="health-track"><span style="width:${first.hp/first.maxHp*100}%"></span></div><small>${first.kind==='resource'?`${Math.round(first.amount)} remaining`:first.kind==='shrine'?`Control: ${first.owner<0?'Neutral':first.owner===0?'Yours':'Enemy'}`:`${hp} / ${max} HP${first.kind==='building'&&first.progress<1?` · Building ${Math.floor(first.progress*100)}%`:''}`}</small></div></div>`;
      if(list.length>1){const counts={};for(const e of list)counts[e.type]=(counts[e.type]||0)+1;panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="unit-tokens">${Object.entries(counts).map(([t,n])=>`<button data-select-type="${t}">${ICONS[t]} <span>${n}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="selection-desc">${touchDevice?'Tap the battlefield to move; tap enemies to attack.':'Right-click to move or attack. A + click issues an attack-move order.'}</p>`;return;}
      if(first.kind==='building'&&mine&&first.progress>=1){
        const p=sim.players[0],train=Object.entries(UNITS).filter(([t,d])=>d.at.includes(first.type));
        const techs=Object.entries(TECHS).filter(([t,d])=>d.at.includes(first.type)&&p.tech[t]<d.max);
        panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="production-actions">${train.map(([t,d])=>`<button data-train="${t}" data-building="${first.id}" title="${esc(d.desc)} · ${costText(d.cost)}" ${p.age<d.age?'disabled':''}><span>${ICONS[t]}</span><strong>${d.name}</strong><small>${p.age<d.age?AGES[d.age]:costText(d.cost)}</small></button>`).join('')}${first.type==='towncenter'&&p.age<3?`<button class="age-up" data-research="age" data-building="${first.id}" ${p.agePending?'disabled':''}><span>✧</span><strong>${p.agePending?'Advancing…':AGES[p.age+1]}</strong><small>${costText(AGE_COSTS[p.age])}</small></button>`:''}${techs.map(([t,d])=>`<button data-research="${t}" data-building="${first.id}" title="${esc(d.desc)}" ${p.age<d.age||p.tech[t]>=Math.min(d.max,p.age+1)?'disabled':''}><span>${ICONS[t]||'✧'}</span><strong>${d.name} ${p.tech[t]+1}</strong><small>${costText(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.cost).map(([r,n])=>[r,n*(p.tech[t]+1)])))}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
        if(first.queue.length)panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="training-queue">${first.queue.map((q,i)=>`<button data-cancel-queue="${i}" data-building="${first.id}" title="Cancel and refund"><span>${ICONS[q.type]||'✧'}</span><small>${i===0?Math.ceil(q.remaining)+'s':i+1}</small><i style="width:${i===0?(1-q.remaining/q.total)*100:0}%"></i></button>`).join('')}<span>QUEUE · click to cancel</span></div>`;
        if(first.type==='market')panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="trade-actions">${['food','wood','stone'].map(r=>`<span>${ICONS[r]} <button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="true">Buy 100 · 130◆</button><button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="false">Sell 100 · 70◆</button></span>`).join('')}</div>`;
      }else if(first.type==='villager'&&mine){panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="worker-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="build">⌂ Construct a building</button><button class="secondary" data-action="auto-work">♣ Gather automatically</button></div><p class="selection-desc">${first.carry?`Carrying ${Math.floor(first.carry)} ${first.carryType}. `:''}${touchDevice?'Tap resources to gather, buildings to construct or repair.':'Right-click resources to gather, buildings to construct or repair.'}</p>`;}
      else panel.innerHTML+=`<p class="selection-desc">${data.desc||''}</p>`;
    }
    function renderHUD(){if(!playing)return;const p=sim.players[0];$('#resource-bar').innerHTML=['food','wood','gold','stone'].map(r=>`<div class="resource"><span class="resource-icon ${r}">${ICONS[r]}</span><strong>${Math.floor(p.resources[r])}</strong><small>${r==='wood'?'TIMBER':r.toUpperCase()}</small></div>`).join('')+`<div class="resource population ${sim.population(0)>=sim.capacity(0)?'full-pop':''}"><span class="resource-icon">♟</span><strong>${sim.population(0)}<i>/${sim.capacity(0)}</i></strong><small>POPULATION</small></div>`;
      $('#age-label').textContent=AGES[p.age];$('#game-time').textContent=formatTime(sim.time);$('#speed-button').textContent=`${speed}×`;
      const m=MODES.find(m=>m.id===sim.options.mode)||sim.mission;let objective=m.objective;
      if(sim.options.mode==='tutorial')objective=sim.tutorialObjectives().map((o,i)=>`<div class="lesson ${o.done?'done':''}"><span>${o.done?'✓':i+1}</span>${o.text}</div>`).join('');
      else objective=`<p>${objective}</p>`;
      let info='';if(sim.options.mode==='survival'||sim.mission?.survival)info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>WAVE ${sim.wave} / ${sim.mission?.waves||10}</span><strong>${sim.wave<(sim.mission?.waves||10)?`Next · ${formatTime(Math.max(0,sim.nextWave-sim.time))}`:'Eliminate remaining enemies'}</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='dominion'||sim.mission?.dominion)info=`<div class="shrine-status">${sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine').map(e=>`<span class="${e.owner===0?'owned':e.owner===1?'rival':''}">✧</span>`).join('')}<strong>${formatTime(sim.hold)} / 03:00</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='wonder')info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>YOUR MONUMENT</span><strong>${formatTime(sim.wonderTime[0])} / 04:00</strong></div>`;
      $('#objectives').innerHTML=`<div class="objective-eyebrow">${sim.mission?'CHAPTER '+sim.mission.chapter:m.tag.toUpperCase()}<span class="difficulty-tag">${DIFFICULTIES[sim.options.difficulty].name}</span></div><h3>${m.name}</h3>${objective}${info}`;
      $('#army-count').textContent=`${sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager').length} soldiers`;$('#map-label').textContent=sim.options.map.toUpperCase();$('#control-hint').textContent=touchDevice?'TAP TO COMMAND · PINCH TO ZOOM':'RIGHT-CLICK TO COMMAND';
      renderMinimap();renderHealth();
    }
    function renderMinimap(){const c=$('#minimap'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),size=c.width,scale=size/160;ctx.fillStyle=sim.options.map==='desert'?'#8e8968':'#6e7c59';ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
      if(sim.options.map==='valley'){ctx.strokeStyle='#72a3a5';ctx.lineWidth=10*scale;ctx.beginPath();for(let z=-80;z<=80;z+=2){const x=Math.sin(z*.045)*4;ctx.lineTo((x+80)*scale,(z+80)*scale);}ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#ac9b75';ctx.fillRect(72*scale,72*scale,16*scale,16*scale);}
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&(e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||e.kind==='resource'&&sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){ctx.fillStyle=e.kind==='resource'?{wood:'#315b42',gold:'#e1bf69',stone:'#bac0b4',food:'#ab7560'}[e.type]:e.kind==='shrine'?(e.owner===0?'#91dbc9':e.owner===1?'#df8582':'#e3d3a2'):e.owner===0?'#b5e7dc':'#ed8b7b';const r=e.kind==='building'?Math.max(2,e.r*scale):e.kind==='unit'?1.6:1.5;ctx.fillRect((e.x+80)*scale-r,(e.z+80)*scale-r,r*2,r*2);}
      if(settings.fog){for(let z=0;z<80;z++)for(let x=0;x<80;x++){const i=z*80+x;if(!sim.visible[i]){ctx.fillStyle=sim.explored[i]?'rgba(14,26,24,.30)':'rgba(14,26,24,.85)';ctx.fillRect(x*size/80,z*size/80,size/80+1,size/80+1);}}}
      const points=[[0,0],[innerWidth,0],[innerWidth,innerHeight],[0,innerHeight]].map(([x,y])=>view.groundPoint(x,y));ctx.strokeStyle='#f0e8c4';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>{if(p)(i?ctx.lineTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale):ctx.moveTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale));});ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();
    }
    function renderHealth(){const layer=$('#health-layer');let html='';for(const e of sim.entities){if(e.hp<=0||e.kind==='resource'||e.kind==='shrine'||(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.hp>=e.maxHp&&e.progress!==undefined&&e.progress>=1)||e.owner===1&&!sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;if(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>=e.maxHp)continue;const p=view.project(e);if(p.visible&&p.x>0&&p.x<innerWidth&&p.y>50&&p.y<innerHeight-100)html+=`<div class="world-health ${e.owner===1?'rival':''}" style="left:${p.x}px;top:${p.y}px"><i style="width:${e.hp/e.maxHp*100}%"></i>${e.kind==='building'&&e.progress<1?`<small>${Math.floor(e.progress*100)}%</small>`:''}</div>`;}layer.innerHTML=html;}
    function menuReturn(){if(playing&&!sim.ended)saveGame(true);closeModal();playing=false;paused=false;cancelBuild();selection=[];view.selection.clear();$('#hud').classList.add('hidden');$('#landing').classList.remove('hidden');$('#resume').classList.toggle('hidden',!read('crowns-save',null));view.focus(-36,30);view.zoom=52;view.angle=-.35;view.updateCamera();updateRotate();}
    function action(name){audio.unlock();
      if(name==='close')return closeModal();if(name==='campaign')return showCampaign();if(name==='settings')return showSettings();if(name==='codex')return showCodex();if(name==='help')return showHelp();if(name==='dismiss-rotate'){portraitDismissed=true;return updateRotate();}
      if(name==='resume'){const save=read('crowns-save',null);if(save)try{startGame(save.options,save);}catch(error){toast('The saved kingdom could not be restored.','warning');}return;}
      if(name==='pause'){if(paused&&modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(name==='save'){saveGame();return;}if(name==='menu')return menuReturn();if(name==='restart')return startGame(sim.options);
      if(name==='apply-settings'){settings.quality=$('#quality').value;settings.volume=Number($('#volume').value);settings.music=$('#music').checked;settings.fog=$('#fog').checked;view.quality(settings.quality);try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify(settings));}catch{}audio.unlock();closeModal();return;}
      if(name==='fullscreen'){document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.().then(()=>{screen.orientation?.lock?.('landscape').catch(()=>{});}).catch(()=>toast('Use your browser fullscreen control on this device.'));return;}
      if(!playing||sim.ended)return;
      if(name==='speed'){speed=speed===1?1.5:speed===1.5?2:1;return;}if(name==='home'){const tc=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(tc){view.focus(tc.x,tc.z);setSelection([tc.id]);}return;}
      if(name==='army'){setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager').map(e=>e.id));return;}
      if(name==='idle'){const idle=sim.owned(0,'unit','villager').filter(e=>!e.order);setSelection(idle.map(e=>e.id));if(idle.length)view.focus(idle[0].x,idle[0].z);else toast('Every villager has an assignment.');return;}
      if(name==='build')return toggleBuild();if(name==='cancel-build')return cancelBuild();
      if(name==='stop'){sim.stop(selection);return;}if(name==='auto-work'){for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.type==='villager')){e.order=null;sim.assignWorker(e);}toast('Villagers assigned to nearby resources.');return;}
      if(name==='attackmove'){attackMove=!attackMove;$('#attackmove').classList.toggle('active',attackMove);$('#order-hint').textContent=attackMove?'Choose a destination. Troops will fight enemies along the way.':'Select units to issue orders.';}
    }
    document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const el=event.target.closest('button,a[data-action]');if(!el)return;
      if(el.dataset.action)action(el.dataset.action);
      if(el.dataset.mode)showSetup(el.dataset.mode);
      if(el.dataset.start){const seed=Math.abs(Number($('#seed').value))||Math.floor(Math.random()*999999);startGame({mode:el.dataset.start,faction:$('#faction').value,difficulty:$('#difficulty').value,map:$('#map').value,seed});}
      if(el.dataset.codex)showCodex(el.dataset.codex);
      if(el.dataset.build){buildType=el.dataset.build;$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');$('#world').classList.add('placing');$('#order-hint').textContent=buildType==='wall'?'Drag across open land to place a wall line.':'Choose open land to place '+BUILDINGS[buildType].name+'.';}
      if(el.dataset.train){sim.train(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.train);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.research){sim.research(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.research);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.cancelQueue!==undefined){sim.cancelQueue(Number(el.dataset.building),Number(el.dataset.cancelQueue));renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.trade){sim.trade(el.dataset.trade,el.dataset.buy==='true');renderHUD();}
      if(el.dataset.selectType)setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit',el.dataset.selectType).map(e=>e.id));
    });
    document.addEventListener('change',updateSetupDescriptions);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA'].includes(event.target.tagName))return;const key=event.key.toLowerCase();if(!playing)return;
      if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(key))event.preventDefault();
      if(key==='escape'){if(buildType||!$('#build-panel').classList.contains('hidden'))cancelBuild();else if(modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(paused)return;keys.add(key);if(event.repeat)return;
      const actions={h:'home',m:'army',b:'build',a:'attackmove',s:'stop','.':'idle','?':'help'};if(actions[key])action(actions[key]);
      if(key===' '&&selection.length){const e=sim.get(selection[0]);if(e)view.focus(e.x,e.z);}
      if(/^[1-9]$/.test(key)){if(event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey){event.preventDefault();groups[key]=[...selection];toast(`Control group ${key} assigned.`);}else if(groups[key])setSelection(groups[key]);}
    });
    document.addEventListener('keyup',event=>keys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()));window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();if(playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended){paused=true;showPause();}});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&playing&&!sim.ended){saveGame(true);if(!paused)showPause();}});
    
    function updateRotate(){$('#rotate-hint').classList.toggle('show',playing&&touchDevice&&innerHeight>innerWidth&&!portraitDismissed);}
    window.addEventListener('resize',updateRotate);

    function frame(now){const dt=Math.min(.08,(now-last)/1000);last=now;

    Add: C:\new\Age_Of_Emprire\tests\simulation.test.js
    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {Simulation,distance} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,TECHS} from '../src/data.js';
    
    const advance=(s,seconds)=>{for(let i=0;i<seconds*10;i++)s.tick(.1);};
    const funded=s=>s.players[0].resources={food:100000,wood:100000,gold:100000,stone:100000};
    
    test('world seeds reproduce resources and starting positions',()=>{
      const a=new Simulation({seed:781}),b=new Simulation({seed:781});assert.deepEqual(a.serialize(),b.serialize());
      const c=new Simulation({seed:782});assert.notDeepEqual(a.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource'),c.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource'));
    });
    test('villagers collect and deposit each of the four resources',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'});const tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];
      for(const type of ['food','wood','gold','stone']){
        const v=s.addUnit('villager',0,tc.x+9,tc.z),r=s.addResource(type,tc.x+11,tc.z,2000);const before=s.players[0].resources[type];
        s.command([v.id],{type:'gather',target:r.id});advance(s,30);assert.ok(s.players[0].resources[type]>before,`${type} deposited`);
      }
    });
    test('construction costs resources, takes worker time, and increases capacity',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),v=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];const cap=s.capacity(0),wood=s.players[0].resources.wood;
      const b=s.build('house',-36,49,[v.id]);assert.ok(b);assert.equal(s.capacity(0),cap);assert.ok(s.players[0].resources.wood<wood);advance(s,45);assert.equal(b.progress,1);assert.equal(s.capacity(0),cap+10);
    });
    test('age restrictions, occupied terrain, visibility and insufficient funds prevent building',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'tutorial'}),v=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];
      assert.equal(s.build('keep',-36,49,[v.id]),false);assert.equal(s.build('house',tc.x,tc.z,[v.id]),false);assert.equal(s.build('house',65,65,[v.id]),false);
      s.players[0].resources.wood=0;assert.equal(s.build('house',-36,49,[v.id]),false);
    });
    test('troops train through queues; cancellations refund and population limits apply',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),b=s.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0],before=s.players[0].resources.food;
      assert.ok(s.train(b.id,'spearman'));s.cancelQueue(b.id,0);assert.equal(s.players[0].resources.food,before);assert.equal(b.queue.length,0);
      s.train(b.id,'spearman');const n=s.population(0);advance(s,18);assert.equal(s.population(0),n+1);
      while(s.population(0)<s.capacity(0))s.addUnit('spearman',0,-20,40);assert.equal(s.train(b.id,'spearman'),false);
    });
    test('age research is queued once and applies health improvements on completion',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'tutorial'});funded(s);const tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0],v=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],hp=v.maxHp;
      assert.ok(s.research(tc.id,'age'));assert.equal(s.research(tc.id,'age'),false);advance(s,56);assert.equal(s.players[0].age,1);assert.ok(v.maxHp>hp);
    });
    test('research levels have age caps and cannot be researched simultaneously',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'});funded(s);const b=s.addBuilding('blacksmith',0,-15,35,true);
      assert.ok(s.research(b.id,'attack'));assert.equal(s.research(b.id,'attack'),false);advance(s,33);assert.equal(s.players[0].tech.attack,1);
    });
    test('spearmen counter cavalry and siege counters buildings',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),spear=s.addUnit('spearman',0,0,0),knight=s.addUnit('knight',1,1,0),archer=s.addUnit('archer',1,1,0),ram=s.addUnit('ram',0,0,0),wall=s.addBuilding('wall',1,1,0,true);
      assert.ok(s.attackDamage(spear,knight)>s.attackDamage(spear,archer)*2);assert.ok(s.attackDamage(ram,wall)>s.attackDamage(ram,archer)*5);
    });
    test('combat destroys units, records kills, and healers restore health',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),spear=s.addUnit('spearman',0,0,0),enemy=s.addUnit('scout',1,1,0);enemy.hp=12;s.command([spear.id],{type:'attack',target:enemy.id});advance(s,1);assert.equal(enemy.hp,0);assert.ok(s.stats.kills>=1);
      spear.hp=20;const monk=s.addUnit('monk',0,2,0);advance(s,3);assert.ok(spear.hp>20);
    });
    test('pathfinding routes around walls and across the river bridge',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'valley'});for(let z=-15;z<15;z+=3)s.addBuilding('wall',1,20,z,true);
      const e=s.addUnit('scout',0,15,0),path=s.pathTo(e,{x:26,z:0});assert.ok(path.some(p=>Math.abs(p.z)>14));
      const river=s.pathTo(s.addUnit('scout',0,-10,30),{x:12,z:30});assert.ok(river.some(p=>Math.abs(p.z)<=9));assert.ok(river.every(p=>!s.isWater(p.x,p.z)));
    });
    test('friendly gates allow passage while enemy gates block',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'});s.addBuilding('gate',0,0,0,true);const cell=s.cell(0,0);assert.equal(s.grid(0)[cell.z*80+cell.x],0);assert.equal(s.grid(1)[cell.z*80+cell.x],1);
    });
    test('shift commands queue each movement order once',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),v=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];s.smartCommand([v.id],null,-30,48);s.smartCommand([v.id],null,-20,48,true);assert.equal(v.orders.length,1);
    });
    test('wall construction queues every segment in order',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),v=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];funded(s);
      const a=s.build('wall',-36,49,[v.id]),b=s.build('wall',-33.15,49,[v.id],0,true),c=s.build('wall',-30.3,49,[v.id],0,true);assert.ok(a&&b&&c);assert.equal(v.order.target,a.id);assert.equal(v.orders.length,2);advance(s,100);assert.equal(a.progress,1);assert.equal(b.progress,1);assert.equal(c.progress,1);
    });
    test('enemy AI gathers resources, constructs buildings and trains troops',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({difficulty:'story'}),n=s.population(1),initial=s.owned(1,'building').length;advance(s,180);assert.ok(s.population(1)>n);assert.ok(s.owned(1,'building').length>initial);assert.ok(s.owned(1,'unit','villager').some(v=>v.carry>0));assert.ok(Object.values(s.players[1].resources).every(n=>n>=0));
    });
    test('shrines capture with military presence and holding all yields victory',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'dominion'});s.tickAI=()=>{};for(const enemy of s.owned(1,'unit'))enemy.hp=0;for(const shrine of s.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine'))s.addUnit('spearman',0,shrine.x,shrine.z);
      advance(s,20);assert.equal(s.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine'&&e.owner===0).length,3);advance(s,180);assert.equal(s.ended?.won,true);
    });
    test('survival does not end before all waves are eliminated',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'survival'});s.wave=9;s.nextWave=Infinity;s.checkVictory();assert.equal(s.ended,null);s.wave=10;s.addUnit('spearman',1,70,70);s.checkVictory();assert.equal(s.ended,null);for(const e of s.owned(1,'unit'))e.hp=0;s.checkVictory();assert.equal(s.ended.won,true);
    });
    test('wonder defense and town center destruction produce the correct results',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'wonder'});s.tickAI=()=>{};s.addBuilding('wonder',0,-58,61,true);s.wonderTime[0]=239.9;s.tick(.2);assert.equal(s.ended.won,true);
      const defeat=new Simulation();defeat.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0].hp=0;defeat.checkVictory();assert.equal(defeat.ended.won,false);
      const win=new Simulation();win.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0].hp=0;win.checkVictory();assert.equal(win.ended.won,true);
    });
    test('save/load preserves resources, queues, orders, exploration and objective timers',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'dominion'});advance(s,10);const tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];s.train(tc.id,'villager');s.hold=42;const data=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.serialize())),restored=Simulation.restore(data);
      assert.deepEqual(restored.players,s.players);assert.equal(restored.time,s.time);assert.equal(restored.hold,42);assert.deepEqual(restored.entities,s.entities);assert.deepEqual(restored.explored,s.explored);restored.tick(.1);assert.ok(restored.time>s.time);
    });
    test('all declared buildings and troops instantiate in sandbox',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'});for(const type of Object.keys(BUILDINGS)){const e=s.addBuilding(type,0,0,0,true);assert.ok(e.hp>0&&e.maxHp>0);}for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const e=s.addUnit(type,0,0,0);assert.ok(e.hp>0);}assert.equal(Object.keys(TECHS).length,6);
    });

    Add: C:\new\Age_Of_Emprire\README.md
    # Crowns of the Frontier
    
    An original, fully 3D, single-player browser RTS built with Three.js. Build a medieval settlement, gather four resources, advance through four ages, research improvements, and command infantry, cavalry, healers, and siege engines.
    
    ## Play
    
    ```powershell
    npm install
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    Open **http://localhost:5173** on the laptop. On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, open the **Network** URL printed by Vite. Landscape is recommended. If the phone cannot reach the laptop, check that the local network permits connections to port 5173.
    
    Start with **First light**, the guided tutorial. Use **Clash of crowns** for a standard match. **Legendary** difficulty offers early attacks and relentless pressure. The game runs locally; it does not require an account.
    
    ## Included gameplay
    
    - **Seven modes:** tutorial, conquest skirmish, regicide, ten-wave survival, shrine control, monument race, and peaceful sandbox.
    - **Five campaign chapters:** settlement, river crossing, fortress defense, sacred valley, and final siege. All chapters can be played immediately.
    - **Six seeded maps:** Emerald highlands, river crossing, sunlit steppe, Winterwood, iron frontier, and twin rivers. Seeds reproduce resource layouts. Bridges create actual movement chokepoints; winter has additional timber and the iron frontier has contested central ore.
    - **Three original civilizations:** Alder Kingdom (durability), Sunward Sultanate (economy and construction), Raven Clans (cavalry).
    - **Four difficulties:** Explorer, Commander, Conqueror, Legendary. Difficulty changes enemy decision and attack timing; survival also changes wave strength.
    - **18 buildings:** town center, house, farm, mill, lumber camp, mining camp, barracks, archery range, stable, siege workshop, blacksmith, market, watchtower, castle, stone wall, gatehouse, monastery, and grand monument.
    - **Nine trainable troops:** villager, scout, spearman, archer, man-at-arms, knight, battering ram, trebuchet, and healer. Regicide adds an irreplaceable sovereign for each side.
    - **Four ages** with population limits, paid training queues, rally points, age requirements, automatic age strength improvements, and queue cancellation refunds.
    - **Six technology families:** gathering tools, melee attack, armor, ranged attack, fortification, and cavalry speed. Research levels have age requirements and increasing costs.
    - Villagers physically walk between resources and drop-off buildings, carry supplies, construct buildings, and repair damage. Farms provide renewable food. Mines and trees deplete. Markets buy and sell resources for gold.
    - Walls block paths; friendly units can pass through gates. Connected walls support queued construction. Construction can be canceled for a 70% resource refund; finished buildings can be demolished for a 20% refund. Your last town center is protected from accidental demolition.
    - Unit counters, splash siege damage, automatic healing, defensive towers, formations, aggressive/hold stances, queued orders, box selection, type selection, and numbered control groups.
    - Fog of war, exploration, a working minimap, mission objectives, victory/defeat screens, match statistics, synthesized audio, pause, game speed, local saves, and campaign completion tracking.
    - Landscape-first touch interface, pinch zoom, drag pan, responsive menus, graphics presets, and automatic rendering resolution adjustment.
    
    ## Controls
    
    | Action | Laptop | Phone/tablet |
    |---|---|---|
    | Select | Left click; Shift adds; drag a selection box | Tap a unit or building |
    | Command | Right click; Shift queues | Select units, then tap ground, enemies, or resources |
    | Pan | WASD/arrows or middle-button drag | Drag the battlefield |
    | Zoom | Mouse wheel | Two-finger pinch |
    | Rotate | Q/E | Fixed tactical angle |
    | Center town | H or minimap home | Minimap home button |
    | Select army | M | Army button |
    | Idle villagers | Period | Idle button |
    | Construct | B | Build button |
    | Attack move | F, then click | Attack button, then tap |
    | Stop / hold | X | Stop button |
    | Groups | Ctrl + 1–9 assigns; 1–9 recalls | Army/type selection buttons |
    | Focus selection | Space | Tap minimap to navigate |
    | Pause | Esc | Pause button |
    
    Choose **Stone wall** and drag across visible, open land to place a connected line. Use **Shift** to keep other construction tools active. Select a completed military building to train troops, a blacksmith to research combat technologies, or the town center to advance ages. Use the in-game **Field guide** for costs and counters.
    
    ## Build, offline play, and tests
    
    ```powershell
    npm run build
    npm run preview
    npm test
    node scripts/browser-qa.mjs
    node scripts/interaction-qa.mjs
    ```
    
    The production output is in `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web host. The generated service worker caches the game and its bundled assets for offline use after the first successful visit over HTTPS (or localhost). The web app manifest requests fullscreen landscape when installed. Browser support for fullscreen, installation, and orientation locking varies. Optional Google Fonts use local serif/sans-serif fallbacks when unavailable. No game assets depend on a third-party CDN.
    
    The browser QA scripts use a locally installed Microsoft Edge. The first captures laptop and emulated landscape phone screenshots in `artifacts/`; the second checks gameplay interactions and a larger army. `npm test` covers simulation behavior, economy, construction, population, age progression, upgrades, combat, pathfinding, AI, saves, and each mode/map. Emulation does not substitute for testing on physical phones.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    - `src/data.js`: troops, buildings, research, civilizations, difficulties, maps, and missions.
    - `src/simulation.js`: deterministic map generation and independent fixed-step gameplay simulation. The opponent gathers, pays for buildings and units, advances ages, researches technologies, and attacks. Survival is explicitly a wave-spawn scenario.
    - `src/world.js`: procedural 3D models, camera, ray picking, shadows, fog, and combat effects. Forests and units use instanced rendering; buildings/resources merge geometry by material. Graphics adapt to sustained slow frames.
    - `src/main.js`: menus, responsive HUD, touch/mouse/keyboard controls, objectives, saves, and modal flows.
    - `src/audio.js`: synthesized cues and ambient music.
    - `vite.config.js`: build splitting and offline cache generation.
    
    ## Research and scope
    
    The design draws on the genre's established exploration → resource collection → construction → army → age progression loop and varied victory conditions described in the [official Age of Empires IV quickstart](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/quickstart-guide-age-of-empires-iv/) and [official strategy introduction](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-tips-to-help-you-get-started/). Picking and repeated-model rendering follow the [Three.js Raycaster](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html) and [InstancedMesh](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/InstancedMesh.html) documentation.
    
    This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Online multiplayer, naval warfare, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production matchmaking/backend service are not implemented. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.

      tickAI(){const m=this.options.mode;if(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(m)||this.mission?.survival)return;const owner=1,p=this.players[1],difficulty=DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty],tc=this.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0];if(!tc)return;

          const choices=Object.entries(UNITS).filter(([type,d])=>type!=='villager'&&type!=='scout'&&d.age<=p.age&&d.at.includes(b.type));

        this.players[1].age=Math.min(3,Math.floor(this.wave/3));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
          let type=i%3===0?'archer':'spearman';if(this.wave>=3&&i%4===0)type='knight';if(this.wave>=5&&i%8===0)type='ram';if(this.wave>=8&&i%10===0)type='catapult';

      tickShrines(dt){for(const s of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine')){const troops=[0,1].map(owner=>this.owned(owner,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&distance(s,e)<7).length);const side=troops[0]>0&&troops[1]===0?0:troops[1]>0&&troops[0]===0?1:-1;
          if(side>=0&&s.owner!==side){if(s.capturer!==side){s.capturer=side;s.progress=0;}s.progress+=dt;if(s.progress>=18){s.owner=side;s.progress=0;this.emit('capture',{owner:side});}}else if(side<0)s.progress=Math.max(0,s.progress-dt*.5);

      checkVictory(){if(this.options.mode==='sandbox')return;
        if(this.options.mode==='regicide'){if(!this.owned(0,'unit','king').length)this.end(false,'Your sovereign has fallen.');else if(!this.owned(1,'unit','king').length)this.end(true,'The rival sovereign is defeated. Your crown endures.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(0,'building','towncenter').length)return this.end(false,'Your last town center has fallen.');
        if(this.options.mode==='tutorial'){if(this.tutorialObjectives().every(o=>o.done))this.end(true,'Your first settlement is thriving. You are ready to rule.');return;}
        const survival=this.options.mode==='survival'||this.mission?.survival;if(survival){const max=this.mission?.waves||10;if(this.wave>=max&&!this.owned(1,'unit').length&&(!this.mission||this.owned(0,'building','keep').some(b=>b.progress>=1)))this.end(true,'Your kingdom endured every assault.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(1,'building','towncenter').length){if(this.options.mode==='campaign1'&&(!this.owned(0,'building','barracks').length||this.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='scout').length<6))return;if(this.options.mode==='campaign2'&&this.players[0].age<2)return;this.end(true,'The rival capital has fallen.     function renderSelection(){if(!playing)return;selection=selection.filter(id=>sim.get(id));view.selection=new Set(selection);const list=selected(),panel=$('#selection-panel');const key=JSON.stringify([sim.players[0].age,sim.players[0].tech,sim.players[0].formation,list.map(e=>[e.id,Math.round(e.hp),Math.round((e.progress||0)*100),Math.floor(e.carry||0),e.order?.type,e.queue?.map(q=>[q.type,Math.ceil(q.remaining)])])]);if(key===selectionKey)return;selectionKey=key;

    function renderHUD(){if(!playing)return;const p=sim.players[0];$('#resource-bar').innerHTML=['food','wood','gold','stone'].map(r=>`<div class="resource"><span class="resource-icon ${r}">${ICONS[r]}</span><strong>${Math.floor(p.resources[r])}</strong><small>${r==='wood'?'TIMBER':r.toUpperCase()}</small></div>`).join('')+`<div class="resource population ${sim.population(0)>=sim.capacity(0)?'full-pop':''}"><span class="resource-icon">â™Ÿ</span><strong>${sim.population(0)}<i>/${sim.capacity(0)}</i></strong><small>POPULATION</small></div>`;
      $('#age-label').textContent=AGES[p.age];$('#game-time').textContent=formatTime(sim.time);$('#speed-button').textContent=`${speed}Ã—`;
      const m=MODES.find(m=>m.id===sim.options.mode)||sim.mission;let objective=m.objective;
      if(sim.options.mode==='tutorial')objective=sim.tutorialObjectives().map((o,i)=>`<div class="lesson ${o.done?'done':''}"><span>${o.done?'âœ“':i+1}</span>${o.text}</div>`).join('');
      else objective=`<p>${objective}</p>`;
      let info='';if(sim.options.mode==='regicide'){const king=sim.owned(0,'unit','king')[0];info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>YOUR SOVEREIGN</span><strong>${king?Math.ceil(king.hp):0} HP ? Keep safe</strong></div>`;}if(sim.options.mode==='survival'||sim.mission?.survival)info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>WAVE ${sim.wave} / ${sim.mission?.waves||10}</span><strong>${sim.wave<(sim.mission?.waves||10)?`Next Â· ${formatTime(Math.max(0,sim.nextWave-sim.time))}`:'Eliminate remaining enemies'}</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='dominion'||sim.mission?.dominion)info=`<div class="shrine-status">${sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine').map(e=>`<span class="${e.owner===0?'owned':e.owner===1?'rival':''}">âœ§</span>`).join('')}<strong>${formatTime(sim.hold)} / 03:00</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='wonder')info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>YOUR MONUMENT</span><strong>${formatTime(sim.wonderTime[0])} / 04:00</strong></div>`;
      $('#objectives').innerHTML=`<div class="objective-eyebrow">${sim.mission?'CHAPTER '+sim.mission.chapter:m.tag.toUpperCase()}<span class="difficulty-tag">${DIFFICULTIES[sim.options.difficulty].name}</span></div><h3>${m.name}</h3>${objective}${info}`;
      $('#army-count').textContent=`${sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager').length} soldiers`;$('#map-label').textContent=sim.options.map.toUpperCase();$('#control-hint').textContent=touchDevice?'TAP TO COMMAND Â· PINCH TO ZOOM':'RIGHT-CLICK TO COMMAND';

    function renderMinimap(){const c=$('#minimap'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),size=c.width,scale=size/160;ctx.fillStyle={desert:'#8e8968',winter:'#b8c5b8',canyon:'#9a8875'}[sim.options.map]||'#6e7c59';ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
      if(['valley','rivers'].includes(sim.options.map)){for(const center of (sim.options.map==='rivers'?[-19,19]:[0])){ctx.strokeStyle='#72a3a5';ctx.lineWidth=(center?8:10)*scale;ctx.beginPath();for(let z=-80;z<=80;z+=2){const x=center+Math.sin(z*.045)*(center?3:4);ctx.lineTo((x+80)*scale,(z+80)*scale);}ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#ac9b75';ctx.fillRect((72+center)*scale,72*scale,16*scale,16*scale);}}
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&(e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||e.kind==='resource'&&sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){ctx.fillStyle=e.kind==='resource'?{wood:'#315b42',gold:'#e1bf69',stone:'#bac0b4',food:'#ab7560'}[e.type]:e.kind==='shrine'?(e.owner===0?'#91dbc9':e.owner===1?'#df8582':'#e3d3a2'):e.owner===0?'#b5e7dc':'#ed8b7b';const r=e.kind==='building'?Math.max(2,e.r*scale):e.kind==='unit'?1.6:1.5;ctx.fillRect((e.x+80)*scale-r,(e.z+80)*scale-r,r*2,r*2);}
      if(settings.fog)ctx.drawImage(view.fogCanvas,0,0,size,size);
      const points=[[0,0],[innerWidth,0],[innerWidth,innerHeight],[0,innerHeight]].map(([x,y])=>view.groundPoint(x,y));ctx.strokeStyle='#f0e8c4';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>{if(p)(i?ctx.lineTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale):ctx.moveTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale));});ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();
    }
    function renderHealth(){const layer=$('#health-layer');let html='';for(const e of sim.entities){if(e.hp<=0||e.kind==='resource'||e.kind==='shrine'||(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.hp>=e.maxHp&&e.progress!==undefined&&e.progress>=1)||e.owner===1&&!sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;if(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>=e.maxHp)continue;const p=view.project(e);if(p.visible&&p.x>0&&p.x<innerWidth&&p.y>50&&p.y<innerHeight-100)html+=`<div class="world-health ${e.owner===1?'rival':''}" style="left:${p.x}px;top:${p.y}px"><i style="width:${e.hp/e.maxHp*100}%"></i>${e.kind==='building'&&e.progress<1?`<small>${Math.floor(e.progress*100)}%</small>`:''}</div>`;}layer.innerHTML=html;}
    function menuReturn(){if(playing&&!sim.ended)saveGame(true);closeModal();playing=false;paused=false;cancelBuild();selection=[];view.selection.clear();$('#hud').classList.add('hidden');$('#landing').classList.remove('hidden');$('#resume').classList.toggle('hidden',!read('crowns-save',null));view.focus(-36,30);view.zoom=52;view.angle=-.35;view.updateCamera();updateRotate();}
    function action(name){audio.unlock();
      if(name==='close')return closeModal();if(name==='campaign')return showCampaign();if(name==='settings')return showSettings();if(name==='codex')return showCodex();if(name==='help')return showHelp();if(name==='dismiss-rotate'){portraitDismissed=true;return updateRotate();}
      if(name==='resume'){const save=read('crowns-save',null);if(save)try{startGame(save.options,save);}catch(error){toast('The saved kingdom could not be restored.','warning');}return;}
      if(name==='pause'){if(paused&&modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(name==='save'){saveGame();return;}if(name==='menu')return menuReturn();if(name==='restart')return startGame(sim.options);
      if(name==='apply-settings'){settings.quality=$('#quality').value;settings.volume=Number($('#volume').value);settings.music=$('#music').checked;settings.autoQuality=$('#auto-quality').checked;settings.fog=$('#fog').checked;view.quality(settings.quality);try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify(settings));}catch{}audio.unlock();closeModal();return;}
      if(name==='fullscreen'){document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.().then(()=>{screen.orientation?.lock?.('landscape').catch(()=>{});}).catch(()=>toast('Use your browser fullscreen control on this device.'));return;}
      if(!playing||sim.ended)return;
      if(name==='speed'){speed=speed===1?1.5:speed===1.5?2:1;return;}if(name==='home'){const tc=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(tc){view.focus(tc.x,tc.z);setSelection([tc.id]);}return;}
      if(name==='army'){setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager').map(e=>e.id));return;}
      if(name==='idle'){const idle=sim.owned(0,'unit','villager').filter(e=>!e.order);setSelection(idle.map(e=>e.id));if(idle.length)view.focus(idle[0].x,idle[0].z);else toast('Every villager has an assignment.');return;}
      if(name==='build')return toggleBuild();if(name==='cancel-build')return cancelBuild();
      if(name==='stop'){sim.stop(selection);return;}if(name==='auto-work'){for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.type==='villager')){e.order=null;sim.assignWorker(e);}toast('Villagers assigned to nearby resources.');return;}
      if(name==='attackmove'){attackMove=!attackMove;$('#attackmove').classList.toggle('active',attackMove);$('#order-hint').textContent=attackMove?'Choose a destination. Troops will fight enemies along the way.':'Select units to issue orders.';}
    }
    document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const el=event.target.closest('button,a[data-action]');if(!el)return;
      if(el.dataset.action)action(el.dataset.action);
      if(el.dataset.demolish){sim.demolish(Number(el.dataset.demolish));selectionKey='';renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.formation){sim.players[0].formation=el.dataset.formation;selectionKey='';renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.stance){for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit')){e.stance=el.dataset.stance;if(e.stance==='hold'){e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];}}toast(el.dataset.stance==='hold'?'Units will hold their position and defend.':'Units will engage nearby enemies.');}
      if(el.dataset.mode)showSetup(el.dataset.mode);
      if(el.dataset.start){const seed=Math.abs(Number($('#seed').value))||Math.floor(Math.random()*999999);startGame({mode:el.dataset.start,faction:$('#faction').value,difficulty:$('#difficulty').value,map:$('#map').value,seed});}
      if(el.dataset.codex)showCodex(el.dataset.codex);
      if(el.dataset.build){buildType=el.dataset.build;$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');$('#world').classList.add('placing');$('#order-hint').textContent=buildType==='wall'?'Drag across open land to place a wall line.':'Choose open land to place '+BUILDINGS[buildType].name+'.';}
      if(el.dataset.train){sim.train(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.train);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.research){sim.research(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.research);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.cancelQueue!==undefined){sim.cancelQueue(Number(el.dataset.building),Number(el.dataset.cancelQueue));renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.trade){sim.trade(el.dataset.trade,el.dataset.buy==='true');renderHUD();}
      if(el.dataset.selectType)setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit',el.dataset.selectType).map(e=>e.id));
    });
    document.addEventListener('change',updateSetupDescriptions);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA'].includes(event.target.tagName))return;const key=event.key.toLowerCase();if(!playing)return;
      if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(key))event.preventDefault();
      if(key==='escape'){if(buildType||!$('#build-panel').classList.contains('hidden'))cancelBuild();else if(modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(paused)return;keys.add(key);if(event.repeat)return;
      const actions={h:'home',m:'army',b:'build',f:'attackmove',x:'stop','.':'idle','?':'help'};if(actions[key])action(actions[key]);
      if(key===' '&&selection.length){const e=sim.get(selection[0]);if(e)view.focus(e.x,e.z);}
      if(/^[1-9]$/.test(key)){if(event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey){event.preventDefault();groups[key]=[...selection];toast(`Control group ${key} assigned.`);}else if(groups[key])setSelection(groups[key]);}
    });
    document.addEventListener('keyup',event=>keys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()));window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();if(playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended){paused=true;showPause();}});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&playing&&!sim.ended){saveGame(true);if(!paused)showPause();}});
    
    function updateRotate(){$('#rotate-hint').classList.toggle('show',playing&&touchDevice&&innerHeight>innerWidth&&!portraitDismissed);}
    export class AudioEngine {
      constructor(settings){this.settings=settings;this.context=null;this.musicTimer=0;this.note=0;}
      unlock(){if(!this.context){const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C)return;this.context=new C();this.master=this.context.createGain();this.master.connect(this.context.destination);}if(this.context.state==='suspended')this.context.resume();this.master.gain.value=this.settings.volume*.24;}
      tone(freq,duration=.15,type='sine',gain=.15,delay=0){if(!this.context||this.settings.volume<=0)return;const t=this.context.currentTime+delay,o=this.context.createOscillator(),g=this.context.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,t+.015);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(this.master);o.start(t);o.stop(t+duration+.02);}
      play(name){if(!this.context)return;this.master.gain.value=this.settings.volume*.24;
        if(name==='select'){this.tone(350,.08,'sine',.1);this.tone(525,.1,'sine',.06,.04);}
        if(name==='order'){this.tone(240,.08,'triangle');this.tone(320,.1,'triangle',.1,.06);}
        if(name==='coin'){this.tone(920,.18,'sine',.08);this.tone(1300,.18,'sine',.07,.1);}
        if(name==='complete'){[392,494,587].forEach((f,i)=>this.tone(f,.4,'triangle',.1,i*.1));}
        if(name==='alarm'){[146,146,196].forEach((f,i)=>this.tone(f,.35,'sawtooth',.055,i*.4));}
        if(name==='attack'&&Math.random()<.12)this.tone(70+Math.random()*60,.07,'triangle',.07);
        if(name==='victory'){[262,330,392,523].forEach((f,i)=>this.tone(f,.9,'triangle',.15,i*.24));}
      }
      tick(dt){if(!this.settings.music||!this.context)return;this.musicTimer-=dt;if(this.musicTimer<=0){this.musicTimer=2.8;const notes=[130.81,164.81,196,146.83,130.81,174.61,196,146.83];const f=notes[this.note++%notes.length];this.tone(f,3.5,'sine',.045);this.tone(f*2,2.8,'triangle',.018,.3);}}
    }

## Assistant

The multiplayer mode will use the laptop as the game server so both devices share one match state.

      for(const method of ['initialize','grid','buildValid','tickUnit','tickBuilding','hurt','smartCommand','assignWorker','tickAI','serialize','addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])original[method]=p[method];
      for(const method of ['addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])p[method]=function(...args){const entity=original[method].apply(this,args);this.index?.set(entity.id,entity);return entity;};
      p.get=function(id){if(!this.index)this.index=new Map(this.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));const e=this.index.get(id);return e?.hp>0?e:null;};
      const restore=Simulation.restore;
      Simulation.restore=function(data){const sim=restore.call(this,data);sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));sim.intel=data.intel||{};return sim;};
      p.initialize=function(){this.intel={};if(this.options.mode==='tides')this.options.map='coast';original.initialize.call(this);
        this.players.forEach(player=>{player.tech.seamanship??=0;});
        if(this.options.map==='coast'){
          this.players.forEach(player=>{player.age=Math.max(1,player.age);player.resources.wood+=350;player.resources.gold+=180;});
          for(const owner of [0,1]){
            if(owner===1&&['sandbox','tutorial'].includes(this.options.mode))continue;
            const sign=owner===0?-1:1;this.addBuilding('dock',owner,sign*19,owner===0?25:-25,true);
            const boat=this.addUnit('fishingboat',owner,sign*10,owner===0?24:-24);
            this.addUnit('galley',owner,sign*9,owner===0?14:-14);this.addUnit('transport',owner,sign*10,owner===0?34:-34);
            boat.order={type:'gather',target:null};
          }
          for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const fish=this.addResource('food',(this.rng()-.5)*17,-66+i*12,2200);fish.water=true;fish.r=2.1;}
          for(const e of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building')){e.maxHp=this.maxHP(e);e.hp=e.maxHp;}
          for(const boat of this.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='fishingboat'))this.assignWorker(boat);
          this.updateFog();
        }
      };
      const water=p.isWater;
      p.isWater=function(x,z){return this.options.map==='coast'?Math.abs(x-Math.sin(z*.03)*2)<14:water.call(this,x,z);};
      p.grid=function(owner,naval=false){if(!naval)return original.grid.call(this,owner);const key='sea'+owner;if(this.grids[key]?.revision===this.revision)return this.grids[key].data;
        const data=new Uint8Array(6400);for(let z=0;z<80;z++)for(let x=0;x<80;x++)data[z*80+x]=this.isWater(x*2-79,z*2-79)?0:1;this.grids[key]={revision:this.revision,data};return data;
      };
      p.buildValid=function(type,x,z,owner=0){if(type!=='dock')return original.buildValid.call(this,type,x,z,owner);
        if(Math.abs(x)>74||Math.abs(z)>74||this.isWater(x,z)||owner===0&&!this.isVisible(x,z))return false;
        let shore=false;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(this.isWater(x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*7,z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*7))shore=true;
        return shore&&!this.entities.some(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='building'&&distance(e,{x,z})<e.r+4.2);
      };
      p.spawnPoint=function(building,naval=false){const grid=this.grid(building.owner,naval);let best=null,score=Infinity;
        for(let x=-14;x<=14;x+=2)for(let z=-14;z<=14;z+=2){const point={x:building.x+x,z:building.z+z},cell=this.cell(point.x,point.z),n=Math.hypot(x,z);if(n>=building.r+1&&!grid[cell.z*80+cell.x]&&n<score){best=point;score=n;}}return best;
      };
      p.tickBuilding=function(e,dt){const before=this.nextId;original.tickBuilding.call(this,e,dt);for(let id=before;id<this.nextId;id++){const unit=this.get(id);if(unit?.kind!=='unit')continue;const spawn=this.spawnPoint(e,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval);if(spawn){unit.x=spawn.x;unit.z=spawn.z;unit.path=[];}
          if(unit.type==='fishingboat')this.assignWorker(unit);
        }
      };
      p.assignWorker=function(e){if(e.type==='fishingboat'){const fish=this.nearest(e,t=>t.kind==='resource'&&t.water&&t.amount>0);if(fish){e.gatherType='food';e.order={type:'gather',target:fish.id};e.path=[];}return;}original.assignWorker.call(this,e);};
      p.smartCommand=function(ids,target,x,z,append=false,attackMove=false,owner=0){

      };
      p.tickUnit=function(e,dt){
        if(e.embarked){const ship=this.get(e.transport);if(!ship){e.hp=0;return;}e.x=ship.x;e.z=ship.z;return;}
        if(e.order?.type==='board'){
          const ship=this.get(e.order.target);if(!ship||ship.owner!==e.owner||ship.type!=='transport'){this.finishOrder(e);return;}
          if((ship.passengers||[]).length>=8){this.finishOrder(e);return;}
          if(distance(e,ship)>6){this.move(e,ship,dt,5);return;}
          ship.passengers??=[];ship.passengers.push(e.id);e.embarked=true;e.transport=ship.id;e.order=null;e.path=[];this.emit('board',{entity:e,target:ship});return;
        }
        if(e.type==='fishingboat'){
          e.moving=false;e.cooldown=Math.max(0,e.cooldown-dt);const order=e.order;if(!order){this.assignWorker(e);return;}
          if(order.type!=='gather')return original.tickUnit.call(this,e,dt);
          const target=this.get(order.target);if(!target){this.assignWorker(e);return;}
          if(e.carry>=75||order.returning){order.returning=true;const dock=this.nearest(e,t=>t.owner===e.owner&&t.type==='dock'&&t.progress>=1);if(!dock)return;if(distance(e,dock)>dock.r+4){this.move(e,dock,dt,dock.r+3.5);return;}
            this.players[e.owner].resources.food+=e.carry;if(e.owner===0)this.stats.gathered+=e.carry;e.carry=0;e.carryType=null;order.returning=false;e.path=[];return;}
          if(distance(e,target)>target.r+2){this.move(e,target,dt,target.r+1.5);return;}
          const n=Math.min(75-e.carry,target.amount,dt*4*(1+this.players[e.owner].tech.economy*.25));e.carry+=n;e.carryType='food';target.amount-=n;if(target.amount<=0){target.hp=0;order.returning=true;}return;

      };
      p.hurt=function(e,amount,attacker){const hp=e.hp;original.hurt.call(this,e,amount,attacker);if(hp>0&&e.hp<=0&&e.kind==='unit'){this.revision--;for(const id of e.passengers||[]){const passenger=this.get(id);if(passenger)this.hurt(passenger,passenger.hp,attacker);}}};
      p.canSee=function(owner,entity){return this.owned(owner).some(e=>(e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building')&&!e.embarked&&distance(e,entity)<(e.kind==='unit'?UNITS[e.type].vision:BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18)+entity.r);};
      p.tickAI=function(){if(this.options.multiplayer)return;original.tickAI.call(this);if(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(this.options.mode)||this.mission?.survival)return;
        const player=this.players[1],tc=this.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0];if(!tc)return;
        const seen=this.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>this.canSee(1,e));for(const e of seen)this.intel[e.type]=this.time;
        const threat=seen.filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&distance(e,tc)<32);
        const army=this.owned(1,'unit').filter(e=>!['villager','fishingboat','king'].includes(e.type)&&!e.embarked);
        if(threat.length){this.command(army.filter(e=>!UNITS[e.type].naval).map(e=>e.id),{type:'attackmove',x:threat[0].x,z:threat[0].z});}
        if(seen.some(e=>UNITS[e.type].role==='cavalry'))for(const b of this.owned(1,'building','barracks'))if(b.progress>=1&&b.queue.length<2)this.train(b.id,'spearman');
        if(seen.some(e=>UNITS[e.type].role==='ranged')&&player.age>=2)for(const b of this.owned(1,'building','stable'))if(b.progress>=1&&b.queue.length<2)this.train(b.id,'knight');
        for(const building of this.owned(1,'building').filter(b=>b.progress>=1&&b.hp<b.maxHp*.55)){
          const worker=this.owned(1,'unit','villager').find(v=>!['repair','build'].includes(v.order?.type));if(worker)this.command([worker.id],{type:'repair',target:building.id});break;
        }
        if(this.options.map==='coast'){
          const dock=this.owned(1,'building','dock').find(b=>b.progress>=1);if(!dock)return;
          if(dock.queue.length<2){const fish=this.owned(1,'unit','fishingboat').length,transports=this.owned(1,'unit','transport').length;this.train(dock.id,fish<3?'fishingboat':!transports?'transport':player.age>=3?'warship':'galley');}
          const ships=army.filter(e=>UNITS[e.type].naval&&UNITS[e.type].damage);
          const target=this.owned(0,'unit').find(e=>UNITS[e.type].naval&&this.canSee(1,e))||this.owned(0,'building','dock')[0];
          if(target&&this.time>50)this.command(ships.map(e=>e.id),{type:'attack',target:target.id});
          for(const ship of this.owned(1,'unit','transport')){ship.passengers??=[];if(ship.passengers.length>=4){ship.order={type:'move',x:-10,z:30};continue;}const troops=army.filter(e=>!UNITS[e.type].naval&&!e.embarked&&e.order?.type!=='board').slice(0,8-ship.passengers.length);for(const e of troops)this.command([e.id],{type:'board',target:ship.id});}
        }
      };
