      }
      g.userData.model3d={kind:'unit',type:e.type,articulated:true};return g;
    }
    export function unitModel(view,e){ensureModels(view);return UNITS[e.type].naval?ship(view,e):['ram','catapult'].includes(e.type)?siege(view,e):human(view,e);}
    
    function cottage(view,g,owner,x,z,w=4,d=3.5,h=3.2){
      const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,roof=view.roofMaterials[owner],faction=view.sim?.players[owner].faction||'alder';
      b.box(m.stoneDark,x,.18,z,w+.25,.65,d+.25);b.box(m.plaster,x,h*.5+.38,z,w,h,d);
      if(faction==='sun'){
        b.box(m.stone,x,h+.45,z,w+.55,.25,d+.55);b.piece(view.geo.dome3d,roof,x,h+.58,z,w*.45,w*.4,d*.45);
        for(const side of [-1,1])for(const zz of [-1,1])b.box(m.stone,x+side*w*.44,h+.73,z+zz*d*.42,.35,.45,.35);
      }else{
        b.roof(roof,x,h+.36,z,w+.7,faction==='raven'?h*.8:h*.65,d+.7);
        b.rod(m.darkwood,[x-(w+.7)/2,h+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],[x,h*1.65+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],.075);
        b.rod(m.darkwood,[x+(w+.7)/2,h+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],[x,h*1.65+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],.075);
        b.box(m.darkwood,x,h*1.65+.38,z,.15,.15,d+.9);
      }
      for(const side of [-1,1]){
        for(const zz of [-.47,0,.47])b.box(m.darkwood,x+side*w*.505,h*.5+.38,z+zz*d,.12,h+.05,.14);
        for(const yy of [.6,h+.25])b.box(m.darkwood,x+side*w*.505,yy,z,.12,.14,d+.15);
        for(const zz of [-.23,.23]){
          b.box(m.wood,x+side*w*.52,h*.65,z+zz*d,.15,.88,.7);
          b.box(m.glass,x+side*w*.54,h*.65,z+zz*d,.025,.65,.5);
          b.box(m.wood,x+side*w*.555,h*.65,z+zz*d,.035,.66,.055);
        }
        b.box(m.wood,x+side*w*.29,h*.65,z+d*.515,.72,.87,.16);
        b.box(m.glass,x+side*w*.29,h*.65,z+d*.54,.51,.64,.025);
        b.box(m.wood,x+side*w*.29,h*.65,z+d*.55,.055,.65,.035);
      }
      b.box(m.darkwood,x,1.23,z+d*.512,.85,1.85,.13);b.arch(m.stone,x,.28,z+d*.55,1.15,1.8,.16);
      b.box(m.gold,x+.27,1.23,z+d*.58,.06,.07,.045);
      b.box(m.stoneDark,x,.15,z+d*.5+.37,1.4,.26,.8);b.box(m.stone,x,.3,z+d*.5+.18,1.1,.22,.43);
      b.box(m.brick,x+w*.27,h+.4,z-d*.17,.43,1.55,.5);
    }
    function turret(view,g,owner,x,z,h=7,r=1.25,covered=false){
      const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;
      b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,x,.3,z,r*1.16,.9,r*1.16);b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stone,x,h/2,z,r,h,r);
      for(const yy of [h*.18,h*.58,h-.2])b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,x,yy,z,r*1.035,.22,r*1.035);
      b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,x,h+.08,z,r*1.2,.32,r*1.2);
      for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/5;b.box(m.stone,x+Math.sin(a)*r*1.08,h+.58,z+Math.cos(a)*r*1.08,.42,.8,.45,a);}
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2;b.box(m.glass,x+Math.sin(a)*(r+.025),h*.65,z+Math.cos(a)*(r+.025),.21,1.15,.055,a);}
      if(covered)b.piece(view.geo.cone,view.roofMaterials[owner],x,h+1.9,z,r*1.45,3,r*1.45);
    }
    function trainingTarget(view,g,team,x,z){const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;b.rod(m.wood,[x,0,z],[x,1.8,z],.07);for(const [radius,material]of [[.58,m.straw],[.36,team],[.14,m.straw]]){const disc=b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,material,x,1.5,z+.02*(.58-radius),radius,.08,radius);disc.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;}}
    
    export function buildingModel(view,e){
      ensureModels(view);const g=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,o=e.owner,team=view.teamMaterials[o],type=e.type;
      if(type!=='farm'&&type!=='dock')b.box(m.stoneDark,0,-.14,0,e.r*1.9,.65,e.r*1.85);
      if(type==='house')cottage(view,g,o,0,0);
      else if(type==='towncenter'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-.8,4.5,4,4.5);cottage(view,g,o,-3,-1.3,2.6,3.2,2.8);cottage(view,g,o,3,-1.3,2.6,3.2,2.8);
        turret(view,g,o,0,-2.5,7.2,.82,true);
        b.box(m.wood,0,.44,2.5,6.5,.33,2.2);
        for(const x of [-2.8,2.8]){b.rod(m.darkwood,[x,.6,3.2],[x,2.6,3.2],.12);b.rod(m.darkwood,[x,2.6,3.2],[0,3.3,3.2],.09);}
        flag(view,g,team,0,8.8,1.6,1.2);crate(view,g,-2.4,.62,2.5);barrel(view,g,2.2,.62,2.5,.55);
      }else if(type==='mill'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-.4,3.6,3.8,5.1);
        const blades=new THREE.Group(),a=builder(view,blades);
        for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const arm=new THREE.Group(),r=builder(view,arm);r.rod(m.wood,[0,0,0],[0,3.1,0],.095);for(let k=0;k<5;k++)r.box(m.canvas,.28,1.35+k*.33,.02,.8,.2,.07);arm.rotation.z=i*Math.PI/2;blades.add(arm);}
        const merged=view.mergeModel(blades);merged.userData.windmill=true;merged.position.set(0,5.7,1.7);g.add(merged);barrel(view,g,2.2,0,1,.65);
      }else if(type==='camp'){
        for(const x of [-1.6,1.6])for(const z of [-1.2,1.2])b.rod(m.wood,[x,0,z],[x,2.3,z],.09);
        b.roof(view.roofMaterials[o],0,2.3,0,4,1.3,3.5);b.box(m.wood,0,.8,1.5,2.8,.16,1);
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++)b.rod(m.trunk,[-1.5+i*.45,.43,-1.4],[-1.5+i*.45,.43,1],.18);
        b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.wood,1.3,.5,1.4,.45,1,.45);b.rod(m.wood,[1.3,.9,1.4],[1.3,1.8,1.4],.035);b.box(m.steel,1.5,1.75,1.4,.35,.25,.12);
      }else if(type==='mine'){
        b.arch(m.wood,0,0,-.3,3.3,2.6,.5);b.box(m.darkwood,0,1,-.66,2.25,2,.07);
        for(const side of [-1,1])b.rod(m.wood,[side*1.9,0,.4],[0,3,.4],.12);
        b.box(m.wood,0,.7,1.8,1.7,.7,1.1);for(const x of [-1,1])wheel(view,g,x,.35,1.8,.35,false);
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++)b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.stone,-.7+i*.33,1.1,1.75,.25,.27,.29);barrel(view,g,-1.7,0,1,.6);
      }else if(type==='barracks'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-.8,6.2,3.8,3.4);flag(view,g,team,2.8,5.4,1.7,1);
        for(const x of [-2.5,2.5]){b.rod(m.wood,[x,0,2.5],[x,2.1,2.5],.08);b.rod(m.wood,[x-.7,1.8,2.5],[x+.7,1.8,2.5],.06);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){b.rod(m.wood,[x-.5+i*.5,.3,2.55],[x-.5+i*.5,2.6,2.55],.025);b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.steel,x-.5+i*.5,2.67,2.55,.07,.2,.04);}}
      }else if(type==='range'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-1.4,5.4,2.6,2.7);for(const x of [-2,0,2])trainingTarget(view,g,team,x,2.4);crate(view,g,2.7,0,-.6,.8);
      }else if(type==='stable'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-1.4,5.8,3.1,3.1);
        for(const x of [-2.4,0,2.4]){b.rod(m.wood,[x,0,2],[x,1.45,2],.09);b.rod(m.wood,[x,.55,.4],[x,.55,2.5],.06);b.rod(m.wood,[x,1.1,.4],[x,1.1,2.5],.06);}
        horse(view,g,false,false,[-1.2,0,1.2],.7);horse(view,g,false,false,[1.2,0,1.2],.7);b.box(m.wood,0,.4,2.7,3.8,.65,.8);
      }else if(type==='workshop'){
        cottage(view,g,o,0,-.8,6.8,4.5,3.5);b.arch(m.stoneDark,0,.1,1.7,3.1,2.8,.35);
        for(const x of [-2,2])wheel(view,g,x,.56,2.7,.56,false);b.box(m.wood,0,.83,2.7,3.5,.25,1.4);
        b.rod(m.wood,[0,1,2.7],[0,3.5,2.7],.1);b.rod(m.wood,[0,3.5,2.7],[0,3.9,4.0],.07);crate(view,g,-2.7,0,1.8,.85);

    export function resourceModel(view,e){

        for(let i=0;i<3;i++)b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,0,.12+i*.15,0,2.6-i*.35,.25,2.6-i*.35);
        for(const x of [-1.7,1.7])for(const z of [-1.7,1.7]){b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stone,x,2,z,.23,3.7,.23);b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,x,3.7,z,.36,.25,.36);}
        b.roof(m.stone,0,3.8,0,4.5,1.8,4.4);b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.relic,0,2.25,0,.45,.75,.45);b.piece(view.geo.ring3d,m.gold,0,2.3,0,.9,.9,.9);
      }else if(e.water){
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const x=Math.sin(i*2.3)*1.4,z=Math.cos(i*2.3)*1.4;b.oval(m.steel,x,-.12,z,.11,.08,.35);const tail=b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.slate,x,-.12,z-.37,.14,.22,.035);tail.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;}
      }else if(e.type==='food'){
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const x=Math.sin(i*2.3)*.7,z=Math.cos(i*2.3)*.7;b.rod(m.trunk,[x,0,z],[x,.6,z],.07);b.oval(m.leaf,x,.65,z,.68,.62,.63);for(let k=0;k<4;k++)b.oval(m.fruit,x+(rng()-.5)*.7,.9+rng()*.3,z+(rng()-.5)*.6,.075,.08,.08);}
      }else{
        for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const x=(rng()-.5)*2.7,z=(rng()-.5)*2.6,s=.5+rng()*.8,rock=b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,e.type==='gold'?m.stoneDark:m.stone,x,s*.52,z,s,s*.92,s*.83);rock.rotation.set(rng()*.4,rng()*6,rng()*.3);
          if(e.type==='gold')for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const nugget=b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.gold,x+(rng()-.5)*s,s*.9+rng()*.2,z+(rng()-.5)*s,.16,.12,.1);nugget.rotation.y=rng()*6;}
        }
        for(let i=0;i<9;i++)b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.stoneDark,(rng()-.5)*3.4,.13,(rng()-.5)*3.4,.16,.16,.2);
      }
      g.userData.model3d={kind:e.kind,type:e.water?'fish':e.type,volumetric:true};return g;
    }
    
    export function treeModel(view,map,variant=0){
      ensureModels(view);const g=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,rng=seededRandom(variant+128),pine=map==='winter',desert=map==='desert';
      b.rod(m.trunk,[0,0,0],[.07,4.5,0],.22);
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
        const a=i*2.4+variant,level=2.5+i*.48,x=Math.sin(a)*(1+i*.08),z=Math.cos(a)*(1+i*.08);
        b.rod(m.trunk,[0,level-.7,0],[x,level+.15,z],.075);
        if(pine){const leaves=b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.leafDark,0,2.9+i*.75,0,2.1-i*.35,2.6,2.1-i*.35);leaves.rotation.y=rng()*6;}
        else b.oval(i%2?m.leafDark:m.leaf,x*.55,level+.6,z*.55,1.25+rng()*.3,desert?.8:1.1+rng()*.3,1.3+rng()*.3);
      }
      g.userData.model3d={kind:'resource',type:'wood',volumetric:true};return g;

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {UNITS,seededRandom} from './data.js';
    import {Landscape,buildLandscape,animateWater} from './landscape.js';
    import {ensureModels,buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from './models-3d.js';
    
    function foundation(view,e){
      const r=e.r*.65;let height=view.landscape.heightAt(e.x,e.z);
      for(const x of [-r,r])for(const z of [-r,r])height=Math.max(height,view.landscape.heightAt(e.x+x,e.z+z));
      return height-.12;
    }
    function buildForest(view){
      view.forest=[];const trees=view.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='wood'&&e.hp>0),rng=seededRandom(view.sim.options.seed+191);
      for(let variant=0;variant<4;variant++){
        const entries=trees.filter(e=>e.id%4===variant);if(!entries.length)continue;
        const model=view.mergeModel(treeModel(view,view.sim.options.map,variant)),parts=[];
        model.traverse(part=>{if(!part.isMesh)return;const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(part.geometry,part.material,entries.length);mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.userData.treeIds=entries.map(e=>e.id);mesh.userData.model3d={kind:'resource',type:'wood'};view.objects.add(mesh);parts.push(mesh);});
        const matrices=entries.map(e=>{const dummy=new THREE.Object3D();dummy.position.set(e.x,view.landscape.heightAt(e.x,e.z),e.z);dummy.rotation.y=rng()*6.28;dummy.scale.setScalar(.75+rng()*.55);dummy.updateMatrix();return dummy.matrix.clone();});
        view.forest.push({entries,parts,matrices});
      }
      view.treeIndices.clear();view.forestFog(true);
    }
    function scaffold(view,e){
      const g=new THREE.Group(),m=view.materials,r=Math.max(1.6,e.r),h=Math.min(8,e.r*1.7);
      for(const x of [-r,r])for(const z of [-r,r])view.cylinder(g,m.wood,x,h/2,z,.055,h);
      for(const yy of [h*.33,h*.66,h])for(const side of [-1,1]){view.box(g,m.wood,0,yy,side*r,r*2,.10,.08);view.box(g,m.wood,side*r,yy,0,.08,.1,r*2);}
      for(const side of [-1,1]){const brace=view.box(g,m.wood,0,h*.5,side*r,.085,Math.hypot(r*2,h),.08);brace.rotation.z=Math.atan2(r*2,h);}
      return view.mergeModel(g);
    }
    
    export function installRealm3D(WorldView){
      const p=WorldView.prototype,attach=p.attach,render=p.render;
      p.attach=function(sim){
        this.landscape=new Landscape(sim.options.seed,sim.options.map);this.foundationHeights=new Map();this.forest=[];this.waterMeshes=[];
        attach.call(this,sim);this.scene.fog.near=115;this.scene.fog.far=275;
      };
      p.buildLandscape=function(){ensureModels(this);buildLandscape(this);};
      p.buildForest=function(){buildForest(this);};
      p.makeSea=function(){}; // The elevated landscape owns all river/coast meshes.
      p.makeBuilding=function(e){return buildingModel(this,e);};
      p.makeUnit=function(e){return unitModel(this,e);};
      p.groundHeight=function(x,z){return this.landscape?.heightAt(x,z)||0;};
      p.entityHeight=function(e,x=e.x,z=e.z){
        if(e.water||UNITS[e.type]?.naval)return .08;
        if(e.kind==='building'){if(!this.foundationHeights.has(e.id))this.foundationHeights.set(e.id,foundation(this,e));return this.foundationHeights.get(e.id);}
        return this.groundHeight(x,z);
      };
      p.forestFog=function(menu=false){
        const empty=this.emptyForestMatrix??=new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0,0,0);
        for(const batch of this.forest||[]){batch.entries.forEach((e,i)=>{const shown=e.hp>0&&(menu||this.settings.fog===false||this.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z));for(const part of batch.parts)part.setMatrixAt(i,shown?batch.matrices[i]:empty);});for(const part of batch.parts){part.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;part.boundingSphere=null;}}
      };
      p.foliageFog=function(menu){this.forestFog(menu);};
      p.createNode=function(e){
        let node;
        if(e.kind==='unit')node=this.unitNode(e);
        else node=this.mergeModel(e.kind==='building'?this.makeBuilding(e):resourceModel(this,e));
        node.position.set(e.x,this.entityHeight(e),e.z);node.userData.entity=e.id;node.userData.model3d={kind:e.kind,type:e.water?'fish':e.type};
        node.traverse(child=>child.userData.entity=e.id);this.objects.add(node);this.nodes.set(e.id,node);
        if(e.owner===0){const ring=new THREE.Mesh(this.geo.ring,new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xc5eee2,transparent:true,opacity:.9,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false}));ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;ring.position.y=.07;ring.scale.setScalar(e.r+.45);ring.visible=false;node.add(ring);node.userData.ring=ring;}
        return node;
      };
      p.updateConstruction=function(e,node){
        if(e.progress<1){
          if(!node.userData.construction){
            const plane=new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0),0),materials=[],restore=[];
            node.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh||mesh===node.userData.ring)return;const original=mesh.material,clipped=original.clone();clipped.clippingPlanes=[plane];clipped.clipShadows=true;mesh.material=clipped;materials.push(clipped);restore.push([mesh,original]);});
            const frame=scaffold(this,e);node.add(frame);node.userData.construction={plane,materials,restore,frame};this.renderer.localClippingEnabled=true;
          }
          node.userData.construction.plane.constant=node.position.y+Math.max(.18,e.progress*13);
        }else if(node.userData.construction){
          const data=node.userData.construction;for(const [mesh,material]of data.restore)mesh.material=material;for(const material of data.materials)material.dispose();data.frame.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh.isMesh)mesh.geometry.dispose();});node.remove(data.frame);delete node.userData.construction;
        }
      };
      p.showGhost=function(type,x,z,valid){
        if(this.ghost.userData.type!==type){
          this.ghost.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh.isMesh){if(!Object.values(this.geo).includes(mesh.geometry))mesh.geometry.dispose();if(mesh.userData.previewMaterial)mesh.material.dispose();}});this.clearGroup(this.ghost);
          const model=this.mergeModel(buildingModel(this,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:2.5,x,z}));
          model.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;mesh.material=mesh.material.clone();mesh.material.transparent=true;mesh.material.opacity=.38;mesh.material.depthWrite=false;mesh.material.clippingPlanes=null;mesh.castShadow=false;mesh.userData.previewMaterial=true;});this.ghost.add(model);this.ghost.userData.type=type;
        }
        this.ghost.position.set(x,this.groundHeight(x,z),z);this.ghost.visible=true;
        this.ghost.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh.isMesh)mesh.material.color.setHex(valid?0x8de3c5:0xee816a);});
      };
      p.render=function(dt,menu){
        animateWater(this);
        if(this.materials.glow)this.materials.glow.emissiveIntensity=1.4+Math.sin(this.clock*8)*.25;
        for(const e of this.sim?.entities||[]){
          const node=this.nodes.get(e.id);if(!node)continue;
          const gate=node.userData.portcullis;
          if(gate){const nearby=this.sim.entities.some(u=>u.hp>0&&u.kind==='unit'&&u.owner===e.owner&&!u.embarked&&!UNITS[u.type].naval&&Math.hypot(u.x-e.x,u.z-e.z)<5.5),desired=nearby?2.5:0;gate.position.y+=(desired-gate.position.y)*Math.min(1,dt*6);}
        }
        render.call(this,dt,menu);
        if(this.forestRefresh===undefined||this.clock-this.forestRefresh>.45){this.forestFog(menu);this.forestRefresh=this.clock;}
      };
    }

        this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe3ece7,0x415039,1.4));const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe1bd,3);sun.position.set(-3,5,4);this.scene.add(sun);

      }

      }

        if(this.key===key)return;this.clear();this.key=key;

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,MAPS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);
        for(const [type,data]of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
        for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const model=unitModel(v,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
      }
    });
    test('forests, fruit, mineral deposits, fish and shrines use volumetric mesh models',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture();for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:51,kind:'resource',type}));
      solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}));solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}));
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS))for(let i=0;i<4;i++)solidBounds(treeModel(v,map,i));
    });
    test('batching preserves model bounds and articulated joints remain animated',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),e={id:31,kind:'unit',type:'knight',owner:0,moving:true,cooldown:0};
      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});
      v.mergeModel(model);const after=solidBounds(model),parts=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)parts.push(m);});
      assert.ok(parts.length<raw.length);assert.ok(before.min.distanceTo(after.min)<.0001);assert.ok(before.max.distanceTo(after.max)<.0001);
      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);
    });

    The browser QA scripts use a locally installed Microsoft Edge. `release-qa.mjs` tests a real room with desktop and emulated phone clients, both command perspectives, phone troop training, and reconnecting after a reload. It defaults to a test server on port 4180; set `QA_URL` to another server URL as needed. `npm test` also runs a real WebSocket test for fair starts, ownership rejection, fog masking, disconnect pauses, and session restoration. Emulation does not substitute for testing on physical phones.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    - `src/data.js`: troops, buildings, research, civilizations, difficulties, maps, and missions.
    - `src/simulation.js`: deterministic map generation and independent fixed-step gameplay simulation. The opponent gathers, pays for buildings and units, advances ages, researches technologies, and attacks. Survival is explicitly a wave-spawn scenario.
    - `src/world.js`: procedural 3D models, camera, ray picking, shadows, fog, and combat effects. Forests and units use instanced rendering; buildings/resources merge geometry by material. Graphics adapt to sustained slow frames.
    - `src/main.js`: menus, responsive HUD, touch/mouse/keyboard controls, objectives, saves, and modal flows.
    - `src/audio.js`: synthesized cues and ambient music.
    - `src/frontiers.js`: naval mechanics and tactical AI additions.
    - `src/navigation.js`: heap-based pathfinding.
    - `src/world-polish.js`: articulated model animation, ship models, material textures, and exploration-aware foliage.
    - `src/soundscape.js`: battle sounds and atmospheric audio.
    - `src/network.js`: room connection, commands, and session reconnection.
    - `server/rooms.js`: authoritative Wi-Fi matches, player perspectives, command validation, disconnect handling, and room lifecycle.
    - `server/index.js`: local game hosting and WebSocket server.
    - `vite.config.js`: build splitting and offline cache generation.
    
    ## Research and scope
    
    The design draws on the genre's established exploration → resource collection → construction → army → age progression loop and varied victory conditions described in the [official Age of Empires IV quickstart](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/quickstart-guide-age-of-empires-iv/) and [official strategy introduction](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-tips-to-help-you-get-started/). Picking and repeated-model rendering follow the [Three.js Raycaster](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html) and [InstancedMesh](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/InstancedMesh.html) documentation.
    
    Instanced animation follows the [Three.js update documentation](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/how-to-update-things.html). Room transport and heartbeat handling follow the [official ws documentation](https://github.com/websockets/ws). The naval design considers fishing economies, transport landings, and shoreline defense described in the [official Age of Empires naval update](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-11-0-782/).
    
    This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Two-player Wi-Fi gameplay is implemented; public internet matchmaking, accounts, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production-scale backend service are not. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.

    +# Realm in depth — version 2.1
    +
    +- Rebuilt all 19 building models and all 14 troop/ship/sovereign models, with faction architecture, solid folded sails and banners, shaped humanoids and horses, and articulated limbs, wheels, oars, rams, and trebuchets.
    +- Rebuilt trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines as volumetric models.
    +- Replaced flat ground and cone-shaped map borders with seeded terrain and ridges. Picking, actors, foundations, fog, construction previews, and effects follow the triangulated terrain surface.
    +- Moving water vertices, submerged naval basins, dry bridges, lifting gate portcullises, construction scaffolds/clipping, and actual 3D building previews.
    +- Live WebGL selection portraits, object inspection on mouse/touch, closer perspectives, and a button to hide battlefield panels.
    +- Visible forests pack into near/far instanced batches with solid geometry at both detail levels. Camera obstruction handling, efficient crop geometry, bounded portrait refresh, and cleanup between maps.

      $('#army-count').textContent=`${sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='fishingboat'&&!e.embarked).length} soldiers`;$('#map-label').textContent=sim.options.map.toUpperCase();$('#control-hint').textContent=net.active?`ROOM ${net.code} | ${net.ping}ms`:touchDevice?'TAP TO COMMAND · PINCH TO ZOOM':'RIGHT-CLICK TO COMMAND';
      renderMinimap();renderHealth();
    }
    function renderMinimap(){const c=$('#minimap'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),size=c.width,scale=size/160;ctx.fillStyle={desert:'#8e8968',winter:'#b8c5b8',canyon:'#9a8875'}[sim.options.map]||'#6e7c59';ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
      if(['valley','rivers'].includes(sim.options.map)){for(const center of (sim.options.map==='rivers'?[-19,19]:[0])){ctx.strokeStyle='#72a3a5';ctx.lineWidth=(center?8:10)*scale;ctx.beginPath();for(let z=-80;z<=80;z+=2){const x=center+Math.sin(z*.045)*(center?3:4);ctx.lineTo((x+80)*scale,(z+80)*scale);}ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#ac9b75';ctx.fillRect((72+center)*scale,72*scale,16*scale,16*scale);}}
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&(e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||e.kind==='resource'&&sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){ctx.fillStyle=e.kind==='resource'?{wood:'#315b42',gold:'#e1bf69',stone:'#bac0b4',food:'#ab7560'}[e.type]:e.kind==='shrine'?(e.owner===0?'#91dbc9':e.owner===1?'#df8582':'#e3d3a2'):e.owner===0?'#b5e7dc':'#ed8b7b';const r=e.kind==='building'?Math.max(2,e.r*scale):e.kind==='unit'?1.6:1.5;ctx.fillRect((e.x+80)*scale-r,(e.z+80)*scale-r,r*2,r*2);}
      if(sim.options.map==='coast'){ctx.fillStyle='#7eafb4';ctx.fillRect(66*scale,0,28*scale,size);}
      if(settings.fog)ctx.drawImage(view.fogCanvas,0,0,size,size);
      const points=[[0,0],[innerWidth,0],[innerWidth,innerHeight],[0,innerHeight]].map(([x,y])=>view.groundPoint(x,y));ctx.strokeStyle='#f0e8c4';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>{if(p)(i?ctx.lineTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale):ctx.moveTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale));});ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();
    }
    function renderHealth(){const layer=$('#health-layer');let html='';for(const e of sim.entities){if(e.hp<=0||e.kind==='resource'||e.kind==='shrine'||(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.hp>=e.maxHp&&e.progress!==undefined&&e.progress>=1)||e.owner===1&&!sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;if(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>=e.maxHp)continue;const p=view.project(e);if(p.visible&&p.x>0&&p.x<innerWidth&&p.y>50&&p.y<innerHeight-100)html+=`<div class="world-health ${e.owner===1?'rival':''}" style="left:${p.x}px;top:${p.y}px"><i style="width:${e.hp/e.maxHp*100}%"></i>${e.kind==='building'&&e.progress<1?`<small>${Math.floor(e.progress*100)}%</small>`:''}</div>`;}layer.innerHTML=html;}
    function menuReturn(){if(net.active)net.leave();if(playing&&!sim.ended)saveGame(true);closeModal();playing=false;paused=false;cancelBuild();selection=[];view.selection.clear();$('#hud').classList.add('hidden');$('#landing').classList.remove('hidden');$('#resume').classList.toggle('hidden',!read('crowns-save',null));view.focus(-36,30);view.zoom=52;view.angle=-.35;view.updateCamera();updateRotate();}
    function action(name){audio.unlock();
      if(name==='lan')return showLan();if(name==='lan-host')return connectLan(true);if(name==='lan-join')return connectLan(false);if(name==='lan-start'){net.send({type:'start'});return;}if(name==='lan-leave'){net.leave();closeModal();return;}if(name==='lan-resume'){net.connect({type:'resume',...net.session});showModal('<h2>Rejoining your kingdom…</h2>','lan');return;}if(name==='unload'){unloadMode=true;$('#order-hint').textContent='Choose open shore within 11 meters of the transport.';return;}if(name==='close')return closeModal();if(name==='campaign')return showCampaign();if(name==='settings')return showSettings();if(name==='codex')return showCodex();if(name==='help')return showHelp();if(name==='dismiss-rotate'){portraitDismissed=true;return updateRotate();}
      if(name==='resume'){const save=read('crowns-save',null);if(save)try{startGame(save.options,save);}catch(error){toast('The saved kingdom could not be restored.','warning');}return;}
      if(name==='pause'){if(paused&&modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(name==='save'){saveGame();return;}if(name==='menu')return menuReturn();if(name==='restart'){if(net.active){net.leave();menuReturn();showLan();return;}return startGame(sim.options);}
      if(name==='apply-settings'){settings.quality=$('#quality').value;settings.volume=Number($('#volume').value);settings.music=$('#music').checked;settings.autoQuality=$('#auto-quality').checked;settings.fog=$('#fog').checked;view.quality(settings.quality);view.setCameraPreset($('#camera-preset').value,$('#camera-preset').value!==settings.cameraPreset);updateCameraLabel();try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify(settings));}catch{}audio.unlock();closeModal();return;}
      if(name==='fullscreen'){document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.().then(()=>{screen.orientation?.lock?.('landscape').catch(()=>{});}).catch(()=>toast('Use your browser fullscreen control on this device.'));return;}
      if(!playing||sim.ended)return;
      if(name.startsWith('camera-')){if(name==='camera-panels'){const hidden=$('#hud').classList.toggle('panels-hidden');$('[data-action=camera-panels]').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(hidden));return;}if(name==='camera-left')view.angle+=Math.PI/8;else if(name==='camera-right')view.angle-=Math.PI/8;else if(name==='camera-closer')view.zoomBy(-6);else if(name==='camera-farther')view.zoomBy(6);else if(name==='camera-view'){const presets=Object.keys(CAMERA_PRESETS);view.setCameraPreset(presets[(presets.indexOf(settings.cameraPreset)+1)%presets.length],true);updateCameraLabel();try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify(settings));}catch{}}view.updateCamera();return;}
      if(name==='inspect'){const e=selected()[0];if(e){view.setCameraPreset('cinematic',true);view.angle=Math.PI/4;view.focus(e.x,e.z);view.target.y=view.entityHeight(e)+(e.kind==='building'?3:e.kind==='unit'?(UNITS[e.type].naval?2.2:1):1);view.zoom=e.kind==='unit'?(UNITS[e.type].naval?26:['ram','catapult'].includes(e.type)?22:16):e.kind==='building'?Math.max(24,e.r*6):20;view.updateCamera();view.forestFog(false);updateCameraLabel();toast('Drag to pan, rotate with the arrows, and pinch or scroll to zoom.');}return;}
      if(name==='speed'){if(net.active)return toast('Network matches run at a shared 1× speed.');speed=speed===1?1.5:speed===1.5?2:1;return;}if(name==='home'){const tc=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(tc){view.focus(tc.x,tc.z);setSelection([tc.id]);}return;}
      if(name==='army'){setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='fishingboat'&&!e.embarked).map(e=>e.id));return;}
      if(name==='idle'){const idle=sim.owned(0,'unit','villager').filter(e=>!e.order);setSelection(idle.map(e=>e.id));if(idle.length)view.focus(idle[0].x,idle[0].z);else toast('Every villager has an assignment.');return;}
      if(name==='build')return toggleBuild();if(name==='cancel-build')return cancelBuild();
      if(name==='stop'){sim.stop(selection);return;}if(name==='auto-work'){for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.type==='villager')){e.order=null;sim.assignWorker(e);}toast('Villagers assigned to nearby resources.');return;}
      if(name==='attackmove'){attackMove=!attackMove;$('#attackmove').classList.toggle('active',attackMove);$('#order-hint').textContent=attackMove?'Choose a destination. Troops will fight enemies along the way.':'Select units to issue orders.';}
    }
    document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const el=event.target.closest('button,a[data-action]');if(!el)return;
      if(el.dataset.action)action(el.dataset.action);
      if(el.dataset.demolish){sim.demolish(Number(el.dataset.demolish));selectionKey='';renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.formation){if(net.active)net.action('formation',[el.dataset.formation]);sim.players[0].formation=el.dataset.formation;selectionKey='';renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.stance){if(net.active)net.action('stance',[selection,el.dataset.stance]);for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit')){e.stance=el.dataset.stance;if(e.stance==='hold'){e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];}}toast(el.dataset.stance==='hold'?'Units will hold their position and defend.':'Units will engage nearby enemies.');}
      if(el.dataset.mode)showSetup(el.dataset.mode);
      if(el.dataset.start){const seed=Math.abs(Number($('#seed').value))||Math.floor(Math.random()*999999);startGame({mode:el.dataset.start,faction:$('#faction').value,difficulty:$('#difficulty').value,map:$('#map').value,seed});}
      if(el.dataset.codex)showCodex(el.dataset.codex);
      if(el.dataset.build){buildType=el.dataset.build;$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');$('#world').classList.add('placing');$('#order-hint').textContent=buildType==='wall'?'Drag across open land to place a wall line.':'Choose open land to place '+BUILDINGS[buildType].name+'.';}
      if(el.dataset.train){sim.train(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.train);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.research){sim.research(Number(el.dataset.building),el.dataset.research);renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.cancelQueue!==undefined){sim.cancelQueue(Number(el.dataset.building),Number(el.dataset.cancelQueue));renderSelection();}
      if(el.dataset.trade){sim.trade(el.dataset.trade,el.dataset.buy==='true');renderHUD();}
      if(el.dataset.selectType)setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit',el.dataset.selectType).map(e=>e.id));
    });
    document.addEventListener('change',updateSetupDescriptions);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA'].includes(event.target.tagName))return;const key=event.key.toLowerCase();if(!playing)return;
      if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(key))event.preventDefault();
      if(key==='escape'){if(buildType||!$('#build-panel').classList.contains('hidden'))cancelBuild();else if(modal)closeModal();else showPause();return;}
      if(paused)return;keys.add(key);if(event.repeat)return;
      const actions={i:'inspect',v:'camera-view',h:'home',m:'army',b:'build',f:'attackmove',x:'stop','.':'idle','?':'help'};if(actions[key])action(actions[key]);
      if(key===' '&&selection.length){const e=sim.get(selection[0]);if(e)view.focus(e.x,e.z);}
      if(/^[1-9]$/.test(key)){if(event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey){event.preventDefault();groups[key]=[...selection];toast(`Control group ${key} assigned.`);}else if(groups[key])setSelection(groups[key]);}
    });
    document.addEventListener('keyup',event=>keys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()));window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();if(playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended){paused=true;showPause();}});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)audio.context?.suspend();else audio.context?.resume().catch(()=>{});if(document.hidden&&playing&&!sim.ended){saveGame(true);if(!paused)showPause();}});
    
    function updateRotate(){$('#rotate-hint').classList.toggle('show',playing&&touchDevice&&innerHeight>innerWidth&&!portraitDismissed);}
    window.addEventListener('resize',updateRotate);
    function issue(point,target,append=false){if(!point)return;const ids=selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0).map(e=>e.id);if(!ids.length)return;sim.smartCommand(ids,target,point.x,point.z,append,attackMove);view.mark(point.x,point.z);if(attackMove){attackMove=false;$('#attackmove').classList.remove('active');}renderSelection();}
    function place(point,event){if(!point||!buildType)return;const result=sim.build(buildType,point.x,point.z,workers());if(result){view.mark(point.x,point.z);if(!event.shiftKey&&buildType!=='wall')cancelBuild();}renderHUD();}
    if(view){const canvas=view.renderer.domElement;canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());canvas.style.touchAction='none';
      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{audio.unlock();if(!playing||paused||sim.ended)return;canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);touches.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});if(touches.size===2){const pts=[...touches.values()];pinch={distance:Math.hypot(pts[0].x-pts[1].x,pts[0].y-pts[1].y),angle:Math.atan2(pts[1].y-pts[0].y,pts[1].x-pts[0].x)};if(pointer)pointer.pinched=true;return;}
        pointer={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,lastX:e.clientX,lastY:e.clientY,button:e.button,touch:e.pointerType==='touch',dragged:false,start:view.groundPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY),pinched:false};
      });
      canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{hover={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};if(!playing||paused)return;const p=view.groundPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(buildType&&p)view.showGhost(buildType,p.x,p.z,sim.buildValid(buildType,p.x,p.z));
        if(touches.has(e.pointerId))touches.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});if(touches.size===2&&pinch){const pts=[...touches.values()],d=Math.hypot(pts[0].x-pts[1].x,pts[0].y-pts[1].y);const angle=Math.atan2(pts[1].y-pts[0].y,pts[1].x-pts[0].x),delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-pinch.angle),Math.cos(angle-pinch.angle));view.angle-=delta;view.zoomBy((pinch.distance-d)*.1);pinch.distance=d;pinch.angle=angle;return;}
        if(!pointer)return;const dx=e.clientX-pointer.lastX,dy=e.clientY-pointer.lastY;if(Math.hypot(e.clientX-pointer.x,e.clientY-pointer.y)>8)pointer.dragged=true;
        if(pointer.dragged){if(buildType==='wall'){$('#selection-box').style.display='none';}else if(pointer.touch||pointer.button===1){view.pan(-dx*view.zoom/innerHeight, -dy*view.zoom/innerHeight);}else if(pointer.button===0){const box=$('#selection-box');box.style.display='block';box.style.left=Math.min(e.clientX,pointer.x)+'px';box.style.top=Math.min(e.clientY,pointer.y)+'px';box.style.width=Math.abs(e.clientX-pointer.x)+'px';box.style.height=Math.abs(e.clientY-pointer.y)+'px';}}
        pointer.lastX=e.clientX;pointer.lastY=e.clientY;
      });
      canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{touches.delete(e.pointerId);pinch=null;$('#selection-box').style.display='none';if(!pointer||paused){pointer=null;return;}const old=pointer;pointer=null;if(old.pinched)return;const point=view.groundPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY),target=view.pick(e.clientX,e.clientY);
        if(buildType){if(buildType==='wall'&&old.dragged&&old.start&&point){const len=distance(old.start,point),n=Math.min(45,Math.floor(len/2.85));let built=0;const ws=workers();for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=n?i/n:0;const b=sim.build('wall',old.start.x+(point.x-old.start.x)*t,old.start.z+(point.z-old.start.z)*t,ws,0,built>0);if(b){built++;}}toast(`${built} wall segments placed.`);renderHUD();}else if(!old.dragged)place(point,e);return;}
        if(old.dragged){if(!old.touch&&old.button===0){const minX=Math.min(old.x,e.clientX),maxX=Math.max(old.x,e.clientX),minY=Math.min(old.y,e.clientY),maxY=Math.max(old.y,e.clientY);const units=sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(unit=>{const p=view.project(unit);return p.visible&&p.x>=minX&&p.x<=maxX&&p.y>=minY&&p.y<=maxY;});setSelection(e.shiftKey?[...selection,...units.map(u=>u.id)]:units.map(u=>u.id));}return;}
        if(unloadMode&&point){const ship=selected().find(e=>e.type==='transport');if(ship&&sim.unload(ship.id,point.x,point.z)){unloadMode=false;view.mark(point.x,point.z);}return;}
        if(old.button===2||attackMove){issue(point,target,e.shiftKey);return;}

      canvas.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{if(!playing||paused)return;const target=view.pick(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(target?.owner===0&&target.kind==='unit')setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit',target.type).filter(unit=>distance(unit,target)<40).map(unit=>unit.id));});

      $('#minimap').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!playing||paused)return;const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*160-80,z=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*160-80;if(e.button===2)issue({x,z},null,e.shiftKey);else view.focus(x,z);});$('#minimap').addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
    }
    function frame(now){const dt=Math.min(.08,(now-last)/1000);last=now;
      if(view){if(playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended){const pan=dt*view.zoom*.42;if(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup'))view.pan(0,-pan);if(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown'))view.pan(0,pan);if(keys.has('a')||keys.has('arrowleft'))view.pan(-pan,0);if(keys.has('d')||keys.has('arrowright'))view.pan(pan,0);if(keys.has('q')){view.angle+=dt;view.updateCamera();}if(keys.has('e')){view.angle-=dt;view.updateCamera();}
          accumulator+=dt*speed;while(accumulator>=.1){if(!net.active)sim.tick(.1);accumulator-=.1;}uiTime+=dt;fogTime+=dt;if(fogTime>.5){view.updateFog();fogTime=0;}if(uiTime>.3){renderHUD();renderSelection();uiTime=0;}if(sim.time-lastAutosave>60){saveGame(true);lastAutosave=sim.time;}
        }
        view.adapt(dt);view.render(dt,!playing);audio.tick(dt);
      }requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    // Expose the running game for reproducible browser QA and debugging.
    window.frontier={get sim(){return sim;},get view(){return view;},get playing(){return playing;},get paused(){return paused;},start:startGame,select:setSelection,action,save:saveGame};
    
    if(import.meta.env.PROD&&'serviceWorker' in navigator)window.addEventListener('load',()=>navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(()=>{}));
    
    document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key!=='Tab'||!modal)return;const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('#modal-root button:not(:disabled),#modal-root input,#modal-root select,#modal-root a')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null);if(!buttons.length)return;const first=buttons[0],last=buttons.at(-1);if(event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){event.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){event.preventDefault();first.focus();}});
    
    function showLan(){if(net.active)return showPause();showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">TWO COMMANDERS. ONE FRONTIER.</div><h2>Meet on the battlefield.</h2><p class="modal-intro">Both devices open this laptop's Wi-Fi game link. Create a room, share its six-character code, and challenge a friend. The host starts once both commanders join.</p><div class="setup-grid"><div><label class="field-label" for="lan-name">COMMANDER NAME</label><input id="lan-name" maxlength="24" value="Commander"></div><div><label class="field-label" for="lan-faction">CIVILIZATION</label><select id="lan-faction">${Object.entries(FACTIONS).map(([id,f])=>`<option value="${id}">${f.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div><label class="field-label" for="lan-mode">VICTORY CONDITION</label><select id="lan-mode">${MODES.filter(m=>['skirmish','regicide','dominion','wonder','tides'].includes(m.id)).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}">${m.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div><label class="field-label" for="lan-map">BATTLEFIELD</label><select id="lan-map">${Object.entries(MAPS).map(([id,m])=>`<option value="${id}">${m.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><button class="primary full lan-create" data-action="lan-host">Create a room <span>➜</span></button><div class="lan-join"><input id="lan-code" maxlength="6" placeholder="ROOM CODE" aria-label="Room code"><button class="secondary" data-action="lan-join">Join a room ↗</button></div>${net.session?'<button class="text-button" data-action="lan-resume">Rejoin your previous network session</button>':''}<p class="settings-note">Wi-Fi multiplayer requires the game server started with <b>npm start</b>. Matches pause during a connection interruption and allow up to two minutes to reconnect.</p>`,'lan',true);}
    function connectLan(host){const name=$('#lan-name').value.trim()||'Commander',faction=$('#lan-faction').value,mode=$('#lan-mode').value,map=$('#lan-map').value,room=$('#lan-code').value.trim().toUpperCase();if(!host&&!/^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test(room))return toast('Enter the six-character room code.','warning');
      if(net.socket)net.leave();net.connect(host?{type:'create',name,faction,options:{mode,map,seed:Math.floor(Math.random()*999999)}}:{type:'join',name,faction,code:room});showModal('<div class="eyebrow">PREPARING THE FRONTIER</div><h2>Connecting…</h2><p class="modal-intro">Contacting the game server on this laptop.</p><button class="secondary" data-action="lan-leave">Cancel</button>','lan');}
    const net=new LanClient({
      notice:message=>{toast(message,'warning');if(!net.active&&modal==='lan'&&!$('#lan-name'))showLan();},

    const cursors=new Map();
    
    function edgeVector(x,y,width,height){
      if(x<0||y<0||x>=width||y>=height)return{x:0,y:0};
      const band=Math.min(24,width/4,height/4);
      const strength=distance=>{const t=1-distance/band;return t*t*(3-2*t);};
      let dx=x<band?-strength(x):x>width-band?strength(width-x):0;
      let dy=y<band?-strength(y):y>height-band?strength(height-y):0;
      const length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(length>1){dx/=length;dy/=length;}
      return{x:dx,y:dy};
    }
    function arrowCursor(x,y){
      const sx=Math.sign(x),sy=Math.sign(y),key=`${sx}:${sy}`;
      if(!cursors.has(key)){
        const angle=Math.atan2(sx,-sy)*180/Math.PI;
        const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><g transform="rotate(${angle} 16 16)"><path d="M16 2 6 14h6v14h8V14h6Z" fill="#f1d79b" stroke="#182d25" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="m16 6-5 6h4v12" fill="none" stroke="#fff5d9" stroke-width="1.4"/></g></svg>`;
        cursors.set(key,`url("data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}") 16 16, auto`);
      }
      return cursors.get(key);
    }

          this.point={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY,buttons:event.buttons};
        };
        // Track the whole viewport so the header/footer do not swallow an edge.
        document.addEventListener('pointermove',track,{passive:true});
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown',track,{passive:true});
        document.addEventListener('pointerup',track,{passive:true});
        document.documentElement.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>this.reset());
        window.addEventListener('blur',()=>this.reset());window.addEventListener('resize',()=>this.reset());
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)this.reset();});
      }
      setCursor(value){
        if(this.cursor===value)return;this.cursor=value;
        if(value)document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--battlefield-cursor',value);
        else document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--battlefield-cursor');
      }
      reset(){this.point=null;this.setCursor('');}
      tick(view,dt,{active,enabled,speed=1}){
        if(!active||!enabled||!this.point||!document.hasFocus()||(this.point.buttons&4)){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        const {x,y}=edgeVector(this.point.x,this.point.y,innerWidth,innerHeight);
        if(!x&&!y){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        const element=document.elementFromPoint(this.point.x,this.point.y);
        if(!element||element.closest(blockedControls)){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        this.setCursor(arrowCursor(x,y));
        const distance=dt*view.zoom*.5*Math.max(.25,Math.min(2,Number(speed)||1));
        // pan() maps screen directions through the current camera rotation.
        view.pan(x*distance,y*distance);return true;
      }
    }

- **3D gameplay:** Yes. The battlefield, buildings, troops, ships, resources, and effects use real 3D geometry. Menus, text, health bars, and the minimap use 2D overlays.

The implemented features passed their tests. **Your original request for a fully finished, world-class game has not yet been fulfilled.**

    CHANGELOG.md:3:## Mouse camera controls
    CHANGELOG.md:5:- Mouse edge scrolling enabled by default on all four viewport edges and diagonal corners, with directional cursor arrows and camera-relative movement.
    CHANGELOG.md:6:- Saved toggle and speed control in Settings; stops over controls, during menus and pauses, on blur/viewport exit, and for touch input or middle-button dragging.
    CHANGELOG.md:7:- Construction previews follow the cursor while edge scrolling moves the terrain beneath it.
    CHANGELOG.md:8:- Browser verification covers eight directions, rotated views, stopping conditions, settings persistence, and touch protection.
    CHANGELOG.md:10:- Rebuilt all 19 building models and all 14 troop/ship/sovereign models, with faction architecture, solid folded sails and banners, shaped humanoids and horses, and articulated limbs, wheels, oars, rams, and trebuchets.
    CHANGELOG.md:11:- Rebuilt trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines as volumetric models.
    CHANGELOG.md:12:- Replaced flat ground and cone-shaped map borders with seeded terrain and ridges. Picking, actors, foundations, fog, construction previews, and effects follow the triangulated terrain surface.
    CHANGELOG.md:13:- Moving water vertices, submerged naval basins, dry bridges, lifting gate portcullises, construction scaffolds/clipping, and actual 3D building previews.
    CHANGELOG.md:14:- Live WebGL selection portraits, object inspection on mouse/touch, closer perspectives, and a button to hide battlefield panels.
    CHANGELOG.md:15:- Visible forests pack into near/far instanced batches with solid geometry at both detail levels. Camera obstruction handling, efficient crop geometry, bounded portrait refresh, and cleanup between maps.
    CHANGELOG.md:16:- Five additional graphics checks cover all model types/civilizations, terrain determinism, surface picking, bridge/sea elevations, model bounds, batching, and skeletal motion. Browser coverage exercises every biome, naval rendering, live portraits, inspection, and landscape phone controls.
    CHANGELOG.md:20:## Visual depth update
    CHANGELOG.md:22:- A closer default perspective and three selectable camera angles, with visible rotate/zoom buttons, V shortcut, two-finger touch rotation, and saved camera preferences.
    CHANGELOG.md:23:- More directional light, procedural environment illumination, camera-centered shadow coverage, and shared contact shadows that remain available with dynamic shadows disabled.
    CHANGELOG.md:24:- Surface relief on masonry, timber, and roofs; separate roof and troop materials; aligned gables; raised timber framing, windows, eaves, and entry steps; smoother heads and shaped torsos.
    CHANGELOG.md:25:- Browser checks cover camera buttons, picking after rotation, persisted settings, actual two-finger touch events, and contact shadows in Performance quality.
    CHANGELOG.md:27:## Gameplay
    CHANGELOG.md:29:- Two-player Wi-Fi rooms with five victory rules, mirrored starting forces, private player economies, per-player fog, command ownership checks, and session reconnection.
    CHANGELOG.md:30:- Naval conquest, a divided-coast map, and a sixth campaign chapter.
    CHANGELOG.md:31:- Shoreline harbors, fishing boats with actual catch deposits, galleys, siege galleons, and eight-passenger transports.
    CHANGELOG.md:32:- Embarking, disembarking, passenger loss when a transport sinks, naval navigation, ship production, and seamanship research.
    CHANGELOG.md:33:- Tactical AI responds to observed cavalry/archers, defends its base, repairs buildings, escorts attacks with healers, manages fishing, and ferries invasion forces.
    CHANGELOG.md:35:## Presentation and performance
    CHANGELOG.md:37:- Articulated legs, arms, weapons, and working villagers through instanced model parts.
    CHANGELOG.md:38:- Rocking ships, ship wakes, animated water, harbor jetties, gabled roofs, textured materials, and rounded forest canopies.
    CHANGELOG.md:39:- Exploration controls forest visibility. Hidden units are not included in multiplayer opponent snapshots.
    CHANGELOG.md:40:- Layered impacts, arrows, siege sounds, stereo placement, birds, wind, and music. Effect counts and audio voices are bounded.
    CHANGELOG.md:41:- Heap-based pathfinding, indexed entity lookup, broader collision checks, cached animation transforms, and interpolated network movement.
    CHANGELOG.md:42:- Selected-unit combat attributes, clear transport unloading controls, room codes, and phone-compatible room menus.
    CHANGELOG.md:44:## Validation
    CHANGELOG.md:46:- Automated simulation and real WebSocket tests cover economy, queues, ages, research, combat, walls, victory rules, save compatibility, naval mechanics, player ownership, fog masking, fair starts, and reconnect pauses.
    CHANGELOG.md:47:- Browser QA covers naval controls and a live desktop/landscape-phone match, phone troop training, and reconnection after a reload.
    CHANGELOG.md:48:- Hardware performance and game balance still need broader real-device and human playtesting. This release does not establish commercial AAA parity.
    README.md:3:An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.1, **Realm in depth**, rebuilds the world graphics with elevated terrain, solid models for every building/troop/resource type, articulated limbs and siege mechanisms, animated water, faction architecture, live 3D selection portraits, and close inspection controls. Naval warfare and two-player Wi-Fi matches remain available alongside the single-player game.
    README.md:5:## Play
    README.md:15:For development, `npm run dev` serves on port 5173. Use `npm start` for Wi-Fi multiplayer; the static Vite preview server does not host rooms.
    README.md:17:### Play with a friend
    README.md:25:## Included gameplay
    README.md:27:- **Eight modes:** tutorial, conquest skirmish, regicide, ten-wave survival, shrine control, monument race, peaceful sandbox, and naval conquest.
    README.md:28:- **Six campaign chapters:** settlement, river crossing, fortress defense, sacred valley, final siege, and a coastal invasion. All chapters can be played immediately.
    README.md:29:- **Seven seeded maps:** Emerald highlands, river crossing, sunlit steppe, Winterwood, iron frontier, twin rivers, and the divided coast. Seeds reproduce resource layouts. Bridges create movement chokepoints; winter has additional timber, the iron frontier has contested central ore, and the coast requires fleets or transports.
    README.md:30:- **Three original civilizations:** Alder Kingdom (durability), Sunward Sultanate (economy and construction), Raven Clans (cavalry).
    README.md:31:- **Four difficulties:** Explorer, Commander, Conqueror, Legendary. Difficulty changes enemy decision and attack timing; survival also changes wave strength.
    README.md:32:- **19 buildings:** town center, house, farm, mill, lumber camp, mining camp, barracks, archery range, stable, siege workshop, blacksmith, market, watchtower, castle, stone wall, gatehouse, monastery, grand monument, and harbor.
    README.md:33:- **13 trainable unit types:** villager, scout, spearman, archer, man-at-arms, knight, battering ram, trebuchet, healer, fishing boat, galley, siege galleon, and transport. Regicide adds an irreplaceable sovereign for each side.
    README.md:34:- **Four ages** with population limits, paid training queues, rally points, age requirements, automatic age strength improvements, and queue cancellation refunds.
    README.md:35:- **Seven technology families:** gathering tools, melee attack, armor, ranged attack, fortification, cavalry speed, and seamanship. Research levels have age requirements and increasing costs.
    README.md:36:- Harbors must be built near a shore. Fishing boats collect fish and return their catch to a harbor. Command land troops onto a friendly transport to embark up to eight passengers; select the transport, choose **Unload**, and select nearby open land. Sinking a transport defeats its passengers. Siege galleons can bombard shoreline defenses.
    README.md:37:- Villagers physically walk between resources and drop-off buildings, carry supplies, construct buildings, and repair damage. Farms provide renewable food. Mines and trees deplete. Markets buy and sell resources for gold.
    README.md:38:- Walls block paths; friendly units can pass through gates. Connected walls support queued construction. Construction can be canceled for a 70% resource refund; finished buildings can be demolished for a 20% refund. Your last town center is protected from accidental demolition.
    README.md:39:- Unit counters, splash siege damage, automatic healing, defensive towers, formations, aggressive/hold stances, queued orders, box selection, type selection, numbered control groups, and visible selected-unit attributes.
    README.md:40:- Enemy AI responds to visible threats, repairs damaged buildings, reinforces counters against observed unit types, escorts attacks with healers, and runs a fishing and transport economy on the coastal map.
    README.md:41:- Articulated walking, weapon motion, working villagers, rocking ships, ship wakes, drifting water textures, textured masonry and wood, gabled roofs, and biome-specific foliage. Hidden forests obey exploration. Battle audio includes impact layers, arrows, siege sounds, stereo placement, wind, birds, and ambient music, with bounded effects and audio voices.
    README.md:42:- Closer perspective cameras, selectable close/perspective/overview angles, mouse and touch rotation, surface relief, directional lighting, sharper camera-centered shadows, timber framing, window recesses, and shared instanced contact shadows that remain available in Performance quality.
    README.md:43:- All 19 building types and all 14 character/ship types (13 trainable plus the sovereign) have solid mesh models. Buildings use arches, domes, gables, piers, fences, turrets, grain stalks, and distinct workshops. Human models have faces, shaped torsos, jointed limbs, held tools and weapons; cavalry adds modeled horses, and siege equipment has moving wheels and mechanisms. Trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines also use mesh geometry.
    README.md:44:- All seven maps have seeded rolling terrain and surrounding ridges. Picking, walking, building foundations, effects, previews, and fog follow the surface. Bridges stay dry and naval channels have submerged beds. Water has moving vertices and updated normals. Nearby gate portcullises lift for friendly troops.
    README.md:45:- Selection portraits render the actual model as a live WebGL turntable. Tap/click the portrait, or press **I**, to inspect the selected object. The square camera button hides or restores battlefield panels for an unobstructed view.
    README.md:46:- Fog of war, exploration, a working minimap, mission objectives, victory/defeat screens, match statistics, synthesized audio, pause, game speed, local saves, and campaign completion tracking.
    README.md:47:- Landscape-first touch interface, pinch zoom, drag pan, responsive menus, graphics presets, and automatic rendering resolution adjustment.
    README.md:49:## Controls
    README.md:73:Mouse edge scrolling is enabled by default. Bring the cursor into the outer 24 pixels of the game window to pan; corners pan diagonally and a directional arrow appears. Scrolling follows the rotated camera, stops outside the game or during menus/pauses, and avoids controls. **Settings** includes an on/off toggle and speed slider. Touch gestures continue to pan and zoom. Fullscreen lets you use the monitor edges.
    README.md:75:## Build, offline play, and tests
    README.md:92:The browser QA scripts use a locally installed Microsoft Edge. `release-qa.mjs` tests a real room with desktop and emulated phone clients, both command perspectives, phone troop training, and reconnecting after a reload. It defaults to a test server on port 4180; set `QA_URL` to another server URL as needed. `npm test` also runs a real WebSocket test for fair starts, ownership rejection, fog masking, disconnect pauses, and session restoration. Emulation does not substitute for testing on physical phones.
    README.md:94:## Implementation
    README.md:96:- `src/data.js`: troops, buildings, research, civilizations, difficulties, maps, and missions.
    README.md:97:- `src/simulation.js`: deterministic map generation and independent fixed-step gameplay simulation. The opponent gathers, pays for buildings and units, advances ages, researches technologies, and attacks. Survival is explicitly a wave-spawn scenario.
    README.md:98:- `src/world.js`: procedural 3D models, camera, ray picking, shadows, fog, and combat effects. Forests and units use instanced rendering; buildings/resources merge geometry by material. Graphics adapt to sustained slow frames.
    README.md:99:- `src/landscape.js`: seeded elevated terrain, triangulated surface sampling and ray picking, river/coastal beds, bridges, terrain textures, solid grass tufts, and animated water meshes.
    README.md:100:- `src/models-3d.js`: solid world models for the complete building/unit/resource catalog and civilization architecture.
    README.md:101:- `src/realm-3d.js`: terrain/model integration, packed forest detail levels, foundations, construction clipping and scaffolds, previews, gate motion, and solid projectiles.
    README.md:102:- `src/portrait-3d.js`: throttled live 3D selection turntables.
    README.md:103:- `src/main.js`: menus, responsive HUD, touch/mouse/keyboard controls, objectives, saves, and modal flows.
    README.md:104:- `src/audio.js`: synthesized cues and ambient music.
    README.md:105:- `src/frontiers.js`: naval mechanics and tactical AI additions.
    README.md:106:- `src/navigation.js`: heap-based pathfinding.
    README.md:107:- `src/world-polish.js`: articulated model animation, ship models, material textures, and exploration-aware foliage.
    README.md:108:- `src/soundscape.js`: battle sounds and atmospheric audio.
    README.md:109:- `src/network.js`: room connection, commands, and session reconnection.
    README.md:110:- `server/rooms.js`: authoritative Wi-Fi matches, player perspectives, command validation, disconnect handling, and room lifecycle.
    README.md:111:- `server/index.js`: local game hosting and WebSocket server.
    README.md:112:- `vite.config.js`: build splitting and offline cache generation.
    README.md:114:## Research and scope
    README.md:122:This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Two-player Wi-Fi gameplay is implemented; public internet matchmaking, accounts, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production-scale backend service are not. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.

      spawnWave(){this.wave++;const d=DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty],count=Math.round((5+this.wave*2.5)*d.wave),sides=[{x:58,z:55},{x:-58,z:-55},{x:60,z:-50}],base=sides[(this.wave-1)%sides.length];
        this.players[1].age=Math.min(3,Math.floor(this.wave/3));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
          let type=i%3===0?'archer':'spearman';if(this.wave>=3&&i%4===0)type='knight';if(this.wave>=5&&i%8===0)type='ram';if(this.wave>=8&&i%10===0)type='catapult';
          const unit=this.addUnit(type,1,base.x+i%6*1.8,base.z+Math.floor(i/6)*1.8);const tc=this.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(tc)unit.order={type:'attackmove',x:tc.x,z:tc.z};
        }this.nextWave=this.time+95;this.emit('wave',{wave:this.wave,count});
        // Supply caravans reward surviving a wave without removing the need for an economy.
        if(this.wave>1)for(const key of ['food','wood','gold'])this.players[0].resources[key]+=80+this.wave*15;
      }
      tickShrines(dt){for(const s of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine')){const troops=[0,1].map(owner=>this.owned(owner,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&distance(s,e)<7).length);const side=troops[0]>0&&troops[1]===0?0:troops[1]>0&&troops[0]===0?1:-1;
          if(side>=0&&s.owner!==side){if(s.capturer!==side){s.capturer=side;s.progress=0;}s.progress+=dt;if(s.progress>=18){s.owner=side;s.progress=0;this.emit('capture',{owner:side});}}else if(side<0)s.progress=Math.max(0,s.progress-dt*.5);
          if(s.owner>=0)this.players[s.owner].resources.gold+=dt*.55;
        }
        const shrines=this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine');if(shrines.length){this.hold=shrines.every(e=>e.owner===0)?this.hold+dt:0;this.enemyHold=shrines.every(e=>e.owner===1)?this.enemyHold+dt:0;if(this.hold>=180)this.end(true,'The sacred valley is yours.');if(this.enemyHold>=180)this.end(false,'The rival kingdom united the sacred valley.');}
      }
      isVisible(x,z){const c=this.cell(x,z);return !!this.visible[c.z*80+c.x];}
      isExplored(x,z){const c=this.cell(x,z);return !!this.explored[c.z*80+c.x];}
      updateFog(){this.visible.fill(0);for(const e of this.owned(0).filter(e=>!e.embarked&&(e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building'&&e.progress>0))){const r=e.kind==='unit'?UNITS[e.type].vision:BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18,c=this.cell(e.x,e.z),rc=Math.ceil(r/2);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-rc);z<=Math.min(79,c.z+rc);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-rc);x<=Math.min(79,c.x+rc);x++)if(Math.hypot(x-c.x,z-c.z)<=rc){this.visible[z*80+x]=1;this.explored[z*80+x]=1;}}
        for(const s of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine'&&e.owner===0)){const c=this.cell(s.x,s.z);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-9);z<=Math.min(79,c.z+9);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-9);x<=Math.min(79,c.x+9);x++){this.visible[z*80+x]=1;this.explored[z*80+x]=1;}}
      }
      tutorialObjectives(){return [
        {text:'Gather 100 resources. Your villagers are already working.',done:this.stats.gathered>=100},
        {text:'Select villagers, open Build, and construct a house.',done:this.tutorialFlags.house},
        {text:'Select the barracks and train 3 spearmen.',done:this.owned(0,'unit','spearman').length>=3},
        {text:'Right-click the ground to command your troops.',done:this.tutorialFlags.command},
        {text:'Select the town center and advance to the Feudal Age.',done:this.players[0].age>=1},
      ];}
      end(won,reason){if(this.ended)return;this.ended={won,reason};this.emit('end',this.ended);}
      checkVictory(){if(this.options.mode==='sandbox')return;
        if(this.options.mode==='regicide'){if(!this.owned(0,'unit','king').length)this.end(false,'Your sovereign has fallen.');else if(!this.owned(1,'unit','king').length)this.end(true,'The rival sovereign is defeated. Your crown endures.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(0,'building','towncenter').length)return this.end(false,'Your last town center has fallen.');
        if(this.options.mode==='tutorial'){if(this.tutorialObjectives().every(o=>o.done))this.end(true,'Your first settlement is thriving. You are ready to rule.');return;}
        const survival=this.options.mode==='survival'||this.mission?.survival;if(survival){const max=this.mission?.waves||10;if(this.wave>=max&&!this.owned(1,'unit').length&&(!this.mission||this.owned(0,'building','keep').some(b=>b.progress>=1)))this.end(true,'Your kingdom endured every assault.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(1,'building','towncenter').length){if(this.options.mode==='campaign1'&&(!this.owned(0,'building','barracks').length||this.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='scout').length<6))return;if(this.options.mode==='campaign2'&&this.players[0].age<2)return;this.end(true,'The rival capital has fallen. The frontier is yours.');}
      }
      tick(dt){if(this.ended)return;this.time+=dt;this.buckets=new Map();for(const e of this.owned(0,'unit').concat(this.owned(1,'unit'))){const key=`${Math.floor(e.x/4)},${Math.floor(e.z/4)}`;if(!this.buckets.has(key))this.buckets.set(key,[]);this.buckets.get(key).push(e);}
        for(const e of [...this.entities])if(e.hp>0){if(e.kind==='unit')this.tickUnit(e,dt);else if(e.kind==='building')this.tickBuilding(e,dt);}
        this.aiClock+=dt;if(this.aiClock>=3*DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty].ai){this.aiClock=0;this.tickAI();}
        const survival=this.options.mode==='survival'||this.mission?.survival;if(survival&&this.time>=this.nextWave&&this.wave<(this.mission?.waves||10))this.spawnWave();
        this.tickShrines(dt);
        if(this.options.mode==='wonder'){for(let owner=0;owner<2;owner++){if(this.owned(owner,'building','wonder').some(e=>e.progress>=1))this.wonderTime[owner]+=dt;else this.wonderTime[owner]=0;if(this.wonderTime[owner]>=240)this.end(owner===0,owner===0?'Your monument will stand for a thousand years.':'The rival monument secured their legacy.');}}
        this.fogClock+=dt;if(this.fogClock>.5){this.updateFog();this.fogClock=0;}this.checkVictory();
        // Bound event history; observers receive events immediately.
        if(this.events.length>200)this.events.splice(0,100);
      }
      serialize(){return {version:1,rngState:this.rng.state,options:this.options,entities:this.entities,players:this.players,nextId:this.nextId,time:this.time,wave:this.wave,nextWave:this.nextWave,nextAttack:this.nextAttack,hold:this.hold,enemyHold:this.enemyHold,wonderTime:this.wonderTime,stats:this.stats,tutorialFlags:this.tutorialFlags,explored:Array.from(this.explored),ended:this.ended};}
      static restore(data){if(data.version!==1||!Array.isArray(data.entities)||!data.players)throw new Error('Unsupported save file');const s=new Simulation(data.options);for(const key of ['entities','players','nextId','time','wave','nextWave','nextAttack','hold','enemyHold','wonderTime','stats','tutorialFlags','ended'])s[key]=data[key];if(data.rngState!==undefined)s.rng.state=data.rngState;s.explored=Uint8Array.from(data.explored);s.revision++;s.grids={};s.updateFog();return s;}
    }
