    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 9 October 2026 against the version 2.1 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Eight modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 13 trainable unit types plus sovereigns.
    - Two-player Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, player perspectives, and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.
    
    ## Development order and release checks
    
    | Pass | Work to implement or improve | Evidence required before declaring the pass complete |
    |---|---|---|
    | 1. Controls and army movement | Remappable hotkeys, selection priority, production across selected buildings, global production queue, queued-command feedback, patrol/guard behaviors, formation cohesion, obstacle avoidance, and recovery from blocked routes. Preserve edge scrolling and touch input. | Repeatable mouse/keyboard/touch scenarios; armies navigate woods, walls, gates, bridges, and crowded towns; no duplicated queued orders or indefinitely stuck troops in the tested cases. Local command feedback and execution latency measured on reference hardware. |
    | 2. Economy, AI, and battle balance | Explicit AI build orders and resource budgets, scouting memory, different attack plans, counter-unit composition, regrouping, retreating, siege protection, expansion, transport decisions, and difficulty based on decisions. Audit starting advantages and any difficulty bonuses. | Seeded economy and combat scenarios; AI can recover after worker losses and exhausted nearby resources; attacks change based on observed enemies; difficulty rules are documented; human testers find each level understandable and challenging. |
    | 3. Civilizations and strategic depth | Unique units and technologies, clearer civilization identities, useful upgrade choices, meaningful land/naval counters, alternative economic strategies, and an interactive technology tree. Expand team/player support before adding team modes. | Comparable-cost counter scenarios plus human matches; all additions have costs, prerequisites, counters, descriptions, art, audio, AI support, saves, and multiplayer validation. Balance judged across maps and skill levels. |
    | 4. Missions and map design | A mission-event system with staged objectives, dialogue, reinforcements, escort/rescue tasks, branching optional goals, checkpoints, and authored set pieces. Curate resource placement, chokepoints, naval landings, and spawn fairness. | Each mission can be completed and failed correctly on each difficulty; checkpoints restore the correct event state; missions require different strategies; map objectives and travel routes remain reachable. |
    | 5. Art, animation, and sound | Establish a consistent medieval art direction; replace or refine the procedural assets with original or appropriately licensed authored models, textures, character rigs, transitions, worker tasks, cargo, attack impacts, damage, and death animations. Add distinctive music, unit responses, ambience, and readable combat sound. | Visual review in real gameplay at every quality setting and camera angle; recognizable units and silhouettes; animations match actions; assets fit performance budgets; retain real mesh geometry at every detail level. |
    | 6. Laptop and phone experience | Profile CPU/GPU work, pathfinding, draw calls, memory, network snapshots, and input delay. Improve detail levels, shared routes, batching, effects budgets, loading, safe areas, readable UI, touch selection, UI scaling, and accessibility options. | Publish device/browser/specification results. Proposed targets: 60 FPS on a defined reference laptop and 30 FPS on defined supported phones in benchmark matches. Verify sustained performance, frame-time spikes, thermal behavior, and memory over long sessions. Targets are not current achievements or guarantees for every device. |
    | 7. Multiplayer and community | Public hosting, persistent room/session state, matchmaking, reconnect recovery, cooperative/team games, profiles, replay/spectator tools, authoritative validation, and operational monitoring. Generalize the current two-player simulation and perspective assumptions first. | Test multiple clients, latency, packet loss, disconnects, server restarts, ownership, hidden-information handling, version compatibility, and replay results. Hosting choices and ongoing costs need an explicit deployment decision. |
    | 8. Release readiness | Improve onboarding, settings, saved-game migrations, campaign progression, post-match economy/combat graphs, installation/update behavior, diagnostics, recovery, and documentation. Conduct repeated external playtests and fix their highest-impact problems. | Long complete matches, all modes, save/resume/update cycles, physical phones/laptops, multiplayer failure scenarios, and accessibility reviews pass the agreed release checklist. Record remaining limitations instead of labeling unchecked areas complete. |
    
    Performance, regression testing, and human feedback run throughout these passes; they are not postponed until the end.
    
    ## Recommended next release
    
    Start with Pass 1 and the most visible parts of Pass 2:
    
    1. Add a global production queue and selection across multiple production buildings.
    2. Introduce remappable controls with conflict reporting and saved profiles.
    3. Improve group movement through gates, around buildings, and over bridges; show blocked-order feedback.
    4. Make AI openings and spending intentional, then add scouting-informed attack/retreat decisions.
    5. Exercise complete economy-to-victory matches with several seeds and difficulties, followed by laptop and phone playtests.
    
    Deliver these as tested releases that can be played and reviewed. Additional units or prettier screenshots alone do not establish overall game quality.
    
    ## What can be developed here and what needs outside evidence
    
    The existing workspace supports implementation of gameplay, AI, UI, asset integration, shaders, animation, performance instrumentation, testing, and multiplayer services. Professional asset/audio production requires suitable original work or licensed sources. Physical-device results require access to the actual devices or measurements from testers. Public online operation requires a hosting decision and ongoing service resources. Fun and balance require repeated human playtesting.
    
    No honest development process can promise an objective “100% world-class” score. The useful commitment is to finish defined requirements, publish test evidence, address player feedback, and improve successive releases.
    
    ## Research references
    
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season One development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-one-update-release-notes/): controls, global production queues, patrol, player feedback, balance, maps, campaign tuning, and post-match navigation. Used as a genre quality reference, not a statement of this project's implemented features.
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season Two development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-17718/): continued iteration across controls, game modes, multiplayer, and stability.
    - The baseline above is supported by the local source, [README](README.md), [change log](CHANGELOG.md), and tests/scripts in this repository.

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,MAPS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group,true),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);
        for(const [type,data]of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
        for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const model=unitModel(v,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
      }
    });
    test('forests, fruit, mineral deposits, fish and shrines use volumetric mesh models',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture();for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:51,kind:'resource',type}));
      solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}));solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}));
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS))for(let i=0;i<4;i++)solidBounds(treeModel(v,map,i));
    });
    test('batching preserves model bounds and articulated joints remain animated',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),e={id:31,kind:'unit',type:'knight',owner:0,moving:true,cooldown:0};
      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});
      v.mergeModel(model);const after=solidBounds(model),parts=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)parts.push(m);});
      assert.ok(parts.length<raw.length);assert.ok(before.min.distanceTo(after.min)<.0001);assert.ok(before.max.distanceTo(after.max)<.0001);
      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {seededRandom} from './data.js';
    
    const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
    export class Landscape {
      constructor(seed,map){this.seed=seed;this.map=map;this.phase=seededRandom(seed+751)()*Math.PI*2;}
      channels(){return this.waterChannels??=(this.map==='coast'?[{center:0,width:14,frequency:.03,bend:2}]:this.map==='valley'?[{center:0,width:5,frequency:.045,bend:4}]:this.map==='rivers'?[-19,19].map(center=>({center,width:4,frequency:.045,bend:3})):[]);}
      heightAt(x,z){
        const p=this.phase;
        let h=.8+Math.sin(x*.061+p)*Math.cos(z*.049-p)*1.15+Math.sin(x*.13+z*.075+p)*.32;
        const townDistance=Math.min(Math.hypot(x+37,z-30),Math.hypot(x-37,z+30));
        h=.65+(h-.65)*smooth(12,26,townDistance);
        for(const channel of this.channels()){
          const d=Math.abs(x-channel.center-Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend);
          if(this.map!=='coast'&&Math.abs(z)<=9&&d<channel.width+5){h=.72+(h-.72)*smooth(channel.width+2,channel.width+5,d);continue;}
          if(d<channel.width+6)h=-1.3+(h+1.3)*smooth(channel.width-1,channel.width+6,d);
        }
        const edge=Math.max(Math.abs(x),Math.abs(z)),rise=smooth(76,110,edge);
        const ridges=7+Math.pow(Math.sin(x*.043+p)*Math.cos(z*.037-p),2)*18+Math.sin((x+z)*.07)*2;
        h+=rise*ridges;
        return h;
      }
      geometry(size=320,segments=160,offset=0){
        const geo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size,size,segments,segments);geo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
        const pos=geo.getAttribute('position');
        for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++)pos.setY(i,this.heightAt(pos.getX(i),pos.getZ(i))+offset);
        if(size===320&&offset===0){this.grid={segments,size,heights:Float32Array.from({length:pos.count},(_,i)=>pos.getY(i))};}
        pos.needsUpdate=true;geo.computeVertexNormals();geo.computeBoundingBox();geo.computeBoundingSphere();return geo;
      }
      surfaceHeightAt(x,z){
        const grid=this.grid;if(!grid||Math.abs(x)>160||Math.abs(z)>160)return this.heightAt(x,z);
        const xx=(x+160)/grid.size*grid.segments,zz=(z+160)/grid.size*grid.segments,ix=Math.min(grid.segments-1,Math.floor(xx)),iz=Math.min(grid.segments-1,Math.floor(zz)),u=xx-ix,v=zz-iz,stride=grid.segments+1,a=iz*stride+ix;
        const h00=grid.heights[a],h10=grid.heights[a+1],h01=grid.heights[a+stride],h11=grid.heights[a+stride+1];
        return u+v<=1?h00+u*(h10-h00)+v*(h01-h00):h11+(1-u)*(h01-h11)+(1-v)*(h10-h11);
      }
      rayPoint(ray){
        // Sample the actual triangulated surface; never command on an invisible y=0 plane.
        let previous=null;
        for(let distance=0;distance<=400;distance+=2){const x=ray.origin.x+ray.direction.x*distance,y=ray.origin.y+ray.direction.y*distance,z=ray.origin.z+ray.direction.z*distance;
          if(Math.abs(x)>160||Math.abs(z)>160){previous=null;continue;}
          const delta=y-this.surfaceHeightAt(x,z);
          if(delta<=0&&previous!==null){let lo=previous,hi=distance;for(let i=0;i<11;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2,xx=ray.origin.x+ray.direction.x*mid,zz=ray.origin.z+ray.direction.z*mid,yy=ray.origin.y+ray.direction.y*mid;if(yy>this.surfaceHeightAt(xx,zz))lo=mid;else hi=mid;}return ray.at((lo+hi)/2,new THREE.Vector3());}
          previous=distance;
        }
        return null;
      }
      waterGeometry(channel){
        const vertices=[],uv=[],indices=[],across=8,length=80;

    function renderMinimap(){const c=$('#minimap'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),size=c.width,scale=size/160;ctx.fillStyle={desert:'#8e8968',winter:'#b8c5b8',canyon:'#9a8875'}[sim.options.map]||'#6e7c59';ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
      if(['valley','rivers'].includes(sim.options.map)){for(const center of (sim.options.map==='rivers'?[-19,19]:[0])){ctx.strokeStyle='#72a3a5';ctx.lineWidth=(center?8:10)*scale;ctx.beginPath();for(let z=-80;z<=80;z+=2){const x=center+Math.sin(z*.045)*(center?3:4);ctx.lineTo((x+80)*scale,(z+80)*scale);}ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#ac9b75';ctx.fillRect((72+center)*scale,72*scale,16*scale,16*scale);}}
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&(e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||e.kind==='resource'&&sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){ctx.fillStyle=e.kind==='resource'?{wood:'#315b42',gold:'#e1bf69',stone:'#bac0b4',food:'#ab7560'}[e.type]:e.kind==='shrine'?(e.owner===0?'#91dbc9':e.owner===1?'#df8582':'#e3d3a2'):e.owner===0?'#b5e7dc':'#ed8b7b';const r=e.kind==='building'?Math.max(2,e.r*scale):e.kind==='unit'?1.6:1.5;ctx.fillRect((e.x+80)*scale-r,(e.z+80)*scale-r,r*2,r*2);}
      if(sim.options.map==='coast'){ctx.fillStyle='#7eafb4';ctx.fillRect(66*scale,0,28*scale,size);}
      if(settings.fog)ctx.drawImage(view.fogCanvas,0,0,size,size);
      const points=[[0,0],[innerWidth,0],[innerWidth,innerHeight],[0,innerHeight]].map(([x,y])=>view.groundPoint(x,y));ctx.strokeStyle='#f0e8c4';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>{if(p)(i?ctx.lineTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale):ctx.moveTo((p.x+80)*scale,(p.z+80)*scale));});ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();
    }
    function renderHealth(){const layer=$('#health-layer');let html='';for(const e of sim.entities){if(e.hp<=0||e.kind==='resource'||e.kind==='shrine'||(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.hp>=e.maxHp&&e.progress!==undefined&&e.progress>=1)||e.owner===1&&!sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;if(!view.selection.has(e.id)&&e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>=e.maxHp)continue;const p=view.project(e);if(p.visible&&p.x>0&&p.x<innerWidth&&p.y>50&&p.y<innerHeight-100)html+=`<div class="world-health ${e.owner===1?'rival':''}" style="left:${p.x}px;top:${p.y}px"><i style="width:${e.hp/e.maxHp*100}%"></i>${e.kind==='building'&&e.progress<1?`<small>${Math.floor(e.progress*100)}%</small>`:''}</div>`;}layer.innerHTML=html;}

    window.addEventListener('resize',updateRotate);
    function issue(point,target,append=false){if(!point)return;const ids=selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0).map(e=>e.id);if(!ids.length)return;sim.smartCommand(ids,target,point.x,point.z,append,attackMove);view.mark(point.x,point.z);if(attackMove){attackMove=false;$('#attackmove').classList.remove('active');}renderSelection();}

        if(buildType){if(buildType==='wall'&&old.dragged&&old.start&&point){const len=distance(old.start,point),n=Math.min(45,Math.floor(len/2.85));let built=0;const ws=workers();for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=n?i/n:0;const b=sim.build('wall',old.start.x+(point.x-old.start.x)*t,old.start.z+(point.z-old.start.z)*t,ws,0,built>0);if(b){built++;}}toast(`${built} wall segments placed.`);renderHUD();}else if(!old.dragged)place(point,e);return;}

        if(unloadMode&&point){const ship=selected().find(e=>e.type==='transport');if(ship&&sim.unload(ship.id,point.x,point.z)){unloadMode=false;view.mark(point.x,point.z);}return;}
        if(old.button===2||attackMove){issue(point,target,e.shiftKey);return;}
        if(old.touch&&selection.length&&(target?.owner!==0||target?.type==='transport'&&selected().some(e=>e.kind==='unit'&&!UNITS[e.type].naval)||(workers().length&&target?.kind==='building'&&(target.progress<1||target.type==='farm'||target.hp<target.maxHp)))){issue(point,target);return;}
        if(target)setSelection(e.shiftKey?[...selection,target.id]:[target.id]);else if(old.touch&&selection.length)issue(point,null);else setSelection([]);

      canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',e=>{touches.delete(e.pointerId);pointer=null;pinch=null;$('#selection-box').style.display='none';});
      canvas.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{if(!playing||paused)return;const target=view.pick(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(target?.owner===0&&target.kind==='unit')setSelection(sim.owned(0,'unit',target.type).filter(unit=>distance(unit,target)<40).map(unit=>unit.id));});

    function frame(now){const dt=Math.min(.08,(now-last)/1000);last=now;
      if(view){const keyboardPan=['w','a','s','d','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].some(key=>keys.has(key));const edgeMoved=edgeScroll.tick(view,dt,{active:playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended&&!modal&&!keyboardPan,enabled:settings.edgeScroll,speed:settings.edgeScrollSpeed});
        if(edgeMoved&&buildType&&edgeScroll.point){const point=view.groundPoint(edgeScroll.point.x,edgeScroll.point.y);if(point)view.showGhost(buildType,point.x,point.z,sim.buildValid(buildType,point.x,point.z));else view.hideGhost();}
        if(playing&&!paused&&!sim.ended){const pan=dt*view.zoom*.42;if(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup'))view.pan(0,-pan);if(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown'))view.pan(0,pan);if(keys.has('a')||keys.has('arrowleft'))view.pan(-pan,0);if(keys.has('d')||keys.has('arrowright'))view.pan(pan,0);if(keys.has('q')){view.angle+=dt;view.updateCamera();}if(keys.has('e')){view.angle-=dt;view.updateCamera();}
        while(b.queue.length)this.cancelQueue(b.id,0,owner);const rate=b.progress<1?.7:.2;for(const [r,n]of Object.entries(this.cost(BUILDINGS[b.type].cost,owner,'building')))this.players[owner].resources[r]+=Math.floor(n*rate);b.demolished=true;b.hp=0;this.revision++;this.emit('death',{entity:b});return true;
      }
      trade(resource,buy,owner=0){if(!this.owned(owner,'building','market').some(b=>b.progress>=1))return this.fail('Build a market to trade resources.',owner);const p=this.players[owner];const cost=buy?{gold:130}:{[resource]:100};if(!this.spend(cost,owner))return this.fail('Not enough resources for this trade.',owner);p.resources[buy?resource:'gold']+=buy?100:70;this.emit('sound',{name:'coin'});return true;}
      command(ids,order,append=false){const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.kind==='unit');units.forEach((e,i)=>{
          const o={...order};if((o.type==='move'||o.type==='attackmove')&&units.length>1){const formation=this.players[e.owner].formation,width=formation==='line'?Math.min(12,units.length):formation==='column'?2:Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(units.length)),rows=Math.ceil(units.length/width);o.x=clamp(o.x+(i%width-(width-1)/2)*2,-77,77);o.z=clamp(o.z+(Math.floor(i/width)-(rows-1)/2)*2,-77,77);}
          if(append&&e.order)e.orders.push(o);else{e.order=o;e.orders=[];e.path=[];e.repath=0;if(o.type==='attack'||o.type==='attackmove')e.stance='aggressive';}
        });if(units.some(e=>e.owner===0)){if(units.some(e=>e.type!=='villager')&&['move','attackmove','attack'].includes(order.type))this.tutorialFlags.command=true;this.emit('order',{order});}
      }
      smartCommand(ids,target,x,z,append=false,attackMove=false){const owned=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===0);const units=owned.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit');
        for(const b of owned.filter(e=>e.kind==='building')){b.rally={x,z,target:target?.kind==='resource'?target.id:null};}
        if(!target){if(units.length)this.command(units.map(e=>e.id),{type:attackMove?'attackmove':'move',x,z},append);return;}
        for(const unit of units){let order={type:attackMove?'attackmove':'move',x,z};
          if(target?.owner===1&&target.kind!=='resource')order={type:'attack',target:target.id};

          else if(unit.type==='villager'&&target?.kind==='building'&&target.owner===0){order=target.progress<1?{type:'build',target:target.id}:target.type==='farm'?{type:'gather',target:target.id}:{type:'repair',target:target.id};}
          else if(unit.type==='monk'&&target?.owner===0&&target.kind==='unit')order={type:'heal',target:target.id};

      await settle(page);const centered=await position(page);await page.waitForTimeout(250);assert.deepEqual(await position(page),centered);
      await page.evaluate(()=>{frontier.view.angle=1.85;frontier.view.updateCamera();});const rotated=await position(page);await hold(page,1437,430);const afterRotate=await position(page);
      assert.ok((afterRotate.x-rotated.x)*Math.cos(rotated.angle)-(afterRotate.z-rotated.z)*Math.sin(rotated.angle)>.05);
      await settle(page);await page.mouse.move(1437,430);await page.mouse.down({button:'middle'});const beforeMiddle=await position(page);await page.waitForTimeout(250);assert.deepEqual(await position(page),beforeMiddle);await page.mouse.up({button:'middle'});
      await settle(page);await page.mouse.move(1437,430);await page.keyboard.down('ArrowLeft');const beforeKey=await position(page);await page.waitForTimeout(250);const afterKey=await position(page);await page.keyboard.up('ArrowLeft');
      assert.ok((afterKey.x-beforeKey.x)*Math.cos(beforeKey.angle)-(afterKey.z-beforeKey.z)*Math.sin(beforeKey.angle)<-.05,'keyboard pan overrides an opposite edge');
      await settle(page);await page.evaluate(()=>{frontier.select([frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0].id]);frontier.action('build');});await page.locator('[data-build=house]').click();
      await hold(page,1437,430);const ghost=await page.evaluate(()=>{const point=frontier.view.groundPoint(1437,430),g=frontier.view.ghost;return{visible:g.visible,error:Math.hypot(g.position.x-point.x,g.position.z-point.z)};});assert.ok(ghost.visible);assert.ok(ghost.error<.02,'construction preview follows the stationary cursor during scrolling');await page.keyboard.press('Escape');

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,MAPS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group,true),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);
        for(const [type,data]of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
        for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const model=unitModel(v,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
      }
    });
    test('forests, fruit, mineral deposits, fish and shrines use volumetric mesh models',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture();for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:51,kind:'resource',type}));
      solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}));solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}));
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS))for(let i=0;i<4;i++)solidBounds(treeModel(v,map,i));
    });
    test('batching preserves model bounds and articulated joints remain animated',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),e={id:31,kind:'unit',type:'knight',owner:0,moving:true,cooldown:0};
      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});
      v.mergeModel(model);const after=solidBounds(model),parts=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)parts.push(m);});
      assert.ok(parts.length<raw.length);assert.ok(before.min.distanceTo(after.min)<.0001);assert.ok(before.max.distanceTo(after.max)<.0001);
      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);
    });

    function foundation(view,e){
      const r=e.r*.65;let height=view.landscape.surfaceHeightAt(e.x,e.z);
      for(const x of [-r,r])for(const z of [-r,r])height=Math.max(height,view.landscape.surfaceHeightAt(e.x+x,e.z+z));
      return height-.12;

    function buildForest(view){
      view.forest=[];const trees=view.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='wood'&&e.hp>0),rng=seededRandom(view.sim.options.seed+191);
      for(let variant=0;variant<4;variant++){
        const entries=trees.filter(e=>e.id%4===variant);if(!entries.length)continue;
        const sets=[];
        for(const far of [false,true]){
          const model=view.mergeModel(treeModel(view,view.sim.options.map,variant,far)),parts=[],ids=[];
          model.traverse(part=>{if(!part.isMesh)return;const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(part.geometry,part.material,entries.length);mesh.count=0;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.userData.treeIds=ids;mesh.userData.model3d={kind:'resource',type:'wood'};view.objects.add(mesh);parts.push(mesh);});
          sets.push({parts,ids});
        }

        view.forest.push({entries,sets,matrices});
      }
      view.treeIndices.clear();view.forestFog(true);
    }

    # Realm in depth â€” version 2.1
    
    ## Mouse camera controls
    
    - Mouse edge scrolling enabled by default on all four viewport edges and diagonal corners, with directional cursor arrows and camera-relative movement.
    - Saved toggle and speed control in Settings; stops over controls, during menus and pauses, on blur/viewport exit, and for touch input or middle-button dragging.
    - Construction previews follow the cursor while edge scrolling moves the terrain beneath it.
    - Browser verification covers eight directions, rotated views, stopping conditions, settings persistence, and touch protection.
    
    - Rebuilt all 19 building models and all 14 troop/ship/sovereign models, with faction architecture, solid folded sails and banners, shaped humanoids and horses, and articulated limbs, wheels, oars, rams, and trebuchets.
    - Rebuilt trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines as volumetric models.
    - Replaced flat ground and cone-shaped map borders with seeded terrain and ridges. Picking, actors, foundations, fog, construction previews, and effects follow the triangulated terrain surface.
    - Moving water vertices, submerged naval basins, dry bridges, lifting gate portcullises, construction scaffolds/clipping, and actual 3D building previews.
    - Live WebGL selection portraits, object inspection on mouse/touch, closer perspectives, and a button to hide battlefield panels.
    - Visible forests pack into near/far instanced batches with solid geometry at both detail levels. Camera obstruction handling, efficient crop geometry, bounded portrait refresh, and cleanup between maps.
    - Five additional graphics checks cover all model types/civilizations, terrain determinism, surface picking, bridge/sea elevations, model bounds, batching, and skeletal motion. Browser coverage exercises every biome, naval rendering, live portraits, inspection, and landscape phone controls.

    # Crowns of the Frontier
    
    An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.1, **Realm in depth**, rebuilds the world graphics with elevated terrain, solid models for every building/troop/resource type, articulated limbs and siege mechanisms, animated water, faction architecture, live 3D selection portraits, and close inspection controls. Naval warfare and two-player Wi-Fi matches remain available alongside the single-player game.
    
    ## Play
    
    ```powershell
    npm install
    npm run build
    npm start
    ```
    
    Open **http://localhost:4173** on the laptop. On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, open **http://YOUR_LAPTOP_WIFI_IP:4173**. Landscape is recommended. The laptop must keep the game server running. If the phone cannot reach it, check that the local network permits connections to port 4173.
    
    For development, `npm run dev` serves on port 5173. Use `npm start` for Wi-Fi multiplayer; the static Vite preview server does not host rooms.
    
    ### Play with a friend
    
    Both players open the same laptop's game URL. Choose **Play with a friend over Wi-Fi**, enter a commander name, then create or join a room. Share the six-character room code with the second player. The host starts once both players join. Conquest, regicide, shrine control, wonder race, and naval conquest are supported.
    
    The server runs the simulation and checks command ownership. Each player sees their own economy and fog of war. Both receive mirrored starting towns and armies. If a connection drops, the match pauses for a reconnect grace period of two minutes. Refreshing the page preserves a room credential in session storage; choose **Rejoin your previous network session**. The menu does not pause an otherwise connected network match. Leaving a started match concedes it. Restarting the laptop server ends its in-memory rooms.
    
    Start with **First light**, the guided tutorial. Use **Clash of crowns** for a standard match. **Legendary** difficulty offers early attacks and relentless pressure. The game runs locally; it does not require an account.
    
    ## Included gameplay
    
    - **Eight modes:** tutorial, conquest skirmish, regicide, ten-wave survival, shrine control, monument race, peaceful sandbox, and naval conquest.
    - **Six campaign chapters:** settlement, river crossing, fortress defense, sacred valley, final siege, and a coastal invasion. All chapters can be played immediately.
    - **Seven seeded maps:** Emerald highlands, river crossing, sunlit steppe, Winterwood, iron frontier, twin rivers, and the divided coast. Seeds reproduce resource layouts. Bridges create movement chokepoints; winter has additional timber, the iron frontier has contested central ore, and the coast requires fleets or transports.
    - **Three original civilizations:** Alder Kingdom (durability), Sunward Sultanate (economy and construction), Raven Clans (cavalry).
    - **Four difficulties:** Explorer, Commander, Conqueror, Legendary. Difficulty changes enemy decision and attack timing; survival also changes wave strength.
    - **19 buildings:** town center, house, farm, mill, lumber camp, mining camp, barracks, archery range, stable, siege workshop, blacksmith, market, watchtower, castle, stone wall, gatehouse, monastery, grand monument, and harbor.
    - **13 trainable unit types:** villager, scout, spearman, archer, man-at-arms, knight, battering ram, trebuchet, healer, fishing boat, galley, siege galleon, and transport. Regicide adds an irreplaceable sovereign for each side.
    - **Four ages** with population limits, paid training queues, rally points, age requirements, automatic age strength improvements, and queue cancellation refunds.
    - **Seven technology families:** gathering tools, melee attack, armor, ranged attack, fortification, cavalry speed, and seamanship. Research levels have age requirements and increasing costs.
    - Harbors must be built near a shore. Fishing boats collect fish and return their catch to a harbor. Command land troops onto a friendly transport to embark up to eight passengers; select the transport, choose **Unload**, and select nearby open land. Sinking a transport defeats its passengers. Siege galleons can bombard shoreline defenses.
    - Villagers physically walk between resources and drop-off buildings, carry supplies, construct buildings, and repair damage. Farms provide renewable food. Mines and trees deplete. Markets buy and sell resources for gold.
    - Walls block paths; friendly units can pass through gates. Connected walls support queued construction. Construction can be canceled for a 70% resource refund; finished buildings can be demolished for a 20% refund. Your last town center is protected from accidental demolition.
    - Unit counters, splash siege damage, automatic healing, defensive towers, formations, aggressive/hold stances, queued orders, box selection, type selection, numbered control groups, and visible selected-unit attributes.
    - Enemy AI responds to visible threats, repairs damaged buildings, reinforces counters against observed unit types, escorts attacks with healers, and runs a fishing and transport economy on the coastal map.
    - Articulated walking, weapon motion, working villagers, rocking ships, ship wakes, drifting water textures, textured masonry and wood, gabled roofs, and biome-specific foliage. Hidden forests obey exploration. Battle audio includes impact layers, arrows, siege sounds, stereo placement, wind, birds, and ambient music, with bounded effects and audio voices.
    - Closer perspective cameras, selectable close/perspective/overview angles, mouse and touch rotation, surface relief, directional lighting, sharper camera-centered shadows, timber framing, window recesses, and shared instanced contact shadows that remain available in Performance quality.
    - All 19 building types and all 14 character/ship types (13 trainable plus the sovereign) have solid mesh models. Buildings use arches, domes, gables, piers, fences, turrets, grain stalks, and distinct workshops. Human models have faces, shaped torsos, jointed limbs, held tools and weapons; cavalry adds modeled horses, and siege equipment has moving wheels and mechanisms. Trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines also use mesh geometry.
    - All seven maps have seeded rolling terrain and surrounding ridges. Picking, walking, building foundations, effects, previews, and fog follow the surface. Bridges stay dry and naval channels have submerged beds. Water has moving vertices and updated normals. Nearby gate portcullises lift for friendly troops.
    - Selection portraits render the actual model as a live WebGL turntable. Tap/click the portrait, or press **I**, to inspect the selected object. The square camera button hides or restores battlefield panels for an unobstructed view.
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond';
      font-style: italic;
    const CACHE = __CACHE__;
    const FILES = __FILES__;
    self.addEventListener('install', event => {
      event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE)
        .then(cache => cache.addAll(FILES))
        .then(() => self.skipWaiting()));
    });
    self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
      event.waitUntil(caches.keys()
        .then(keys => Promise.all(keys
          .filter(key => key.startsWith('frontier-') && key !== CACHE)
          .map(key => caches.delete(key))))
        .then(() => self.clients.claim()));
    });
    self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
      if (event.request.method !== 'GET' || new URL(event.request.url).origin !== self.location.origin) return;
      // Precache requests and crossorigin module requests have different Origin
      // headers. The assets here are immutable and restricted to this origin.
      event.respondWith(caches.match(event.request, {ignoreVary: true}).then(cached => {
        if (cached) return cached;
        return fetch(event.request).catch(() => {
          if (event.request.mode === 'navigate') return caches.match('/index.html');
          return Response.error();
        });
      }));
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WORLD} from './data.js';
    
    export const MAP_HALF=WORLD/2;
    export function insideMap(x,z){return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(z)&&Math.abs(x)<=MAP_HALF&&Math.abs(z)<=MAP_HALF;}
    
    export function minimapPoint(clientX,clientY,rect){
      const axis=(value,start,size)=>(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(value-start)/size))-.5)*WORLD;
      return {x:axis(clientX,rect.left,rect.width),z:axis(clientY,rect.top,rect.height)};
    }
    
    // Intersect the square battlefield with the camera frustum on the ground.
    // Unlike four corner rays, this also works when the top of the view sees sky.
    export function cameraMapFootprint(camera,height=0){
      const matrix=new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(camera.projectionMatrix,camera.matrixWorldInverse);
      const frustum=new THREE.Frustum().setFromProjectionMatrix(matrix);
      let polygon=[[-MAP_HALF,-MAP_HALF],[MAP_HALF,-MAP_HALF],[MAP_HALF,MAP_HALF],[-MAP_HALF,MAP_HALF]].map(([x,z])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,height,z));
      for(const plane of frustum.planes){
        const clipped=[];
        for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++){
          const a=polygon[i],b=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length],da=plane.distanceToPoint(a),db=plane.distanceToPoint(b);
          if(da>=0)clipped.push(a);
          if((da>=0)!==(db>=0))clipped.push(a.clone().lerp(b,da/(da-db)));
        }
        polygon=clipped;if(!polygon.length)break;
      }
      return polygon;
    }

    export const MAP_HALF=WORLD/2;
    export function insideMap(x,z){return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(z)&&Math.abs(x)<=MAP_HALF&&Math.abs(z)<=MAP_HALF;}
    
    export function minimapPoint(clientX,clientY,rect){
      const axis=(value,start,size)=>(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(value-start)/size))-.5)*WORLD;
      return {x:axis(clientX,rect.left,rect.width),z:axis(clientY,rect.top,rect.height)};
    }
    
    // Intersect the square battlefield with the camera frustum on the ground.
    // Unlike four corner rays, this also works when the top of the view sees sky.
    export function cameraMapFootprint(camera,height=0){
      const matrix=new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(camera.projectionMatrix,camera.matrixWorldInverse);
      const frustum=new THREE.Frustum().setFromProjectionMatrix(matrix);
      let polygon=[[-MAP_HALF,-MAP_HALF],[MAP_HALF,-MAP_HALF],[MAP_HALF,MAP_HALF],[-MAP_HALF,MAP_HALF]].map(([x,z])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,height,z));
      for(const plane of frustum.planes){
        const clipped=[];
        for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++){
          const a=polygon[i],b=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length],da=plane.distanceToPoint(a),db=plane.distanceToPoint(b);
          if(da>=0)clipped.push(a);
          if((da>=0)!==(db>=0))clipped.push(a.clone().lerp(b,da/(da-db)));
        }
        polygon=clipped;if(!polygon.length)break;
      }
      return polygon;
    }

    function buildMapBoundary(view){
      const vertices=[],indices=[],half=MAP_HALF,width=.18,depth=.16;
      const corners=[[-half,-half],[half,-half],[half,half],[-half,half]];
      for(let side=0;side<4;side++){
        const [ax,az]=corners[side],[bx,bz]=corners[(side+1)%4],dx=(bx-ax)/WORLD,dz=(bz-az)/WORLD;
        for(let distance=0;distance<WORLD;distance+=2){
          const base=vertices.length/3;
          for(const t of [distance,distance+2])for(const across of [-width,width]){
            const x=ax+dx*t-dz*across,z=az+dz*t+dx*across,y=view.landscape.surfaceHeightAt(x,z)+.15;
            vertices.push(x,y,z,x,y-depth,z);
          }
          for(const face of [[0,4,6,2],[1,3,7,5],[0,1,5,4],[2,6,7,3],[0,2,3,1],[4,5,7,6]])indices.push(base+face[0],base+face[1],base+face[2],base+face[0],base+face[2],base+face[3]);
        }
      }
      const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));geometry.setIndex(indices);geometry.computeVertexNormals();geometry.computeBoundingBox();
      const boundary=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xa4af93,transparent:true,opacity:.65,depthWrite:false,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));boundary.renderOrder=6;boundary.userData.mapBoundary=true;view.terrain.add(boundary);view.mapBoundary=boundary;
    }
    
    function buildBridge(view,channel){
      const g=new THREE.Group(),m=view.materials,x=channel.center,width=channel.width+3;
      view.box(g,m.wood,x,.54,0,width*2,.36,15.5);
      for(let z=-7.5;z<=7.5;z+=.65)view.box(g,m.darkwood,x,.745,z,width*2,.045,.06);
      for(const side of [-1,1]){
        view.box(g,m.stoneDark,x,1.18,side*7.4,width*2+.6,.3,.45);
        for(let xx=-width;xx<=width;xx+=2){view.box(g,m.stone,x+xx,.7,side*7.4,.5,1.3,.5);}
      }
      for(const xx of [-width+1,width-1])for(const z of [-6,6])view.box(g,m.stoneDark,x+xx,-.05,z,1.2,2.5,1.5);
      view.terrain.add(view.mergeModel(g));
    }
    
    export function animateWater(view){
      for(const mesh of view.waterMeshes||[]){
        const p=mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position');
        for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)p.setY(i,.08+Math.sin(p.getX(i)*.9+p.getZ(i)*.36+view.clock*1.3)*.035+Math.cos(p.getZ(i)*.65-view.clock)*.02);

      }
      view.waterNormalFrame=Math.floor(view.clock*8);

    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 9 October 2026 against the version 2.1 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Eight modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 13 trainable unit types plus sovereigns.
    - Two-player Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, player perspectives, and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.
    
    ## Development order and release checks
    
    | Pass | Work to implement or improve | Evidence required before declaring the pass complete |
    |---|---|---|
    | 1. Controls and army movement | Remappable hotkeys, selection priority, production across selected buildings, global production queue, queued-command feedback, patrol/guard behaviors, formation cohesion, obstacle avoidance, and recovery from blocked routes. Preserve edge scrolling and touch input. | Repeatable mouse/keyboard/touch scenarios; armies navigate woods, walls, gates, bridges, and crowded towns; no duplicated queued orders or indefinitely stuck troops in the tested cases. Local command feedback and execution latency measured on reference hardware. |
    | 2. Economy, AI, and battle balance | Explicit AI build orders and resource budgets, scouting memory, different attack plans, counter-unit composition, regrouping, retreating, siege protection, expansion, transport decisions, and difficulty based on decisions. Audit starting advantages and any difficulty bonuses. | Seeded economy and combat scenarios; AI can recover after worker losses and exhausted nearby resources; attacks change based on observed enemies; difficulty rules are documented; human testers find each level understandable and challenging. |
    | 3. Civilizations and strategic depth | Unique units and technologies, clearer civilization identities, useful upgrade choices, meaningful land/naval counters, alternative economic strategies, and an interactive technology tree. Expand team/player support before adding team modes. | Comparable-cost counter scenarios plus human matches; all additions have costs, prerequisites, counters, descriptions, art, audio, AI support, saves, and multiplayer validation. Balance judged across maps and skill levels. |
    | 4. Missions and map design | A mission-event system with staged objectives, dialogue, reinforcements, escort/rescue tasks, branching optional goals, checkpoints, and authored set pieces. Curate resource placement, chokepoints, naval landings, and spawn fairness. | Each mission can be completed and failed correctly on each difficulty; checkpoints restore the correct event state; missions require different strategies; map objectives and travel routes remain reachable. |
    | 5. Art, animation, and sound | Establish a consistent medieval art direction; replace or refine the procedural assets with original or appropriately licensed authored models, textures, character rigs, transitions, worker tasks, cargo, attack impacts, damage, and death animations. Add distinctive music, unit responses, ambience, and readable combat sound. | Visual review in real gameplay at every quality setting and camera angle; recognizable units and silhouettes; animations match actions; assets fit performance budgets; retain real mesh geometry at every detail level. |
    | 6. Laptop and phone experience | Profile CPU/GPU work, pathfinding, draw calls, memory, network snapshots, and input delay. Improve detail levels, shared routes, batching, effects budgets, loading, safe areas, readable UI, touch selection, UI scaling, and accessibility options. | Publish device/browser/specification results. Proposed targets: 60 FPS on a defined reference laptop and 30 FPS on defined supported phones in benchmark matches. Verify sustained performance, frame-time spikes, thermal behavior, and memory over long sessions. Targets are not current achievements or guarantees for every device. |
    | 7. Multiplayer and community | Public hosting, persistent room/session state, matchmaking, reconnect recovery, cooperative/team games, profiles, replay/spectator tools, authoritative validation, and operational monitoring. Generalize the current two-player simulation and perspective assumptions first. | Test multiple clients, latency, packet loss, disconnects, server restarts, ownership, hidden-information handling, version compatibility, and replay results. Hosting choices and ongoing costs need an explicit deployment decision. |
    | 8. Release readiness | Improve onboarding, settings, saved-game migrations, campaign progression, post-match economy/combat graphs, installation/update behavior, diagnostics, recovery, and documentation. Conduct repeated external playtests and fix their highest-impact problems. | Long complete matches, all modes, save/resume/update cycles, physical phones/laptops, multiplayer failure scenarios, and accessibility reviews pass the agreed release checklist. Record remaining limitations instead of labeling unchecked areas complete. |
    
    Performance, regression testing, and human feedback run throughout these passes; they are not postponed until the end.
    
    ## Recommended next release
    
    Start with Pass 1 and the most visible parts of Pass 2:
    
    1. Add a global production queue and selection across multiple production buildings.
    2. Introduce remappable controls with conflict reporting and saved profiles.
    3. Improve group movement through gates, around buildings, and over bridges; show blocked-order feedback.
    4. Make AI openings and spending intentional, then add scouting-informed attack/retreat decisions.
    5. Exercise complete economy-to-victory matches with several seeds and difficulties, followed by laptop and phone playtests.
    
    Deliver these as tested releases that can be played and reviewed. Additional units or prettier screenshots alone do not establish overall game quality.
    
    ## What can be developed here and what needs outside evidence
    
    The existing workspace supports implementation of gameplay, AI, UI, asset integration, shaders, animation, performance instrumentation, testing, and multiplayer services. Professional asset/audio production requires suitable original work or licensed sources. Physical-device results require access to the actual devices or measurements from testers. Public online operation requires a hosting decision and ongoing service resources. Fun and balance require repeated human playtesting.
    
    No honest development process can promise an objective â€œ100% world-classâ€ score. The useful commitment is to finish defined requirements, publish test evidence, address player feedback, and improve successive releases.
    
    ## Research references
    
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season One development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-one-update-release-notes/): controls, global production queues, patrol, player feedback, balance, maps, campaign tuning, and post-match navigation. Used as a genre quality reference, not a statement of this project's implemented features.
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season Two development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-17718/): continued iteration across controls, game modes, multiplayer, and stability.
    - The baseline above is supported by the local source, [README](README.md), [change log](CHANGELOG.md), and tests/scripts in this repository.

        if(first.type==='market')panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="trade-actions">${['food','wood','stone'].map(r=>`<span>${ICONS[r]} <button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="true">Buy 100 Â· 130â—†</button><button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="false">Sell 100 Â· 70â—†</button></span>`).join('')}</div>`;

      else panel.innerHTML+=`<p class="selection-desc">${data.desc||''}</p>${mine&&first.kind==='unit'?attributes(first)+tactics():''}${mine&&first.type==='transport'?`<div class="worker-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="unload">âš“ Unload ${first.passengers?.length||0} passengers</button></div>`:''}`;
      if(mine&&first.kind==='building'&&(first.type!=='towncenter'||sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter').length>1))panel.innerHTML+=`<button class="demolish" data-demolish="${first.id}">${first.progress<1?'Cancel construction (70% refund)':'Demolish (20% refund)'}</button>`;

    function renderHUD(){if(!playing)return;const p=sim.players[0];$('#resource-bar').innerHTML=['food','wood','gold','stone'].map(r=>`<div class="resource"><span class="resource-icon ${r}">${ICONS[r]}</span><strong>${Math.floor(p.resources[r])}</strong><small>${r==='wood'?'TIMBER':r.toUpperCase()}</small></div>`).join('')+`<div class="resource population ${sim.population(0)>=sim.capacity(0)?'full-pop':''}"><span class="resource-icon">â™Ÿ</span><strong>${sim.population(0)}<i>/${sim.capacity(0)}</i></strong><small>POPULATION</small></div>`;
      $('#age-label').textContent=AGES[p.age];$('#game-time').textContent=formatTime(sim.time);if(net.active)$('#control-hint').textContent=`ROOM ${net.code} Â· ${net.ping}ms`;$('#speed-button').textContent=`${speed}Ã—`;
      const m=MODES.find(m=>m.id===sim.options.mode)||sim.mission;let objective=m.objective;
      if(sim.options.mode==='tutorial')objective=sim.tutorialObjectives().map((o,i)=>`<div class="lesson ${o.done?'done':''}"><span>${o.done?'âœ“':i+1}</span>${o.text}</div>`).join('');
      else objective=`<p>${objective}</p>`;
      let info='';if(sim.options.mode==='regicide'){const king=sim.owned(0,'unit','king')[0];info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>YOUR SOVEREIGN</span><strong>${king?Math.ceil(king.hp):0} HP ? Keep safe</strong></div>`;}if(sim.options.mode==='survival'||sim.mission?.survival)info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>WAVE ${sim.wave} / ${sim.mission?.waves||10}</span><strong>${sim.wave<(sim.mission?.waves||10)?`Next Â· ${formatTime(Math.max(0,sim.nextWave-sim.time))}`:'Eliminate remaining enemies'}</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='dominion'||sim.mission?.dominion)info=`<div class="shrine-status">${sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine').map(e=>`<span class="${e.owner===0?'owned':e.owner===1?'rival':''}">âœ§</span>`).join('')}<strong>${formatTime(sim.hold)} / 03:00</strong></div>`;
      if(sim.options.mode==='wonder')info=`<div class="objective-progress"><span>YOUR MONUMENT</span><strong>${formatTime(sim.wonderTime[0])} / 04:00</strong></div>`;
      $('#objectives').innerHTML=`<div class="objective-eyebrow">${sim.mission?'CHAPTER '+sim.mission.chapter:m.tag.toUpperCase()}<span class="difficulty-tag">${DIFFICULTIES[sim.options.difficulty].name}</span></div><h3>${m.name}</h3>${objective}${info}`;
      $('#army-count').textContent=`${sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='fishingboat'&&!e.embarked).length} soldiers`;$('#map-label').textContent=sim.options.map.toUpperCase();$('#control-hint').textContent=net.active?`ROOM ${net.code} | ${net.ping}ms`:touchDevice?'TAP TO COMMAND Â· PINCH TO ZOOM':'MOUSE EDGES TO PAN | RIGHT-CLICK TO COMMAND';
      renderMinimap();renderHealth();

      if(name==='save'){saveGame();return;}if(name==='menu')return menuReturn();if(name==='restart'){if(net.active){net.leave();menuReturn();showLan();return;}return startGame(sim.options);}

    document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const el=event.target.closest('button,a[data-action]');if(!el)return;
      if(el.dataset.action)action(el.dataset.action);

      if(el.dataset.stance){if(net.active)net.action('stance',[selection,el.dataset.stance]);for(const e of selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit')){e.stance=el.dataset.stance;if(e.stance==='hold'){e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];}}toast(el.dataset.stance==='hold'?'Units will hold their position and defend.':'Units will engage nearby enemies.');}

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {cameraMapBox,cameraMapFootprint,insideMap,minimapPoint} from '../src/map-geometry.js';
    import {CAMERA_PRESETS} from '../src/world.js';
    
    function cameraAt(x,z,angle,tilt,zoom,aspect){
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(46,aspect,.5,400);
      camera.position.set(x+Math.sin(angle)*zoom,.65+Math.tan(tilt)*zoom,z+Math.cos(angle)*zoom);
      camera.lookAt(x,.65,z);camera.updateMatrixWorld();return camera;
    }
    
    test('radar camera box stays finite and rectangular across map edges, views and rotations',()=>{
      for(const preset of Object.values(CAMERA_PRESETS))for(const [x,z]of [[0,0],[-72,-72],[-72,72],[72,-72],[72,72]])for(const angle of [0,Math.PI/4,1.85,Math.PI])for(const aspect of [1440/900,844/390,390/844]){
        const camera=cameraAt(x,z,angle,preset.tilt,preset.zoom,aspect),box=cameraMapBox(camera,.65);
        assert.ok(box,'a camera aimed inside the battlefield always has a locator');
        for(const value of Object.values(box))assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value)&&Math.abs(value)<=80.00001);
        assert.ok(box.minX<box.maxX&&box.minZ<box.maxZ);
        assert.ok(x>=box.minX-1e-5&&x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&z<=box.maxZ+1e-5,'the camera center is inside its box');
        for(const p of cameraMapFootprint(camera,.65))assert.ok(p.x>=box.minX-1e-5&&p.x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&p.z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&p.z<=box.maxZ+1e-5);
      }
    });
    
    test('radar locator follows scrolling and grows when zooming out',()=>{
      const preset=CAMERA_PRESETS.tactical,make=(x,z,zoom)=>cameraMapBox(cameraAt(x,z,0,preset.tilt,zoom,1.6),.65);
      const near=make(0,0,24),far=make(0,0,45),moved=make(10,12,24);
      assert.ok(far.maxX-far.minX>near.maxX-near.minX);assert.ok(far.maxZ-far.minZ>near.maxZ-near.minZ);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minX-near.minX-10)<1e-5);assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minZ-near.minZ-12)<1e-5);
    });
    
    test('minimap coordinates map consistently to the square battlefield and clamp captured drags',()=>{
      const rect={left:17,top:29,width:101,height:101};
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(17,29,rect),{x:-80,z:-80});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(118,130,rect),{x:80,z:80});
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(67.5,79.5,rect),{x:0,z:0});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(-50,600,rect),{x:-80,z:80});
      for(const [x,z]of [[NaN,0],[0,Infinity],[81,0],[0,-81]])assert.equal(insideMap(x,z),false);
    });
    
    test('terrain picking allows the playable square and rejects decorative surroundings',()=>{
      for(const map of ['highlands','coast','valley']){
        const land=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=land.geometry(320,112);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-79,-79],[79,79],[-79,79],[79,-79],[0,0]])assert.ok(land.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0))));
        for(const [x,z]of [[81,0],[-81,0],[0,81],[0,-81],[140,140]])assert.equal(land.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0))),null);
        geometry.dispose();
      }
    });

    export class LanClient {
      constructor(callbacks){this.callbacks=callbacks;this.active=false;this.retry=0;this.socket=null;this.ping=0;this.session=null;try{this.session=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('crowns-lan'));}catch{};}
      connect(message){this.intent=message;this.leaving=false;this.socket=new WebSocket(`${location.protocol==='https:'?'wss:':'ws:'}//${location.host}/socket`);
        this.socket.addEventListener('open',()=>{this.retry=0;this.send(message);clearInterval(this.pinger);this.pinger=setInterval(()=>this.send({type:'ping',stamp:Date.now()}),3000);});
        this.socket.addEventListener('message',event=>{const data=JSON.parse(event.data);if(data.type==='session'){this.session={code:data.code,token:data.token};try{sessionStorage.setItem('crowns-lan',JSON.stringify(this.session));}catch{}}
          if(data.type==='lobby')this.callbacks.lobby(data);
          if(data.type==='begin'){this.active=true;this.code=data.code;this.callbacks.begin(data.state);}
          if(data.type==='state')this.callbacks.state(data.state,data.effects,data.waiting);
          if(data.type==='error'){if(!this.active&&this.intent?.type==='resume'){this.session=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem('crowns-lan');}catch{}}this.callbacks.notice(data.message);}
          if(data.type==='closed'){this.leave();this.callbacks.notice(data.message);}
          if(data.type==='pong')this.ping=Date.now()-data.stamp;
        });
        this.socket.addEventListener('close',()=>{clearInterval(this.pinger);if(this.leaving)return;this.callbacks.notice('Connection interrupted. The match waits while you reconnect.');if(this.session&&this.retry++<8)setTimeout(()=>this.connect({type:'resume',...this.session}),2000);});
        this.socket.addEventListener('error',()=>this.callbacks.notice('Multiplayer needs the game server. Start with npm start, then use the same Wi-Fi link.'));
      }
      send(message){if(this.socket?.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN)this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));}
      action(method,args){const normalized=args.map(arg=>arg?.id!==undefined?arg.id:arg);this.send({type:'action',method,args:normalized});return true;}
      bind(sim){for(const method of ['build','train','research','cancelQueue','trade','smartCommand','stop','unload','demolish','assignWorker'])sim[method]=(...args)=>{if(method==='smartCommand')sim.emit('order',{order:{}});return this.action(method,args);};}
      leave(){this.leaving=true;this.active=false;this.send({type:'leave'});this.socket?.close();clearInterval(this.pinger);this.session=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem('crowns-lan');}catch{}}
    }

    import {UNITS,TECHS} from './data.js';
    
    export function productionBuildings(sim,ids=null){
      const selection=ids?new Set(ids):null;
      return sim.owned(0,'building').filter(b=>b.hp>0&&b.progress>=1&&(!selection||selection.has(b.id))&&(Object.values(UNITS).some(d=>d.at.includes(b.type))||Object.values(TECHS).some(d=>d.at.includes(b.type))));
    }
    export function trainingBuildings(sim,type,ids){return productionBuildings(sim,ids).filter(b=>UNITS[type]?.at.includes(b.type));}
    export const queuedSeconds=building=>building.queue.reduce((sum,q)=>sum+q.remaining,0);
    
    // Balance a batch against virtual queues, so remote commands also distribute
    // correctly while waiting for the authoritative multiplayer snapshot.
    export function trainAcrossBuildings(sim,type,ids,count=1){
      const buildings=trainingBuildings(sim,type,ids),definition=UNITS[type];if(!buildings.length||!definition)return 0;
      const seconds=new Map(buildings.map(b=>[b.id,queuedSeconds(b)])),lengths=new Map(buildings.map(b=>[b.id,b.queue.length]));
      const budget={...sim.players[0].resources};let slots=sim.capacity(0)-sim.population(0)-sim.reservedPopulation(0),trained=0;
      for(let i=0;i<Math.max(1,Math.min(5,count));i++){
        const available=buildings.filter(b=>lengths.get(b.id)<8).sort((a,b)=>seconds.get(a.id)-seconds.get(b.id)||a.id-b.id),building=available[0]||buildings[0];
        const affordable=Object.entries(definition.cost).every(([resource,cost])=>budget[resource]>=cost);
        if(!available.length||slots<=0||!affordable||sim.players[0].age<definition.age){if(!trained)sim.train(building.id,type);break;}
        if(!sim.train(building.id,type))break;
        trained++;slots--;lengths.set(building.id,lengths.get(building.id)+1);seconds.set(building.id,seconds.get(building.id)+definition.time);
        for(const [resource,cost]of Object.entries(definition.cost))budget[resource]-=cost;
      }
      return trained;
    }

    import {attachRooms} from '../server/rooms.js';
    class Inbox {
      constructor(ws){this.messages=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),i=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(i>=0){const [w]=this.waiters.splice(i,1);clearTimeout(w.timer);w.resolve(message);}else this.messages.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.messages.findIndex(m=>m.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.messages.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),3000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }

      t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});
      const connect=async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`);clients.push(ws);const inbox=new Inbox(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:data=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(data))};};

      const a=(await host.inbox.next('begin')).state,b=(await guest.inbox.next('begin')).state;

      assert.deepEqual(a.players[0].resources,b.players[0].resources);assert.equal(a.entities.find(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='towncenter').x,-b.entities.find(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='towncenter').x);assert.equal(b.players[0].faction,'raven');
      assert.equal(b.entities.filter(e=>e.owner===1&&e.kind==='unit').length,0);

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {UNITS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {productionBuildings,trainAcrossBuildings} from '../src/production.js';
    
    function setup(){
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',seed:512}),a=sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0],b=sim.addBuilding('barracks',0,-15,25,true);
      sim.players[0].resources={food:10000,wood:10000,gold:10000,stone:10000};return {sim,a,b};
    }
    test('group training distributes units across the shortest available queues',()=>{
      const {sim,a,b}=setup(),food=sim.players[0].resources.food;
      assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id],5),5);
      assert.deepEqual([a.queue.length,b.queue.length],[3,2]);assert.equal(sim.players[0].resources.food,food-UNITS.spearman.cost.food*5);
      assert.equal(sim.reservedPopulation(0),5);
      assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id]),1);assert.deepEqual([a.queue.length,b.queue.length],[3,3]);
    });
    test('full, hostile, incomplete, and incompatible buildings cannot consume group orders',()=>{
      const {sim,a,b}=setup(),enemy=sim.owned(1,'building','barracks')[0],foundation=sim.addBuilding('barracks',0,-15,40),range=sim.addBuilding('range',0,-50,40,true);
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++)assert.ok(sim.train(a.id,'spearman'));
      assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id,enemy.id,foundation.id,range.id],5),5);assert.equal(a.queue.length,8);assert.equal(b.queue.length,5);assert.equal(enemy.queue.length,0);assert.equal(foundation.queue.length,0);assert.equal(range.queue.length,0);
      assert.ok(!productionBuildings(sim).some(e=>e.owner!==0||e.progress<1));
    });
    test('batches stop at the actual resource and population budgets without charging rejected units',()=>{
      const {sim,a,b}=setup();sim.players[0].resources.food=UNITS.spearman.cost.food*2;
      assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id],5),2);assert.equal(sim.players[0].resources.food,0);
      const cap=sim.capacity(0);while(sim.population(0)+sim.reservedPopulation(0)<cap)sim.addUnit('scout',0,-20,20);
      const budget={...sim.players[0].resources};assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id],5),0);assert.deepEqual(sim.players[0].resources,budget);
    });
    test('multiplayer batches use virtual queue lengths while awaiting server snapshots',()=>{
      const {sim,a,b}=setup(),requests=[];sim.train=(id,type)=>{requests.push({id,type});return true;};
      assert.equal(trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id],5),5);assert.deepEqual(requests.map(r=>r.id),[a.id,b.id,a.id,b.id,a.id]);
      assert.equal(a.queue.length+b.queue.length,0,'network requests do not mutate authoritative queues');
    });
    test('production queues preserve refunds and completion through save and resume',()=>{
      const {sim,a,b}=setup(),before={...sim.players[0].resources};trainAcrossBuildings(sim,'spearman',[a.id,b.id],5);
      const loaded=Simulation.restore(sim.serialize());loaded.cancelQueue(a.id,0);assert.equal(loaded.reservedPopulation(0),4);
      for(const [resource,cost]of Object.entries(UNITS.spearman.cost))assert.equal(loaded.players[0].resources[resource],before[resource]-cost*4);
      const population=loaded.population(0);for(let i=0;i<600;i++)loaded.tick(.1);assert.equal(loaded.population(0),population+4);assert.equal(loaded.reservedPopulation(0),0);
    });

    README.md:21:The server runs the simulation and checks command ownership. Each player sees their own economy and fog of war. Both receive mirrored starting towns and armies. Leaving a started match concedes it. Restarting the laptop server ends its in-memory rooms.

    const server=http.createServer((request,response)=>{try{const pathname=decodeURIComponent(new URL(request.url,'http://localhost').pathname);const file=path.resolve(root,'.'+(pathname==='/'?'/index.html':pathname));if(!file.startsWith(root+path.sep)||!fs.existsSync(file)||!fs.statSync(file).isFile()){response.writeHead(404);response.end('Not found');return;}response.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(file)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':file.includes(path.sep+'assets'+path.sep)?'public, max-age=31536000, immutable':'no-cache'});fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(response);}catch{response.writeHead(400);response.end('Invalid request');}});

    ## Controls
    
    | Action | Laptop | Phone/tablet |
    |---|---|---|
    | Select | Left click; Shift adds; drag a selection box | Tap a unit or building |
    | Command | Right click; Shift queues | Select units, then tap ground, enemies, or resources |
    | Pan | Mouse at the game-window edges/corners, WASD/arrows, or middle-button drag | Drag the battlefield |
    | Zoom | Mouse wheel | Two-finger pinch |
    | Rotate | Q/E or camera arrow buttons | Two-finger twist or camera arrow buttons |
    | Camera angle | V or the camera view button | Camera view button |
    | Inspect selected model | I or selection portrait | Tap selection portrait |
    | Hide/show panels | Square camera button | Square camera button |
    | Center town | H or minimap home | Minimap home button |
    | Select army | M | Army button |
    | Idle villagers | Period | Idle button |
    | Construct | B | Build button |
    | Attack move | F, then click | Attack button, then tap |
    | Stop / hold | X | Stop button |
    | Groups | Ctrl + 1â€“9 assigns; 1â€“9 recalls | Army/type selection buttons |
    | Focus selection | Space | Tap minimap to navigate |
    | Pause | Esc | Pause button |
    
    Choose **Stone wall** and drag across visible, open land to place a connected line. Use **Shift** to keep other construction tools active. Select a completed military building to train troops, a blacksmith to research combat technologies, or the town center to advance ages. Use the in-game **Field guide** for costs and counters.
    
    Mouse edge scrolling is enabled by default. Bring the cursor into the outer 24 pixels of the game window to pan; corners pan diagonally and a directional arrow appears. Scrolling follows the rotated camera, stops outside the game or during menus/pauses, and avoids controls. **Settings** includes an on/off toggle and speed slider. Touch gestures continue to pan and zoom. Fullscreen lets you use the monitor edges.
    
    ## Build, offline play, and tests
    
    ```powershell
    npm run build
    npm run preview
    npm test
    - `src/soundscape.js`: battle sounds and atmospheric audio.
    - `src/network.js`: room connection, commands, and session reconnection.
    - `server/rooms.js`: authoritative Wi-Fi matches, player perspectives, command validation, disconnect handling, and room lifecycle.
    - `server/index.js`: local game hosting and WebSocket server.
    - `vite.config.js`: build splitting and offline cache generation.
    
    ## Research and scope
    
    The design draws on the genre's established exploration â†’ resource collection â†’ construction â†’ army â†’ age progression loop and varied victory conditions described in the [official Age of Empires IV quickstart](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/quickstart-guide-age-of-empires-iv/) and [official strategy introduction](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-tips-to-help-you-get-started/). Picking and repeated-model rendering follow the [Three.js Raycaster](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html) and [InstancedMesh](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/InstancedMesh.html) documentation.
    
    Instanced animation follows the [Three.js update documentation](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/how-to-update-things.html). Room transport and heartbeat handling follow the [official ws documentation](https://github.com/websockets/ws). The naval design considers fishing economies, transport landings, and shoreline defense described in the [official Age of Empires naval update](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-11-0-782/).
    
    The graphics use shaped [CapsuleGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/CapsuleGeometry.html), solid architectural [ExtrudeGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/ExtrudeGeometry.html), and indexed terrain [BufferGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/BufferGeometry.html). Distant forests use simpler solid geometry and pack only visible instances; world objects do not switch to billboard images.
    
    This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Two-player Wi-Fi gameplay is implemented; public internet matchmaking, accounts, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production-scale backend service are not. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.
    ```
