    The production output is in `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web host. The generated service worker caches the game and its bundled assets for offline use after the first successful visit over HTTPS (or localhost). The web app manifest requests fullscreen landscape when installed. Browser support for fullscreen, installation, and orientation locking varies. Fonts and their licenses are bundled locally. No game assets depend on a third-party CDN.
    
    The browser QA scripts use a locally installed Microsoft Edge. `release-qa.mjs` tests a real room with desktop and emulated phone clients, both command perspectives, phone troop training, and reconnecting after a reload. It defaults to a test server on port 4180; set `QA_URL` to another server URL as needed. `npm test` also runs a real WebSocket test for fair starts, ownership rejection, fog masking, disconnect pauses, and session restoration. Emulation does not substitute for testing on physical phones.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    - `src/data.js`: troops, buildings, research, civilizations, difficulties, maps, and missions.
    - `src/simulation.js`: deterministic map generation and independent fixed-step gameplay simulation. The opponent gathers, pays for buildings and units, advances ages, researches technologies, and attacks. Survival is explicitly a wave-spawn scenario.
    - `src/world.js`: procedural 3D models, camera, ray picking, shadows, fog, and combat effects. Forests and units use instanced rendering; buildings/resources merge geometry by material. Graphics adapt to sustained slow frames.

**No. The game is still a playable beta.** I cannot honestly call it fully completed or world-class in every area.

The battlefield, buildings, troops, ships, and resources use **real 3D models**. Menus, the HUD, and radar use 2D overlays, so “100% 3D in every area” would be inaccurate.

All 50 automated tests pass. Further AI improvements, balance, mission depth, visual/audio polish, complete-match playtesting, and testing on physical phones and laptops remain before a finished release.

    function startGame(options,save=null){if(!view)return;edgeScroll.reset();tacticalMode=null;unloadMode=false;productionOpen=false;productionKey='';$('#production-panel').classList.add('hidden');$('#production-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');$('#hud').classList.remove('panels-hidden');$('[data-action=camera-panels]').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');closeModal();setupOptions={...setupOptions,...options};sim=save?Simulation.restore(save):new Simulation(options);view.attach(sim);sim.on(onEvent);playing=true;paused=false;speed=1;groups={};$('#toasts').innerHTML='';selection=[];view.selection=new Set();buildType=null;attackMove=false;accumulator=0;lastAutosave=sim.time;$('#landing').classList.add('hidden');$('#hud').classList.remove('hidden');$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');view.angle=Math.PI/4;view.setCameraPreset(settings.cameraPreset,true);updateCameraLabel();audio.unlock();renderHUD();renderSelection();updateRotate();toast('Your kingdom awaits.     function onEvent(e){if(e.type==='notice'&&e.owner!==undefined&&e.owner!==0)return;
      if(e.type==='notice')toast(e.message,e.tone);
      if(e.type==='complete'){toast(`${BUILDINGS[e.entity.type].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='trained'&&e.entity.owner===0){audio.play('complete');if(e.entity.type==='villager'&&!e.entity.order)sim.assignWorker(e.entity);}
      if(e.type==='research'){toast(e.tech==='age'?`${AGES[e.age]} reached. New troops and buildings unlocked.`:`${TECHS[e.tech].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='order'){audio.play('order');}
      if(e.type==='sound')audio.play(e.name);
      if(e.type==='alarm'){$('#alert-line').innerHTML='<span class="alert-pulse"></span> YOUR KINGDOM IS UNDER ATTACK';audio.play('alarm');setTimeout(()=>$('#alert-line').innerHTML='',7000);}
      if(e.type==='raid')toast('Scouts report an enemy army on the move.','warning');
      if(e.type==='wave'){toast(`Wave ${e.wave} Â· ${e.count} enemies approach. Supplies have arrived.`,'warning');audio.play('alarm');}
      if(e.type==='capture'){toast(e.owner===0?'An ancient shrine is under your control.':'The enemy has captured a shrine.',e.owner===0?'':'warning');audio.play('complete');}
      if(e.type==='attack'||e.type==='death'||e.type==='heal'){view.effect(e);if(e.type==='attack')audio.play('attack',e.entity,{x:view.target.x,z:view.target.z,angle:view.angle});}
      if(e.type==='campaign-stage'){toast(e.text);audio.play('complete');renderHUD();}
      if(e.type==='campaign-checkpoint'){saveGame(true);toast('Campaign checkpoint saved. Restore it from the commander menu.');}
      if(e.type==='end')showEnd(e);
    }

    function showHelp(){if(playing)paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">THE COMMANDER'S HANDBOOK</div><h2>Every empire starts small.</h2><div class="help-grid"><div><h3>Mouse & keyboard</h3><p>Move the mouse to an edge of the game window to scroll the camera.     export class LanClient {
      constructor(callbacks){this.callbacks=callbacks;this.active=false;this.retry=0;this.socket=null;this.ping=0;this.session=null;try{this.session=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('crowns-lan'));}catch{};}

        let resource=this.nearest(e,t=>t.kind==='resource'&&!t.water&&t.type===type&&t.amount>0);if(!resource)resource=this.nearest(e,t=>t.type==='farm'&&t.owner===e.owner&&t.progress>=1);if(resource){e.gatherType=resource.type==='farm'?'food':resource.type;e.order={type:'gather',target:resource.id};e.path=[];}}
      assignEconomy(owner){for(const e of this.owned(owner,'unit','villager'))if(!e.order)this.assignWorker(e);}
      aiBuild(type,owner=1){const tc=this.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0];if(!tc)return false;const worker=this.owned(owner,'unit','villager').find(w=>!['build','repair'].includes(w.order?.type));if(!worker)return false;
        for(let i=0;i<24;i++){const angle=this.rng()*Math.PI*2,r=12+this.rng()*23,x=clamp(tc.x+Math.cos(angle)*r,-71,71),z=clamp(tc.z+Math.sin(angle)*r,-71,71);if(this.buildValid(type,x,z,owner))return this.build(type,x,z,[worker.id],owner);}return false;
      }
      tickAI(){const m=this.options.mode;if(this.options.multiplayer||['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(m)||this.mission?.survival)return;const owner=1,p=this.players[1],difficulty=DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty],tc=this.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0];if(!tc)return;
        this.assignEconomy(1);const workers=this.owned(1,'unit','villager');
        if(workers.length<22&&!tc.queue.some(q=>q.kind==='unit'))this.train(tc.id,'villager');
        if(this.capacity(1)-this.population(1)-this.reservedPopulation(1)<5&&!this.owned(1,'building','house').some(b=>b.progress<1))this.aiBuild('house');
        if(p.age<3&&!p.agePending&&workers.length>=10&&this.canAfford(AGE_COSTS[p.age],1))this.research(tc.id,'age');
        const priorities=['barracks',...(p.age>=1?['range','stable','blacksmith','market']:[]),...(p.age>=2?['workshop','tower','monastery']:[])];
        for(const type of priorities)if(!this.owned(1,'building',type).length&&this.canAfford(BUILDINGS[type].cost,1)){this.aiBuild(type);break;}
        if(p.resources.food<150&&this.owned(1,'building','farm').length<5)this.aiBuild('farm');
        for(const b of this.owned(1,'building').filter(e=>e.progress>=1&&e.queue.length<2)){
          const choices=Object.entries(UNITS).filter(([type,d])=>type!=='villager'&&type!=='scout'&&d.age<=p.age&&d.at.includes(b.type));
          if(choices.length){const [type]=choices[Math.floor(this.rng()*choices.length)];this.train(b.id,type);}
          if(b.type==='blacksmith'){for(const tech of ['attack','armor','ranged'])if(p.tech[tech]<p.age&&!b.queue.length)this.research(b.id,tech);}
        }
        const soldiers=this.owned(1,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='fishingboat'&&e.type!=='king'&&!e.embarked);
        if(this.time>=this.nextAttack&&soldiers.length>=4){const target=this.options.mode==='regicide'?this.owned(0,'unit','king')[0]:this.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(target){this.command(soldiers.map(e=>e.id),{type:'attackmove',x:target.x,z:target.z});this.nextAttack=this.time+Math.max(35,70*difficulty.ai);this.emit('raid',{});}}
        const king=this.owned(1,'unit','king')[0];if(king&&king.hp<king.maxHp*.6&&tc)king.order={type:'move',x:tc.x+8,z:tc.z-7};
        if((m==='dominion'||this.mission?.dominion)&&this.time>65){const free=soldiers.filter(e=>!e.order||e.order.type!=='attack');for(const shrine of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine'&&e.owner!==1)){const group=free.splice(0,3);this.command(group.map(e=>e.id),{type:'attackmove',x:shrine.x,z:shrine.z});}}
        if(m==='wonder'&&p.age===3&&this.time>700&&!this.owned(1,'building','wonder').length&&this.canAfford(BUILDINGS.wonder.cost,1))this.aiBuild('wonder');
      }
      spawnWave(){this.wave++;const d=DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty],count=Math.round((5+this.wave*2.5)*d.wave),sides=[{x:58,z:55},{x:-58,z:-55},{x:60,z:-50}],base=sides[(this.wave-1)%sides.length];
        this.players[1].age=Math.min(3,Math.floor(this.wave/3));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
          let type=i%3===0?'archer':'spearman';if(this.wave>=3&&i%4===0)type='knight';if(this.wave>=5&&i%8===0)type='ram';if(this.wave>=8&&i%10===0)type='catapult';
          const unit=this.addUnit(type,1,base.x+i%6*1.8,base.z+Math.floor(i/6)*1.8);const tc=this.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];if(tc)unit.order={type:'attackmove',x:tc.x,z:tc.z};
        }this.nextWave=this.time+95;this.emit('wave',{wave:this.wave,count});
        // Supply caravans reward surviving a wave without removing the need for an economy.
        if(this.wave>1)for(const key of ['food','wood','gold'])this.players[0].resources[key]+=80+this.wave*15;
      }
      tickShrines(dt){for(const s of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine')){const troops=[0,1].map(owner=>this.owned(owner,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&distance(s,e)<7).length);const side=troops[0]>0&&troops[1]===0?0:troops[1]>0&&troops[0]===0?1:-1;
          if(side>=0&&s.owner!==side){if(s.capturer!==side){s.capturer=side;s.progress=0;}s.progress+=dt;if(s.progress>=18){s.owner=side;s.progress=0;this.emit('capture',{owner:side});}}else if(side<0)s.progress=Math.max(0,s.progress-dt*.5);
          if(s.owner>=0)this.players[s.owner].resources.gold+=dt*.55;
        }
        const shrines=this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine');if(shrines.length){this.hold=shrines.every(e=>e.owner===0)?this.hold+dt:0;this.enemyHold=shrines.every(e=>e.owner===1)?this.enemyHold+dt:0;if(this.hold>=180)this.end(true,'The sacred valley is yours.');if(this.enemyHold>=180)this.end(false,'The rival kingdom united the sacred valley.');}
      }
      isVisible(x,z){const c=this.cell(x,z);return !!this.visible[c.z*80+c.x];}
      isExplored(x,z){const c=this.cell(x,z);return !!this.explored[c.z*80+c.x];}
      updateFog(){this.visible.fill(0);for(const e of this.owned(0).filter(e=>!e.embarked&&(e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building'&&e.progress>0))){const r=e.kind==='unit'?UNITS[e.type].vision:BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18,c=this.cell(e.x,e.z),rc=Math.ceil(r/2);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-rc);z<=Math.min(79,c.z+rc);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-rc);x<=Math.min(79,c.x+rc);x++)if(Math.hypot(x-c.x,z-c.z)<=rc){this.visible[z*80+x]=1;this.explored[z*80+x]=1;}}
        for(const s of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='shrine'&&e.owner===0)){const c=this.cell(s.x,s.z);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-9);z<=Math.min(79,c.z+9);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-9);x<=Math.min(79,c.x+9);x++){this.visible[z*80+x]=1;this.explored[z*80+x]=1;}}
      }
      tutorialObjectives(){return [
        {text:'Gather 100 resources. Your villagers are already working.',done:this.stats.gathered>=100},
        {text:'Select villagers, open Build, and construct a house.',done:this.tutorialFlags.house},
        {text:'Select the barracks and train 3 spearmen.',done:this.owned(0,'unit','spearman').length>=3},
        {text:'Right-click the ground to command your troops.',done:this.tutorialFlags.command},
        {text:'Select the town center and advance to the Feudal Age.',done:this.players[0].age>=1},
      ];}
      end(won,reason){if(this.ended)return;this.ended={won,reason};this.emit('end',this.ended);}
      checkVictory(){if(this.options.mode==='sandbox')return;
        if(this.options.mode==='regicide'){if(!this.owned(0,'unit','king').length)this.end(false,'Your sovereign has fallen.');else if(!this.owned(1,'unit','king').length)this.end(true,'The rival sovereign is defeated. Your crown endures.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(0,'building','towncenter').length)return this.end(false,'Your last town center has fallen.');
        if(this.options.mode==='tutorial'){if(this.tutorialObjectives().every(o=>o.done))this.end(true,'Your first settlement is thriving. You are ready to rule.');return;}
        const survival=this.options.mode==='survival'||this.mission?.survival;if(survival){const max=this.mission?.waves||10;if(this.wave>=max&&!this.owned(1,'unit').length&&(!this.mission||this.owned(0,'building','keep').some(b=>b.progress>=1)))this.end(true,'Your kingdom endured every assault.');return;}
        if(!this.owned(1,'building','towncenter').length){if(this.options.mode==='campaign1'&&(!this.owned(0,'building','barracks').length||this.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'&&e.type!=='scout').length<6))return;if(this.options.mode==='campaign2'&&this.players[0].age<2)return;this.end(true,'The rival capital has fallen. The frontier is yours.');}
      }
      tick(dt){if(this.ended)return;this.time+=dt;this.buckets=new Map();for(const e of this.owned(0,'unit').concat(this.owned(1,'unit'))){const key=`${Math.floor(e.x/4)},${Math.floor(e.z/4)}`;if(!this.buckets.has(key))this.buckets.set(key,[]);this.buckets.get(key).push(e);}
        for(const e of [...this.entities])if(e.hp>0){if(e.kind==='unit')this.tickUnit(e,dt);else if(e.kind==='building')this.tickBuilding(e,dt);}
        this.aiClock+=dt;if(this.aiClock>=3*DIFFICULTIES[this.options.difficulty].ai){this.aiClock=0;this.tickAI();}
        const survival=this.options.mode==='survival'||this.mission?.survival;if(survival&&this.time>=this.nextWave&&this.wave<(this.mission?.waves||10))this.spawnWave();
        this.tickShrines(dt);
        if(this.options.mode==='wonder'){for(let owner=0;owner<2;owner++){if(this.owned(owner,'building','wonder').some(e=>e.progress>=1))this.wonderTime[owner]+=dt;else this.wonderTime[owner]=0;if(this.wonderTime[owner]>=240)this.end(owner===0,owner===0?'Your monument will stand for a thousand years.':'The rival monument secured their legacy.');}}
        this.fogClock+=dt;if(this.fogClock>.5){this.updateFog();this.fogClock=0;}this.checkVictory();

        if(this.events.length>200)this.events.splice(0,100);
      }
      serialize(){return {version:1,rngState:this.rng.state,options:this.options,entities:this.entities,players:this.players,nextId:this.nextId,time:this.time,wave:this.wave,nextWave:this.nextWave,nextAttack:this.nextAttack,hold:this.hold,enemyHold:this.enemyHold,wonderTime:this.wonderTime,stats:this.stats,tutorialFlags:this.tutorialFlags,explored:Array.from(this.explored),ended:this.ended};}
      static restore(data){if(data.version!==1||!Array.isArray(data.entities)||!data.players)throw new Error('Unsupported save file');const s=new Simulation(data.options);for(const key of ['entities','players','nextId','time','wave','nextWave','nextAttack','hold','enemyHold','wonderTime','stats','tutorialFlags','ended'])s[key]=data[key];if(data.rngState!==undefined)s.rng.state=data.rngState;s.explored=Uint8Array.from(data.explored);s.revision++;s.grids={};s.updateFog();return s;}
    }
    
    installFrontiers(Simulation);
    installTactics(Simulation);
    installCommanderAI(Simulation);
    installCampaigns(Simulation);
    import {UNITS,BUILDINGS,DIFFICULTIES,TECHS} from './data.js';
    const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
    
    export function installFrontiers(Simulation){
      const p=Simulation.prototype,original={};
      for(const method of ['initialize','grid','buildValid','tickUnit','tickBuilding','hurt','smartCommand','assignWorker','tickAI','serialize','addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])original[method]=p[method];
      for(const method of ['addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])p[method]=function(...args){const entity=original[method].apply(this,args);this.index?.set(entity.id,entity);if(entity.kind==='unit'&&UNITS[entity.type].naval)entity.r=entity.type==='warship'?2:1.6;return entity;};
      p.get=function(id){if(!this.index)this.index=new Map(this.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));const e=this.index.get(id);return e?.hp>0?e:null;};
      const restore=Simulation.restore;
      Simulation.restore=function(data){const sim=restore.call(this,data);sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));for(const player of sim.players)for(const key of Object.keys(TECHS))player.tech[key]??=0;sim.intel=data.intel||{};return sim;};
      p.initialize=function(){this.intel={};if(this.options.mode==='tides')this.options.map='coast';original.initialize.call(this);
        this.players.forEach(player=>{player.tech.seamanship??=0;});
        if(this.options.map==='coast'){
          this.players.forEach(player=>{player.age=Math.max(1,player.age);player.resources.wood+=350;player.resources.gold+=180;});
          for(const owner of [0,1]){
            if(owner===1&&(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(this.options.mode)||this.mission?.survival))continue;
            const sign=owner===0?-1:1;this.addBuilding('dock',owner,sign*19,owner===0?25:-25,true);
            const boat=this.addUnit('fishingboat',owner,sign*10,owner===0?24:-24);
            this.addUnit('galley',owner,sign*9,owner===0?14:-14);this.addUnit('transport',owner,sign*10,owner===0?34:-34);
            boat.order={type:'gather',target:null};
          }
          for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const fish=this.addResource('food',(this.rng()-.5)*17,-66+i*12,2200);fish.water=true;fish.r=2.1;}
          for(const e of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building')){e.maxHp=this.maxHP(e);e.hp=e.maxHp;}
          for(const boat of this.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='fishingboat'))this.assignWorker(boat);
          this.updateFog();
        }
      };
      const water=p.isWater;
      p.isWater=function(x,z){return this.options.map==='coast'?Math.abs(x-Math.sin(z*.03)*2)<14:water.call(this,x,z);};
      p.grid=function(owner,naval=false){if(!naval)return original.grid.call(this,owner);const key='sea'+owner;if(this.grids[key]?.revision===this.revision)return this.grids[key].data;
        const data=new Uint8Array(6400);for(let z=0;z<80;z++)for(let x=0;x<80;x++)data[z*80+x]=this.isWater(x*2-79,z*2-79)?0:1;this.grids[key]={revision:this.revision,data};return data;
      };
      p.buildValid=function(type,x,z,owner=0){if(type!=='dock')return original.buildValid.call(this,type,x,z,owner);
        if(Math.abs(x)>74||Math.abs(z)>74||this.isWater(x,z)||owner===0&&!this.isVisible(x,z))return false;
        let shore=false;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(this.isWater(x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*7,z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*7))shore=true;
        return shore&&!this.entities.some(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='building'&&distance(e,{x,z})<e.r+4.2);
      };
      p.spawnPoint=function(building,naval=false){const grid=this.grid(building.owner,naval);let best=null,score=Infinity;
        for(let x=-14;x<=14;x+=2)for(let z=-14;z<=14;z+=2){const point={x:building.x+x,z:building.z+z},cell=this.cell(point.x,point.z),n=Math.hypot(x,z);if(n>=building.r+1&&!grid[cell.z*80+cell.x]&&n<score){best=point;score=n;}}return best;
      };
      p.tickBuilding=function(e,dt){const before=this.nextId;original.tickBuilding.call(this,e,dt);for(let id=before;id<this.nextId;id++){const unit=this.get(id);if(unit?.kind!=='unit')continue;if(unit.owner===1)this.emit('stat-trained',{entity:unit});const spawn=this.spawnPoint(e,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval);if(spawn){unit.x=spawn.x;unit.z=spawn.z;unit.path=[];}
          if(unit.type==='fishingboat')this.assignWorker(unit);
        }
      };
      p.assignWorker=function(e){if(e.type==='fishingboat'){const fish=this.nearest(e,t=>t.kind==='resource'&&t.water&&t.amount>0);if(fish){e.gatherType='food';e.order={type:'gather',target:fish.id};e.path=[];}return;}original.assignWorker.call(this,e);};
      p.smartCommand=function(ids,target,x,z,append=false,attackMove=false,owner=0){
        if(owner!==0){const entities=this.entities,players=this.players;for(const e of entities)if(e.owner>=0)e.owner=1-e.owner;this.players=[players[1],players[0]];try{return this.smartCommand(ids,target,x,z,append,attackMove,0);}finally{for(const e of entities)if(e.owner>=0)e.owner=1-e.owner;this.players=players;}}
        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit');if(target?.owner===0&&target.kind==='unit'&&UNITS[target.type].naval&&target.type!=='transport'&&units.every(e=>e.type==='villager')){this.command(units.map(e=>e.id),{type:'repair',target:target.id},append);return;}
        if(target?.type==='transport'&&target.owner===0){for(const e of units)if(!UNITS[e.type].naval)this.command([e.id],{type:'board',target:target.id},append);return;}
        const fishers=units.filter(e=>e.type==='fishingboat');if(target?.water){for(const e of fishers)this.command([e.id],{type:'gather',target:target.id},append);if(!fishers.length)this.fail('Only fishing boats can harvest fish shoals.');return;}
        const legal=ids.filter(id=>{const e=this.get(id);return e?.kind!=='unit'||!!UNITS[e.type].naval===this.isWater(x,z)||target?.kind==='building'||target?.owner===1;});
        if(legal.length<ids.length)this.fail('Ships sail on water. Land troops need a transport to cross the sea.');
        original.smartCommand.call(this,legal,target,x,z,append,attackMove);
      };
      p.unload=function(id,x,z,owner=0){const ship=this.get(id);if(!ship||ship.owner!==owner||ship.type!=='transport')return false;
        if(this.isWater(x,z)||distance(ship,{x,z})>11)return this.fail('Choose a shore within 11 meters of the transport.',owner);
        const cell=this.cell(x,z);if(this.grid(owner)[cell.z*80+cell.x])return this.fail('Choose open land to disembark.',owner);
        const passengers=ship.passengers||[];passengers.forEach((pid,i)=>{const e=this.get(pid);if(!e)return;e.embarked=false;e.transport=null;e.x=x+(i%3-1)*1.3;e.z=z+Math.floor(i/3)*1.3;if(this.isWater(e.x,e.z)){e.x=x;e.z=z;}e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];});ship.passengers=[];this.emit('unload',{entity:ship});return true;
      };
      p.tickUnit=function(e,dt){
        if(e.embarked){const ship=this.get(e.transport);if(!ship){e.hp=0;return;}e.x=ship.x;e.z=ship.z;return;}
        if(e.order?.type==='board'){
          const ship=this.get(e.order.target);if(!ship||ship.owner!==e.owner||ship.type!=='transport'){this.finishOrder(e);return;}
          if((ship.passengers||[]).length>=8){this.finishOrder(e);return;}
          if(distance(e,ship)>6){this.move(e,ship,dt,5);return;}
          ship.passengers??=[];ship.passengers.push(e.id);e.embarked=true;e.transport=ship.id;e.order=null;e.path=[];this.emit('board',{entity:e,target:ship});return;
        }
        if(e.type==='fishingboat'){
          e.moving=false;e.cooldown=Math.max(0,e.cooldown-dt);const order=e.order;if(!order){if(e.stance!=='hold')this.assignWorker(e);return;}
          if(order.type!=='gather')return original.tickUnit.call(this,e,dt);
          const target=this.get(order.target);if(!target){this.assignWorker(e);return;}
          if(e.carry>=75||order.returning){order.returning=true;const dock=this.nearest(e,t=>t.owner===e.owner&&t.type==='dock'&&t.progress>=1);if(!dock)return;if(distance(e,dock)>dock.r+5.5){this.move(e,dock,dt,dock.r+5);return;}
            this.players[e.owner].resources.food+=e.carry;this.emit('gathered',{owner:e.owner,amount:e.carry,resource:'food',source:'fishingboat'});if(e.owner===0)this.stats.gathered+=e.carry;e.carry=0;e.carryType=null;order.returning=false;e.path=[];return;}
          if(distance(e,target)>target.r+2){this.move(e,target,dt,target.r+1.5);return;}
          const n=Math.min(75-e.carry,target.amount,dt*4*(1+this.players[e.owner].tech.economy*.25));e.carry+=n;e.carryType='food';target.amount-=n;if(target.amount<=0){target.hp=0;order.returning=true;}return;
        }
        const site=e.order?.type==='build'?this.get(e.order.target):null,progress=site?.progress;
        original.tickUnit.call(this,e,dt);
        if(e.owner===1&&site&&progress<1&&site.progress>=1)this.emit('stat-complete',{entity:site});
        if(e.type==='transport'&&e.owner===1&&(e.passengers||[]).length){const shore={x:-18,z:30};if(distance(e,shore)<11&&this.unload(e.id,shore.x,shore.z,1))e.order={type:'move',x:10,z:-24};}
      };
      p.hurt=function(e,amount,attacker){const hp=e.hp;if(attacker?.owner>=0)e.lastAttacker=attacker.owner;original.hurt.call(this,e,amount,attacker);if(hp>0&&e.hp<=0&&e.kind==='unit'){this.revision--;for(const id of e.passengers||[]){const passenger=this.get(id);if(passenger)this.hurt(passenger,passenger.hp,attacker);}}};
      p.canSee=function(owner,entity){return this.owned(owner).some(e=>(e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building'&&e.progress>0)&&!e.embarked&&distance(e,entity)<(e.kind==='unit'?UNITS[e.type].vision:BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18)+(entity.r||0));};
      p.tickAI=function(){if(this.options.multiplayer)return;original.tickAI.call(this);if(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(this.options.mode)||this.mission?.survival)return;
        const player=this.players[1],tc=this.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0];if(!tc)return;
        const seen=this.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>this.canSee(1,e));for(const e of seen)this.intel[e.type]=this.time;

    export function formationSlot(sim,unit,point){

      };

    {
      "name": "crowns-of-the-frontier",
      "version": "2.3.0",
      "private": true,
      "type": "module",
      "scripts": {
        "dev": "vite --host 0.0.0.0",
        "build": "vite build",
        "preview": "vite preview --host 0.0.0.0",
        "test": "node --test tests/*.test.js",
        "start": "node server/index.js"
      },
      "dependencies": {
        "three": "^0.180.0",
        "ws": "^8.22.0"
      },
      "devDependencies": {
        "@playwright/test": "^1.56.0",
        "vite": "^7.1.7"
      }
    }
    # Movement display update
    
    - Removed selected-unit movement and queued-route lines on desktop and phones, including the route-display setting. Movement, patrol, guard, and queued commands remain available.
    
    # Frontier chronicles (version 2.3)
    
    - Three staged objectives per campaign chapter, original dialogue journals, optional medals, and active minimap/3D goal markers.
    - Supply-caravan mesh model and guarded river escort with an explicit loss condition. Select-caravan and locate-goal controls are available in the objective panel.
    - Frozen initial and stage checkpoints, commander-menu and defeat-screen recovery, local save/resume, and legacy rules for existing campaign saves.
    - Settlement, fortress, shrine-control/conquest, siege-breach, and coastal landing/artillery chapter flows. Fishing objectives count deposited boat catch.
    - Objective updates preserve scrolling/focus and expose interactive controls without triggering camera edge scrolling. Phone recovery controls and compact technology-tree layouts receive browser coverage.
    - Exact waypoint arrival and island-aware naval regrouping reduce the coastal diagnostic run from 74 blocked orders to four. Remaining bridge/crowding cases still need review.
    - Regression coverage includes normal economy/production, real escort navigation, shrine holding, paid naval artillery, actual gate attacks, actor loss, and checkpoint recovery.
    
    This continues the playable beta roadmap. External balance and mission-pacing tests, real-device rendering performance, richer authored assets/audio, public online operations, and overall world-class parity remain unfinished.
    
    # Commanders and kingdoms (version 2.2)
    
    - Saved remappable keys with conflict/reserved-key validation, updated shortcut labels, and active bindings in Help.
    - Patrol/guard orders, network ownership checks, queued-order summaries, and bounded 3D route previews. Routes follow terrain and stay visible above water for ships.
    - Legal formation destinations, correct partial-path arrival checks, blocked-order feedback/recovery, axis sliding near obstacles, and safer automatic naval target selection.

    export class MinHeap {
      constructor(){this.items=[];}
      get size(){return this.items.length;}
      push(id,score){const item={id,score};let i=this.items.length;this.items.push(item);while(i>0){const parent=(i-1)>>1;if(this.items[parent].score<=score)break;this.items[i]=this.items[parent];i=parent;}this.items[i]=item;}
      pop(){if(!this.items.length)return null;const first=this.items[0],last=this.items.pop();if(this.items.length){let i=0;while(true){let child=i*2+1;if(child>=this.items.length)break;if(child+1<this.items.length&&this.items[child+1].score<this.items[child].score)child++;if(last.score<=this.items[child].score)break;this.items[i]=this.items[child];i=child;}this.items[i]=last;}return first.id;}
    }
    
    export function findPath(sim,e,dest){

    // Resolve formation slots on the unit's own movement surface. This keeps edge
    // slots out of foundations and water without sending land troops across a sea.
    export function formationSlot(sim,unit,point){
      const grid=sim.grid(unit.owner,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval),cell=sim.cell(point.x,point.z);
      if(!grid[cell.z*80+cell.x])return {x:clamp(point.x),z:clamp(point.z)};
      let best=null,score=Infinity;
      for(let r=1;r<=4;r++)for(let z=Math.max(0,cell.z-r);z<=Math.min(79,cell.z+r);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,cell.x-r);x<=Math.min(79,cell.x+r);x++){
        if(grid[z*80+x])continue;const wx=x*2-79,wz=z*2-79,s=Math.hypot(wx-point.x,wz-point.z)+Math.hypot(wx-unit.x,wz-unit.z)*.03;
        if(s<score){score=s;best={x:wx,z:wz};}
      }return best||{x:clamp(point.x),z:clamp(point.z)};
    }
    
    export function installTactics(Simulation){
      const p=Simulation.prototype;
      p.patrol=function(ids,x,z,append=false,owner=0){

        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===owner&&e.kind==='unit'&&!e.embarked&&!['worker','fisher'].includes(UNITS[e.type].role));
        for(const e of units){const target=formationSlot(this,e,{x,z});this.command([e.id],{type:'patrol',...target,originX:e.x,originZ:e.z},append);}

        units.forEach((e,i)=>this.command([e.id],{type:'guard',target:target.id,offsetX:Math.cos(i*2.4)*(target.r+3),offsetZ:Math.sin(i*2.4)*(target.r+3)},append));

      };

    # Movement display update
    
    - Removed selected-unit movement and queued-route lines on desktop and phones, including the route-display setting. Movement, patrol, guard, and queued commands remain available.
    
    # Frontier chronicles (version 2.3)
    
    - Three staged objectives per campaign chapter, original dialogue journals, optional medals, and active minimap/3D goal markers.
    - Supply-caravan mesh model and guarded river escort with an explicit loss condition. Select-caravan and locate-goal controls are available in the objective panel.
    - Frozen initial and stage checkpoints, commander-menu and defeat-screen recovery, local save/resume, and legacy rules for existing campaign saves.
    - Settlement, fortress, shrine-control/conquest, siege-breach, and coastal landing/artillery chapter flows. Fishing objectives count deposited boat catch.
    - Objective updates preserve scrolling/focus and expose interactive controls without triggering camera edge scrolling. Phone recovery controls and compact technology-tree layouts receive browser coverage.
    - Exact waypoint arrival and island-aware naval regrouping reduce the coastal diagnostic run from 74 blocked orders to four. Remaining bridge/crowding cases still need review.
    - Regression coverage includes normal economy/production, real escort navigation, shrine holding, paid naval artillery, actual gate attacks, actor loss, and checkpoint recovery.

    }
    export function normalizeBattle(options){

        name:String(slot.name||(i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`)).trim().slice(0,24)||`Kingdom ${i+1}`,
        faction:FACTIONS[slot.faction]?slot.faction:'alder',team:Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Math.floor(Number(slot.team)||i+1))),difficulty:DIFFICULTIES[slot.difficulty]?slot.difficulty:'normal',enabled:true,

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {seededRandom} from './data.js';
    
    export const WEATHER_NAMES={clear:'Clear skies',cloudy:'Cloudy',rain:'Rain',storm:'Storm',snow:'Snowfall'};
    const clamp=n=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,n));
    const smooth=n=>{n=clamp(n);return n*n*(3-2*n);};
    
    // Weather uses a separate seeded clock: it never changes economy/combat RNG.
    export function weatherAt(seed,map,time,preference='auto'){
      time=Math.max(0,time);const cycle=Math.floor(time/210),phase=time%210,rng=seededRandom((seed+cycle*7919+4421)>>>0),wet=rng()<(map==='desert'?.38:.86),storm=rng()<.38;
      let type='clear',amount=0,cloud=0;
      if(preference!=='auto'&&WEATHER_NAMES[preference]){type=preference;amount=type==='storm'?1:type==='rain'?.7:type==='snow'?.65:0;cloud=type==='clear'?0:type==='cloudy'?.6:.9;}
      else if(phase>=40&&phase<185){
        cloud=smooth((phase-40)/25)*smooth((185-phase)/25)*.9;
        if(wet&&phase>=75&&phase<155){amount=smooth((phase-75)/14)*smooth((155-phase)/14);type=map==='winter'?'snow':storm?'storm':'rain';amount*=type==='rain'?.7:type==='snow'?.65:1;}else type='cloudy';
      }
      const flashPhase=((time-16)%43+43)%43,flash=type==='storm'&&amount>.5&&flashPhase<.16;
      return {type,amount,cloud,wind:type==='storm'?3.4:type==='snow'?1.1:1.8,flash,thunderKey:type==='storm'&&amount>.5?Math.floor((time-16)/43):null,time};
    }
    
    export class WeatherRenderer {
      constructor(view){

        this.base={background:view.scene.background.clone(),fog:view.scene.fog.color.clone(),sun:view.sun.color.clone(),hemi:view.hemi.color.clone(),ground:view.groundSurface.material.color.clone(),near:115,far:275};
        this.rain=this.instances(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.018,.012,1,4),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xbdd1db,transparent:true,opacity:.52,depthWrite:false}),1400);

        this.cloudSeeds=Array.from({length:36},()=>({x:(rng()-.5)*210,z:(rng()-.5)*210,y:48+rng()*24,scale:9+rng()*12}));

      updateRoofs(){
        const v=this.view,stamp=`${v.sim.revision}:${Math.floor(v.sim.time/4)}`;if(stamp===this.roofStamp)return;this.roofStamp=stamp;this.roofs.clear();
        for(const e of v.sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&e.kind==='building'&&(e.owner===0||v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))){const h=v.entityHeight(e)+Math.max(2,e.r*1.5)*Math.max(.15,e.progress);

    export function battlePreset(preset='2v2'){
      const n=preset==='4v4'||preset==='ffa8'?8:preset==='3v3'?6:4,split=preset==='1v3'?1:n/2;
      return Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({enabled:i<n,name:i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],team:preset.startsWith('ffa')?i+1:i<split?1:2,difficulty:'normal'}));
    }
    export function normalizeBattle(options){
      const raw=Array.isArray(options.slots)?options.slots:battlePreset(),slots=raw.slice(0,8).map((slot,i)=>({...slot,slotNumber:slot.slotNumber||i+1})).filter((slot,i)=>i===0||slot.enabled!==false).map((slot,i)=>({
        name:String(slot.name||(i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`)).trim().slice(0,24)||`Kingdom ${i+1}`,
        faction:FACTIONS[slot.faction]?slot.faction:'alder',team:Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Math.floor(Number(slot.team)||i+1))),difficulty:DIFFICULTIES[slot.difficulty]?slot.difficulty:'normal',enabled:true,slotNumber:slot.slotNumber,color:PLAYER_COLORS[slot.slotNumber-1]??PLAYER_COLORS[i],controller:i===0||options.multiplayer&&slot.controller==='human'?'human':'ai',
      }));
      if(slots.length<2)throw new Error('Enable at least one opposing kingdom.');
      if(slots.every(slot=>slot.team===slots[0].team))throw new Error('Place at least one kingdom on a different team.');
      const mapSize=BATTLE_SIZES[options.mapSize]?options.mapSize:'huge';
      return {...options,mode:'custom',slots,mapSize,worldSize:BATTLE_SIZES[mapSize].size,faction:slots[0].faction,difficulty:'normal',victory:VICTORY_RULES[options.victory]?options.victory:'annihilation',startAge:Math.max(options.map==='coast'?1:0,Math.min(3,Math.floor(Number(options.startAge)||0))),resourceLevel:options.resourceLevel==='rich'?'rich':'standard',populationLimit:[80,120,160].includes(Number(options.populationLimit))?Number(options.populationLimit):80,shareVision:options.shareVision!==false,revealRemnants:options.revealRemnants!==false,multiplayer:!!options.multiplayer};
    }
    export function battleSpawns(slots,worldSize){
      const ordered=slots.map((slot,i)=>({team:slot.team,i})).sort((a,b)=>a.team-b.team||a.i-b.i),human=ordered.findIndex(slot=>slot.i===0),r=worldSize*.34,result=[];
      ordered.forEach((slot,index)=>{const angle=Math.PI*.75+(index-human)*Math.PI*2/slots.length;let x=Math.cos(angle)*r,z=Math.sin(angle)*r;if(Math.abs(x)<38)x=x<0?-38:38;result[slot.i]={x,z};});return result;
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import http from 'node:http';
    import WebSocket from 'ws';
    import {attachRooms} from '../server/rooms.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    class Inbox{
      constructor(ws){this.items=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),index=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(index>=0){const [waiter]=this.waiters.splice(index,1);clearTimeout(waiter.timer);waiter.resolve(message);}else this.items.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.items.findIndex(message=>message.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.items.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),8000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }
    async function fixture(t){const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});return {service,connect:async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`),inbox=new Inbox(ws);clients.push(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:message=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(message))};}};}
    const pause=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));
    
    test('eight human commanders ready, receive private team perspectives, reconnect, and win as an alliance',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),players=[],sessions=[],slots=battlePreset('4v4').map(slot=>({...slot,controller:'human'}));
      const host=await connect();players.push(host);host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');sessions.push(session);const code=session.code;
      for(let i=1;i<8;i++){const player=await connect();players.push(player);player.send({type:'join',name:`Commander ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],code});sessions.push(await player.inbox.next('session'));}
      host.send({type:'start'});assert.match((await host.inbox.next('error')).message,/ready/);
      for(const player of players)player.send({type:'ready',ready:true});await pause(80);host.send({type:'start'});
      const beginnings=await Promise.all(players.map(player=>player.inbox.next('begin'))),room=service.rooms.get(code);assert.equal(room.sim.players.length,8);assert.equal(room.sim.worldSize,400);
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const state=beginnings[i].state;assert.equal(state.players[0].name,i===0?'Host':`Commander ${i+1}`);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length,9);assert.equal(state.visible.length,40000);
        assert.ok(state.players.slice(1).every(player=>Object.values(player.resources).every(value=>value===0)));assert.equal(state.aiStates,null);assert.equal(state.commanderAI,null);
        assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='unit'&&state.players[e.owner]?.team!==state.players[0].team).length,0);
      }
      const guest=players[7],own=room.sim.owned(7,'building','barracks')[0],enemy=room.sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[enemy.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(enemy.queue.length,0);
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[own.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(own.queue[0]?.type,'spearman');
      const state=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state;assert.ok(state.compactResources);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource').length,0);
      guest.ws.terminate();await pause(100);const stopped=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.equal(room.sim.time,stopped);
      const rejoined=await connect();rejoined.send({type:'resume',...sessions[7]});const resumed=(await rejoined.inbox.next('begin')).state;assert.equal(resumed.players[0].name,'Commander 8');assert.ok(resumed.entities.some(e=>e.id===own.id&&e.queue[0]?.type==='spearman'));
      // Host defeat is not the end of a multiplayer war: surviving teammates continue.
      room.sim.eliminateKingdom(0,'Test capital assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);

    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    const slots=battlePreset('4v4');for(const slot of slots)slot.difficulty='hard';
    const sim=new Simulation({mode:'custom',map:process.env.BENCH_MAP||'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots,resourceLevel:'standard',populationLimit:80});
    // An AI controls the human slot only in this offline diagnostic, making it possible
    // to observe a complete economy-to-siege match without synthetic damage or income.
    sim.players[0].controller='ai';const seconds=Number(process.env.BENCH_SECONDS)||1200,samples=[],start=performance.now(),blocked={};let lastReport=0;
    sim.on(event=>{if(event.type==='order-blocked')blocked[event.entity.owner]=(blocked[event.entity.owner]||0)+1;});
    const summary=()=>sim.players.map((p,owner)=>({owner,age:p.age,defeated:p.defeated,units:sim.population(owner),buildings:sim.owned(owner,'building').length,resources:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p.resources).map(([key,value])=>[key,Math.round(value)])),phase:sim.aiStates[owner]?.phase,stats:p.battleStats}));
    while(sim.time<seconds&&!sim.ended){const before=performance.now();sim.tick(.1);samples.push(performance.now()-before);if(sim.time-lastReport>=60){lastReport=sim.time;console.log(JSON.stringify({time:Math.round(sim.time),elapsed:Math.round((performance.now()-start)/1000),ages:sim.players.map(p=>p.age),units:sim.players.map((p,i)=>sim.population(i)),dead:sim.players.filter(p=>p.defeated).length}));}}
    samples.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const at=percent=>samples[Math.min(samples.length-1,Math.floor(samples.length*percent))];
    const result={seed:512,map:sim.options.map,simulatedSeconds:sim.time,ended:sim.ended,elapsedSeconds:(performance.now()-start)/1000,tickMilliseconds:{median:at(.5),p95:at(.95),p99:at(.99),max:samples.at(-1)},blocked,kingdoms:summary()};
    fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(`artifacts/battle-benchmark-${sim.options.map}.json`,JSON.stringify(result,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));

## Assistant

Yes, I understand: multiplayer means real people joining the same battle. When you play without other people, you choose AI allies and enemies, with separate difficulty levels.

Those AI battles should develop into challenging wars with gathering, expansion, upgrades, defenses, attacks, and rebuilding. Their length should depend on how the battle unfolds. I’m checking that behavior now, including victory conditions that prevent an early ending while enemy buildings remain.

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import http from 'node:http';
    import WebSocket from 'ws';
    import {attachRooms} from '../server/rooms.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    class Inbox{
      constructor(ws){this.items=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),index=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(index>=0){const [waiter]=this.waiters.splice(index,1);clearTimeout(waiter.timer);waiter.resolve(message);}else this.items.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.items.findIndex(message=>message.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.items.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),8000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }
    async function fixture(t){const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});return {service,connect:async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`),inbox=new Inbox(ws);clients.push(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:message=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(message))};}};}
    const pause=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));
    
    test('eight human commanders ready, receive private team perspectives, reconnect, and win as an alliance',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),players=[],sessions=[],slots=battlePreset('4v4').map(slot=>({...slot,controller:'human'}));
      const host=await connect();players.push(host);host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');sessions.push(session);const code=session.code;
      for(let i=1;i<8;i++){const player=await connect();players.push(player);player.send({type:'join',name:`Commander ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],code});sessions.push(await player.inbox.next('session'));}
      host.send({type:'start'});assert.match((await host.inbox.next('error')).message,/ready/);
      for(const player of players)player.send({type:'ready',ready:true});while(!(await host.inbox.next('lobby')).canStart){}host.send({type:'start'});
      const beginnings=await Promise.all(players.map(player=>player.inbox.next('begin'))),room=service.rooms.get(code);assert.equal(room.sim.players.length,8);assert.equal(room.sim.worldSize,400);
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const state=beginnings[i].state;assert.equal(state.players[0].name,i===0?'Host':`Commander ${i+1}`);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length,9);assert.equal(state.visible.length,40000);
        assert.ok(state.players.slice(1).every(player=>Object.values(player.resources).every(value=>value===0)));assert.equal(state.aiStates,null);assert.equal(state.commanderAI,null);
        assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='unit'&&state.players[e.owner]?.team!==state.players[0].team).length,0);
      }
      const guest=players[7],own=room.sim.owned(7,'building','barracks')[0],enemy=room.sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[enemy.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(enemy.queue.length,0);
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[own.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(own.queue[0]?.type,'spearman');
      const state=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state;assert.ok(state.compactResources);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource').length,0);
      guest.ws.terminate();await pause(100);const stopped=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.equal(room.sim.time,stopped);
      const rejoined=await connect();rejoined.send({...sessions[7],type:'resume'});const resumed=(await rejoined.inbox.next('begin')).state;assert.equal(resumed.players[0].name,'Commander 8');assert.ok(resumed.entities.some(e=>e.id===own.id&&e.queue[0]?.type==='spearman'));
      // Host defeat is not the end of a multiplayer war: surviving teammates continue.
      room.sim.eliminateKingdom(0,'Test capital assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);
      for(let owner=4;owner<8;owner++)room.sim.eliminateKingdom(owner,'Test final assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended.winningTeam,1);
      const endedState=async inbox=>{let state;do{state=(await inbox.next('state')).state;}while(!state.ended);return state;};
      host.inbox.items=[];rejoined.inbox.items=[];const finalHost=await endedState(host.inbox),finalEnemy=await endedState(rejoined.inbox);assert.equal(finalHost.ended.won,true);assert.equal(finalEnemy.ended.won,false);
    });
    
    test('custom rooms mix humans and AI, preserve assigned slots, and treat leaving as a concession',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),slots=battlePreset('3v3');slots[4].controller='human';slots[1].difficulty='brutal';const host=await connect();host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',seed:601,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');
      const guest=await connect();guest.send({type:'join',name:'Guest',faction:'raven',slot:5,code:session.code});await guest.inbox.next('session');guest.send({type:'ready',ready:true});while(!(await host.inbox.next('lobby')).canStart){}host.send({type:'start'});await host.inbox.next('begin');await guest.inbox.next('begin');const room=service.rooms.get(session.code);
      assert.equal(room.players[1].side,4);assert.equal(room.sim.players[4].controller,'human');assert.equal(room.sim.players[1].controller,'ai');
      await pause(1800);assert.ok(room.sim.aiStates[1]?.decision>=1);assert.equal(room.sim.aiStates[4],undefined);
      guest.send({type:'leave'});await pause(100);assert.equal(room.sim.players[4].defeated,true);assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);const before=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.ok(room.sim.time>before);
    });

    export function rememberVisibleEnemies(sim,state,owner=1){

      wishes.sentinel=2+(roles.ranged||0);wishes.marksman=2+(roles.infantry||0);wishes.outrider=2+(roles.worker||0);

    export class MinHeap {
      constructor(){this.items=[];}
      get size(){return this.items.length;}
      push(id,score){const item={id,score};let i=this.items.length;this.items.push(item);while(i>0){const parent=(i-1)>>1;if(this.items[parent].score<=score)break;this.items[i]=this.items[parent];i=parent;}this.items[i]=item;}

    }

## Assistant

The expanded test suite now passes all 90 checks, including eight-player rooms, allies, reconnects, ownership, and team victories. In the default custom battle, losing a town center does not end the match while that kingdom still has other buildings.

The longer battle test also exposed performance pressure as armies grow. I’m working through that and checking the new multiplayer lobby in the browser.

    export function installCustomBattle(Simulation){

      p.tickAI=function(){if(this.options.mode!=='custom')return tickAI.call(this);for(let owner=1;owner<this.players.length;owner++)if(!this.players[owner].defeated)tickAI.call(this,owner);};
      p.tickCustomAI=function(dt){for(let owner=0;owner<this.players.length;owner++){
        const player=this.players[owner];if(player.defeated||player.controller==='human')continue;player.aiClock+=dt;const interval=3*DIFFICULTIES[player.difficulty].ai;if(player.aiClock<interval)continue;player.aiClock-=interval;
        const tc=this.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0];
        if(!tc){const worker=this.owned(owner,'unit','villager').find(e=>e.order?.type!=='build');if(worker&&!this.owned(owner,'building','towncenter').length)for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const angle=i*2.4,r=12+Math.floor(i/4)*6,x=player.start.x+Math.cos(angle)*r,z=player.start.z+Math.sin(angle)*r;if(this.buildValid('towncenter',x,z,owner)){this.build('towncenter',x,z,[worker.id],owner);break;}}this.assignEconomy(owner);continue;}
        tickAI.call(this,owner);
      }};
      p.eliminateKingdom=function(owner,reason){
        const player=this.players[owner];if(!player||player.defeated)return;player.defeated=true;
        for(const e of this.owned(owner).filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building')){e.hp=0;if(e.queue)e.queue=[];player.battleStats.lost++;this.emit('death',{entity:e});}
        this.revision++;this.emit('kingdom-defeated',{owner,name:player.name,reason});this.updateFog();
      };
      p.resign=function(owner=0){if(this.options.mode!=='custom'||this.ended)return false;this.eliminateKingdom(owner,'Resigned');this.checkVictory();return true;};
      p.checkVictory=function(){
        if(this.options.mode!=='custom')return checkVictory.call(this);
        for(let owner=0;owner<this.players.length;owner++){

        if(this.options.multiplayer){const teams=[...new Set(this.players.filter(player=>!player.defeated).map(player=>player.team))];if(teams.length<=1){this.end(teams[0]===team,teams.length?'The last surviving alliance controls the battlefield.':'Every kingdom has been eliminated.');this.ended.winningTeam=teams[0]??null;}return;}
        if(!allies.length)this.end(false,'Every kingdom in your alliance has been eliminated.');else if(!enemies.length)this.end(true,'Your alliance has eliminated every opposing kingdom.');
      };
      p.hurt=function(target,amount,attacker){const alive=target.hp>0;hurt.call(this,target,amount,attacker);if(this.options.mode==='custom'&&alive&&target.hp<=0){if(target.owner>=0)this.players[target.owner].battleStats.lost++;if(attacker?.owner>=0)this.players[attacker.owner].battleStats.kills++;}};
      p.emit=function(type,data={}){if(this.options.mode==='custom'){
        const owner=data.owner??data.entity?.owner,stats=this.players?.[owner]?.battleStats;
        if(stats){if(type==='gathered')stats.gathered+=data.amount;if(type==='trained'||type==='stat-trained')stats.trained++;if(type==='complete'||type==='stat-complete')stats.built++;}

    export function visibilityFor(sim,owner,explored,observer=false){
      const size=sim.gridSize,visible=new Uint8Array(size*size);
      if(observer){visible.fill(1);explored.fill(1);return visible;}
      const reveal=(e,r)=>{const c=sim.cell(e.x,e.z),rc=Math.ceil(r/2);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-rc);z<=Math.min(size-1,c.z+rc);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-rc);x<=Math.min(size-1,c.x+rc);x++)if(Math.hypot(x-c.x,z-c.z)<=rc){visible[z*size+x]=1;explored[z*size+x]=1;}};
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&!e.embarked&&(e.owner===owner||sim.options.mode==='custom'&&sim.options.shareVision&&sim.allied(owner,e.owner))){if(e.kind==='unit')reveal(e,UNITS[e.type].vision);else if(e.kind==='building'&&e.progress>0)reveal(e,BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18);else if(e.kind==='shrine')reveal(e,18);}
      for(const side of sim.revealedOwners||[])for(const e of sim.owned(side,'building'))reveal(e,e.r+4);
      return visible;
    }

        const battle=normalizeBattle(draft),spawns=battleSpawns(battle.slots,battle.worldSize);launch.disabled=false;warning.textContent='Matching team numbers are allies. Different team numbers are enemies. Coast battles include ships and start in at least the Feudal Age.';
        let active=0;draft.slots.forEach((slot,index)=>{if(!slot.enabled)return;const point=spawns[active++],x=(point.x/battle.worldSize+.5)*size,z=(point.z/battle.worldSize+.5)*size;
          ctx.fillStyle=color(index);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,z,12,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#203528';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#172b23';ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText(index+1,x,z);

        root.querySelector('#battle-summary').textContent=`${battle.slots.length} kingdoms Â· ${new Set(battle.slots.map(slot=>slot.team)).size} teams Â· ${BATTLE_SIZES[battle.mapSize].desc}`;root.querySelector('#battle-rule').textContent=VICTORY_RULES[battle.victory].desc;

    export function battleObjectiveMarkup(sim){
      return `<div class="objective-eyebrow">CUSTOM BATTLE<span>${sim.players.length} KINGDOMS</span></div><h3>War of the kingdoms</h3><details class="battle-rules"><summary>${VICTORY_RULES[sim.options.victory].name}</summary><p>${VICTORY_RULES[sim.options.victory].desc}</p></details>${sim.players[0].defeated?'<p class="battle-spectating">Your kingdom is eliminated. Watch your allies fight for the team victory.</p>':''}<div class="battle-roster">${sim.players.map((player,i)=>`<button data-focus-kingdom="${i}" title="Locate ${esc(player.name)}" class="${player.defeated?'defeated':''}"><i style="background:#${player.color.toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}"></i><span><strong>${esc(player.name)}</strong><small>Team ${player.team} Â· ${i===0?'You':sim.allied(0,i)?'Ally':'Enemy'}</small></span><em>${player.defeated?'Eliminated':player.controller==='human'?'Human':DIFFICULTIES[player.difficulty].name}</em></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
    }
    export function battleResultMarkup(sim){
      if(sim.options.mode!=='custom')return '';
      return `<div class="battle-result-table"><table><caption>Kingdom results</caption><thead><tr><th>Kingdom</th><th>Team</th><th>Defeated</th><th>Gathered</th></tr></thead><tbody>${sim.players.map(player=>`<tr><th>${esc(player.name)}</th><td>${player.team}</td><td>${player.battleStats.kills}</td><td>${Math.floor(player.battleStats.gathered)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
    }
    export function roomLobbyMarkup(room){
      const isCustom=room.options.mode==='custom';
      return `<div class="eyebrow">MULTIPLAYER WAR ROOM</div><h2>${isCustom?'Gather your alliances.':'Your frontier awaits.'}</h2><p class="modal-intro">Share the room code. ${isCustom?'Friends join Human slots, choose an available slot, and mark themselves ready. AI kingdoms are ready automatically.':'The host starts once both commanders join.'}</p><div class="room-code" id="room-code">${room.code}</div>${isCustom?`<div class="room-grid">${room.slots.map(slot=>{const participant=room.players.find(player=>player.side===slot.side);return `<article><strong>${slot.slotNumber}. ${esc(participant?.name||slot.name)}</strong><small>Team ${slot.team} Â· ${esc(FACTIONS[slot.faction].name)}</small><span>${slot.controller==='ai'?`AI Â· ${DIFFICULTIES[slot.difficulty].name}`:participant?`${participant.connected?'Connected':'Disconnected'} Â· ${participant.ready?'Ready':'Not ready'}`:'Open Human slot'}</span></article>`;}).join('')}</div>${!room.host?`<label class="field-label" for="lobby-slot">YOUR SLOT / TEAM</label><select id="lobby-slot">${room.slots.filter(slot=>slot.controller==='human'&&(slot.side===room.selfSide||!room.players.some(player=>player.side===slot.side))).map(slot=>`<option value="${slot.slotNumber}" ${slot.side===room.selfSide?'selected':''}>Slot ${slot.slotNumber} Â· Team ${slot.team}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:''}<button class="secondary full" data-action="lan-ready" aria-pressed="${room.selfReady}">${room.selfReady?'Ready Â· click to unready':'Mark yourself ready'}</button>`:`<div class="room-players">${room.players.map(player=>`<article><span class="status-dot"></span><strong>${esc(player.name)}</strong><small>${FACTIONS[player.faction].name}</small></article>`).join('')}${room.players.length<2?'<article class="waiting-player"><strong>Waiting for a rivalâ€¦</strong></article>':''}</div>`}${room.host?`<button class="primary full" data-action="lan-start" ${!room.canStart?'disabled':''}>Start the battle <span>âžœ</span></button>`:'<p class="modal-intro">The host starts when all Human slots are connected and ready.</p>'}<button class="text-button" data-action="lan-leave">Leave room</button>`;
    }

    import {UNITS,BUILDINGS,DIFFICULTIES,TECHS} from './data.js';
    const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
    
    export function installFrontiers(Simulation){
      const p=Simulation.prototype,original={};
      for(const method of ['initialize','grid','buildValid','tickUnit','tickBuilding','hurt','smartCommand','assignWorker','tickAI','serialize','addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])original[method]=p[method];
      for(const method of ['addUnit','addBuilding','addResource','addShrine'])p[method]=function(...args){const entity=original[method].apply(this,args);this.index?.set(entity.id,entity);if(entity.kind==='unit'&&UNITS[entity.type].naval)entity.r=entity.type==='warship'?2:1.6;return entity;};
      p.get=function(id){if(!this.index)this.index=new Map(this.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));const e=this.index.get(id);return e?.hp>0?e:null;};
      const restore=Simulation.restore;
      Simulation.restore=function(data){const sim=restore.call(this,data);sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));for(const player of sim.players)for(const key of Object.keys(TECHS))player.tech[key]??=0;sim.intel=data.intel||{};return sim;};
      p.initialize=function(){this.intel={};if(this.options.mode==='tides')this.options.map='coast';original.initialize.call(this);
        this.players.forEach(player=>{player.tech.seamanship??=0;});
        if(this.options.map==='coast'){
          this.players.forEach(player=>{player.age=Math.max(1,player.age);player.resources.wood+=350;player.resources.gold+=180;});
          for(const owner of [0,1]){
            if(owner===1&&(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(this.options.mode)||this.mission?.survival))continue;
            const sign=owner===0?-1:1;this.addBuilding('dock',owner,sign*19,owner===0?25:-25,true);
            const boat=this.addUnit('fishingboat',owner,sign*10,owner===0?24:-24);
            this.addUnit('galley',owner,sign*9,owner===0?14:-14);this.addUnit('transport',owner,sign*10,owner===0?34:-34);
            boat.order={type:'gather',target:null};
          }
          for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const fish=this.addResource('food',(this.rng()-.5)*17,-66+i*12,2200);fish.water=true;fish.r=2.1;}
          for(const e of this.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'||e.kind==='building')){e.maxHp=this.maxHP(e);e.hp=e.maxHp;}
          for(const boat of this.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='fishingboat'))this.assignWorker(boat);
          this.updateFog();
        }
      };
      const water=p.isWater;
      p.isWater=function(x,z){return this.options.map==='coast'?Math.abs(x-Math.sin(z*.03)*2)<14:water.call(this,x,z);};
      p.grid=function(owner,naval=false){if(!naval)return original.grid.call(this,owner);const key='sea'+owner;if(this.grids[key]?.revision===this.revision)return this.grids[key].data;
        const size=this.gridSize,half=this.halfWorld,data=new Uint8Array(size*size);for(let z=0;z<size;z++)for(let x=0;x<size;x++)data[z*size+x]=this.isWater(x*2-half+1,z*2-half+1)?0:1;this.grids[key]={revision:this.revision,data};return data;
      };
      p.buildValid=function(type,x,z,owner=0){if(type!=='dock')return original.buildValid.call(this,type,x,z,owner);
        if(Math.abs(x)>this.halfWorld-6||Math.abs(z)>this.halfWorld-6||this.isWater(x,z)||owner===0&&!this.isVisible(x,z))return false;
        let shore=false;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(this.isWater(x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*7,z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*7))shore=true;
        return shore&&!this.entities.some(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='building'&&distance(e,{x,z})<e.r+4.2);
      };
      p.spawnPoint=function(building,naval=false){const grid=this.grid(building.owner,naval);let best=null,score=Infinity;
        for(let x=-14;x<=14;x+=2)for(let z=-14;z<=14;z+=2){const point={x:building.x+x,z:building.z+z},cell=this.cell(point.x,point.z),n=Math.hypot(x,z);if(n>=building.r+1&&Math.abs(point.x)<=this.halfWorld-3&&Math.abs(point.z)<=this.halfWorld-3&&!grid[cell.z*this.gridSize+cell.x]&&n<score){best=point;score=n;}}return best;
      };
      p.tickBuilding=function(e,dt){const before=this.nextId;original.tickBuilding.call(this,e,dt);for(let id=before;id<this.nextId;id++){const unit=this.get(id);if(unit?.kind!=='unit')continue;if(unit.owner>0)this.emit('stat-trained',{entity:unit});const spawn=this.spawnPoint(e,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval);if(spawn){unit.x=spawn.x;unit.z=spawn.z;unit.path=[];}
          if(unit.type==='fishingboat')this.assignWorker(unit);
        }
      };
      p.assignWorker=function(e){if(e.type==='fishingboat'){const fish=this.nearest(e,t=>t.kind==='resource'&&t.water&&t.amount>0);if(fish){e.gatherType='food';e.order={type:'gather',target:fish.id};e.path=[];}return;}original.assignWorker.call(this,e);};
      p.smartCommand=function(ids,target,x,z,append=false,attackMove=false,owner=0){
        if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(z)||Math.abs(x)>this.halfWorld||Math.abs(z)>this.halfWorld)return false;
        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===owner&&e.kind==='unit');if(this.allied(owner,target?.owner)&&target.kind==='unit'&&UNITS[target.type].naval&&target.type!=='transport'&&units.every(e=>e.type==='villager')){this.command(units.map(e=>e.id),{type:'repair',target:target.id},append);return;}
        if(target?.type==='transport'&&this.allied(owner,target.owner)){for(const e of units)if(!UNITS[e.type].naval)this.command([e.id],{type:'board',target:target.id},append);return;}
        const fishers=units.filter(e=>e.type==='fishingboat');if(target?.water){for(const e of fishers)this.command([e.id],{type:'gather',target:target.id},append);if(!fishers.length)this.fail('Only fishing boats can harvest fish shoals.');return;}
        const legal=ids.filter(id=>{const e=this.get(id);return e?.kind!=='unit'||!!UNITS[e.type].naval===this.isWater(x,z)||target?.kind==='building'||this.hostile(owner,target?.owner);});
        if(legal.length<ids.length)this.fail('Ships sail on water. Land troops need a transport to cross the sea.');
        original.smartCommand.call(this,legal,target,x,z,append,attackMove,owner);
      };
      p.unload=function(id,x,z,owner=0){const ship=this.get(id);if(!ship||ship.owner!==owner||ship.type!=='transport')return false;
        if(this.isWater(x,z)||distance(ship,{x,z})>11)return this.fail('Choose a shore within 11 meters of the transport.',owner);
        const cell=this.cell(x,z);if(this.grid(owner)[cell.z*this.gridSize+cell.x])return this.fail('Choose open land to disembark.',owner);
        const passengers=ship.passengers||[];passengers.forEach((pid,i)=>{const e=this.get(pid);if(!e)return;e.embarked=false;e.transport=null;e.x=x+(i%3-1)*1.3;e.z=z+Math.floor(i/3)*1.3;if(this.isWater(e.x,e.z)){e.x=x;e.z=z;}e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];});ship.passengers=[];this.emit('unload',{entity:ship});return true;
      };
      p.tickUnit=function(e,dt){

      p.tickAI=function(){if(this.options.multiplayer)return;original.tickAI.call(this);if(['sandbox','tutorial','survival'].includes(this.options.mode)||this.mission?.survival)return;

        let resource=this.nearest(e,t=>t.kind==='resource'&&!t.water&&t.type===type&&t.amount>0);if(!resource)resource=this.nearest(e,t=>t.type==='farm'&&t.owner===e.owner&&t.progress>=1);if(resource){e.gatherType=resource.type==='farm'?'food':resource.type;e.order={type:'gather',target:resource.id};e.path=[];}}

      state:(state,effects,waiting)=>{if(!playing||!net.active)return;const old=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));const resources=state.compactResources?sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource'):[];for(const update of state.resourceUpdates||[]){const e=resources.find(resource=>resource.id===update.id);if(e)Object.assign(e,update);}
        sim.entities=[...state.entities,...resources].map(e=>{const previous=old.get(e.id);if(e.kind==='unit'&&previous){e.renderFromX=previous.renderX??previous.x;e.renderFromZ=previous.renderZ??previous.z;e.snapshotAt=performance.now();}return e;});sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));for(const key of ['players','time','wave','nextWave','hold','enemyHold','wonderTime','stats','ended','revealedOwners'])sim[key]=state[key];sim.explored=Uint8Array.from(state.explored);sim.visible=Uint8Array.from(state.visible);sim.revision++;sim.grids={};view.pruneMissing();view.updateFog();for(const effect of effects)onEvent(effect);if(waiting)$('#alert-line').innerHTML='WAITING FOR THE OTHER COMMANDER TO RECONNECT';else if($('#alert-line').textContent.includes('WAITING'))$('#alert-line').innerHTML='';renderHUD();renderSelection();if(sim.ended&&modal!=='end')showEnd(sim.ended);},

    export function customBattleMarkup(draft){

    export function readBattleSetup(root=document){
      const get=id=>root.querySelector('#'+id),slots=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({name:get(`custom-name-${i}`).value,enabled:i===0||get(`custom-type-${i}`).value!=='closed',controller:i===0||get(`custom-type-${i}`).value==='human'?'human':'ai',faction:get(`custom-faction-${i}`).value,team:Number(get(`custom-team-${i}`).value),difficulty:get(`custom-difficulty-${i}`).value}));
      return {mode:'custom',slots,map:get('custom-map').value,mapSize:get('custom-size').value,startAge:Number(get('custom-age').value),resourceLevel:get('custom-resources').value,populationLimit:Number(get('custom-population').value),seed:Math.max(1,Math.min(999999999,Math.abs(Number(get('custom-seed').value))||2026)),victory:get('custom-victory').value,shareVision:get('custom-vision').checked,revealRemnants:get('custom-remnants').checked};
    }
    export function updateBattlePreview(root=document){
      const draft=readBattleSetup(root),canvas=root.querySelector('#battle-preview'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),size=canvas.width;
      root.querySelectorAll('.battle-slot').forEach((row,i)=>{const active=draft.slots[i].enabled;row.classList.toggle('closed',!active);row.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(input=>{if(!input.id.includes('-type-'))input.disabled=!active||input.id.includes('-difficulty-')&&draft.slots[i].controller==='human';});});
      ctx.fillStyle={winter:'#b7c4b2',desert:'#a89773',canyon:'#8a7b67'}[draft.map]||'#667e50';ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
      if(['coast','valley','rivers'].includes(draft.map)){ctx.strokeStyle='#70a9b0';ctx.lineWidth=draft.map==='coast'?21:8;for(const offset of draft.map==='rivers'?[-15,15]:[0]){ctx.beginPath();for(let y=0;y<=size;y+=4){const x=size/2+offset+Math.sin(y*.08)*4;if(!y)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y);}ctx.stroke();}}
      const warning=root.querySelector('.custom-validation'),launch=root.querySelector('[data-action=custom-start]');
      try{
        const battle=normalizeBattle(draft),spawns=battleSpawns(battle.slots,battle.worldSize);launch.disabled=false;warning.textContent='Matching team numbers are allies. Different team numbers are enemies. Coast battles include ships and start in at least the Feudal Age.';
        let active=0;draft.slots.forEach((slot,index)=>{if(!slot.enabled)return;const point=spawns[active++],x=(point.x/battle.worldSize+.5)*size,z=(point.z/battle.worldSize+.5)*size;
          ctx.fillStyle=color(index);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,z,12,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#203528';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#172b23';ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText(index+1,x,z);
        });
        root.querySelector('#battle-summary').textContent=`${battle.slots.length} kingdoms Â· ${new Set(battle.slots.map(slot=>slot.team)).size} teams Â· ${BATTLE_SIZES[battle.mapSize].desc}`;root.querySelector('#battle-rule').textContent=VICTORY_RULES[battle.victory].desc;
      }catch(error){launch.disabled=true;warning.textContent=error.message;root.querySelector('#battle-summary').textContent='Add an opposing team to begin.';}
      return draft;
    }
    export function battleObjectiveMarkup(sim){

    export function battleResultMarkup(sim){

    export function roomLobbyMarkup(room){

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {cameraMapBox,cameraMapFootprint,insideMap,minimapPoint} from '../src/map-geometry.js';
    import {CAMERA_PRESETS} from '../src/world.js';
    
    function cameraAt(x,z,angle,tilt,zoom,aspect){
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(46,aspect,.5,400);
      camera.position.set(x+Math.sin(angle)*zoom,.65+Math.tan(tilt)*zoom,z+Math.cos(angle)*zoom);
      camera.lookAt(x,.65,z);camera.updateMatrixWorld();return camera;
    }
    
    test('radar camera box stays finite and rectangular across map edges, views and rotations',()=>{
      for(const preset of Object.values(CAMERA_PRESETS))for(const [x,z]of [[0,0],[-72,-72],[-72,72],[72,-72],[72,72]])for(const angle of [0,Math.PI/4,1.85,Math.PI])for(const aspect of [1440/900,844/390,390/844]){
        const camera=cameraAt(x,z,angle,preset.tilt,preset.zoom,aspect),box=cameraMapBox(camera,.65);
        assert.ok(box,'a camera aimed inside the battlefield always has a locator');
        for(const value of Object.values(box))assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value)&&Math.abs(value)<=80.00001);
        assert.ok(box.minX<box.maxX&&box.minZ<box.maxZ);
        assert.ok(x>=box.minX-1e-5&&x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&z<=box.maxZ+1e-5,'the camera center is inside its box');
        for(const p of cameraMapFootprint(camera,.65))assert.ok(p.x>=box.minX-1e-5&&p.x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&p.z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&p.z<=box.maxZ+1e-5);
      }
    });
    
    test('radar locator follows scrolling and grows when zooming out',()=>{
      const preset=CAMERA_PRESETS.tactical,make=(x,z,zoom)=>cameraMapBox(cameraAt(x,z,0,preset.tilt,zoom,1.6),.65);
      const near=make(0,0,24),far=make(0,0,45),moved=make(10,12,24);
      assert.ok(far.maxX-far.minX>near.maxX-near.minX);assert.ok(far.maxZ-far.minZ>near.maxZ-near.minZ);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minX-near.minX-10)<1e-5);assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minZ-near.minZ-12)<1e-5);
    });
    
    test('minimap coordinates map consistently to the square battlefield and clamp captured drags',()=>{
      const rect={left:17,top:29,width:101,height:101};
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(17,29,rect),{x:-80,z:-80});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(118,130,rect),{x:80,z:80});
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(67.5,79.5,rect),{x:0,z:0});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(-50,600,rect),{x:-80,z:80});
      for(const [x,z]of [[NaN,0],[0,Infinity],[81,0],[0,-81]])assert.equal(insideMap(x,z),false);
    });
    
    test('terrain picking allows the playable square and rejects decorative surroundings',()=>{
      for(const map of ['highlands','coast','valley']){
        const land=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=land.geometry(320,112);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-79,-79],[79,79],[-79,79],[79,-79],[0,0]])assert.ok(land.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0))));

        geometry.dispose();

    });

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {Simulation,distance} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {clearSegment} from '../src/navigation.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    const advance=(sim,seconds)=>{for(let i=0;i<seconds*10;i++)sim.tick(.1);};
    
    test('trees and mineral deposits block construction and movement until harvested',()=>{
      for(const type of ['wood','gold','stone']){
        const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',seed:512});sim.entities=sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind!=='resource');sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));sim.revision++;sim.visible.fill(1);sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));
        const source=sim.addResource(type,0,20,6),worker=sim.addUnit('villager',0,0,15),scout=sim.addUnit('scout',0,-8,20);sim.revision++;
        assert.equal(sim.buildValid('house',0,20),false);assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,sim.grid(0),scout,{x:8,z:20}),false);
        const route=sim.pathTo(scout,{x:8,z:20});assert.equal(scout.pathStatus,'ready');assert.ok(route.some(point=>Math.abs(point.z-20)>1));
        const bank=sim.players[0].resources[type];sim.command([worker.id],{type:'gather',target:source.id});advance(sim,30);
        assert.equal(source.hp,0);assert.ok(sim.players[0].resources[type]>=bank+5.99);assert.equal(sim.buildValid('house',0,20),true);assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,sim.grid(0),scout,{x:8,z:20}),true);
      }
    });
    
    test('straight navigation cannot cut diagonal corners or cross a thin wall',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),grid=new Uint8Array(sim.gridSize**2),from={x:1,z:21},to={x:5,z:25},cell=sim.cell(3,21);
      assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,from,to),true);grid[cell.z*sim.gridSize+cell.x]=1;assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,from,to),false);
      grid.fill(0);const wall=sim.cell(1,35);grid[wall.z*sim.gridSize+wall.x]=1;assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,{x:1,z:21},{x:1,z:49}),false);
    });
    
    test('stable long orders keep their route and recompute when terrain changes',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast'});sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const ship=sim.addUnit('transport',0,0,-60),original=sim.pathTo.bind(sim);let searches=0;sim.pathTo=(...args)=>{searches++;return original(...args);};
      sim.command([ship.id],{type:'move',x:0,z:60});advance(sim,12);assert.ok(ship.z>-40);assert.ok(searches<=2,`stable route searched ${searches} times`);
      const before=searches;sim.revision++;advance(sim,.2);assert.ok(searches>before);assert.equal(ship.pathStatus,'ready');
    });

## Assistant

I found and fixed a large-map issue: terrain clicks near the outer edges still used an older map-size limit. I’ve also reduced repeated route searches for units following unchanged destinations, which should ease CPU load in large battles.

The new obstacle checks are now testing whether trees and mineral deposits block movement and construction, then open the space when harvested.

    const clamp=(sim,n)=>Math.max(-sim.halfWorld+3,Math.min(sim.halfWorld-3,n));
    
    // Resolve formation slots on the unit's own movement surface. This keeps edge
    // slots out of foundations and water without sending land troops across a sea.
    export function formationSlot(sim,unit,point){
      const size=sim.gridSize,half=sim.halfWorld,grid=sim.grid(unit.owner,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval),cell=sim.cell(point.x,point.z);
      if(!grid[cell.z*size+cell.x])return {x:clamp(sim,point.x),z:clamp(sim,point.z)};
      let best=null,score=Infinity;
      for(let r=1;r<=4;r++)for(let z=Math.max(0,cell.z-r);z<=Math.min(size-1,cell.z+r);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,cell.x-r);x<=Math.min(size-1,cell.x+r);x++){
        if(grid[z*size+x])continue;const wx=x*2-half+1,wz=z*2-half+1,s=Math.hypot(wx-point.x,wz-point.z)+Math.hypot(wx-unit.x,wz-unit.z)*.03;
        if(s<score){score=s;best={x:wx,z:wz};}
      }return best||{x:clamp(sim,point.x),z:clamp(sim,point.z)};
    }
    
    export function installTactics(Simulation){
      const p=Simulation.prototype;
