    test('naval mode starts with a fishing economy and separates land and sea navigation',()=>{const s=new Simulation({mode:'tides'});s.tickAI=()=>{};s.stop(s.owned(0,'unit','villager').map(e=>e.id));const boat=s.owned(0,'unit','fishingboat')[0],food=s.players[0].resources.food;advance(s,65);assert.ok(s.players[0].resources.food>=food+75,'a fishing boat actually deposited its catch');assert.ok(s.isWater(boat.x,boat.z));const cell=s.cell(0,30);assert.equal(s.grid(0)[cell.z*80+cell.x],1);assert.equal(s.grid(0,true)[cell.z*80+cell.x],0);});
    test('harbors require a shoreline and fishing boats spawn on water',()=>{const s=new Simulation({mode:'tides'});s.tickAI=()=>{};assert.equal(s.buildValid('dock',-45,50),false);const dock=s.owned(0,'building','dock')[0];assert.ok(s.train(dock.id,'fishingboat'));advance(s,21);assert.ok(s.owned(0,'unit','fishingboat').every(e=>s.isWater(e.x,e.z)));});
    test('transports board land units, move on water, unload on shore, and reject remote landings',()=>{const s=new Simulation({mode:'tides'});s.tickAI=()=>{};const ship=s.owned(0,'unit','transport')[0];ship.x=-10;ship.z=34;const unit=s.addUnit('spearman',0,-16,34);s.command([unit.id],{type:'board',target:ship.id});advance(s,2);assert.equal(unit.embarked,true);assert.equal(ship.passengers.length,1);assert.equal(s.unload(ship.id,60,34),false);assert.equal(s.unload(ship.id,-18,34),true);assert.equal(unit.embarked,false);assert.equal(s.isWater(unit.x,unit.z),false);});
    test('sinking transports also defeats their embarked troops',()=>{const s=new Simulation({mode:'tides'}),ship=s.owned(0,'unit','transport')[0],unit=s.addUnit('spearman',0,ship.x-5,ship.z);unit.embarked=true;unit.transport=ship.id;ship.passengers=[unit.id];s.hurt(ship,ship.hp+1,s.owned(1,'unit','galley')[0]);assert.equal(unit.hp,0);});
    test('player two can trade, cancel queues, and demolish its own buildings',()=>{const s=new Simulation();s.players[1].resources={food:2000,wood:2000,gold:2000,stone:2000};s.players[1].age=1;const market=s.addBuilding('market',1,60,-50,true),before=s.players[1].resources.gold;assert.ok(s.trade('food',true,1));assert.equal(s.players[1].resources.gold,before-130);assert.equal(s.players[0].resources.gold,250);const tc=s.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0];s.train(tc.id,'villager');s.cancelQueue(tc.id,0,1);assert.equal(tc.queue.length,0);assert.ok(s.demolish(market.id,1));});
    test('saved transports preserve passenger and naval research state',()=>{const s=new Simulation({mode:'tides'}),ship=s.owned(0,'unit','transport')[0],unit=s.addUnit('spearman',0,-17,34);unit.embarked=true;unit.transport=ship.id;ship.passengers=[unit.id];s.players[0].tech.seamanship=1;const restored=Simulation.restore(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.serialize())));assert.equal(restored.get(unit.id).embarked,true);assert.deepEqual(restored.get(ship.id).passengers,[unit.id]);assert.equal(restored.players[0].tech.seamanship,1);});

    const CACHE = __CACHE__;
    const FILES = __FILES__;
    self.addEventListener('install', event => {
      event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE)
        .then(cache => cache.addAll(FILES))
        .then(() => self.skipWaiting()));
    });
    self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
      event.waitUntil(caches.keys()
        .then(keys => Promise.all(keys
          .filter(key => key.startsWith('frontier-') && key !== CACHE)
          .map(key => caches.delete(key))))
        .then(() => self.clients.claim()));
    });
    self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
      if (event.request.method !== 'GET' || new URL(event.request.url).origin !== self.location.origin) return;
      // Precache requests and crossorigin module requests have different Origin
      // headers. The assets here are immutable and restricted to this origin.
      event.respondWith(caches.match(event.request, {ignoreVary: true}).then(cached => {
        if (cached) return cached;
        return fetch(event.request).catch(() => {
          if (event.request.mode === 'navigate') return caches.match('/index.html');
          return Response.error();
        });
      }));
    });

    # Version 2.4 verification
    
    Checked 10 October 2026. This records observed checks, rather than a claim that all possible bugs or all device configurations have been ruled out.
    
    ## Automated game checks
    
    `npm test`: **102 passed, zero failed**. Coverage includes paid gathering/construction/training/research; ages and civilization restrictions; counters, healing and siege; walls, gates and bridges; fleets and transports; all modes and staged campaigns; checkpoints and save compatibility; production batches; custom alliances, large-map fog/navigation/picking, each victory rule, independent AI clocks, seeded weather, and real WebSocket rooms.
    
    Eight simultaneous real WebSocket clients exercised readiness, private economies and fog, command ownership, reconnect recovery, host elimination and alliance results. Mixed human/AI rooms also passed. These tests use isolated services and do not modify live player rooms.
    
    ## Custom battle and 3D checks
    
    `scripts/custom-battle-qa.mjs` passed in a real Edge renderer with desktop and emulated landscape-phone layouts:
    
    - Huge 400 × 400 battlefield, eight kingdoms, independent AI difficulty and eight army materials.
    - Actual terrain clicks beyond the former ±160 picking limit and full-map radar navigation.
    - Deferred unseen-mesh allocation, persistent objective scrolling/rules, and custom save/resume with a paid training queue.
    - Volumetric rain with three effect draw calls; quality-limited snow, weather settings and optional lightning.
    - Square minimap, touch interaction and no horizontal page overflow at 844 × 390.
    
    `scripts/custom-multiplayer-qa.mjs` passed with desktop and phone-sized browsers, a third real WebSocket commander and an AI kingdom: guest slot choice, host/guest readiness, private local perspectives, rejected foreign commands, phone production, reload/rejoin, host defeat without ending the match, and correct alliance victory/defeat.
    
    The machine reports approximately 4 GB RAM. Running three simultaneous 3D browser contexts exceeded the practical test budget and timed out without a JavaScript error; the mixed-room browser test runs two graphics clients plus a protocol client. This is not an eight-device FPS measurement.
    
    ## Full-match diagnostic
    
    `scripts/battle-benchmark.mjs`, seed 512, Huge highlands, eight Hard AI kingdoms, standard resources and an 80-person cap:
    
    - Started with the normal economy. The diagnostic alone assigned AI control to the normal human slot.
    - All kingdoms reached Imperial Age. The winning alliance eliminated every opposing building through normal production and combat, finishing at **977.4 simulated seconds** (about 16 minutes).
    - CPU-only simulation tick times: median **10.44 ms**, p95 **21.24 ms**, p99 **30.10 ms**, maximum **65.68 ms** on this run. These are simulation timings, not rendered FPS or phone timings.
    - An earlier pre-optimization match also reached a normal result after about 29 simulated minutes. Battle length is situational, without a forced minimum timer.
    
    Recorded artifacts include `artifacts/battle-benchmark-highlands.json`, the earlier baseline/pre-route-cache reports, custom browser JSON reports and screenshots.
    
    ## Corrections made during the audit
    
    Corrected outer-map picking, resource/harbor overlap, coastal resource access, final-load delivery after deposits/shoals are exhausted, sustained AI attack orders, final-building visibility for AI, naval boarding reservations, individual AI ownership/budgets, private research/error notices and objective scroll resets. Added straight-route checks, connected movement regions, reusable path buffers, valid-route retention, blocked-order retry limits, vision indexing and shared composition calculations. Low quality and background/menu rendering budgets reduce work; saved graphics preferences remain respected.
    
    ## Further release evidence
    
    The broader browser regression run records results in `artifacts/release-browser-checks.json`. Physical phone/laptop FPS, sustained thermal/memory behavior, human balance and mission pacing, and delayed/lossy network play still need independent testing. Public matchmaking, persistent server rooms, accounts, professional authored assets and voice acting are outside this implemented local release. The game is an original playable RTS beta; commercial AAA parity or “100% world class” has not been established.

    import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    const names=process.argv.slice(2),checks=names.length?names:['edge-scroll-qa.mjs','map-qa.mjs','production-qa.mjs','commander-qa.mjs','campaign-qa.mjs','realm-qa.mjs','offline-qa.mjs','custom-multiplayer-qa.mjs'];
    const report={version:JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version,started:new Date().toISOString(),checks:[]};fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});
    for(const name of checks){
      if(!/^[a-z-]+\.mjs$/.test(name))throw new Error('Invalid check filename');const start=Date.now();let output='';console.log(`Checking ${name}`);
      const child=spawn(process.execPath,['scripts/'+name],{env:{...process.env,QA_URL:process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4173/'},stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});child.stdout.on('data',chunk=>output+=chunk);child.stderr.on('data',chunk=>output+=chunk);const code=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{child.once('error',reject);child.once('exit',resolve);});
      report.checks.push({name,passed:code===0,seconds:(Date.now()-start)/1000,output});fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/release-browser-checks.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));console.log(`${code===0?'PASS':'FAIL'} ${name} (${Math.round((Date.now()-start)/1000)}s)`);if(code!==0)console.log(output.slice(-2500));
    }
    report.finished=new Date().toISOString();report.passed=report.checks.every(check=>check.passed);fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/release-browser-checks.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));if(!report.passed)process.exitCode=1;

## Assistant

The coastal battle check found an AI recovery bug: after losing a harbor, some kingdoms stopped ferrying armies, and a transport could fail to retry an interrupted landing. I’m fixing harbor rebuilding, sailing retries, and unloading beside occupied docks so naval battles keep progressing.

    function closedCloth(width=1,height=1){
      const positions=[],uv=[],indices=[],cols=8,rows=3;
      for(let side=0;side<2;side++)for(let row=0;row<=rows;row++)for(let col=0;col<=cols;col++){

    export function ensureModels(view){

      Object.assign(m,{leather:standard(0x594334),pants:standard(0x535c4a),hair:standard(0x47372b),straw:standard(0xbda270),horse:standard(0x76513a),mane:standard(0x342b28),steel:standard(0xb5c0c0,{metalness:.85,roughness:.3}),slate:standard(0x47576a),brick:standard(0x967255),grain:standard(0xd7b65b),fruit:standard(0x9e4240),canvas:standard(0xd0c4a6),glow:standard(0xcd6229,{emissive:0xff6d26,emissiveIntensity:1.8}),relic:standard(0x55cdb5,{emissive:0x287b67,emissiveIntensity:.65,metalness:.55,roughness:.18})});

      Object.assign(view.geo,{capsule,anatomy:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,7),foliageNear:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),foliageFar:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),grain3d:new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1),limb:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.86,1,1,7),cloth3d:closedCloth(),arch3d:archGeometry(),roof3d:gableGeometry(),hull3d:hullGeometry(),wheel3d:new THREE.TorusGeometry(.5,.09,5,16).rotateY(Math.PI/2),ring3d:new THREE.TorusGeometry(1,.075,5,20),rock3d:new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1,0),helmet3d:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,5,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.68),dome3d:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,16,8,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2)});

    function builder(view,g){
      const piece=(geo,m,x,y,z,sx=1,sy=1,sz=1)=>view.piece(g,geo,m,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz);
      const box=(m,x,y,z,w,h,d,ry=0)=>view.box(g,m,x,y,z,w,h,d,ry);
      const oval=(m,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz)=>piece(view.geo.anatomy,m,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz);
      const rod=(m,a,b,r=.06)=>{const start=new THREE.Vector3(...a),end=new THREE.Vector3(...b),delta=end.clone().sub(start),center=start.clone().add(end).multiplyScalar(.5);const mesh=piece(view.geo.limb,m,center.x,center.y,center.z,r,delta.length(),r);mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Y,delta.normalize());return mesh;};
      const arch=(m,x,y,z,w,h,d=.3)=>piece(view.geo.arch3d,m,x,y,z,w,h,d);
      const roof=(m,x,y,z,w,h,d)=>piece(view.geo.roof3d,m,x,y,z,w,h,d);
      return{piece,box,oval,rod,arch,roof};
    }
    function motion(mesh,type,pivot,side=1,parent=null){mesh.userData.motion={type,pivot,side,parent};return mesh;}
    function tag(group,definition){group.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh.isMesh)mesh.userData.motion=definition;});}
    function flag(view,g,team,x,y,z,size=1){const b=builder(view,g);b.rod(view.materials.darkwood,[x,0,z],[x,y,z],.055);const f=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,team,x+size*.5,y-.35*size,z,size,.65*size,1);f.userData.flag=true;}
    function barrel(view,g,x,y,z,s=.6){const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;b.piece(view.geo.capsule,m.wood,x,y+s*.7,z,s,s*1.4,s);for(const yy of [.25,1.1]){const hoop=b.piece(view.geo.ring3d,m.iron,x,y+s*yy,z,s*.48,s*.48,s*.48);hoop.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;}}
    function crate(view,g,x,y,z,s=.65){const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;b.box(m.wood,x,y+s*.5,z,s,s,s);for(const xx of [-.36,.36])b.box(m.darkwood,x+xx*s,y+s*.5,z+s*.51,.07*s,s*.95,.035);b.box(m.darkwood,x,y+s*.5,z+s*.525,s*1.15,.07,.035).rotation.z=.7;}
    function wheel(view,g,x,y,z,r=.5,animated=true){
      const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,parts=[];parts.push(b.piece(view.geo.wheel3d,m.darkwood,x,y,z,.4,r*2,r*2));parts.push(b.rod(m.iron,[x-.16,y,z],[x+.16,y,z],.13));
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/3;parts.push(b.rod(m.wood,[x,y,z],[x,y+Math.sin(a)*r,z+Math.cos(a)*r],.04));}
      if(animated)for(const part of parts)motion(part,'wheel',[x,y,z]);
    }
    
    function horse(view,g,armor=false,animated=true,offset=[0,0,0],scale=1){
      const model=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,model),m=view.materials;
      b.oval(m.horse,0,1.15,0,.46,.43,.92);b.oval(m.horse,0,1.65,.6,.28,.62,.29).rotation.x=-.35;
      b.oval(m.horse,0,2.08,.98,.25,.27,.45);b.oval(m.mane,0,1.78,.38,.13,.55,.16).rotation.x=-.4;
      for(const side of [-1,1]){b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.horse,side*.16,2.37,.84,.07,.24,.10);b.oval(m.hair,side*.235,2.17,1.06,.034,.04,.037);}
      b.rod(m.mane,[0,1.3,-.85],[0,.62,-1.12],.10);b.box(m.leather,0,1.53,-.05,.9,.16,.72);
      if(armor){b.oval(m.steel,0,1.41,.6,.45,.21,.45);b.box(m.steel,0,2.15,1.2,.12,.32,.12);}
      for(const x of [-.3,.3])for(const z of [-.58,.59]){
        const pivot=[x,1.18,z],side=Math.sign(x)*(z>0?1:-1);
        const upper=b.rod(m.horse,pivot,[x,.66,z+.04],.115),lower=b.rod(m.horse,[x,.66,z+.04],[x,.20,z-.02],.075),hoof=b.box(m.mane,x,.15,z-.015,.19,.2,.24);
        if(animated){motion(upper,'horseleg',pivot,side);motion(lower,'horseleg',pivot,side);motion(hoof,'horseleg',pivot,side);}
      }
      model.position.set(...offset);model.scale.setScalar(scale);g.add(model);return model;
    }
    
    function human(view,e){
      const root=new THREE.Group(),body=new THREE.Group();root.add(body);root.userData.body=body;
      const b=builder(view,body),m=view.materials,team=view.teamMaterials[e.owner],type=UNITS[e.type].model||e.type;
      const riding=['knight','scout'].includes(type),offset=riding?.85:0,armored=['swordsman','knight','king'].includes(type);
      if(riding)horse(view,body,type==='knight');
      b.piece(view.geo.capsule,armored?m.steel:team,0,1.35+offset,0,.66,.73,.44);
      b.oval(m.pants,0,.99+offset,0,.27,.2,.22);b.box(m.leather,0,1.08+offset,0,.62,.09,.47);b.box(m.gold,0,1.08+offset,.245,.12,.1,.04);
      b.rod(m.skin,[0,1.68+offset,0],[0,1.83+offset,0],.12);b.oval(m.skin,0,2+offset,0,.23,.28,.215);
      b.oval(m.skin,0,1.99+offset,.218,.07,.085,.08);
      for(const side of [-1,1])b.oval(m.hair,side*.08,2.075+offset,.196,.024,.025,.025);
      if(type==='villager'){
        const brim=b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.straw,0,2.22,0,.37,.055,.35);brim.scale.y=.055;
        b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.straw,0,2.35,0,.26,.23,.25);b.box(m.canvas,0,1.25,.249,.42,.53,.05);
      }else if(type==='monk'){

      }else if(type==='archer'||type==='scout')b.oval(team,0,2.17+offset,-.07,.255,.21,.255);
      else{

        b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.gold,0,2.28,0,.26,.15,.26);
        for(let i=0;i<6;i++)b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.gold,Math.sin(i*Math.PI/3)*.23,2.45,Math.cos(i*Math.PI/3)*.23,.055,.23,.055);
        const cape=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,team,0,1.36,-.28,.8,1.4,1);cape.rotation.x=.18;
      }
      for(const side of [-1,1]){
        const hip=[side*.17,1.02+offset,0],knee=[side*.17,.63+offset,.025];
        const parent={type:'leg',pivot:hip,side};

        motion(b.rod(m.pants,knee,[side*.17,.22+offset,0],.095),'knee',knee,side,parent);
        motion(b.piece(view.geo.capsule,m.leather,side*.17,.145+offset,.10,.21,.24,.37),'knee',knee,side,parent);
        const shoulder=[side*.39,1.63+offset,0],elbow=[side*.50,1.28+offset,.07],hand=[side*.56,1.04+offset,.20];
        const arm={type:'arm',pivot:shoulder,side};
        motion(b.rod(armored?m.steel:team,shoulder,elbow,.13),'arm',shoulder,side);
        motion(b.rod(armored?m.leather:team,elbow,hand,.10),'forearm',elbow,side,arm);
        motion(b.oval(m.skin,...hand,.105,.12,.10),'forearm',elbow,side,arm);
        if(armored)motion(b.oval(m.steel,side*.38,1.65+offset,0,.19,.13,.23),'arm',shoulder,side);
      }
      const tool=new THREE.Group(),t=builder(view,tool),y=offset;
      if(['spearman','knight','scout'].includes(type)){
        t.rod(m.wood,[.56,.7+y,.2],[.56,3.6+y,.2],.035);t.piece(view.geo.cone,m.steel,.56,3.75+y,.2,.12,.42,.07);
        t.box(team,.58,3.35+y,.21,.08,.23,.025);
      }else if(type==='archer'){
        const bow=t.piece(view.geo.ring3d,m.wood,.56,1.25,.27,.42,.68,.14);bow.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;
        t.rod(m.canvas,[.56,.63,.27],[.56,1.87,.27],.012);
        t.rod(m.wood,[.56,1.15,.27],[.56,1.15,1.2],.018);
        b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.leather,-.15,1.52,-.28,.14,.72,.14);
        for(let i=0;i<3;i++)b.rod(m.wood,[-.24+i*.08,1.42,-.30],[-.24+i*.08,2.0,-.30],.015);
      }else if(type==='villager'){
        t.rod(m.wood,[.56,.67,.2],[.56,1.69,.2],.035);t.box(m.steel,.68,1.67,.2,.32,.24,.10);t.box(m.steel,.83,1.65,.2,.07,.28,.11);
      }else if(type==='monk'){

      }else{
        t.box(m.steel,.56,1.25+y,.64,.065,.09,.88);t.box(m.gold,.56,1.25+y,.25,.36,.07,.09);t.rod(m.leather,[.56,1.25+y,.02],[.56,1.25+y,.24],.045);
        const shield=new THREE.Group(),s=builder(view,shield);s.piece(view.geo.cylinder,team,-.63,1.27+y,.24,.38,.10,.38).rotation.z=Math.PI/2;
        s.oval(m.steel,-.72,1.27+y,.24,.10,.13,.13);const trim=s.piece(view.geo.ring3d,m.steel,-.70,1.27+y,.24,.35,.35,.35);trim.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;

      if(e.type==='sentinel'){const cape=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,team,0,1.35,-.31,.77,1.3,1);cape.rotation.x=.15;b.box(m.gold,0,2.40,0,.08,.28,.3);b.box(m.steel,-.68,1.3,.23,.10,.85,.55);}
      if(e.type==='marksman'){const cape=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,m.canvas,0,1.40,-.30,.7,1.1,1);cape.rotation.x=.12;b.oval(m.leather,0,1.76,-.10,.3,.12,.22);tool.scale.set(1,1.18,1.15);}
      if(e.type==='outrider'){b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,team,0,2.04,-.37,.75,.85,1);b.box(m.gold,.58,4.15,.2,.08,.16,.34);}

    }
    
    function siege(view,e){
      const g=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,team=view.teamMaterials[e.owner];
      b.box(m.wood,0,.78,0,1.8,.35,2.8);for(const x of [-1,1])for(const z of [-.95,.95])wheel(view,g,x,.53,z,.48);
      if(e.type==='ram'){
        for(const x of [-.8,.8])for(const z of [-1.2,1.2])b.rod(m.darkwood,[x,.7,z],[x,1.9,z],.075);
        b.roof(view.roofMaterials[e.owner],0,1.85,0,2.2,1,3.2);
        const log=new THREE.Group(),l=builder(view,log);l.rod(m.wood,[0,1.23,-1.7],[0,1.23,2.15],.25);l.oval(m.steel,0,1.23,2.16,.28,.27,.20);
        tag(log,{type:'ram',pivot:[0,1.23,0],side:1});g.add(log);
        for(const z of [-.9,.9])b.rod(m.iron,[0,1.75,z],[0,1.24,z],.025);
      }else{
        for(const x of [-.62,.62]){b.rod(m.wood,[x,.9,-1.3],[x,2.8,0],.13);b.rod(m.wood,[x,.9,1.3],[x,2.8,0],.13);}
        b.rod(m.iron,[-.85,2.8,0],[.85,2.8,0],.1);
        const arm=new THREE.Group(),a=builder(view,arm);a.rod(m.wood,[0,2.8,1.1],[0,4.5,-2.1],.12);a.box(m.stoneDark,0,2.2,1.2,.8,.9,.7);
        a.rod(m.canvas,[0,4.5,-2.1],[0,4.1,-2.5],.03);a.oval(m.leather,0,4.07,-2.49,.25,.12,.28);
        tag(arm,{type:'siege',pivot:[0,2.8,0],side:1});g.add(arm);flag(view,g,team,.85,2.65,.7,.55);
      }

    function ship(view,e){

      b.piece(view.geo.hull3d,m.wood,0,.05,0,scale,1,scale);
      b.box(m.darkwood,0,.99,0,1.96*scale,.13,3.75*scale);
      for(const side of [-1,1])b.rod(m.darkwood,[side*1.01*scale,1.13,-1.7*scale],[side*.80*scale,1.13,1.7*scale],.075);
      for(let z=-1.6;z<=1.6;z+=.3)b.box(m.wood,0,1.07,z*scale,1.8*scale,.035,.045);
      if(e.type==='fishingboat'){

        b.rod(m.wood,[.9,1.2,-.5],[1.55,1.8,-1.4],.045);
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++)b.rod(m.canvas,[1.05,1.18,-.5+i*.14],[1.4,.25,-.65+i*.14],.01);
      }else{
        b.rod(m.darkwood,[0,1.1,0],[0,6,0],.075);b.rod(m.wood,[-1.45*scale,4.75,0],[1.45*scale,4.75,0],.055);
        const sail=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,m.canvas,0,3.5,.02,2.9*scale,2.35,1);motion(sail,'sail',[0,4.75,0]);
        const emblem=b.piece(view.geo.cloth3d,team,0,3.5,.10,.28,1.55,1);motion(emblem,'sail',[0,4.75,0]);
        for(const side of [-1,1])b.rod(m.canvas,[0,5.5,0],[side*.8,1.1,-1.5],.012);
        flag(view,g,team,0,6.1,0,.65);
        if(e.type==='galley')for(const side of [-1,1])for(let z=-1;z<=1;z+=.55){const oar=b.rod(m.wood,[side*.9,1.05,z],[side*2.2,.3,z+.5],.04);motion(oar,'oar',[side*.9,1.05,z],side);}
        if(heavy){for(const side of [-1,1])for(const z of [-1.1,1.1]){b.rod(m.steel,[side*.75,1.28,z],[side*1.7,1.3,z],.12);b.box(m.darkwood,side*.65,1.15,z,.4,.3,.55);}b.box(m.wood,0,1.45,-1.7,1.5,.65,.7);}

    }
    function supplyCart(view,e){const g=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;b.box(m.darkwood,0,.75,0,1.8,.2,2.7);
      for(const x of [-1,1])for(const z of [-.9,.9])wheel(view,g,x,.5,z,.46);
      for(const x of [-.84,.84])b.box(m.wood,x,1.05,0,.1,.6,2.8);
      for(const x of [-.4,.4])for(const z of [-.7,.6])crate(view,g,x,.89,z,.66);barrel(view,g,0,1.5,0,.45);
      b.rod(m.darkwood,[-.5,.65,1.2],[-.5,.3,2.5],.06);b.rod(m.darkwood,[.5,.65,1.2],[.5,.3,2.5],.06);flag(view,g,view.teamMaterials[e.owner],.85,2.8,-1,.65);
      g.userData.model3d={kind:'unit',type:'cart',articulated:true};return g;}
    export function unitModel(view,e){ensureModels(view);return e.type==='cart'?supplyCart(view,e):UNITS[e.type].naval?ship(view,e):['ram','catapult'].includes(e.type)?siege(view,e):human(view,e);}
    
    function cottage(view,g,owner,x,z,w=4,d=3.5,h=3.2){
      const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,roof=view.roofMaterials[owner],faction=view.sim?.players[owner].faction||'alder';
      b.box(m.stoneDark,x,.18,z,w+.25,.65,d+.25);b.box(m.plaster,x,h*.5+.38,z,w,h,d);
      if(faction==='sun'){
        b.box(m.stone,x,h+.45,z,w+.55,.25,d+.55);b.piece(view.geo.dome3d,roof,x,h+.58,z,w*.45,w*.4,d*.45);
        for(const side of [-1,1])for(const zz of [-1,1])b.box(m.stone,x+side*w*.44,h+.73,z+zz*d*.42,.35,.45,.35);
      }else{
        b.roof(roof,x,h+.36,z,w+.7,faction==='raven'?h*.8:h*.65,d+.7);
        b.rod(m.darkwood,[x-(w+.7)/2,h+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],[x,h*1.65+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],.075);
        b.rod(m.darkwood,[x+(w+.7)/2,h+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],[x,h*1.65+.35,z+(d+.7)/2],.075);
        b.box(m.darkwood,x,h*1.65+.38,z,.15,.15,d+.9);
      }
      for(const side of [-1,1]){
        for(const zz of [-.47,0,.47])b.box(m.darkwood,x+side*w*.505,h*.5+.38,z+zz*d,.12,h+.05,.14);
        for(const yy of [.6,h+.25])b.box(m.darkwood,x+side*w*.505,yy,z,.12,.14,d+.15);
        for(const zz of [-.23,.23]){
          b.box(m.wood,x+side*w*.52,h*.65,z+zz*d,.15,.88,.7);
          b.box(m.glass,x+side*w*.54,h*.65,z+zz*d,.025,.65,.5);

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {mergeGeometries} from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
    
    export function cargoGeometry(view,type){
      const parts=[],add=(geometry,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,angle=0)=>{const copy=geometry.clone();copy.scale(sx,sy,sz);copy.rotateZ(angle);copy.translate(x,y,z);parts.push(copy);};
      if(type==='wood')for(const [y,z]of [[-.08,-.07],[-.08,.07],[.08,0]])add(view.geo.cylinder,0,y,z,.08,.65,.08,Math.PI/2);
      else if(type==='gold')for(const [x,y]of [[-.13,-.08],[.13,-.08],[0,.06]])add(view.geo.box,x,y,0,.25,.12,.28);
      else if(type==='stone')for(const [x,y]of [[-.12,-.05],[.12,-.05],[0,.1]])add(view.geo.rock3d,x,y,0,.19,.17,.20);
      else add(view.geo.capsule,0,0,0,.43,.55,.42);
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();return result;
    }
    
    export class WorldInteractions {
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;this.group=new THREE.Group();this.group.name='3D world interactions';view.scene.add(this.group);this.dummy=new THREE.Object3D();this.cargo={};this.fell=new Set(view.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0).map(e=>e.id));view.treeFalls=new Map();
        for(const type of ['wood','food','gold','stone']){const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(cargoGeometry(view,type),view.materials[type==='food'?'canvas':type],512);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.userData.model3d={type:'cargo',resource:type,volumetric:true};this.cargo[type]=mesh;this.group.add(mesh);}
        this.stumps=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.27,.36,.32,8),view.materials.trunk,4096);this.stumps.count=0;this.stumps.frustumCulled=false;this.stumps.receiveShadow=true;this.stumps.userData.model3d={type:'stump',volumetric:true};this.group.add(this.stumps);
      }
      update(dt,menu){
        const v=this.view,counts={wood:0,food:0,gold:0,stone:0};let stumpCount=0;
        for(const e of v.sim.entities){
          if(e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0){
            if(!this.fell.has(e.id)){this.fell.add(e.id);if(v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)){v.treeFalls.set(e.id,{at:v.clock});v.forestRefresh=undefined;}}
            if(stumpCount<4096&&(menu||v.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){this.dummy.position.set(e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z)+.15,e.z);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,e.id*.7,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(1);this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.stumps.setMatrixAt(stumpCount++,this.dummy.matrix);}continue;
          }
          if(e.kind==='resource'&&['gold','stone'].includes(e.type)&&e.hp>0){const node=v.nodes.get(e.id);if(node)node.scale.setScalar(.48+.52*Math.min(1,e.amount/(e.initialAmount||Math.max(e.amount,1800))));}
          if(e.hp<=0||e.type!=='villager'||e.embarked)continue;
          const shown=menu||e.owner===0||v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z);if(!shown)continue;
          if(!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type)){const target=v.sim.get(e.order.target);if(target)e.heading=Math.atan2(target.x-e.x,target.z-e.z);}
          if(!e.carry||!this.cargo[e.carryType]||counts[e.carryType]>=512)continue;
          const heading=e.heading||0,x=e.renderX??e.x,z=e.renderZ??e.z;this.dummy.position.set(x-Math.sin(heading)*.42,v.entityHeight(e,x,z)+1.24,z-Math.cos(heading)*.42);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,heading,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(.72+.28*Math.min(1,e.carry/18));this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.cargo[e.carryType].setMatrixAt(counts[e.carryType]++,this.dummy.matrix);
        }
        for(const [id,fall]of v.treeFalls)if(v.clock-fall.at>1.7){v.treeFalls.delete(id);v.forestRefresh=undefined;}
        for(const type of Object.keys(counts)){this.cargo[type].count=counts[type];this.cargo[type].instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;}this.stumps.count=stumpCount;this.stumps.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
        v.interactionDiagnostics={cargo:counts,stumps:stumpCount,fallingTrees:v.treeFalls.size,drawCalls:Object.values(counts).filter(count=>count>0).length+(stumpCount?1:0)};
      }
      dispose(){for(const mesh of this.group.children){mesh.geometry.dispose();mesh.dispose();}this.group.removeFromParent();}
    }
    
    export function installWorldInteractions(WorldView){const p=WorldView.prototype,attach=p.attach,render=p.render;p.attach=function(sim){this.interactions?.dispose();attach.call(this,sim);this.interactions=new WorldInteractions(this);};p.render=function(dt,menu=false){this.interactions?.update(dt,menu);render.call(this,dt,menu);};}

## Assistant

I’m adding visible 3D feedback to the world: rooted trees with fuller canopies and snow-covered branches, stronger terrain relief, town-center changes as you advance ages, carried supplies on villagers, and falling trees that leave stumps.

I also found two old map-size limits in the graphics: grass covered only the middle strip of huge maps, and the fog mesh stopped short of the edges. Both are corrected.

    export function cargoGeometry(view,type){
      const parts=[],add=(geometry,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,angle=0)=>{const copy=geometry.clone();copy.scale(sx,sy,sz);copy.rotateZ(angle);copy.translate(x,y,z);parts.push(copy);};
      if(type==='wood')for(const [y,z]of [[-.08,-.07],[-.08,.07],[.08,0]])add(view.geo.cylinder,0,y,z,.08,.65,.08,Math.PI/2);
      else if(type==='gold')for(const [x,y]of [[-.13,-.08],[.13,-.08],[0,.06]])add(view.geo.box,x,y,0,.25,.12,.28);
      else if(type==='stone')for(const [x,y]of [[-.12,-.05],[.12,-.05],[0,.1]])add(view.geo.rock3d,x,y,0,.19,.17,.20);
      else add(view.geo.capsule,0,0,0,.43,.55,.42);
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();return result;
    }
    
    export class WorldInteractions {
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;this.group=new THREE.Group();this.group.name='3D world interactions';view.scene.add(this.group);this.dummy=new THREE.Object3D();this.cargo={};this.fell=new Set(view.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0).map(e=>e.id));view.treeFalls=new Map();
        for(const type of ['wood','food','gold','stone']){const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(cargoGeometry(view,type),view.materials[type==='food'?'canvas':type],512);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.userData.model3d={type:'cargo',resource:type,volumetric:true};this.cargo[type]=mesh;this.group.add(mesh);}
        this.stumps=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.27,.36,.32,8),view.materials.trunk,4096);this.stumps.count=0;this.stumps.frustumCulled=false;this.stumps.receiveShadow=true;this.stumps.userData.model3d={type:'stump',volumetric:true};this.group.add(this.stumps);
      }
      update(dt,menu){
        const v=this.view,counts={wood:0,food:0,gold:0,stone:0};let stumpCount=0;
        for(const e of v.sim.entities){
          if(e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0){
            if(!this.fell.has(e.id)){this.fell.add(e.id);if(v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)){v.treeFalls.set(e.id,{at:v.clock});v.forestRefresh=undefined;}}
            if(stumpCount<4096&&(menu||v.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){this.dummy.position.set(e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z)+.15,e.z);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,e.id*.7,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(1);this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.stumps.setMatrixAt(stumpCount++,this.dummy.matrix);}continue;
          }
          if(e.kind==='resource'&&['gold','stone'].includes(e.type)&&e.hp>0){const node=v.nodes.get(e.id);if(node)node.scale.setScalar(.48+.52*Math.min(1,e.amount/(e.initialAmount||Math.max(e.amount,1800))));}
          if(e.hp<=0||e.type!=='villager'||e.embarked)continue;
          const shown=menu||e.owner===0||v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z);if(!shown)continue;
          if(!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type)){const target=v.sim.get(e.order.target);if(target)e.heading=Math.atan2(target.x-e.x,target.z-e.z);}
          if(!e.carry||!this.cargo[e.carryType]||counts[e.carryType]>=512)continue;
          const heading=e.heading||0,x=e.renderX??e.x,z=e.renderZ??e.z;this.dummy.position.set(x-Math.sin(heading)*.42,v.entityHeight(e,x,z)+1.24,z-Math.cos(heading)*.42);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,heading,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(.72+.28*Math.min(1,e.carry/18));this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.cargo[e.carryType].setMatrixAt(counts[e.carryType]++,this.dummy.matrix);
        }
        for(const [id,fall]of v.treeFalls)if(v.clock-fall.at>1.7){v.treeFalls.delete(id);v.forestRefresh=undefined;}
        for(const type of Object.keys(counts)){this.cargo[type].count=counts[type];this.cargo[type].instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;}this.stumps.count=stumpCount;this.stumps.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
        v.interactionDiagnostics={cargo:counts,stumps:stumpCount,fallingTrees:v.treeFalls.size,drawCalls:Object.values(counts).filter(count=>count>0).length+(stumpCount?1:0)};
      }
      dispose(){for(const mesh of this.group.children){mesh.geometry.dispose();mesh.dispose();}this.group.removeFromParent();}
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import http from 'node:http';
    import WebSocket from 'ws';
    import {attachRooms} from '../server/rooms.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    class Inbox{
      constructor(ws){this.items=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),index=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(index>=0){const [waiter]=this.waiters.splice(index,1);clearTimeout(waiter.timer);waiter.resolve(message);}else this.items.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.items.findIndex(message=>message.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.items.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),8000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }
    async function fixture(t){const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});return {service,connect:async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`),inbox=new Inbox(ws);clients.push(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:message=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(message))};}};}
    const pause=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));
    
    test('eight human commanders ready, receive private team perspectives, reconnect, and win as an alliance',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),players=[],sessions=[],slots=battlePreset('4v4').map(slot=>({...slot,controller:'human'}));
      const host=await connect();players.push(host);host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');sessions.push(session);const code=session.code;
      for(let i=1;i<8;i++){const player=await connect();players.push(player);player.send({type:'join',name:`Commander ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],code});sessions.push(await player.inbox.next('session'));}
      host.send({type:'start'});assert.match((await host.inbox.next('error')).message,/ready/);
      for(const player of players)player.send({type:'ready',ready:true});while(!(await host.inbox.next('lobby')).canStart){}host.send({type:'start'});
      const beginnings=await Promise.all(players.map(player=>player.inbox.next('begin'))),room=service.rooms.get(code);assert.equal(room.sim.players.length,8);assert.equal(room.sim.worldSize,400);
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const state=beginnings[i].state;assert.equal(state.players[0].name,i===0?'Host':`Commander ${i+1}`);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length,9);assert.equal(state.visible.length,40000);
        assert.ok(state.players.slice(1).every(player=>Object.values(player.resources).every(value=>value===0)));assert.equal(state.aiStates,null);assert.equal(state.commanderAI,null);
        assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='unit'&&state.players[e.owner]?.team!==state.players[0].team).length,0);
      }
      const guest=players[7],own=room.sim.owned(7,'building','barracks')[0],enemy=room.sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[enemy.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(enemy.queue.length,0);
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[own.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(own.queue[0]?.type,'spearman');
      const state=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state;assert.ok(state.compactResources);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource').length,0);
      guest.ws.terminate();await pause(100);const stopped=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.equal(room.sim.time,stopped);
      const rejoined=await connect();rejoined.send({...sessions[7],type:'resume'});const resumed=(await rejoined.inbox.next('begin')).state;assert.equal(resumed.players[0].name,'Commander 8');assert.ok(resumed.entities.some(e=>e.id===own.id&&e.queue[0]?.type==='spearman'));
      // Host defeat is not the end of a multiplayer war: surviving teammates continue.
      room.sim.eliminateKingdom(0,'Test capital assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);
      for(let owner=4;owner<8;owner++)room.sim.eliminateKingdom(owner,'Test final assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended.winningTeam,1);
      const endedState=async inbox=>{let state;do{state=(await inbox.next('state')).state;}while(!state.ended);return state;};
      host.inbox.items=[];rejoined.inbox.items=[];const finalHost=await endedState(host.inbox),finalEnemy=await endedState(rejoined.inbox);assert.equal(finalHost.ended.won,true);assert.equal(finalEnemy.ended.won,false);
    });
    
    test('custom rooms mix humans and AI, preserve assigned slots, and treat leaving as a concession',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),slots=battlePreset('3v3');slots[4].controller='human';slots[1].difficulty='brutal';const host=await connect();host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',seed:601,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');
      const guest=await connect();guest.send({type:'join',name:'Guest',faction:'raven',slot:5,code:session.code});await guest.inbox.next('session');guest.send({type:'ready',ready:true});while(!(await host.inbox.next('lobby')).canStart){}host.send({type:'start'});await host.inbox.next('begin');await guest.inbox.next('begin');const room=service.rooms.get(session.code);
      assert.equal(room.players[1].side,4);assert.equal(room.sim.players[4].controller,'human');assert.equal(room.sim.players[1].controller,'ai');
      await pause(1800);assert.ok(room.sim.aiStates[1]?.decision>=1);assert.equal(room.sim.aiStates[4],undefined);
      guest.send({type:'leave'});await pause(100);assert.equal(room.sim.players[4].defeated,true);assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);const before=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.ok(room.sim.time>before);
    });
    # Version 2.4 verification
    
    Checked 10 October 2026. This records observed checks, rather than a claim that all possible bugs or all device configurations have been ruled out.
    
    ## Automated game checks
    
    `npm test`: **102 passed, zero failed**. Coverage includes paid gathering/construction/training/research; ages and civilization restrictions; counters, healing and siege; walls, gates and bridges; fleets and transports; all modes and staged campaigns; checkpoints and save compatibility; production batches; custom alliances, large-map fog/navigation/picking, each victory rule, independent AI clocks, seeded weather, and real WebSocket rooms.
    
    Eight simultaneous real WebSocket clients exercised readiness, private economies and fog, command ownership, reconnect recovery, host elimination and alliance results. Mixed human/AI rooms also passed. These tests use isolated services and do not modify live player rooms.
    
    ## Custom battle and 3D checks
    
    `scripts/custom-battle-qa.mjs` passed in a real Edge renderer with desktop and emulated landscape-phone layouts:
    
    - Huge 400 Ã— 400 battlefield, eight kingdoms, independent AI difficulty and eight army materials.
    - Actual terrain clicks beyond the former Â±160 picking limit and full-map radar navigation.
    - Deferred unseen-mesh allocation, persistent objective scrolling/rules, and custom save/resume with a paid training queue.
    - Volumetric rain with three effect draw calls; quality-limited snow, weather settings and optional lightning.
    - Square minimap, touch interaction and no horizontal page overflow at 844 Ã— 390.
    
    `scripts/custom-multiplayer-qa.mjs` passed with desktop and phone-sized browsers, a third real WebSocket commander and an AI kingdom: guest slot choice, host/guest readiness, private local perspectives, rejected foreign commands, phone production, reload/rejoin, host defeat without ending the match, and correct alliance victory/defeat.
    
    The machine reports approximately 4 GB RAM. Running three simultaneous 3D browser contexts exceeded the practical test budget and timed out without a JavaScript error; the mixed-room browser test runs two graphics clients plus a protocol client. This is not an eight-device FPS measurement.
    
    ## Full-match diagnostic
    
    `scripts/battle-benchmark.mjs`, seed 512, Huge highlands, eight Hard AI kingdoms, standard resources and an 80-person cap:
    
    - Started with the normal economy. The diagnostic alone assigned AI control to the normal human slot.
    - All kingdoms reached Imperial Age. The winning alliance eliminated every opposing building through normal production and combat, finishing at **977.4 simulated seconds** (about 16 minutes).
    - CPU-only simulation tick times: median **10.44 ms**, p95 **21.24 ms**, p99 **30.10 ms**, maximum **65.68 ms** on this run. These are simulation timings, not rendered FPS or phone timings.
    - An earlier pre-optimization match also reached a normal result after about 29 simulated minutes. Battle length is situational, without a forced minimum timer.
    
    Recorded artifacts include `artifacts/battle-benchmark-highlands.json`, the earlier baseline/pre-route-cache reports, custom browser JSON reports and screenshots.
    
    ## Corrections made during the audit
    
    Corrected outer-map picking, resource/harbor overlap, coastal resource access, final-load delivery after deposits/shoals are exhausted, sustained AI attack orders, final-building visibility for AI, naval boarding reservations, individual AI ownership/budgets, private research/error notices and objective scroll resets. Added straight-route checks, connected movement regions, reusable path buffers, valid-route retention, blocked-order retry limits, vision indexing and shared composition calculations. Low quality and background/menu rendering budgets reduce work; saved graphics preferences remain respected.
    
    ## Further release evidence
    
    All eight broader browser regressions passed: edge scrolling, square radar, production, commander controls/tactics/technology tree, campaign checkpoint flows, solid 3D models across biomes, offline reload/play, and custom multiplayer. The report is `artifacts/release-browser-checks.json`. The running server was restarted with the final source after verifying that no player connections were active; its HTTP version 2.4 bundle and WebSocket ping passed at the laptop and Wi-Fi address. See `artifacts/live-server-check.json`.
    
    Physical phone/laptop FPS, sustained thermal/memory behavior, human balance and mission pacing, and delayed/lossy network play still need independent testing. Public matchmaking, persistent server rooms, accounts, professional authored assets and voice acting are outside this implemented local release. The game is an original playable RTS beta; commercial AAA parity or â€œ100% world classâ€ has not been established.

      else if(kind==='roof'){for(let y=0;y<256;y+=22){ctx.fillStyle='#fff4';ctx.fillRect(0,y,256,2);ctx.fillStyle='#384e4435';ctx.fillRect(0,y+18,256,4);for(let x=0;x<256;x+=26){ctx.fillStyle='#354c4422';ctx.fillRect(x+(y%44?13:0),y,1,22);}}}

      const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.anisotropy=4;return t;
    }

    function jointAngle(view,m,e){
      const phase=view.clock*8.5+e.id*.7,walk=Math.sin(phase)*m.side;
      if(m.type==='wheel')return e.moving?view.clock*5:0;
      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm')return e.moving?-.15:0;
      if(m.type==='arm'){
        if(e.type==='villager'&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type||e.activity)&&!e.moving)return -.5+Math.sin(view.clock*6)*.55;
        if(e.cooldown>.45)return -.3-Math.sin((1.2-e.cooldown)*5)*.75;
        return e.moving?walk*.3:0;
      }
      return 0;
    }

    export function visibilityFor(sim,owner,explored,observer=false){
      const size=sim.gridSize,visible=new Uint8Array(size*size);
      if(observer){visible.fill(1);explored.fill(1);return visible;}
      const reveal=(e,r)=>{const c=sim.cell(e.x,e.z),rc=Math.ceil(r/2);for(let z=Math.max(0,c.z-rc);z<=Math.min(size-1,c.z+rc);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,c.x-rc);x<=Math.min(size-1,c.x+rc);x++)if(Math.hypot(x-c.x,z-c.z)<=rc){visible[z*size+x]=1;explored[z*size+x]=1;}};
      for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.hp>0&&!e.embarked&&(e.owner===owner||sim.options.mode==='custom'&&sim.options.shareVision&&sim.allied(owner,e.owner))){if(e.kind==='unit')reveal(e,UNITS[e.type].vision);else if(e.kind==='building'&&e.progress>0)reveal(e,BUILDINGS[e.type].vision||18);else if(e.kind==='shrine')reveal(e,18);}
      for(const side of sim.revealedOwners||[])for(const e of sim.owned(side,'building'))reveal(e,e.r+4);
      return visible;
    }

    # Crowns of the Frontier
    
    An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.4, **Kingdoms and skies**, adds custom battles with up to eight kingdoms, configurable human/AI slots, allies and enemies, independent AI difficulties, spacious maps, team multiplayer, and changing 3D weather. Staged campaigns, checkpoints, naval warfare, civilization-exclusive troops and upgrades, a technology tree, solid world models, elevated terrain, and landscape phone controls remain available.
    
    ## Play
    
    ```powershell
    npm install
    npm run build
    npm start
    ```
    
    Open **http://localhost:4173** on the laptop. On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, open **http://YOUR_LAPTOP_WIFI_IP:4173**. Landscape is recommended. The laptop must keep the game server running. If the phone cannot reach it, check that the local network permits connections to port 4173.
    
    For development, `npm run dev` serves on port 5173. Use `npm start` for Wi-Fi multiplayer; the static Vite preview server does not host rooms.
    
    ### Play with a friend
    
    Both players open the same laptop's game URL. Choose **Play with a friend over Wi-Fi**, enter a commander name, then create or join a room. Share the six-character room code with the second player. The host starts once both players join. Conquest, regicide, shrine control, wonder race, and naval conquest are supported.
    
    The server runs the simulation and checks command ownership. Each player sees their own economy and fog of war. Classic two-player rooms receive mirrored starting towns and armies. If a connection drops, the match pauses for a reconnect grace period of two minutes. Refreshing the page preserves a room credential in session storage; choose **Rejoin your previous network session**. The menu does not pause an otherwise connected network match. Leaving a started match concedes that kingdom. Restarting the laptop server ends its in-memory rooms.
    
    ### Custom battles with AI or real people
    
    Choose **Custom battle**. Enable two to eight kingdoms, set their civilizations and team numbers, and choose a difficulty for each AI. Matching team numbers are allies. Presets include 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, 1v3, and four/eight-way free-for-all. Without other people, all remaining enabled kingdoms are AI, including your allies.
    
    **Huge** is the default: a 400 Ã— 400 battlefield, 6.25 times the area of a classic map. Large is 320 Ã— 320 and Spacious is 240 Ã— 240. Choose any of the seven biomes, a seed, starting age, starting resources, population cap, shared allied vision, and victory rule. Coast battles begin in at least the Feudal Age and include harbors, fishing boats and transports.
    
    The default victory rule is **destroy all opposing buildings**, including walls and unfinished foundations. Losing a capital alone does not eliminate a kingdom; surviving villagers can rebuild. Other rules require the last town center to fall, or require every opposing unit and building to be defeated. The final few buildings can be revealed after a capital falls to help finish the war. Battles develop through real paid gathering, construction, upgrades and armies; their length depends on the battle rather than a forced minimum timer.
    
    For real people, choose **Human slot** for each friend and **Host multiplayer battle**. Friends join using the room code and can choose an available Human slot. Every human must be connected and ready before the host starts; AI slots are ready automatically. Human and AI kingdoms can fight together or against each other. A defeated host can watch surviving allies, and the match continues until one alliance remains. Each client receives its own command perspective and private economy.
    
    ### Weather and graphics
    
    Automatic weather changes from clear skies to clouds, rain or storms; Winterwood can receive snow, and the desert is drier. Rain, snow, clouds and splash rings use 3D meshes with pooled instances. Weather changes atmosphere without altering resource or combat rules. Settings provide automatic or forced weather, independent weather audio, and optional lightning flashes; reduced motion disables flashes.
    
    Low quality limits active rendering to 30 FPS and reduces particles, shadows and detail. When the browser reports at most 4 GB of memory or four processor threads, a fresh installation starts on Low; saved quality choices take precedence. Menus and hidden tabs render less often, and hidden world objects defer mesh allocation until revealed. These are performance budgets, not guarantees for every device. Start with Low quality and 80 population per kingdom on phones.
    
    Start with **First light**, the guided tutorial. Use **Clash of crowns** for a standard match. **Legendary** difficulty offers early attacks and relentless pressure. The game runs locally; it does not require an account.
    
    ## Included gameplay
    
    - **Nine modes:** tutorial, conquest skirmish, regicide, ten-wave survival, shrine control, monument race, peaceful sandbox, naval conquest, and configurable custom battles.
    - **Six campaign chapters:** settlement, river crossing, fortress defense, sacred valley, final siege, and a coastal invasion. All chapters can be played immediately. Each has three staged objectives, an original dialogue journal, an optional completion goal, and checkpoints. The river chapter requires a protected caravan escort; shrine control supports an alternative conquest route, and the coastal chapter supports landings or naval artillery.
    - **Seven seeded maps:** Emerald highlands, river crossing, sunlit steppe, Winterwood, iron frontier, twin rivers, and the divided coast. Seeds reproduce resource layouts. Bridges create movement chokepoints; winter has additional timber, the iron frontier has contested central ore, and the coast requires fleets or transports.
    - **Three original civilizations:** Alder Kingdom (durability), Sunward Sultanate (economy and construction), Raven Clans (cavalry).
    - **Four difficulties:** Explorer, Commander, Conqueror, Legendary. Difficulty changes enemy decision and attack timing; survival also changes wave strength.
    - **19 buildings:** town center, house, farm, mill, lumber camp, mining camp, barracks, archery range, stable, siege workshop, blacksmith, market, watchtower, castle, stone wall, gatehouse, monastery, grand monument, and harbor.
    - **16 trainable unit types across the catalog:** villager, scout, spearman, archer, man-at-arms, knight, battering ram, trebuchet, healer, fishing boat, galley, siege galleon, and transport, plus civilization-exclusive Alder sentinels, Sunward marksmen, and Raven outriders. Each civilization has access to its own exclusive troop. Regicide adds an irreplaceable sovereign for each side.
    - **Four ages** with population limits, paid training queues, rally points, age requirements, automatic age strength improvements, and queue cancellation refunds.
    - **Ten technology families across the catalog:** gathering tools, melee attack, armor, ranged attack, fortification, cavalry speed, and seamanship, plus civilization-exclusive Shield drill, Caravan ledger, and Raiding parties. Research levels have age requirements and increasing costs.
    - Harbors must be built near a shore. Fishing boats collect fish and return their catch to a harbor. Command land troops onto a friendly transport to embark up to eight passengers; select the transport, choose **Unload**, and select nearby open land. Sinking a transport defeats its passengers. Siege galleons can bombard shoreline defenses.
    - Villagers physically walk between resources and drop-off buildings, carry supplies, construct buildings, and repair damage. Farms provide renewable food. Mines and trees deplete. Markets buy and sell resources for gold.
    - Walls block paths; friendly units can pass through gates. Connected walls support queued construction. Construction can be canceled for a 70% resource refund; finished buildings can be demolished for a 20% refund. Your last town center is protected from accidental demolition.
    - Unit counters, splash siege damage, automatic healing, defensive towers, formations, aggressive/hold stances, queued orders, box selection, type selection, numbered control groups, and visible selected-unit attributes.
    - Enemy AI responds to visible threats, repairs damaged buildings, reinforces counters against observed unit types, escorts attacks with healers, and runs a fishing and transport economy on the coastal map.
    - Articulated walking, weapon motion, working villagers, rocking ships, ship wakes, drifting water textures, textured masonry and wood, gabled roofs, and biome-specific foliage. Hidden forests obey exploration. Battle audio includes impact layers, arrows, siege sounds, stereo placement, wind, birds, and ambient music, with bounded effects and audio voices.
    - Closer perspective cameras, selectable close/perspective/overview angles, mouse and touch rotation, surface relief, directional lighting, sharper camera-centered shadows, timber framing, window recesses, and shared instanced contact shadows that remain available in Performance quality.
    - All 19 building types and all 18 character/ship types (16 trainable across the catalog, the sovereign, and a campaign supply caravan) have solid mesh models. Buildings use arches, domes, gables, piers, fences, turrets, grain stalks, and distinct workshops. Human models have faces, shaped torsos, jointed limbs, held tools and weapons; cavalry adds modeled horses, and siege equipment has moving wheels and mechanisms. Trees, ore deposits, fruit, fish, and shrines also use mesh geometry.
    - All seven maps have seeded rolling terrain and surrounding ridges. Picking, walking, building foundations, effects, previews, and fog follow the surface. Bridges stay dry and naval channels have submerged beds. Water has moving vertices and updated normals. Nearby gate portcullises lift for friendly troops.
    - Selection portraits render the actual model as a live WebGL turntable. Tap/click the portrait, or press **I**, to inspect the selected object. The square camera button hides or restores battlefield panels for an unobstructed view.
    - Fog of war, exploration, a working minimap, mission objectives, victory/defeat screens, match statistics, synthesized audio, pause, game speed, local saves, and campaign completion tracking.
    - Landscape-first touch interface, pinch zoom, drag pan, responsive menus, graphics presets, and automatic rendering resolution adjustment.
    
    ## Controls
    
    These are the default keyboard bindings. Settings lets you remap controls with conflict checks; Escape, Tab, and numbered control groups stay reserved. Custom bindings, higher-contrast UI, reduced decorative motion, and order-route preferences are saved on this device.
    
    | Action | Laptop | Phone/tablet |
    |---|---|---|
    | Select | Left click; Shift adds; drag a selection box | Tap a unit or building |
    | Command | Right click; Shift queues | Select units, then tap ground, enemies, or resources |
    | Pan | Mouse at the game-window edges/corners, WASD/arrows, or middle-button drag | Drag the battlefield |
    | Zoom | Mouse wheel | Two-finger pinch |
    | Rotate | Q/E or camera arrow buttons | Two-finger twist or camera arrow buttons |
    | Camera angle | V or the camera view button | Camera view button |
    | Inspect selected model | I or selection portrait | Tap selection portrait |
    | Hide/show panels | Square camera button | Square camera button |
    | Center town | H or minimap home | Minimap home button |
    | Radar navigation | Click or drag the square minimap | Tap or drag the square minimap |
    | Production overview | P or top-bar P button | Top-bar P button |
    | Queue five troops | Shift-click a troop; +5 in building groups | +5 in building groups |
    | Select army | M | Army button |
    | Idle villagers | Period | Idle button |
    | Construct | B | Build button |
    | Attack move | F, then click | Attack button, then tap |
    | Stop / hold | X | Stop button |
    | Patrol | R, then click a destination | Select military units, tap Patrol, then a destination |
    | Guard | G, then click a friendly unit/building | Select military units, tap Guard, then an ally |
    | Groups | Ctrl + 1â€“9 assigns; 1â€“9 recalls | Army/type selection buttons |
    | Focus selection | Space | Tap minimap to navigate |
    | Pause | Esc | Pause button |
    
    Choose **Stone wall** and drag across visible, open land to place a connected line. Use **Shift** to keep other construction tools active. Select a completed military building to train troops, a blacksmith to research combat technologies, or the town center to advance ages. Use the in-game **Field guide** for costs and counters.
    
    Mouse edge scrolling is enabled by default. Bring the cursor into the outer 24 pixels of the game window to pan; corners pan diagonally and a directional arrow appears. Scrolling follows the rotated camera, stops outside the game or during menus/pauses, and avoids controls. **Settings** includes an on/off toggle and speed slider. Touch gestures continue to pan and zoom. Fullscreen lets you use the monitor edges.
    
    The square minimap acts as your battlefield radar. Its outlined rectangle encloses the ground within the camera view, and its center dot marks where the camera is aimed. The locator remains rectangular at map edges and follows rotation and zoom. Right-click the minimap to give selected units orders; commands outside the playable battlefield are ignored.
    
    Open **Production** with **P** or the top-bar button to see your completed production/research buildings, active queues, progress, and idle sites. Tap a building to select and locate it, or choose its type to select several. Troop orders across selected buildings go to the shortest available queue. Use **+5** or Shift-click to request a batch, limited by resources, population, ages, and queue capacity. Tap queued items to cancel and refund them. Research and age advancement also appear in the overview.

    # Kingdoms and skies (version 2.4)
    
    - Configurable custom battles with two to eight kingdoms, human or AI slots, civilizations, teams, individual AI difficulties and six team/free-for-all presets.
    - Huge 400 Ã— 400 maps by default, plus 320 Ã— 320 and 240 Ã— 240 options. Navigation, fog, terrain picking, camera limits, minimap and rendering support the larger battlefield and eight army colors.
    - Default victory requires all opposing buildings, including walls and foundations. Optional capital and total-conquest rules, capital rebuilding, public final-building markers, alliance results and defeat spectating.
    - Authoritative mixed human/AI multiplayer, slot choice, readiness gating, per-team visibility, private economies, ownership, compressed compact snapshots, disconnect pauses, reconnect recovery and concessions that preserve surviving teams.
    - Seeded weather transitions, volumetric rain/snow/clouds and splash rings, wet terrain/light changes, optional lightning, independent weather audio, reduced-motion support and quality budgets.
    - Sustained AI attacks across large maps, independent planning, remembered-target cleanup and paid market trade for shortages. AI gathers and pays for armies, buildings and upgrades.
    - Physical tree/ore navigation and construction obstacles, final-load delivery after resources run out, cached vision/movement regions, valid-route retention and bounded blocked-path retries.
    - Low quality renders at up to 30 FPS; menu and hidden-tab rendering is throttled. Fresh settings choose Low on modest reported hardware, and unseen objects defer mesh allocation. Real-device FPS and balance remain separate release validation requirements.
    - Expanded automated, browser and long-match diagnostics cover custom setup, eight real WebSocket clients, phone layouts, weather, ownership, reconnects, alliances, late-game progression and full-building elimination.
    
    # Movement display update
    
    - Removed selected-unit movement and queued-route lines on desktop and phones, including the route-display setting. Movement, patrol, guard, and queued commands remain available.
    
    # Frontier chronicles (version 2.3)
    
    - Three staged objectives per campaign chapter, original dialogue journals, optional medals, and active minimap/3D goal markers.
    - Supply-caravan mesh model and guarded river escort with an explicit loss condition. Select-caravan and locate-goal controls are available in the objective panel.
    - Frozen initial and stage checkpoints, commander-menu and defeat-screen recovery, local save/resume, and legacy rules for existing campaign saves.
    - Settlement, fortress, shrine-control/conquest, siege-breach, and coastal landing/artillery chapter flows. Fishing objectives count deposited boat catch.
    - Objective updates preserve scrolling/focus and expose interactive controls without triggering camera edge scrolling. Phone recovery controls and compact technology-tree layouts receive browser coverage.
    - Exact waypoint arrival and island-aware naval regrouping reduce the coastal diagnostic run from 74 blocked orders to four. Remaining bridge/crowding cases still need review.
    - Regression coverage includes normal economy/production, real escort navigation, shrine holding, paid naval artillery, actual gate attacks, actor loss, and checkpoint recovery.
    
    This continues the playable beta roadmap. External balance and mission-pacing tests, real-device rendering performance, richer authored assets/audio, public online operations, and overall world-class parity remain unfinished.
    
    # Commanders and kingdoms (version 2.2)
    
    - Saved remappable keys with conflict/reserved-key validation, updated shortcut labels, and active bindings in Help.
    - Patrol/guard orders, network ownership checks, queued-order summaries, and bounded 3D route previews. Routes follow terrain and stay visible above water for ships.
    - Legal formation destinations, correct partial-path arrival checks, blocked-order feedback/recovery, axis sliding near obstacles, and safer automatic naval target selection.
    - Paid strategic AI with planned economy/production, observed enemy memory, counters, age-resource reserves, repairs, retreats, healer escorts, scouting, and transport boarding reservations.
    - Alder sentinels, Sunward marksmen, and Raven outriders with solid 3D model variants, costs, prerequisites, and counters. Shield drill, Caravan ledger, and Raiding parties add civilization-specific research.
    - Interactive technology tree with faction comparison and eligible training/research. Older saves initialize added research fields.
    - Higher-contrast interface, reduced decorative motion, larger tactical touch controls, and saved route preferences.
    - Expanded simulation, graphics, control, strategy, save, and real-WebSocket regression coverage. New commander browser and passive-player AI soak scripts write reviewable artifacts.
    
    This is a tested development milestone. Public matchmaking, replay/spectator services, richer authored campaigns, production-quality assets/audio, measured physical-device targets, independent balance testing, and overall world-class parity remain unverified or unfinished. Naval blocked-order cases remain under review.

    export class LanClient {
      constructor(callbacks){this.callbacks=callbacks;this.active=false;this.retry=0;this.socket=null;this.ping=0;this.session=null;try{this.session=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('crowns-lan'));}catch{};}
      connect(message){this.intent=message;this.leaving=false;this.socket=new WebSocket(`${location.protocol==='https:'?'wss:':'ws:'}//${location.host}/socket`);
        this.socket.addEventListener('open',()=>{this.retry=0;this.send(message);clearInterval(this.pinger);this.pinger=setInterval(()=>this.send({type:'ping',stamp:Date.now()}),3000);});
        this.socket.addEventListener('message',event=>{const data=JSON.parse(event.data);if(data.type==='session'){this.session={code:data.code,token:data.token};try{sessionStorage.setItem('crowns-lan',JSON.stringify(this.session));}catch{}}
          if(data.type==='lobby')this.callbacks.lobby(data);
          if(data.type==='begin'){this.active=true;this.code=data.code;this.callbacks.begin(data.state);}
          if(data.type==='state')this.callbacks.state(data.state,data.effects,data.waiting);
          if(data.type==='error'){if(!this.active&&this.intent?.type==='resume'){this.session=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem('crowns-lan');}catch{}}this.callbacks.notice(data.message);}
          if(data.type==='closed'){this.leave();this.callbacks.notice(data.message);}
          if(data.type==='pong')this.ping=Date.now()-data.stamp;
        });
        this.socket.addEventListener('close',()=>{clearInterval(this.pinger);if(this.leaving)return;this.callbacks.notice('Connection interrupted. The match waits while you reconnect.');if(this.session&&this.retry++<8)setTimeout(()=>this.connect({type:'resume',...this.session}),2000);});
        this.socket.addEventListener('error',()=>this.callbacks.notice('Multiplayer needs the game server. Start with npm start, then use the same Wi-Fi link.'));
      }
      send(message){if(this.socket?.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN)this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));}
      action(method,args){const normalized=args.map(arg=>arg?.id!==undefined?arg.id:arg);this.send({type:'action',method,args:normalized});return true;}
      bind(sim){for(const method of ['build','train','research','cancelQueue','trade','smartCommand','stop','unload','demolish','assignWorker','patrol','guard','setStance','resign'])sim[method]=(...args)=>{if(['smartCommand','patrol','guard'].includes(method))sim.emit('order',{order:{}});return this.action(method,args);};}
      leave(){this.leaving=true;this.active=false;this.send({type:'leave'});this.socket?.close();clearInterval(this.pinger);this.session=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem('crowns-lan');}catch{}}
    }

    const server=http.createServer((request,response)=>{try{const pathname=decodeURIComponent(new URL(request.url,'http://localhost').pathname);const file=path.resolve(root,'.'+(pathname==='/'?'/index.html':pathname));if(!file.startsWith(root+path.sep)||!fs.existsSync(file)||!fs.statSync(file).isFile()){response.writeHead(404);response.end('Not found');return;}response.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(file)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':file.includes(path.sep+'assets'+path.sep)?'public, max-age=31536000, immutable':'no-cache'});fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(response);}catch{response.writeHead(400);response.end('Invalid request');}});
    const rooms=attachRooms(server),port=Number(process.env.PORT)||4173;server.listen(port,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log(`Crowns of the Frontier Â· http://localhost:${port} Â· Wi-Fi multiplayer enabled`));

    export default defineConfig({
      build:{rollupOptions:{output:{manualChunks:{three:['three']}}}},

        const assets=fs.readdirSync('dist/assets').map(f=>'/assets/'+f);
        const fonts=fs.existsSync('dist/fonts')?fs.readdirSync('dist/fonts').map(f=>'/fonts/'+f):[];
        const version='frontier-'+assets.join('').split('').reduce((a,c)=>(a*31+c.charCodeAt(0))>>>0,0);
        const source=fs.readFileSync('scripts/sw-template.js','utf8').replace('__CACHE__',JSON.stringify(version)).replace('__FILES__',JSON.stringify(['/', '/index.html','/manifest.webmanifest','/icon.svg',...assets,...fonts]));
        new Script(source,{filename:'sw.js'});
        fs.writeFileSync('dist/sw.js',source);
      }}],
    });

    export function multiplayerEndpoint(page,configured='',staticHost=false){
      if(!configured){if(staticHost)return null;return `${page.protocol==='https:'?'wss:':'ws:'}//${page.host}/socket`;}
      const url=new URL(configured);if(url.username||url.password||url.hash||url.search)throw new Error('Use a multiplayer server URL without credentials or query parameters.');
      if(url.protocol==='https:')url.protocol='wss:';else if(url.protocol==='http:')url.protocol='ws:';
      if(!['ws:','wss:'].includes(url.protocol)||page.protocol==='https:'&&url.protocol!=='wss:')throw new Error('This site requires a secure multiplayer server URL (wss://).');
      if(url.pathname==='/')url.pathname='/socket';return url.href;
    }

    # Free deployment
    
    Use **Render Free Web Service** for the simplest complete deployment: one URL serves the game and its real-person multiplayer rooms. The included [render.yaml](render.yaml) fills in the build, start, free plan, and health-check settings.
    
    1. Put this project in its own GitHub repository, with `package.json` and `render.yaml` at the root. Do not upload `node_modules`, test artifacts, or local `.env` files.
    2. Sign in to Render, select **New > Blueprint**, and connect that repository.
    3. Confirm that the service plan is **Free**, then deploy. Share the resulting HTTPS `onrender.com` address with players. No separate multiplayer URL or database is needed.
    
    If using **New > Web Service** instead, choose Node, the Free plan, build command `npm ci --include=dev && npm run build`, start command `npm start`, and health-check path `/health`. The server reads Render's `PORT` automatically. Use one instance because rooms are currently kept in memory.
    
    The web-service free tier uses recurring monthly allowances, rather than a fixed trial expiry. It provides 750 instance hours per workspace each month, sleeps after 15 idle minutes, and takes about a minute to wake. Active incoming WebSocket messages count as traffic. Free services can restart, ending live rooms; local single-player saves stay in the player's browser. Bandwidth and build limits also apply. Keep the Free plan and avoid adding a payment method if you want services suspended at chargeable usage limits instead of overage billing. No database is provisioned, so the separate 30-day free database expiry does not apply. Provider terms may change.
    
    This is a free hobby/testing deployment, with limited server CPU. Eight large kingdoms or many simultaneous rooms require hosted performance validation. Free hosting does not establish unlimited capacity or uninterrupted public-game service.
    
    Sources checked 10 October 2026: [free-tier limits](https://render.com/docs/free), [WebSocket support](https://render.com/docs/websocket), [Blueprint configuration](https://render.com/docs/blueprint-spec).
    
    ## Optional Netlify frontend
    
    Netlify can host solo/AI gameplay with the included [netlify.toml](netlify.toml): build `npm run build`, publish `dist`. A static-only build reports that online multiplayer is unavailable while solo modes continue working.
    
    To enable multiplayer from Netlify, set `VITE_MULTIPLAYER_URL=wss://YOUR_RENDER_SERVICE.onrender.com/socket` in the Netlify build environment. On the separate Node service, set `ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://YOUR_SITE.netlify.app`. Add any custom frontend domain as another comma-separated exact origin, then rebuild/redeploy the frontend. These are public endpoint settings, not credentials. HTTPS sites require secure `wss://` connections.
    
    Netlify's build command and output directory follow its [official Vite guide](https://docs.netlify.com/build/frameworks/framework-setup-guides/vite/). The existing authoritative Node simulation remains a running web service; it is not executed by uploading `dist` to a static host.

    import test from 'node:test';

    test('single-service and static-host deployment resolve appropriate secure multiplayer endpoints',()=>{
      assert.equal(multiplayerEndpoint({protocol:'http:',host:'192.168.1.6:4173'}),'ws://192.168.1.6:4173/socket');
      const page={protocol:'https:',host:'crowns.onrender.com'};assert.equal(multiplayerEndpoint(page),'wss://crowns.onrender.com/socket');assert.equal(multiplayerEndpoint(page,'',true),null);
      assert.equal(multiplayerEndpoint(page,'https://battle.example.com'),'wss://battle.example.com/socket');assert.equal(multiplayerEndpoint(page,'wss://battle.example.com/socket',true),'wss://battle.example.com/socket');
      for(const url of ['ws://battle.example.com/socket','https://user:pass@battle.example.com','ftp://battle.example.com','https://battle.example.com/?secret=1'])assert.throws(()=>multiplayerEndpoint(page,url));
    });
    
    test('external frontends require exact configured origins rather than a wildcard',()=>{
      const allow=['https://crowns.netlify.app'];assert.ok(originAllowed('https://crowns.netlify.app','server.onrender.com',allow));assert.ok(originAllowed('https://server.onrender.com','server.onrender.com',allow));assert.ok(originAllowed(undefined,'localhost:4173',allow));
      for(const value of ['https://evil.netlify.app','https://crowns.netlify.app.evil.example','null','file://server.onrender.com','https://crowns.netlify.app/path'])assert.equal(originAllowed(value,'server.onrender.com',allow),false);
    });
    
    test('a real cross-origin WebSocket frontend connects only when explicitly allowed',async t=>{
      const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server,{allowedOrigins:['https://crowns.netlify.app']}),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));t.after(async()=>{clients.forEach(ws=>ws.terminate());service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});
      const endpoint=`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`,good=new WebSocket(endpoint,{origin:'https://crowns.netlify.app'});clients.push(good);await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{good.once('open',resolve);good.once('error',reject);});
      const pong=new Promise(resolve=>good.once('message',raw=>resolve(JSON.parse(raw))));good.send(JSON.stringify({type:'ping',stamp:42}));assert.deepEqual(await pong,{type:'pong',stamp:42});
      const bad=new WebSocket(endpoint,{origin:'https://unapproved.netlify.app'});clients.push(bad);const denied=await new Promise(resolve=>{bad.once('open',()=>resolve(false));bad.once('error',()=>resolve(true));});assert.ok(denied);

    const clamp=(sim,n)=>Math.max(-sim.halfWorld+3,Math.min(sim.halfWorld-3,n));
    
    // Resolve formation slots on the unit's own movement surface. This keeps edge
    // slots out of foundations and water without sending land troops across a sea.
    export function formationSlot(sim,unit,point){
      const size=sim.gridSize,half=sim.halfWorld,grid=sim.grid(unit.owner,!!UNITS[unit.type].naval),cell=sim.cell(point.x,point.z);
      if(!grid[cell.z*size+cell.x])return {x:clamp(sim,point.x),z:clamp(sim,point.z)};
      let best=null,score=Infinity;
      for(let r=1;r<=4;r++)for(let z=Math.max(0,cell.z-r);z<=Math.min(size-1,cell.z+r);z++)for(let x=Math.max(0,cell.x-r);x<=Math.min(size-1,cell.x+r);x++){
        if(grid[z*size+x])continue;const wx=x*2-half+1,wz=z*2-half+1,s=Math.hypot(wx-point.x,wz-point.z)+Math.hypot(wx-unit.x,wz-unit.z)*.03;
        if(s<score){score=s;best={x:wx,z:wz};}
      }return best||{x:clamp(sim,point.x),z:clamp(sim,point.z)};
    }
    
    export function installTactics(Simulation){
      const p=Simulation.prototype;
      p.patrol=function(ids,x,z,append=false,owner=0){
        if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(z))return false;
        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===owner&&e.kind==='unit'&&!e.embarked&&!['worker','fisher'].includes(UNITS[e.type].role));
        for(const e of units){const target=formationSlot(this,e,{x,z});this.command([e.id],{type:'patrol',...target,originX:e.x,originZ:e.z},append);}
        return units.length>0;
      };
      p.guard=function(ids,targetId,append=false,owner=0){
        const target=this.get(targetId);if(!target||!this.allied(target.owner,owner)||!['unit','building'].includes(target.kind))return false;
        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===owner&&e.kind==='unit'&&e!==target&&!e.embarked&&!['worker','fisher'].includes(UNITS[e.type].role));
        units.forEach((e,i)=>this.command([e.id],{type:'guard',target:target.id,offsetX:Math.cos(i*2.4)*(target.r+3),offsetZ:Math.sin(i*2.4)*(target.r+3)},append));
        return units.length>0;
      };
      p.setStance=function(ids,stance,owner=0){
        if(!['hold','aggressive'].includes(stance))return false;
        const units=ids.map(id=>this.get(id)).filter(e=>e?.owner===owner&&e.kind==='unit');
        for(const e of units){e.stance=stance;if(stance==='hold'){e.order=null;e.orders=[];e.path=[];e.pathStatus='idle';e.stuckTime=0;}}
        return units.length>0;
      };
    }

The coastal match exposed another issue: land recruitment could fill the population cap and leave no room to replace lost ships. I’ve reserved fleet capacity and adjusted transports to gather fuller crews, including siege units.

Visual inspection also flagged cargo that appeared detached from villagers. I’m checking its position against the rendered character positions before accepting that change.
