    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 10 October 2026 against the version 2.4 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.
    
    ## Version 2.4 custom-battle progress
    
    - The requested AI and real-human battle configurations are implemented separately in one custom setup. Solo configurations convert the other enabled slots to AI; multiplayer preserves Human slots and allows AI kingdoms alongside them.
    - Huge maps, eight kingdoms, allied gates/healing/shared vision, independent AI economies and planning clocks, capital rebuilding, all-building elimination, optional conquest/capital rules and team victory are implemented.
    - Multiplayer checks include eight real WebSocket participants, private economies and fog, ownership, mixed AI/humans, guest slot choice, readiness, concessions, host defeat, reconnect and winning/losing alliance perspectives.
    - Resource exhaustion, unreachable routes, outer-map picking and private completion notices were corrected during the audit. Cached movement regions, route retention, vision indexing, pooled weather and reduced render cadence address measured CPU/GPU pressure.
    - Coastal armies use their current shore, scout capitals, search remaining settlements, reserve fleet capacity, rebuild harbors, prioritize transports and fill balanced crews. A full eight-kingdom paid coastal war now reaches all-building victory; the final diagnostic lasted about 19 simulated minutes.
    - Keep physical-device performance, multiplayer latency/failure testing and human balance/pacing reviews in the release checklist. The original 3D art remains procedural; commercial world-class parity has not been established.
    
    ## Version 2.3 campaign progress
    
    - Six chapters now have three authored stages each, original dialogue journals, optional completion medals, and active goal markers in the minimap and explored 3D world.
    - The river chapter has a modeled supply caravan, guarded escort navigation, a bridgehead objective, a loss condition, and recovery through frozen checkpoints.
    - Fortress defense requires a completed castle and the wave objectives. Sacred valley supports shrine control or a recorded conquest alternative. Final siege requires paid siege production and a defensive breach. The coastal chapter counts actual deposited fishing catch and accepts a landing or an Imperial siege-galleon route.
    - Initial and stage checkpoints preserve actors, objectives, economy, armies, exploration, and AI state without recursive snapshots. Existing campaign saves retain legacy rules.
    - Automated scenarios use gathering, construction, training, escort movement, shrine control, fishing, and gate attacks to exercise the chapter flows. All four difficulties initialize every chapter. Browser verification covers journals, selecting and inspecting the caravan, locating goals, defeat recovery, local save/resume, and emulated-phone controls.
    
    Pass 4 has a playable scripted baseline. Human completion tests on all difficulties, more mission events and set pieces, professional narration/audio, broader map fairness checks, and mission pacing remain unfinished.
    
    ## Version 2.2 implementation progress
    
    - Saved remappable keyboard controls, reserved-key validation, conflict reporting, active key documentation, and updated shortcut labels.
    - Patrol and guard commands in the simulation, desktop/touch interface, saves, and authoritative network commands. Formation slots avoid blocked terrain. Partial paths no longer count as successful arrival; persistent blocked orders report feedback and yield to queued orders.
    - Selected-unit order summaries and bounded 3D route previews, including patrol return routes and ship routes above the water.
    - Paid AI economy and army planning, civilization-aware counter composition, scouting memory, age-resource reserves, worker reassignment, repairs, retreats, healer escorts, and transport boarding/departure reservations.
    - Three civilization-exclusive units with solid model variants, explicit costs, age/building requirements, and distinct roles. Three exclusive technologies affect armor, market exchange, and cavalry raids. Old saves initialize the new research fields.
    - Interactive technology tree with faction comparison, prerequisite/status explanations, training, and research. Higher-contrast UI, reduced decorative motion, and larger tactical touch buttons.
    - Regression coverage now includes these behaviors. Commander browser checks exercise remapping, persistence, tactics, queued-order feedback without movement lines, save/resume, and desktop/emulated-phone layouts. Passive-player soak checks exercise full land, river, and coastal matches and record simulation CPU timings.
    
    Passes 1 through 3 have concrete implementation progress; they are not fully complete. Group cohesion, advanced recovery, AI expansion, further economy/combat tuning, richer strategic interactions, authored missions, asset/audio production, measured device performance, public online services, and external playtesting remain on the roadmap. Naval regrouping now respects the current island, and movement reaches the actual final waypoint rather than stopping at a grid center. The latest coastal soak reports four blocked orders instead of 74 in the previous diagnostic run; remaining land/bridge cases still need review. CPU timings from automated simulations do not establish rendering FPS, phone performance, or enjoyable difficulty.
    
    ## Development order and release checks
    
    | Pass | Work to implement or improve | Evidence required before declaring the pass complete |
    |---|---|---|
    | 1. Controls and army movement | Remappable hotkeys, selection priority, production across selected buildings, global production queue, queued-command feedback, patrol/guard behaviors, formation cohesion, obstacle avoidance, and recovery from blocked routes. Preserve edge scrolling and touch input. | Repeatable mouse/keyboard/touch scenarios; armies navigate woods, walls, gates, bridges, and crowded towns; no duplicated queued orders or indefinitely stuck troops in the tested cases. Local command feedback and execution latency measured on reference hardware. |
    | 2. Economy, AI, and battle balance | Explicit AI build orders and resource budgets, scouting memory, different attack plans, counter-unit composition, regrouping, retreating, siege protection, expansion, transport decisions, and difficulty based on decisions. Audit starting advantages and any difficulty bonuses. | Seeded economy and combat scenarios; AI can recover after worker losses and exhausted nearby resources; attacks change based on observed enemies; difficulty rules are documented; human testers find each level understandable and challenging. |
    | 3. Civilizations and strategic depth | Build on the implemented exclusive units/technologies, technology tree and eight-kingdom team support with clearer identities, more useful upgrade choices, land/naval counters and alternative economic strategies. | Comparable-cost counter scenarios plus human matches; all additions have costs, prerequisites, counters, descriptions, art, audio, AI support, saves, and multiplayer validation. Balance judged across maps and skill levels. |
    | 4. Missions and map design | A mission-event system with staged objectives, dialogue, reinforcements, escort/rescue tasks, branching optional goals, checkpoints, and authored set pieces. Curate resource placement, chokepoints, naval landings, and spawn fairness. | Each mission can be completed and failed correctly on each difficulty; checkpoints restore the correct event state; missions require different strategies; map objectives and travel routes remain reachable. |
    | 5. Art, animation, and sound | Establish a consistent medieval art direction; replace or refine the procedural assets with original or appropriately licensed authored models, textures, character rigs, transitions, worker tasks, cargo, attack impacts, damage, and death animations. Add distinctive music, unit responses, ambience, and readable combat sound. | Visual review in real gameplay at every quality setting and camera angle; recognizable units and silhouettes; animations match actions; assets fit performance budgets; retain real mesh geometry at every detail level. |
    | 6. Laptop and phone experience | Profile CPU/GPU work, pathfinding, draw calls, memory, network snapshots, and input delay. Improve detail levels, shared routes, batching, effects budgets, loading, safe areas, readable UI, touch selection, UI scaling, and accessibility options. | Publish device/browser/specification results. Proposed targets: 60 FPS on a defined reference laptop and 30 FPS on defined supported phones in benchmark matches. Verify sustained performance, frame-time spikes, thermal behavior, and memory over long sessions. Targets are not current achievements or guarantees for every device. |
    | 7. Multiplayer and community | Extend the implemented team rooms, readiness, authoritative validation, defeat spectating and reconnect recovery with public hosting, persistent rooms, matchmaking, profiles, replays and operational monitoring. | Test multiple clients, latency, packet loss, disconnects, server restarts, ownership, hidden-information handling, version compatibility, and replay results. Hosting choices and ongoing costs need an explicit deployment decision. |
    | 8. Release readiness | Improve onboarding, settings, saved-game migrations, campaign progression, post-match economy/combat graphs, installation/update behavior, diagnostics, recovery, and documentation. Conduct repeated external playtests and fix their highest-impact problems. | Long complete matches, all modes, save/resume/update cycles, physical phones/laptops, multiplayer failure scenarios, and accessibility reviews pass the agreed release checklist. Record remaining limitations instead of labeling unchecked areas complete. |
    
    Performance, regression testing, and human feedback run throughout these passes; they are not postponed until the end.
    
    ## Recommended next release
    
    Start with Pass 1 and the most visible parts of Pass 2:
    
    1. Global production overview and multi-building training are implemented. Configurable hotkeys and queued-order feedback are now implemented; continue with group cohesion, obstacle recovery, and full-match input testing.
    2. Continue control refinements with profile management, selection priority, and accessibility reviews.
    3. Improve group movement through gates, around buildings, and over bridges; show blocked-order feedback.
    4. Refine the implemented AI plans with expansion, resource exhaustion recovery, siege protection, and human difficulty tuning.
    5. Exercise complete economy-to-victory matches with several seeds and difficulties, followed by laptop and phone playtests.
    
    Deliver these as tested releases that can be played and reviewed. Additional units or prettier screenshots alone do not establish overall game quality.
    
    ## What can be developed here and what needs outside evidence
    
    The existing workspace supports implementation of gameplay, AI, UI, asset integration, shaders, animation, performance instrumentation, testing, and multiplayer services. Professional asset/audio production requires suitable original work or licensed sources. Physical-device results require access to the actual devices or measurements from testers. Public online operation requires a hosting decision and ongoing service resources. Fun and balance require repeated human playtesting.
    
    No honest development process can promise an objective “100% world-class” score. The useful commitment is to finish defined requirements, publish test evidence, address player feedback, and improve successive releases.
    
    ## Research references
    
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season One development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-one-update-release-notes/): controls, global production queues, patrol, player feedback, balance, maps, campaign tuning, and post-match navigation. Used as a genre quality reference, not a statement of this project's implemented features.
    - [Official Age of Empires IV Season Two development notes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-17718/): continued iteration across controls, game modes, multiplayer, and stability.
    - The baseline above is supported by the local source, [README](README.md), [change log](CHANGELOG.md), and tests/scripts in this repository.

        text = config.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        after = tomllib.loads(text)
        previous = before['mcp_servers']['node_repl'].get('args')
        if previous is not None and 'args' not in after['mcp_servers']['node_repl']:

            config.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
        restored = tomllib.loads(config.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert restored['mcp_servers'].pop('blender', None) is not None
        assert before == restored, 'Configuration differs beyond the authorized Blender connection'

    export function resourceModel(view,e){

        for(const x of [-1.7,1.7])for(const z of [-1.7,1.7]){b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stone,x,2,z,.23,3.7,.23);b.piece(view.geo.cylinder,m.stoneDark,x,3.7,z,.36,.25,.36);}
        b.roof(m.stone,0,3.8,0,4.5,1.8,4.4);b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.relic,0,2.25,0,.45,.75,.45);b.piece(view.geo.ring3d,m.gold,0,2.3,0,.9,.9,.9);
      }else if(e.water){
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const x=Math.sin(i*2.3)*1.4,z=Math.cos(i*2.3)*1.4;b.oval(m.steel,x,-.12,z,.11,.08,.35);const tail=b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.slate,x,-.12,z-.37,.14,.22,.035);tail.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;}
      }else if(e.type==='food'){
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const x=Math.sin(i*2.3)*.7,z=Math.cos(i*2.3)*.7;b.rod(m.trunk,[x,0,z],[x,.6,z],.07);b.oval(m.leaf,x,.65,z,.68,.62,.63);for(let k=0;k<4;k++)b.oval(m.fruit,x+(rng()-.5)*.7,.9+rng()*.3,z+(rng()-.5)*.6,.075,.08,.08);}
      }else{
        for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const x=(rng()-.5)*2.7,z=(rng()-.5)*2.6,s=.5+rng()*.8,rock=b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,e.type==='gold'?m.stoneDark:m.stone,x,s*.52,z,s,s*.92,s*.83);rock.rotation.set(rng()*.4,rng()*6,rng()*.3);
          if(e.type==='gold')for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const nugget=b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.gold,x+(rng()-.5)*s,s*.9+rng()*.2,z+(rng()-.5)*s,.16,.12,.1);nugget.rotation.y=rng()*6;}
        }
        for(let i=0;i<9;i++)b.piece(view.geo.rock3d,m.stoneDark,(rng()-.5)*3.4,.13,(rng()-.5)*3.4,.16,.16,.2);
      }
      g.userData.model3d={kind:e.kind,type:e.water?'fish':e.type,volumetric:true};return g;
    }
    
    export function treeModel(view,map,variant=0,far=false){
      ensureModels(view);const g=new THREE.Group(),b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials,rng=seededRandom(variant+128),pine=map==='winter',desert=map==='desert';
      b.rod(m.trunk,[0,0,0],[.07,4.5,0],.22);
      if(!far){for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const angle=i*Math.PI/2+variant;b.rod(m.trunk,[0,.4,0],[Math.sin(angle)*.75,.04,Math.cos(angle)*.75],.12);}b.rod(m.trunk,[.02,2.2,0],[.45,4.8,.15],.12);}

        if(pine){const radius=2.1-i*.35,leaves=b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.leafDark,0,2.9+i*.75,0,radius,2.6,radius);leaves.rotation.y=rng()*6;b.piece(view.geo.cone,m.snow,0,3.24+i*.75,0,radius*.79,2.02,radius*.79);}

      }
      g.userData.model3d={kind:'resource',type:'wood',volumetric:true};return g;
    }

      show(e){

        this.show(e);const width=container.clientWidth,height=container.clientHeight;if(!width||!height)return;

        this.model.rotation.y=now*.25;this.renderer.render(this.scene,this.camera);

    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group,true),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);
        for(const [type,data]of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
        for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const model=unitModel(v,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
      }
    });
    test('forests, fruit, mineral deposits, fish and shrines use volumetric mesh models',()=>{

      solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}));solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}));
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS))for(let i=0;i<4;i++)solidBounds(treeModel(v,map,i));
    });
    test('batching preserves model bounds and articulated joints remain animated',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),e={id:31,kind:'unit',type:'knight',owner:0,moving:true,cooldown:0};
      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});
      v.mergeModel(model);const after=solidBounds(model),parts=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)parts.push(m);});

      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);
    });
    
    test('town centers gain solid age architecture and preserve age metadata when batched',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),vertices=[];for(let age=0;age<4;age++){v.sim.players[0].age=age;const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type:'towncenter',owner:0,r:5,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);v.mergeModel(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.architectureAge,age);let count=0;model.traverse(part=>{if(part.isMesh)count+=part.geometry.getAttribute('position').count;});vertices.push(count);}

      const worker=v.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],tree=v.sim.entities.find(e=>e.type==='wood');worker.carry=18;worker.carryType='wood';v.interactions=new WorldInteractions(v);tree.hp=0;tree.amount=0;v.interactions.update(.1,false);

      v.clock=2;v.interactions.update(.1,false);assert.equal(v.treeFalls.size,0);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.stumps,1);v.interactions.dispose();assert.equal(v.scene.children.length,0);

      groundTexture(seed,map){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=1024;const ctx=c.getContext('2d'),rng=seededRandom(seed);ctx.fillStyle={desert:'#b7ad83',winter:'#d3dbcd',canyon:'#a39079',rivers:'#7f9978'}[map]||'#81916a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);
        for(let i=0;i<65000;i++){const x=rng()*1024,y=rng()*1024;ctx.fillStyle=rng()>.5?'rgba(43,68,35,.075)':'rgba(230,221,168,.07)';ctx.fillRect(x,y,2+rng()*7,2+rng()*7);}
        for(const sign of [1,-1]){ctx.strokeStyle='#ab9d78';ctx.lineWidth=20;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(((-39*sign+80)/160)*1024,((30*sign+80)/160)*1024);ctx.lineTo(((-27*sign+80)/160)*1024,((24*sign+80)/160)*1024);ctx.lineTo(((-27*sign+80)/160)*1024,((0+80)/160)*1024);ctx.stroke();}

      }
      attach(sim){this.sim=sim;
        for(const batch of this.unitBatches.values())for(const part of batch.parts){part.geometry.dispose();part.dispose();part.removeFromParent();}this.unitBatches.clear();

      makeRiver(center=0,width=5){const vertices=[],indices=[];for(let i=0;i<=80;i++){const z=-80+i*2,x=center+Math.sin(z*.045)*(width===5?4:3);vertices.push(x-width,.08,z,x+width,.08,z);if(i<80){const a=i*2;indices.push(a,a+1,a+2,a+1,a+3,a+2);}}const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));geo.setIndex(indices);geo.computeVertexNormals();this.terrain.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo,this.materials.water));

      flag(g,team,x,y,z,size=1){this.cylinder(g,this.materials.darkwood,x,y/2,z,.07,y);const flag=this.box(g,team,x+size*.5,y-.45,z,size,.75*size,.035);flag.userData.flag=true;}

    function toast(message,tone=''){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className=`toast ${tone}`;el.textContent=message;$('#toasts').append(el);while($('#toasts').children.length>3)$('#toasts').firstElementChild.remove();setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),4800);}
    function setSelection(ids){selectionKey='';selection=[...new Set(ids)].filter(id=>sim.get(id));view.selection=new Set(selection);$('#selection-panel').scrollTop=0;audio.play('select');renderSelection();}
    function selected(){return selection.map(id=>sim.get(id)).filter(Boolean);}
    function workers(){return selected().filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='villager').map(e=>e.id);}
    function updateCameraLabel(){const label=$('#camera-view-label');if(label)label.textContent=(CAMERA_PRESETS[settings.cameraPreset]||CAMERA_PRESETS.balanced).label;}
    function closeModal(){if(modal==='pause'||modal==='settings-game'||modal==='help-game'||modal==='codex-game'||modal==='tree-game'||modal==='journal-game')paused=false;modal=null;$('#modal-root').innerHTML='';}
    function showModal(content,kind='info',wide=false){edgeScroll.reset();modal=kind;$('#modal-root').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-backdrop"><section class="modal ${wide?'wide':''}" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><button class="modal-close" data-action="close" aria-label="Close dialog">×</button>${content}</section></div>`;if(kind==='end')$('#modal-root .modal').classList.add('result-dialog');if(kind==='settings'||kind==='settings-game')appendKeyboardSettings($('#modal-root'),settings.bindings);if(kind==='help'||kind==='help-game')$('#modal-root .help-grid').after(Object.assign(document.createElement('section'),{className:'current-controls',innerHTML:'<h3>Your active keyboard controls</h3>'+activeControlsMarkup(settings.bindings)}));$('#modal-root').querySelector('button')?.focus();}
    function showSetup(mode){if(mode==='custom')return showCustomBattle();const m=MODES.find(m=>m.id===mode)||MISSIONS.find(m=>m.id===mode);showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">${m.chapter?`CHAPTER ${m.chapter} · THE FRONTIER CHRONICLES`:m.label}</div><h2>${m.name}</h2><p class="modal-intro">${m.desc}</p><div class="setup-grid"><div><label class="field-label" for="faction">YOUR CIVILIZATION</label><select id="faction">${Object.entries(FACTIONS).map(([id,f])=>`<option value="${id}" ${id===setupOptions.faction?'selected':''}>${f.name}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="faction-description" class="faction-description"></div></div><div><label class="field-label" for="difficulty">CHALLENGE</label><select id="difficulty">${Object.entries(DIFFICULTIES).map(([id,d])=>`<option value="${id}" ${id===setupOptions.difficulty?'selected':''}>${d.name}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="difficulty-description" class="faction-description"></div></div><div><label class="field-label" for="map">BATTLEFIELD</label><select id="map" ${m.map?'disabled':''}>${Object.entries(MAPS).map(([id,map])=>`<option value="${id}" ${id===(m.map||setupOptions.map)?'selected':''}>${map.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div><label class="field-label" for="seed">WORLD SEED</label><input id="seed" type="number" min="1" max="999999999" value="${m.seed||setupOptions.seed}"></div></div><div class="mission-brief"><span>VICTORY CONDITION</span><p>${m.objective}</p><small>${m.time||'A campaign chapter'} · Mouse & touch supported</small></div><button class="primary full" data-start="${mode}">${mode==='tutorial'?'Start the tutorial':'Enter the frontier'} <span>➜</span></button>`, 'setup');updateSetupDescriptions();}
    function updateSetupDescriptions(){if($('#faction')){$('#faction-description').textContent=FACTIONS[$('#faction').value].desc;$('#difficulty-description').textContent=DIFFICULTIES[$('#difficulty').value].desc;}}
    function showCustomBattle(preset=null){if(playing)paused=true;if(preset){if(modal==='custom-setup')customDraft=readBattleSetup($('#modal-root'));customDraft.slots=battlePreset(preset);}showModal(customBattleMarkup(customDraft),'custom-setup',true);$('#modal-root .modal').classList.add('custom-dialog');updateBattlePreview($('#modal-root'));}
    function launchCustom(multiplayer){
      try{customDraft=readBattleSetup($('#modal-root'));localStorage.setItem('crowns-custom-setup',JSON.stringify(customDraft));
        if(!multiplayer)return startGame(normalizeBattle({...customDraft,multiplayer:false}));
        const slots=customDraft.slots.map(slot=>({...slot}));if(!slots.slice(1).some(slot=>slot.enabled&&slot.controller==='human')){const next=slots.findIndex((slot,i)=>i>0&&slot.enabled);slots[next].controller='human';}
        const options=normalizeBattle({...customDraft,slots,multiplayer:true});if(net.socket)net.leave();showModal('<h2>Creating your war room…</h2><button class="secondary" data-action="lan-leave">Cancel</button>','lan');net.connect({type:'create',name:options.slots[0].name,faction:options.slots[0].faction,options});
      }catch(error){toast(error.message,'warning');}
    }
    function showJournal(){if(!sim.campaignState||sim.campaignState.legacy)return;if(playing)paused=true;showModal('<div class="eyebrow">THE FRONTIER CHRONICLES</div><h2>Campaign journal.</h2><div class="campaign-journal">'+sim.campaignState.history.map(entry=>'<article><span>'+esc(entry.speaker)+' · '+formatTime(entry.time)+'</span><p>'+esc(entry.text)+'</p></article>').join('')+'</div><p class="journal-optional">Optional goal: '+esc(CAMPAIGN_SCRIPTS[sim.options.mode].optional.text)+'</p>','journal-game',true);}
    function showCampaign(){showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">THE FRONTIER CHRONICLES</div><h2>A kingdom in the making.</h2><p class="modal-intro">Six story chapters, or create your own battle with configurable allies, rivals, and victory rules.</p><button class="secondary full" data-action="custom-battle">Create your own custom battle</button><div class="chapter-list">${MISSIONS.map(m=>`<button class="chapter" data-mode="${m.id}"><span class="chapter-number">${m.chapter}</span><span><strong>${m.name}</strong><small>${m.desc}</small></span><span class="chapter-status">${progress[m.id]?.optional?'✦':progress[m.id]?'✓':'↗'}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`, 'campaign',true);}
    function startGame(options,save=null){if(!view)return;edgeScroll.reset();audio.lastThunder=undefined;tacticalMode=null;unloadMode=false;productionOpen=false;productionKey='';$('#production-panel').classList.add('hidden');$('#production-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');$('#hud').classList.remove('panels-hidden');$('[data-action=camera-panels]').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');closeModal();setupOptions={...setupOptions,...options};sim=save?Simulation.restore(save):new Simulation(options);view.attach(sim);sim.on(onEvent);playing=true;paused=false;speed=1;groups={};$('#toasts').innerHTML='';selection=[];view.selection=new Set();buildType=null;attackMove=false;accumulator=0;lastAutosave=sim.time;$('#landing').classList.add('hidden');$('#hud').classList.remove('hidden');$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');view.angle=Math.PI/4;view.setCameraPreset(settings.cameraPreset,true);updateCameraLabel();audio.unlock();renderHUD();renderSelection();updateRotate();toast('Your kingdom awaits. Select a villager or your town center.');if(sim.options.mode==='tutorial')toast('Start with the objectives in the upper-left corner.');if(sim.ended)showEnd(sim.ended);}
    function onEvent(e){if(['notice','research','sound'].includes(e.type)&&e.owner!==undefined&&e.owner!==0)return;
      if(e.type==='notice')toast(e.message,e.tone);
      if(e.type==='kingdom-defeated')toast(`${e.name} has been eliminated.${e.owner===0?' You can watch your allies continue.':''}`);
      if(e.type==='remnants-revealed')toast(`${e.name}: the last buildings are marked on the radar.`);
      if(e.type==='complete'){toast(`${BUILDINGS[e.entity.type].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='trained'&&e.entity.owner===0){audio.play('complete');if(e.entity.type==='villager'&&!e.entity.order)sim.assignWorker(e.entity);}
      if(e.type==='research'){toast(e.tech==='age'?`${AGES[e.age]} reached. New troops and buildings unlocked.`:`${TECHS[e.tech].name} completed.`);audio.play('complete');renderSelection();}
      if(e.type==='order'){audio.play('order');}
      if(e.type==='sound')audio.play(e.name);
      if(e.type==='alarm'){$('#alert-line').innerHTML='<span class="alert-pulse"></span> YOUR KINGDOM IS UNDER ATTACK';audio.play('alarm');setTimeout(()=>$('#alert-line').innerHTML='',7000);}
      if(e.type==='raid')toast('Scouts report an enemy army on the move.','warning');
      if(e.type==='wave'){toast(`Wave ${e.wave} · ${e.count} enemies approach. Supplies have arrived.`,'warning');audio.play('alarm');}
      if(e.type==='capture'){toast(e.owner===0?'An ancient shrine is under your control.':'The enemy has captured a shrine.',e.owner===0?'':'warning');audio.play('complete');}
      if(e.type==='attack'||e.type==='death'||e.type==='heal'){view.effect(e);if(e.type==='attack')audio.play('attack',e.entity,{x:view.target.x,z:view.target.z,angle:view.angle});}
      if(e.type==='campaign-stage'){toast(e.text);audio.play('complete');renderHUD();}
      if(e.type==='campaign-checkpoint'){saveGame(true);toast('Campaign checkpoint saved. Restore it from the commander menu.');}
      if(e.type==='end')showEnd(e);
    }
    function saveGame(automatic=false){if(net.active){if(!automatic)toast('Network games reconnect through the room session. Local saving is for single-player matches.');return;}try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-save',JSON.stringify(sim.serialize()));if(!automatic)toast('Your kingdom has been saved on this device.');}catch{if(!automatic)toast('This browser could not store the save. Free storage or enable local storage.','warning');}}
    function showEnd(result){paused=true;buildType=null;view.hideGhost();if(result.won){progress[sim.options.mode]=sim.campaignState&&!sim.campaignState.legacy?{won:true,optional:sim.campaignState.optional,route:sim.campaignState.route,seconds:sim.time}:true;try{localStorage.setItem('crowns-progress',JSON.stringify(progress));}catch{}audio.play('victory');}showModal(`<div class="result-crest">${result.won?'♛':'⚔'}</div><div class="eyebrow">${result.won?'A LEGACY WRITTEN':'THE CROWN HAS FALLEN'}</div><h2>${result.won?'Victory.':'Defeat.'}</h2><p class="modal-intro">${esc(result.reason)}</p><div class="result-stats"><div><strong>${formatTime(sim.time)}</strong><span>TIME IN BATTLE</span></div><div><strong>${sim.stats.kills}</strong><span>ENEMIES DEFEATED</span></div><div><strong>${Math.round(sim.stats.gathered)}</strong><span>RESOURCES GATHERED</span></div><div><strong>${sim.stats.built}</strong><span>BUILDINGS RAISED</span></div></div>${battleResultMarkup(sim)}${sim.campaignState?.finished?`<p class="campaign-medal">${sim.campaignState.optional?'✦ Optional goal completed':'Chapter completed'}</p>`:''}<div class="result-actions">${sim.campaignCheckpoint&&!result.won?'<button class="primary" data-action="checkpoint">Restore campaign checkpoint</button>':''}<button class="primary" data-action="restart">Play again ↗</button><button class="secondary" data-action="menu">Return to menu</button></div>`,'end');}
    function showPause(){paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">A MOMENT OF RESPITE</div><h2>${net.active?'Commander menu.':'The kingdom can wait.'}</h2>${net.active?'<p class="modal-intro">The network match continues while this menu is open.</p>':''}<p class="modal-intro">${AGES[sim.players[0].age]} · ${formatTime(sim.time)} · ${DIFFICULTIES[sim.options.difficulty].name}</p><div class="pause-actions"><button class="primary full" data-action="close">Return to battle <span>➜</span></button><button class="secondary full" data-action="save">Save kingdom</button>${sim.campaignCheckpoint?'<button class="secondary full" data-action="checkpoint">Restore campaign checkpoint</button>':''}${sim.campaignState&&!sim.campaignState.legacy?'<button class="secondary full" data-action="journal">Campaign journal</button>':''}<button class="secondary full" data-action="settings">Settings</button><button class="secondary full" data-action="help">Controls & strategy</button><button class="secondary full" data-action="fullscreen">Enter fullscreen</button>${sim.options.mode==='custom'&&!sim.players[0].defeated?'<button class="text-button" data-action="resign">Resign your kingdom</button>':''}<button class="text-button" data-action="menu">Save & return to menu</button></div>`,'pause');}
    function showSettings(){if(playing)paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">MAKE IT YOURS</div><h2>Settings.</h2><label class="field-label" for="quality">GRAPHICS QUALITY</label><select id="quality"><option value="high" ${settings.quality==='high'?'selected':''}>High · full shadows & sharp rendering</option><option value="medium" ${settings.quality==='medium'?'selected':''}>Balanced · recommended for phones</option><option value="low" ${settings.quality==='low'?'selected':''}>Performance · shadows off</option></select><label class="field-label" for="camera-preset">CAMERA VIEW</label><select id="camera-preset">${Object.entries(CAMERA_PRESETS).map(([id,p])=>`<option value="${id}" ${settings.cameraPreset===id?'selected':''}>${p.label}</option>`).join('')}</select><label class="toggle"><input id="edge-scroll" type="checkbox" ${settings.edgeScroll?'checked':''}> Mouse edge scrolling</label><label class="field-label" for="edge-scroll-speed">MOUSE SCROLL SPEED</label><input type="range" id="edge-scroll-speed" min=".5" max="2" step=".25" value="${settings.edgeScrollSpeed}"><label class="field-label" for="volume">VOLUME</label><input type="range" id="volume" min="0" max="1" step=".05" value="${settings.volume}"><label class="toggle"><input id="auto-quality" type="checkbox" ${settings.autoQuality?'checked':''}> Automatically optimize performance</label><label class="toggle"><input id="music" type="checkbox" ${settings.music?'checked':''}> Ambient music</label><label class="field-label" for="weather-mode">WEATHER</label><select id="weather-mode"><option value="auto" ${settings.weather==='auto'?'selected':''}>Automatic weather</option>${Object.entries(WEATHER_NAMES).map(([id,name])=>`<option value="${id}" ${settings.weather===id?'selected':''}>${name}</option>`).join('')}</select><label class="toggle"><input id="weather-sounds" type="checkbox" ${settings.weatherSounds?'checked':''}> Rain, wind, and thunder sounds</label><label class="toggle"><input id="weather-lightning" type="checkbox" ${settings.lightning?'checked':''}> Lightning flashes <small>Reduced motion also disables flashes.</small></label><label class="toggle"><input id="fog" type="checkbox" ${settings.fog?'checked':''}> Fog overlay <small>Enemy visibility rules remain active.</small></label><label class="toggle"><input id="high-contrast" type="checkbox" ${settings.highContrast?'checked':''}> Higher contrast interface</label><label class="toggle"><input id="reduced-motion" type="checkbox" ${settings.reducedMotion?'checked':''}> Reduce decorative motion</label><p class="settings-note">Use landscape on phones. Pinch to zoom, drag to pan, and tap to select or command. Saves are stored on this browser and device.</p><button class="primary full" data-action="apply-settings">Apply settings <span>✓</span></button>`,playing?'settings-game':'settings');}
    function showHelp(){if(playing)paused=true;showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">THE COMMANDER'S HANDBOOK</div><h2>Every empire starts small.</h2><div class="help-grid"><div><h3>Mouse & keyboard</h3><p>Move the mouse to an edge of the game window to scroll the camera. Corners scroll diagonally; the cursor arrow shows the direction. Use fullscreen to scroll at the screen edges. Adjust Mouse edge scrolling and its speed in Settings.</p><p>Click to select. Drag a box to select a group. Shift-click adds units. Double-click selects nearby troops of the same type.</p><p><b>Right-click</b> to move, attack, gather, build, repair, heal, or set a building's rally point. <b>Shift + right-click</b> queues orders.</p><p><b>WASD / arrows:</b> pan · <b>Q/E:</b> rotate · <b>V:</b> camera angle / <b>Wheel:</b> zoom · <b>Middle drag:</b> pan · <b>H:</b> town · <b>M:</b> army · <b>B:</b> build · <b>F:</b> attack move · <b>X:</b> stop · <b>.:</b> idle worker · <b>Esc:</b> pause/cancel</p><p><b>Ctrl + 1–9:</b> store group · <b>1–9:</b> recall group · <b>Space:</b> focus selection</p></div><div><h3>Phone & tablet</h3><p>Play in landscape. Tap your units to select. With a unit selected, tap open ground to move, an enemy to attack, or a resource to gather.</p><p>Drag the battlefield to pan. Use two fingers to pinch-zoom or twist to rotate. The camera buttons also rotate, zoom, and change the viewing angle. The <b>Army</b> button selects every soldier. The <b>Idle</b> button selects idle workers.</p><p>Tap <b>Build</b>, choose a building, then tap open land. Select walls and drag to create a wall line. Gates allow friendly troops through.</p><p>Tap or drag the square minimap to move the camera. Its outlined box and center dot locate your view. Open Production in the top bar to manage queues and select several buildings; the +5 buttons queue a batch. Training and research appear when you select a completed building.</p></div></div><div class="strategy-tip"><b>A good first five minutes</b><p>Keep training villagers. Build houses before reaching the population cap. Place gathering camps near resources. Mix spearmen with archers, advance your age, and bring siege weapons against fortifications. Add healers to preserve expensive troops.</p></div><button class="secondary" data-action="codex">Open the complete field guide ↗</button>`,playing?'help-game':'help',true);}
    let treeFaction=null;
    function showTechnologyTree(faction=null){const top=modal==='tree'||modal==='tree-game'?$('#modal-root .modal').scrollTop:0;treeFaction=faction||(playing?sim.players[0].faction:setupOptions.faction);if(playing)paused=true;showModal(technologyTreeMarkup(playing?sim:null,treeFaction),playing?'tree-game':'tree',true);$('#modal-root .modal').classList.add('technology-modal');$('#modal-root .modal').scrollTop=top;}
    function showCodex(tab='units'){if(playing)paused=true;const lists={units:UNITS,buildings:BUILDINGS,technologies:TECHS};showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">KNOWLEDGE IS POWER</div><h2>Field guide.</h2><button class="secondary" data-action="tech-tree">Explore the technology tree</button><nav class="codex-tabs">${Object.keys(lists).map(t=>`<button class="${t===tab?'active':''}" data-codex="${t}">${t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1)}</button>`).join('')}</nav><div class="codex-list">${Object.entries(lists[tab]).map(([id,d])=>`<article class="codex-item"><span class="codex-icon">${ICONS[id]||'✧'}</span><div><h3>${d.name} <small>${AGES[d.age]}</small></h3><p>${d.desc}</p><span class="cost">${costText(d.cost)} ${d.hp?` · ${d.hp} base HP`:''} ${d.time?` · ${d.time}s`:''}</span></div></article>`).join('')}</div><div class="strategy-tip"><b>Unit counters</b><p>Spearmen → cavalry · cavalry → archers · archers → spearmen · armored infantry → light troops · siege → buildings. Troops gain strength with each age. Research stacks with civilization bonuses.</p></div>`,playing?'codex-game':'codex',true);}
    function toggleBuild(){if(buildType){cancelBuild();return;}const ws=workers();if(!ws.length){const free=sim.owned(0,'unit','villager').filter(e=>!e.order);setSelection((free.length?free:sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')).slice(0,2).map(e=>e.id));}if(!workers().length)return toast('Train a villager before constructing buildings.','warning');
      const age=sim.players[0].age;$('#build-panel').classList.remove('hidden');$('#build-panel').innerHTML=`<div class="floating-heading"><span>RAISE YOUR KINGDOM</span><button data-action="cancel-build" aria-label="Close construction">×</button></div><div class="build-grid">${Object.entries(BUILDINGS).map(([id,d])=>`<button class="build-option ${age<d.age?'locked':''}" data-build="${id}" ${age<d.age?'disabled':''} title="${esc(d.desc)}"><span class="build-icon">${ICONS[id]}</span><strong>${d.name}</strong><small>${age<d.age?AGES[d.age]:costText(sim.cost(d.cost,0,'building'))}</small></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="build-footnote">Select a building, then choose open land. Drag to place connected walls. Shift keeps the tool active.</p>`;
    }
    function cancelBuild(){buildType=null;$('#build-panel').classList.add('hidden');view?.hideGhost();$('#world').classList.remove('placing');$('#order-hint').textContent='Select units to issue orders.';}
    function attributes(e){const d=UNITS[e.type],p=sim.players[e.owner],attack=Math.round(d.damage*(1+p.age*.12)*(1+(d.role==='ranged'?p.tech.ranged:p.tech.attack)*.2)*(d.naval?1+(p.tech.seamanship||0)*.2:1)*(d.role==='cavalry'?FACTIONS[p.faction].cavalry:1));return `<div class="unit-attributes"><span>ATTACK<b>${attack}</b></span><span>ARMOR<b>${sim.unitArmor(e)}</b></span><span>RANGE<b>${d.range+(d.role==='ranged'?p.tech.ranged:0)}m</b></span><span>VISION<b>${d.vision}m</b></span></div>`;}
    function applyAccessibility(){document.documentElement.classList.toggle('high-contrast',!!settings.highContrast);document.documentElement.classList.toggle('reduced-motion',!!settings.reducedMotion);}
    function refreshShortcutLabels(){for(const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]')){const key=settings.bindings[button.dataset.action];if(key){button.title=button.title.replace(/ \([^)]*\)$/,'')+' ('+keyLabel(key)+')';}}}
    applyAccessibility();refreshShortcutLabels();
    function orderSummary(list){const units=list.filter(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit');if(!units.length)return '';const blocked=units.filter(e=>e.pathStatus==='blocked').length,queued=units.reduce((n,e)=>n+(e.orders?.length||0),0),orders=[...new Set(units.map(e=>e.order?.type||'idle'))].join(', ');return '<div class="order-summary" role="status">'+esc(orders)+(queued?' · '+queued+' queued':'')+(blocked?' · '+blocked+' blocked':'')+'<small>Shift-command adds a waypoint. Routes appear for selected units.</small></div>';}
    function tactics(){return `<div class="tactics"><span>FORMATION</span>${['square','line','column'].map(f=>`<button data-formation="${f}" class="${sim.players[0].formation===f?'active':''}">${f}</button>`).join('')}<button data-action="patrol" title="Patrol between here and a destination">Patrol</button><button data-action="guard" title="Follow and protect a friendly unit or building">Guard</button><button data-stance="aggressive">Engage</button><button data-stance="hold">Hold ground</button></div>`;}
    function groupProduction(list){
      const ids=list.map(e=>e.id),age=sim.players[0].age;
      const choices=Object.entries(UNITS).map(([type,data])=>({type,data,sites:trainingBuildings(sim,type,ids)})).filter(choice=>choice.sites.length);
      if(!choices.length)return '<p class="selection-desc">These buildings cannot train troops. Select one building to manage its upgrades.</p>';
    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    
    const base=process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:5173/';
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']});
    const errors=[],reports=[];fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});
    async function start(page){
      page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
      await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'networkidle'});
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin your reign'}).click();
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Enter the frontier'}).click();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>frontier.playing&&frontier.view.contactShadows?.count>0);
    }
    try{
      const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});await start(page);
      const initial=await page.evaluate(()=>({perspective:frontier.view.camera.isPerspectiveCamera,tilt:frontier.view.tilt,shadows:frontier.view.contactShadows.count,relief:!!frontier.view.materials.stone.bumpMap,roofSeparate:frontier.view.roofMaterials[0]!==frontier.view.teamMaterials[0]}));
      assert.ok(initial.perspective&&initial.relief&&initial.roofSeparate);assert.ok(initial.shadows>0);assert.ok(Math.abs(initial.tilt-32*Math.PI/180)<.001);
      await page.waitForTimeout(600);await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/3d-desktop-game.png'});
      const angle=await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.angle);
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Rotate camera left',exact:true}).click();assert.ok(await page.evaluate(a=>frontier.view.angle>a,angle));
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Rotate camera right',exact:true}).click();assert.ok(await page.evaluate(a=>Math.abs(frontier.view.angle-a)<.001,angle));
      await page.locator('[data-action=camera-view]').click();assert.ok(await page.evaluate(()=>Math.abs(frontier.view.tilt-20*Math.PI/180)<.001));
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Zoom in',exact:true}).click();
      await page.waitForTimeout(200);await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/3d-close-view.png'});
      await page.locator('[data-action=camera-view]').click();assert.ok(await page.evaluate(()=>Math.abs(frontier.view.tilt-56*Math.PI/180)<.001));
      await page.keyboard.press('v');assert.equal(await page.locator('#camera-view-label').textContent(),'Perspective');
      // Picking must follow the rotated perspective, rather than relying on old screen positions.

    function jointAngle(view,m,e){

    // Export the original game's complete model catalogue for Blender refinement.
    // Semantic materials and joint extras keep team colours and gameplay animation.
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { GLTFExporter } from 'three/addons/exporters/GLTFExporter.js';
    import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
    import { WorldView } from '../../src/world.js';
    import { BUILDINGS, UNITS } from '../../src/data.js';
    import { buildingModel, unitModel, resourceModel, treeModel } from '../../src/models-3d.js';
    
    // GLTFExporter uses FileReader for its binary Blob, including without textures.
    globalThis.FileReader ??= class {
      readAsArrayBuffer(blob) {
        blob.arrayBuffer().then((buffer) => {
          this.result = buffer;
          this.onloadend?.({ target: this });
        }).catch((error) => this.onerror?.(error));
      }
    };
    
    const colors = {
      stone:0xb6b5a4, stoneDark:0x737e78, plaster:0xd9c8a6,
      wood:0x756046, darkwood:0x483c30, roof:0x5a6c66, roofRed:0x8b5949,
      gold:0xbda44b, iron:0x8a9ba0, leaf:0x668943, leafDark:0x416936,
      trunk:0x66563e, skin:0xd2b08d, berry:0x9d4d48, soil:0x837052,
      furrow:0x6b6343, crop:0xc3ad62, water:0x89b8bd,
      glass:0x263e42, timberEdge:0x473328,
    };
    function fixture(faction) {
      const view = Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      view.materials = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(colors).map(([key,color]) =>
        [key,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.85})]));
      view.materials.shadow = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({transparent:true,opacity:.1});
      view.geo = {
        box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1), sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),
        cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10), cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7),
      };
      view.teamMaterials = [new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x397f8c})];
      view.roofMaterials = [new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x475b65})];
      view.sim = {
        players:[{faction,age:0}], options:{seed:2026,map:'highlands'},
        isWater:(x) => x>8,
      };
      return view;
    }
    
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const manifest = [];
    let meshId = 0;
    function add(view, root, assetKey) {
      if (root.userData.body) root.userData.body.userData.assetBody = true;
      delete root.userData.body;
      delete root.userData.portcullis;
      view.mergeModel(root);
      root.name = `asset__${assetKey.replaceAll(':','__')}`;
      root.userData.assetKey = assetKey;
      const names = new Map(Object.entries(view.materials).map(([key,mat]) => [mat,key]));
      names.set(view.teamMaterials[0],'team');
      names.set(view.roofMaterials[0],'teamRoof');
      root.traverse((part) => {
        if (!part.isMesh) return;
        const role = names.get(part.material);
        if (!role) throw new Error(`Unmapped material in ${assetKey}`);
        part.material.name = role;
        part.userData.assetMaterial = role;
        part.name = `part_${++meshId}`;
      });
      scene.add(root);
      manifest.push({key:assetKey,kind:root.userData.model3d?.kind});
    }
    
    for (const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']) {
      const view = fixture(faction);
      for (const [type,definition] of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)) {
        for (let age=0;age<(type==='towncenter'?4:1);age++) {
          view.sim.players[0].age = age;
          add(view,buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:definition.r,x:-20,z:0}),
            `building:${type}:${faction}:${age}`);
        }
      }
    }
    const view = fixture('alder');
    for (const type of Object.keys(UNITS))
      add(view,unitModel(view,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31}),`unit:${type}`);
    for (const biome of ['highlands','winter','desert'])
      for (let variant=0;variant<4;variant++)
        for (const far of [false,true])
          add(view,treeModel(view,biome,variant,far),`tree:${biome}:${variant}:${far?'far':'near'}`);
    for (const type of ['food','gold','stone'])
      for (let variant=0;variant<4;variant++)
        add(view,resourceModel(view,{id:51+variant,kind:'resource',type}),`resource:${type}:${variant}`);
    add(view,resourceModel(view,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}),'resource:fish');
    add(view,resourceModel(view,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}),'resource:shrine');
    
    await mkdir('.tools/art-source',{recursive:true});
    const output = await new GLTFExporter().parseAsync(scene,{
      binary:true,onlyVisible:false,includeCustomExtensions:true,
      copyright:'Original Crowns of the Frontier models; project-owned source.',
    });
    await writeFile('.tools/art-source/catalogue.glb',Buffer.from(output));
    await writeFile('.tools/art-source/catalogue.json',`${JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)}\n`);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({models:manifest.length,meshes:meshId,bytes:output.byteLength}));

    """Original Blender art pass: solid foliage, roof tiles, bevels and baked shading.
    
    Run with the project Blender executable in background mode after export-source.
    The output retains the game's semantic materials, joints and moving subgroups.
    """
    
    import bpy
    import bmesh
    import json
    import math
    import random
    from pathlib import Path
    from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
    from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    source = project / ".tools/art-source/catalogue.glb"
    out = project / ".tools/art-refined"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=str(source))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    materials = {}
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial"):
            materials.setdefault(obj["assetMaterial"], obj.data.materials[0])
    
    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:
                visit(child)
        visit(root)
        return result
    
    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj
    
    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
        faces.append(tuple(base + sides + i for i in range(sides)))
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            faces.append((base + i, base + j, base + sides + j, base + sides + i))
    
    def organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, detail):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=detail, radius=1)
        bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        base = len(vertices)
        for vert in bm.verts:
            p = vert.co
            noise = 1 + .12 * math.sin(p.x * 5 + p.y * 3) + rng.uniform(-.055, .055)
            vertices.append((center[0] + p.x * scale[0] * noise,
                             center[1] + p.y * scale[1] * noise,
                             center[2] + p.z * scale[2] * noise))
        for face in bm.faces:
            faces.append(tuple(base + vert.index for vert in face.verts))
        bm.free()
    
    def author_tree(root):
        _, biome, variant, lod = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        variant = int(variant)
        rng = random.Random(2201 + variant)
        far = lod == "far"
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        vertices, faces = [], []
        height = 5.8 + variant * .15
        rod_data(vertices, faces, (0, 0, 0), (.09, -.04, height * .77), .26, .42, 7 if far else 9)
        for i in range(4 if not far else 2):
            angle = i * math.tau / 4 + variant
            rod_data(vertices, faces, (0, 0, .35),
                     (math.cos(angle) * .72, math.sin(angle) * .72, .035), .15, .22)
        crowns = []
        for i in range(3 if far else 7):
            angle = i * 2.399 + variant
            radius = .8 if i else .15
            location = (math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius,
                        height - .1 - (i % 3) * .58)
            rod_data(vertices, faces, (.07, -.02, height * .55), location, .085, .22)
            crowns.append(location)
        make_mesh(root, "trunk", vertices, faces, root.name + "_Bark")
        if biome == "winter":
            for role, snow in [("leafDark", False), ("snow", True)]:
                vertices, faces = [], []
                for tier in range(3):
                    z = 2.2 + tier * 1.02 + (0.24 if snow else 0)
                    radius = (2.05 - tier * .4) * (.81 if snow else 1)
                    # Closed tiered crowns keep snow and foliage fully volumetric.
                    sides, base = (7 if far else 11), len(vertices)
                    for j in range(sides):
                        angle = j * math.tau / sides
                        vertices.append((math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius, z))
                    vertices.append((.04, -.03, z + (1.95 if snow else 2.3)))
                    faces.append(tuple(base + j for j in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
                    for j in range(sides):
                        faces.append((base + j, base + (j + 1) % sides, base + sides))
                make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
        else:
            for parity, role in [(0, "leaf"), (1, "leafDark")]:
                vertices, faces = [], []
                for i, center in enumerate(crowns):
                    if i % 2 != parity:
                        continue
                    scale = (1.4, 1.25, .78 if biome == "desert" else 1.12)
                    organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, 1 if far else 2)
                make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
    
    def weld(obj):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
        bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=list(bm.verts), dist=.00001)
        bm.normal_update()
        bm.to_mesh(obj.data)
        bm.free()
        obj.data.update()
    
    def roof_tiles(root):
        key = root["assetKey"]
        if not key.startswith("building:") or ":sun:" in key:
            return
        for roof in [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial") == "teamRoof"]:
            mesh = roof.data
            vertices = [roof.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in mesh.vertices]
            faces = [tuple(poly.vertices) for poly in mesh.polygons]
            tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
            minx, maxx = min(v.x for v in vertices), max(v.x for v in vertices)
            miny, maxy = min(v.y for v in vertices), max(v.y for v in vertices)
            top = max(v.z for v in vertices) + 1
            tile_vertices, tile_faces = [], []
            count = 0
            y = miny + .28
            while y < maxy - .15 and count < 140:
                x = minx + .29
                while x < maxx - .15 and count < 140:
                    point, normal, _, _ = tree.ray_cast(Vector((x, y, top)), Vector((0, 0, -1)))
                    if point is not None and .3 < normal.z < .95:
                        tangent = Vector((0, 1, 0))
                        tangent = (tangent - normal * tangent.dot(normal)).normalized()
                        across = tangent.cross(normal).normalized()
                        base = len(tile_vertices)
                        for depth in [0, .035]:
                            for a, b in [(-.285, -.235), (.285, -.235), (.285, .235), (-.285, .235)]:
                                tile_vertices.append(tuple(point + across * a + tangent * b + normal * (depth + .006)))
                        tile_faces.extend([(base,base+3,base+2,base+1),(base+4,base+5,base+6,base+7),
                                           (base,base+1,base+5,base+4),(base+1,base+2,base+6,base+5),
                                           (base+2,base+3,base+7,base+6),(base+3,base,base+4,base+7)])
                        count += 1
                    x += .6
                y += .49
            if tile_vertices:
                obj = make_mesh(root, "teamRoof", tile_vertices, tile_faces, root.name + "_SlateTiles")
                obj["nearOnly"] = True
    
    def bake_shading(root):
        meshes = [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH"]
        vertices, faces = [], []
        for obj in meshes:
            base = len(vertices)
            vertices.extend(obj.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in obj.data.vertices)
            faces.extend(tuple(base + v for v in poly.vertices) for poly in obj.data.polygons)
        tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
        is_unit = root["assetKey"].startswith("unit:")
        distance = .65 if is_unit else 1.6
        for obj in meshes:
            mesh = obj.data
            old = mesh.color_attributes.get("BakedDepth")
            if old:
                mesh.color_attributes.remove(old)
            colors = mesh.color_attributes.new(name="BakedDepth", type="FLOAT_COLOR", domain="POINT")
            mesh.color_attributes.active_color = colors
            matrix, normal_matrix = obj.matrix_world, obj.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted().transposed()
            for vert in mesh.vertices:
                p = matrix @ vert.co
                normal = (normal_matrix @ vert.normal).normalized()
                u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
                if u.length < .01:
                    u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
                u.normalize()
                v = normal.cross(u).normalized()
                occlusion = 0
                for direction in [normal, (normal + u * .8).normalized(),
                                  (normal - u * .8).normalized(), (normal + v * .8).normalized()]:
                    hit, _, _, dist = tree.ray_cast(p + normal * .018, direction, distance)
                    if hit is not None:
                        occlusion += 1 - dist / distance
                shade = max(.64, 1 - occlusion * .075)
                colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade, shade, shade, 1)
    
    for i, root in enumerate(roots):
        if root["assetKey"].startswith("tree:"):
            author_tree(root)
        for obj in descendants(root):
            if obj.type == "MESH":
                weld(obj)
        roof_tiles(root)
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        bake_shading(root)
        if (i + 1) % 12 == 0:
            print(f"Refined {i + 1}/{len(roots)} models", flush=True)
    
    def export(name, near):
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
        selected = []
        for root in roots:
            for obj in descendants(root):
                if not near and obj.get("nearOnly"):
                    continue
                obj.select_set(True)
                selected.append(obj)
        if near:
            for obj in selected:
                if obj.type != "MESH" or obj.get("assetMaterial") in ["leaf", "leafDark", "snow"]:
                    continue
                bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
                bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Crafted edges", "BEVEL")
                bevel.width = .009 if obj.get("motion") else .023
                bevel.segments = 1
                bevel.limit_method = "ANGLE"
                bevel.angle_limit = .8
                bevel.use_clamp_overlap = True
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(out / name), export_format="GLB",
                                 use_selection=True, export_apply=True,
                                 export_extras=True, export_animations=False,
                                 export_cameras=False, export_lights=False)
    
    export("frontier-low.glb", False)
    export("frontier-near.glb", True)
    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(out / "frontier-assets.blend"), compress=True)
    (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"models": len(roots), "source": "original game assets and authored Blender geometry",
                                                 "features": ["solid foliage", "slate tiles", "beveled edges", "baked vertex shading"]}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("Blender catalogue art pass complete.", flush=True)

    Usage: gltfpack [options] -i input -o output
    
    Basics:
        -i file: input file to process, .obj/.gltf/.glb
        -o file: output file path, .gltf/.glb
        -c: produce compressed gltf/glb files (-cc/-cz for higher compression ratio)
    
    Textures:
        -tc: convert all textures to KTX2 with BasisU supercompression
        -tu: use UASTC when encoding textures (much higher quality and much larger size)
        -tw: convert all textures to WebP
        -tq N: set texture encoding quality (default: 8; N should be between 1 and 10)
        -ts R: scale texture dimensions by the ratio R (default: 1; R should be between 0 and 1)
        -tl N: limit texture dimensions to N pixels (default: 0 = no limit)
        -tp: resize textures to nearest power of 2 to conform to WebGL1 restrictions
        -tfy: flip textures along Y axis during BasisU supercompression
        -tj N: use N threads when compressing textures
        -tr: keep referring to original texture paths instead of copying/embedding images
        Texture classes:
        -tc C: use ETC1S when encoding textures of class C
        -tu C: use UASTC when encoding textures of class C
        -tw C: use WebP when encoding textures of class C
        -tq C N: set texture encoding quality for class C
        -ts C R: scale texture dimensions for class C
        -tl C N: limit texture dimensions for class C
        ... where C is a comma-separated list (no spaces) with valid values color,normal,attrib
    
    Simplification:
        -si R: simplify meshes targeting triangle/point count ratio R (default: 1; R should be between 0 and 1)
        -se E: limit simplification error to E (default: 0.01 = 1% deviation; E should be between 0 and 1)
        -sv: simplify with vertex position and attribute optimization
        -sp: use permissive simplification mode to allow simplification across attribute discontinuities
        -sa: aggressively simplify to the target ratio disregarding quality
        -slb: lock border vertices during simplification to avoid gaps on connected meshes
    
    Vertex precision:
        -vp N: use N-bit quantization for positions (default: 14; N should be between 1 and 16)
        -vt N: use N-bit quantization for texture coordinates (default: 12; N should be between 1 and 16)
        -vn N: use N-bit quantization for normals (default: 8; N should be between 1 and 16) and tangents (up to 8-bit)
        -vc N: use N-bit quantization for colors (default: 8; N should be between 1 and 16)
    
    Vertex positions:
        -vpi: use integer attributes for positions (default)
        -vpn: use normalized attributes for positions
        -vpf: use floating point attributes for positions
    
    Vertex attributes:
        -vtf: use floating point attributes for texture coordinates
        -vnf: use floating point attributes for normals
        -vi: use interleaved vertex attributes (reduces compression efficiency)
        -gt: generate tangent frames when needed, replacing existing tangents
        -gn A: generate normals when absent, using crease angle A (degrees)
        -kv: keep source vertex attributes even if they aren't used
    
    Animations:
        -at N: use N-bit quantization for translations (default: 16; N should be between 1 and 24)
        -ar N: use N-bit quantization for rotations (default: 12; N should be between 4 and 16)
        -as N: use N-bit quantization for scale (default: 16; N should be between 1 and 24)
        -af N: resample animations at N Hz (default: 30; use 0 to disable)
        -ac: keep constant animation tracks even if they don't modify the node transform
    
    Scene:
        -kn: keep named nodes and meshes attached to named nodes so that named nodes can be transformed externally
        -km: keep named materials and disable named material merging
        -ke: keep extras data
        -mm: merge instances of the same mesh together when possible
        -mi: use EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing when serializing multiple mesh instances
    
    Miscellaneous:
        -cf: produce compressed gltf/glb files with fallback for loaders that don't support compression
        -ce ext|khr: use EXT or KHR version of meshopt compression extension for compression
        -noq: disable quantization; produces much larger glTF files with no extensions
        -v: verbose output (when used with other options)
        -v: print version (when used without other options)
        -r file: output a JSON report to file

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    
    const sources={
      low:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-low.glb',import.meta.url).href,
      high:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-near.glb',import.meta.url).href,
    };
    const pending=new Map();
    let active=null;
    
    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge
    // compressed meshes reliably, including normalized/interleaved source buffers.
    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      if(templates.size<100)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete.');
      active={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      return active;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const detail=quality==='low'?'low':'high';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength);
      })());
      try{active=await pending.get(detail);return active;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }
    
    export function authoredUnit(view,e){return cloneAsset(view,`unit:${e.type}`,e.owner);}
    export function authoredBuilding(view,e){
      const faction=view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.faction||'alder';
      const age=e.type==='towncenter'?(view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.age||0):0;
      // The harbor's pier depends on the actual shore, so its original dynamic
      // model remains responsible for orientation until its semantic pier is used.
      if(e.type==='dock')return null;
      return cloneAsset(view,`building:${e.type}:${faction}:${age}`,e.owner);
    }
    export function authoredResource(view,e){
      const key=e.kind==='shrine'?'resource:shrine':e.water?'resource:fish':`resource:${e.type}:${e.id%4}`;
      return cloneAsset(view,key,Math.max(0,e.owner||0));
    }
    export function authoredTree(view,map,variant,far){
      const biome=['winter','desert'].includes(map)?map:'highlands';
      return cloneAsset(view,`tree:${biome}:${variant}:${far?'far':'near'}`);
    }
