    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,treeModel,resourceModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {registerAuthoredAssets,clearAuthoredAssets} from '../src/authored-assets.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    async function catalogue(detail){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(new URL(`../src/assets3d/frontier-${detail==='high'?'near':'low'}.glb`,import.meta.url));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)
        .parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,bytes.length);
    }
    function fixture(catalogue,faction='alder',owner=0){
      const view=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      view.materials={};for(const template of catalogue.templates.values())template.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.isMesh&&part.userData.assetMaterial&&!['team','teamRoof'].includes(part.userData.assetMaterial))
          view.materials[part.userData.assetMaterial]??=part.material.clone();
      });
      view.materials.water??=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial();
      view.teamMaterials=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:i?0x9a687d:0x397f8c}));
      view.roofMaterials=view.teamMaterials.map(mat=>mat.clone());
      view.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      view.sim={players:Array.from({length:8},()=>({faction,age:3})),options:{seed:512,map:'highlands'},isWater:(x,z)=>z>5};
      return view;
    }
    function triangles(catalogue){let count=0;for(const geometry of catalogue.geometries)count+=(geometry.index?.count??geometry.attributes.position.count)/3;return count;}
    function solid(root){
      const size=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      assert.ok(size.x>0&&size.y>0&&size.z>0);
      root.traverse(part=>{if(!part.isMesh)return;for(const attr of ['position','normal','uv','color'])assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes[attr]);assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes.position.array.every(Number.isFinite));});
    }
    
    test('Blender catalogues cover all civilizations, buildings, troops, resources and forest detail levels',async()=>{
      try{
        for(const detail of ['low','high']){
          const assets=await catalogue(detail);assert.equal(assets.templates.size,122);
          for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
            const view=fixture(assets,faction);
            for(const [type,data] of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){
              const model=buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:0,z:0});
              assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.authored,true,`${type} is loaded from Blender`);
              solid(model);view.mergeModel(model);solid(model);
            }
            for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){
              const model=unitModel(view,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:51});
              assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.authored,true);solid(model);view.mergeModel(model);solid(model);
            }
          }
          const view=fixture(assets);
          for(const biome of ['highlands','winter','desert'])for(let variant=0;variant<4;variant++)for(const far of [false,true])solid(treeModel(view,biome,variant,far));
          for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'resource',id:51,type}));
          solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'resource',id:52,type:'food',water:true}));
          solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'shrine',id:53}));
        }
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });
    
    test('Blender joints, gates, windmills, shore orientation and team surfaces retain gameplay semantics',async()=>{
      try{
        const assets=await catalogue('low'),view=fixture(assets),e={kind:'unit',id:51,type:'knight',owner:7,moving:true,cooldown:0};
        const model=view.mergeModel(unitModel(view,e));let joint;
        model.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.motion?.type==='knee')joint=part;});assert.ok(joint);
        view.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(view,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();view.clock=.4;
        assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,animatePart(view,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).elements);
        let team=false;unitModel(view,{...e,type:'villager'}).traverse(part=>{if(part.material===view.teamMaterials[7])team=true;});assert.ok(team);
        const gate=view.mergeModel(buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'gate',owner:0,r:2.5,x:0,z:0}));assert.ok(gate.userData.portcullis?.children.some(part=>part.isMesh));
        const mill=view.mergeModel(buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'mill',owner:0,r:2.5,x:0,z:0}));let rotor;mill.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.windmill)rotor=part;});assert.ok(rotor?.children.some(part=>part.isMesh));
        const dock=buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'dock',owner:0,r:3.6,x:0,z:0});let pier;dock.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.dockPier)pier=part;});assert.ok(pier);assert.ok(Math.abs(pier.rotation.y)>0);
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });
    
    test('phone assets preserve the complete catalogue with smaller download and geometry budgets',async()=>{
      try{
        const high=await catalogue('high'),low=await catalogue('low');
        assert.deepEqual([...low.templates.keys()].sort(),[...high.templates.keys()].sort());
        assert.ok(low.bytes<high.bytes*.5);assert.ok(triangles(low)<triangles(high)*.6);
        assert.ok(low.bytes<3*1024*1024);
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    
    const sources={
      low:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-low.glb',import.meta.url).href,
      high:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-near.glb',import.meta.url).href,
    };
    const pending=new Map();
    let active=null;
    let loadSerial=0;
    
    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge
    // compressed meshes reliably, including normalized/interleaved source buffers.
    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      const positions=geometry.getAttribute('position');
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('color'))geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(positions.count*3).fill(1),3));
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('uv')){
        const uv=new Float32Array(positions.count*2);
        for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){uv[i*2]=positions.getX(i)*.25;uv[i*2+1]=(positions.getY(i)+positions.getZ(i))*.25;}
        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      if(templates.size<100)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete.');
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='low'?'low':'high';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());
      try{const catalogue=await pending.get(detail);if(serial===loadSerial)active=catalogue;return catalogue;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }
    
    export function authoredUnit(view,e){return cloneAsset(view,`unit:${e.type}`,e.owner);}
    export function authoredBuilding(view,e){
      const faction=view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.faction||'alder';
      const age=e.type==='towncenter'?(view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.age||0):0;
      const root=cloneAsset(view,`building:${e.type}:${faction}:${age}`,e.owner);
      if(root&&e.type==='dock')root.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.userData.dockPier)return;
        let angle=0;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(view.sim.isWater(e.x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*9,e.z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*9)){angle=i*Math.PI/8;break;}
        part.rotation.y=-angle;
      });
      return root;
    }
    export function authoredResource(view,e){
      const key=e.kind==='shrine'?'resource:shrine':e.water?'resource:fish':`resource:${e.type}:${e.id%4}`;
      return cloneAsset(view,key,Math.max(0,e.owner||0));

      assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);report.passed=true;
      console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));

      report.passed=false;report.failure=error.message;
      if(page){report.worldError=await page.locator('#world').innerText().catch(()=>'');await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-browser-failure.png'}).catch(()=>{});}
      console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));throw error;
    }finally{
      fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/authored-art-qa.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));await browser.close();
    }

    function jointAngle(view,m,e){
      const phase=view.clock*8.5+e.id*.7,walk=Math.sin(phase)*m.side;
      if(m.type==='wheel')return e.moving?view.clock*5:0;
      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm')return e.moving?-.15:0;
      if(m.type==='arm'){
        if(e.type==='villager'&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type||e.activity)&&!e.moving)return -.5+Math.sin(view.clock*6)*.55;
        if(e.cooldown>.45)return -.3-Math.sin((1.2-e.cooldown)*5)*.75;
        return e.moving?walk*.3:0;
      }
      return 0;
    }

    $taskPreviousScripts = $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS

        Start-Process -FilePath $taskBlender -WorkingDirectory $taskProject `
            -WindowStyle $taskWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $taskLog `
            -RedirectStandardError $taskErrorLog -PassThru |
            Select-Object Id,ProcessName

        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = $taskPreviousConfig
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = $taskPreviousScripts

    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']});
    const base=process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4173/',errors=[],reports=[];fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});
    async function open(page){page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'low',weather:'clear',music:false,volume:0,autoQuality:false})));await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);}

    """Original articulated medieval figures with adult proportions and real tools.
    
    Executed by refine-catalogue.py with its mesh/material helpers available.
    Coordinates and joint extras use the game's Y-up convention; authored mesh
    vertices are converted to Blender's Z-up convention for glTF export.
    """
    
    HUMANS = {"villager", "spearman", "swordsman", "archer", "scout", "knight", "monk", "king", "sentinel", "marksman", "outrider"}
    
    def author_human(root):
        key = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        unit = key[1]
        if unit not in HUMANS:
            return
        task = key[2] if len(key) > 2 else "wood"
        riding = unit in {"scout", "knight", "outrider"}
        armored = unit in {"spearman", "swordsman", "knight", "sentinel", "king"}
        offset = .78 if riding else 0
        # Retain the articulated horse; replace its rider and saddle independently.
        keep = set()
        if riding:
            for obj in descendants(root)[1:]:
                role = obj.get("assetMaterial")
                motion = obj.get("motion")
                if role in {"horse", "mane"} or (motion and motion.get("type") == "horseleg"):
                    keep.add(obj)
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):
            if obj not in keep:
                bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    
        batches = {}
        def add(role, verts, faces, motion=None):
            motion_key = json.dumps(motion, sort_keys=True) if motion else ""
            batch = batches.setdefault((role, motion_key), [[], [], motion])
            start = len(batch[0])
            batch[0].extend((x, -z, y) for x, y, z in verts)
            batch[1].extend(tuple(start + index for index in face) for face in faces)
    
        def section(role, center, rings, motion=None, sides=10):
            verts, faces = [], []
            for height, width, depth in rings:
                for i in range(sides):
                    angle = math.tau * i / sides
                    verts.append((center[0] + math.sin(angle) * width,
                                  center[1] + height, center[2] + math.cos(angle) * depth))
            faces.append(tuple(range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
            for ring in range(len(rings) - 1):
                for i in range(sides):
                    j = (i + 1) % sides
                    faces.append((ring * sides + i, ring * sides + j,
                                  (ring + 1) * sides + j, (ring + 1) * sides + i))
            faces.append(tuple((len(rings) - 1) * sides + i for i in range(sides)))
            add(role, verts, faces, motion)
    
        def bar(role, start, end, radius=.035, motion=None, taper=1, sides=7):
            a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
            direction = (b - a).normalized()
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
            if u.length < .001:
                u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
            u.normalize()
            v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
            verts, faces = [], []
            for center, scale in [(a, 1), (b, taper)]:
                for i in range(sides):
                    angle = i * math.tau / sides
                    verts.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * radius * scale))
            faces.extend([tuple(range(sides - 1, -1, -1)), tuple(sides + i for i in range(sides))])
            for i in range(sides):
                j = (i + 1) % sides
                faces.append((i, j, sides + j, sides + i))
            add(role, verts, faces, motion)
    
        def box(role, center, size, motion=None):
            x, y, z = center
            a, b, c = [v / 2 for v in size]
            verts = [(x-a,y-b,z-c),(x+a,y-b,z-c),(x+a,y+b,z-c),(x-a,y+b,z-c),
                     (x-a,y-b,z+c),(x+a,y-b,z+c),(x+a,y+b,z+c),(x-a,y+b,z+c)]
            add(role, verts, [(0,3,2,1),(4,5,6,7),(0,1,5,4),(1,2,6,5),(2,3,7,6),(3,0,4,7)], motion)
    
        torso = {"type":"torso", "pivot":[0,1.28+offset,0], "side":1}
        head = {"type":"head", "pivot":[0,2.14+offset,0], "side":1, "parent":torso}
        section("steel" if armored else "team", (0,offset,0),
                [(1.21,.25,.17),(1.38,.28,.18),(1.77,.36,.205),(1.94,.31,.17),(2.02,.16,.14)], torso)
        section("pants", (0,offset,0), [(1.1,.28,.18),(1.32,.27,.18)], torso)
        section("leather", (0,offset,0), [(1.29,.286,.188),(1.37,.286,.188)], torso)
        box("gold", (0,1.33+offset,.194), (.095,.065,.035), torso)
        if armored:
            box("team", (0,1.64+offset,.216), (.40,.50,.035), torso)
            bar("steel", (0,1.42+offset,.247), (0,1.93+offset,.247), .014, torso)
            for x in [-.145,.145]:
                for y in [1.48,1.78,1.93]:
                    section("gold", (x,y+offset,.245), [(-.015,.016,.012),(.015,.016,.012)], torso, sides=6)
        elif unit == "villager":
            box("canvas", (0,1.62,.218), (.37,.59,.025), torso)
            for x in [-.15,.15]:
                bar("leather", (x,1.36,.234), (x,1.98,.172), .014, torso)
        else:
            bar("leather", (-.25,1.44+offset,.19), (.25,1.93+offset,.19), .02, torso)
    
        bar("skin", (0,1.99+offset,0), (0,2.18+offset,0), .085, head)
        section("skin", (0,2.32+offset,.012),
                [(-.17,.085,.092),(-.11,.126,.112),(.015,.142,.122),(.115,.134,.111),(.18,.088,.077)], head, sides=12)
        for side in [-1,1]:
            section("skin", (side*.145,2.31+offset,0), [(-.045,.018,.023),(.045,.018,.024)], head, sides=6)
            section("hair", (side*.057,2.36+offset,.133), [(-.012,.013,.010),(.012,.013,.010)], head, sides=6)
            bar("hair", (side*.04,2.397+offset,.13), (side*.087,2.392+offset,.129), .006, head)
        add("skin", [(-.023,2.345+offset,.131),(.023,2.345+offset,.131),(0,2.285+offset,.174),
                     (-.025,2.286+offset,.132),(.025,2.286+offset,.132)],
            [(0,1,2),(0,2,3),(1,4,2),(3,2,4),(0,3,4,1)], head)
        bar("hair", (-.026,2.245+offset,.123), (.026,2.245+offset,.123), .004, head)
        section("hair", (0,2.32+offset,0), [(.085,.145,.124),(.18,.12,.10),(.205,.04,.035)], head)
        if unit == "villager":
            section("straw", (0,2.49,0), [(-.015,.29,.255),(.015,.29,.255),(.045,.15,.14),(.18,.10,.09)], head, sides=12)
        elif unit in {"archer","marksman","monk","scout","outrider"}:
            role = "canvas" if unit == "monk" else "team"
            section(role, (0,2.34+offset,-.035), [(-.08,.16,.14),(.11,.175,.15),(.235,.10,.08)], head)
        else:
            section("steel", (0,2.36+offset,-.01), [(-.02,.158,.142),(.13,.153,.13),(.22,.04,.04)], head)
            bar("steel", (0,2.51+offset,.147), (0,2.29+offset,.147), .025, head)
        if unit == "king":
            section("gold", (0,2.57,0), [(-.02,.17,.15),(.075,.17,.15)], head)
            for i in range(6):
                a = i * math.tau / 6
                bar("gold", (math.sin(a)*.16,2.61,math.cos(a)*.14),
                    (math.sin(a)*.16,2.78,math.cos(a)*.14), .025, head, taper=.2)
    
        hands = {}
        for side in [-1,1]:
            hip = [side*.18,1.26+offset,0]
            knee = [side*(.47 if riding else .18),.73+offset,.01]
            ankle = [side*(.52 if riding else .18),.19+offset,.035]
            leg = {"type":"leg","pivot":hip,"side":side}
            lower = {"type":"knee","pivot":knee,"side":side,"parent":leg}
            bar("pants", hip, knee, .118, leg, taper=.81, sides=9)
            bar("pants", knee, ankle, .088, lower, taper=.72, sides=9)
            section("leather", (ankle[0],offset,.08),[(.035,.094,.16),(.17,.095,.17),(.31,.067,.08)], lower, sides=9)
            if armored:
                box("steel", (knee[0],knee[1],knee[2]+.085), (.17,.19,.065), lower)
            shoulder = [side*.35,1.925+offset,0]
            elbow = [side*.46,1.63+offset,.035]
            hand = [side*.50,1.38+offset,.115]
            arm = {"type":"arm","pivot":shoulder,"side":side,"parent":torso}
            forearm = {"type":"forearm","pivot":elbow,"side":side,"parent":arm}
            bar("steel" if armored else "team", shoulder, elbow, .098, arm, taper=.88, sides=9)
            bar("leather" if armored else "team", elbow, hand, .078, forearm, taper=.7, sides=9)
            section("skin", hand, [(-.08,.05,.055),(.065,.058,.06)], forearm, sides=8)
            if armored:
                section("steel", shoulder, [(-.105,.14,.145),(.085,.12,.13)], arm, sides=9)
                section("leather", elbow, [(-.04,.085,.085),(.045,.085,.085)], forearm, sides=9)
            hands[side] = (hand,forearm)
    
        hand, tool = hands[1]
        x, y, z = hand
        if unit in {"spearman","knight","scout","outrider"}:
            bar("wood", (x,y-.65,z), (x,y+1.90,z), .026, tool)
            add("steel", [(x-.09,y+1.88,z),(x+.09,y+1.88,z),(x,y+2.18,z),
                          (x-.09,y+1.88,z+.035),(x+.09,y+1.88,z+.035),(x,y+2.18,z+.035)],
                [(0,1,2),(3,5,4),(0,3,4,1),(1,4,5,2),(2,5,3,0)],tool)
        elif unit in {"archer","marksman"}:
            left, bow_motion = hands[-1]
            bx,by,bz = left
            points=[]
            for i in range(9):
                a=-math.pi/2+i*math.pi/8
                points.append((bx+.22*math.cos(a),by+.49*math.sin(a),bz+.16))
            for a,b in zip(points,points[1:]):bar("wood",a,b,.026,bow_motion)
            bar("canvas",points[0],points[-1],.008,bow_motion)
            bar("wood",(bx,by,bz),(bx,by,bz+.75),.011,tool)
            section("leather",(.16,1.63,-.27),[(-.32,.095,.085),(.32,.095,.085)],torso)

        elif unit == "villager":

    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    
    const base=process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4174/';
    fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});
    const errors=[],report={checks:[],errors};
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']});
    let page;
    function watch(page){page.on('pageerror',error=>errors.push(error.message));page.on('console',message=>{if(message.type()==='error')errors.push(message.text());});}
    async function ready(page){await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'networkidle'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view,null,{timeout:90000});}
    try{
      page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});watch(page);
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'high',autoQuality:false,volume:0,music:false})));
      const started=Date.now();await ready(page);
      const boot=await page.evaluate(()=>({art:frontier.view.artDiagnostics,quality:frontier.view.settings.quality}));
      assert.equal(boot.art.models,122);assert.equal(boot.art.source,'Blender');assert.equal(boot.art.detail,'high');
      report.checks.push({boot,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started});console.log('Verified: the game starts with the detailed Blender catalogue.');
      await page.evaluate(()=>{
        frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',faction:'alder',difficulty:'normal',seed:512});
        const s=frontier.sim;s.owned(0,'unit','villager').forEach(e=>s.stop([e.id]));
        const sites=[['keep',-15,17],['gate',-8,33],['tower',-15,43],['farm',-36,49],['farm',-29,49],['market',-25,4],['range',-42,7],['stable',-48,18],['blacksmith',-51,35],['workshop',-19,54],['monastery',-55,51],['camp',-56,2],['mine',-21,-9],['wonder',-6,0]];
        for(const[type,x,z]of sites)s.addBuilding(type,0,x,z,true);
        for(let z=22;z<=45;z+=2.85)s.addBuilding('wall',0,-8,z,true);
        for(let i=0;i<36;i++)s.addUnit(['spearman','swordsman','archer','knight','ram','catapult'][i%6],0,-33+i%12*2.2,36+Math.floor(i/12)*2.3);
        s.updateFog();frontier.view.focus(-30,28);frontier.view.angle=.65;frontier.view.zoom=84;frontier.view.tilt=.65;frontier.view.updateCamera();
      });
      await page.waitForTimeout(700);await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Toggle battlefield panels'}).click();
      await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-kingdom-high.png'});
      const kingdom=await page.evaluate(()=>({
        authoredBuildings:[...frontier.view.nodes.values()].filter(n=>n.userData.model3d?.kind==='building'&&n.userData.model3d.authored).length,
        authoredUnits:[...frontier.view.nodes.values()].filter(n=>n.userData.model3d?.kind==='unit'&&n.userData.model3d.authored).length,
        calls:frontier.view.renderer.info.render.calls,triangles:frontier.view.renderer.info.render.triangles,
        memory:frontier.view.renderer.info.memory,
      }));assert.ok(kingdom.authoredBuildings>20);assert.ok(kingdom.authoredUnits>30);report.checks.push({kingdom});
      console.log('Verified: buildings and batched troops use the Blender models in the live battlefield.');
    
      await page.evaluate(()=>{const e=frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];frontier.select([e.id]);frontier.action('inspect');});
      await page.waitForTimeout(400);await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-villager-high.png'});
      const selection=await page.evaluate(()=>({target:frontier.view.target.toArray(),zoom:frontier.view.zoom,selected:[...frontier.view.selection],time:frontier.sim.time}));
      await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.quality('low'));
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>frontier.view.artDiagnostics?.detail==='low',null,{timeout:90000});
      const low=await page.evaluate(()=>({art:frontier.view.artDiagnostics,target:frontier.view.target.toArray(),zoom:frontier.view.zoom,selected:[...frontier.view.selection]}));
      assert.deepEqual(low.target,selection.target);assert.equal(low.zoom,selection.zoom);assert.deepEqual(low.selected,selection.selected);
      await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-villager-low.png'});report.checks.push({qualitySwitch:low});
      console.log('Verified: changing graphics detail preserves the camera and selection.');
    
      for(const map of ['winter','desert','canyon','rivers','valley','coast']){
        await page.evaluate(map=>frontier.start({mode:map==='coast'?'tides':'sandbox',map,faction:map==='desert'?'sun':'raven',difficulty:'normal',seed:512}),map);
        await page.waitForTimeout(180);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.artDiagnostics.models),122);
      }

      await page.waitForTimeout(300);await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-fleet-low.png'});
      report.checks.push({biomes:7,naval:true});await page.close();page=null;
    
      const phone=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:844,height:390},isMobile:true,hasTouch:true,deviceScaleFactor:2});page=phone;watch(phone);
      await phone.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'low',autoQuality:true,volume:0,music:false})));
      await ready(phone);await phone.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin your reign'}).tap();await phone.getByRole('button',{name:'Enter the frontier'}).tap();

      await phone.waitForFunction(()=>!!document.querySelector('#model-portrait canvas'));
      await phone.locator('[data-action=inspect]').tap();await phone.waitForTimeout(200);
      await phone.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-phone-landscape.png'});
      assert.equal(await phone.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth),false);
      assert.equal(await phone.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.artDiagnostics.detail),'low');
      report.checks.push({landscapeTouch:true,authoredPortrait:true,lowDetail:true});
      assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);report.passed=true;
      console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
    }catch(error){
      report.passed=false;report.failure=error.message;
      if(page){report.worldError=await page.locator('#world').innerText().catch(()=>'');await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-browser-failure.png'}).catch(()=>{});}
      console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));throw error;

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,treeModel,resourceModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {registerAuthoredAssets,clearAuthoredAssets} from '../src/authored-assets.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    async function catalogue(detail){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(new URL(`../src/assets3d/frontier-${detail==='high'?'near':'low'}.glb`,import.meta.url));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)
        .parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,bytes.length);
    }
    function fixture(catalogue,faction='alder',owner=0){
      const view=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      view.materials={};for(const template of catalogue.templates.values())template.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.isMesh&&part.userData.assetMaterial&&!['team','teamRoof'].includes(part.userData.assetMaterial))
          view.materials[part.userData.assetMaterial]??=part.material.clone();
      });
      view.materials.water??=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial();
      view.teamMaterials=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:i?0x9a687d:0x397f8c}));
      view.roofMaterials=view.teamMaterials.map(mat=>mat.clone());
      view.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      view.sim={players:Array.from({length:8},()=>({faction,age:3})),options:{seed:512,map:'highlands'},isWater:(x,z)=>z>5};
      return view;
    }
    function triangles(catalogue){let count=0;for(const geometry of catalogue.geometries)count+=(geometry.index?.count??geometry.attributes.position.count)/3;return count;}
    function solid(root){
      const size=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      assert.ok(size.x>0&&size.y>0&&size.z>0);
      root.traverse(part=>{if(!part.isMesh)return;for(const attr of ['position','normal','uv','color'])assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes[attr]);assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes.position.array.every(Number.isFinite));});
    }
    
    test('Blender catalogues cover all civilizations, buildings, troops, resources and forest detail levels',async()=>{
      try{
        for(const detail of ['low','high']){
          const assets=await catalogue(detail);assert.equal(assets.templates.size,122);
          for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
            const view=fixture(assets,faction);
            for(const [type,data] of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){
              const model=buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:0,z:0});
              assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.authored,true,`${type} is loaded from Blender`);
              solid(model);view.mergeModel(model);solid(model);
            }
            for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){
              const model=unitModel(view,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:51});
              assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.authored,true);solid(model);view.mergeModel(model);solid(model);
            }
          }
          const view=fixture(assets);
          for(const biome of ['highlands','winter','desert'])for(let variant=0;variant<4;variant++)for(const far of [false,true])solid(treeModel(view,biome,variant,far));
          for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'resource',id:51,type}));
          solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'resource',id:52,type:'food',water:true}));
          solid(resourceModel(view,{kind:'shrine',id:53}));
        }
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });
    
    test('Blender joints, gates, windmills, shore orientation and team surfaces retain gameplay semantics',async()=>{
      try{
        const assets=await catalogue('low'),view=fixture(assets),e={kind:'unit',id:51,type:'knight',owner:7,moving:true,cooldown:0};
        const model=view.mergeModel(unitModel(view,e));let joint;
        model.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.motion?.type==='knee')joint=part;});assert.ok(joint);
        view.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(view,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();view.clock=.4;
        assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,animatePart(view,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).elements);
        let team=false;unitModel(view,{...e,type:'villager'}).traverse(part=>{if(part.material===view.teamMaterials[7])team=true;});assert.ok(team);
        const gate=view.mergeModel(buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'gate',owner:0,r:2.5,x:0,z:0}));assert.ok(gate.userData.portcullis?.children.some(part=>part.isMesh));
        const mill=view.mergeModel(buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'mill',owner:0,r:2.5,x:0,z:0}));let rotor;mill.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.windmill)rotor=part;});assert.ok(rotor?.children.some(part=>part.isMesh));
        const dock=buildingModel(view,{kind:'building',type:'dock',owner:0,r:3.6,x:0,z:0});let pier;dock.traverse(part=>{if(part.userData.dockPier)pier=part;});assert.ok(pier);assert.ok(Math.abs(pier.rotation.y)>0);
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });
    
    test('phone assets preserve the complete catalogue with smaller download and geometry budgets',async()=>{
      try{
        const high=await catalogue('high'),low=await catalogue('low');
        assert.deepEqual([...low.templates.keys()].sort(),[...high.templates.keys()].sort());
        assert.ok(low.bytes<high.bytes*.5);assert.ok(triangles(low)<triangles(high)*.6);
        assert.ok(low.bytes<3*1024*1024);
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });

      render(container,e,now){
        if(now-(this.lastFrame||-1)<(this.view.settings.quality==='low'?1/12:1/24))return;this.lastFrame=now;
        if(this.renderer.domElement.parentElement!==container){container.textContent='';container.append(this.renderer.domElement);}
        this.show(e);const width=container.clientWidth,height=container.clientHeight;if(!width||!height)return;
        if(width!==this.width||height!==this.height){this.width=width;this.height=height;this.renderer.setSize(width,height,false);this.camera.aspect=width/height;this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
        const distance=this.radius*3.4/Math.min(1,this.camera.aspect);this.camera.position.set(distance*.68,distance*.28,distance*.72);this.camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
        this.model.traverse(part=>{if(!part.userData.motion)return;part.matrixAutoUpdate=false;part.matrix.copy(animatePart(this.view,part,e,this.poseIdentity??=new THREE.Matrix4()));});
        this.model.rotation.y=now*.25;this.renderer.render(this.scene,this.camera);
      }
    }
    
    export function renderModelPortrait(view){
      const target=document.getElementById('model-portrait');if(!target||document.hidden||view.portraitDisabled)return;
      const entity=view.sim.get(Number(target.dataset.entity));if(!entity)return;
      try{view.modelPortrait??=new ModelPortrait(view);view.modelPortrait.render(target,entity,view.clock);}catch(error){view.portraitDisabled=true;console.error('3D portrait could not start',error);}

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,MAPS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    import {cargoGeometry,WorldInteractions} from '../src/world-interactions.js';
    import {forestTransform} from '../src/realm-3d.js';
    
    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group,true),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);
        for(const [type,data]of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
        for(const type of Object.keys(UNITS)){const model=unitModel(v,{kind:'unit',type,owner:0,id:31});solidBounds(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.type,type);}
      }
    });
    test('forests, fruit, mineral deposits, fish and shrines use volumetric mesh models',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture();for(const type of ['food','gold','stone'])solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:51,kind:'resource',type}));
      solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:52,kind:'resource',type:'food',water:true}));solidBounds(resourceModel(v,{id:53,kind:'shrine'}));
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS))for(let i=0;i<4;i++)solidBounds(treeModel(v,map,i));
    });
    test('batching preserves model bounds and articulated joints remain animated',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),e={id:31,kind:'unit',type:'knight',owner:0,moving:true,cooldown:0};
      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});
      v.mergeModel(model);const after=solidBounds(model),parts=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)parts.push(m);});
      assert.ok(parts.length<raw.length);assert.ok(before.min.distanceTo(after.min)<.0001);assert.ok(before.max.distanceTo(after.max)<.0001);
      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);
    });
    
    test('town centers gain solid age architecture and preserve age metadata when batched',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture(),vertices=[];for(let age=0;age<4;age++){v.sim.players[0].age=age;const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type:'towncenter',owner:0,r:5,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);v.mergeModel(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.architectureAge,age);let count=0;model.traverse(part=>{if(part.isMesh)count+=part.geometry.getAttribute('position').count;});vertices.push(count);}
      assert.ok(vertices.every((count,i)=>i===0||count>vertices[i-1]),'each age adds physical arches, turrets or banners to the architecture');
    });
    
    test('carried resources use solid batched geometry and depletion leaves stumps with a bounded draw cost',()=>{
      const v=viewFixture();buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type:'towncenter',owner:0,r:5,x:-19,z:25});v.scene=new THREE.Scene();v.nodes=new Map();v.clock=0;v.groundHeight=()=>1;v.entityHeight=()=>1;v.sim.isVisible=()=>true;v.sim.isExplored=()=>true;
      for(const type of ['wood','food','gold','stone'])solidBounds(new THREE.Mesh(cargoGeometry(v,type),v.materials.wood));
      const worker=v.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],tree=v.sim.entities.find(e=>e.type==='wood');worker.carry=18;worker.carryType='wood';v.interactions=new WorldInteractions(v);tree.hp=0;tree.amount=0;v.interactions.update(.1,false);
      assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.cargo.wood,1);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.stumps,1);assert.equal(v.treeFalls.size,1);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.drawCalls,2);
      v.clock=2;v.interactions.update(.1,false);assert.equal(v.treeFalls.size,0);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.stumps,1);v.interactions.dispose();assert.equal(v.scene.children.length,0);
    });

      const base=new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(14,2.5,7),new THREE.Quaternion(),new THREE.Vector3(1.2,1.2,1.2)),v={clock:1,settings:{quality:'high'},weatherState:{intensity:1}};
      for(const [leaves,fall]of [[true,null],[false,{at:0}]]){const pose=forestTransform(v,base,31,leaves,fall).clone();assert.ok(pose.elements.every(Number.isFinite));assert.ok(Math.abs(pose.determinant()-base.determinant())<.0001);assert.deepEqual(new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(pose).toArray(),[14,2.5,7]);assert.notDeepEqual(pose.elements,base.elements);}
      v.settings.quality='low';assert.deepEqual(forestTransform(v,base,31,true).elements,base.elements);
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    
    const sources={
      low:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-low.glb',import.meta.url).href,
      high:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-near.glb',import.meta.url).href,
    };
    const pending=new Map();
    let active=null;
    let loadSerial=0;
    
    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge
    // compressed meshes reliably, including normalized/interleaved source buffers.
    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      const positions=geometry.getAttribute('position');
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('color'))geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(positions.count*3).fill(1),3));
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('uv')){
        const uv=new Float32Array(positions.count*2);
        for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){uv[i*2]=positions.getX(i)*.25;uv[i*2+1]=(positions.getY(i)+positions.getZ(i))*.25;}
        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      if(templates.size<100)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete.');
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='low'?'low':'high';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());
      try{const catalogue=await pending.get(detail);if(serial===loadSerial)active=catalogue;return catalogue;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }
    
    export function workerVisualTask(view,e){
      if(e.type!=='villager')return 'standard';
      if(['build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type))return 'build';
      const target=view.sim?.get?.(e.order?.target),resource=e.carryType||target?.type;
      if(['gold','stone'].includes(resource))return 'mine';
      if(resource==='food'||resource==='farm')return 'food';
      return 'wood';
    }
    export function authoredUnit(view,e){
      const task=workerVisualTask(view,e);
      return (e.type==='villager'?cloneAsset(view,`unit:villager:${task}`,e.owner):null)||cloneAsset(view,`unit:${e.type}`,e.owner);
    }
    export function authoredBuilding(view,e){
      const faction=view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.faction||'alder';
      const age=e.type==='towncenter'?(view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.age||0):0;
      const root=cloneAsset(view,`building:${e.type}:${faction}:${age}`,e.owner);
      if(root&&e.type==='dock')root.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.userData.dockPier)return;
        let angle=0;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(view.sim.isWater(e.x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*9,e.z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*9)){angle=i*Math.PI/8;break;}
        part.rotation.y=-angle;
      });
      return root;
    }
    export function authoredResource(view,e){
      const key=e.kind==='shrine'?'resource:shrine':e.water?'resource:fish':`resource:${e.type}:${e.id%4}`;
      return cloneAsset(view,key,Math.max(0,e.owner||0));
    }

    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $taskProject = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'))

    $taskBlender = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-4.5.14-windows-x64\blender.exe'
    $taskProfile = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-profile'
    $taskLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stdout.log'
    $taskErrorLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stderr.log'
    
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskBlender)) {
        throw 'Project Blender installation is missing.'
    }

    $taskExisting = Get-Process blender -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $taskBlender }
    if ($taskExisting) {
        $taskExisting | Select-Object Id,ProcessName
        return
    }
    
    $taskPreviousConfig = $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG
    $taskPreviousScripts = $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS
    try {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = Join-Path $taskProfile 'config'
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = Join-Path $taskProfile 'scripts'
        $taskWindow = if ($Visible) { 'Normal' } else { 'Hidden' }
        Start-Process -FilePath $taskBlender -WorkingDirectory $taskProject `
            -WindowStyle $taskWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $taskLog `
            -RedirectStandardError $taskErrorLog -PassThru |
            Select-Object Id,ProcessName
    } finally {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = $taskPreviousConfig
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = $taskPreviousScripts
    }

    export function forestTransform(view,base,id,leaves=false,fall=null){
      const pose=view.forestPose??=new THREE.Matrix4(),rotation=view.forestRotation??=new THREE.Matrix4();pose.copy(base);
      if(fall){const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(view.clock-fall.at)/1.5));rotation.makeRotationZ(t*t*1.48);pose.multiply(rotation);}

    export function cargoGeometry(view,type){
      const parts=[],add=(geometry,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,angle=0)=>{const copy=geometry.clone();copy.scale(sx,sy,sz);copy.rotateZ(angle);copy.translate(x,y,z);parts.push(copy);};

      else if(type==='stone')for(const [x,y]of [[-.12,-.05],[.12,-.05],[0,.1]])add(view.geo.rock3d,x,y,0,.19,.17,.20);

    }

    // Shared materials and one instanced shadow pass keep the depth cues affordable.
    function surfaceRelief(material,scale){
      if(!material.map)return;
      material.bumpMap=material.map.clone();
      material.bumpMap.colorSpace=THREE.NoColorSpace;
      material.bumpMap.needsUpdate=true;
      material.bumpScale=scale;
      material.roughness=.88;
      material.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    function initializeDepth(view){
      const sky=document.createElement('canvas');sky.width=128;sky.height=64;
      const c=sky.getContext('2d'),gradient=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);
      gradient.addColorStop(0,'#7ba3c3');gradient.addColorStop(.47,'#d7e3e8');
      gradient.addColorStop(.53,'#e4d5b1');gradient.addColorStop(1,'#465538');
      c.fillStyle=gradient;c.fillRect(0,0,128,64);
      const source=new THREE.CanvasTexture(sky);source.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      source.mapping=THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
      const generator=new THREE.PMREMGenerator(view.renderer);
      view.environmentTarget=generator.fromEquirectangular(source);
      view.scene.environment=view.environmentTarget.texture;view.scene.environmentIntensity=.3;
      source.dispose();generator.dispose();
    
      const m=view.materials;
      surfaceRelief(m.stone,.12);surfaceRelief(m.wood,.055);
      for(const roof of view.roofMaterials)surfaceRelief(roof,.085);
      m.plaster.color.setHex(0xd9c8a6);m.stone.color.setHex(0xb6b5a4);
      m.stoneDark.color.setHex(0x737e78);m.iron.metalness=.8;m.iron.roughness=.32;
      m.gold.metalness=.75;m.gold.roughness=.3;m.shadow.opacity=.06;

      view.geo.sphere.dispose();view.geo.sphere=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1);
    
      const shadowCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');shadowCanvas.width=shadowCanvas.height=64;
      const context=shadowCanvas.getContext('2d'),fade=context.createRadialGradient(32,32,3,32,32,32);
      fade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(14,26,20,.65)');fade.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(14,26,20,.34)');fade.addColorStop(1,'rgba(14,26,20,0)');
      context.fillStyle=fade;context.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
      const map=new THREE.CanvasTexture(shadowCanvas);map.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      const material=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map,transparent:true,opacity:.72,depthWrite:false});
      view.contactShadows=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1,1),material,1024);
      view.contactShadows.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);

      view.contactDummy=new THREE.Object3D();view.contactDummy.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
      view.scene.add(view.contactShadows);
    }
    
    function updateContacts(view,menu){
      const mesh=view.contactShadows,dummy=view.contactDummy;let count=0;
      for(const e of view.sim.entities){
        if(count===1024)break;
        if(e.hp<=0||e.embarked||e.water||UNITS[e.type]?.naval||e.type==='farm'||(e.kind==='building'&&e.progress===0))continue;
        const shown=menu||e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||view.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||(e.kind==='resource'&&view.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z));

        const normal=(view.contactNormal??=new THREE.Vector3()).set(view.groundHeight(x-.25,z)-view.groundHeight(x+.25,z),.5,view.groundHeight(x,z-.25)-view.groundHeight(x,z+.25)).normalize();
        dummy.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(view.contactForward??=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1),normal);
        dummy.scale.set(radius*2.8,radius*2.8,1);dummy.updateMatrix();mesh.setMatrixAt(count++,dummy.matrix);
      }

    }

    ROADMAP.md:1:# Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    ROADMAP.md:5:This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    ROADMAP.md:9:- Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    ROADMAP.md:11:- Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    ROADMAP.md:12:- Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    ROADMAP.md:14:- Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    ROADMAP.md:32:- Six chapters now have three authored stages each, original dialogue journals, optional completion medals, and active goal markers in the minimap and explored 3D world.
    ROADMAP.md:43:- Patrol and guard commands in the simulation, desktop/touch interface, saves, and authoritative network commands. Formation slots avoid blocked terrain. Partial paths no longer count as successful arrival; persistent blocked orders report feedback and yield to queued orders.

Used as a genre quality reference, not a statement of this project's implemented features.
    README.md:3:An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.4, **Kingdoms and skies**, adds custom battles with up to eight kingdoms, configurable human/AI slots, allies and enemies, independent AI difficulties, spacious maps, team multiplayer, and changing 3D weather. Staged campaigns, checkpoints, naval warfare, civilization-exclusive troops and upgrades, a technology tree, solid world models, elevated terrain, and landscape phone controls remain available.
    README.md:39:The world also has rooted trees with wind movement and winter snowcaps, falling harvested trees and persistent stumps, carried logs/sacks/ingots/rocks, shrinking ore deposits, stronger terrain relief, and town-center architecture that changes through the four ages. Cargo and stumps use at most five additional draw calls. The HUD, text, and square radar remain readable interface elements over the 3D battlefield.
    README.md:41:Low quality limits active rendering to 30 FPS and reduces particles, shadows and detail. When the browser reports at most 4 GB of memory or four processor threads, a fresh installation starts on Low; saved quality choices take precedence. Menus and hidden tabs render less often, and hidden world objects defer mesh allocation until revealed. These are performance budgets, not guarantees for every device. Start with Low quality and 80 population per kingdom on phones.
    README.md:48:- **Six campaign chapters:** settlement, river crossing, fortress defense, sacred valley, final siege, and a coastal invasion. All chapters can be played immediately. Each has three staged objectives, an original dialogue journal, an optional completion goal, and checkpoints. The river chapter requires a protected caravan escort; shrine control supports an alternative conquest route, and the coastal chapter supports landings or naval artillery.
    README.md:61:- Articulated walking, weapon motion, working villagers, rocking ships, ship wakes, drifting water textures, textured masonry and wood, gabled roofs, and biome-specific foliage. Hidden forests obey exploration. Battle audio includes impact layers, arrows, siege sounds, stereo placement, wind, birds, and ambient music, with bounded effects and audio voices.
    README.md:62:- Closer perspective cameras, selectable close/perspective/overview angles, mouse and touch rotation, surface relief, directional lighting, sharper camera-centered shadows, timber framing, window recesses, and shared instanced contact shadows that remain available in Performance quality.
    README.md:64:- All seven maps have seeded rolling terrain and surrounding ridges. Picking, walking, building foundations, effects, previews, and fog follow the surface. Bridges stay dry and naval channels have submerged beds. Water has moving vertices and updated normals. Nearby gate portcullises lift for friendly troops.
    README.md:136:The production output is in `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web host. The generated service worker caches the game and its bundled assets for offline use after the first successful visit over HTTPS (or localhost). The web app manifest requests fullscreen landscape when installed. Browser support for fullscreen, installation, and orientation locking varies. Fonts and their licenses are bundled locally. No game assets depend on a third-party CDN.
    README.md:156:- `src/landscape.js`: seeded elevated terrain, triangulated surface sampling and ray picking, river/coastal beds, bridges, terrain textures, solid grass tufts, and animated water meshes.
    README.md:158:- `src/realm-3d.js`: terrain/model integration, packed forest detail levels, foundations, construction clipping and scaffolds, previews, gate motion, and solid projectiles.
    README.md:175:The design draws on the genre's established exploration → resource collection → construction → army → age progression loop and varied victory conditions described in the [official Age of Empires IV quickstart](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/quickstart-guide-age-of-empires-iv/) and [official strategy introduction](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-tips-to-help-you-get-started/). Picking and repeated-model rendering follow the [Three.js Raycaster](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html) and [InstancedMesh](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/InstancedMesh.html) documentation.
    README.md:177:Instanced animation follows the [Three.js update documentation](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/how-to-update-things.html). Room transport and heartbeat handling follow the [official ws documentation](https://github.com/websockets/ws). The naval design considers fishing economies, transport landings, and shoreline defense described in the [official Age of Empires naval update](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-11-0-782/).
    README.md:179:The graphics use shaped [CapsuleGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/CapsuleGeometry.html), solid architectural [ExtrudeGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/ExtrudeGeometry.html), and indexed terrain [BufferGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/BufferGeometry.html). Distant forests use simpler solid geometry and pack only visible instances; world objects do not switch to billboard images.
    README.md:183:This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Wi-Fi custom battles support up to eight human/AI kingdoms; public internet matchmaking, accounts, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production-scale backend service are not included. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.

    export class Landscape {

        const xx=(x+this.worldSize)/grid.size*grid.segments,zz=(z+this.worldSize)/grid.size*grid.segments,ix=Math.min(grid.segments-1,Math.floor(xx)),iz=Math.min(grid.segments-1,Math.floor(zz)),u=xx-ix,v=zz-iz,stride=grid.segments+1,a=iz*stride+ix;

    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:
                visit(child)
        visit(root)
        return result
    
    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj
    
    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
        faces.append(tuple(base + sides + i for i in range(sides)))
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            faces.append((base + i, base + j, base + sides + j, base + sides + i))
    
    def organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, detail):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=detail, radius=1)
        bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        base = len(vertices)
        for vert in bm.verts:
            p = vert.co
            noise = 1 + .12 * math.sin(p.x * 5 + p.y * 3) + rng.uniform(-.055, .055)
            vertices.append((center[0] + p.x * scale[0] * noise,
                             center[1] + p.y * scale[1] * noise,
                             center[2] + p.z * scale[2] * noise))
        for face in bm.faces:
            faces.append(tuple(base + vert.index for vert in face.verts))
        bm.free()

    def bake_shading(root):

        vertices, faces = [], []

            faces.extend(tuple(base + v for v in poly.vertices) for poly in obj.data.polygons)
        tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)

    def export(name, near):
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
        selected = []
        for root in roots:
            for obj in descendants(root):
                if not near and obj.get("nearOnly"):
                    continue
                obj.select_set(True)
                selected.append(obj)
        if near:
            for obj in selected:
                if obj.type != "MESH" or obj.get("assetMaterial") in ["leaf", "leafDark", "snow"]:
                    continue
                bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
                bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Crafted edges", "BEVEL")
                bevel.width = .009 if obj.get("motion") else .023
                bevel.segments = 1
                bevel.limit_method = "ANGLE"
                bevel.angle_limit = .8
                bevel.use_clamp_overlap = True
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(out / name), export_format="GLB",
                                 use_selection=True, export_apply=True,

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {animatePart} from './world-polish.js';
    
    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.
    // Picking uses the packed IDs, never the allocator's potentially empty slots.
    export function beginUnitFrame(view){
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values())batch.renderIds.length=0;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      for(const part of batch.parts)part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));
      return true;
    }
    
    export function endUnitFrame(view){
      let drawn=0,allocated=0,activeBatches=0;
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){
        const count=batch.renderIds.length;drawn+=count;allocated+=batch.ids.length-batch.free.length;
        if(count)activeBatches++;
        for(const part of batch.parts){part.count=count;part.visible=count>0;part.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;part.boundingSphere=null;}
      }
      view.unitRenderDiagnostics={drawn,allocated,activeBatches};
    }

    import {beginUnitFrame,writeUnitPose,endUnitFrame,nearViewport} from '../src/render-batches.js';
    
    test('unit poses pack visible IDs despite freed slots, fog and embarked troops',()=>{
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,1,.1,200);camera.position.set(0,30,40);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
      const batch={ids:[41,null,73,84],free:[1],renderIds:[],parts:[new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial(),10)]};
      batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds=batch.renderIds;
      const view={camera,unitBatches:new Map([['troops',batch]]),clock:1};
      beginUnitFrame(view);
      assert.ok(nearViewport(view,0,0,0));assert.equal(nearViewport(view,800,0,0),false);
      assert.ok(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:73},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(2,0,0),true));
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),false),false);
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:84},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(800,0,0),true),false);
      endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds,[73]);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,1);
      const pose=new THREE.Matrix4();batch.parts[0].getMatrixAt(0,pose);assert.equal(pose.elements[12],2);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.ids,[41,null,73,84]);assert.equal(view.unitRenderDiagnostics.allocated,3);
      beginUnitFrame(view);endUnitFrame(view);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,0);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,false);
      beginUnitFrame(view);writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),true);endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,true);assert.deepEqual(batch.renderIds,[41]);
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {seededRandom} from './data.js';
    import {nearViewport} from './render-batches.js';
    
    export function grassTuftGeometry(){
      const vertices=[],indices=[],uv=[];
      for(let blade=0;blade<6;blade++){
        const angle=blade*2.399,h=.28+(blade%3)*.11,w=.035,lean=.12;
        const center=new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(angle)*.12,0,Math.cos(angle)*.12);
        const across=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(angle),0,-Math.sin(angle));
        const front=new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(angle),0,Math.cos(angle));
        const base=vertices.length/3;
        for(const [width,y,bend,thickness] of [[w,0,0,.009],[w*.7,h*.55,lean*.3,.006]]){
          for(const [side,depth] of [[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]]){
            const p=center.clone().addScaledVector(across,side*width).addScaledVector(front,bend+depth*thickness);p.y=y;
            vertices.push(...p.toArray());uv.push((side+1)*.5,y/h);

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GroundCover,grassTuftGeometry} from '../src/ground-cover.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    
    test('grass blades are closed solid meshes with thickness and finite normals',()=>{
      const geometry=grassTuftGeometry(),edges=new Map(),index=geometry.index.array;
      for(let i=0;i<index.length;i+=3)for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const a=index[i+k],b=index[i+(k+1)%3],key=Math.min(a,b)+':'+Math.max(a,b);edges.set(key,(edges.get(key)||0)+1);}
      assert.ok([...edges.values()].every(count=>count===2));
      assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y>.4);assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.z-geometry.boundingBox.min.z>.1);
      assert.ok(geometry.attributes.normal.array.every(Number.isFinite));assert.equal(geometry.index.count/3,84);geometry.dispose();
    });
    
    test('seeded ground cover obeys terrain, exploration and newly built foundations with one draw call',()=>{
      const land=new Landscape(512,'highlands'),view={landscape:land,terrain:new THREE.Group(),settings:{quality:'low',fog:true},sim:{entities:[],isExplored:()=>false},clock:0,target:new THREE.Vector3(),zoom:40,angle:0,tilt:.7};
      const cover=new GroundCover(view),copy=new GroundCover({...view,terrain:new THREE.Group()});
      assert.deepEqual(cover.entries,copy.entries);assert.ok(cover.entries.length>400);
      cover.update(false,true);assert.equal(cover.mesh.count,0);
      view.sim.isExplored=()=>true;cover.update(false,true);const count=cover.mesh.count;assert.ok(count>400);assert.equal(view.groundCoverDiagnostics.drawCalls,1);
      const e=cover.entries[0];view.sim.entities.push({kind:'building',x:e.x,z:e.z,r:15,hp:100});cover.update(false,true);assert.ok(cover.mesh.count<count);
      const matrix=new THREE.Matrix4();for(let i=0;i<cover.mesh.count;i++){cover.mesh.getMatrixAt(i,matrix);assert.ok(Math.hypot(matrix.elements[12]-e.x,matrix.elements[14]-e.z)>=15.99);}
      for(const item of [cover,copy]){item.mesh.geometry.dispose();item.mesh.material.dispose();item.mesh.dispose();}
    });

    """Original articulated medieval figures with adult proportions and real tools.
    
    Executed by refine-catalogue.py with its mesh/material helpers available.
    Coordinates and joint extras use the game's Y-up convention; authored mesh
    vertices are converted to Blender's Z-up convention for glTF export.

    HUMANS = {"villager", "spearman", "swordsman", "archer", "scout", "knight", "monk", "king", "sentinel", "marksman", "outrider"}
    
    def author_human(root):
        key = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        unit = key[1]
        if unit not in HUMANS:
            return
        task = key[2] if len(key) > 2 else "wood"
        riding = unit in {"scout", "knight", "outrider"}
        armored = unit in {"spearman", "swordsman", "knight", "sentinel", "king"}
        offset = .78 if riding else 0

        keep = set()
        if riding:
            for obj in descendants(root)[1:]:
                role = obj.get("assetMaterial")
                motion = obj.get("motion")
                if role in {"horse", "mane"} or (motion and motion.get("type") == "horseleg"):
                    keep.add(obj)
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):

                bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)

            batch[1].extend(tuple(start + index for index in face) for face in faces)
