    # Version 2.4 verification
    
    Checked 10 October 2026. This records observed checks, rather than a claim that all possible bugs or all device configurations have been ruled out.
    
    ## Automated game checks
    
    `npm test`: **118 passed, zero failed**. Coverage includes paid gathering/construction/training/research; ages and civilization restrictions; counters, healing and siege; walls, gates and bridges; fleets and transports; all modes and staged campaigns; checkpoints and save compatibility; production batches; custom alliances, large-map fog/navigation/picking, each victory rule, independent AI clocks, seeded weather, real WebSocket rooms, shore-aware invasion targets, fleet population reserves, visible work animations, solid cargo/tree transforms, secure hosted endpoints and canceled reconnect timers.
    
    Eight simultaneous real WebSocket clients exercised readiness, private economies and fog, command ownership, reconnect recovery, host elimination and alliance results. Mixed human/AI rooms also passed. These tests use isolated services and do not modify live player rooms.
    
    ## Custom battle and 3D checks
    
    `scripts/custom-battle-qa.mjs` passed in a real Edge renderer with desktop and emulated landscape-phone layouts:
    
    - Huge 400 Ã— 400 battlefield, eight kingdoms, independent AI difficulty and eight army materials.
    - Actual terrain clicks beyond the former Â±160 picking limit and full-map radar navigation.
    - Deferred unseen-mesh allocation, persistent objective scrolling/rules, and custom save/resume with a paid training queue.
    - Volumetric rain with three effect draw calls; quality-limited snow, weather settings and optional lightning.
    - Square minimap, touch interaction and no horizontal page overflow at 844 Ã— 390.
    
    `scripts/custom-multiplayer-qa.mjs` passed with desktop and phone-sized browsers, a third real WebSocket commander and an AI kingdom: guest slot choice, host/guest readiness, private local perspectives, rejected foreign commands, phone production, reload/rejoin, host defeat without ending the match, and correct alliance victory/defeat.
    
    The machine reports approximately 4 GB RAM. Three simultaneous 3D browser contexts timed out without a JavaScript error; a later two-renderer run also timed out during startup. The current mixed-room check keeps two browser connections, suspends rendering in the background desktop host, actively renders the landscape-phone client, and connects a third real WebSocket commander. This is not a simultaneous multi-device FPS measurement. Failed attempts remain recorded in the browser report. A reconnect assertion was corrected to count both queued and completed paid units in the received resume state, because production can finish while a cold browser redraws.
    
    `scripts/interactions-qa.mjs` passed actual harvesting, carried logs/sacks/ingots/rocks, tree falls and persistent stumps, ore depletion, one-time town-center model replacement per age change, huge-map fog/grass coverage and landscape-phone camera interaction. The scene contains no sprites. Four repeated Huge winter matches held GPU counts at **245 geometries and 11 textures** in this fixture. Cargo/stumps used at most five extra draw calls. This follows Three.js's [explicit resource disposal guidance](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/how-to-dispose-of-objects.html) and [mesh batching guidance](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/optimize-lots-of-objects.html).
    
    ## Full-match diagnostic
    
    `scripts/battle-benchmark.mjs`, seed 512, Huge highlands, eight Hard AI kingdoms, standard resources and an 80-person cap:
    
    - Started with the normal economy. The diagnostic alone assigned AI control to the normal human slot.
    - All kingdoms reached Imperial Age. The winning alliance eliminated every opposing building through normal production and combat, finishing at **977.4 simulated seconds** (about 16 minutes).
    - CPU-only simulation tick times: median **10.44 ms**, p95 **21.24 ms**, p99 **30.10 ms**, maximum **65.68 ms** on this run. These are simulation timings, not rendered FPS or phone timings.
    - An earlier pre-optimization match also reached a normal result after about 29 simulated minutes. Battle length is situational, without a forced minimum timer.
    
    Recorded artifacts include `artifacts/battle-benchmark-highlands.json`, the earlier baseline/pre-route-cache reports, custom browser JSON reports and screenshots.
    
    The expanded coastal audit initially exposed stalled cross-shore orders, repeated harbor losses and fleet recruitment starvation. After the fixes, the eight-Hard-AI Huge coast diagnostic reached normal all-building victory at **1138.8 simulated seconds** (about 19 minutes), with all kingdoms reaching Imperial Age. It used standard starting resources, paid production and actual combat. The earlier fleet-fix run also reached victory at 778.5 seconds; flanking strategy changed the final battle's course. The final report is `artifacts/battle-benchmark-coast.json`, with failed/stalled earlier runs retained separately. It ran alongside browser checks on this low-memory machine: median tick 12.86 ms, p95 73.86 ms and a 2.51-second maximum under contention. These timings are not a standalone performance baseline or evidence of smooth phone FPS.
    
    ## Corrections made during the audit
    
    Corrected outer-map picking, resource/harbor overlap, coastal resource access, final-load delivery after deposits/shoals are exhausted, sustained AI attack orders, final-building visibility for AI, naval boarding reservations, individual AI ownership/budgets, private research/error notices and objective scroll resets. Added straight-route checks, connected movement regions, reusable path buffers, valid-route retention, blocked-order retry limits, vision indexing and shared composition calculations. Low quality and background/menu rendering budgets reduce work; saved graphics preferences remain respected.
    
    Further corrections include harbor rebuilding without free resources, market trade recovery at the real price threshold, current-shore army orders and retreats, legal capital scouting, searches after clearing a capital, canceled-voyage retries, formation-safe unloading beside occupied harbors, reserved fleet population, transport replacement priority, fuller siege/healer invasion crews and flanking shores chosen from observed defenses. Cargo now uses current interpolated unit positions; town-center age metadata survives batching, and allied units open modeled gate portcullises.

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {mergeGeometries} from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
    import {UNITS,seededRandom} from './data.js';

    function fallenGeometry(view,e){
      const model=view.mergeModel(view.makeUnit({...e,moving:false,cooldown:0,order:null})),parts=[];
      model.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh||part.material.transparent)return;
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);
        if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
        const position=geometry.attributes.position,existing=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(position.count*3),color=part.material.color;
        for(let i=0;i<position.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++)colors[i*3+k]=(existing?existing.getComponent(i,k):1)*color.getComponent(k);
        geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));parts.push(geometry);
      });
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();view.releaseNode(model);
      return result;
    }
    
    // Cosmetic remains never enter the simulation, navigation grid or picking set.
    export class BattleRemains{
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;this.group=new THREE.Group();this.group.name='Battle remains';view.scene.add(this.group);
        this.limit=view.settings.quality==='high'?24:8;this.items=[];this.batches=new Map();this.seen=new Set();this.dummy=new THREE.Object3D();this.color=new THREE.Color();
        this.material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.92,metalness:.08});
        this.rubble=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xffffff,roughness:1}),this.limit*12);
        this.rubble.name='Solid masonry and timber rubble';this.rubble.count=0;this.rubble.frustumCulled=false;this.rubble.castShadow=view.settings.quality!=='low';this.rubble.receiveShadow=true;this.rubble.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);this.group.add(this.rubble);
      }
      spawn(e){
        const v=this.view;if(!e||this.seen.has(e.id)||!['unit','building'].includes(e.kind))return;
        this.seen.add(e.id);if(this.seen.size>2048)this.seen.delete(this.seen.values().next().value);
        if(e.owner!==0&&!v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||!nearViewport(v,e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z),e.z))return;
        const item={...e,at:v.clock,life:v.settings.quality==='high'?16:10};
        if(e.kind==='unit'){
          item.key=e.owner+':'+e.type+':'+workerVisualTask(v,e);
          if(!this.batches.has(item.key)){
            const geometry=fallenGeometry(v,e);if(!geometry)return;
            const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry,this.material,this.limit);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=v.settings.quality!=='low';mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);this.group.add(mesh);this.batches.set(item.key,{mesh,last:v.clock});
          }
        }else{
          const rng=seededRandom(e.id+517);item.chunks=Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>({dx:(rng()-.5)*e.r*1.8,dz:(rng()-.5)*e.r*1.8,scale:.2+rng()*Math.min(1,e.r*.2),height:.5+rng()*1.2,angle:rng()*Math.PI,color:i%3===0?0x75634f:0x9b9c8e}));
        }
        this.items.push(item);if(this.items.length>this.limit)this.items.shift();
      }
      update(){
        const v=this.view;this.items=this.items.filter(e=>v.clock-e.at<e.life);
        for(const batch of this.batches.values())batch.mesh.count=0;
        let rubble=0,bodies=0;
        for(const e of this.items){
          if(e.owner!==0&&!v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||!nearViewport(v,e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z),e.z))continue;
          const age=v.clock-e.at,sink=Math.max(0,(age-e.life+3)/3);
          if(e.key){
            const batch=this.batches.get(e.key),naval=UNITS[e.type].naval;
            const fall=Math.min(1,age/.65);this.dummy.position.set(e.x,(naval?.08:v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z)+.18)-sink*.65-(naval?fall*1.3:0),e.z);
            this.dummy.rotation.set(0,e.heading||0,naval?fall*.25:fall*1.48);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(1);this.dummy.updateMatrix();batch.mesh.setMatrixAt(batch.mesh.count++,this.dummy.matrix);batch.last=v.clock;bodies++;
          }else{
            const t=Math.min(1,age/.9);
            for(const chunk of e.chunks){const x=e.x+chunk.dx*t,z=e.z+chunk.dz*t;this.dummy.position.set(x,v.groundHeight(x,z)+chunk.scale*.35+Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*chunk.height-sink*.9,z);this.dummy.rotation.set(t*.8,chunk.angle,t*.35);this.dummy.scale.set(chunk.scale*1.4,chunk.scale*.65,chunk.scale);this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.rubble.setMatrixAt(rubble,this.dummy.matrix);this.rubble.setColorAt(rubble,this.color.setHex(chunk.color));rubble++;}
          }
        }
        let calls=rubble?1:0;
        for(const [key,batch] of this.batches){batch.mesh.visible=batch.mesh.count>0;batch.mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;batch.mesh.boundingSphere=null;if(batch.mesh.count)calls++;
          if(!batch.mesh.count&&(v.clock-batch.last>30||this.batches.size>this.limit*2)){batch.mesh.geometry.dispose();batch.mesh.dispose();batch.mesh.removeFromParent();this.batches.delete(key);}
        }
        this.rubble.count=rubble;this.rubble.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;if(this.rubble.instanceColor)this.rubble.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;
        v.remainsDiagnostics={bodies,rubble,retained:this.items.length,limit:this.limit,drawCalls:calls};
      }
      dispose(){for(const batch of this.batches.values()){batch.mesh.geometry.dispose();batch.mesh.dispose();}this.material.dispose();this.rubble.geometry.dispose();this.rubble.material.dispose();this.rubble.dispose();this.group.removeFromParent();}
    }
    
    export function installBattleRemains(WorldView){
      const p=WorldView.prototype,attach=p.attach,effect=p.effect,render=p.render;
      p.attach=function(sim){this.remains?.dispose();attach.call(this,sim);this.remains=new BattleRemains(this);};
      p.effect=function(event){if(event.type==='death')this.remains?.spawn(event.entity);effect.call(this,event);};
      p.render=function(dt,menu){this.remains?.update();render.call(this,dt,menu);};
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {BattleRemains} from '../src/battle-remains.js';
    
    function fixture(){
      const geometry=new THREE.BoxGeometry(.7,2,.4),material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x397f8c});
      const view={clock:0,scene:new THREE.Scene(),settings:{quality:'low'},sim:{entities:[],isVisible:()=>true},groundHeight:()=>2,materials:{},
        makeUnit(){const group=new THREE.Group(),mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);mesh.position.y=1;group.add(mesh);return group;},
        mergeModel:WorldView.prototype.mergeModel,releaseNode(model){model.traverse(mesh=>mesh.geometry?.dispose());}};
      return view;
    }
    
    test('fallen units stay volumetric and colored with a bounded lifetime, without entering gameplay state',()=>{
      const view=fixture(),pool=new BattleRemains(view),e={id:1,owner:0,type:'swordsman',kind:'unit',x:3,z:4,heading:.4};
      pool.spawn(e);pool.spawn(e);assert.equal(pool.items.length,1);assert.equal(view.sim.entities.length,0);
      const batch=[...pool.batches.values()][0];assert.ok(batch.mesh.geometry.attributes.color.array.some(color=>color>0&&color<1));
      pool.update();const a=new THREE.Matrix4();batch.mesh.getMatrixAt(0,a);view.clock=.7;pool.update();const b=new THREE.Matrix4();batch.mesh.getMatrixAt(0,b);assert.notDeepEqual(a.elements,b.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(b.determinant()-1)<.001);
      for(let i=2;i<20;i++)pool.spawn({...e,id:i});pool.update();assert.equal(pool.items.length,8);assert.equal(batch.mesh.count,8);assert.equal(view.remainsDiagnostics.drawCalls,1);
      view.sim.isVisible=()=>false;pool.spawn({...e,id:99,owner:1});assert.equal(pool.items.length,8);
      view.clock=11;pool.update();assert.equal(batch.mesh.count,0);assert.equal(view.remainsDiagnostics.retained,0);pool.dispose();assert.equal(view.scene.children.length,0);
    });
    
    test('building destruction scatters solid rubble within an affordable instanced budget',()=>{
      const view=fixture(),pool=new BattleRemains(view);pool.spawn({id:20,owner:0,type:'towncenter',kind:'building',x:3,z:4,r:5});
      view.clock=.45;pool.update();assert.equal(pool.rubble.count,12);assert.equal(view.remainsDiagnostics.drawCalls,1);
      const pose=new THREE.Matrix4();for(let i=0;i<12;i++){pool.rubble.getMatrixAt(i,pose);assert.ok(pose.elements.every(Number.isFinite));assert.ok(pose.determinant()>0);assert.ok(pose.elements[13]>2);}
      view.clock=10.1;pool.update();assert.equal(pool.rubble.count,0);pool.dispose();
    });

    - `vite.config.js`: build splitting and offline cache generation.
    
    ## Research and scope
    
    The design draws on the genre's established exploration → resource collection → construction → army → age progression loop and varied victory conditions described in the [official Age of Empires IV quickstart](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/quickstart-guide-age-of-empires-iv/) and [official strategy introduction](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-tips-to-help-you-get-started/). Picking and repeated-model rendering follow the [Three.js Raycaster](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html) and [InstancedMesh](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/InstancedMesh.html) documentation.
    
    Instanced animation follows the [Three.js update documentation](https://threejs.org/manual/pages/how-to-update-things.html). Room transport and heartbeat handling follow the [official ws documentation](https://github.com/websockets/ws). The naval design considers fishing economies, transport landings, and shoreline defense described in the [official Age of Empires naval update](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-11-0-782/).
    
    The graphics use shaped [CapsuleGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/CapsuleGeometry.html), solid architectural [ExtrudeGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/ExtrudeGeometry.html), and indexed terrain [BufferGeometry](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/BufferGeometry.html). Distant forests use simpler solid geometry and pack only visible instances; world objects do not switch to billboard images.
    
    Custom setup and elimination rules were researched against the official [Age of Empires civilization/game-mode guide](https://www.ageofempires.com/learn-to-play/civilizations-game-modes-aoe2/), [ending a match guide](https://www.ageofempires.com/learn-to-play/ending-a-match-aoe2/), and [military/economy guide](https://www.ageofempires.com/learn-to-play/military-and-economy-aoe2/). The resulting rules are this game's own implementation.
    
    This is an original playable RTS implementation with procedural art, fictional civilizations, and its own balance. It contains no Age of Empires assets or licensed branding. Wi-Fi custom battles support up to eight human/AI kingdoms; public internet matchmaking, accounts, historical documentary campaigns, professional voice acting, and a production-scale backend service are not included. Commercial AAA parity is not claimed. Balance and performance need broader human playtesting and real-device testing; smooth performance on every device cannot be guaranteed.
    # Kingdoms and skies (version 2.4)
    
    - Rooted near-detail trees, solid winter snowcaps, wind movement, harvested tree falls and persistent stumps. Batched 3D cargo follows villagers, ore visibly shrinks with depletion, and town-center architecture gains physical features at each age. Stronger playable terrain relief, huge-map grass/fog coverage, allied animated gates, and observed multiplayer work animations.
    - Coastal armies stay on their current shore, scout capitals before repeated harbor foundations, search cleared settlements, rebuild harbors with paid workers, reserve fleet population, prioritize transport replacement, fill balanced invasion crews, retry voyages, and choose flanking landing sites around observed defenses.
    - Free single-service Render deployment configuration, health checks and a short deployment guide; optional Netlify static builds with a separate secure multiplayer endpoint and exact frontend origin permissions. Leaving now cancels pending reconnect attempts.
    - Health, carried-resource and production timer updates preserve existing buttons and portrait canvases, preventing live updates from interrupting touch training or cancellation. Hosted connection errors stay visible in the multiplayer dialog.
    
    - Configurable custom battles with two to eight kingdoms, human or AI slots, civilizations, teams, individual AI difficulties and six team/free-for-all presets.
    - Huge 400 × 400 maps by default, plus 320 × 320 and 240 × 240 options. Navigation, fog, terrain picking, camera limits, minimap and rendering support the larger battlefield and eight army colors.
    - Default victory requires all opposing buildings, including walls and foundations. Optional capital and total-conquest rules, capital rebuilding, public final-building markers, alliance results and defeat spectating.
    - Authoritative mixed human/AI multiplayer, slot choice, readiness gating, per-team visibility, private economies, ownership, compressed compact snapshots, disconnect pauses, reconnect recovery and concessions that preserve surviving teams.
    - Seeded weather transitions, volumetric rain/snow/clouds and splash rings, wet terrain/light changes, optional lightning, independent weather audio, reduced-motion support and quality budgets.
    - Sustained AI attacks across large maps, independent planning, remembered-target cleanup and paid market trade for shortages. AI gathers and pays for armies, buildings and upgrades.
    - Physical tree/ore navigation and construction obstacles, final-load delivery after resources run out, cached vision/movement regions, valid-route retention and bounded blocked-path retries.
    - Low quality renders at up to 30 FPS; menu and hidden-tab rendering is throttled. Fresh settings choose Low on modest reported hardware, and unseen objects defer mesh allocation. Real-device FPS and balance remain separate release validation requirements.
    - Expanded automated, browser and long-match diagnostics cover custom setup, eight real WebSocket clients, phone layouts, weather, ownership, reconnects, alliances, late-game progression and full-building elimination.
    
    # Movement display update
    
    - Removed selected-unit movement and queued-route lines on desktop and phones, including the route-display setting. Movement, patrol, guard, and queued commands remain available.

        const fonts=fs.existsSync(path.join(outputDirectory,'fonts'))?fs.readdirSync(path.join(outputDirectory,'fonts')).map(f=>'/fonts/'+f):[];

        new Script(source,{filename:'sw.js'});
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outputDirectory,'sw.js'),source);

    Add: C:\New\Age_Of_Emprire\scripts\vendor-materials.mjs
    import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
    import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
    
    const ids=['leafy_grass','medieval_blocks_05','old_wood_floor'];
    const folder=new URL('../src/assets3d/textures/',import.meta.url);
    const headers={'User-Agent':'CrownsOfTheFrontier-AssetPreparation/1.0'};
    await fs.mkdir(folder,{recursive:true});
    const manifest=[];
    for(const id of ids){
      const read=async endpoint=>{const response=await fetch('https://api.polyhaven.com/'+endpoint+'/'+id,{headers,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30000)});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`${id}: ${response.status}`);return response.json();};
      const [info,files]=await Promise.all([read('info'),read('files')]);
      const maps=[];
      for(const [kind,key] of [['color','Diffuse'],['normal','nor_gl'],['arm','arm']]){
        const file=files[key]?.['1k']?.jpg;if(!file)throw new Error(`Missing ${id} ${key} 1k JPEG.`);
        const url=new URL(file.url);if(url.protocol!=='https:'||url.hostname!=='dl.polyhaven.org'||file.size>8*1024*1024)throw new Error('Unexpected material download.');
        const response=await fetch(url,{headers,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60000)});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`${id} ${kind}: ${response.status}`);
        const bytes=Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
        if(bytes.length!==file.size||createHash('md5').update(bytes).digest('hex')!==file.md5)throw new Error('Material download integrity check failed.');
        const name=`${id}_${kind}.jpg`;await fs.writeFile(new URL(name,folder),bytes);maps.push({kind,file:name,bytes:bytes.length,url:file.url,md5:file.md5});
      }
      manifest.push({id,name:info.name,authors:info.authors,dimensionsMM:info.dimensions,source:'https://polyhaven.com/a/'+id,license:'CC0-1.0',maps});
      console.log(JSON.stringify({id,maps:maps.length,bytes:maps.reduce((n,m)=>n+m.bytes,0)}));
    }
    await fs.writeFile(new URL('manifest.json',folder),JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');
    await fs.writeFile(new URL('LICENSE.md',folder),'# Material sources\n\nThese three texture sets are by Poly Haven contributors and are distributed under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). See the [Poly Haven license](https://polyhaven.com/license).\n\n'+manifest.map(asset=>`- [${asset.name}](${asset.source}) — ${Object.keys(asset.authors).join(', ')}; original 1k diffuse, OpenGL normal, and packed AO/roughness/metallic JPEG maps.`).join('\n')+'\n\nOriginal downloaded files are verified against the source API file size and MD5. Runtime assets are bundled locally; the game does not call Poly Haven services.\n');

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    
    const files={
      grass:{color:new URL('./assets3d/textures/leafy_grass_color.jpg',import.meta.url).href,normal:new URL('./assets3d/textures/leafy_grass_normal.jpg',import.meta.url).href,arm:new URL('./assets3d/textures/leafy_grass_arm.jpg',import.meta.url).href},
      stone:{color:new URL('./assets3d/textures/medieval_blocks_05_color.jpg',import.meta.url).href,normal:new URL('./assets3d/textures/medieval_blocks_05_normal.jpg',import.meta.url).href,arm:new URL('./assets3d/textures/medieval_blocks_05_arm.jpg',import.meta.url).href},
      wood:{color:new URL('./assets3d/textures/old_wood_floor_color.jpg',import.meta.url).href,normal:new URL('./assets3d/textures/old_wood_floor_normal.jpg',import.meta.url).href,arm:new URL('./assets3d/textures/old_wood_floor_arm.jpg',import.meta.url).href},
    };
    const cache=new Map(),surfaces={};
    async function texture(role,kind){
      const key=role+':'+kind;if(!cache.has(key))cache.set(key,new THREE.TextureLoader().loadAsync(files[role][kind]).then(map=>{
        map.colorSpace=kind==='color'?THREE.SRGBColorSpace:THREE.NoColorSpace;map.wrapS=map.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;map.flipY=false;map.anisotropy=4;
        (surfaces[role]??={})[kind]=map;return map;
      }).catch(error=>{cache.delete(key);throw error;}));return cache.get(key);
    }
    export async function loadSurfaceAssets(quality){
      const kinds=quality==='high'?['color','normal','arm']:quality==='medium'?['color','normal']:['color'];
      await Promise.all(Object.keys(files).flatMap(role=>kinds.map(kind=>texture(role,kind))));
    }
    export function surfaceAssetState(){return {source:'Poly Haven CC0',loaded:[...cache.keys()].length};}
    
    export function applySurfaceMaterials(view){
      const m=view.materials,quality=view.settings.quality;
      const bind=(material,role,tint)=>{
        const set=surfaces[role];if(!set?.color||!material)return;
        material.map=set.color;material.bumpMap=null;material.color.setHex(tint);
        material.normalMap=quality==='low'?null:set.normal||null;material.normalScale.setScalar(role==='stone'?.45:.3);
        material.roughnessMap=quality==='high'?set.arm||null:null;material.roughness=.95;material.needsUpdate=true;
      };
      bind(m.stone,'stone',0xe5e0d4);bind(m.brick,'stone',0xb8947b);
      bind(m.wood,'wood',0xddd1b9);bind(m.darkwood,'wood',0x988674);bind(m.timberEdge,'wood',0x82715d);
      view.surfaceDiagnostics=surfaceAssetState();view.surfaceQuality=quality;
    }
    
    export function applyGroundSurface(material,land,quality){
      const set=surfaces.grass;if(!set?.color)return;
      const amount=land.map==='winter'?.16:['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map)?.22:.72;
      // Preserve the seeded biome and roads; photographed detail keeps a consistent
      // physical scale across both small and huge maps.
      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        shader.uniforms.frontierGroundColor={value:set.color};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundScale={value:land.renderSize/2};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundAmount={value:amount};
        shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierGroundColor;\nuniform float frontierGroundScale;\nuniform float frontierGroundAmount;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <map_fragment>',`#include <map_fragment>
          vec3 groundDetail = texture2D(frontierGroundColor, vMapUv * frontierGroundScale).rgb;
          float roadMask = smoothstep(0.018, 0.09, diffuseColor.r - diffuseColor.g);
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, groundDetail * 0.85, frontierGroundAmount * (1.0 - roadMask));`);
      };
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=>`frontier-ground-v1:${land.renderSize}:${amount}`;
      material.userData.surface='Poly Haven leafy grass';
      if(quality!=='low'&&set.normal){material.bumpMap?.dispose();material.bumpMap=null;material.normalMap=set.normal;material.normalMap.repeat.setScalar(land.renderSize/2);material.normalScale.setScalar(.35);}
      if(quality==='high'&&set.arm){material.roughnessMap=set.arm;material.roughnessMap.repeat.setScalar(land.renderSize/2);}
    }
    
    export function retainedSurfaceTextures(){return new Set(Object.values(surfaces).flatMap(set=>Object.values(set)));}

    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.

    import * as THREE from 'three';

    function paletteMaterial(view){
      if(!view.materials.unitPalette){
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.9});
        const wood={value:view.materials.wood.map||null};material.userData.wood=wood;
        material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
          shader.uniforms.frontierUnitWood=wood;
          shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 unitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
          shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>','#include <color_vertex>\nvUnitSurface = unitSurface;');
          shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierUnitWood;\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>','#include <color_fragment>\nif(vUnitSurface.z > 0.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierUnitWood, vUv).rgb;');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>','#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\nroughnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.x, 0.04, 1.0);');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>','#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\nmetalnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.y, 0.0, 1.0);');
        };
        // A shared UV channel is needed for the optional wood sampling above.
        material.defines={USE_UV:''};material.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-unit-palette-v1';
        view.materials.unitPalette=material;
      }
      view.materials.unitPalette.userData.wood.value=view.materials.wood.map||null;
      return view.materials.unitPalette;
    }
    
    // Bake the ownership palette into vertex colors, while retaining per-vertex
    // roughness/metalness and every nested joint. This merges surfaces at each joint
    // instead of drawing a separate skin, sleeve, cuff and tool mesh for that joint.
    export function mergeUnitModel(view,model){
      model.updateMatrixWorld(true);const groups=new Map(),transparent=[];
      const palette=paletteMaterial(view),result=new THREE.Group();result.userData.model3d=model.userData.model3d;
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        if(part.material.transparent){const copy=part.clone();copy.geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);copy.position.set(0,0,0);copy.rotation.set(0,0,0);copy.scale.setScalar(1);transparent.push(copy);return;}
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);
        if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
        const count=geometry.attributes.position.count,old=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(count*3),surface=new Float32Array(count*3),color=part.material.color.toArray();
        const wooden=[view.materials.wood,view.materials.darkwood,view.materials.timberEdge].includes(part.material)&&!!view.materials.wood.map;
        for(let i=0;i<count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++){colors[i*3+k]=(old?old.getComponent(i,k):1)*color[k];surface[i*3+k]=k===0?part.material.roughness??.9:k===1?part.material.metalness??0:wooden?1:0;}
        geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));geometry.setAttribute('unitSurface',new THREE.BufferAttribute(surface,3));
        const key=JSON.stringify(part.userData.motion||null);if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{motion:part.userData.motion,geometries:[]});groups.get(key).geometries.push(geometry);
      });
      for(const group of groups.values()){
        const geometry=mergeGeometries(group.geometries);for(const source of group.geometries)source.dispose();
        if(!geometry)throw new Error('Troop surfaces could not be merged.');
        const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,palette);mesh.userData.motion=group.motion;mesh.castShadow=mesh.receiveShadow=true;result.add(mesh);
      }
      for(const part of transparent)result.add(part);
      return result;
    }

    import http from 'node:http';

    import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
    import {attachRooms} from './rooms.js';
    const root=path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'../dist');
    const types={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.webmanifest':'application/manifest+json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg'};
    const server=http.createServer((request,response)=>{try{const pathname=decodeURIComponent(new URL(request.url,'http://localhost').pathname);if(pathname==='/health'){response.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'application/json','Cache-Control':'no-store'});response.end(JSON.stringify({ok:true,service:'crowns-of-the-frontier'}));return;}const file=path.resolve(root,'.'+(pathname==='/'?'/index.html':pathname));if(!file.startsWith(root+path.sep)||!fs.existsSync(file)||!fs.statSync(file).isFile()){response.writeHead(404);response.end('Not found');return;}response.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(file)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':file.includes(path.sep+'assets'+path.sep)?'public, max-age=31536000, immutable':'no-cache'});fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(response);}catch{response.writeHead(400);response.end('Invalid request');}});
    const rooms=attachRooms(server),port=Number(process.env.PORT)||4173;server.listen(port,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log(`Crowns of the Frontier Â· http://localhost:${port} Â· Wi-Fi multiplayer enabled`));
    function shutdown(){rooms.close();server.close(()=>process.exit(0));setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),1000).unref();}process.on('SIGINT',shutdown);process.on('SIGTERM',shutdown);
    import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
    import {mkdir,stat,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
    
    const project=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../',import.meta.url));
    const tools=path.join(project,'.tools');
    const blender=path.join(tools,'blender-4.5.14-windows-x64','blender.exe');
    const optimizer=path.join(tools,'gltfpack','gltfpack.exe');
    await stat(blender);await stat(optimizer);
    await mkdir(path.join(project,'src','assets3d'),{recursive:true});
    await mkdir(path.join(tools,'art-refined'),{recursive:true});
    const env={...process.env,BLENDER_USER_CONFIG:path.join(tools,'blender-profile','config'),BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS:path.join(tools,'blender-profile','scripts')};
    
    async function run(command,args,log){
      await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
        const output=log?fs.openSync(log,'w'):null;
        const child=spawn(command,args,{cwd:project,env,windowsHide:true,stdio:output===null?'inherit':['ignore',output,output]});
        child.on('error',error=>{if(output!==null)fs.closeSync(output);reject(error);});
        child.on('exit',code=>{if(output!==null)fs.closeSync(output);code===0?resolve():reject(new Error(`${path.basename(command)} failed (${code}); inspect ${log||'the console'}.`));});
      });
    }
    console.log('Exporting the complete source catalogue.');
    await run(process.execPath,['scripts/blender/export-source.mjs']);
    console.log('Authoring and refining the game models in Blender.');
    await run(blender,['--background','--python-exit-code','1','--python','scripts/blender/refine-catalogue.py'],path.join(tools,'art-refine.log'));
    for(const [name,ratio]of [['near','0.82'],['low','0.55']]){
      console.log(`Optimizing the ${name} catalogue.`);
      await run(optimizer,['-i',`.tools/art-refined/frontier-${name}.glb`,'-o',`src/assets3d/frontier-${name}.glb`,
        '-cc','-kn','-km','-ke','-kv','-vpf','-vtf','-si',ratio,'-r',`.tools/art-refined/${name}-optimized.json`]);
    }
    const source=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools,'art-source','catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const sizes={};for(const name of ['near','low'])sizes[name]=(await stat(path.join(project,'src','assets3d',`frontier-${name}.glb`))).size;
    await writeFile(path.join(project,'src','assets3d','catalogue.json'),`${JSON.stringify({models:source,sizes,source:'Original Crowns of the Frontier assets authored/refined in Blender.'},null,2)}\n`);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({models:source.length,bytes:sizes}));

        await page.evaluate(save=>{
          frontier.start(save.options,save);frontier.sim.players[0].controller='human';
          const army=frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit').filter(e=>e.type!=='villager'),at=army.find(e=>e.order?.type==='attack')||army[0];
          if(at)frontier.view.focus(at.x,at.z);frontier.view.zoom=65;frontier.view.updateCamera();
        },save);
        await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
        const sample=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
          const v=frontier.view,render=v.render,times=[],ticks=[],tick=frontier.sim.tick;
          let frames=0;
          v.render=function(...args){const before=performance.now();const result=render.apply(this,args);times.push(performance.now()-before);frames++;return result;};
          frontier.sim.tick=function(...args){const before=performance.now();const result=tick.apply(this,args);ticks.push(performance.now()-before);return result;};
          const start=performance.now();await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,5000));const elapsed=performance.now()-start;
          v.render=render;frontier.sim.tick=tick;
          const stats=values=>{values.sort((a,b)=>a-b);return {samples:values.length,median:values[Math.floor(values.length*.5)]||0,p95:values[Math.floor(values.length*.95)]||0,max:values.at(-1)||0};};
          const gl=v.renderer.getContext(),debug=gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
          return {quality:v.settings.quality,headless:true,physicalPhone:false,world:frontier.sim.worldSize,players:frontier.sim.players.length,units:frontier.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0).length,
            renderedFPS:frames*1000/elapsed,renderSubmitMilliseconds:stats(times),simulationTickMilliseconds:stats(ticks),gpu:debug?gl.getParameter(debug.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER),
            render:{...v.renderer.info.render},memory:{...v.renderer.info.memory},packedUnits:v.unitRenderDiagnostics,art:v.artDiagnostics,surfaces:v.surfaceDiagnostics,cover:v.groundCoverDiagnostics};

    test('custom defaults are huge, team-aware, and do not silently accept an empty opposition',()=>{
      const s=make();assert.equal(s.worldSize,400);assert.equal(s.gridSize,200);assert.equal(s.players.length,4);assert.ok(s.allied(0,1));assert.ok(s.hostile(0,2));assert.ok(s.hostile(2,0));assert.equal(s.options.victory,'annihilation');
      assert.throws(()=>normalizeBattle({slots:[{team:1},{team:1}]}),/different team/);
      const slots=battlePreset('4v4');slots[2].enabled=false;const a=make({slots}),b=Simulation.restore(a.serialize());assert.equal(a.players[2].color,PLAYER_COLORS[3]);assert.deepEqual(a.players.map(p=>p.color),b.players.map(p=>p.color));
    });
    test('eight kingdoms have distinct dry starts and local resources on every large biome',()=>{
      for(const map of ['highlands','desert','winter','canyon','valley','rivers','coast']){
        const s=make({map,slots:battlePreset('4v4')});assert.equal(s.players.length,8);assert.equal(new Set(s.players.map(p=>p.color)).size,8);
        for(let owner=0;owner<8;owner++){
          const p=s.players[owner],tc=s.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0];assert.ok(!s.isWater(tc.x,tc.z));assert.equal(s.owned(owner,'unit','villager').length,8);
          for(const type of ['wood','gold','stone','food'])assert.ok(s.entities.some(e=>e.kind==='resource'&&!e.water&&e.type===type&&distance(e,tc)<46),`${map} ${owner}: local ${type}`);
          for(const e of s.owned(owner))assert.ok(Math.abs(e.x)<s.halfWorld&&Math.abs(e.z)<s.halfWorld);
          for(let other=owner+1;other<8;other++)assert.ok(distance(p.start,s.players[other].start)>65);
        }
      }
    });

      const hp=ally.hp;s.tickUnit(a,1);assert.equal(ally.hp,hp);s.hit(a,ally);assert.equal(ally.hp,hp);
      a.cooldown=0;s.hit(a,enemy);assert.ok(enemy.hp<enemy.maxHp);
      const monk=s.addUnit('monk',0,0,25);ally.hp-=40;s.command([monk.id],{type:'heal',target:ally.id});s.tickUnit(monk,1);assert.ok(ally.hp>hp-40);

## Assistant

The official Age of Empires updates support smarter allied defense, including keeping troops at home and moving support forces in formation. I also found that this game’s custom AI can launch with just six soldiers, and its navy can advance separately from the land attack schedule. I’m correcting both so major attacks follow a fuller buildup and allied help uses a dedicated reinforcement group. [Source](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-9-1-109/)

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {AI_PROFILES} from '../src/commander-ai.js';
    import {alliedSupport,customOpening} from '../src/allied-ai.js';
    
    const make=options=>new Simulation({mode:'custom',map:'highlands',mapSize:'spacious',startAge:1,seed:512,...options});
    function readyArmy(sim,owner=1){const tc=sim.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0];for(let i=0;i<14;i++)sim.addUnit(i%2?'archer':'spearman',owner,tc.x+14+i%4*1.8,tc.z+10+Math.floor(i/4)*1.8);return sim.owned(owner,'unit').filter(e=>['archer','spearman','swordsman','knight','monk'].includes(e.type));}
    
    test('custom openings build a full army and economy, with optional longer or aggressive pacing',()=>{
      const sim=make({startAge:0}),profile=AI_PROFILES.normal;
      assert.equal(sim.options.aiPace,'balanced');const balanced=customOpening(sim,1,profile);
      assert.equal(balanced.earliest,300);assert.equal(balanced.army,10);assert.equal(balanced.workers,16);assert.equal(balanced.age,1);
      sim.options.aiPace='patient';assert.ok(customOpening(sim,1,profile).earliest>balanced.earliest);
      sim.options.aiPace='aggressive';assert.ok(customOpening(sim,1,profile).earliest<balanced.earliest);
      sim.options.aiPace='balanced';sim.options.startAge=3;assert.ok(customOpening(sim,1,profile).earliest<balanced.earliest);
    });
    
    test('AI sends real reinforcements to a damaged allied base, keeping home defenders and private enemy information',()=>{
      const sim=make({shareVision:false}),base=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0],tc=sim.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0],army=readyArmy(sim),enemy=sim.addUnit('knight',2,base.x+5,base.z);
      const before=army.map(e=>({id:e.id,x:e.x,z:e.z})),resources={...sim.players[1].resources},count=sim.entities.length;
      sim.time=70;sim.hurt(base,35,enemy);const state=sim.aiStates[1]={};let notice;sim.on(event=>{if(event.type==='ally-support')notice=event;});
      const sent=alliedSupport(sim,1,state,army,[],tc,[]);
      assert.ok(sent.size>=2&&sent.size<army.length);assert.ok(army.length-sent.size>=2);assert.equal(notice.ally,0);assert.equal(notice.owner,1);
      for(const e of army.filter(e=>sent.has(e.id)))assert.equal(e.order.type,'attackmove');
      assert.deepEqual(army.map(e=>({id:e.id,x:e.x,z:e.z})),before);assert.equal(sim.entities.length,count);assert.deepEqual(sim.players[1].resources,resources);
      const alarm=Object.values(sim.teamAlarms)[0];assert.equal(alarm.base,base.id);assert.equal(alarm.owner,0);assert.equal('attacker' in alarm,false);
      const restored=Simulation.restore(sim.serialize());assert.deepEqual(restored.aiStates[1].support,state.support);assert.deepEqual(restored.teamAlarms,sim.teamAlarms);
      assert.equal(restored.options.aiPace,'balanced');
    });
    
    test('reinforcements return when their own base is threatened and never control human allies',()=>{
      const sim=make(),base=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0],tc=sim.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0],army=readyArmy(sim),enemy=sim.addUnit('knight',2,base.x+5,base.z),state={};
      sim.time=70;sim.hurt(base,35,enemy);const sent=alliedSupport(sim,1,state,army,[],tc,[]);assert.ok(sent.size);
      alliedSupport(sim,1,state,army,[],tc,[enemy]);assert.equal(state.support,null);for(const id of sent)assert.equal(sim.get(id).order.type,'move');
      sim.players[1].controller='human';assert.equal(alliedSupport(sim,1,{},army,[],tc,[]).size,0);
    });
    
    test('AI does not start a major offensive early, but remains able to defend during its buildup',()=>{
      const sim=make({startAge:0}),owner=1,tc=sim.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0];readyArmy(sim,owner);
      sim.time=180;sim.tickCustomAI(5);assert.notEqual(sim.aiStates[owner].phase,'attack');
      const enemy=sim.addUnit('swordsman',2,tc.x+8,tc.z+3);sim.updateFog();sim.hurt(tc,20,enemy);sim.tickCustomAI(5);assert.equal(sim.aiStates[owner].phase,'defend');
      const old=sim.serialize();delete old.options.aiPace;assert.equal(Simulation.restore(old).options.aiPace,'aggressive');
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {mergeGeometries} from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
    
    function paletteMaterial(view){
      if(!view.materials.unitPalette){
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.9});
        const wood={value:view.materials.wood.map||null},teams={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.teamMaterials[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())},roofs={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.roofMaterials?.[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())};material.frontierUniforms={wood,teams,roofs};
        material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
          shader.uniforms.frontierUnitWood=wood;
          shader.uniforms.frontierTeamColors=teams;shader.uniforms.frontierRoofColors=roofs;
          shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 unitSurface;\nattribute float unitTeamMask;\n#ifdef USE_INSTANCING\nattribute float instanceOwner;\n#endif\nuniform vec3 frontierTeamColors[8];\nuniform vec3 frontierRoofColors[8];\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
          shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>',`#include <color_vertex>
            vUnitSurface = unitSurface; vUnitTeamColor = vec3(1.0);
            #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
            int owner = int(clamp(instanceOwner, 0.0, 7.0) + 0.5);
            if(unitTeamMask > 1.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierRoofColors[owner];
            else if(unitTeamMask > 0.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierTeamColors[owner];
            #endif`);
          shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierUnitWood;\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>','#include <color_fragment>\ndiffuseColor.rgb *= vUnitTeamColor;\nif(vUnitSurface.z > 0.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierUnitWood, vUv).rgb;');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>','#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\nroughnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.x, 0.04, 1.0);');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>','#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\nmetalnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.y, 0.0, 1.0);');
        };
        // A shared UV channel is needed for the optional wood sampling above.
        material.defines={USE_UV:''};material.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-unit-palette-v2';
        view.materials.unitPalette=material;
      }
      const uniforms=view.materials.unitPalette.frontierUniforms;uniforms.wood.value=view.materials.wood.map||null;
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){uniforms.teams.value[i]=view.teamMaterials[i]?.color||uniforms.teams.value[i];uniforms.roofs.value[i]=view.roofMaterials?.[i]?.color||uniforms.roofs.value[i];}
      return view.materials.unitPalette;
    }
    
    // Bake the ownership palette into vertex colors, while retaining per-vertex
    // roughness/metalness and every nested joint. This merges surfaces at each joint
    // instead of drawing a separate skin, sleeve, cuff and tool mesh for that joint.
    export function mergeUnitModel(view,model,neutralTeams=false){
      model.updateMatrixWorld(true);const groups=new Map(),transparent=[];
      const palette=paletteMaterial(view),result=new THREE.Group();result.userData.model3d=model.userData.model3d;
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        if(part.material.transparent){const copy=part.clone();copy.geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);copy.position.set(0,0,0);copy.rotation.set(0,0,0);copy.scale.setScalar(1);transparent.push(copy);return;}
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);
        if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
        const team=neutralTeams?(view.teamMaterials.includes(part.material)?1:view.roofMaterials?.includes(part.material)?2:0):0;
        const count=geometry.attributes.position.count,old=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(count*3),surface=new Float32Array(count*3),color=team?[1,1,1]:part.material.color.toArray();
        const wooden=[view.materials.wood,view.materials.darkwood,view.materials.timberEdge].includes(part.material)&&!!view.materials.wood.map;
        for(let i=0;i<count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++){colors[i*3+k]=(old?old.getComponent(i,k):1)*color[k];surface[i*3+k]=k===0?part.material.roughness??.9:k===1?part.material.metalness??0:wooden?1:0;}
        geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));geometry.setAttribute('unitSurface',new THREE.BufferAttribute(surface,3));geometry.setAttribute('unitTeamMask',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count).fill(team),1));
        const key=JSON.stringify(part.userData.motion||null);if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{motion:part.userData.motion,geometries:[]});groups.get(key).geometries.push(geometry);
      });
      for(const group of groups.values()){
        const geometry=mergeGeometries(group.geometries);for(const source of group.geometries)source.dispose();
        if(!geometry)throw new Error('Troop surfaces could not be merged.');
        const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,palette);mesh.userData.motion=group.motion;mesh.castShadow=mesh.receiveShadow=true;result.add(mesh);
      }
      for(const part of transparent)result.add(part);
      return result;
    }

    import {UNITS,DIFFICULTIES} from './data.js';
    const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
    
    export const AI_PACES={balanced:{name:'Balanced Â· build up, then battle',factor:1,army:1},patient:{name:'Grand war Â· longer buildup',factor:1.5,army:1.3},aggressive:{name:'Aggressive Â· early pressure',factor:0,army:.65}};
    export function customOpening(sim,owner,profile){
      const pace=AI_PACES[sim.options.aiPace]||AI_PACES.balanced,difficulty=sim.difficulty(owner),age=sim.options.startAge||0;
      if(!pace.factor)return {earliest:DIFFICULTIES[difficulty].attack,army:Math.min(profile.raid,6+sim.players[owner].age*3),workers:0,age:0};
      const floor={story:420,normal:300,hard:240,brutal:210}[difficulty];
      return {earliest:Math.max(DIFFICULTIES[difficulty].attack,floor*[1,.7,.45,.3][age]*pace.factor),army:Math.ceil(profile.raid*pace.army),workers:age>=2?12:16,age:1};
    }
    
    // A teammate's damage report shares the threatened base, not hidden enemy data.
    export function recordBaseAlarm(sim,target,attacker,damage){
      if(sim.options.mode!=='custom'||target.owner<0||!attacker||!sim.hostile(target.owner,attacker.owner)||damage<=0)return;
      if(target.kind!=='building'&&UNITS[target.type]?.role!=='worker')return;
      const sites=sim.owned(target.owner,'building').filter(b=>b.progress>=1&&!['wall','gate','farm'].includes(b.type));
      const base=sites.filter(b=>distance(b,target)<24).sort((a,b)=>(a.type==='towncenter'?-20:0)+distance(a,target)-(b.type==='towncenter'?-20:0)-distance(b,target))[0];
      if(!base)return;
      sim.teamAlarms??={};const key=target.owner+':'+base.id,old=sim.teamAlarms[key];
      sim.teamAlarms[key]={owner:target.owner,base:base.id,x:base.x,z:base.z,at:sim.time,intensity:Math.min(500,(old&&sim.time-old.at<20?old.intensity:0)+damage)};
    }
    
    export function alliedSupport(sim,owner,state,ready,visible,tc,ownThreats){

      sim.teamAlarms??={};for(const [key,alarm] of Object.entries(sim.teamAlarms))if(sim.time-alarm.at>90||!sim.get(alarm.base)?.hp)delete sim.teamAlarms[key];
      for(const base of sim.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='building'&&['towncenter','keep','dock'].includes(e.type)&&e.owner!==owner&&sim.allied(owner,e.owner)&&sim.canSee(owner,e))){
        const attackers=visible.filter(e=>e.kind==='unit'&&e.type!=='scout'&&UNITS[e.type].damage>0&&distance(e,base)<24);
        if(attackers.length>=3){const key=base.owner+':'+base.id;sim.teamAlarms[key]={owner:base.owner,base:base.id,x:base.x,z:base.z,at:sim.time,intensity:Math.min(500,attackers.length*25+(sim.teamAlarms[key]?.intensity||0))};}
      }

      const release=()=>{
        for(const id of duty?.units||[]){const unit=sim.get(id);if(unit?.hp>0&&unit.owner===owner&&!unit.embarked)sim.command([id],{type:'move',x:tc.x+8,z:tc.z-6});}

        duty.units=duty.units.filter(id=>{const u=sim.get(id);return u?.hp>0&&u.owner===owner&&!u.embarked&&u.hp>u.maxHp*.28;});
        if(ownThreats.length||!base?.hp||!sim.allied(owner,duty.ally)||!duty.units.length||sim.time>duty.until)release();
        else{

          const arrived=duty.units.some(id=>distance(sim.get(id),base)<20),danger=visible.some(e=>e.kind==='unit'&&UNITS[e.type].damage&&distance(e,base)<30);

        }
      }
      if(duty||ownThreats.length||sim.time-(state.lastSupport||-40)<25)return new Set(duty?.units||[]);
      const candidates=Object.values(sim.teamAlarms).filter(alarm=>alarm.owner!==owner&&sim.allied(owner,alarm.owner)&&sim.time-alarm.at<30&&distance(tc,alarm)<240&&(sim.options.map!=='coast'||Math.sign(tc.x)===Math.sign(alarm.x))).sort((a,b)=>(distance(tc,a)-a.intensity*.08)-(distance(tc,b)-b.intensity*.08));
      const alarm=candidates[0];if(!alarm)return new Set();
      const combat=ready.filter(u=>UNITS[u.type].damage>0&&UNITS[u.type].role!=='siege'&&!UNITS[u.type].naval&&u.order?.type!=='board');
      const reserve=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(combat.length*.25)),count=Math.min(12,Math.max(2,Math.ceil(combat.length*.4)),combat.length-reserve);if(count<2)return new Set();
      const base=sim.get(alarm.base),d=Math.max(1,distance(tc,base)),point={x:base.x+(tc.x-base.x)/d*(base.r+6),z:base.z+(tc.z-base.z)/d*(base.r+6)};
      const group=combat.sort((a,b)=>distance(a,point)/UNITS[a.type].speed-distance(b,point)/UNITS[b.type].speed).slice(0,count);

      const healer=ready.find(u=>u.type==='monk'&&u.hp>u.maxHp*.5&&distance(u,point)<240),units=group.map(u=>u.id);
      sim.command(units,{type:'attackmove',...point});if(healer){sim.guard([healer.id],group[0].id,false,owner);units.push(healer.id);}
      const travel=distance(group[0],point)/UNITS[group[0].type].speed;
      state.support={ally:alarm.owner,base:alarm.base,units,...point,until:sim.time+Math.min(100,travel+25),lastOrder:sim.time};state.lastSupport=sim.time;
      sim.emit('ally-support',{owner,ally:alarm.owner,count:units.length,x:base.x,z:base.z});

    const cache=new Map(),surfaces={};
    async function texture(role,kind){
      const key=role+':'+kind;if(!cache.has(key))cache.set(key,new THREE.TextureLoader().loadAsync(files[role][kind]).then(map=>{
        map.colorSpace=kind==='color'?THREE.SRGBColorSpace:THREE.NoColorSpace;map.wrapS=map.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;map.flipY=false;map.anisotropy=4;
        (surfaces[role]??={})[kind]=map;return map;
      }).catch(error=>{cache.delete(key);throw error;}));return cache.get(key);
    }
    export async function loadSurfaceAssets(quality){
      const kinds=quality==='high'?['color','normal','arm']:quality==='medium'?['color','normal']:['color'];
      await Promise.all(Object.keys(files).flatMap(role=>kinds.map(kind=>texture(role,kind))));
    }
    export function surfaceAssetState(){return {source:'Poly Haven CC0',loaded:[...cache.keys()].length};}
    
    export function applySurfaceMaterials(view){
      const m=view.materials,quality=view.settings.quality;
      const bind=(material,role,tint)=>{
        const set=surfaces[role];if(!set?.color||!material)return;
        material.map=set.color;material.bumpMap=null;material.color.setHex(tint);
        material.normalMap=quality==='low'?null:set.normal||null;material.normalScale.setScalar(role==='stone'?.45:.3);
        material.roughnessMap=quality==='high'?set.arm||null:null;material.roughness=.95;material.needsUpdate=true;

      bind(m.stone,'stone',0xe5e0d4);bind(m.brick,'stone',0xb8947b);
      bind(m.wood,'wood',0xddd1b9);bind(m.darkwood,'wood',0x988674);bind(m.timberEdge,'wood',0x82715d);
      view.surfaceDiagnostics=surfaceAssetState();view.surfaceQuality=quality;
    }
    
    export function applyGroundSurface(material,land,quality){
      const set=surfaces.grass;if(!set?.color)return;
      const amount=land.map==='winter'?.16:['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map)?.22:.72;
      // Preserve the seeded biome and roads; photographed detail keeps a consistent

      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        shader.uniforms.frontierGroundColor={value:set.color};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundScale={value:land.renderSize/2};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundAmount={value:amount};
        shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierGroundColor;\nuniform float frontierGroundScale;\nuniform float frontierGroundAmount;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;

          float roadMask = smoothstep(0.018, 0.09, diffuseColor.r - diffuseColor.g);
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, groundDetail * 0.85, frontierGroundAmount * (1.0 - roadMask));`);
      };
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=>`frontier-ground-v1:${land.renderSize}:${amount}`;

      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)

      return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,bytes.length);
    }

          view.materials[part.userData.assetMaterial]??=part.material.clone();

      view.teamMaterials=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:i?0x9a687d:0x397f8c}));
      view.roofMaterials=view.teamMaterials.map(mat=>mat.clone());

    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){

      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }

    export function battlePreset(preset='2v2'){

      return Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({enabled:i<n,name:i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],team:preset.startsWith('ffa')?i+1:i<split?1:2,difficulty:'normal'}));

      }));
      if(slots.length<2)throw new Error('Enable at least one opposing kingdom.');
      if(slots.every(slot=>slot.team===slots[0].team))throw new Error('Place at least one kingdom on a different team.');
      const mapSize=BATTLE_SIZES[options.mapSize]?options.mapSize:'huge';
      return {...options,mode:'custom',slots,mapSize,worldSize:BATTLE_SIZES[mapSize].size,faction:slots[0].faction,difficulty:'normal',victory:VICTORY_RULES[options.victory]?options.victory:'annihilation',aiPace:Object.hasOwn(AI_PACES,options.aiPace)?options.aiPace:'balanced',startAge:Math.max(options.map==='coast'?1:0,Math.min(3,Math.floor(Number(options.startAge)||0))),resourceLevel:options.resourceLevel==='rich'?'rich':'standard',populationLimit:[80,120,160].includes(Number(options.populationLimit))?Number(options.populationLimit):80,shareVision:options.shareVision!==false,revealRemnants:options.revealRemnants!==false,multiplayer:!!options.multiplayer};

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import http from 'node:http';
    import WebSocket from 'ws';
    import {attachRooms} from '../server/rooms.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    class Inbox{
      constructor(ws){this.items=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),index=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(index>=0){const [waiter]=this.waiters.splice(index,1);clearTimeout(waiter.timer);waiter.resolve(message);}else this.items.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.items.findIndex(message=>message.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.items.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),8000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }
    async function fixture(t){const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});return {service,connect:async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`),inbox=new Inbox(ws);clients.push(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:message=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(message))};}};}
    const pause=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));
    
    test('eight human commanders ready, receive private team perspectives, reconnect, and win as an alliance',async t=>{
      const {service,connect}=await fixture(t),players=[],sessions=[],slots=battlePreset('4v4').map(slot=>({...slot,controller:'human'}));
      const host=await connect();players.push(host);host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'custom',map:'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');sessions.push(session);const code=session.code;
      for(let i=1;i<8;i++){const player=await connect();players.push(player);player.send({type:'join',name:`Commander ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],code});sessions.push(await player.inbox.next('session'));}
      host.send({type:'start'});assert.match((await host.inbox.next('error')).message,/ready/);
      for(const player of players)player.send({type:'ready',ready:true});while(!(await host.inbox.next('lobby')).canStart){}host.send({type:'start'});
      const beginnings=await Promise.all(players.map(player=>player.inbox.next('begin'))),room=service.rooms.get(code);assert.equal(room.sim.players.length,8);assert.equal(room.sim.worldSize,400);
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const state=beginnings[i].state;assert.equal(state.players[0].name,i===0?'Host':`Commander ${i+1}`);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length,9);assert.equal(state.visible.length,40000);
        assert.ok(state.players.slice(1).every(player=>Object.values(player.resources).every(value=>value===0)));assert.equal(state.aiStates,null);assert.equal(state.commanderAI,null);
        assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='unit'&&state.players[e.owner]?.team!==state.players[0].team).length,0);
      }
      const guest=players[7],own=room.sim.owned(7,'building','barracks')[0],enemy=room.sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[enemy.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(enemy.queue.length,0);
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[own.id,'spearman']});await pause(100);assert.equal(own.queue[0]?.type,'spearman');
      const state=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state;assert.ok(state.compactResources);assert.equal(state.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource').length,0);
      const alliedWorker=room.sim.owned(6,'unit','villager')[0];assert.equal(alliedWorker.order.type,'gather');guest.inbox.items=[];const animation=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state.entities.find(e=>e.id===alliedWorker.id);assert.equal(animation.activity,'gather');assert.equal(animation.order,undefined);assert.deepEqual(animation.orders,[]);
      guest.ws.terminate();await pause(100);const stopped=room.sim.time;await pause(200);assert.equal(room.sim.time,stopped);
      const rejoined=await connect();rejoined.send({...sessions[7],type:'resume'});const resumed=(await rejoined.inbox.next('begin')).state;assert.equal(resumed.players[0].name,'Commander 8');assert.ok(resumed.entities.some(e=>e.id===own.id&&e.queue[0]?.type==='spearman'));
      // Host defeat is not the end of a multiplayer war: surviving teammates continue.
      room.sim.eliminateKingdom(0,'Test capital assault');room.sim.checkVictory();assert.equal(room.sim.ended,null);
