    function jointAngle(view,m,e){
      const phase=view.clock*8.5+e.id*.7,walk=Math.sin(phase)*m.side;
      if(m.type==='wheel')return e.moving?view.clock*5:0;
      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.035:0):e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.025:0):e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='torso')return e.moving?walk*.022:e.type==='villager'&&e.order?.type==='gather'?.04+Math.sin(view.clock*4+e.id)*.022:Math.sin(view.clock*1.7+e.id)*.009;
      if(m.type==='head')return e.moving?-.018:Math.sin(view.clock*1.4+e.id)*.012;
      if(m.type==='cape')return Math.sin(view.clock*2+e.id)*(.025+(view.weatherState?.intensity||0)*.035)+(e.moving?.07:0);
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm'){
        if(e.type==='villager'&&!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type))return -.18+Math.sin(view.clock*(workerVisualTask(view,e)==='build'?8:6)+e.id)*.12;
        return e.moving?-.15:0;
      }
      if(m.type==='arm'){
        if(e.type==='villager'&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type||e.activity)&&!e.moving){const task=workerVisualTask(view,e),rate=task==='build'?8:task==='food'?4:6;return (task==='food'?-.55:-.65)+Math.sin(view.clock*rate+e.id)*(task==='food'?.22:task==='build'?.32:.60);}
        if(e.cooldown>.45)return -.3-Math.sin((1.2-e.cooldown)*5)*.75;
        return e.moving?walk*.3:0;
      }
      return 0;
    }

      const m=part.userData.motion;if(!m)return matrix;
      const result=view.poseMatrix??=new THREE.Matrix4(),rotation=view.poseRotation??=new THREE.Matrix4();result.copy(matrix);

    export const FRAME_RATES={auto:'Automatic · 60 FPS desktop / 30 FPS touch',60:'60 FPS · smoother motion',30:'30 FPS · lower power use'};
    export function normalizeFrameRate(value){return Object.hasOwn(FRAME_RATES,String(value))?String(value):'auto';}
    export function targetFrameRate(settings,touch=globalThis.matchMedia?.('(pointer: coarse)').matches||false){
      const value=normalizeFrameRate(settings.frameRate);return value==='auto'?(touch?30:60):Number(value);
    }
    
    // Keep a deadline instead of rounding every frame's elapsed time. Otherwise a
    // 16.6 ms display tick can miss a 16.67 ms threshold and silently halve 60 FPS.
    export class FramePacer{
      due(now,interval){
        if(this.interval!==interval||now<(this.lastNow??-Infinity)){this.interval=interval;this.next=now;}
        this.lastNow=now;if(now+.5<this.next)return false;
        this.next+=interval;if(this.next<now)this.next=now+interval;
        return true;
      }
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {FramePacer,targetFrameRate,normalizeFrameRate} from '../src/frame-pacing.js';
    
    test('frame targets are separate from visual quality and old settings migrate to automatic',()=>{
      for(const quality of ['low','medium','high']){assert.equal(targetFrameRate({quality},false),60);assert.equal(targetFrameRate({quality},true),30);assert.equal(targetFrameRate({quality,frameRate:'60'},true),60);}
      assert.equal(normalizeFrameRate('bad'),'auto');assert.equal(normalizeFrameRate(30),'30');
    });
    
    test('60 FPS pacing survives fractional display ticks, while 30 FPS preserves its lower-power cadence',()=>{
      for(const fps of [30,60]){
        const pacer=new FramePacer();let rendered=0;
        for(let i=0;i<600;i++)if(pacer.due(i*1000/60+(i%2?.12:-.12),1000/fps))rendered++;
        assert.ok(Math.abs(rendered-fps*10)<=1,{fps,rendered});
        assert.equal(pacer.due(12000,1000/fps),true);assert.equal(pacer.due(12000.1,1000/fps),false);
        assert.equal(pacer.due(12000.2,1000),true);assert.equal(pacer.due(12100,1000),false);
        assert.equal(pacer.due(100,1000/fps),true,'a reset animation clock recovers');
      }
    });

## Assistant

I found a performance rule worth correcting: Low graphics forced every desktop to a 30 FPS cap. I’m separating frame-rate targets from visual quality, adding saved 30/60 FPS controls, and making automatic quality respond to the selected target.

The retreat fix also reduced blocked orders in the same late-battle replay from 23 to 1. That is one verified scenario, not proof that every routing issue is resolved.

    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Keep drawing/releasing a bow distinct from melee swings. The same cooldown
    // state animates local and observed network units, without per-bone messages.
    export function combatJointAngle(entity,joint){
      const definition=UNITS[entity.type];if(!definition||entity.moving||!definition.damage||!['ranged','infantry','cavalry','spear'].includes(definition.role))return null;
      const aiming=definition.role==='ranged'&&entity.order?.type==='attack';if(!entity.cooldown&&!aiming)return null;
      const interval=definition.cooldown||1.2,phase=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-(entity.cooldown||0)/interval));
      if(definition.role==='ranged'){
        const draw=Math.min(1,phase/.75);
        if(joint.type==='arm')return joint.side<0?-1.25:-.65-draw*.23;
        if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.06:-.25-draw*.65;
        if(joint.type==='torso')return -.018+draw*.028;
        if(joint.type==='head')return -.045;
        return null;
      }
      const recovery=Math.min(1,phase/.45),windup=Math.max(0,(phase-.72)/.28),strike=(1-recovery);
      if(joint.type==='arm')return joint.side<0?-.13:definition.role==='spear'?-.85+recovery*.3-windup*.15:.45*strike-.2*recovery-.55*windup;
      if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.15:-.12-.2*windup;
      if(joint.type==='torso')return .025+.055*strike;
      if(joint.type==='head')return -.035;
      return null;
    }

        this.lastNow=now;if(now+.5<this.next)return false;

    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:

        visit(root)

    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj
    
    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
        faces.append(tuple(base + sides + i for i in range(sides)))
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            faces.append((base + i, base + j, base + sides + j, base + sides + i))
    
    def organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, detail):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=detail, radius=1)
        bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        base = len(vertices)
        for vert in bm.verts:
            p = vert.co
            noise = 1 + .12 * math.sin(p.x * 5 + p.y * 3) + rng.uniform(-.055, .055)
            vertices.append((center[0] + p.x * scale[0] * noise,
                             center[1] + p.y * scale[1] * noise,
                             center[2] + p.z * scale[2] * noise))
        for face in bm.faces:
            faces.append(tuple(base + vert.index for vert in face.verts))
        bm.free()

    Add: C:\New\Age_Of_Emprire\QUALITY_TARGETS.md
    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    | AI and custom battles | Eight allied/enemy kingdoms, selectable difficulty/pace, real reinforcement groups, home reserves and team victory | Reliable formations, route recovery, scouting/retreat/counter choices, stronger coordinated pressure and interesting long wars. Verify full matches across seeds, biomes, starting ages and player configurations. |
    | Campaigns and maps | Six staged chapters, checkpoints, journals, escort/defense/naval objectives and seven seeded biomes | More distinctive authored locations, mission events, varied encounters and pacing, plus completion/failure testing and human reviews on every difficulty. |
    | Controls and interface | Desktop edge scrolling, square radar/locator, production overview, hotkeys, landscape touch | Responsive, precise and readable control through crowded play; camera/selection/production remain reliable on real devices. Preserve the user's removal of movement lines. |
    | Audio and feedback | Synthesized ambience/music/combat/weather and bounded voices | More distinctive, coherent unit/impact/ambient layers and clear attack/order feedback; assess audibility and fatigue over full matches. |
    | Multiplayer and release | Authoritative mixed human/AI rooms, ownership/fog privacy, reconnect, static/Node builds and local saves | Hosted capacity/latency/loss/restart tests, version compatibility, durable operations where required, installation/update recovery, accessibility and external playtesting. Public matchmaking/persistent rooms remain unfinished. |
    
    The gaps are broader than frame rate. [Blizzard's Reforged development update](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23411981/warcraft-iii-reforged-developer-update) addresses art, gameplay and systems across campaign/custom/versus modes. [AoE IV's formation and allied-healing changes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/) provide concrete genre examples. These are historical design references, not claims that our implementation matches them.
    
    Green tests prove their covered scenarios. They do not prove AAA parity, human enjoyment, complete balance or compatibility with every possible device. Keep the full goal active until its requirements have appropriate evidence.

    +## Latest quality work
    +
    +The laptop's earlier 12 FPS result is a constrained stress measurement, not the development target or a definition of acceptable graphics. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) keeps the full art, animation, gameplay, missions, controls, sound, multiplayer and device goals explicit. Desktop/gaming-laptop rendering targets 60 FPS and primary-touch devices target 30 FPS, with saved 30/60 choices independent of Low/Medium/High graphics. Deadline-based frame pacing avoids accidentally halving a 60 FPS target on fractional display ticks. Automatic quality uses the selected frame budget.

    import * as THREE from 'three';

    // Shared materials and one instanced shadow pass keep the depth cues affordable.
    function surfaceRelief(material,scale){
      if(!material.map)return;
      material.bumpMap=material.map.clone();
      material.bumpMap.colorSpace=THREE.NoColorSpace;
      material.bumpMap.needsUpdate=true;
      material.bumpScale=scale;
      material.roughness=.88;
      material.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    function initializeDepth(view){
      const sky=document.createElement('canvas');sky.width=128;sky.height=64;
      const c=sky.getContext('2d'),gradient=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);
      gradient.addColorStop(0,'#7ba3c3');gradient.addColorStop(.47,'#d7e3e8');
      gradient.addColorStop(.53,'#e4d5b1');gradient.addColorStop(1,'#465538');
      c.fillStyle=gradient;c.fillRect(0,0,128,64);
      const source=new THREE.CanvasTexture(sky);source.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      source.mapping=THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
      const generator=new THREE.PMREMGenerator(view.renderer);
      view.environmentTarget=generator.fromEquirectangular(source);
      view.scene.environment=view.environmentTarget.texture;view.scene.environmentIntensity=.3;
      source.dispose();generator.dispose();
    
      const m=view.materials;
      surfaceRelief(m.stone,.12);surfaceRelief(m.wood,.055);
      for(const roof of view.roofMaterials)surfaceRelief(roof,.085);
      m.plaster.color.setHex(0xd9c8a6);m.stone.color.setHex(0xb6b5a4);
      m.stoneDark.color.setHex(0x737e78);m.iron.metalness=.8;m.iron.roughness=.32;
      m.gold.metalness=.75;m.gold.roughness=.3;m.shadow.opacity=.06;
      m.glass=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x263e42,roughness:.3,metalness:.08});
      m.timberEdge=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x473328,roughness:.92});
      view.geo.head=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,8);
      view.geo.torso=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.47,.53,1,8);
      view.geo.shield=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.5,.5,1,12).rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
      view.geo.sphere.dispose();view.geo.sphere=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1);
    
      const shadowCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');shadowCanvas.width=shadowCanvas.height=64;
      const context=shadowCanvas.getContext('2d'),fade=context.createRadialGradient(32,32,3,32,32,32);
      fade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(14,26,20,.65)');fade.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(14,26,20,.34)');fade.addColorStop(1,'rgba(14,26,20,0)');
      context.fillStyle=fade;context.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
      const map=new THREE.CanvasTexture(shadowCanvas);map.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      const material=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map,transparent:true,opacity:.72,depthWrite:false});
      view.contactShadows=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1,1),material,1024);
      view.contactShadows.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
      view.contactShadows.frustumCulled=false;view.contactShadows.count=0;
      view.contactDummy=new THREE.Object3D();view.contactDummy.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
      view.scene.add(view.contactShadows);
    }
    
    function updateContacts(view,menu){
      const mesh=view.contactShadows,dummy=view.contactDummy;let count=0;
      for(const e of view.sim.entities){
        if(count===1024)break;
        if(e.hp<=0||e.embarked||e.water||UNITS[e.type]?.naval||e.type==='farm'||(e.kind==='building'&&e.progress===0))continue;
        const shown=menu||e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||view.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||(e.kind==='resource'&&view.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z));
        if(!shown)continue;
        const radius=e.type==='wood'?2.2:e.kind==='unit'?Math.max(.55,e.r||.5):(e.r||1.5)*1.05;
        const x=e.renderX??e.x,z=e.renderZ??e.z;
        if(!nearViewport(view,x,view.groundHeight(x,z),z,Math.max(4,radius*2)))continue;
        dummy.position.set(x,view.groundHeight(x,z)+.035,z);
        const normal=(view.contactNormal??=new THREE.Vector3()).set(view.groundHeight(x-.25,z)-view.groundHeight(x+.25,z),.5,view.groundHeight(x,z-.25)-view.groundHeight(x,z+.25)).normalize();
        dummy.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(view.contactForward??=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1),normal);
        dummy.scale.set(radius*2.8,radius*2.8,1);dummy.updateMatrix();mesh.setMatrixAt(count++,dummy.matrix);
      }
      mesh.count=count;mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
    }

    out = project / ".tools/art-refined"

    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)

        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)

        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])

        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")

    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
        faces.append(tuple(base + sides + i for i in range(sides)))
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            faces.append((base + i, base + j, base + sides + j, base + sides + i))
    
    def organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, detail):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=detail, radius=1)
        bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        base = len(vertices)
        for vert in bm.verts:
            p = vert.co
            noise = 1 + .12 * math.sin(p.x * 5 + p.y * 3) + rng.uniform(-.055, .055)
            vertices.append((center[0] + p.x * scale[0] * noise,
                             center[1] + p.y * scale[1] * noise,
                             center[2] + p.z * scale[2] * noise))
        for face in bm.faces:
            faces.append(tuple(base + vert.index for vert in face.verts))
        bm.free()
    
    def author_tree(root):
        _, biome, variant, lod = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        variant = int(variant)
        rng = random.Random(2201 + variant)
        far = lod == "far"
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        vertices, faces = [], []
        height = 5.8 + variant * .15
        # A gently bent, tapering trunk avoids the straight toy-cylinder silhouette.
        trunk = [(0, 0, 0), (.06, -.025, height*.28),
                 (.13+variant*.025, -.06, height*.56), (.18, -.10, height*.80)]
        radii = [.28, .235, .17, .105]
        for segment in range(len(trunk)-1):
            rod_data(vertices, faces, trunk[segment], trunk[segment+1], radii[segment],
                     radii[segment+1]/radii[segment], 8 if far else 13)
        for i in range(4 if not far else 2):
            angle = i * math.tau / 4 + variant
            rod_data(vertices, faces, (0, 0, .35),
                     (math.cos(angle) * .72, math.sin(angle) * .72, .035), .15, .22)
        crowns = []
        for i in range(3 if far else 7):
            angle = i * 2.399 + variant
            radius = (.82 + rng.random()*.28) if i else .15
            location = (math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius,
                        height - .1 - (i % 3) * .58)
            junction = (.13, -.06, height*.50)
            bend = ((junction[0]+location[0])*.5, (junction[1]+location[1])*.5, height*.70)
            rod_data(vertices, faces, junction, bend, .10, .6, 7 if far else 10)
            rod_data(vertices, faces, bend, location, .06, .25, 6 if far else 9)
            crowns.append(location)
        make_mesh(root, "trunk", vertices, faces, root.name + "_Bark")
        if biome == "winter":
            for role, snow in [("leafDark", False), ("snow", True)]:
                vertices, faces = [], []
                for tier in range(3):
                    z = 2.2 + tier * 1.02 + (0.24 if snow else 0)
                    radius = (2.05 - tier * .4) * (.81 if snow else 1)
                    # Closed tiered crowns keep snow and foliage fully volumetric.
                    sides, base = (7 if far else 11), len(vertices)
                    for j in range(sides):
                        angle = j * math.tau / sides
                        vertices.append((math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius, z))
                    vertices.append((.04, -.03, z + (1.95 if snow else 2.3)))
                    faces.append(tuple(base + j for j in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
                    for j in range(sides):
                        faces.append((base + j, base + (j + 1) % sides, base + sides))
                make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
        else:
            for parity, role in [(0, "leaf"), (1, "leafDark")]:
                vertices, faces = [], []
                for i, center in enumerate(crowns):
                    if i % 2 != parity:
                        continue
                    scale = (1.4, 1.25, .78 if biome == "desert" else 1.12)
                    # Smooth closed lobes retain volume at both detail levels.
                    # The old 20-triangle far lobes visibly broke the silhouette.
                    organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, 2 if far else 3)
                make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
    
    def weld(obj):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
        bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=list(bm.verts), dist=.00001)
        bm.normal_update()
        bm.to_mesh(obj.data)
        bm.free()
        obj.data.update()
        if obj.get("assetMaterial") in {"skin", "hair", "pants", "team", "canvas", "leather", "straw", "horse", "mane", "leaf", "leafDark", "trunk"}:

            obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(55))
    
    def roof_tiles(root):

    // Shared materials and one instanced shadow pass keep the depth cues affordable.

    }

      gradient.addColorStop(.53,'#e4d5b1');gradient.addColorStop(1,'#465538');

      source.mapping=THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;

      view.environmentTarget=generator.fromEquirectangular(source);
      view.scene.environment=view.environmentTarget.texture;view.scene.environmentIntensity=.3;

      for(const roof of view.roofMaterials)surfaceRelief(roof,.085);
      m.plaster.color.setHex(0xd9c8a6);m.stone.color.setHex(0xb6b5a4);
      m.stoneDark.color.setHex(0x737e78);m.iron.metalness=.8;m.iron.roughness=.32;

      m.timberEdge=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x473328,roughness:.92});

    export function contactPose(view,e,x,z,radius){

      if(previous&&previous.x===x&&previous.z===z&&previous.radius===radius)return previous;

    async function ready(page){await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'networkidle'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view,null,{timeout:90000});}
    try{
      page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});watch(page);
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'high',autoQuality:false,volume:0,music:false})));
      const started=Date.now();await ready(page);
      const boot=await page.evaluate(()=>({art:frontier.view.artDiagnostics,quality:frontier.view.settings.quality}));
      assert.equal(boot.art.models,126);assert.equal(boot.art.source,'Blender');assert.equal(boot.art.detail,'high');
      report.checks.push({boot,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started});console.log('Verified: the game starts with the detailed Blender catalogue.');
      await page.locator('.landing-header [data-action=settings]').click();await page.locator('#frame-rate').selectOption('60');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Apply settings'}).click();assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crowns-settings')).frameRate),'60');report.checks.push({savedFrameRateTarget:60});
      await page.evaluate(()=>{
        frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',faction:'alder',difficulty:'normal',seed:512});
        const s=frontier.sim;s.owned(0,'unit','villager').forEach(e=>s.stop([e.id]));
        const sites=[['keep',-15,17],['gate',-8,33],['tower',-15,43],['farm',-36,49],['farm',-29,49],['market',-25,4],['range',-42,7],['stable',-48,18],['blacksmith',-51,35],['workshop',-19,54],['monastery',-55,51],['camp',-56,2],['mine',-21,-9],['wonder',-6,0]];
        for(const[type,x,z]of sites)s.addBuilding(type,0,x,z,true);
        for(let z=22;z<=45;z+=2.85)s.addBuilding('wall',0,-8,z,true);
        for(let i=0;i<36;i++)s.addUnit(['spearman','swordsman','archer','knight','ram','catapult'][i%6],0,-33+i%12*2.2,36+Math.floor(i/12)*2.3);
        s.updateFog();frontier.view.focus(-30,28);frontier.view.angle=.65;frontier.view.zoom=84;frontier.view.tilt=.65;frontier.view.updateCamera();
      });

        authoredBuildings:[...frontier.view.nodes.values()].filter(n=>n.userData.model3d?.kind==='building'&&n.userData.model3d.authored).length,
        authoredUnits:[...frontier.view.nodes.values()].filter(n=>n.userData.model3d?.kind==='unit'&&n.userData.model3d.authored).length,
        calls:frontier.view.renderer.info.render.calls,triangles:frontier.view.renderer.info.render.triangles,

      console.log('Verified: buildings and batched troops use the Blender models in the live battlefield.');
    
      const workers=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        const e=frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],v=frontier.view;
        frontier.sim.stop([e.id]);frontier.select([e.id]);
        const jobs=[['wood','wood'],['gold','mine'],['food','food'],['farm','build']];
        const results=[];
        for(let pass=0;pass<3;pass++)for(const [resource,variant] of jobs){
          const target=frontier.sim.entities.find(entity=>entity.type===resource&&entity.hp>0);
          e.order={type:variant==='build'?'build':'gather',target:target.id};e.moving=false;e.carryType='wood';
          const old=v.nodes.get(e.id),oldBatch=old.userData.batch,oldIndex=old.userData.index;
          v.render(.033,false);const node=v.nodes.get(e.id);
          const alive=[...v.unitBatches.values()].reduce((n,b)=>n+b.ids.filter(id=>id===e.id).length,0);
          const oldCleared=old===node||oldBatch.ids[oldIndex]===null;
          results.push({variant:node.userData.unitVariant,expected:variant,alive,oldCleared,selected:v.selection.has(e.id),figure:node.userData.model3d.figure});
        }
        frontier.sim.stop([e.id]);
        return {changes:results,capacity:[...v.unitBatches.values()].filter(b=>b.model3d.type==='villager').map(b=>({slots:b.ids.length,free:b.free.length}))};
      });
      for(const result of workers.changes){assert.equal(result.variant,result.expected);assert.equal(result.figure,'adult');assert.equal(result.alive,1);assert.ok(result.oldCleared&&result.selected);}
      assert.ok(workers.capacity.every(b=>b.slots<=10));report.checks.push({workers});
      console.log('Verified: worker tools change with jobs, recycle their slots, and preserve selection without duplicate figures.');
    
      const picking=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        const e=frontier.sim.addUnit('swordsman',0,-40,60),v=frontier.view;

        const node=v.nodes.get(e.id),point=node.position.clone();point.y+=1.4;point.project(v.camera);
        const picked=v.pick((point.x+1)*innerWidth/2,(1-point.y)*innerHeight/2);
        return {expected:e.id,picked:picked?.id,packed:node.userData.batch.renderIds.includes(e.id)};
      });assert.equal(picking.picked,picking.expected);assert.ok(picking.packed);report.checks.push({packedPicking:picking});
    
      const teams=await page.evaluate(()=>{

        return {shared:first===second,owners:[a,b].map(e=>first.parts[0].geometry.attributes.instanceOwner.getX(first.renderIds.indexOf(e.id))),teamMask:first.parts[0].geometry.attributes.unitTeamMask.array.some(mask=>mask>0)};
      });assert.ok(teams.shared);assert.deepEqual(teams.owners,[0,1]);assert.ok(teams.teamMask);report.checks.push({sharedTeamBatches:teams});
    
      const remains=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        const s=frontier.sim,v=frontier.view;
        for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const e=s.addUnit(['spearman','swordsman','archer'][i%3],0,-42+i*1.4,61);s.hurt(e,e.maxHp+1);}

      });assert.ok(remains.diagnostics.bodies>=6);assert.equal(remains.diagnostics.rubble,12);assert.ok(remains.diagnostics.retained<=remains.diagnostics.limit);assert.ok(remains.solid&&remains.finite);report.checks.push({remains});
      await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-battle-remains.png'});
    
      await page.evaluate(()=>{const e=frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];frontier.select([e.id]);frontier.action('inspect');});
      await page.waitForTimeout(400);await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/blender-villager-high.png'});
      const selection=await page.evaluate(()=>({target:frontier.view.target.toArray(),zoom:frontier.view.zoom,selected:[...frontier.view.selection],time:frontier.sim.time}));
      await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.quality('low'));

    param([switch]$Visible,[switch]$Showcase)
    
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $taskProject = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'))
    $taskTools = Join-Path $taskProject '.tools'
    $taskBlender = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-4.5.14-windows-x64\blender.exe'
    $taskProfile = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-profile'
    $taskLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stdout.log'
    $taskErrorLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stderr.log'
    
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskBlender)) {
        throw 'Project Blender installation is missing.'
    }
    
    # A duplicate instance would compete for the same connector port.
    $taskExisting = Get-Process blender -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $taskBlender }
    if ($taskExisting) {
        $taskExisting | Select-Object Id,ProcessName
        return
    }
    
    $taskPreviousConfig = $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG
    $taskPreviousScripts = $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS
    try {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = Join-Path $taskProfile 'config'
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = Join-Path $taskProfile 'scripts'
        $taskWindow = if ($Visible) { 'Normal' } else { 'Hidden' }
        $taskStartup = @{}
        if ($Showcase) {
            $taskScript = Join-Path $taskProject 'scripts\blender\showcase.py'
            $taskStartup.ArgumentList = @('--python', ('"' + $taskScript + '"'))
        }
        Start-Process -FilePath $taskBlender -WorkingDirectory $taskProject @taskStartup `
            -WindowStyle $taskWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $taskLog `
            -RedirectStandardError $taskErrorLog -PassThru |
            Select-Object Id,ProcessName
    } finally {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = $taskPreviousConfig
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = $taskPreviousScripts
    }

    def weld(obj):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
        bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=list(bm.verts), dist=.00001)
        bm.normal_update()
        bm.to_mesh(obj.data)
        bm.free()
        obj.data.update()
        if obj.get("assetMaterial") in {"skin", "hair", "pants", "team", "canvas", "leather", "straw", "horse", "mane", "leaf", "leafDark", "trunk"}:
            for polygon in obj.data.polygons:
                polygon.use_smooth = True
            # Blender 4.5 splits sharp joins while preserving curved skin and cloth.
            obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(55))
    
    def roof_tiles(root):
        key = root["assetKey"]
        if not key.startswith("building:") or ":sun:" in key:
            return
        for roof in [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial") == "teamRoof"]:
            mesh = roof.data
            vertices = [roof.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in mesh.vertices]
            faces = [tuple(poly.vertices) for poly in mesh.polygons]
            tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
            minx, maxx = min(v.x for v in vertices), max(v.x for v in vertices)
            miny, maxy = min(v.y for v in vertices), max(v.y for v in vertices)
            top = max(v.z for v in vertices) + 1
            tile_vertices, tile_faces = [], []
            count = 0
            y = miny + .28
            while y < maxy - .15 and count < 140:
                x = minx + .29
                while x < maxx - .15 and count < 140:
                    point, normal, _, _ = tree.ray_cast(Vector((x, y, top)), Vector((0, 0, -1)))
                    if point is not None and .3 < normal.z < .95:
                        tangent = Vector((0, 1, 0))
                        tangent = (tangent - normal * tangent.dot(normal)).normalized()
                        across = tangent.cross(normal).normalized()
                        base = len(tile_vertices)
                        for depth in [0, .035]:
                            for a, b in [(-.285, -.235), (.285, -.235), (.285, .235), (-.285, .235)]:
                                tile_vertices.append(tuple(point + across * a + tangent * b + normal * (depth + .006)))
                        tile_faces.extend([(base,base+3,base+2,base+1),(base+4,base+5,base+6,base+7),
                                           (base,base+1,base+5,base+4),(base+1,base+2,base+6,base+5),
                                           (base+2,base+3,base+7,base+6),(base+3,base,base+4,base+7)])
                        count += 1
                    x += .6
                y += .49
            if tile_vertices:
                obj = make_mesh(root, "teamRoof", tile_vertices, tile_faces, root.name + "_SlateTiles")
                obj["nearOnly"] = True
    
    def bake_shading(root):
        meshes = [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH"]
        vertices, faces = [], []
        for obj in meshes:
            base = len(vertices)
            vertices.extend(obj.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in obj.data.vertices)
            faces.extend(tuple(base + v for v in poly.vertices) for poly in obj.data.polygons)
        tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
        is_unit = root["assetKey"].startswith("unit:")
        distance = .65 if is_unit else 1.6
        for obj in meshes:
            mesh = obj.data
            old = mesh.color_attributes.get("BakedDepth")
            if old:
                mesh.color_attributes.remove(old)
            colors = mesh.color_attributes.new(name="BakedDepth", type="FLOAT_COLOR", domain="POINT")
            mesh.color_attributes.active_color = colors
            matrix, normal_matrix = obj.matrix_world, obj.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted().transposed()
            for vert in mesh.vertices:
                p = matrix @ vert.co
                normal = (normal_matrix @ vert.normal).normalized()
                u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
                if u.length < .01:
                    u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
                u.normalize()
                v = normal.cross(u).normalized()
                occlusion = 0
                for direction in [normal, (normal + u * .8).normalized(),
                                  (normal - u * .8).normalized(), (normal + v * .8).normalized()]:
                    hit, _, _, dist = tree.ray_cast(p + normal * .018, direction, distance)
                    if hit is not None:
                        occlusion += 1 - dist / distance
                shade = max(.64, 1 - occlusion * .075)
                colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade, shade, shade, 1)

    export function combatJointAngle(entity,joint){
      const definition=UNITS[entity.type];if(!definition||entity.moving||!definition.damage||!['ranged','infantry','cavalry','spear'].includes(definition.role))return null;
      const aiming=definition.role==='ranged'&&entity.order?.type==='attack';if(!entity.cooldown&&!aiming)return null;
      const interval=definition.cooldown||1.2,phase=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-(entity.cooldown||0)/interval));

        if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.06:-.25-draw*.65;
        if(joint.type==='torso')return -.018+draw*.028;
        if(joint.type==='head')return -.045;

      }

    function updateContacts(view,menu){
      const mesh=view.contactShadows;let count=0;
      for(const e of view.sim.entities){
        if(count===1024)break;
        if(e.hp<=0||e.embarked||e.water||UNITS[e.type]?.naval||e.type==='farm'||(e.kind==='building'&&e.progress===0))continue;
        const shown=menu||e.owner===0||e.kind==='shrine'||view.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)||(e.kind==='resource'&&view.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z));
        if(!shown)continue;
        const radius=e.type==='wood'?2.2:e.kind==='unit'?Math.max(.55,e.r||.5):(e.r||1.5)*1.05;
        const x=e.renderX??e.x,z=e.renderZ??e.z;
        const pose=contactPose(view,e,x,z,radius);
        if(!nearViewport(view,x,pose.ground,z,Math.max(4,radius*2)))continue;
        mesh.setMatrixAt(count++,pose.matrix);
      }
      if(view.clock-(view.contactPrunedAt||0)>2){for(const id of view.contactCache?.keys()||[])if(!view.sim.get(id))view.contactCache.delete(id);view.contactPrunedAt=view.clock;}
      mesh.count=count;mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
    }

            const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(raw),before=[];raw.traverse(p=>{if(p.isMesh)before.push(p);});

            const again=view.makeBuilding(e),other=[];again.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.structureSurface)other.push(p);});

            }
            if(type==='mill'){let rotor;packed.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.windmill)rotor=p;});assert.ok(rotor.children.some(p=>p.userData.structureSurface));}
            let disposed=false;staticMesh.geometry.addEventListener('dispose',()=>disposed=true);view.releaseNode(packed);assert.equal(disposed,false);
          }

          assert.notEqual(ga,gb);assert.notDeepEqual(ga.attributes.color.array,gb.attributes.color.array);

          building.progress=1;view.updateConstruction(building,node);assert.equal(node.userData.construction,undefined);
        }

    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge
    // compressed meshes reliably, including normalized/interleaved source buffers.
    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      const positions=geometry.getAttribute('position');
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('color'))geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(positions.count*3).fill(1),3));
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('uv')){
        const uv=new Float32Array(positions.count*2);
        for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){uv[i*2]=positions.getX(i)*.25;uv[i*2+1]=(positions.getY(i)+positions.getZ(i))*.25;}
        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      if(templates.size<100)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete.');
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='high'?'high':'low';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());
      try{const catalogue=await pending.get(detail);if(serial===loadSerial)active=catalogue;return catalogue;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }
    
    export function workerVisualTask(view,e){
      if(e.type!=='villager')return 'standard';
      const activity=e.order?.type||e.activity;
      if(['build','repair'].includes(activity))return 'build';
      const target=view.sim?.get?.(e.order?.target),resource=activity==='gather'?target?.type||e.gatherType||e.carryType:e.carryType;
      if(['gold','stone'].includes(resource))return 'mine';
      if(resource==='food'||resource==='farm')return 'food';
      return 'wood';
    }
    export function authoredUnit(view,e){
      const task=workerVisualTask(view,e);
      return (e.type==='villager'?cloneAsset(view,`unit:villager:${task}`,e.owner):null)||cloneAsset(view,`unit:${e.type}`,e.owner);
    }
    export function authoredBuilding(view,e){
      const faction=view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.faction||'alder';
      const age=e.type==='towncenter'?(view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.age||0):0;
      const root=cloneAsset(view,`building:${e.type}:${faction}:${age}`,e.owner);
      if(root&&e.type==='dock')root.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.userData.dockPier)return;
        let angle=0;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(view.sim.isWater(e.x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*9,e.z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*9)){angle=i*Math.PI/8;break;}
        part.rotation.y=-angle;
      });
      return root;
    }
    export function authoredResource(view,e){
      const key=e.kind==='shrine'?'resource:shrine':e.water?'resource:fish':`resource:${e.type}:${e.id%4}`;
      return cloneAsset(view,key,Math.max(0,e.owner||0));
    }
    export function authoredTree(view,map,variant,far){
      const biome=['winter','desert'].includes(map)?map:'highlands';
      return cloneAsset(view,`tree:${biome}:${variant}:${far?'far':'near'}`);
    }

    import bpy

    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(project / ".tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend"))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:

    buildings = ["towncenter", "house", "mill", "camp", "mine", "barracks", "range", "stable", "workshop", "blacksmith", "market", "tower", "keep", "wall", "gate", "monastery", "wonder", "dock", "farm"]
    units = ["villager", "spearman", "swordsman", "archer", "scout", "knight", "sentinel", "marksman", "outrider", "monk", "king", "ram", "catapult", "cart", "fishingboat", "galley", "warship", "transport"]
    for root in roots:
        parts = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        if parts[0] == "building":
            faction = ["alder", "sun", "raven"].index(parts[2])
            column = buildings.index(parts[1])
            if parts[1] == "towncenter" and parts[3] != "3":
                root.hide_viewport = True
                root.hide_render = True
                continue
            root.location = ((column % 7) * 15, faction * 52 + (column // 7) * 16, 0)
        elif parts[0] == "unit":
            column = units.index(parts[1])
            root.location = ((column % 9) * 7, -18 - (column // 9) * 12, 0)
            if len(parts) > 2:
                column = ["wood", "mine", "food", "build"].index(parts[2])
                root.location = (column * 7, -42, 0)
        elif parts[0] == "tree":
            if parts[-1] == "far":
                root.hide_viewport = True
                root.hide_render = True
                continue
            biome = ["highlands", "winter", "desert"].index(parts[1])
            root.location = (112 + int(parts[2]) * 8, biome * 14, 0)
        else:
            column = ["food", "gold", "stone", "fish", "shrine"].index(parts[1])
            variant = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
            root.location = (112 + variant * 8, 50 + column * 12, 0)
    
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
    focus = next(root for root in roots if root["assetKey"] == "building:towncenter:alder:3")
    focus.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = focus
    for screen in bpy.data.screens:
        for area in screen.areas:
            if area.type != "VIEW_3D":
                continue
            space = area.spaces.active
            space.shading.type = "SOLID"
            space.shading.color_type = "MATERIAL"
            space.shading.light = "STUDIO"
            space.shading.show_shadows = True
            space.shading.show_cavity = True
            space.shading.cavity_type = "BOTH"
            space.shading.use_scene_world = False
            space.overlay.show_floor = False
            space.overlay.show_axis_x = False
            space.overlay.show_axis_y = False
            space.region_3d.view_distance = 95
            space.region_3d.view_location = (30, 7, 1)
            space.region_3d.view_rotation = (0.82, 0.42, 0.18, 0.34)
    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(project / ".tools/art-refined/frontier-showcase.blend"), compress=True)
    print("Opened the actual building, troop, tree and resource showcase in Blender.")

      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.035:0):e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.025:0):e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='torso')return e.moving?walk*.022:working?.04+Math.sin(view.clock*4+e.id)*.022:Math.sin(view.clock*1.7+e.id)*.009;
      if(m.type==='head')return e.moving?-.018:Math.sin(view.clock*1.4+e.id)*.012;
      if(m.type==='cape')return Math.sin(view.clock*2+e.id)*(.025+(view.weatherState?.intensity||0)*.035)+(e.moving?.07:0);
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm'){
        if(working)return m.side<0?-.12:-.18+Math.sin(view.clock*(workerVisualTask(view,e)==='build'?8:6)+e.id)*.12;
        return e.moving?-.15:0;
      }
      if(m.type==='arm'){
        if(working){const task=workerVisualTask(view,e),rate=task==='build'?8:task==='food'?4:6;return m.side<0?-.24+Math.sin(view.clock*rate+e.id)*.1:(task==='food'?-.55:-.65)+Math.sin(view.clock*rate+e.id)*(task==='food'?.22:task==='build'?.32:.60);}
        if(e.cooldown>.45)return -.3-Math.sin((1.2-e.cooldown)*5)*.75;
        return e.moving?walk*.3:0;
      }
      return 0;
    }
    export function animatePart(view,part,e,matrix){
      const m=part.userData.motion;if(!m)return matrix;
      const result=view.poseMatrix??=new THREE.Matrix4(),rotation=view.poseRotation??=new THREE.Matrix4();result.copy(matrix);
      if(m.type==='ram'){const translation=part.userData.ramTranslation??=new THREE.Matrix4();translation.makeTranslation(0,0,e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(e.cooldown*8)*.25:0);return result.multiply(translation);}
      if(!part.userData.poseChain){const chain=[];for(let joint=m;joint;joint=joint.parent)chain.unshift({joint,forward:new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(...joint.pivot),back:new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(-joint.pivot[0],-joint.pivot[1],-joint.pivot[2])});part.userData.poseChain=chain;}
      for(const pose of part.userData.poseChain){rotation.makeRotationX(jointAngle(view,pose.joint,e));result.multiply(pose.forward).multiply(rotation).multiply(pose.back);}
      return result;
    }
    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads three CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is approximately 12.2 MiB; the lower detail GLB is approximately 2.5 MiB. Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Nine photographed surface maps total approximately 7.4 MiB.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Curved tapering trunks, branching bends and smoother closed foliage replace the coarse crown silhouettes. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size; important trees keep their richer geometry at ordinary RTS zoom.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    
    `tests/authored-assets.test.js`, `tests/render-batches.test.js`, `tests/ground-cover.test.js` and `tests/battle-remains.test.js` check catalogue coverage, bounds, joints, tools, ownership, packing, foundations and effect limits. `scripts/authored-art-qa.mjs` reviews the live renderer, camera/selection preservation, biomes, naval models and emulated landscape-phone controls. Rendering targets and actual measured limitations are recorded separately in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).

      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());

      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }

    });

      const model=unitModel(v,e),before=solidBounds(model),raw=[];model.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)raw.push(m);});

      const joint=parts.find(p=>p.userData.motion?.type==='knee');assert.ok(joint);v.clock=.1;const first=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();v.clock=.4;const second=animatePart(v,joint,e,new THREE.Matrix4()).clone();assert.notDeepEqual(first.elements,second.elements);assert.ok(Math.abs(first.determinant()-1)<.001);

      const v=viewFixture(),vertices=[];for(let age=0;age<4;age++){v.sim.players[0].age=age;const model=buildingModel(v,{kind:'building',type:'towncenter',owner:0,r:5,x:-19,z:25});solidBounds(model);v.mergeModel(model);assert.equal(model.userData.model3d.architectureAge,age);let count=0;model.traverse(part=>{if(part.isMesh)count+=part.geometry.getAttribute('position').count;});vertices.push(count);}

      const worker=v.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],tree=v.sim.entities.find(e=>e.type==='wood');worker.carry=18;worker.carryType='wood';v.interactions=new WorldInteractions(v);tree.hp=0;tree.amount=0;v.interactions.update(.1,false);
      assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.cargo.wood,1);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.stumps,1);assert.equal(v.treeFalls.size,1);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.drawCalls,2);
      v.clock=2;v.interactions.update(.1,false);assert.equal(v.treeFalls.size,0);assert.equal(v.interactionDiagnostics.stumps,1);v.interactions.dispose();assert.equal(v.scene.children.length,0);

    test('tree falling and wind transforms preserve finite volume and original terrain placement',()=>{
      const base=new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(14,2.5,7),new THREE.Quaternion(),new THREE.Vector3(1.2,1.2,1.2)),v={clock:1,settings:{quality:'high'},weatherState:{intensity:1}};
      for(const [leaves,fall]of [[true,null],[false,{at:0}]]){const pose=forestTransform(v,base,31,leaves,fall).clone();assert.ok(pose.elements.every(Number.isFinite));assert.ok(Math.abs(pose.determinant()-base.determinant())<.0001);assert.deepEqual(new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(pose).toArray(),[14,2.5,7]);assert.notDeepEqual(pose.elements,base.elements);}

    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    | AI and custom battles | Eight allied/enemy kingdoms, selectable difficulty/pace, real reinforcement groups, home reserves and team victory | Reliable formations, route recovery, scouting/retreat/counter choices, stronger coordinated pressure and interesting long wars. Verify full matches across seeds, biomes, starting ages and player configurations. |
    | Campaigns and maps | Six staged chapters, checkpoints, journals, escort/defense/naval objectives and seven seeded biomes | More distinctive authored locations, mission events, varied encounters and pacing, plus completion/failure testing and human reviews on every difficulty. |
    | Controls and interface | Desktop edge scrolling, square radar/locator, production overview, hotkeys, landscape touch | Responsive, precise and readable control through crowded play; camera/selection/production remain reliable on real devices. Preserve the user's removal of movement lines. |
    | Audio and feedback | Synthesized ambience/music/combat/weather and bounded voices | More distinctive, coherent unit/impact/ambient layers and clear attack/order feedback; assess audibility and fatigue over full matches. |
    | Multiplayer and release | Authoritative mixed human/AI rooms, ownership/fog privacy, reconnect, static/Node builds and local saves | Hosted capacity/latency/loss/restart tests, version compatibility, durable operations where required, installation/update recovery, accessibility and external playtesting. Public matchmaking/persistent rooms remain unfinished. |
    
    The gaps are broader than frame rate. [Blizzard's Reforged development update](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23411981/warcraft-iii-reforged-developer-update) addresses art, gameplay and systems across campaign/custom/versus modes. [AoE IV's formation and allied-healing changes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/) provide concrete genre examples. These are historical design references, not claims that our implementation matches them.
    
    Green tests prove their covered scenarios. They do not prove AAA parity, human enjoyment, complete balance or compatibility with every possible device. Keep the full goal active until its requirements have appropriate evidence.

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
    $taskSourceFiles=@()
    foreach ($taskDirectory in @('src','server','scripts','tests','public')) {
        $taskSourceFiles+=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskProject $taskDirectory) -Recurse -File
    }
    foreach ($taskFileName in @('package.json','package-lock.json','index.html','vite.config.js','netlify.toml','render.yaml','.gitignore','.nvmrc','README.md','ART_PIPELINE.md','DEPLOYMENT.md','RELEASE_CHECKS.md','ROADMAP.md','CHANGELOG.md','DEVELOPMENT_CHECKPOINT.md','QUALITY_TARGETS.md')) {
        $taskFilePath=Join-Path $taskProject $taskFileName
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskFilePath) { $taskSourceFiles+=Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskFilePath }
    }
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-source.zip" $taskProject $taskSourceFiles
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-static.zip" $taskStatic (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskStatic -Recurse -File)

    +def leaf_volume(vertices, faces, center, direction, length, width, thickness=.025):
    +    """A pointed leaf with a raised vein and a closed underside, not a card."""
    +    center, axis = Vector(center), Vector(direction).normalized()
    +    across = axis.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    +    if across.length < .01:
    +        across = axis.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
    +    across.normalize()
    +    normal = across.cross(axis).normalized()
    +    base = len(vertices)
    +    vertices.extend(tuple(point) for point in [center + axis*length*.5,
    +        center + across*width, center - axis*length*.5, center - across*width,
    +        center + normal*thickness, center - normal*thickness])
    +    for i in range(4):
    +        j = (i+1) % 4
    +        faces.extend([(base+i, base+j, base+4), (base+j, base+i, base+5)])
    +
    +def crown_leaves(root, crowns, scale, rng):
    +    for parity, role in [(0, "leaf"), (1, "leafDark")]:
    +        vertices, faces = [], []
    +        for i, center in enumerate(crowns):

    +            # Stable surface distribution with different tilt/size at each tip.

    +                angle = j*2.399963 + rng.uniform(-.16, .16)

    +        if vertices:

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {animatePart} from './world-polish.js';
    
    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.
    // Picking uses the packed IDs, never the allocator's potentially empty slots.
    export function beginUnitFrame(view){
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values())batch.renderIds.length=0;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      for(const part of batch.parts){part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner')?.setX(index,e.owner||0);}
      return true;
    }
    
    export function endUnitFrame(view){
      let drawn=0,allocated=0,activeBatches=0;
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){
        const count=batch.renderIds.length;drawn+=count;allocated+=batch.ids.length-batch.free.length;
        if(count)activeBatches++;
        for(const part of batch.parts){part.count=count;part.visible=count>0;part.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;part.boundingSphere=null;const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner');if(owner)owner.needsUpdate=true;}
      }
      view.unitRenderDiagnostics={drawn,allocated,activeBatches};
    }

    +          volume+=a.dot(b.cross(c))/6;

## Assistant

## Activity

    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads three CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is approximately 12.2 MiB; the lower detail GLB is approximately 2.5 MiB. Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Nine photographed surface maps total approximately 7.4 MiB.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Curved tapering trunks, branching bends and smoother closed foliage replace the coarse crown silhouettes. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size; important trees keep their richer geometry at ordinary RTS zoom.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    
    `tests/authored-assets.test.js`, `tests/render-batches.test.js`, `tests/ground-cover.test.js` and `tests/battle-remains.test.js` check catalogue coverage, bounds, joints, tools, ownership, packing, foundations and effect limits. `scripts/authored-art-qa.mjs` reviews the live renderer, camera/selection preservation, biomes, naval models and emulated landscape-phone controls. Rendering targets and actual measured limitations are recorded separately in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).
