          shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 structureSurface;\nattribute vec3 structureEmission;\nvarying vec3 vStructureSurface;\nvarying vec3 vStructureEmission;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
          shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>','#include <color_vertex>\nvStructureSurface = structureSurface;\nvStructureEmission = structureEmission;');
          shader.fragmentShader=`uniform sampler2D frontierStructurewood;
            uniform sampler2D frontierStructurestone;
            uniform sampler2D frontierStructurewoodNormal;
            uniform sampler2D frontierStructurestoneNormal;
            uniform sampler2D frontierStructurewoodArm;
            uniform sampler2D frontierStructurestoneArm;
            uniform float frontierStructuredetail;
            varying vec3 vStructureSurface;
            varying vec3 vStructureEmission;\n`+shader.fragmentShader;
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>',`#include <color_fragment>
            if(vStructureSurface.z > 1.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierStructurestone, vUv).rgb;
            else if(vStructureSurface.z > 0.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierStructurewood, vUv).rgb;`);

    function bakeSurface(view,part,matrix){
      const geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(matrix),count=geometry.attributes.position.count;
      // Indexed geometry retains the compressed catalogue's shared vertices in RAM.
      if(!geometry.index)geometry.setIndex(Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>i));
      for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
      if(!geometry.attributes.normal)geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      if(!geometry.attributes.uv)geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count*2),2));
      const old=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(count*3),surface=new Float32Array(count*3),emission=new Float32Array(count*3);
      const m=view.materials,material=part.material,color=material.color.toArray(),emissive=material.emissive?.toArray()||[0,0,0];
      const mode=[m.wood,m.darkwood,m.timberEdge].includes(material)&&m.wood.map?1:[m.stone,m.brick].includes(material)&&m.stone.map?2:0;
      for(let i=0;i<count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
        colors[i*3+k]=color[k]*(old?old.getComponent(i,k):1);
        surface[i*3+k]=k===0?material.roughness??.9:k===1?material.metalness??0:mode;
        emission[i*3+k]=emissive[k]*(material.emissiveIntensity??1);
      }
      geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));
      geometry.setAttribute('structureSurface',new THREE.BufferAttribute(surface,3));
      geometry.setAttribute('structureEmission',new THREE.BufferAttribute(emission,3));
      geometry.clearGroups();return geometry;
    }

    const cache=new Map(),surfaces={};
    async function texture(role,kind){
      const key=role+':'+kind;if(!cache.has(key))cache.set(key,new THREE.TextureLoader().loadAsync(files[role][kind]).then(map=>{
        map.colorSpace=kind==='color'?THREE.SRGBColorSpace:THREE.NoColorSpace;map.wrapS=map.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;map.flipY=false;map.anisotropy=4;
        (surfaces[role]??={})[kind]=map;return map;
      }).catch(error=>{cache.delete(key);throw error;}));return cache.get(key);
    }
    export async function loadSurfaceAssets(quality){
      const kinds=quality==='high'?['color','normal','arm']:quality==='medium'?['color','normal']:['color'];
      await Promise.all(Object.keys(files).flatMap(role=>kinds.map(kind=>texture(role,kind))));
    }
    export function surfaceAssetState(){return {source:'Poly Haven CC0',loaded:[...cache.keys()].length};}
    
    export function applySurfaceMaterials(view){

    export function applyGroundSurface(material,land,quality){
      const set=surfaces.grass;if(!set?.color)return;
      const amount=land.map==='winter'?.16:['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map)?.22:.72;
      // Preserve the seeded biome and roads; photographed detail keeps a consistent
      // physical scale across both small and huge maps.
      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        shader.uniforms.frontierGroundColor={value:set.color};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundScale={value:land.renderSize/2};shader.uniforms.frontierGroundAmount={value:amount};
        shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierGroundColor;\nuniform float frontierGroundScale;\nuniform float frontierGroundAmount;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <map_fragment>',`#include <map_fragment>
          vec3 groundDetail = texture2D(frontierGroundColor, vMapUv * frontierGroundScale).rgb;
          float roadMask = smoothstep(0.018, 0.09, diffuseColor.r - diffuseColor.g);
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, groundDetail * 0.85, frontierGroundAmount * (1.0 - roadMask));`);
      };
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=>`frontier-ground-v1:${land.renderSize}:${amount}`;
      material.userData.surface='Poly Haven leafy grass';
      if(quality!=='low'&&set.normal){material.bumpMap?.dispose();material.bumpMap=null;material.normalMap=set.normal;material.normalMap.repeat.setScalar(land.renderSize/2);material.normalScale.setScalar(.35);}
      if(quality==='high'&&set.arm){material.roughnessMap=set.arm;material.roughnessMap.repeat.setScalar(land.renderSize/2);}
    }

        def section(role, center, rings, motion=None, sides=10):
            verts, faces = [], []
            for height, width, depth in rings:
                for i in range(sides):
                    angle = math.tau * i / sides
                    verts.append((center[0] + math.sin(angle) * width,
                                  center[1] + height, center[2] + math.cos(angle) * depth))
            faces.append(tuple(range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
            for ring in range(len(rings) - 1):
                for i in range(sides):
                    j = (i + 1) % sides
                    faces.append((ring * sides + i, ring * sides + j,
                                  (ring + 1) * sides + j, (ring + 1) * sides + i))
            faces.append(tuple((len(rings) - 1) * sides + i for i in range(sides)))
            add(role, verts, faces, motion)

    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Keep rendering poses outside the authoritative simulation/save data. The
    // fixed 10 Hz simulation can then move smoothly between ticks at any frame rate.
    export class LocalMotion{
      constructor(){this.previous=new Map();this.point={x:0,z:0};this.clear();}
      clear(){this.previous.clear();this.time=-1;this.sequence=0;}
      capture(sim){
        const sequence=++this.sequence;
        for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0){
          let pose=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!pose){pose={};this.previous.set(e.id,pose);}
          pose.x=e.x;pose.z=e.z;pose.sequence=sequence;
        }
        for(const [id,pose]of this.previous)if(pose.sequence!==sequence)this.previous.delete(id);
      }
      commit(sim){this.time=sim.time;}
      sample(e,blend,time){
        const previous=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!previous||this.time!==time)return e;
        const limit=Math.max(2,(UNITS[e.type]?.speed||4)*.5),dx=e.x-previous.x,dz=e.z-previous.z;
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz>limit*limit)return e; // Spawn/unload/teleport should appear at its real destination.
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,blend));this.point.x=previous.x+dx*t;this.point.z=previous.z+dz*t;return this.point;
      }
    }
    
    export function smoothHeading(node,target,dt){
      if(!node.userData.headingReady){node.userData.headingReady=true;return target||0;}
      const previous=node.rotation.y,delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin((target||0)-previous),Math.cos((target||0)-previous));
      return previous+delta*(1-Math.exp(-Math.max(0,dt)*14));
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {LocalMotion,smoothHeading} from '../src/motion-smoothing.js';
    
    test('local render movement interpolates fixed ticks without changing authoritative positions',()=>{
      const unit={id:1,kind:'unit',type:'archer',hp:10,x:2,z:4},sim={entities:[unit],time:0},motion=new LocalMotion();
      motion.capture(sim);unit.x=2.3;unit.z=4.2;sim.time=.1;motion.commit(sim);
      assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,0,.1)},{x:2,z:4});assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,.5,.1)},{x:2.15,z:4.1});assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,1,.1)},{x:2.3,z:4.2});
      assert.equal(unit.x,2.3);assert.equal(unit.z,4.2);assert.equal(unit.snapshotAt,undefined);
      unit.x=30;assert.equal(motion.sample(unit,.5,.1),unit);assert.equal(motion.sample(unit,.5,.2),unit);
      unit.hp=0;motion.capture(sim);assert.equal(motion.previous.size,0);motion.clear();assert.equal(motion.time,-1);
    });
    
    test('figures take the shortest smooth turn across the angle boundary and start facing correctly',()=>{
      const node=new THREE.Object3D();assert.equal(smoothHeading(node,3.12,.016),3.12);node.rotation.y=3.12;
      const next=smoothHeading(node,-3.12,.016);assert.ok(next>3.12&&next<3.17);node.rotation.y=next;
      for(let i=0;i<60;i++)node.rotation.y=smoothHeading(node,-3.12,.016);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(node.rotation.y+3.12),Math.cos(node.rotation.y+3.12)))<.0001);assert.equal(smoothHeading(node,0,0),node.rotation.y);
    });

    export async function currentGameUpdate(buildId,fetcher=fetch){
      try{
        const response=await fetcher('/version.json',{cache:'no-store'});if(!response.ok)return null;
        const data=await response.json();return typeof data.buildId==='string'&&/^\d{13}$/.test(data.buildId)&&data.buildId!==buildId?data:null;
      }catch{return null;}
    }
    
    export function installGameUpdates({buildId,canRefresh,beforeRefresh}){
      let latest=null,busy=false;
      const notice=document.createElement('aside');notice.id='game-update';notice.className='game-update hidden';notice.setAttribute('role','status');
      notice.innerHTML='<div><strong>A game update is ready</strong><span>You can finish your match before refreshing.</span></div><button class="secondary">Save and refresh</button>';
      document.body.append(notice);const button=notice.querySelector('button'),hint=notice.querySelector('span');
      const check=async()=>{
        if(busy||navigator.onLine===false)return;busy=true;
        try{latest=await currentGameUpdate(buildId)||latest;if(latest){notice.classList.remove('hidden');button.disabled=!canRefresh();button.textContent=canRefresh()?'Save and refresh':'Leave the room to update';}}finally{busy=false;}
      };
      button.onclick=()=>{
        if(!latest||!canRefresh())return;
        if(beforeRefresh()===false){hint.textContent='Your match could not be saved. Finish it before refreshing.';return;}
        const url=new URL(location.href);url.searchParams.set('build',latest.buildId);location.assign(url);
      };
      const timer=setInterval(()=>{if(!document.hidden)check();},30000);return {check,dispose(){clearInterval(timer);notice.remove();}};
    }
    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Keep rendering poses outside the authoritative simulation/save data. The
    // fixed 10 Hz simulation can then move smoothly between ticks at any frame rate.
    export class LocalMotion{
      constructor(){this.previous=new Map();this.point={x:0,z:0};this.clear();}
      clear(){this.previous.clear();this.time=-1;this.sequence=0;}
      capture(sim){
        const sequence=++this.sequence;
        for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0){
          let pose=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!pose){pose={};this.previous.set(e.id,pose);}
          pose.x=e.x;pose.z=e.z;pose.sequence=sequence;
        }
        for(const [id,pose]of this.previous)if(pose.sequence!==sequence)this.previous.delete(id);
      }
      commit(sim){this.time=sim.time;}
      sample(e,blend,time){
        const previous=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!previous||this.time!==time)return e;
        const limit=Math.max(2,(UNITS[e.type]?.speed||4)*.5),dx=e.x-previous.x,dz=e.z-previous.z;
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz>limit*limit)return e; // Spawn/unload/teleport should appear at its real destination.
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,blend));this.point.x=previous.x+dx*t;this.point.z=previous.z+dz*t;return this.point;
      }
    }
    
    export function smoothHeading(node,target,dt){
      if(!node.userData.headingReady){node.userData.headingReady=true;return target||0;}
      const previous=node.rotation.y,delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin((target||0)-previous),Math.cos((target||0)-previous));
      return previous+delta*(1-Math.exp(-Math.max(0,dt)*14));
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

    async function until(predicate){const deadline=Date.now()+5000;while(!predicate()&&Date.now()<deadline)await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,20));assert.ok(predicate(),'server did not apply the command within 5 seconds');}
    class Inbox {
      constructor(ws){this.messages=[];this.waiters=[];ws.on('message',raw=>{const message=JSON.parse(raw),i=this.waiters.findIndex(w=>w.type===message.type);if(i>=0){const [w]=this.waiters.splice(i,1);clearTimeout(w.timer);w.resolve(message);}else this.messages.push(message);});}
      next(type){const i=this.messages.findIndex(m=>m.type===type);if(i>=0)return Promise.resolve(this.messages.splice(i,1)[0]);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const waiter={type,resolve,timer:setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Missing '+type)),3000)};this.waiters.push(waiter);});}
    }
    test('Wi-Fi rooms synchronize both players, enforce ownership, and reconnect',async t=>{
      const server=http.createServer(),service=attachRooms(server),clients=[];await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));
      t.after(async()=>{for(const ws of clients)ws.terminate();service.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));});
      const connect=async()=>{const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/socket`);clients.push(ws);const inbox=new Inbox(ws);await new Promise(resolve=>ws.once('open',resolve));return {ws,inbox,send:data=>ws.send(JSON.stringify(data))};};
      const host=await connect();host.send({type:'create',name:'Host',faction:'alder',options:{mode:'skirmish',map:'highlands',seed:67}});const session=await host.inbox.next('session');const guest=await connect();guest.send({type:'join',name:'Guest',faction:'raven',code:session.code});const guestSession=await guest.inbox.next('session');host.send({type:'start'});
      const a=(await host.inbox.next('begin')).state,b=(await guest.inbox.next('begin')).state;
      assert.equal(a.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length,b.entities.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit').length);
      assert.deepEqual(a.players[0].resources,b.players[0].resources);assert.equal(a.entities.find(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='towncenter').x,-b.entities.find(e=>e.owner===0&&e.type==='towncenter').x);assert.equal(b.players[0].faction,'raven');
      assert.equal(b.entities.filter(e=>e.owner===1&&e.kind==='unit').length,0);
      const room=service.rooms.get(session.code),enemyBarracks=room.sim.owned(0,'building','barracks')[0],ownBarracks=room.sim.owned(1,'building','barracks')[0];
      room.sim.hold=12;room.sim.enemyHold=34;room.sim.wonderTime=[22,44];guest.inbox.messages=guest.inbox.messages.filter(m=>m.type!=='state');let timers;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){timers=(await guest.inbox.next('state')).state;if(timers.hold===34)break;}assert.equal(timers.hold,34);assert.deepEqual(timers.wonderTime,[44,22]);
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[enemyBarracks.id,'spearman']});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80));assert.equal(enemyBarracks.queue.length,0);
      const houses=room.sim.owned(1,'building','house').length,worker=room.sim.owned(1,'unit','villager')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'build',args:['house',-70,-70,[worker.id]]});await guest.inbox.next('error');assert.equal(room.sim.owned(1,'building','house').length,houses);
      const house=room.sim.owned(1,'building','house')[0];guest.send({type:'action',method:'demolish',args:[house.id]});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80));assert.equal(house.hp,0);assert.equal(room.stats[0].kills,0);assert.equal(room.stats[1].lost,0);

      const scout=room.sim.owned(1,'unit','scout')[0],ownTown=room.sim.owned(1,'building','towncenter')[0],hostTown=room.sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'guard',args:[[scout.id],hostTown.id]});guest.send({type:'action',method:'train',args:[ownBarracks.id,'spearman']});await until(()=>ownBarracks.queue.length===2);assert.notEqual(scout.order?.type,'guard');
      guest.send({type:'action',method:'guard',args:[[scout.id],ownTown.id]});await until(()=>scout.order?.type==='guard');assert.equal(scout.order?.type,'guard');

    """Show the actual game catalogue in the running Blender window."""
    import bpy
    import math
    from pathlib import Path
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(project / ".tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend"))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        for modifier in obj.modifiers:
            modifier.show_viewport=False
    buildings = ["towncenter", "house", "mill", "camp", "mine", "barracks", "range", "stable", "workshop", "blacksmith", "market", "tower", "keep", "wall", "gate", "monastery", "wonder", "dock", "farm"]
    units = ["villager", "spearman", "swordsman", "archer", "scout", "knight", "sentinel", "marksman", "outrider", "monk", "king", "ram", "catapult", "cart", "fishingboat", "galley", "warship", "transport"]
    for root in roots:
        parts = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        if parts[0] == "building":
            faction = ["alder", "sun", "raven"].index(parts[2])
            column = buildings.index(parts[1])
            if parts[1] == "towncenter" and parts[3] != "3":
                root.hide_viewport = True
                root.hide_render = True
                continue
            root.location = ((column % 7) * 15, faction * 52 + (column // 7) * 16, 0)
        elif parts[0] == "unit":
            column = units.index(parts[1])
            root.location = ((column % 9) * 7, -18 - (column // 9) * 12, 0)
            if len(parts) > 2:
                column = ["wood", "mine", "food", "build"].index(parts[2])
                root.location = (column * 7, -42, 0)
        elif parts[0] == "tree":
            if parts[-1] == "far":
                root.hide_viewport = True
                root.hide_render = True
                continue
            biome = ["highlands", "winter", "desert"].index(parts[1])
            root.location = (112 + int(parts[2]) * 8, biome * 14, 0)
        else:
            column = ["food", "gold", "stone", "fish", "shrine"].index(parts[1])
            variant = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
            root.location = (112 + variant * 8, 50 + column * 12, 0)
    
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
    focus = next(root for root in roots if root["assetKey"] == "building:towncenter:alder:3")
    focus.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = focus
    for screen in bpy.data.screens:
        for area in screen.areas:
            if area.type != "VIEW_3D":
                continue
            space = area.spaces.active
            space.shading.type = "SOLID"
            space.shading.color_type = "MATERIAL"
            space.shading.light = "STUDIO"
            space.shading.show_shadows = True
            space.shading.show_cavity = True
            space.shading.cavity_type = "BOTH"
            space.shading.use_scene_world = False
            space.overlay.show_floor = False
            space.overlay.show_axis_x = False
            space.overlay.show_axis_y = False
            space.region_3d.view_distance = 95
            space.region_3d.view_location = (30, 7, 1)
            space.region_3d.view_rotation = (0.82, 0.42, 0.18, 0.34)
    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(project / ".tools/art-refined/frontier-showcase.blend"), compress=True)
    print("Opened the actual building, troop, tree and resource showcase in Blender.")

    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge

    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){

        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));

        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }

      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();

        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      const missing=manifest.models.filter(model=>!templates.has(model.key));
      if(missing.length)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete: '+missing.map(model=>model.key).join(', '));
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }

    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      const missing=manifest.models.filter(model=>!templates.has(model.key));
      if(missing.length)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete: '+missing.map(model=>model.key).join(', '));
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='high'?'high':'low';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());
      try{const catalogue=await pending.get(detail);if(serial===loadSerial)active=catalogue;return catalogue;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }

    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads three CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is approximately 13.1 MiB; the lower detail GLB is approximately 3.0 MiB. Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Nine photographed surface maps total approximately 7.4 MiB.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Curved tapering trunks, branching bends and smoother closed foliage replace the coarse crown silhouettes. High includes pointed closed leaf tips; they are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Winter forests have branched boughs and irregular snow patches. Bark grain and muted, varied canopy colors add surface detail. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    
    `tests/authored-assets.test.js`, `tests/render-batches.test.js`, `tests/ground-cover.test.js`, `tests/battle-effects.test.js` and `tests/battle-remains.test.js` check catalogue coverage, outward leaf volumes, bounds, joints, tools, ownership, packing, foundations and effect limits. `scripts/authored-art-qa.mjs` reviews the live renderer, camera/selection preservation, biomes, naval models and emulated landscape-phone controls. `scripts/battle-visual-qa.mjs` captures close forests and checks live projectile arcs, pool reuse and scene-switch memory. Rendering targets and actual measured limitations are recorded separately in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).

    // Keep rendering poses outside the authoritative simulation/save data. The
    // fixed 10 Hz simulation can then move smoothly between ticks at any frame rate.
    export class LocalMotion{
      constructor(){this.previous=new Map();this.point={x:0,z:0};this.clear();}
      clear(){this.previous.clear();this.time=-1;this.sequence=0;}
      capture(sim){
        const sequence=++this.sequence;
        for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0){
          let pose=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!pose){pose={};this.previous.set(e.id,pose);}
          pose.x=e.x;pose.z=e.z;pose.sequence=sequence;
        }
        for(const [id,pose]of this.previous)if(pose.sequence!==sequence)this.previous.delete(id);
      }
      commit(sim){this.time=sim.time;}
      sample(e,blend,time){
        const previous=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!previous||this.time!==time)return e;
        const limit=Math.max(2,(UNITS[e.type]?.speed||4)*.5),dx=e.x-previous.x,dz=e.z-previous.z;
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz>limit*limit)return e; // Spawn/unload/teleport should appear at its real destination.
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,blend));this.point.x=previous.x+dx*t;this.point.z=previous.z+dz*t;return this.point;
      }
    }

    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,treeModel,resourceModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';

    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';

    async function catalogue(detail){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(new URL(`../src/assets3d/frontier-${detail==='high'?'near':'low'}.glb`,import.meta.url));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)
        .parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,bytes.length);
    }
    function fixture(catalogue,faction='alder',owner=0){
      const view=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      view.materials={};for(const template of catalogue.templates.values())template.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.isMesh&&part.userData.assetMaterial&&!['team','teamRoof'].includes(part.userData.assetMaterial))
          view.materials[part.userData.assetMaterial]??=part.material.clone();
      });
      view.materials.water??=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial();
      view.teamMaterials=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:i?0x9a687d:0x397f8c}));
      view.roofMaterials=view.teamMaterials.map(mat=>mat.clone());
      view.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      view.sim={players:Array.from({length:8},()=>({faction,age:3})),options:{seed:512,map:'highlands'},isWater:(x,z)=>z>5};
      return view;
    }
    function triangles(catalogue){let count=0;for(const geometry of catalogue.geometries)count+=(geometry.index?.count??geometry.attributes.position.count)/3;return count;}
    function solid(root){
      const size=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      assert.ok(size.x>0&&size.y>0&&size.z>0);
      root.traverse(part=>{if(!part.isMesh)return;for(const attr of ['position','normal','uv','color'])assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes[attr]);assert.ok(part.geometry.attributes.position.array.every(Number.isFinite));});
    }
    
    test('building batching keeps solid bounds, team surfaces and moving pivots while sharing repeat geometry',async()=>{
      try{
        const assets=await catalogue('low');
        for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
          const view=fixture(assets,faction);view.settings={quality:'low'};view.foundationHeights=new Map();
          view.materials.wood.map=new THREE.Texture();view.materials.stone.map=new THREE.Texture();
          for(const [type,data] of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){
            const e={kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:0,z:0},raw=buildingModel(view,e);
            const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(raw),before=[];raw.traverse(p=>{if(p.isMesh)before.push(p);});
            const packed=packBuildingModel(view,raw,e),after=[];packed.traverse(p=>{if(p.isMesh)after.push(p);});solid(packed);
            const changed=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(packed);assert.ok(bounds.min.distanceTo(changed.min)<.001&&bounds.max.distanceTo(changed.max)<.001,type+' keeps its footprint');
            assert.ok(after.length<before.length,type+' reduces draw calls');

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {

                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }

    let guest;
    try{
      const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1280,height:800},serviceWorkers:'block'}),page=await context.newPage();
      page.setDefaultTimeout(90000);page.on('pageerror',error=>report.errors.push(error.message));
      page.on('console',message=>{if(message.type()==='error'&&/WebGL|Shader|THREE/.test(message.text()))report.errors.push(message.text());});
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'low',autoQuality:false,volume:0,music:false,weather:'clear'})));
      let failed=false;
      await page.route('**/*.glb',route=>{if(!failed){failed=true;return route.fulfill({status:503,body:'Deliberate artwork download failure'});}return route.continue();});
      await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:90000});
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Try again',exact:true}).waitFor();
      assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-mode=skirmish]').isDisabled(),true);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>!!window.frontier?.view),false);
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Try again',exact:true}).click();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.artDiagnostics.models),126);
      report.checks.push({missingArtworkBlocksPlay:true,retryLoadsFullCatalogue:true});
    
      const visuals=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',seed:512});frontier.action('pause');
        document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';
        const s=frontier.sim,v=frontier.view,tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0],worker=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0];
        s.stop([worker.id]);v.focus(tc.x,tc.z);v.zoom=25;v.tilt=.6;v.updateCamera();v.render(.016,false);
        const building=v.nodes.get(tc.id),unit=v.nodes.get(worker.id),uniforms=v.materials.structurePalette.frontierUniforms;
        let plasterVertices=0;building.traverse(part=>{const a=part.geometry?.attributes.structureSurface;if(a)for(let i=0;i<a.count;i++)if(a.getZ(i)===3)plasterVertices++;});
        return {building:building.userData.model3d,unit:unit.userData.model3d,art:v.artDiagnostics,plasterVertices,plasterMap:!!uniforms.plaster.value,draws:v.renderer.info.render.calls};
      });
      assert.equal(visuals.building.artRevision,'civic-arcades');assert.equal(visuals.unit.artRevision,'field-gear');
      assert.ok(visuals.plasterVertices>0&&visuals.plasterMap);assert.equal(visuals.art.bytes,fs.statSync('src/assets3d/frontier-low.glb').size);
      report.checks.push({currentArtwork:visuals});await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/civic-capital-close.png'});
    
      const motion=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        const s=frontier.sim,v=frontier.view,e=s.owned(0,'unit','scout')[0];s.stop([e.id]);
        const from={x:e.x,z:e.z};v.localMotion.capture(s);e.x+=.4;s.time+=.1;v.localMotion.commit(s);
        const authoritative={x:e.x,z:e.z};v.localBlend=.25;v.render(.016,false);const quarter=e.renderX;
        v.localBlend=.75;v.render(.016,false);const threeQuarter=e.renderX;
        return {from,authoritative,after:{x:e.x,z:e.z},quarter,threeQuarter,finite:[...v.unitBatches.values()].every(b=>b.parts.every(p=>p.instanceMatrix.array.every(Number.isFinite)))};
      });
      assert.ok(Math.abs(motion.quarter-motion.from.x-.1)<1e-6&&Math.abs(motion.threeQuarter-motion.from.x-.3)<1e-6);
      assert.deepEqual(motion.after,motion.authoritative);assert.ok(motion.finite);report.checks.push({interpolatedMovement:motion});
      const current=await page.locator('meta[name=frontier-build]').getAttribute('content'),version=await(await fetch(new URL('version.json',base))).json();assert.equal(version.buildId,current);
      const newer=String(Number(current)+1);
      await page.route('**/version.json',route=>route.fulfill({json:{buildId:newer,version:version.version}}));
      await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.checkUpdate());await page.locator('#game-update:not(.hidden)').waitFor();
      await Promise.all([page.waitForURL(url=>url.searchParams.get('build')===newer),page.locator('#game-update button').click()]);
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);
      const saved=await page.evaluate(()=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crowns-save')));assert.equal(saved.time,.1);assert.equal(saved.options.mode,'sandbox');
      report.checks.push({productionVersionMatchesPage:true,updateSavesSoloMatch:true,refreshUsesNewBuildURL:true});
      await page.unroute('**/version.json');
    
      // One browser renderer plus a real socket keeps this check within the dev
      // machine's memory budget while exercising the actual room update guard.
      await page.locator('[data-action=lan]').click();await page.locator('[data-action=lan-host]').click();
      const room=page.locator('#room-code');await room.waitFor();const code=(await room.textContent()).trim();
      const endpoint=new URL('socket',base);endpoint.protocol=endpoint.protocol==='https:'?'wss:':'ws:';
      guest=new WebSocket(endpoint);await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{guest.once('open',resolve);guest.once('error',reject);});
      guest.send(JSON.stringify({type:'join',code,name:'Update check guest',faction:'raven'}));
      await page.locator('[data-action=lan-start]:enabled').waitFor();await page.locator('[data-action=lan-start]').click();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>frontier.playing);await page.route('**/version.json',route=>route.fulfill({json:{buildId:newer,version:version.version}}));
      await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.checkUpdate());const update=page.locator('#game-update button');
      assert.equal(await update.isDisabled(),true);assert.equal(await update.textContent(),'Leave the room to update');
      const address=page.url();await page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector('#game-update button').click());assert.equal(page.url(),address);
      report.checks.push({liveMultiplayerRefreshBlocked:true});await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.action('menu'));
      assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);report.passed=true;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
    }catch(error){report.failure=error.message;throw error;}
    finally{guest?.terminate();fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/visual-updates-qa.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));await browser.close();}

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {seededRandom} from './data.js';
    import {insideMap} from './map-geometry.js';
    import {GroundCover} from './ground-cover.js';
    import {applyGroundSurface} from './surface-assets.js';
    
    const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
    export class Landscape {
      constructor(seed,map,worldSize=160,settlements=null){this.worldSize=worldSize;this.half=worldSize/2;this.renderSize=worldSize*2;this.settlements=settlements||[{x:-37,z:30},{x:37,z:-30}];this.seed=seed;this.map=map;this.phase=seededRandom(seed+751)()*Math.PI*2;}
      channels(){return this.waterChannels??=(this.map==='coast'?[{center:0,width:14,frequency:.03,bend:2}]:this.map==='valley'?[{center:0,width:5,frequency:.045,bend:4}]:this.map==='rivers'?[-19,19].map(center=>({center,width:4,frequency:.045,bend:3})):[]);}
      heightAt(x,z){
        const p=this.phase;
        const relief={highlands:1.8,canyon:2.5,winter:1.5,valley:1.35,rivers:1.3,coast:1.25,desert:.85}[this.map]||1;
        let h=.8+relief*(Math.sin(x*.061+p)*Math.cos(z*.049-p)*1.15+Math.sin(x*.13+z*.075+p)*.32);
        const townDistance=Math.min(...this.settlements.map(point=>Math.hypot(x-point.x,z-point.z)));
        h=.65+(h-.65)*smooth(12,26,townDistance);
        for(const channel of this.channels()){
          const d=Math.abs(x-channel.center-Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend);
          if(this.map!=='coast'&&Math.abs(z)<=9&&d<channel.width+5){h=.72+(h-.72)*smooth(channel.width+2,channel.width+5,d);continue;}
          if(d<channel.width+6)h=-1.3+(h+1.3)*smooth(channel.width-1,channel.width+6,d);

    test('building batching keeps solid bounds, team surfaces and moving pivots while sharing repeat geometry',async()=>{
      try{
        const assets=await catalogue('low');
        for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
          const view=fixture(assets,faction);view.settings={quality:'low'};view.foundationHeights=new Map();
          view.materials.wood.map=new THREE.Texture();view.materials.stone.map=new THREE.Texture();
          for(const [type,data] of Object.entries(BUILDINGS)){
            const e={kind:'building',type,owner:0,r:data.r,x:0,z:0},raw=buildingModel(view,e);
            const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(raw),before=[];raw.traverse(p=>{if(p.isMesh)before.push(p);});
            const packed=packBuildingModel(view,raw,e),after=[];packed.traverse(p=>{if(p.isMesh)after.push(p);});solid(packed);
            const changed=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(packed);assert.ok(bounds.min.distanceTo(changed.min)<.001&&bounds.max.distanceTo(changed.max)<.001,type+' keeps its footprint');
            assert.ok(after.length<before.length,type+' reduces draw calls');
            assert.ok(after.length<=6,type+' remains a small number of draws');
            const staticMesh=after.find(p=>p.userData.structureSurface);
            assert.ok(staticMesh.geometry.index);assert.ok(staticMesh.geometry.attributes.structureEmission.array.every(Number.isFinite));
            const again=view.makeBuilding(e),other=[];again.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.structureSurface)other.push(p);});
            assert.equal(other[0].geometry,staticMesh.geometry,type+' shares geometry');
            assert.equal(view.mergeModel(packed),packed);
            if(type==='gate'){
              assert.ok(packed.userData.portcullis.children.some(p=>p.userData.structureSurface));
              const before=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(packed.userData.portcullis);packed.userData.portcullis.position.y+=2.5;
              assert.ok(Math.abs(new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(packed.userData.portcullis).min.y-before.min.y-2.5)<.001);
            }
            if(type==='mill'){let rotor;packed.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.windmill)rotor=p;});assert.ok(rotor.children.some(p=>p.userData.structureSurface));}
            let disposed=false;staticMesh.geometry.addEventListener('dispose',()=>disposed=true);view.releaseNode(packed);assert.equal(disposed,false);
          }
          const a=view.makeBuilding({kind:'building',type:'house',owner:0,x:0,z:0}),b=view.makeBuilding({kind:'building',type:'house',owner:1,x:0,z:0});
          let ga,gb;a.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.structureSurface)ga=p.geometry;});b.traverse(p=>{if(p.userData.structureSurface)gb=p.geometry;});
          assert.notEqual(ga,gb);assert.notDeepEqual(ga.attributes.color.array,gb.attributes.color.array);
          // Construction clipping must preserve the same PBR shader callback.
          const building={progress:.4,r:2.3},node=a;view.renderer={};
          view.updateConstruction(building,node);for(const [mesh,original] of node.userData.construction.restore)assert.equal(mesh.material.onBeforeCompile,original.onBeforeCompile);
          building.progress=1;view.updateConstruction(building,node);assert.equal(node.userData.construction,undefined);
        }
      }finally{clearAuthoredAssets();}
    });

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
    $taskSourceFiles=@()
    foreach ($taskDirectory in @('src','server','scripts','tests','public')) {
        $taskSourceFiles+=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskProject $taskDirectory) -Recurse -File
    }
    foreach ($taskFileName in @('package.json','package-lock.json','index.html','vite.config.js','netlify.toml','render.yaml','.gitignore','.nvmrc','README.md','ART_PIPELINE.md','DEPLOYMENT.md','RELEASE_CHECKS.md','ROADMAP.md','CHANGELOG.md','DEVELOPMENT_CHECKPOINT.md','QUALITY_TARGETS.md')) {
        $taskFilePath=Join-Path $taskProject $taskFileName
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskFilePath) { $taskSourceFiles+=Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskFilePath }
    }
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-source.zip" $taskProject $taskSourceFiles
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-static.zip" $taskStatic (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskStatic -Recurse -File)
    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 11 October 2026 against the version 2.5 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.

    // Keep the existing physical wave profile on the GPU. Analytical slope normals
    // give moving highlights without rewriting geometry or recalculating faces.
    export function configureWaterSurface(material){
      if(material.frontierWaveTime)return;
      const time=material.frontierWaveTime={value:0};
      const previous=material.onBeforeCompile;
      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        previous.call(material,shader);
        shader.uniforms.frontierWaterTime=time;
        shader.vertexShader='uniform float frontierWaterTime;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
        shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <beginnormal_vertex>',`#include <beginnormal_vertex>
          float frontierWaveA = position.x * 0.9 + position.z * 0.36 + frontierWaterTime * 1.3;
          float frontierWaveB = position.z * 0.65 - frontierWaterTime;
          objectNormal = normalize(vec3(-0.0315 * cos(frontierWaveA), 1.0,
            -0.0126 * cos(frontierWaveA) + 0.013 * sin(frontierWaveB)));`);
        shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>',`#include <begin_vertex>
          transformed.y += 0.035 * sin(frontierWaveA) + 0.02 * cos(frontierWaveB);`);
      };
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-water-waves-v1';material.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function animateWaterSurface(view){
      const time=view.materials.water.frontierWaveTime;if(time)time.value=view.clock;
      const diagnostics=view.waterDiagnostics??={animation:'GPU mesh displacement',geometryUploadsPerFrame:0};
      diagnostics.meshes=view.waterMeshes?.length||0;
    }

    function cameraAt(x,z,angle,tilt,zoom,aspect){
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(46,aspect,.5,400);
      camera.position.set(x+Math.sin(angle)*zoom,.65+Math.tan(tilt)*zoom,z+Math.cos(angle)*zoom);
      camera.lookAt(x,.65,z);camera.updateMatrixWorld();return camera;
    }
    
    test('radar camera box stays finite and rectangular across map edges, views and rotations',()=>{
      for(const preset of Object.values(CAMERA_PRESETS))for(const [x,z]of [[0,0],[-72,-72],[-72,72],[72,-72],[72,72]])for(const angle of [0,Math.PI/4,1.85,Math.PI])for(const aspect of [1440/900,844/390,390/844]){
        const camera=cameraAt(x,z,angle,preset.tilt,preset.zoom,aspect),box=cameraMapBox(camera,.65);
        assert.ok(box,'a camera aimed inside the battlefield always has a locator');
        for(const value of Object.values(box))assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value)&&Math.abs(value)<=80.00001);
        assert.ok(box.minX<box.maxX&&box.minZ<box.maxZ);
        assert.ok(x>=box.minX-1e-5&&x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&z<=box.maxZ+1e-5,'the camera center is inside its box');
        for(const p of cameraMapFootprint(camera,.65))assert.ok(p.x>=box.minX-1e-5&&p.x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&p.z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&p.z<=box.maxZ+1e-5);
      }
    });
    
    test('radar locator follows scrolling and grows when zooming out',()=>{
      const preset=CAMERA_PRESETS.tactical,make=(x,z,zoom)=>cameraMapBox(cameraAt(x,z,0,preset.tilt,zoom,1.6),.65);
      const near=make(0,0,24),far=make(0,0,45),moved=make(10,12,24);
      assert.ok(far.maxX-far.minX>near.maxX-near.minX);assert.ok(far.maxZ-far.minZ>near.maxZ-near.minZ);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minX-near.minX-10)<1e-5);assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minZ-near.minZ-12)<1e-5);
    });
    
    test('minimap coordinates map consistently to the square battlefield and clamp captured drags',()=>{
      const rect={left:17,top:29,width:101,height:101};
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(17,29,rect),{x:-80,z:-80});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(118,130,rect),{x:80,z:80});
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(67.5,79.5,rect),{x:0,z:0});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(-50,600,rect),{x:-80,z:80});
      for(const [x,z]of [[NaN,0],[0,Infinity],[81,0],[0,-81]])assert.equal(insideMap(x,z),false);
    });

        const land=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=land.geometry(320,112);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-79,-79],[79,79],[-79,79],[79,-79],[0,0]])assert.ok(land.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0))));
        for(const [x,z]of [[81,0],[-81,0],[0,81],[0,-81],[140,140]])assert.equal(land.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0))),null);
        geometry.dispose();

    });

    function paletteMaterial(view){
      if(!view.materials.unitPalette){
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.9});
        const wood={value:view.materials.wood.map||null},teams={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.teamMaterials[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())},roofs={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.roofMaterials?.[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())};material.frontierUniforms={wood,teams,roofs};
        material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
          shader.uniforms.frontierUnitWood=wood;
          shader.uniforms.frontierTeamColors=teams;shader.uniforms.frontierRoofColors=roofs;
          shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 unitSurface;\nattribute float unitTeamMask;\n#ifdef USE_INSTANCING\nattribute float instanceOwner;\n#endif\nuniform vec3 frontierTeamColors[8];\nuniform vec3 frontierRoofColors[8];\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
          shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>',`#include <color_vertex>
            vUnitSurface = unitSurface; vUnitTeamColor = vec3(1.0);
            #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
            int owner = int(clamp(instanceOwner, 0.0, 7.0) + 0.5);
            if(unitTeamMask > 1.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierRoofColors[owner];
            else if(unitTeamMask > 0.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierTeamColors[owner];
            #endif`);
          shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierUnitWood;\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>','#include <color_fragment>\ndiffuseColor.rgb *= vUnitTeamColor;\nif(vUnitSurface.z > 0.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierUnitWood, vUv).rgb;');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>','#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\nroughnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.x, 0.04, 1.0);');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>','#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\nmetalnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.y, 0.0, 1.0);');
        };
        // A shared UV channel is needed for the optional wood sampling above.
        material.defines={USE_UV:''};material.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-unit-palette-v2';
        view.materials.unitPalette=material;
      }

      return view.materials.unitPalette;
    }

    export function mergeUnitModel(view,model,neutralTeams=false){
      model.updateMatrixWorld(true);const groups=new Map(),transparent=[];
      const palette=paletteMaterial(view),result=new THREE.Group();result.userData.model3d=model.userData.model3d;
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        if(part.material.transparent){const copy=part.clone();copy.geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);copy.position.set(0,0,0);copy.rotation.set(0,0,0);copy.scale.setScalar(1);transparent.push(copy);return;}
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);
        if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
        const team=neutralTeams?(view.teamMaterials.includes(part.material)?1:view.roofMaterials?.includes(part.material)?2:0):0;
        const count=geometry.attributes.position.count,old=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(count*3),surface=new Float32Array(count*3),color=team?[1,1,1]:part.material.color.toArray();
        const wooden=[view.materials.wood,view.materials.darkwood,view.materials.timberEdge].includes(part.material)&&!!view.materials.wood.map;
        for(let i=0;i<count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++){colors[i*3+k]=(old?old.getComponent(i,k):1)*color[k];surface[i*3+k]=k===0?part.material.roughness??.9:k===1?part.material.metalness??0:wooden?1:0;}
        geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));geometry.setAttribute('unitSurface',new THREE.BufferAttribute(surface,3));geometry.setAttribute('unitTeamMask',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count).fill(team),1));
        const key=JSON.stringify(part.userData.motion||null);if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{motion:part.userData.motion,geometries:[]});groups.get(key).geometries.push(geometry);
      });
      for(const group of groups.values()){
        const geometry=mergeGeometries(group.geometries);for(const source of group.geometries)source.dispose();
        if(!geometry)throw new Error('Troop surfaces could not be merged.');
        const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,palette);mesh.userData.motion=group.motion;mesh.castShadow=mesh.receiveShadow=true;result.add(mesh);

    export function grassTuftGeometry(){
      const vertices=[],indices=[],uv=[];
      for(let blade=0;blade<6;blade++){
        const angle=blade*2.399,h=.28+(blade%3)*.11,w=.035,lean=.12;
        const center=new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(angle)*.12,0,Math.cos(angle)*.12);
        const across=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(angle),0,-Math.sin(angle));
        const front=new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(angle),0,Math.cos(angle));
        const base=vertices.length/3;
        for(const [width,y,bend,thickness] of [[w,0,0,.009],[w*.7,h*.55,lean*.3,.006]]){
          for(const [side,depth] of [[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]]){
            const p=center.clone().addScaledVector(across,side*width).addScaledVector(front,bend+depth*thickness);p.y=y;
            vertices.push(...p.toArray());uv.push((side+1)*.5,y/h);
          }
        }
        const tip=center.clone().addScaledVector(front,lean);tip.y=h;vertices.push(...tip.toArray());uv.push(.5,1);
        indices.push(base,base+2,base+1,base,base+3,base+2);
        for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const next=(i+1)%4;indices.push(base+i,base+next,base+4+next,base+i,base+4+next,base+4+i,base+4+i,base+4+next,base+8);}
      }
      const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));geometry.setIndex(indices);geometry.computeVertexNormals();geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();return geometry;
    }
    
    function pathDistance(x,z,land){
      let distance=Infinity;
      for(const town of land.settlements){
        const end=land.map==='coast'?{x:Math.sign(town.x)*20,z:town.z}:{x:town.x*.2,z:0};
        const dx=end.x-town.x,dz=end.z-town.z,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-town.x)*dx+(z-town.z)*dz)/(dx*dx+dz*dz||1)));
        distance=Math.min(distance,Math.hypot(x-town.x-t*dx,z-town.z-t*dz));
      }
      return distance;
    }

        const winter=land.map==='winter',arid=['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map);

    // Shared materials and one instanced shadow pass keep the depth cues affordable.
    function surfaceRelief(material,scale){
      if(!material.map)return;
      material.bumpMap=material.map.clone();
      material.bumpMap.colorSpace=THREE.NoColorSpace;
      material.bumpMap.needsUpdate=true;
      material.bumpScale=scale;
      material.roughness=.88;
      material.needsUpdate=true;
    }

      const c=sky.getContext('2d'),gradient=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);
      gradient.addColorStop(0,'#7ba3c3');gradient.addColorStop(.47,'#d7e3e8');
      gradient.addColorStop(.53,'#e4d5b1');gradient.addColorStop(1,'#465538');
      c.fillStyle=gradient;c.fillRect(0,0,128,64);
      const source=new THREE.CanvasTexture(sky);source.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      source.mapping=THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
      const generator=new THREE.PMREMGenerator(view.renderer);
      view.environmentTarget=generator.fromEquirectangular(source);
      view.scene.environment=view.environmentTarget.texture;view.scene.environmentIntensity=.3;
      source.dispose();generator.dispose();
    
      const m=view.materials;

    export function beginUnitFrame(view){
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){batch.renderIds.length=0;for(const part of batch.parts)part.userData.ownerChanged=false;}
    }
    
    export function markInstancePrefix(mesh,count=mesh.count){
      if(!count)return;
      const attribute=mesh.instanceMatrix;attribute.clearUpdateRanges();attribute.addUpdateRange(0,count*16);attribute.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      for(const part of batch.parts){
        part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner'),value=e.owner||0;
        if(owner&&owner.getX(index)!==value){owner.setX(index,value);part.userData.ownerChanged=true;}
      }
      return true;
    }

    const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
    
    export function roadDistance(x,z,land){
      land.roads??=land.settlements.map(town=>{
        const end=land.map==='coast'?{x:Math.sign(town.x)*20,z:town.z}:{x:town.x*.2,z:0};
        const dx=end.x-town.x,dz=end.z-town.z;return {x:town.x,z:town.z,dx,dz,length:dx*dx+dz*dz||1};
      });
      let distance=Infinity;
      for(const road of land.roads){const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-road.x)*road.dx+(z-road.z)*road.dz)/road.length));distance=Math.min(distance,Math.hypot(x-road.x-t*road.dx,z-road.z-t*road.dz));}
      return distance;
    }
    
    export function terrainWeights(land,x,y,z,normalY=1){
      const road=1-smooth(1.2,2.8,roadDistance(x,z,land)),slope=1-Math.max(0,normalY);
      const patch=.5+.5*Math.sin(x*.064+land.phase)*Math.cos(z*.053-land.phase);
      let bank=0;for(const channel of land.channels()){
        const distance=Math.abs(x-channel.center-Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend)-channel.width;
        if(distance>=0)bank=Math.max(bank,1-smooth(.2,4,distance));
      }
      const arid=['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map),rock=(.12*patch+smooth(.025,.19,slope)*.75+smooth(5,15,y)*.35)*(1-road*.9)*(1-bank*.6);
      const soil=Math.min(.95,Math.max(road*.95,bank*.75,(arid?.48:.12)+patch*.17))*(1-rock);
      return {grass:Math.max(0,1-soil-rock),soil,rock};
    }
    
    export function prepareTerrainGeometry(geometry,land){
      const p=geometry.attributes.position,n=geometry.attributes.normal,weights=new Float32Array(p.count*3);
      let min=Infinity,max=-Infinity,rocky=0,paths=0;
      for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
        const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i),mix=terrainWeights(land,x,y,z,n.getY(i));
        weights.set([mix.grass,mix.soil,mix.rock],i*3);min=Math.min(min,y);max=Math.max(max,y);if(mix.rock>.3)rocky++;if(mix.soil>.7)paths++;
      }
      return {weights,diagnostics:{vertices:p.count,heightRange:{min,max},rockyVertices:rocky,pathVertices:paths}};
    }

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    
    export function applyTerrainShading(material,land,quality,surfaces,dimensions){
      const grass=surfaces.grass;if(!grass?.color)return;
      const soil=surfaces.soil||grass,rock=surfaces.rock||grass,normal=quality!=='low'&&grass.normal;
      material.bumpMap?.dispose();material.bumpMap=null;
      material.normalMap=normal||null;material.roughnessMap=null;
      const arid=['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map),amount=land.map==='winter'?.22:arid?.43:.82;
      const uniforms={
        grass:{value:grass.color},soil:{value:soil.color||grass.color},rock:{value:rock.color||grass.color},
        grassNormal:{value:grass.normal||null},soilNormal:{value:soil.normal||grass.normal||null},rockNormal:{value:rock.normal||grass.normal||null},
        grassArm:{value:grass.arm||null},soilArm:{value:soil.arm||grass.arm||null},rockArm:{value:rock.arm||grass.arm||null},
        scale:{value:new THREE.Vector3(land.renderSize/(dimensions.grass||2),land.renderSize/(dimensions.soil||1.3),land.renderSize/(dimensions.rock||90))},
        amount:{value:amount},tint:{value:new THREE.Color(arid?0xd5b58d:land.map==='winter'?0xe3e8de:0xdbe1c6)},
      };
      material.frontierTerrainUniforms=uniforms;
      material.defines={...material.defines,...(quality==='high'?{FRONTIER_TERRAIN_ARM:''}:{})};
      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(uniforms))shader.uniforms['frontierTerrain'+key]=value;
        shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 terrainMix;\nvarying vec3 vTerrainMix;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
        shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>','#include <color_vertex>\nvTerrainMix = terrainMix;');
        shader.fragmentShader=`varying vec3 vTerrainMix;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerraingrass;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainsoil;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainrock;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerraingrassNormal;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainsoilNormal;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainrockNormal;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerraingrassArm;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainsoilArm;
          uniform sampler2D frontierTerrainrockArm;
          uniform vec3 frontierTerrainscale;
          uniform vec3 frontierTerraintint;
          uniform float frontierTerrainamount;\n`+shader.fragmentShader;
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <map_fragment>',`#include <map_fragment>
          vec3 terrainBlend = max(vTerrainMix, vec3(0.0));
          terrainBlend /= max(dot(terrainBlend, vec3(1.0)), 0.001);
          vec3 terrainColor = texture2D(frontierTerraingrass, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.x).rgb * terrainBlend.x
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainsoil, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.y).rgb * terrainBlend.y
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainrock, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.z).rgb * terrainBlend.z;
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, terrainColor * frontierTerraintint, frontierTerrainamount);`);
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <normal_fragment_maps>',`
          #ifdef USE_NORMALMAP_TANGENTSPACE
          vec3 terrainNormal = texture2D(frontierTerraingrassNormal, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.x).xyz * terrainBlend.x
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainsoilNormal, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.y).xyz * terrainBlend.y
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainrockNormal, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.z).xyz * terrainBlend.z;
          terrainNormal = terrainNormal * 2.0 - 1.0;
          terrainNormal.xy *= 0.35;
          normal = normalize(tbn * terrainNormal);
          #endif`);
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>',`#include <roughnessmap_fragment>
          #ifdef FRONTIER_TERRAIN_ARM
          float terrainRoughness = texture2D(frontierTerraingrassArm, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.x).g * terrainBlend.x
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainsoilArm, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.y).g * terrainBlend.y
            + texture2D(frontierTerrainrockArm, vMapUv * frontierTerrainscale.z).g * terrainBlend.z;
          roughnessFactor *= clamp(terrainRoughness, 0.25, 1.0);
          #endif`);
      };
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=>`frontier-terrain-v2:${land.map}:${land.renderSize}:${quality}`;
      material.userData.surface='Locally bundled natural grass, soil and rocky terrain';
    }

    import {seededRandom} from './data.js';
    import {roadDistance} from './terrain-layout.js';

    export function pebbleGeometry(){
      const geometry=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(.35,1),p=geometry.attributes.position;
      for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
        const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i),noise=Math.sin(x*127.1+y*74.7+z*311.7)*43758.5453;
        const scale=.88+(noise-Math.floor(noise))*.24;p.setXYZ(i,x*scale,y*scale*.65,z*scale);
      }
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();return geometry;
    }
    
    // Small cosmetic stones share one draw; they never become hidden obstacles or
    // game entities. Exploration and new building foundations control visibility.
    export class TerrainDetails{
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;const land=view.landscape,rng=seededRandom(land.seed+2903),high=view.settings.quality==='high',capacity=high?360:120;
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xffffff,roughness:.98});
        this.mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(pebbleGeometry(),material,capacity);this.mesh.name='Solid terrain pebbles';this.mesh.count=0;this.mesh.frustumCulled=false;this.mesh.receiveShadow=true;
        this.mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);view.terrain.add(this.mesh);this.entries=[];this.dummy=new THREE.Object3D();this.color=new THREE.Color();
        const arid=['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map),palette=land.map==='winter'?[0x929d98,0xaab2a8,0x737d77]:arid?[0xb09a7b,0x9b856c,0xc2ad8c]:[0x8a8c7d,0xaaa28a,0x74796e];
        for(let i=0;i<capacity;i++){
          const x=(rng()-.5)*(land.worldSize-6),z=(rng()-.5)*(land.worldSize-6),y=land.surfaceHeightAt(x,z);
          if(y<.2||roadDistance(x,z,land)<2)continue;
          this.entries.push({x,y,z,angle:rng()*Math.PI*2,scale:.3+rng()*.6,color:palette[i%3],stretch:.8+rng()*.6,shade:.9+rng()*.15});
        }
        this.update(true,true);
      }
      update(menu=false,force=false){
        const v=this.view,key=[v.target.x,v.target.z,v.zoom,v.angle,v.tilt,menu,v.settings.fog].join(':');
        if(!force&&this.key===key&&v.clock-(this.last||0)<.5)return;
        this.key=key;this.last=v.clock;let count=0;const sites=v.groundCover?.buildingSites;
        for(const e of this.entries){
          if(!nearViewport(v,e.x,e.y,e.z,2)||!menu&&v.settings.fog!==false&&!v.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))continue;
          if(sites?.get(Math.floor(e.x/16)+':'+Math.floor(e.z/16))?.some(b=>Math.hypot(b.x-e.x,b.z-e.z)<b.r+1))continue;
          this.dummy.position.set(e.x,e.y+.015,e.z);this.dummy.rotation.set(.08*Math.sin(e.angle),e.angle,.06*Math.cos(e.angle));this.dummy.scale.set(e.scale*e.stretch,e.scale,e.scale);this.dummy.updateMatrix();
          this.mesh.setMatrixAt(count,this.dummy.matrix);this.mesh.setColorAt(count,this.color.setHex(e.color).multiplyScalar(e.shade));count++;
        }
        this.mesh.count=count;markInstancePrefix(this.mesh);
        if(this.mesh.instanceColor&&count){this.mesh.instanceColor.clearUpdateRanges();this.mesh.instanceColor.addUpdateRange(0,count*3);this.mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;}
        v.terrainDetailDiagnostics={visible:count,seeded:this.entries.length,capacity:this.mesh.instanceMatrix.count,triangles:count*this.mesh.geometry.attributes.position.count/3,drawCalls:count?1:0};
      }
    }

    test('terrain material transitions preserve roads and form normalized finite weights over all biomes',()=>{
      for(const map of ['highlands','winter','desert','canyon','valley','rivers','coast']){
        const land=new Landscape(512,map,400),geometry=land.geometry(800,112),prepared=prepareTerrainGeometry(geometry,land);
        assert.equal(prepared.weights.length,geometry.attributes.position.count*3);assert.ok(prepared.diagnostics.heightRange.max-prepared.diagnostics.heightRange.min>15);
        for(let i=0;i<prepared.weights.length;i+=3){const values=prepared.weights.slice(i,i+3);assert.ok(values.every(value=>Number.isFinite(value)&&value>=0&&value<=1));assert.ok(Math.abs(values[0]+values[1]+values[2]-1)<1e-6);}
        const town=land.settlements[0],end=land.map==='coast'?{x:Math.sign(town.x)*20,z:town.z}:{x:town.x*.2,z:0},x=(town.x+end.x)/2,z=(town.z+end.z)/2;
        assert.ok(roadDistance(x,z,land)<1e-8);assert.ok(terrainWeights(land,x,1,z,1).soil>.85);
        assert.ok(terrainWeights(land,60,8,60,.65).rock>terrainWeights(land,60,1,60,1).rock);
        assert.equal(land.heightAt(town.x,town.z),.65,'settlement construction keeps a flat starting area');geometry.dispose();
      }
    });
