      const key=i=>[p.getX(i),p.getY(i),p.getZ(i)].map(value=>value.toFixed(5)).join(':');
      for(let i=0;i<p.count;i+=3)for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const pair=[key(i+j),key(i+(j+1)%3)].sort().join('|');edges.set(pair,(edges.get(pair)||0)+1);}
      assert.ok([...edges.values()].every(count=>count===2));assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>.3);assert.ok(p.array.every(Number.isFinite));geometry.dispose();
      const land=new Landscape(512,'highlands'),ground=land.geometry(320,112),view={landscape:land,terrain:new THREE.Group(),settings:{quality:'low',fog:true},sim:{entities:[],isExplored:()=>false},clock:0,target:new THREE.Vector3(),zoom:40,angle:0,tilt:.7};

    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads four CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes, reusing only verified local files. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is 15,554,824 bytes (14.83 MiB); the lower detail GLB is 3,639,276 bytes (3.47 MiB). Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Twelve photographed surface maps total 9,895,943 bytes (9.44 MiB). The declared low-catalogue content budget is now 4 MiB to retain the added architecture and equipment; this is a download budget, not an FPS achievement.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - Covered civic arcades, front steps, facade arches, gable windows and civilization-specific roof details strengthen building silhouettes. Painted-plaster color, normal and roughness maps join the grass, wood and masonry sets.
    - Adult figures include villager field packs and armored visors. Local unit positions interpolate between simulation ticks and turn smoothly without changing authoritative positions or saves. Multiplayer interpolation is bounded to its snapshot interval.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Curved tapering trunks and branching bends support distinct oak, birch, elm and beech crown proportions. High includes sixteen smaller crown lobes with pointed closed leaf tips; the tips are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Winter forests have branched boughs and irregular snow patches. Bark grain and muted, varied canopy colors add surface detail. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    # Crowns of the Frontier
    
    An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.5, **Crafted battlefields**, integrates 126 original Blender models, photographed CC0 masonry/wood/grass surfaces, solid ground cover and bounded battlefield remains. Custom battles support up to eight kingdoms, configurable human/AI slots, allies and enemies, individual difficulties, large maps, team multiplayer and changing 3D weather. Staged campaigns, checkpoints, naval warfare, civilization-exclusive troops and upgrades, a technology tree and landscape phone controls remain available. Development and release verification are recorded in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).
    
    ## Play
    
    For a free online address with one service hosting the game and multiplayer, use the included Render deployment file. See [the short deployment guide](DEPLOYMENT.md). Netlify static hosting is also configured; it needs a separate running server for real-person multiplayer.
    
    ```powershell
    npm install
    npm run build
    npm start
    ```
    
    Open **http://localhost:4173** on the laptop. On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, open **http://YOUR_LAPTOP_WIFI_IP:4173**. Landscape is recommended. The laptop must keep the game server running. If the phone cannot reach it, check that the local network permits connections to port 4173.
    
    For development, `npm run dev` serves on port 5173. Use `npm start` for Wi-Fi multiplayer; the static Vite preview server does not host rooms.

    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    | AI and custom battles | Eight allied/enemy kingdoms, selectable difficulty/pace, real reinforcement groups, home reserves and team victory | Reliable formations, route recovery, scouting/retreat/counter choices, stronger coordinated pressure and interesting long wars. Verify full matches across seeds, biomes, starting ages and player configurations. |
    | Campaigns and maps | Six staged chapters, checkpoints, journals, escort/defense/naval objectives and seven seeded biomes | More distinctive authored locations, mission events, varied encounters and pacing, plus completion/failure testing and human reviews on every difficulty. |
    | Controls and interface | Desktop edge scrolling, square radar/locator, production overview, hotkeys, landscape touch | Responsive, precise and readable control through crowded play; camera/selection/production remain reliable on real devices. Preserve the user's removal of movement lines. |
    | Audio and feedback | Synthesized ambience/music/combat/weather and bounded voices | More distinctive, coherent unit/impact/ambient layers and clear attack/order feedback; assess audibility and fatigue over full matches. |
    | Multiplayer and release | Authoritative mixed human/AI rooms, ownership/fog privacy, reconnect, static/Node builds and local saves | Hosted capacity/latency/loss/restart tests, version compatibility, durable operations where required, installation/update recovery, accessibility and external playtesting. Public matchmaking/persistent rooms remain unfinished. |
    
    The gaps are broader than frame rate. [Blizzard's Reforged development update](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23411981/warcraft-iii-reforged-developer-update) addresses art, gameplay and systems across campaign/custom/versus modes. [AoE IV's formation and allied-healing changes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/) provide concrete genre examples. These are historical design references, not claims that our implementation matches them.
    
    Green tests prove their covered scenarios. They do not prove AAA parity, human enjoyment, complete balance or compatibility with every possible device. Keep the full goal active until its requirements have appropriate evidence.
    # Development checkpoint — 11 October 2026
    
    The user's full quality goal remains active. They want an original fully 3D RTS comparable to established top games in visuals, interaction, strategic depth, custom allied AI/human battles, missions, controls and sustained performance.     import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {animatePart} from './world-polish.js';
    
    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.
    // Picking uses the packed IDs, never the allocator's potentially empty slots.
    export function beginUnitFrame(view){
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){batch.renderIds.length=0;for(const part of batch.parts)part.userData.ownerChanged=false;}
    }
    
    export function markInstancePrefix(mesh,count=mesh.count){
      if(!count)return;
      const attribute=mesh.instanceMatrix;attribute.clearUpdateRanges();attribute.addUpdateRange(0,count*16);attribute.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      for(const part of batch.parts){
        part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner'),value=e.owner||0;
        if(owner&&owner.getX(index)!==value){owner.setX(index,value);part.userData.ownerChanged=true;}
      }
      return true;
    }
    
    export function endUnitFrame(view){
      let drawn=0,allocated=0,activeBatches=0,matrixUploadBytes=0,ownerUploadBytes=0,capacityMatrixBytes=0;
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){
        const count=batch.renderIds.length;drawn+=count;allocated+=batch.ids.length-batch.free.length;
        if(count)activeBatches++;
        for(const part of batch.parts){part.count=count;part.visible=count>0;markInstancePrefix(part,count);part.boundingSphere=null;matrixUploadBytes+=count*16*4;capacityMatrixBytes+=part.instanceMatrix.array.byteLength;const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner');if(owner&&part.userData.ownerChanged&&count){owner.clearUpdateRanges();owner.addUpdateRange(0,count);owner.needsUpdate=true;ownerUploadBytes+=count*4;}}
      }
      view.unitRenderDiagnostics={drawn,allocated,activeBatches,matrixUploadBytes,ownerUploadBytes,capacityMatrixBytes};
    }

    function jointAngle(view,m,e){
      const combat=combatJointAngle(e,m);if(combat!==null)return combat;
      const working=e.type==='villager'&&!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type||e.activity);
      const phase=view.clock*8.5+e.id*.7,walk=Math.sin(phase)*m.side;
      if(m.type==='wheel')return e.moving?view.clock*5:0;
      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.035:0):e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.025:0):e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='torso')return e.moving?walk*.022:working?.04+Math.sin(view.clock*4+e.id)*.022:Math.sin(view.clock*1.7+e.id)*.009;
      if(m.type==='head')return e.moving?-.018:Math.sin(view.clock*1.4+e.id)*.012;
      if(m.type==='cape')return Math.sin(view.clock*2+e.id)*(.025+(view.weatherState?.intensity||0)*.035)+(e.moving?.07:0);
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm'){

        return e.moving?-.15:0;
      }
      if(m.type==='arm'){
        if(working){const task=workerVisualTask(view,e),rate=task==='build'?8:task==='food'?4:6;return m.side<0?-.24+Math.sin(view.clock*rate+e.id)*.1:(task==='food'?-.55:-.65)+Math.sin(view.clock*rate+e.id)*(task==='food'?.22:task==='build'?.32:.60);}

        return e.moving?walk*.3:0;
      }

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import manifest from './assets3d/catalogue.json' with {type:'json'};
    
    const sources={
      low:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-low.glb',import.meta.url).href,
      high:new URL('./assets3d/frontier-near.glb',import.meta.url).href,
    };
    const pending=new Map();
    let active=null;
    let loadSerial=0;
    
    // Uniform float attributes let the existing material/joint batches merge
    // compressed meshes reliably, including normalized/interleaved source buffers.
    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      const positions=geometry.getAttribute('position');
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('color'))geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(positions.count*3).fill(1),3));
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('uv')){
        const uv=new Float32Array(positions.count*2);
        for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){uv[i*2]=positions.getX(i)*.25;uv[i*2+1]=(positions.getY(i)+positions.getZ(i))*.25;}
        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      const missing=manifest.models.filter(model=>!templates.has(model.key));
      if(missing.length)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete: '+missing.map(model=>model.key).join(', '));
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='high'?'high':'low';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());
      try{const catalogue=await pending.get(detail);if(serial===loadSerial)active=catalogue;return catalogue;}
      catch(error){pending.delete(detail);throw error;}
    }
    
    export function authoredAssetState(){return active?{source:active.source,detail:active.detail,models:active.templates.size,bytes:active.bytes}:null;}
    export function clearAuthoredAssets(){active=null;}
    
    function cloneAsset(view,key,owner=0){
      const template=active?.templates.get(key);if(!template)return null;
      const root=template.clone(true);
      view.authoredGeometry??=new Set();
      root.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.userData.assetBody)root.userData.body=part;
        if(part.userData.gate)root.userData.portcullis=part;
        if(!part.isMesh)return;
        const role=part.userData.assetMaterial;
        const material=role==='team'?view.teamMaterials[owner]:role==='teamRoof'?view.roofMaterials[owner]:view.materials[role];
        if(!material)throw new Error(`Unknown 3D surface '${role}' in '${key}'.`);
        material.vertexColors=true;part.material=material;
        part.castShadow=true;part.receiveShadow=true;
        view.authoredGeometry.add(part.geometry);
      });
      root.userData.model3d={...root.userData.model3d,authored:true,detail:active.detail};
      view.artDiagnostics=authoredAssetState();
      return root;
    }
    
    export function workerVisualTask(view,e){
      if(e.type!=='villager')return 'standard';
      const activity=e.order?.type||e.activity;
      if(['build','repair'].includes(activity))return 'build';
      const target=view.sim?.get?.(e.order?.target),resource=activity==='gather'?target?.type||e.gatherType||e.carryType:e.carryType;
      if(['gold','stone'].includes(resource))return 'mine';
      if(resource==='food'||resource==='farm')return 'food';
      return 'wood';
    }
    export function authoredUnit(view,e){
      const task=workerVisualTask(view,e);
      return (e.type==='villager'?cloneAsset(view,`unit:villager:${task}`,e.owner):null)||cloneAsset(view,`unit:${e.type}`,e.owner);
    }
    export function authoredBuilding(view,e){
      const faction=view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.faction||'alder';
      const age=e.type==='towncenter'?(view.sim?.players[e.owner]?.age||0):0;
      const root=cloneAsset(view,`building:${e.type}:${faction}:${age}`,e.owner);
      if(root&&e.type==='dock')root.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.userData.dockPier)return;
        let angle=0;for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(view.sim.isWater(e.x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/8)*9,e.z+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/8)*9)){angle=i*Math.PI/8;break;}
        part.rotation.y=-angle;
      });
      return root;
    }
    export function authoredResource(view,e){
      const key=e.kind==='shrine'?'resource:shrine':e.water?'resource:fish':`resource:${e.type}:${e.id%4}`;
      return cloneAsset(view,key,Math.max(0,e.owner||0));
    }
    export function authoredTree(view,map,variant,far){
      const biome=['winter','desert'].includes(map)?map:'highlands';
      return cloneAsset(view,`tree:${biome}:${variant}:${far?'far':'near'}`);
    }

    """Original Blender art pass: solid foliage, roof tiles, bevels and baked shading.
    
    Run with the project Blender executable in background mode after export-source.
    The output retains the game's semantic materials, joints and moving subgroups.
    """
    
    import bpy
    import bmesh
    import json
    import math
    import random
    from pathlib import Path
    from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
    from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    source = project / ".tools/art-source/catalogue.glb"
    out = project / ".tools/art-refined"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=str(source))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    materials = {}
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial"):
            materials.setdefault(obj["assetMaterial"], obj.data.materials[0])
    
    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:
                visit(child)
        visit(root)
        return result
    
    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj
    
    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))
        faces.append(tuple(base + sides + i for i in range(sides)))
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            faces.append((base + i, base + j, base + sides + j, base + sides + i))
    
    def organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, detail):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=detail, radius=1)
        bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        base = len(vertices)
        for vert in bm.verts:
            p = vert.co
            noise = 1 + .12 * math.sin(p.x * 5 + p.y * 3) + rng.uniform(-.055, .055)
            vertices.append((center[0] + p.x * scale[0] * noise,
                             center[1] + p.y * scale[1] * noise,
                             center[2] + p.z * scale[2] * noise))
        for face in bm.faces:
            faces.append(tuple(base + vert.index for vert in face.verts))
        bm.free()
    
    def leaf_volume(vertices, faces, center, direction, length, width, thickness=.025):
        """A pointed leaf with a raised vein and a closed underside, not a card."""
        center, axis = Vector(center), Vector(direction).normalized()
        across = axis.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if across.length < .01:
            across = axis.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        across.normalize()
        normal = across.cross(axis).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        vertices.extend(tuple(point) for point in [center + axis*length*.5,
            center + across*width, center - axis*length*.5, center - across*width,
            center + normal*thickness, center - normal*thickness])
        for i in range(4):
            j = (i+1) % 4
            faces.extend([(base+j, base+i, base+4), (base+i, base+j, base+5)])
    
    def crown_leaves(root, crowns, scale, rng):
        for parity, role in [(0, "leaf"), (1, "leafDark")]:
            vertices, faces = [], []
            for i, center in enumerate(crowns):
                if i % 2 != parity:
                    continue
                # Stable surface distribution with different tilt/size at each tip.
                for j in range(64):
                    z = 1 - 2*(j+.5)/64
                    angle = j*2.399963 + rng.uniform(-.16, .16)
                    radius = math.sqrt(max(0, 1-z*z))
                    direction = Vector((radius*math.cos(angle), radius*math.sin(angle), z))
                    position = Vector(center) + Vector(tuple(direction[k]*scale[k]*1.10 for k in range(3)))
                    tilt = Vector((math.cos(angle+.7), math.sin(angle+.7), rng.uniform(-.45, .35)))
                    leaf_volume(vertices, faces, position, tilt, rng.uniform(.34, .55), rng.uniform(.10, .18))
            if vertices:
                obj = make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_LeafTips_" + role)
                obj["nearOnly"] = True
                obj["foliageDetail"] = "closed leaf tips"
    
    def winter_boughs(root, height, variant, far, rng):
        bark_vertices, bark_faces = [], []
        foliage = {role: ([], []) for role in ["leafDark", "snow"]}
        tiers, branches = (5, 7) if far else (7, 9)
        for tier in range(tiers):
            z = 1.5 + tier*(height-1.9)/(tiers-1)
            radius = 2.15*(1-tier/(tiers+1))
            for branch in range(branches):
                angle = branch*math.tau/branches + tier*.43 + variant*.3
                direction = Vector((math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle), 0))
                root_point = Vector((.10, -.05, z))
                tip = root_point + direction*(radius*rng.uniform(.88, 1.1)) + Vector((0, 0, -.22))
                rod_data(bark_vertices, bark_faces, root_point, tip, .075*(1-tier/tiers*.65), .12, 5 if far else 7)
                for section in range(2 if far else 3):
                    fraction = .30 + section*(.55 if far else .30)
                    center = root_point.lerp(tip, fraction)
                    length = radius*(.7 if far else .55)
                    width = radius*(.22 if far else .18)*(1-section*.12)
                    verts, faces = foliage["leafDark"]
                    leaf_volume(verts, faces, center, direction, length, width, .13 if far else .11)
                    # Uneven patches sit on the boughs, leaving dark needle edges.
                    if (branch+tier+variant) % 3 != 0:
                        verts, faces = foliage["snow"]
                        leaf_volume(verts, faces, center+Vector((0, 0, .125)), direction,
                                    length*.72, width*.68, .06)
        make_mesh(root, "trunk", bark_vertices, bark_faces, root.name + "_Boughs")
        for role, (vertices, faces) in foliage.items():
            make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
    
    def author_tree(root):
        _, biome, variant, lod = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        variant = int(variant)
        rng = random.Random(2201 + variant)
        far = lod == "far"
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        vertices, faces = [], []
        height, spread = [(6.3, 1.0), (7.2, .78), (6.5, 1.18), (5.8, 1.12)][variant]
        if biome == "winter":
            height, spread = 5.8 + variant*.15, 1.0
        elif biome == "desert":
            spread *= .85
        root["foliageSpecies"] = "pine" if biome == "winter" else ["oak", "birch", "elm", "beech"][variant]
        # A gently bent, tapering trunk avoids the straight toy-cylinder silhouette.
        trunk = [(0, 0, 0), (.06, -.025, height*.28),
                 (.13+variant*.025, -.06, height*.56), (.18, -.10, height*.80)]
        radii = [.28, .235, .17, .105]
        for segment in range(len(trunk)-1):
            rod_data(vertices, faces, trunk[segment], trunk[segment+1], radii[segment],
                     radii[segment+1]/radii[segment], 8 if far else 13)
        for i in range(4 if not far else 2):
            angle = i * math.tau / 4 + variant
            rod_data(vertices, faces, (0, 0, .35),
                     (math.cos(angle) * .72, math.sin(angle) * .72, .035), .15, .22)
        if biome == "winter":
            make_mesh(root, "trunk", vertices, faces, root.name + "_Bark")
            winter_boughs(root, height, variant, far, rng)
            return
        crowns = []
        for i in range(3 if far else 16):
            angle = i * 2.399 + variant
            tier = (i-1) % 3 if i else 0
            radius = ((.82+rng.random()*.28) if far else (.55+tier*.45+rng.random()*.25))*spread if i else .10
            location = (math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius,
                        height - (.30 if not i else .60+tier*.65))
            junction = (.13, -.06, height*.50)
            bend = ((junction[0]+location[0])*.5, (junction[1]+location[1])*.5, height*.70)
            rod_data(vertices, faces, junction, bend, .10, .6, 7 if far else 10)
            rod_data(vertices, faces, bend, location, .06, .25, 6 if far else 9)
            crowns.append(location)
        make_mesh(root, "trunk", vertices, faces, root.name + "_Bark")
        scale = ((1.4 if far else .92)*spread, (1.25 if far else .83)*spread,
                 (.78 if far else .60) if biome == "desert" else (1.12 if far else .78))
        for parity, role in [(0, "leaf"), (1, "leafDark")]:
            vertices, faces = [], []
            for i, center in enumerate(crowns):
                if i % 2 != parity:
                    continue
                # Smooth closed lobes remain the affordable distant canopy.
                organic_crown(vertices, faces, center, scale, rng, 2)
            make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, root.name + "_" + role)
        if not far:
            crown_leaves(root, crowns, scale, rng)
    
    def weld(obj):
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
        bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=list(bm.verts), dist=.00001)
        bm.normal_update()
        bm.to_mesh(obj.data)
        bm.free()
        obj.data.update()
        if obj.get("assetMaterial") in {"skin", "hair", "pants", "team", "canvas", "leather", "straw", "horse", "mane", "leaf", "leafDark", "trunk", "steel"}:
            for polygon in obj.data.polygons:
                polygon.use_smooth = True
            # Blender 4.5 splits sharp joins while preserving curved skin and cloth.
            obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(55))
    
    def roof_tiles(root):
        key = root["assetKey"]
        if not key.startswith("building:") or ":sun:" in key:
            return
        for roof in [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial") == "teamRoof"]:
            mesh = roof.data
            vertices = [roof.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in mesh.vertices]
            faces = [tuple(poly.vertices) for poly in mesh.polygons]
            tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)

    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    const base=process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4173/',report={checks:[],errors:[],passed:false};
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']});
    try{
      const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});page.setDefaultTimeout(90000);
      page.on('pageerror',error=>report.errors.push(error.message));page.on('console',message=>{if(message.type()==='error')report.errors.push(message.text());});
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'high',autoQuality:false,weather:'clear',volume:0,music:false})));
      await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:90000});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);
      for(const map of ['highlands','winter','desert','canyon','valley','rivers','coast']){
        const info=await page.evaluate(map=>{
          frontier.start({mode:map==='coast'?'tides':'sandbox',map,seed:512});frontier.action('pause');document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';
          const s=frontier.sim,v=frontier.view,tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];v.settings.fog=false;v.focus(tc.x+9,tc.z-6);v.zoom=58;v.tilt=.62;v.angle=.7;v.updateCamera();v.render(.016,false);v.render(.016,false);
          return {map,land:v.terrainDiagnostics,details:v.terrainDetailDiagnostics,surfaces:v.surfaceDiagnostics,uniforms:Object.keys(v.groundSurface.material.frontierTerrainUniforms||{}),
            calls:v.renderer.info.render.calls,triangles:v.renderer.info.render.triangles,finite:v.groundSurface.geometry.attributes.position.array.every(Number.isFinite)};
        },map);
        assert.ok(info.finite&&info.land.rockyVertices>0);assert.ok(info.uniforms.includes('roads')&&info.uniforms.includes('soil')&&info.uniforms.includes('rock'));assert.equal(info.surfaces.loaded,18);
        assert.ok(info.details.capacity<=360&&info.details.drawCalls<=1);report.checks.push({biome:info});await page.screenshot({path:`artifacts/terrain-${map}-high.png`});
      }
      const memory=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        const records=[],disposed=[];
        for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
          const previous=frontier.view.groundSurface.material.frontierOwnedTextures[0];let released=false;previous.addEventListener('dispose',()=>released=true);
          frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',seed:512});frontier.action('pause');document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';frontier.view.render(.016,false);
          records.push({...frontier.view.renderer.info.memory});disposed.push(released);
        }return {records,disposed};
      });
      assert.ok(memory.disposed.every(Boolean));assert.equal(memory.records[3].geometries,memory.records[1].geometries);assert.equal(memory.records[3].textures,memory.records[1].textures);report.checks.push({sceneMemory:memory});
      await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.quality('low'));await page.waitForFunction(()=>frontier.view.surfaceQuality==='low'&&frontier.view.artDiagnostics.detail==='low');
      const low=await page.evaluate(()=>({land:frontier.view.terrainDiagnostics,details:frontier.view.terrainDetailDiagnostics,normal:!!frontier.view.groundSurface.material.normalMap,models:frontier.view.artDiagnostics.models}));
      assert.equal(low.models,126);assert.equal(low.normal,false);assert.ok(low.details.capacity<=120);report.checks.push({low});await page.screenshot({path:'artifacts/terrain-highlands-low.png'});
      assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);report.passed=true;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
    }catch(error){report.failure=error.message;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));throw error;}
    finally{fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/terrain-visual-qa.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));await browser.close();}

    export function pebbleGeometry(){
      const geometry=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(.35,1),p=geometry.attributes.position;
      for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
        const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i),noise=Math.sin(x*127.1+y*74.7+z*311.7)*43758.5453;
        const scale=.88+(noise-Math.floor(noise))*.24;p.setXYZ(i,x*scale,y*scale*.65,z*scale);
      }
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();return geometry;
    }
    
    // Small cosmetic stones share one draw; they never become hidden obstacles or
    // game entities. Exploration and new building foundations control visibility.
    export class TerrainDetails{
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;const land=view.landscape,rng=seededRandom(land.seed+2903),high=view.settings.quality==='high',capacity=high?360:120;
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xffffff,roughness:.98});

    async function catalogue(detail){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(new URL(`../src/assets3d/frontier-${detail==='high'?'near':'low'}.glb`,import.meta.url));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)
        .parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,bytes.length);
    }
    function fixture(catalogue,faction='alder',owner=0){
      const view=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      view.materials={};for(const template of catalogue.templates.values())template.traverse(part=>{
        if(part.isMesh&&part.userData.assetMaterial&&!['team','teamRoof'].includes(part.userData.assetMaterial))
          view.materials[part.userData.assetMaterial]??=part.material.clone();
      });
      view.materials.water??=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial();
      view.teamMaterials=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:i?0x9a687d:0x397f8c}));
      view.roofMaterials=view.teamMaterials.map(mat=>mat.clone());
      view.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      view.sim={players:Array.from({length:8},()=>({faction,age:3})),options:{seed:512,map:'highlands'},isWater:(x,z)=>z>5};
      return view;
    }

    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Batched roofs retain their shared tile texture and per-owner colors, including the lighter model catalogue. Roof normals use the actual mesh rather than a wall's normal map.
    - Water waves displace the actual mesh on the GPU with analytical slope normals and expanded culling bounds. They retain the earlier wave profile without uploading geometry or recalculating face normals each frame. `scripts/water-visual-qa.mjs` checks visible lighting changes, both presets, unchanged CPU geometry and disposal on scene changes.
    - Terrain banks meet water level at the naval channel boundary rather than dipping below the sea outside navigable water. View-angle-dependent sky tint replaces the conspicuous scrolling stripe map. This is a lightweight lighting approximation, not a full reflection of other scene objects.
    - Fine moving ripple normals add small highlights between the larger mesh waves, with lower intensity on Low. Water is treated as a dielectric surface rather than metal. Water-only pixel probes exclude ships, fish and foliage so their movement cannot pass the wave check.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    - Artwork loading requires every manifest model and offers a retry on failure. Production pages check the current build and offer a saved solo refresh; an active human multiplayer match blocks refreshing until leaving the room. Existing pages from before this feature need one normal refresh first.

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {UNITS,seededRandom} from './data.js';
    import {authoredUnit,authoredBuilding,authoredResource,authoredTree} from './authored-assets.js';
    
    const Y=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
    function standard(color,extra={}){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.85,...extra});}
    function closedCloth(width=1,height=1){
      const positions=[],uv=[],indices=[],cols=8,rows=3;
      for(let side=0;side<2;side++)for(let row=0;row<=rows;row++)for(let col=0;col<=cols;col++){
        const u=col/cols,v=row/rows;positions.push((u-.5)*width,(v-.5)*height,Math.sin(u*Math.PI*2)*.09*width+Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*.045+(side?-.018:.018));uv.push(u,v);
      }
      const layer=(cols+1)*(rows+1);
      for(let row=0;row<rows;row++)for(let col=0;col<cols;col++){
        const a=row*(cols+1)+col,b=a+cols+1;indices.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b,a+layer,b+layer,a+1+layer,a+1+layer,b+layer,b+1+layer);
      }
      const stitch=(a,b)=>indices.push(a,b,a+layer,b,b+layer,a+layer);
      for(let col=0;col<cols;col++){stitch(col,col+1);stitch(rows*(cols+1)+col+1,rows*(cols+1)+col);}
      for(let row=0;row<rows;row++){stitch((row+1)*(cols+1),row*(cols+1));stitch(row*(cols+1)+cols,(row+1)*(cols+1)+cols);}
      const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));g.setIndex(indices);g.computeVertexNormals();return g;
    }
    function archGeometry(){
      const outer=new THREE.Shape();outer.moveTo(-.5,0);outer.lineTo(.5,0);outer.lineTo(.5,.5);outer.absarc(0,.5,.5,0,Math.PI,false);outer.lineTo(-.5,0);
      const hole=new THREE.Path();hole.moveTo(-.32,0);hole.lineTo(-.32,.5);hole.absarc(0,.5,.32,Math.PI,0,true);hole.lineTo(.32,0);hole.lineTo(-.32,0);outer.holes.push(hole);
      return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(outer,{depth:1,bevelEnabled:false,curveSegments:8}).translate(0,0,-.5);
    }
    function gableGeometry(){const s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(-.5,0);s.lineTo(.5,0);s.lineTo(0,1);s.closePath();return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:1,bevelEnabled:false}).translate(0,0,-.5);}
    function hullGeometry(){
      const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(0,2.5);shape.bezierCurveTo(1.2,1.9,1.4,-1.4,.65,-2.3);shape.lineTo(-.65,-2.3);shape.bezierCurveTo(-1.4,-1.4,-1.2,1.9,0,2.5);
      const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:.7,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.2,bevelSize:.12,bevelSegments:1,curveSegments:8});g.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);return g;
    }
    
    export function ensureModels(view){
      if(view.modelsReady)return;view.modelsReady=true;const m=view.materials;
      Object.assign(m,{leather:standard(0x594334),pants:standard(0x535c4a),hair:standard(0x47372b),straw:standard(0xbda270),horse:standard(0x76513a),mane:standard(0x342b28),steel:standard(0xb5c0c0,{metalness:.85,roughness:.3}),slate:standard(0x47576a),brick:standard(0x967255),grain:standard(0xd7b65b),fruit:standard(0x9e4240),canvas:standard(0xd0c4a6),glow:standard(0xcd6229,{emissive:0xff6d26,emissiveIntensity:1.8}),relic:standard(0x55cdb5,{emissive:0x287b67,emissiveIntensity:.65,metalness:.55,roughness:.18})});
      m.brick.map=m.stone.map;m.brick.bumpMap=m.stone.bumpMap;m.brick.bumpScale=.1;m.snow=standard(0xe3e9e5);
      const capsule=new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(.5,.5,2,8);capsule.scale(1,2/3,1);
      Object.assign(view.geo,{capsule,anatomy:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,7),foliageNear:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),foliageFar:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0),grain3d:new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1),limb:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.86,1,1,7),cloth3d:closedCloth(),arch3d:archGeometry(),roof3d:gableGeometry(),hull3d:hullGeometry(),wheel3d:new THREE.TorusGeometry(.5,.09,5,16).rotateY(Math.PI/2),ring3d:new THREE.TorusGeometry(1,.075,5,20),rock3d:new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1,0),helmet3d:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,5,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.68),dome3d:new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,16,8,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2)});
      for(const [i,roof]of view.roofMaterials.entries())roof.color.copy(view.teamMaterials[i].color).lerp(new THREE.Color(i?0x72534b:0x526479),.72);

    function builder(view,g){

      const box=(m,x,y,z,w,h,d,ry=0)=>view.box(g,m,x,y,z,w,h,d,ry);
      const oval=(m,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz)=>piece(view.geo.anatomy,m,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz);

      const roof=(m,x,y,z,w,h,d)=>piece(view.geo.roof3d,m,x,y,z,w,h,d);

    function crate(view,g,x,y,z,s=.65){const b=builder(view,g),m=view.materials;b.box(m.wood,x,y+s*.5,z,s,s,s);for(const xx of [-.36,.36])b.box(m.darkwood,x+xx*s,y+s*.5,z+s*.51,.07*s,s*.95,.035);b.box(m.darkwood,x,y+s*.5,z+s*.525,s*1.15,.07,.035).rotation.z=.7;}

    test('terrain material transitions preserve roads and form normalized finite weights over all biomes',()=>{
      for(const map of ['highlands','winter','desert','canyon','valley','rivers','coast']){
        const land=new Landscape(512,map,400),geometry=land.geometry(800,112),prepared=prepareTerrainGeometry(geometry,land);
        assert.equal(prepared.weights.length,geometry.attributes.position.count*3);assert.ok(prepared.diagnostics.heightRange.max-prepared.diagnostics.heightRange.min>15);
        for(let i=0;i<prepared.weights.length;i+=3){const values=prepared.weights.slice(i,i+3);assert.ok(values.every(value=>Number.isFinite(value)&&value>=0&&value<=1));assert.ok(Math.abs(values[0]+values[1]+values[2]-1)<1e-6);}
        const town=land.settlements[0],end=land.map==='coast'?{x:Math.sign(town.x)*20,z:town.z}:{x:town.x*.2,z:0},x=(town.x+end.x)/2,z=(town.z+end.z)/2;
        assert.ok(roadDistance(x,z,land)<1e-8);assert.ok(terrainWeights(land,x,1,z,1).soil>.85);
        assert.ok(terrainWeights(land,60,8,60,.65).rock>terrainWeights(land,60,1,60,1).rock);
        assert.equal(land.heightAt(town.x,town.z),.65,'settlement construction keeps a flat starting area');geometry.dispose();
      }
    });

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
    $taskSourceFiles=@()
    foreach ($taskDirectory in @('src','server','scripts','tests','public')) {
        $taskSourceFiles+=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskProject $taskDirectory) -Recurse -File
    }
    foreach ($taskFileName in @('package.json','package-lock.json','index.html','vite.config.js','netlify.toml','render.yaml','.gitignore','.nvmrc','README.md','ART_PIPELINE.md','DEPLOYMENT.md','RELEASE_CHECKS.md','ROADMAP.md','CHANGELOG.md','DEVELOPMENT_CHECKPOINT.md','QUALITY_TARGETS.md')) {
        $taskFilePath=Join-Path $taskProject $taskFileName
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskFilePath) { $taskSourceFiles+=Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskFilePath }
    }
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-source.zip" $taskProject $taskSourceFiles
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-static.zip" $taskStatic (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskStatic -Recurse -File)
    # Version 2.5 verification
    
    Checked 11 October 2026. This is a tested development build; the high-load performance and external playtesting requirements below remain release blockers.
    
    ## Latest quality work
    
    The latest source/build pass adds civic arcades and facade details, worker packs and armored visors, species-shaped broadleaf crowns, photographed plaster, local movement interpolation, required-art retry and saved update notices. Both catalogues have all 126 models; their current sizes are 15,554,824/3,639,276 bytes. Twelve surface JPEGs total 9,895,943 bytes. The low-catalogue download budget is explicitly 4 MiB. The complete automated suite passes **153 checks, zero failures**, including bank heights matching actual naval navigation boundaries. The network timer fixture isolates perspective remapping from the normal gameplay reset of uncaptured sacred-site counters. Eight relevant art checks pass again after fixing batched roof textures. The older 149-check performance results below predate this pass and must not be treated as measurements of the new assets.
    
    Current production Edge checks pass both catalogues, all seven biomes, naval models, working tools, picking/team colors, bounded remains, camera preservation and emulated landscape touch with no browser errors. High startup takes 10.6 seconds in this run; the settlement fixture uses 218 draws and 1,131,379 triangles. Close High forests/projectiles compile with no shader errors and retain 146 geometries/18 textures through repeated combat. Focused checks deliberately fail the artwork download, verify a usable retry, prove current civic/figure revisions and textured roof/plaster surfaces, sample movement between ticks without changing simulation positions, save before updating, and block refresh in a real human room. Reports: `artifacts/authored-art-qa.json`, `artifacts/battle-visual-qa.json`, `artifacts/visual-updates-qa.json`. These are functional/visual checks, not sustained frame-rate or physical-device certification.
    
    The subsequent GPU-water check passes on High/Low: the same physical wave profile moves highlights across the sampled water pixels while CPU vertex/normal versions remain unchanged, and old water geometry is disposed on scene changes. Culling bounds include the wave amplitude. This eliminates that animation's per-frame geometry uploads; it is not proof of a 60 FPS achievement. `artifacts/water-visual-qa.json` records the live shader result.
    
    The latest crowded-scene sample before GPU water measured High **13.48 FPS**, 305 draws and 1,958,126 triangles at 1280 x 720. A Low repeat after the GPU-water source measured **12.24 FPS**, 294 draws and 399,532 triangles in a 5.065-second window. Both miss the selected 60 FPS target; this highlands fixture contains no water, so it cannot measure that optimization. The preceding Low sample stalled for roughly 21 seconds with a 14-second tick; it is retained separately and should not be used as a stable quality comparison. Reports: `artifacts/performance-before-gpu-water.json`, `artifacts/performance-civic-stalled-low.json`, `artifacts/performance-qa.json`. Sustained optimization and reference-device validation remain open.
    
    ### Earlier checks before the civic and figure redesign
    
    The laptop's earlier 12 FPS result is a constrained stress measurement, not the development target or a definition of acceptable graphics. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) keeps the full art, animation, gameplay, missions, controls, sound, multiplayer and device goals explicit. Desktop/gaming-laptop rendering targets 60 FPS and primary-touch devices target 30 FPS, with saved 30/60 choices independent of Low/Medium/High graphics. Deadline-based frame pacing avoids accidentally halving a 60 FPS target on fractional display ticks. Automatic quality uses the selected frame budget.
    
    The latest full automated run passes **149 checks**. The regenerated 126-model Blender catalogues retain their complete roster; curved/tapered trunks, closed broadleaf tips, varied canopy shading, bark grain and branched winter foliage with patchy snow improve forest detail. Extra broadleaf tip meshes are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Tree detail follows projected screen size. Near/low GLBs are 13,753,532/3,093,656 bytes. Live Blender-art checks pass all seven biomes, naval models, saved frame-rate choice, 3D picking, team colors, camera/selection preservation and landscape touch without browser errors. The updated settlement fixture submits 218 draws and approximately 862,000 triangles; richer foliage adds geometry, and this count is not a frame-rate achievement.
    
    Ranged soldiers now use bow draw/release/recovery poses rather than melee swings; real unit cooldowns preserve firing intervals. Working villagers have a steadier off hand. Observed multiplayer workers use their public work activity/resource type to choose the same physical tools and poses as local workers, without revealing private orders.
    
    Solid projectiles start at terrain/interpolation-aligned weapon heights and rotate along their flight arc.     const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
    
    export function roadDistance(x,z,land){
      land.roads??=land.settlements.map(town=>{
        const end=land.map==='coast'?{x:Math.sign(town.x)*20,z:town.z}:{x:town.x*.2,z:0};
        const dx=end.x-town.x,dz=end.z-town.z;return {x:town.x,z:town.z,dx,dz,length:dx*dx+dz*dz||1};
      });
      let distance=Infinity;
      for(const road of land.roads){const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-road.x)*road.dx+(z-road.z)*road.dz)/road.length));distance=Math.min(distance,Math.hypot(x-road.x-t*road.dx,z-road.z-t*road.dz));}
      return distance;
    }
    
    export function terrainWeights(land,x,y,z,normalY=1){
      const road=1-smooth(1.2,2.8,roadDistance(x,z,land)),slope=1-Math.max(0,normalY);
      const patch=.5+.5*Math.sin(x*.064+land.phase)*Math.cos(z*.053-land.phase);
      let bank=0;for(const channel of land.channels()){
        const distance=Math.abs(x-channel.center-Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend)-channel.width;
        if(distance>=0)bank=Math.max(bank,1-smooth(.2,4,distance));
      }
      const arid=['desert','canyon'].includes(land.map),rock=Math.min(.94,.12*patch+smooth(.025,.19,slope)*.75+smooth(5,15,y)*.35)*(1-road*.9)*(1-bank*.6);
      const soil=Math.min(.95,Math.max(road*.95,bank*.75,(arid?.48:.12)+patch*.17))*(1-rock);
      return {grass:Math.max(0,1-soil-rock),soil,rock};
    }
    
    export function prepareTerrainGeometry(geometry,land){
      const p=geometry.attributes.position,n=geometry.attributes.normal,weights=new Float32Array(p.count*3);
      let min=Infinity,max=-Infinity,rocky=0,paths=0;
      for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
        const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i),mix=terrainWeights(land,x,y,z,n.getY(i));
        weights.set([mix.grass,mix.soil,mix.rock],i*3);min=Math.min(min,y);max=Math.max(max,y);if(mix.rock>.3)rocky++;if(mix.soil>.7)paths++;
      }
      return {weights,diagnostics:{vertices:p.count,heightRange:{min,max},rockyVertices:rocky,pathVertices:paths}};
    }
    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 11 October 2026 against the version 2.5 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.
    
    ## Version 2.5 art, AI and performance progress
    
    - Integrated 126 original Blender models, near/low catalogues, photographed CC0 surfaces, adult figures with nested joints, task-specific worker tools, solid grass and bounded battlefield remains. The art pipeline and creator/source credits are documented.
    - Packed visible troops into shared team-colored batches with correct picking, merged static building surfaces and shared repeat geometry, while keeping flags, gates, mill rotors, harbor piers and construction effects. The updated live settlement fixture uses 218 draws, compared with 483 before batching. Used instance prefixes reduce recurring matrix uploads, and unchanged ownership avoids color uploads.
    - Added Balanced/Grand war/Aggressive custom pacing, paid army/economy buildup before major balanced attacks, allied land/naval support, home reserves and recall. Saved assignments and multiplayer notice privacy have regression coverage.
    - Spatial queries, resource drop-offs, fog circles and custom victory scans reduce CPU work. A full eight-Hard-AI Balanced highlands battle reached normal all-building victory after approximately 20 simulated minutes, with every kingdom reaching Imperial Age.
    - The full automated suite passes 153 checks, including shorelines matching naval boundaries, with eight art checks refreshed after roof texture preservation. Production Blender-art, landscape-touch, pooled effects, required-download retry, current artwork revisions, interpolated movement, saved updates and the real-room refresh guard pass. Civic arcades, gable/facade details, field packs/visors, species-shaped forests and plaster surfaces improve the visible world. GPU water removes per-frame geometry updates. HTTP/WebSocket/health checks pass; sustained device performance and independent player assessment remain open.
    - Performance remains open: short headless crowded-battle results vary and still miss the declared 60 FPS desktop target on this 4 GB Intel UHD laptop. It is a constrained diagnostic device, not the standard for all users. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) preserves full art/gameplay/device acceptance targets; [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md) records actual measurements. Formation recovery reduced one saved replay's blocked orders from 23 to 1, but broad routing, sustained device performance and human playtests remain unfinished.
    
    ## Version 2.4 custom-battle progress
    
    - The requested AI and real-human battle configurations are implemented separately in one custom setup. Solo configurations convert the other enabled slots to AI; multiplayer preserves Human slots and allows AI kingdoms alongside them.
    - Huge maps, eight kingdoms, allied gates/healing/shared vision, independent AI economies and planning clocks, capital rebuilding, all-building elimination, optional conquest/capital rules and team victory are implemented.
    - Multiplayer checks include eight real WebSocket participants, private economies and fog, ownership, mixed AI/humans, guest slot choice, readiness, concessions, host defeat, reconnect and winning/losing alliance perspectives.
    - Resource exhaustion, unreachable routes, outer-map picking and private completion notices were corrected during the audit. Cached movement regions, route retention, vision indexing, pooled weather and reduced render cadence address measured CPU/GPU pressure.

    export function combatJointAngle(entity,joint){
      const definition=UNITS[entity.type];if(!definition||entity.moving||!definition.damage||!['ranged','infantry','cavalry','spear'].includes(definition.role))return null;
      const aiming=definition.role==='ranged'&&entity.order?.type==='attack';if(!entity.cooldown&&!aiming)return null;
      const interval=definition.cooldown||1.2,phase=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-(entity.cooldown||0)/interval));
      if(definition.role==='ranged'){
        const draw=Math.min(1,phase/.75);
        if(joint.type==='arm')return joint.side<0?-1.25:-.65-draw*.23;
        if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.06:-.25-draw*.65;
        if(joint.type==='torso')return -.018+draw*.028;
        if(joint.type==='head')return -.045;
        return null;
      }

      if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.15:-.12-.2*windup;
      if(joint.type==='torso')return .025+.055*strike;
      if(joint.type==='head')return -.035;
      return null;

    def bake_shading(root):
        meshes = [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH"]
        vertices, faces = [], []
        for obj in meshes:
            base = len(vertices)
            vertices.extend(obj.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in obj.data.vertices)
            faces.extend(tuple(base + v for v in poly.vertices) for poly in obj.data.polygons)
        tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
        is_unit = root["assetKey"].startswith("unit:")
        distance = .65 if is_unit else 1.6
        for obj in meshes:
            mesh = obj.data
            old = mesh.color_attributes.get("BakedDepth")
            if old:
                mesh.color_attributes.remove(old)
            colors = mesh.color_attributes.new(name="BakedDepth", type="FLOAT_COLOR", domain="POINT")
            mesh.color_attributes.active_color = colors
            matrix, normal_matrix = obj.matrix_world, obj.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted().transposed()
            for vert in mesh.vertices:
                p = matrix @ vert.co
                normal = (normal_matrix @ vert.normal).normalized()
                u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
                if u.length < .01:
                    u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
                u.normalize()
                v = normal.cross(u).normalized()
                occlusion = 0
                for direction in [normal, (normal + u * .8).normalized(),
                                  (normal - u * .8).normalized(), (normal + v * .8).normalized()]:
                    hit, _, _, dist = tree.ray_cast(p + normal * .018, direction, distance)
                    if hit is not None:
                        occlusion += 1 - dist / distance
                shade = max(.64, 1 - occlusion * .075)
                role = obj.get("assetMaterial")
                if role in ["leaf", "leafDark"]:
                    # Subtle canopy variation survives compression and batching.
                    variation = .90 + .10*(.5+.5*math.sin(p.x*8.1+p.y*5.3+p.z*6.7))
                    colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade*variation*.96, shade*variation, shade*variation*.92, 1)
                else:
                    colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade, shade, shade, 1)
    
    exec(compile((project / "scripts/blender/human-figures.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "human-figures.py", "exec"))

    def export(name, near):
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
        selected = []
        for root in roots:
            for obj in descendants(root):
                if not near and obj.get("nearOnly"):
                    continue
                obj.select_set(True)
                selected.append(obj)
        if near:
            for obj in selected:
                if obj.type != "MESH" or obj.get("assetMaterial") in ["leaf", "leafDark", "snow"]:
                    continue
                bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
                bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Crafted edges", "BEVEL")
                bevel.width = .009 if obj.get("motion") else .023
                bevel.segments = 1
                bevel.limit_method = "ANGLE"
                bevel.angle_limit = .8
                bevel.use_clamp_overlap = True
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(out / name), export_format="GLB",

    export function cargoGeometry(view,type){
      const parts=[],add=(geometry,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,angle=0)=>{const copy=geometry.clone();copy.scale(sx,sy,sz);copy.rotateZ(angle);copy.translate(x,y,z);parts.push(copy);};
      if(type==='wood')for(const [y,z]of [[-.08,-.07],[-.08,.07],[.08,0]])add(view.geo.cylinder,0,y,z,.08,.65,.08,Math.PI/2);
      else if(type==='gold')for(const [x,y]of [[-.13,-.08],[.13,-.08],[0,.06]])add(view.geo.box,x,y,0,.25,.12,.28);
      else if(type==='stone')for(const [x,y]of [[-.12,-.05],[.12,-.05],[0,.1]])add(view.geo.rock3d,x,y,0,.19,.17,.20);
      else add(view.geo.capsule,0,0,0,.43,.55,.42);
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();return result;
    }
    
    export class WorldInteractions {
      constructor(view){
        this.view=view;this.group=new THREE.Group();this.group.name='3D world interactions';view.scene.add(this.group);this.dummy=new THREE.Object3D();this.cargo={};this.fell=new Set(view.sim.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0).map(e=>e.id));view.treeFalls=new Map();
        for(const type of ['wood','food','gold','stone']){const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(cargoGeometry(view,type),view.materials[type==='food'?'canvas':type],512);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.userData.model3d={type:'cargo',resource:type,volumetric:true};this.cargo[type]=mesh;this.group.add(mesh);}
        this.stumps=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.27,.36,.32,8),view.materials.trunk,4096);this.stumps.count=0;this.stumps.frustumCulled=false;this.stumps.receiveShadow=true;this.stumps.userData.model3d={type:'stump',volumetric:true};this.group.add(this.stumps);
      }
      update(dt,menu){
        const v=this.view,counts={wood:0,food:0,gold:0,stone:0};let stumpCount=0;
        for(const e of v.sim.entities){
          if(e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0){
            if(!this.fell.has(e.id)){this.fell.add(e.id);if(v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)){v.treeFalls.set(e.id,{at:v.clock});v.forestRefresh=undefined;}}
            if(stumpCount<4096&&(menu||v.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){this.dummy.position.set(e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z)+.15,e.z);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,e.id*.7,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(1);this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.stumps.setMatrixAt(stumpCount++,this.dummy.matrix);}continue;
          }
          if(e.kind==='resource'&&['gold','stone'].includes(e.type)&&e.hp>0){const node=v.nodes.get(e.id);if(node)node.scale.setScalar(.48+.52*Math.min(1,e.amount/(e.initialAmount||Math.max(e.amount,1800))));}
          if(e.hp<=0||e.type!=='villager'||e.embarked)continue;
          const shown=menu||e.owner===0||v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z);if(!shown)continue;
          if(!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type)){const target=v.sim.get(e.order.target);if(target)e.heading=Math.atan2(target.x-e.x,target.z-e.z);}
          if(!e.carry||!this.cargo[e.carryType]||counts[e.carryType]>=512)continue;
          const heading=e.heading||0,t=e.snapshotAt===undefined?1:Math.min(1,(performance.now()-e.snapshotAt)/200),x=e.renderFromX===undefined?e.x:e.renderFromX+(e.x-e.renderFromX)*t,z=e.renderFromZ===undefined?e.z:e.renderFromZ+(e.z-e.renderFromZ)*t;this.dummy.position.set(x-Math.sin(heading)*.42,v.entityHeight(e,x,z)+1.24,z-Math.cos(heading)*.42);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,heading,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(.72+.28*Math.min(1,e.carry/18));this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.cargo[e.carryType].setMatrixAt(counts[e.carryType]++,this.dummy.matrix);
        }
        for(const [id,fall]of v.treeFalls)if(v.clock-fall.at>1.7){v.treeFalls.delete(id);v.forestRefresh=undefined;}
        for(const type of Object.keys(counts)){this.cargo[type].count=counts[type];this.cargo[type].instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;}this.stumps.count=stumpCount;this.stumps.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
        v.interactionDiagnostics={cargo:counts,stumps:stumpCount,fallingTrees:v.treeFalls.size,drawCalls:Object.values(counts).filter(count=>count>0).length+(stumpCount?1:0)};
      }
      dispose(){for(const mesh of this.group.children){mesh.geometry.dispose();mesh.dispose();}this.group.removeFromParent();}
    }

    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Keep rendering poses outside the authoritative simulation/save data. The
    // fixed 10 Hz simulation can then move smoothly between ticks at any frame rate.
    export class LocalMotion{
      constructor(){this.previous=new Map();this.point={x:0,z:0};this.clear();}
      clear(){this.previous.clear();this.time=-1;this.sequence=0;}
      capture(sim){
        const sequence=++this.sequence;
        for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0){
          let pose=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!pose){pose={};this.previous.set(e.id,pose);}
          pose.x=e.x;pose.z=e.z;pose.sequence=sequence;
        }
        for(const [id,pose]of this.previous)if(pose.sequence!==sequence)this.previous.delete(id);
      }
      commit(sim){this.time=sim.time;}
      sample(e,blend,time){
        const previous=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!previous||this.time!==time)return e;
        const limit=Math.max(2,(UNITS[e.type]?.speed||4)*.5),dx=e.x-previous.x,dz=e.z-previous.z;
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz>limit*limit)return e; // Spawn/unload/teleport should appear at its real destination.
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,blend));this.point.x=previous.x+dx*t;this.point.z=previous.z+dz*t;return this.point;
      }
    }
    
    export function smoothHeading(node,target,dt){
      if(!node.userData.headingReady){node.userData.headingReady=true;return target||0;}
      const previous=node.rotation.y,delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin((target||0)-previous),Math.cos((target||0)-previous));
      return previous+delta*(1-Math.exp(-Math.max(0,dt)*14));
    }

    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {LocalMotion,smoothHeading} from '../src/motion-smoothing.js';
    
    test('local render movement interpolates fixed ticks without changing authoritative positions',()=>{
      const unit={id:1,kind:'unit',type:'archer',hp:10,x:2,z:4},sim={entities:[unit],time:0},motion=new LocalMotion();
      motion.capture(sim);unit.x=2.3;unit.z=4.2;sim.time=.1;motion.commit(sim);
      assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,0,.1)},{x:2,z:4});assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,.5,.1)},{x:2.15,z:4.1});assert.deepEqual({...motion.sample(unit,1,.1)},{x:2.3,z:4.2});
      assert.equal(unit.x,2.3);assert.equal(unit.z,4.2);assert.equal(unit.snapshotAt,undefined);
      unit.x=30;assert.equal(motion.sample(unit,.5,.1),unit);assert.equal(motion.sample(unit,.5,.2),unit);
      unit.hp=0;motion.capture(sim);assert.equal(motion.previous.size,0);motion.clear();assert.equal(motion.time,-1);
    });
