    # Version 2.5 verification
    
    Checked 11 October 2026. This is a tested development build; the high-load performance and external playtesting requirements below remain release blockers.
    
    ## Latest quality work
    
    The latest source/build pass adds civic arcades and facade details, worker packs and armored visors, species-shaped broadleaf crowns, photographed plaster, local movement interpolation, required-art retry and saved update notices. Both catalogues have all 126 models; their current sizes are 15,554,824/3,639,276 bytes. Twelve surface JPEGs total 9,895,943 bytes. The low-catalogue download budget is explicitly 4 MiB. The complete automated suite passes **153 checks, zero failures**, including bank heights matching actual naval navigation boundaries. The network timer fixture isolates perspective remapping from the normal gameplay reset of uncaptured sacred-site counters. Eight relevant art checks pass again after fixing batched roof textures. The older 149-check performance results below predate this pass and must not be treated as measurements of the new assets.
    
    Current production Edge checks pass both catalogues, all seven biomes, naval models, working tools, picking/team colors, bounded remains, camera preservation and emulated landscape touch with no browser errors. High startup takes 10.6 seconds in this run; the settlement fixture uses 218 draws and 1,131,379 triangles. Close High forests/projectiles compile with no shader errors and retain 146 geometries/18 textures through repeated combat. Focused checks deliberately fail the artwork download, verify a usable retry, prove current civic/figure revisions and textured roof/plaster surfaces, sample movement between ticks without changing simulation positions, save before updating, and block refresh in a real human room. Reports: `artifacts/authored-art-qa.json`, `artifacts/battle-visual-qa.json`, `artifacts/visual-updates-qa.json`. These are functional/visual checks, not sustained frame-rate or physical-device certification.
    
    The subsequent GPU-water check passes on High/Low: the same physical wave profile moves highlights across the sampled water pixels while CPU vertex/normal versions remain unchanged, and old water geometry is disposed on scene changes. Culling bounds include the wave amplitude. This eliminates that animation's per-frame geometry uploads; it is not proof of a 60 FPS achievement. `artifacts/water-visual-qa.json` records the live shader result.
    
    The latest crowded-scene sample before GPU water measured High **13.48 FPS**, 305 draws and 1,958,126 triangles at 1280 x 720. A Low repeat after the GPU-water source measured **12.24 FPS**, 294 draws and 399,532 triangles in a 5.065-second window. Both miss the selected 60 FPS target; this highlands fixture contains no water, so it cannot measure that optimization. The preceding Low sample stalled for roughly 21 seconds with a 14-second tick; it is retained separately and should not be used as a stable quality comparison. Reports: `artifacts/performance-before-gpu-water.json`, `artifacts/performance-civic-stalled-low.json`, `artifacts/performance-qa.json`. Sustained optimization and reference-device validation remain open.
    
    ### Earlier checks before the civic and figure redesign
    
    The laptop's earlier 12 FPS result is a constrained stress measurement, not the development target or a definition of acceptable graphics. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) keeps the full art, animation, gameplay, missions, controls, sound, multiplayer and device goals explicit. Desktop/gaming-laptop rendering targets 60 FPS and primary-touch devices target 30 FPS, with saved 30/60 choices independent of Low/Medium/High graphics. Deadline-based frame pacing avoids accidentally halving a 60 FPS target on fractional display ticks. Automatic quality uses the selected frame budget.
    
    The latest full automated run passes **149 checks**. The regenerated 126-model Blender catalogues retain their complete roster; curved/tapered trunks, closed broadleaf tips, varied canopy shading, bark grain and branched winter foliage with patchy snow improve forest detail. Extra broadleaf tip meshes are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Tree detail follows projected screen size. Near/low GLBs are 13,753,532/3,093,656 bytes. Live Blender-art checks pass all seven biomes, naval models, saved frame-rate choice, 3D picking, team colors, camera/selection preservation and landscape touch without browser errors. The updated settlement fixture submits 218 draws and approximately 862,000 triangles; richer foliage adds geometry, and this count is not a frame-rate achievement.
    
    Ranged soldiers now use bow draw/release/recovery poses rather than melee swings; real unit cooldowns preserve firing intervals. Working villagers have a steadier off hand. Observed multiplayer workers use their public work activity/resource type to choose the same physical tools and poses as local workers, without revealing private orders.
    
    Solid projectiles start at terrain/interpolation-aligned weapon heights and rotate along their flight arc. Live combat-effects checks verify reuse, bounded retained objects, cleanup during scene switches and a stable 146-geometry/14-texture count over the repeated attack fixture. These cosmetic effects preserve authoritative damage/timing. Idle contact shadows reuse cached terrain poses.

    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is 15,554,824 bytes (14.83 MiB); the lower detail GLB is 3,639,276 bytes (3.47 MiB). Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Twenty-one photographed surface maps total 15,684,309 bytes (14.96 MiB). The declared low-catalogue content budget is now 4 MiB to retain the added architecture and equipment; this is a download budget, not an FPS achievement.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - All seven biomes have stronger rolling relief, slope/altitude/shore/road transitions and grass/soil/rock blends at their documented physical scales. A small road mask keeps paths continuous on Low geometry. Solid seeded pebbles use one instanced draw, obey exploration and clear beneath foundations; the caps are 360 on High and 120 otherwise. These cosmetic stones do not change navigation.
    - Natural rock grain and normal/roughness detail replace masonry on ore deposits. Gold retains its separate metallic inclusions. Pebbles share the rock texture; building masonry stays separate.
    - Covered civic arcades, front steps, facade arches, gable windows and civilization-specific roof details strengthen building silhouettes. Painted-plaster color, normal and roughness maps join the grass, wood and masonry sets.
    - Adult figures include villager field packs and armored visors. Local unit positions interpolate between simulation ticks and turn smoothly without changing authoritative positions or saves. Multiplayer interpolation is bounded to its snapshot interval.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Reusable joint-prefix matrices avoid repeating torso/limb calculations within each rendered unit, with numerical coverage against the original poses. The cache stores joint definitions rather than unit history. Cargo samples the same interpolated positions and turns as figures, including bounded network snapshots.
    - Curved tapering trunks and branching bends support distinct oak, birch, elm and beech crown proportions. High includes sixteen smaller crown lobes with pointed closed leaf tips; the tips are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Winter forests have branched boughs and irregular snow patches. Bark grain and muted, varied canopy colors add surface detail. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Batched roofs retain their shared tile texture and per-owner colors, including the lighter model catalogue. Roof normals use the actual mesh rather than a wall's normal map.
    - Water waves displace the actual mesh on the GPU with analytical slope normals and expanded culling bounds. They retain the earlier wave profile without uploading geometry or recalculating face normals each frame. `scripts/water-visual-qa.mjs` checks visible lighting changes, both presets, unchanged CPU geometry and disposal on scene changes.
    - Terrain banks meet water level at the naval channel boundary rather than dipping below the sea outside navigable water. View-angle-dependent sky tint replaces the conspicuous scrolling stripe map. This is a lightweight lighting approximation, not a full reflection of other scene objects.
    - Fine moving ripple normals add small highlights between the larger mesh waves, with lower intensity on Low. Water is treated as a dielectric surface rather than metal. Water-only pixel probes exclude ships, fish and foliage so their movement cannot pass the wave check.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    - Artwork loading requires every manifest model and offers a retry on failure. Production pages check the current build and offer a saved solo refresh; an active human multiplayer match blocks refreshing until leaving the room. Existing pages from before this feature need one normal refresh first.

    param([switch]$Visible,[switch]$Showcase,[switch]$LowPreview)
    
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $taskProject = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'))
    $taskTools = Join-Path $taskProject '.tools'
    $taskBlender = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-4.5.14-windows-x64\blender.exe'
    $taskProfile = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-profile'
    $taskLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stdout.log'
    $taskErrorLog = Join-Path $taskTools 'blender-stderr.log'
    
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskBlender)) {
        throw 'Project Blender installation is missing.'
    }
    
    # A duplicate instance would compete for the same connector port.
    $taskExisting = Get-Process blender -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $taskBlender }
    if ($taskExisting) {
        $taskExisting | Select-Object Id,ProcessName
        return
    }
    
    $taskPreviousConfig = $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG
    $taskPreviousScripts = $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS
    try {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = Join-Path $taskProfile 'config'
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = Join-Path $taskProfile 'scripts'
        $taskWindow = if ($Visible) { 'Normal' } else { 'Hidden' }
        $taskStartup = @{}
        if ($Showcase) {
            $taskScript = Join-Path $taskProject 'scripts\blender\showcase.py'
            $taskStartup.ArgumentList = @('--python', ('"' + $taskScript + '"'))
            if ($LowPreview) { $taskStartup.ArgumentList += @('--', '--low-preview') }
        }
        Start-Process -FilePath $taskBlender -WorkingDirectory $taskProject @taskStartup `
            -WindowStyle $taskWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $taskLog `
            -RedirectStandardError $taskErrorLog -PassThru |
            Select-Object Id,ProcessName
    } finally {
        $env:BLENDER_USER_CONFIG = $taskPreviousConfig
        $env:BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS = $taskPreviousScripts
    }

    """Original Blender art pass: solid foliage, roof tiles, bevels and baked shading.
    
    Run with the project Blender executable in background mode after export-source.
    The output retains the game's semantic materials, joints and moving subgroups.
    """
    
    import bpy
    import bmesh
    import json
    import math
    import random
    from pathlib import Path
    from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
    from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    source = project / ".tools/art-source/catalogue.glb"
    out = project / ".tools/art-refined"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=str(source))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    materials = {}
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial"):
            materials.setdefault(obj["assetMaterial"], obj.data.materials[0])
    
    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:
                visit(child)
        visit(root)
        return result
    
    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj
    
    def rod_data(vertices, faces, start, end, radius, taper=.45, sides=7):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if u.length < .001:
            u = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        u.normalize()
        v = direction.cross(u).normalized()
        base = len(vertices)
        for center, r in [(a, radius), (b, radius * taper)]:
            for i in range(sides):
                angle = i * math.tau / sides
                vertices.append(tuple(center + (u * math.cos(angle) + v * math.sin(angle)) * r))
        faces.append(tuple(base + i for i in range(sides - 1, -1, -1)))

      root.userData.assetKey = assetKey;

      names.set(view.teamMaterials[0],'team');

      root.traverse((part) => {

    def bake_shading(root):
        meshes = [obj for obj in descendants(root) if obj.type == "MESH"]
        vertices, faces = [], []
        for obj in meshes:
            base = len(vertices)
            vertices.extend(obj.matrix_world @ vert.co for vert in obj.data.vertices)
            faces.extend(tuple(base + v for v in poly.vertices) for poly in obj.data.polygons)
        tree = BVHTree.FromPolygons(vertices, faces, all_triangles=False)
        is_unit = root["assetKey"].startswith("unit:")
        distance = .65 if is_unit else 1.6
        for obj in meshes:
            mesh = obj.data
            old = mesh.color_attributes.get("BakedDepth")
            if old:
                mesh.color_attributes.remove(old)
            colors = mesh.color_attributes.new(name="BakedDepth", type="FLOAT_COLOR", domain="POINT")
            mesh.color_attributes.active_color = colors
            matrix, normal_matrix = obj.matrix_world, obj.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted().transposed()
            for vert in mesh.vertices:
                p = matrix @ vert.co
                normal = (normal_matrix @ vert.normal).normalized()
                u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
                if u.length < .01:
                    u = normal.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
                u.normalize()
                v = normal.cross(u).normalized()
                occlusion = 0
                for direction in [normal, (normal + u * .8).normalized(),
                                  (normal - u * .8).normalized(), (normal + v * .8).normalized()]:
                    hit, _, _, dist = tree.ray_cast(p + normal * .018, direction, distance)
                    if hit is not None:
                        occlusion += 1 - dist / distance
                shade = max(.64, 1 - occlusion * .075)
                role = obj.get("assetMaterial")
                if role in ["leaf", "leafDark"]:
                    # Subtle canopy variation survives compression and batching.
                    variation = .90 + .10*(.5+.5*math.sin(p.x*8.1+p.y*5.3+p.z*6.7))
                    colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade*variation*.96, shade*variation, shade*variation*.92, 1)
                else:
                    colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade, shade, shade, 1)

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
    $taskSourceFiles=@()

    import path from 'node:path';
    
    // Fixed project-owned destinations keep preview work away from the live roster.
    export function artBuildPlan(project,args=[]){
      if(args.some(arg=>!['--stage','--resources-only'].includes(arg))||new Set(args).size!==args.length)throw new Error('Use --stage and optionally --resources-only.');
      const staged=args.includes('--stage'),resources=args.includes('--resources-only');
      if(resources&&!staged)throw new Error('Resource previews require --stage; they are not a complete game catalogue.');
      const stage=staged?(resources?'resources':'full'):'';
      const candidate=path.join(project,'.tools','art-candidate',stage||'full');
      return {stage,resources,sourceDirectory:resources?path.join(candidate,'source'):path.join(project,'.tools','art-source'),
        rawDirectory:staged?path.join(candidate,'raw'):path.join(project,'.tools','art-refined'),
        outputDirectory:staged?path.join(candidate,'optimized'):path.join(project,'src','assets3d')};
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import {artBuildPlan} from '../scripts/blender/build-plan.mjs';
    
    test('candidate and partial art exports cannot target the playable model directory',()=>{
      const project=path.resolve('.'),live=artBuildPlan(project);
      assert.equal(live.outputDirectory,path.join(project,'src','assets3d'));
      for(const args of [['--stage'],['--stage','--resources-only']]){
        const plan=artBuildPlan(project,args);assert.notEqual(plan.outputDirectory,live.outputDirectory);assert.notEqual(plan.rawDirectory,live.rawDirectory);
        assert.ok(plan.outputDirectory.startsWith(path.join(project,'.tools','art-candidate')+path.sep));
        if(plan.resources)assert.notEqual(plan.sourceDirectory,live.sourceDirectory);
      }
    });
    test('partial previews and invalid options fail before any output can overwrite the complete roster',()=>{
      const project=path.resolve('.');for(const args of [['--resources-only'],['--output','../dist'],['--stage','--stage'],['--stgae']])assert.throws(()=>artBuildPlan(project,args));

    export function attackFlight(view,entity,target){
      const def=UNITS[entity.type],ranged=entity.kind==='building'||(def?.range||0)>5;
      const siege=['catapult','warship'].includes(entity.type),kind=siege?'stone':ranged?'arrow':'slash';

      const ground=view.entityHeight(entity,x,z),targetGround=view.entityHeight(target,tx,tz);
      const height=entity.kind==='building'?buildingHeight(entity.type):def?.naval?2.1:entity.type==='catapult'?3.3:1.95;
      const localX=kind==='arrow'&&entity.kind==='unit'&&!def?.naval?-.48:0;

      const from=new THREE.Vector3(x+Math.cos(heading)*localX+Math.sin(heading)*forward,ground+height,z-Math.sin(heading)*localX+Math.cos(heading)*forward);
      const to=new THREE.Vector3(tx,targetGround+(target.kind==='building'?Math.min(3.5,buildingHeight(target.type)*.6):UNITS[target.type]?.naval?1.15:1.35),tz);
      if(!ranged)from.lerp(to,.7);
      return {kind,from,to,duration:siege?clamp(distance/30,.45,1.4):ranged?clamp(distance/34,.14,.65):.19,

        alignFlight:true,impact:siege,impactColor:UNITS[target.type]?.naval?0xa6c9c4:0xb5aa95,impactSize:siege?1.6:0};
    }
    
    export function updateFlight(effect,t){
      effect.object.position.lerpVectors(effect.from,effect.to,t);
      effect.object.position.y+=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*(effect.arc||0);
      if(effect.alignFlight){
        const tangent=effect.tangent??=new THREE.Vector3(),forward=effect.forward??=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1);

    def author_resource(root):
        key = root["assetKey"].split(":")
        if len(key) != 3 or key[1] not in {"food", "stone", "gold"}:
            return
        kind, variant = key[1], int(key[2])
        rng = random.Random(9017+variant*193+(500 if kind == "gold" else 0))
        for obj in reversed(descendants(root)[1:]):
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        metadata = dict(root.get("model3d", {}))
        metadata["resourceRevision"] = "field-resources-v1"
        root["model3d"] = metadata

    const project=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../',import.meta.url)),args=process.argv.slice(2);
    const plan=artBuildPlan(project,['--stage',...args]);
    const manifest=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const live=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(project,'src/assets3d/catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const expected=live.models.filter(model=>!plan.resources||model.key.startsWith('resource:')).map(model=>model.key).sort();
    assert.equal(manifest.stage,plan.stage);assert.equal(manifest.completeCatalogue,!plan.resources);
    assert.deepEqual(manifest.models.map(model=>model.key).sort(),expected);
    const reports=[];
    for(const detail of ['near','low']){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,`frontier-${detail}.glb`));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder).parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      const roots=new Map(),geometries=new Set();gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{if(node.userData.assetKey)roots.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);if(node.isMesh)geometries.add(node.geometry);});
      assert.deepEqual([...roots.keys()].sort(),expected);assert.equal(bytes.length,manifest.sizes[detail]);
      for(const [key,root]of roots){
        if(!/^resource:(food|gold|stone):/.test(key))continue;
        assert.equal(root.userData.model3d.resourceRevision,'field-resources-v1');
        const size=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
        assert.ok(size.x>1&&size.x<5&&size.y>.5&&size.y<3&&size.z>1&&size.z<5,key+' keeps a playable resource footprint');
        const roles=new Set();let leafVolume=0,triangles=0;
        root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        root.traverse(part=>{
          if(!part.isMesh)return;roles.add(part.userData.assetMaterial);const g=part.geometry,p=g.attributes.position,index=g.index;
          for(const attribute of ['position','normal','uv','color']){const data=g.attributes[attribute];assert.ok(data,key+' has '+attribute);for(let i=0;i<data.count;i++)for(let c=0;c<data.itemSize;c++)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(data.getComponent(i,c)));}
          const count=index?.count??p.count;triangles+=count/3;
          if(part.userData.foliageDetail==='closed shrub leaflets'){
            const a=new THREE.Vector3(),b=new THREE.Vector3(),c=new THREE.Vector3();let volume=0;
            for(let i=0;i<count;i+=3){a.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i):i).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);b.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i+1):i+1).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);c.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i+2):i+2).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);volume+=a.dot(b.cross(c))/6;}
            assert.ok(volume>0,key+' has outward closed leaf surfaces');leafVolume+=volume;
          }
          if(detail==='low')assert.ok(!part.userData.nearOnly,'Low omits near-only detail');
        });
        if(key.includes(':food:')){assert.ok(roles.has('trunk')&&roles.has('fruit')&&leafVolume>.0001);assert.ok(triangles<5500,'bush detail is bounded');}
        if(key.includes(':gold:'))assert.ok(roles.has('gold'),'gold seams survive export');
        reports.push({detail,key,size:size.toArray(),triangles,leafVolume});
      }
      for(const geometry of geometries)geometry.dispose();
    }
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'validation.json'),JSON.stringify({passed:true,completeCatalogue:manifest.completeCatalogue,models:expected.length,reports},null,2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,stage:plan.stage,models:expected.length,resources:reports.length}));

    export function cargoGeometry(view,type){
      const parts=[],add=(geometry,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,angle=0)=>{const copy=geometry.clone();copy.scale(sx,sy,sz);copy.rotateZ(angle);copy.translate(x,y,z);parts.push(copy);};
      if(type==='wood')for(const [y,z]of [[-.08,-.07],[-.08,.07],[.08,0]])add(view.geo.cylinder,0,y,z,.08,.65,.08,Math.PI/2);
      else if(type==='gold')for(const [x,y]of [[-.13,-.08],[.13,-.08],[0,.06]])add(view.geo.box,x,y,0,.25,.12,.28);
      else if(type==='stone')for(const [x,y]of [[-.12,-.05],[.12,-.05],[0,.1]])add(view.geo.rock3d,x,y,0,.19,.17,.20);
      else add(view.geo.capsule,0,0,0,.43,.55,.42);
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();return result;
    }

        for(const type of ['wood','food','gold','stone']){const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(cargoGeometry(view,type),view.materials[type==='food'?'canvas':type],512);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.userData.model3d={type:'cargo',resource:type,volumetric:true};this.cargo[type]=mesh;this.group.add(mesh);}

        this.stumps=new THREE.InstancedMesh(stumpGeometry,view.materials.trunk,4096);this.stumps.count=0;this.stumps.frustumCulled=false;this.stumps.receiveShadow=true;this.stumps.userData.model3d={type:'stump',volumetric:true};this.group.add(this.stumps);
      }
      update(dt,menu){
        const v=this.view,counts={wood:0,food:0,gold:0,stone:0};let stumpCount=0,stumpsChanged=false;
        for(const e of v.sim.entities){
          if(e.type==='wood'&&e.hp<=0){
            if(!this.fell.has(e.id)){this.fell.add(e.id);if(v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z)){v.treeFalls.set(e.id,{at:v.clock});v.forestRefresh=undefined;}}
            if(stumpCount<4096&&(menu||v.sim.isExplored(e.x,e.z))){
              let pose=this.stumpPoses.get(e.id),changed=!pose||pose.x!==e.x||pose.z!==e.z;
              if(changed){this.dummy.position.set(e.x,v.groundHeight(e.x,e.z)+.15,e.z);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,e.id*.7,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(1);this.dummy.updateMatrix();pose={x:e.x,z:e.z,matrix:this.dummy.matrix.clone()};this.stumpPoses.set(e.id,pose);if(this.stumpPoses.size>4096)this.stumpPoses.delete(this.stumpPoses.keys().next().value);}
              if(changed||this.stumpSlots[stumpCount]!==e.id){this.stumps.setMatrixAt(stumpCount,pose.matrix);stumpsChanged=true;}
              this.stumpSlots[stumpCount++]=e.id;
            }continue;
          }
          if(e.kind==='resource'&&['gold','stone'].includes(e.type)&&e.hp>0){const node=v.nodes.get(e.id);if(node)node.scale.setScalar(.48+.52*Math.min(1,e.amount/(e.initialAmount||Math.max(e.amount,1800))));}
          if(e.hp<=0||e.type!=='villager'||e.embarked)continue;
          const shown=menu||e.owner===0||v.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z);if(!shown)continue;
          if(!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type)){const target=v.sim.get(e.order.target);if(target)e.heading=Math.atan2(target.x-e.x,target.z-e.z);}
          if(!e.carry||!this.cargo[e.carryType]||counts[e.carryType]>=512)continue;
          const node=v.nodes.get(e.id),heading=node?.userData.headingReady?smoothHeading(node,e.heading,dt):e.heading||0,position=renderPosition(v,e),x=position.x,z=position.z;this.dummy.position.set(x-Math.sin(heading)*.42,v.entityHeight(e,x,z)+1.24,z-Math.cos(heading)*.42);this.dummy.rotation.set(0,heading,0);this.dummy.scale.setScalar(.72+.28*Math.min(1,e.carry/18));this.dummy.updateMatrix();this.cargo[e.carryType].setMatrixAt(counts[e.carryType]++,this.dummy.matrix);

        v.interactionDiagnostics={cargo:counts,stumps:stumpCount,fallingTrees:v.treeFalls.size,drawCalls:Object.values(counts).filter(count=>count>0).length+(stumpCount?1:0),matrixUploadBytes,cachedStumps:this.stumpPoses.size};

      let reveal=false,samples=0;

      assert.deepEqual(interactions.cargo.wood.instanceMatrix.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:16}]);
      view.clock=.1;interactions.update(.016,false);assert.equal(interactions.stumps.instanceMatrix.version,initial);assert.equal(samples,terrainSamples,'idle remains do not resample the same terrain');assert.equal(view.interactionDiagnostics.matrixUploadBytes,64);
      reveal=true;view.clock=.2;interactions.update(.016,false);assert.equal(interactions.stumps.count,2);assert.ok(interactions.stumps.instanceMatrix.version>initial);assert.deepEqual(interactions.stumps.instanceMatrix.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:32}]);

    import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import {artBuildPlan} from './build-plan.mjs';
    
    const project=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../',import.meta.url)),args=process.argv.slice(2);
    const plan=artBuildPlan(project,['--stage',...args]);
    const manifest=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const live=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(project,'src/assets3d/catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const expected=live.models.filter(model=>!plan.resources||model.key.startsWith('resource:')).map(model=>model.key).sort();
    assert.equal(manifest.stage,plan.stage);assert.equal(manifest.completeCatalogue,!plan.resources);
    assert.deepEqual(manifest.models.map(model=>model.key).sort(),expected);
    const reports=[];
    for(const detail of ['near','low']){
      const bytes=await fs.readFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,`frontier-${detail}.glb`));
      const gltf=await new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder).parseAsync(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),'');
      const roots=new Map(),geometries=new Set();gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{if(node.userData.assetKey)roots.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);if(node.isMesh)geometries.add(node.geometry);});
      assert.deepEqual([...roots.keys()].sort(),expected);assert.equal(bytes.length,manifest.sizes[detail]);
      for(const [key,root]of roots){
        if(!/^resource:(food|gold|stone):/.test(key))continue;
        assert.equal(root.userData.model3d.resourceRevision,'field-resources-v1');
        const size=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
        assert.ok(size.x>1&&size.x<5&&size.y>.5&&size.y<3&&size.z>1&&size.z<5,key+' keeps a playable resource footprint');
        const roles=new Set();let leafVolume=0,triangles=0;
        root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        root.traverse(part=>{
          if(!part.isMesh)return;roles.add(part.userData.assetMaterial);const g=part.geometry,p=g.attributes.position,index=g.index;
          for(const attribute of ['position','normal','uv','color']){const data=g.attributes[attribute];assert.ok(data,key+' has '+attribute);for(let i=0;i<data.count;i++)for(let c=0;c<data.itemSize;c++)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(data.getComponent(i,c)));}
          const count=index?.count??p.count;triangles+=count/3;
          if(part.userData.foliageDetail==='closed shrub leaflets'){
            const a=new THREE.Vector3(),b=new THREE.Vector3(),c=new THREE.Vector3();let volume=0;
            for(let i=0;i<count;i+=3){a.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i):i).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);b.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i+1):i+1).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);c.fromBufferAttribute(p,index?index.getX(i+2):i+2).applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);volume+=a.dot(b.cross(c))/6;}
            assert.ok(volume>0,key+' has outward closed leaf surfaces');leafVolume+=volume;
          }
          if(detail==='low')assert.ok(!part.userData.nearOnly,'Low omits near-only detail');
        });
        if(key.includes(':food:')){assert.ok(roles.has('trunk')&&roles.has('fruit')&&leafVolume>.0001);assert.ok(triangles<5500,'bush detail is bounded');}
        if(key.includes(':gold:'))assert.ok(roles.has('gold'),'gold seams survive export');
        reports.push({detail,key,size:size.toArray(),triangles,leafVolume});
      }
      for(const geometry of geometries)geometry.dispose();
    }
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'validation.json'),JSON.stringify({passed:true,completeCatalogue:manifest.completeCatalogue,models:expected.length,reports},null,2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,stage:plan.stage,models:expected.length,resources:reports.length}));

                    colors.data[vert.index].color = (shade, shade, shade, 1)
    
    exec(compile((project / "scripts/blender/human-figures.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "human-figures.py", "exec"))
    
    for i, root in enumerate(roots):
        if root["assetKey"].startswith("unit:"):
            author_human(root)
        if root["assetKey"].startswith("tree:"):
            author_tree(root)
        if root["assetKey"].startswith("resource:"):
            author_resource(root)
        for obj in descendants(root):
            if obj.type == "MESH":
                weld(obj)
        roof_tiles(root)
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        bake_shading(root)
        if (i + 1) % 12 == 0:
            print(f"Refined {i + 1}/{len(roots)} models", flush=True)
    
    def export(name, near):
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
        selected = []
        for root in roots:
            for obj in descendants(root):
                if not near and obj.get("nearOnly"):
                    continue
                obj.select_set(True)
                selected.append(obj)
        if near:
            for obj in selected:
                if obj.type != "MESH" or obj.get("assetMaterial") in ["leaf", "leafDark", "snow"]:
                    continue
                bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
                bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Crafted edges", "BEVEL")
                bevel.width = .009 if obj.get("motion") else .023
                bevel.segments = 1
                bevel.limit_method = "ANGLE"
                bevel.angle_limit = .8
                bevel.use_clamp_overlap = True
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(out / name), export_format="GLB",
                                 use_selection=True, export_apply=True,
                                 export_vertex_color="ACTIVE",
                                 export_extras=True, export_animations=False,

    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    
    export function readGlb(bytes){
      assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(0),0x46546c67);assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(4),2);assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(8),bytes.length);
      const jsonLength=bytes.readUInt32LE(12);assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(16),0x4e4f534a);
      const json=JSON.parse(bytes.subarray(20,20+jsonLength).toString('utf8')),at=20+jsonLength;
      assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(at+4),0x004e4942);const bin=bytes.subarray(at+8,at+8+bytes.readUInt32LE(at));
      assert.equal(at+8+bin.length,bytes.length);return {json,bin};
    }
    export function writeGlb(json,bin){
      const text=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(json)),jsonBytes=Buffer.alloc(Math.ceil(text.length/4)*4,32),binary=Buffer.alloc(Math.ceil(bin.length/4)*4);text.copy(jsonBytes);bin.copy(binary);
      const header=Buffer.alloc(20);header.writeUInt32LE(0x46546c67,0);header.writeUInt32LE(2,4);header.writeUInt32LE(28+jsonBytes.length+binary.length,8);header.writeUInt32LE(jsonBytes.length,12);header.writeUInt32LE(0x4e4f534a,16);
      const binHeader=Buffer.alloc(8);binHeader.writeUInt32LE(binary.length,0);binHeader.writeUInt32LE(0x004e4942,4);return Buffer.concat([header,jsonBytes,binHeader,binary]);
    }
    
    // These project catalogues use material colors, compressed meshes and nested
    // joint extras. Keep the existing compressed geometry byte-for-byte; replacing
    // resources must never simplify unrelated troops or buildings a second time.
    export function replaceCatalogueResources(baseBytes,patchBytes){
      const base=readGlb(baseBytes),patch=readGlb(patchBytes),out=structuredClone(base.json),p=patch.json;
      for(const document of [out,p]){
        for(const key of ['images','textures','skins','animations','cameras'])assert.ok(!document[key]?.length,'Unsupported catalogue '+key);
        assert.ok(!document.buffers[0].uri);assert.ok(document.buffers[0].byteLength<= (document===out?base.bin.length:patch.bin.length));
        for(const buffer of document.buffers.slice(1))assert.ok(buffer.extensions?.EXT_meshopt_compression?.fallback&&!buffer.uri,'Only meshopt fallback buffers are supported');
        for(const node of document.nodes)assert.ok(!node.extensions&&node.skin===undefined&&node.camera===undefined,'Unsupported node references');
      }
      const shift={},fields=['nodes','meshes','materials','accessors','bufferViews'];for(const field of fields){out[field]??=[];shift[field]=out[field].length;}
      const binOffset=base.bin.length,buffers=p.buffers.map((buffer,index)=>index===0?0:out.buffers.length+index-1);
      out.buffers.push(...structuredClone(p.buffers.slice(1)));out.buffers[0].byteLength=binOffset+patch.bin.length;
      const views=structuredClone(p.bufferViews).map(view=>{
        const original=view.buffer;view.buffer=buffers[original];if(original===0)view.byteOffset=(view.byteOffset||0)+binOffset;
        for(const name of Object.keys(view.extensions||{}))assert.equal(name,'EXT_meshopt_compression');
        const compressed=view.extensions?.EXT_meshopt_compression;if(compressed){const original=compressed.buffer;compressed.buffer=buffers[original];if(original===0)compressed.byteOffset=(compressed.byteOffset||0)+binOffset;}
        return view;
      });out.bufferViews.push(...views);
      out.accessors.push(...structuredClone(p.accessors).map(accessor=>{
        if(accessor.bufferView!==undefined)accessor.bufferView+=shift.bufferViews;
        if(accessor.sparse){accessor.sparse.indices.bufferView+=shift.bufferViews;accessor.sparse.values.bufferView+=shift.bufferViews;}return accessor;
      }));
      out.materials.push(...structuredClone(p.materials));
      out.meshes.push(...structuredClone(p.meshes).map(mesh=>{
        for(const primitive of mesh.primitives){assert.ok(!primitive.extensions,'Unsupported primitive extensions');
          for(const key of Object.keys(primitive.attributes))primitive.attributes[key]+=shift.accessors;
          if(primitive.indices!==undefined)primitive.indices+=shift.accessors;if(primitive.material!==undefined)primitive.material+=shift.materials;
          for(const target of primitive.targets||[])for(const key of Object.keys(target))target[key]+=shift.accessors;
        }return mesh;
      }));
      out.nodes.push(...structuredClone(p.nodes).map(node=>{if(node.mesh!==undefined)node.mesh+=shift.meshes;if(node.children)node.children=node.children.map(index=>index+shift.nodes);return node;}));
      const replacements=new Map(),keys=[];
      for(let index=0;index<p.nodes.length;index++){
        const key=p.nodes[index].extras?.assetKey;if(!/^resource:(food|gold|stone):/.test(key||''))continue;
        const previous=base.json.nodes.findIndex(node=>node.extras?.assetKey===key);assert.ok(previous>=0,'Resource does not exist in the complete roster');
        const replacement=index+shift.nodes;for(const field of ['matrix','translation','rotation','scale'])assert.deepEqual(out.nodes[previous][field],out.nodes[replacement][field],'Resource root transforms remain compatible');
        replacements.set(previous,replacement);keys.push(key);
      }
      assert.equal(replacements.size,12,'All food, gold and stone variants are required');
      for(const node of out.nodes)if(node.children)node.children=node.children.map(index=>replacements.get(index)??index);
      for(const scene of out.scenes)scene.nodes=scene.nodes.map(index=>replacements.get(index)??index);
      for(const field of ['extensionsUsed','extensionsRequired'])out[field]=[...new Set([...(out[field]||[]),...(p[field]||[])])];
      out.asset.generator='Crowns of the Frontier: original Blender resource composition';
      return {bytes:writeGlb(out,Buffer.concat([base.bin,patch.bin])),keys};
    }

      const json={asset:{version:'2.0'},scene:0,scenes:[{nodes:nodes.map((_,i)=>i)}],nodes,meshes:[{primitives:[{attributes:{POSITION:0},indices:0,material:0}]}],materials:[{name:marker}],accessors:[{bufferView:0,componentType:5126,count:1,type:'VEC3'}],
        buffers:[{byteLength:4},{byteLength:12,extensions:{EXT_meshopt_compression:{fallback:true}}}],bufferViews:[{buffer:1,byteOffset:0,byteLength:12,extensions:{EXT_meshopt_compression:{buffer:0,byteOffset:0,byteLength:4,byteStride:12,count:1,mode:'ATTRIBUTES'}}}],extensionsUsed:['EXT_meshopt_compression']};
      return writeGlb(json,Buffer.from([marker==='old'?1:2,3,4,5]));

      assert.deepEqual(parsed.json.scenes[0].nodes.slice(0,12),Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>i+13));assert.equal(parsed.json.scenes[0].nodes[12],12);

      assert.equal(parsed.json.nodes[13].mesh,1);assert.equal(parsed.json.meshes[1].primitives[0].attributes.POSITION,1);assert.equal(parsed.json.meshes[1].primitives[0].material,1);

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {cameraMapBox,cameraMapFootprint,insideMap,minimapPoint} from '../src/map-geometry.js';
    import {CAMERA_PRESETS} from '../src/world.js';
    
    function cameraAt(x,z,angle,tilt,zoom,aspect){
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(46,aspect,.5,400);
      camera.position.set(x+Math.sin(angle)*zoom,.65+Math.tan(tilt)*zoom,z+Math.cos(angle)*zoom);
      camera.lookAt(x,.65,z);camera.updateMatrixWorld();return camera;
    }
    
    test('river and sea banks meet the naval boundary rather than submerged dry land',()=>{
      for(const map of ['coast','valley','rivers'])for(const seed of [512,2026,91]){
        const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map,seed}),land=new Landscape(seed,map),z=30;
        for(const channel of land.channels())for(const side of [-1,1]){
          const mid=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend,bank=mid+side*channel.width;
          assert.ok(sim.isWater(bank-side*.25,z));assert.equal(sim.isWater(bank+side*.25,z),false);
          assert.ok(land.heightAt(mid,z)<-.5);assert.ok(Math.abs(land.heightAt(bank,z)-.08)<1e-8);
          assert.ok(land.heightAt(bank+side*.25,z)>.08,'land immediately outside the navigation boundary stays above water');
        }
      }
    });
    
    test('radar camera box stays finite and rectangular across map edges, views and rotations',()=>{
      for(const preset of Object.values(CAMERA_PRESETS))for(const [x,z]of [[0,0],[-72,-72],[-72,72],[72,-72],[72,72]])for(const angle of [0,Math.PI/4,1.85,Math.PI])for(const aspect of [1440/900,844/390,390/844]){
        const camera=cameraAt(x,z,angle,preset.tilt,preset.zoom,aspect),box=cameraMapBox(camera,.65);
        assert.ok(box,'a camera aimed inside the battlefield always has a locator');
        for(const value of Object.values(box))assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value)&&Math.abs(value)<=80.00001);
        assert.ok(box.minX<box.maxX&&box.minZ<box.maxZ);
        assert.ok(x>=box.minX-1e-5&&x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&z<=box.maxZ+1e-5,'the camera center is inside its box');
        for(const p of cameraMapFootprint(camera,.65))assert.ok(p.x>=box.minX-1e-5&&p.x<=box.maxX+1e-5&&p.z>=box.minZ-1e-5&&p.z<=box.maxZ+1e-5);
      }
    });
    
    test('radar locator follows scrolling and grows when zooming out',()=>{
      const preset=CAMERA_PRESETS.tactical,make=(x,z,zoom)=>cameraMapBox(cameraAt(x,z,0,preset.tilt,zoom,1.6),.65);
      const near=make(0,0,24),far=make(0,0,45),moved=make(10,12,24);
      assert.ok(far.maxX-far.minX>near.maxX-near.minX);assert.ok(far.maxZ-far.minZ>near.maxZ-near.minZ);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minX-near.minX-10)<1e-5);assert.ok(Math.abs(moved.minZ-near.minZ-12)<1e-5);
    });
    
    test('minimap coordinates map consistently to the square battlefield and clamp captured drags',()=>{
      const rect={left:17,top:29,width:101,height:101};
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(17,29,rect),{x:-80,z:-80});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(118,130,rect),{x:80,z:80});
      assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(67.5,79.5,rect),{x:0,z:0});assert.deepEqual(minimapPoint(-50,600,rect),{x:-80,z:80});
      for(const [x,z]of [[NaN,0],[0,Infinity],[81,0],[0,-81]])assert.equal(insideMap(x,z),false);
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    
    // Open branch/leaf geometry still needs an easy-to-hit central volume. This
    // fallback is used only after real meshes miss, and obeys existing visibility.
    export function pickFruitVolume(view){
      const sphere=view.fruitPickSphere??=new THREE.Sphere(),point=view.fruitPickPoint??=new THREE.Vector3(),ray=view.raycaster.ray;
      let nearest=null,distance=Infinity;
      for(const e of view.sim.entities){
        if(e.hp<=0||e.kind!=='resource'||e.type!=='food'||e.water||!view.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;
        const node=view.nodes.get(e.id);if(!node||!node.visible)continue;
        sphere.center.copy(node.position);sphere.center.y+=.7*node.scale.y;sphere.radius=Math.max(.7,(e.r||1.7)*.72)*node.scale.x;
        if(!ray.intersectSphere(sphere,point))continue;const depth=point.distanceTo(ray.origin);
        if(depth<distance){nearest=e;distance=depth;}
      }
      return nearest;
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {pickFruitVolume} from '../src/resource-picking.js';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    
    test('fruit hit volumes fill foliage gaps, choose the nearest cluster and never expose hidden resources',()=>{
      const near={id:1,kind:'resource',type:'food',hp:1,r:1.7,x:0,z:0},far={...near,id:2,z:-4},nodes=new Map();
      for(const e of [near,far]){const node=new THREE.Object3D();node.position.set(e.x,1,e.z);nodes.set(e.id,node);}
      let visible=true;const view={sim:{entities:[far,near],isVisible:()=>visible},nodes,raycaster:{ray:new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(0,1.7,6),new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1))}};
      assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),near);nodes.get(1).visible=false;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),far);visible=false;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);
      visible=true;far.water=true;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);far.water=false;far.hp=0;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);
    });
    test('existing solid foreground picking takes priority over a fruit fallback',()=>{
      const building={id:3,owner:0,kind:'building'},view={groundPoint:()=>{},objects:{children:[]},sim:{get:()=>building},raycaster:{intersectObjects:()=>[{object:{userData:{entity:3}}}]}};
      assert.equal(WorldView.prototype.pick.call(view,10,10),building);
    });

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    
    // Open branch/leaf geometry still needs an easy-to-hit central volume. This
    // fallback is used only after real meshes miss, and obeys existing visibility.
    export function pickFruitVolume(view){
      const sphere=view.fruitPickSphere??=new THREE.Sphere(),point=view.fruitPickPoint??=new THREE.Vector3(),ray=view.raycaster.ray;
      let nearest=null,distance=Infinity;
      for(const e of view.sim.entities){
        if(e.hp<=0||e.kind!=='resource'||e.type!=='food'||e.water||!view.sim.isVisible(e.x,e.z))continue;
        const node=view.nodes.get(e.id);if(!node||!node.visible)continue;
        sphere.center.copy(node.position);sphere.center.y+=.7*node.scale.y;sphere.radius=Math.max(.7,(e.r||1.7)*.72)*node.scale.x;
        if(!ray.intersectSphere(sphere,point))continue;const depth=point.distanceTo(ray.origin);
        if(depth<distance){nearest=e;distance=depth;}
      }
      return nearest;
    }

    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    
    const report={checks:[],errors:[],failures:[],passed:false},base=process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4174/',candidate='.tools/art-candidate/full/optimized';
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']});
    async function prepare(page){
      page.setDefaultTimeout(90000);page.on('pageerror',error=>report.errors.push(error.message));page.on('console',message=>{if(message.type()==='error')report.errors.push(message.text());});
      await page.route(/frontier-(near|low)(?:-[\w-]+)?\.glb(?:\?.*)?$/,route=>{const detail=route.request().url().includes('frontier-near')?'near':'low';return route.fulfill({body:fs.readFileSync(`${candidate}/frontier-${detail}.glb`),contentType:'model/gltf-binary'});});
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'low',autoQuality:false,weather:'clear',music:false,volume:0})));
      await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);
    }
    try{
      const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});await prepare(page);
      for(const quality of ['low','high']){
        await page.evaluate(quality=>frontier.view.quality(quality),quality);await page.waitForFunction(quality=>frontier.view.surfaceQuality===quality&&frontier.view.artDiagnostics.detail===(quality==='high'?'high':'low'),quality);
        for(const type of ['food','stone','gold']){
          const info=await page.evaluate(type=>{
            frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',seed:512});frontier.action('pause');document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';
            const v=frontier.view,s=frontier.sim,tc=s.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0],e=s.entities.filter(e=>e.kind==='resource'&&e.type===type&&!e.water).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-tc.x,a.z-tc.z)-Math.hypot(b.x-tc.x,b.z-tc.z))[0];
            v.settings.fog=false;v.focus(e.x,e.z);v.zoom=20;v.tilt=.9;v.angle=2.6;v.updateCamera();v.render(.016,false);
            const node=v.nodes.get(e.id)||v.createNode(e),p=node.position.clone();p.y+=type==='food'?.8:.6;p.project(v.camera);const rect=v.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect(),hit=v.pick(rect.left+(p.x+1)*rect.width/2,rect.top+(1-p.y)*rect.height/2);
            return {type,models:v.artDiagnostics.models,revision:node.userData.model3d.resourceRevision,bytes:v.artDiagnostics.bytes,centerPick:hit?.id===e.id,picked:hit?.id,visible:s.isVisible(e.x,e.z),shown:node.visible,resource:e.id,draws:v.renderer.info.render.calls};
          },type);
          assert.equal(info.models,126);assert.equal(info.revision,'field-resources-v1');if(!info.centerPick)report.failures.push(`${quality} ${type} center cannot be selected`);report.checks.push({quality,resource:info});await page.screenshot({path:`artifacts/candidate-${type}-${quality}.png`});
        }
      }
      await page.close();
      const phone=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:568,height:320},isMobile:true,hasTouch:true});await prepare(phone);
      for(const [width,height]of [[568,320],[640,360],[667,375],[844,390],[320,568],[360,640],[1024,768]]){
        await phone.setViewportSize({width,height});
        await phone.evaluate(()=>{document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='';frontier.action('menu');});
        await phone.locator('[data-action=custom-battle]').first().tap();await phone.locator('[data-battle-preset="4v4"]').tap();
        assert.ok(await phone.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth),'custom setup fits the viewport');
        await phone.locator('[data-action=custom-start]').tap();await phone.waitForFunction(()=>frontier.sim.players.length===8);
        if(width<height&&await phone.locator('[data-action=dismiss-rotate]').isVisible())await phone.locator('[data-action=dismiss-rotate]').tap();
        await phone.evaluate(()=>{frontier.action('pause');document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';frontier.select([frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0].id]);});
        const controls=await phone.evaluate(()=>{
          const selectors=['.camera-controls','#minimap','#selection-panel','.command-panel','.game-header'],boxes=selectors.map(selector=>{const r=document.querySelector(selector).getBoundingClientRect();return {selector,x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height};});
          const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.camera-controls button,.command-buttons button,#production-toggle')].filter(button=>button.getBoundingClientRect().height>0).map(button=>{const r=button.getBoundingClientRect(),hit=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);return {action:button.dataset.action,width:r.width,height:r.height,reachable:hit===button||button.contains(hit)};});
          const canvas=frontier.view.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();return {width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,layoutWidth:document.documentElement.clientWidth,canvas:{width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height},overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>document.documentElement.clientWidth,boxes,buttons,models:frontier.view.artDiagnostics.models};
        });report.checks.push({phone:controls});
        assert.equal(controls.overflow,false);assert.equal(controls.models,126);const radar=controls.boxes.find(box=>box.selector==='#minimap');assert.equal(radar.width,radar.height);
        if(controls.width!==width||controls.canvas.width!==width||controls.canvas.height!==height)report.failures.push(`${width}x${height}: viewport or canvas scale is wrong`);
        if(!controls.boxes.every(box=>box.x>=-1&&box.y>=-1&&box.x+box.width<=width+1&&box.y+box.height<=height+1))report.failures.push(`${width}x${height}: panels outside viewport`);
        if(!controls.buttons.every(button=>button.reachable))report.failures.push(`${width}x${height}: primary controls covered`);
        if(!controls.buttons.every(button=>button.height>=44&&button.width>=40))report.failures.push(`${width}x${height}: primary controls too small`);
        const angle=await phone.evaluate(()=>frontier.view.angle);await phone.getByRole('button',{name:'Rotate camera left',exact:true}).tap();assert.ok(await phone.evaluate(angle=>frontier.view.angle>angle,angle));
        await phone.locator('#production-toggle').tap();const bounds=await phone.locator('#production-panel').boundingBox();assert.ok(bounds&&bounds.x>=0&&bounds.y>=0&&bounds.x+bounds.width<=width+1&&bounds.y+bounds.height<=height+1);await phone.locator('#production-toggle').tap();
        await phone.locator('.command-buttons [data-action=build]').tap();assert.ok(await phone.locator('#build-panel').isVisible());await phone.evaluate(()=>frontier.action('cancel-build'));
        await phone.screenshot({path:`artifacts/candidate-phone-${width}x${height}.png`});
      }
      await phone.close();assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);assert.deepEqual(report.failures,[]);report.passed=true;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
    }catch(error){report.failure=error.message;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));throw error;}
    finally{fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/resource-candidate-qa.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));await browser.close();}

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {pickFruitVolume} from '../src/resource-picking.js';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    
    test('fruit hit volumes fill foliage gaps, choose the nearest cluster and never expose hidden resources',()=>{
      const near={id:1,kind:'resource',type:'food',hp:1,r:1.7,x:0,z:0},far={...near,id:2,z:-4},nodes=new Map();
      for(const e of [near,far]){const node=new THREE.Object3D();node.position.set(e.x,1,e.z);nodes.set(e.id,node);}
      let visible=true;const view={sim:{entities:[far,near],isVisible:()=>visible},nodes,raycaster:{ray:new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(0,1.7,6),new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1))}};
      assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),near);nodes.get(1).visible=false;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),far);visible=false;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);
      visible=true;far.water=true;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);far.water=false;far.hp=0;assert.equal(pickFruitVolume(view),null);
    });
    test('existing solid foreground picking takes priority over a fruit fallback',()=>{
      const building={id:3,owner:0,kind:'building'},view={groundPoint:()=>{},objects:{children:[]},sim:{get:()=>building},raycaster:{intersectObjects:()=>[{object:{userData:{entity:3}}}]}};
      assert.equal(WorldView.prototype.pick.call(view,10,10),building);
    });

## Activity

    $ Get-Content QUALITY_TARGETS.md | Select-Object -First 105; Get-Content scripts/interactions-qa.mjs; Get-Content scripts/render-profile.mjs | Select-Object -First 70
    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    | AI and custom battles | Eight allied/enemy kingdoms, selectable difficulty/pace, real reinforcement groups, home reserves and team victory | Reliable formations, route recovery, scouting/retreat/counter choices, stronger coordinated pressure and interesting long wars. Verify full matches across seeds, biomes, starting ages and player configurations. |
    | Campaigns and maps | Six staged chapters, checkpoints, journals, escort/defense/naval objectives and seven seeded biomes | More distinctive authored locations, mission events, varied encounters and pacing, plus completion/failure testing and human reviews on every difficulty. |
    | Controls and interface | Desktop edge scrolling, square radar/locator, production overview, hotkeys, landscape touch | Responsive, precise and readable control through crowded play; camera/selection/production remain reliable on real devices. Preserve the user's removal of movement lines. |
    | Audio and feedback | Synthesized ambience/music/combat/weather and bounded voices | More distinctive, coherent unit/impact/ambient layers and clear attack/order feedback; assess audibility and fatigue over full matches. |
    | Multiplayer and release | Authoritative mixed human/AI rooms, ownership/fog privacy, reconnect, static/Node builds and local saves | Hosted capacity/latency/loss/restart tests, version compatibility, durable operations where required, installation/update recovery, accessibility and external playtesting. Public matchmaking/persistent rooms remain unfinished. |
    
    The gaps are broader than frame rate. [Blizzard's Reforged development update](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23411981/warcraft-iii-reforged-developer-update) addresses art, gameplay and systems across campaign/custom/versus modes. [AoE IV's formation and allied-healing changes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/) provide concrete genre examples. These are historical design references, not claims that our implementation matches them.
    
    Green tests prove their covered scenarios. They do not prove AAA parity, human enjoyment, complete balance or compatibility with every possible device. Keep the full goal active until its requirements have appropriate evidence.

    export const BATTLE_SIZES={spacious:{name:'Spacious',size:240,desc:'2.25Ã— standard area'},large:{name:'Large',size:320,desc:'4Ã— standard area'},huge:{name:'Huge',size:400,desc:'6.25Ã— standard area'}};

    export const VICTORY_RULES={annihilation:{name:'Destroy all buildings',desc:'A kingdom is eliminated when its last building falls, including walls and foundations. Its remaining army surrenders. Your alliance wins when every opposing kingdom is eliminated.'},capital:{name:'Capital conquest',desc:'Destroy every town center belonging to each opposing kingdom.     export function battlePreset(preset='2v2'){
      const n=preset==='4v4'||preset==='ffa8'?8:preset==='3v3'?6:4,split=preset==='1v3'?1:n/2;
      return Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({enabled:i<n,name:i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`,faction:['alder','sun','raven'][i%3],team:preset.startsWith('ffa')?i+1:i<split?1:2,difficulty:'normal'}));
    }
    export function normalizeBattle(options){
      const raw=Array.isArray(options.slots)?options.slots:battlePreset(),slots=raw.slice(0,8).map((slot,i)=>({...slot,slotNumber:slot.slotNumber||i+1})).filter((slot,i)=>i===0||slot.enabled!==false).map((slot,i)=>({
        name:String(slot.name||(i===0?'Your kingdom':`Kingdom ${i+1}`)).trim().slice(0,24)||`Kingdom ${i+1}`,
        faction:FACTIONS[slot.faction]?slot.faction:'alder',team:Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Math.floor(Number(slot.team)||i+1))),difficulty:DIFFICULTIES[slot.difficulty]?slot.difficulty:'normal',enabled:true,slotNumber:slot.slotNumber,color:PLAYER_COLORS[slot.slotNumber-1]??PLAYER_COLORS[i],controller:i===0||options.multiplayer&&slot.controller==='human'?'human':'ai',
      }));
      if(slots.length<2)throw new Error('Enable at least one opposing kingdom.');
      if(slots.every(slot=>slot.team===slots[0].team))throw new Error('Place at least one kingdom on a different team.');
      const mapSize=BATTLE_SIZES[options.mapSize]?options.mapSize:'huge';
      return {...options,mode:'custom',slots,mapSize,worldSize:BATTLE_SIZES[mapSize].size,faction:slots[0].faction,difficulty:'normal',victory:VICTORY_RULES[options.victory]?options.victory:'annihilation',aiPace:Object.hasOwn(AI_PACES,options.aiPace)?options.aiPace:'balanced',startAge:Math.max(options.map==='coast'?1:0,Math.min(3,Math.floor(Number(options.startAge)||0))),resourceLevel:options.resourceLevel==='rich'?'rich':'standard',populationLimit:[80,120,160].includes(Number(options.populationLimit))?Number(options.populationLimit):80,shareVision:options.shareVision!==false,revealRemnants:options.revealRemnants!==false,multiplayer:!!options.multiplayer};

    export function installCampaignView(WorldView){
      const p=WorldView.prototype,render=p.render;
      p.render=function(dt,menu=false){
        if(!this.campaignMarker){const group=new THREE.Group(),material=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xf2ce77,transparent:true,opacity:.8,depthWrite:false});
          const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(2.6,2.85,40),material);ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;ring.position.y=.25;group.add(ring);
          const pole=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.06,.06,5,6),material);pole.position.set(2.4,2.5,0);group.add(pole);
          const banner=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4,.8,.08),material);banner.position.set(3.05,4.45,0);group.add(banner);this.campaignMarker=group;this.scene.add(group);}
        const marker=this.sim&&campaignObjective(this.sim)?.marker;
        this.campaignMarker.visible=!!marker&&!menu&&this.sim.isExplored(marker.x,marker.z);
        if(marker)this.campaignMarker.position.set(marker.x,this.groundHeight(marker.x,marker.z),marker.z);
        render.call(this,dt,menu);
      };
    }
    ✓ • 509ms

## Assistant

The layout now fits seven emulated phone and tablet sizes, including 320-pixel portrait screens. The screenshots still show panels covering too much of the battlefield. I’m making objectives expandable and compacting the portrait camera controls, then checking actual gathering and production taps.

    import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {GLTFLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
    import {MeshoptDecoder} from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';
    import {artBuildPlan} from './build-plan.mjs';
    
    const project=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../',import.meta.url)),args=process.argv.slice(2);
    const plan=artBuildPlan(project,['--stage',...args]);
    const manifest=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const live=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(project,'src/assets3d/catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const expected=live.models.filter(model=>!plan.resources||model.key.startsWith('resource:')).map(model=>model.key).sort();
    assert.equal(manifest.stage,plan.stage);assert.equal(manifest.completeCatalogue,!plan.resources);
    assert.deepEqual(manifest.models.map(model=>model.key).sort(),expected);
    const reports=[];
    for(const detail of ['near','low']){

    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.

    }

    }
