    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads seven CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes, reusing only verified local files. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is 15,554,824 bytes (14.83 MiB); the lower detail GLB is 3,639,276 bytes (3.47 MiB). Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Twenty-one photographed surface maps total 15,684,309 bytes (14.96 MiB). The declared low-catalogue content budget is now 4 MiB to retain the added architecture and equipment; this is a download budget, not an FPS achievement.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - All seven biomes have stronger rolling relief, slope/altitude/shore/road transitions and grass/soil/rock blends at their documented physical scales. A small road mask keeps paths continuous on Low geometry. Solid seeded pebbles use one instanced draw, obey exploration and clear beneath foundations; the caps are 360 on High and 120 otherwise. These cosmetic stones do not change navigation.
    - Natural rock grain and normal/roughness detail replace masonry on ore deposits. Gold retains its separate metallic inclusions. Pebbles share the rock texture; building masonry stays separate.
    - Covered civic arcades, front steps, facade arches, gable windows and civilization-specific roof details strengthen building silhouettes. Painted-plaster color, normal and roughness maps join the grass, wood and masonry sets.
    - Adult figures include villager field packs and armored visors. Local unit positions interpolate between simulation ticks and turn smoothly without changing authoritative positions or saves. Multiplayer interpolation is bounded to its snapshot interval.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Reusable joint-prefix matrices avoid repeating torso/limb calculations within each rendered unit, with numerical coverage against the original poses. The cache stores joint definitions rather than unit history. Cargo samples the same interpolated positions and turns as figures, including bounded network snapshots.
    - Curved tapering trunks and branching bends support distinct oak, birch, elm and beech crown proportions. High includes sixteen smaller crown lobes with pointed closed leaf tips; the tips are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Winter forests have branched boughs and irregular snow patches. Bark grain and muted, varied canopy colors add surface detail. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.
    - Troops share instanced batches across team colors. Visible instance IDs are packed together so picking and selection still identify the correct unit. Fog and offscreen culling reduce submitted instances.
    - Buildings merge static surfaces into one opaque draw, with shared geometry for repeat structures. Flags, windmills, gates and harbor piers retain their independent transforms. Construction clipping preserves the textured material shader.
    - Batched roofs retain their shared tile texture and per-owner colors, including the lighter model catalogue. Roof normals use the actual mesh rather than a wall's normal map.
    - Water waves displace the actual mesh on the GPU with analytical slope normals and expanded culling bounds. They retain the earlier wave profile without uploading geometry or recalculating face normals each frame. `scripts/water-visual-qa.mjs` checks visible lighting changes, both presets, unchanged CPU geometry and disposal on scene changes.
    - Terrain banks meet water level at the naval channel boundary rather than dipping below the sea outside navigable water. View-angle-dependent sky tint replaces the conspicuous scrolling stripe map. This is a lightweight lighting approximation, not a full reflection of other scene objects.
    - Fine moving ripple normals add small highlights between the larger mesh waves, with lower intensity on Low. Water is treated as a dielectric surface rather than metal. Water-only pixel probes exclude ships, fish and foliage so their movement cannot pass the wave check.
    - Solid grass uses one instanced draw and clears building foundations. Fallen units and flying/settling rubble are cosmetic, bounded and excluded from collision, orders and saves.
    - The square radar, HUD and text remain interface overlays. The playable world and selectable objects use solid 3D meshes.
    - Artwork loading requires every manifest model and offers a retry on failure. Production pages check the current build and offer a saved solo refresh; an active human multiplayer match blocks refreshing until leaving the room. Existing pages from before this feature need one normal refresh first.
    
    Use `scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase -LowPreview` for the actual lighter catalogue in Blender when authoring and gameplay would otherwise compete for memory. It saves a separate `frontier-showcase-low.blend`; the detailed editable source and the High runtime catalogue remain available.
    
    `tests/authored-assets.test.js`, `tests/render-batches.test.js`, `tests/ground-cover.test.js`, `tests/battle-effects.test.js` and `tests/battle-remains.test.js` check catalogue coverage, outward leaf volumes, bounds, joints, tools, ownership, packing, foundations and effect limits. `scripts/authored-art-qa.mjs` reviews the live renderer, camera/selection preservation, biomes, naval models and emulated landscape-phone controls. `scripts/battle-visual-qa.mjs` captures close forests and checks live projectile arcs, pool reuse and scene-switch memory. Rendering targets and actual measured limitations are recorded separately in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).
    # Crafted battlefields (version 2.5)
    
    - Stronger rolling land across seven biomes, photographed grass/soil/rock blends, continuous soil roads and shore transitions. Bounded solid pebbles share one draw and respect fog and foundations.
    - Seven verified CC0 sets provide 21 bundled maps. Natural rock grain replaces masonry on stone/gold deposits and textures terrain pebbles; separate solid gold inclusions remain metallic.
    - Shared torso/limb pose prefixes retain the same animation with less repeated calculation. Cargo follows the figures' interpolated positions and turns. The full suite passes 156 checks; sustained frame-rate and physical-device validation remain open.
    
    - Covered civic arcades, facade arches, steps and gable details; villager field packs and armored visors; species-shaped oak/birch/elm/beech canopies. Both complete Blender catalogues were regenerated.
    - Local photographed plaster surfaces join wood, stone and grass, with verified CC0 credits. The lighter complete catalogue has a declared 4 MiB content budget.
    - Smooth rendering between fixed simulation ticks, bounded network interpolation and gradual heading changes preserve authoritative gameplay positions.
    - Required artwork retry, explicit graphics-start failure handling and saved production-update refresh. Live human rooms block refreshing mid-match. Loading status cannot erase a failed-download retry.
    - Optional lighter Blender showcase avoids opening the full authoring scene during gameplay checks. Deterministic network timer testing isolates perspective remapping from sacred-site resets; the full automated suite passes 152 checks.
    - Building batching preserves roof tile textures and team colors in both catalogues. The retry banner accepts mouse/touch input and stays available when background texture downloads finish.
    - Animated water now uses GPU mesh displacement and analytical slope normals, with expanded wave bounds. Live High/Low checks verify visible waves, zero per-frame geometry updates and scene cleanup without shader errors.
    - Terrain banks meet water level at the actual river/sea navigation boundary. Angle-dependent sky tint replaces the repetitive stripe map; the complete suite passes 153 checks with shoreline coverage.
    - Fine moving ripple highlights use lighter intensity on Low; water-only visual probes exclude other objects and verify both presets without shader errors.
    
    - Detailed closed leaf tips, muted canopy variation, bark grain and branched winter foliage with patchy snow. Extra broadleaf tip meshes are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue.

The network timer fixture isolates perspective remapping from normal sacred-site counter resets. Earlier performance results below must not be treated as measurements of the latest terrain.

    ### Earlier checks before the civic and figure redesign
    
    The laptop's earlier 12 FPS result is a constrained stress measurement, not the development target or a definition of acceptable graphics. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) keeps the full art, animation, gameplay, missions, controls, sound, multiplayer and device goals explicit. Desktop/gaming-laptop rendering targets 60 FPS and primary-touch devices target 30 FPS, with saved 30/60 choices independent of Low/Medium/High graphics. Deadline-based frame pacing avoids accidentally halving a 60 FPS target on fractional display ticks. Automatic quality uses the selected frame budget.

These cosmetic effects preserve authoritative damage/timing. Idle contact shadows reuse cached terrain poses.
    
    The live CPU profile identified ownership queries, joint animation and graphics buffer work among remaining costs. Unit/building queries now narrow candidates while preserving immediate death/ownership changes, spawning and snapshot restoration. Packed troop, forest, contact and cover matrices upload only their used prefix; unchanged troop ownership avoids repeated color uploads. The late fixture requests 103,424 bytes of troop matrices per frame instead of its 5,939,200-byte allocated capacity. This is upload-range evidence, not an FPS guarantee.

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {
        $taskDestination=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $taskArtifacts $taskName))
        if (-not $taskDestination.StartsWith($taskArtifacts+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Archive target is outside the project artifacts folder.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskDestination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination }
        $taskArchive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($taskDestination,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }
        } finally { $taskArchive.Dispose() }
        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
    $taskSourceFiles=@()
    foreach ($taskDirectory in @('src','server','scripts','tests','public')) {
        $taskSourceFiles+=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskProject $taskDirectory) -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -notin @('.pyc','.pyo') -and $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]__pycache__[\\/]' }
    }
    foreach ($taskFileName in @('package.json','package-lock.json','index.html','vite.config.js','netlify.toml','render.yaml','.gitignore','.nvmrc','README.md','ART_PIPELINE.md','DEPLOYMENT.md','RELEASE_CHECKS.md','ROADMAP.md','CHANGELOG.md','DEVELOPMENT_CHECKPOINT.md','QUALITY_TARGETS.md')) {
        $taskFilePath=Join-Path $taskProject $taskFileName
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskFilePath) { $taskSourceFiles+=Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskFilePath }
    }
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-source.zip" $taskProject $taskSourceFiles
    Write-GameArchive "crowns-of-the-frontier-$taskVersion-static.zip" $taskStatic (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskStatic -Recurse -File)

    const blockedControls='button,a,input,select,textarea,label,[role="button"],#minimap,.bottom-hud,#build-panel,#production-panel,.camera-controls,.objective-panel.interactive-objectives';
    const cursors=new Map();
    
    function edgeVector(x,y,width,height){
      if(x<0||y<0||x>=width||y>=height)return{x:0,y:0};
      const band=Math.min(24,width/4,height/4);
      const strength=distance=>{const t=1-distance/band;return t*t*(3-2*t);};
      let dx=x<band?-strength(x):x>width-band?strength(width-x):0;
      let dy=y<band?-strength(y):y>height-band?strength(height-y):0;
      const length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(length>1){dx/=length;dy/=length;}
      return{x:dx,y:dy};
    }
    function arrowCursor(x,y){
      const sx=Math.sign(x),sy=Math.sign(y),key=`${sx}:${sy}`;
      if(!cursors.has(key)){
        const angle=Math.atan2(sx,-sy)*180/Math.PI;
        const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><g transform="rotate(${angle} 16 16)"><path d="M16 2 6 14h6v14h8V14h6Z" fill="#f1d79b" stroke="#182d25" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="m16 6-5 6h4v12" fill="none" stroke="#fff5d9" stroke-width="1.4"/></g></svg>`;
        cursors.set(key,`url("data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}") 16 16, auto`);
      }
      return cursors.get(key);
    }
    
    export class EdgeScroll {
      constructor(){
        this.point=null;this.cursor='';
        const track=event=>{
          if(event.pointerType!=='mouse'){this.reset();return;}
          this.point={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY,buttons:event.buttons};
        };
        // Track the whole viewport so the header/footer do not swallow an edge.
        document.addEventListener('pointermove',track,{passive:true});
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown',track,{passive:true});
        document.addEventListener('pointerup',track,{passive:true});
        document.documentElement.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>this.reset());
        window.addEventListener('blur',()=>this.reset());window.addEventListener('resize',()=>this.reset());
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)this.reset();});
      }
      setCursor(value){
        if(this.cursor===value)return;this.cursor=value;
        if(value)document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--battlefield-cursor',value);
        else document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--battlefield-cursor');
      }
      reset(){this.point=null;this.setCursor('');}
      tick(view,dt,{active,enabled,speed=1}){
        if(!active||!enabled||!this.point||!document.hasFocus()||(this.point.buttons&4)){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        const {x,y}=edgeVector(this.point.x,this.point.y,innerWidth,innerHeight);
        if(!x&&!y){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        const element=document.elementFromPoint(this.point.x,this.point.y);
        if(!element||element.closest(blockedControls)){this.setCursor('');return false;}
        this.setCursor(arrowCursor(x,y));
        const distance=dt*view.zoom*.5*Math.max(.25,Math.min(2,Number(speed)||1));
        // pan() maps screen directions through the current camera rotation.
        view.pan(x*distance,y*distance);return true;
      }
    }

    - Stronger rolling land across seven biomes, photographed grass/soil/rock blends, continuous soil roads and shore transitions. Bounded solid pebbles share one draw and respect fog and foundations.
    - Seven verified CC0 sets provide 21 bundled maps. Natural rock grain replaces masonry on stone/gold deposits and textures terrain pebbles; separate solid gold inclusions remain metallic.
    - Shared torso/limb pose prefixes retain the same animation with less repeated calculation. Cargo follows the figures' interpolated positions and turns. The full suite passes 156 checks; sustained frame-rate and physical-device validation remain open.
    
    - Covered civic arcades, facade arches, steps and gable details; villager field packs and armored visors; species-shaped oak/birch/elm/beech canopies. Both complete Blender catalogues were regenerated.
    - Local photographed plaster surfaces join wood, stone and grass, with verified CC0 credits. The lighter complete catalogue has a declared 4 MiB content budget.
    - Smooth rendering between fixed simulation ticks, bounded network interpolation and gradual heading changes preserve authoritative gameplay positions.
    - Required artwork retry, explicit graphics-start failure handling and saved production-update refresh. Live human rooms block refreshing mid-match. Loading status cannot erase a failed-download retry.

    - Terrain banks meet water level at the actual river/sea navigation boundary. Angle-dependent sky tint replaces the repetitive stripe map; the complete suite passes 153 checks with shoreline coverage.
    - Fine moving ripple highlights use lighter intensity on Low; water-only visual probes exclude other objects and verify both presets without shader errors.

    """Original Blender art pass: solid foliage, roof tiles, bevels and baked shading.
    
    Run with the project Blender executable in background mode after export-source.
    The output retains the game's semantic materials, joints and moving subgroups.
    """

    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    stage = os.environ.get("FRONTIER_ART_STAGE", "")
    if stage not in {"", "full", "resources"}:
        raise ValueError("Invalid art staging mode")
    source = project / (".tools/art-candidate/resources/source/catalogue.glb" if stage == "resources" else ".tools/art-source/catalogue.glb")
    out = project / (f".tools/art-candidate/{stage}/raw" if stage else ".tools/art-refined")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=str(source))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    materials = {}
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial"):
            materials.setdefault(obj["assetMaterial"], obj.data.materials[0])
    if "leafDark" not in materials and "leaf" in materials:
        # A resource-only source has no forest mesh supplying this semantic surface.
        materials["leafDark"] = materials["leaf"].copy()
        materials["leafDark"].name = "leafDark"

    import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
    import {mkdir,stat,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
    import {setPriority,constants as osConstants} from 'node:os';
    import {artBuildPlan} from './build-plan.mjs';
    
    const project=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../',import.meta.url));
    const plan=artBuildPlan(project,process.argv.slice(2));
    const tools=path.join(project,'.tools');
    const blender=process.env.BLENDER_BIN||path.join(tools,'blender-4.5.14-windows-x64','blender.exe');
    const optimizer=process.env.GLTFPACK_BIN||path.join(tools,'gltfpack','gltfpack.exe');
    await stat(blender);await stat(optimizer);
    await mkdir(plan.outputDirectory,{recursive:true});await mkdir(plan.rawDirectory,{recursive:true});
    const env={...process.env,FRONTIER_ART_STAGE:plan.stage,BLENDER_USER_CONFIG:path.join(tools,'blender-profile','config'),BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS:path.join(tools,'blender-profile','scripts')};
    
    async function run(command,args,log){
      await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
        const output=log?fs.openSync(log,'w'):null;
        const child=spawn(command,args,{cwd:project,env,windowsHide:true,stdio:output===null?'inherit':['ignore',output,output]});
        if(plan.stage)try{setPriority(child.pid,osConstants.priority.PRIORITY_LOW);}catch{} // Never change the game or user's process priority.
        child.on('error',error=>{if(output!==null)fs.closeSync(output);reject(error);});
        child.on('exit',code=>{if(output!==null)fs.closeSync(output);code===0?resolve():reject(new Error(`${path.basename(command)} failed (${code}); inspect ${log||'the console'}.`));});
      });
    }
    console.log(plan.resources?'Exporting a separate resource preview.':'Exporting the complete source catalogue.');
    await run(process.execPath,['scripts/blender/export-source.mjs',...(plan.resources?['--resources-only']:[])]);
    console.log('Authoring and refining the game models in Blender.');
    await run(blender,['--background','--threads','1','--python-exit-code','1','--python','scripts/blender/refine-catalogue.py'],path.join(plan.rawDirectory,'art-refine.log'));
    for(const [name,ratio]of [['near','0.82'],['low','0.55']]){
      console.log(`Optimizing the ${name} catalogue.`);
      await run(optimizer,['-i',path.join(plan.rawDirectory,`frontier-${name}.glb`),'-o',path.join(plan.outputDirectory,`frontier-${name}.glb`),
        '-cc','-kn','-km','-ke','-kv','-vpf','-vtf','-si',ratio,'-r',path.join(plan.rawDirectory,`${name}-optimized.json`)]);
    }
    const source=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(plan.sourceDirectory,'catalogue.json'),'utf8'));
    const sizes={};for(const name of ['near','low'])sizes[name]=(await stat(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,`frontier-${name}.glb`))).size;
    await writeFile(path.join(plan.outputDirectory,'catalogue.json'),`${JSON.stringify({models:source,sizes,stage:plan.stage,completeCatalogue:!plan.resources,source:'Original Crowns of the Frontier assets authored/refined in Blender.'},null,2)}\n`);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({models:source.length,bytes:sizes,stage:plan.stage,completeCatalogue:!plan.resources,output:plan.outputDirectory}));

    """Compose a full editable catalogue without rebaking unrelated game artwork."""
    import bpy
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    base = project / ".tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend"
    patch = project / ".tools/art-candidate/resources/raw/frontier-assets.blend"
    out = project / ".tools/art-candidate/full/raw"
    validation = json.loads((project / ".tools/art-candidate/full/optimized/validation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert validation["passed"] and validation["models"] == 126
    expected = {f"resource:{kind}:{variant}" for kind in ("food", "gold", "stone") for variant in range(4)}
    
    def descendants(root):
        result = [root]
        for child in root.children:
            result.extend(descendants(child))
        return result
    
    bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(base))
    original = {obj["assetKey"]: obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")}
    assert len(original) == 126 and expected <= original.keys()
    unchanged = {key: [(obj.name, obj.type, obj.data.name if obj.data else None) for obj in descendants(root)]
                 for key, root in original.items() if key not in expected}
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(patch), link=False) as (source, target):
        target.objects = source.objects
    loaded = [obj for obj in target.objects if obj]
    replacement = {obj["assetKey"]: obj for obj in loaded if obj.get("assetKey") in expected}
    assert set(replacement) == expected
    retained = set()
    for key, root in replacement.items():
        assert root.get("model3d", {}).get("resourceRevision") == "field-resources-v1"
        old = original[key]
        assert max(abs(root.matrix_world[r][c] - old.matrix_world[r][c]) for r in range(4) for c in range(4)) < 1e-6
        for obj in reversed(descendants(old)):
            mesh = obj.data if obj.type == "MESH" else None
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
            if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
                bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)
        for obj in descendants(root):
            retained.add(obj)
            bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    for obj in loaded:
        if obj not in retained:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    roots = {obj["assetKey"]: obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")}
    assert set(roots) == set(original)
    for key, snapshot in unchanged.items():
        assert [(obj.name, obj.type, obj.data.name if obj.data else None) for obj in descendants(roots[key])] == snapshot
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(out / "frontier-assets.blend"), compress=True)
    report = {"passed": True, "models": len(roots), "replacedResources": len(expected),
              "unrelatedModelsPreserved": len(unchanged), "resourceRevision": "field-resources-v1"}
    (out / "editable-validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)

    import {CONTROL_ACTIONS,DEFAULT_BINDINGS,readBindings,bindingErrors,normalizeKey,keyLabel} from './controls.js';
    const escape=value=>String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    export function settingsBindings(root){return Object.fromEntries([...root.querySelectorAll('[data-keybind]')].map(input=>[input.dataset.keybind,input.dataset.key]));}
    export function appendKeyboardSettings(root,bindings){
      const panel=document.createElement('section');panel.className='keyboard-settings';
      panel.innerHTML=`<h3>Keyboard controls</h3><p>Choose a control, then press its new key. Escape cancels capture. Numbers 1â€“9 remain control groups. Arrow keys pan unless assigned to another control.</p><div class="keybind-grid">${CONTROL_ACTIONS.map(a=>`<label>${a.label}<input readonly data-keybind="${a.id}" data-key="${escape(bindings[a.id])}" value="${escape(keyLabel(bindings[a.id]))}" aria-label="${a.label} key" autocomplete="off"></label>`).join('')}</div><p class="binding-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">Your controls will be saved when you apply settings.</p><button type="button" class="secondary" data-controls-reset>Restore default controls</button>`;
      root.querySelector('[data-action="apply-settings"]').before(panel);
      const feedback=()=>{const errors=bindingErrors(settingsBindings(root));panel.querySelector('.binding-feedback').textContent=errors.length?errors.join(' '):'All controls have distinct keys. Apply settings to save.';panel.querySelector('.binding-feedback').classList.toggle('binding-error',!!errors.length);return !errors.length;};
      panel.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{const input=event.target.closest('[data-keybind]');if(!input)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(event.key==='Escape'){input.blur();return;}
        if(event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey){panel.querySelector('.binding-feedback').textContent='Choose a key without Ctrl, Alt, or Command.';return;}
        input.dataset.key=normalizeKey(event.key);input.value=keyLabel(input.dataset.key);feedback();
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-controls-reset]').addEventListener('click',()=>{for(const input of panel.querySelectorAll('[data-keybind]')){input.dataset.key=DEFAULT_BINDINGS[input.dataset.keybind];input.value=keyLabel(input.dataset.key);}feedback();});
      return panel;
    }
    export function activeControlsMarkup(bindings){return `<div class="active-controls">${CONTROL_ACTIONS.map(a=>`<span>${a.label}<kbd>${escape(keyLabel(readBindings(bindings)[a.id]))}</kbd></span>`).join('')}</div>`;}

    export const CONTROL_ACTIONS = [
      ['panUp','Pan forward','w'],['panDown','Pan backward','s'],['panLeft','Pan left','a'],['panRight','Pan right','d'],
      ['rotateLeft','Rotate left','q'],['rotateRight','Rotate right','e'],['production','Production overview','p'],
      ['inspect','Inspect model','i'],['camera-view','Camera angle','v'],['home','Center town','h'],['army','Select army','m'],
      ['build','Construction','b'],['attackmove','Attack move','f'],['patrol','Patrol','r'],['guard','Guard an ally','g'],
      ['stop','Stop / hold','x'],['idle','Idle villagers','.'],['focus','Focus selection','space'],['help','Help','?'],
    ].map(([id,label,key])=>({id,label,key}));
    export const DEFAULT_BINDINGS=Object.fromEntries(CONTROL_ACTIONS.map(a=>[a.id,a.key]));
    const RESERVED=new Set(['escape','tab','shift','control','alt','meta','capslock','unidentified','dead']);
    const NAMED=new Set(['space','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','home','end','pageup','pagedown','insert','delete','enter','backspace']);
    export function normalizeKey(key){return key===' '?'space':String(key||'').toLowerCase();}
    export function keyLabel(key){return key==='space'?'Space':key.startsWith('arrow')?key.slice(5)[0].toUpperCase()+key.slice(6)+' arrow':key.length===1?key.toUpperCase():key[0]?.toUpperCase()+key.slice(1);}
    export function bindingErrors(bindings){
      const errors=[],used=new Map();
      for(const a of CONTROL_ACTIONS){const key=normalizeKey(bindings[a.id]);
        if(!key||RESERVED.has(key)||/^[1-9]$/.test(key)||!(key.length===1||NAMED.has(key))){errors.push(`${a.label}: choose a single key. Escape, Tab, and 1â€“9 are reserved.`);continue;}
        if(used.has(key))errors.push(`${a.label} and ${used.get(key)} both use ${keyLabel(key)}.`);else used.set(key,a.label);
      }return errors;
    }
    export function readBindings(saved){
      if(!saved||typeof saved!=='object')return {...DEFAULT_BINDINGS};
      const bindings=Object.fromEntries(CONTROL_ACTIONS.map(a=>[a.id,normalizeKey(saved[a.id]??a.key)]));
      return bindingErrors(bindings).length?{...DEFAULT_BINDINGS}:bindings;
    }
    export function controlForKey(key,bindings){
      const normalized=normalizeKey(key),match=CONTROL_ACTIONS.find(a=>bindings[a.id]===normalized);
      if(match)return match.id;
      return {arrowup:'panUp',arrowdown:'panDown',arrowleft:'panLeft',arrowright:'panRight'}[normalized]||null;
    }
    export function heldControl(keys,id,bindings){return [...keys].some(key=>controlForKey(key,bindings)===id);}

    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 11 October 2026 against the version 2.5 source and current verification scripts.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    # Version 2.5 verification
    
    Checked 11 October 2026. This is a tested development build; the high-load performance and external playtesting requirements below remain release blockers.
    
    ## Latest quality work
    
    The latest source/build pass adds civic arcades and facade details, field gear, species-shaped crowns, local movement interpolation, art retry and saved update notices. It also adds stronger rolling land, grass/soil/rock transitions and continuous roads across seven biomes, bounded solid pebbles and natural resource textures. Both catalogues have all 126 models; current sizes are 15,554,824/3,639,276 bytes. Seven CC0 sets provide 21 surface JPEGs totaling 15,684,309 bytes. The low-catalogue download budget is explicitly 4 MiB. The complete suite passes **156 checks, zero failures**, including shore boundaries, all-biome normalized blends, seeded/fog-aware foundation clearing and exact shared animation poses. The network timer fixture isolates perspective remapping from normal sacred-site counter resets. Earlier performance results below must not be treated as measurements of the latest terrain.
    
    Live all-biome High/Low terrain checks pass without shader errors. Four scene replacements retain a stable 146-geometry/25-texture count and dispose each previous road mask. This was before the extra resource rock set. High/Medium/Low resource checks confirm natural rock color, tier-specific normal/roughness maps, solid gold inclusions and shared pebble textures, retaining all 126 models. Joint-prefix reuse keeps exact figure poses; cargo now follows the same local/network interpolation as figures.

    +# Fieldcraft and controls (version 2.6)
    +
    +- Blender-authored branching fruit canes with closed leaflets, settled weathered ore and metallic gold inclusions/seams replace twelve resource variants. Both complete 126-model catalogues retain unrelated compressed geometry. The full editable Blender source is updated and checked, with the previous source preserved.
    +- Staged resource/full authoring prevents partial catalogues from replacing the game. Validation checks coverage, finite geometry, closed outward leaves and Low detail exclusions; patch hashes prevent adding the same resource payload twice.
    +- Phone canvas sizing follows the actual CSS container through orientation changes. The resource header fits compact landscape screens, primary touch targets are at least 44 pixels, objectives expand on demand and portrait camera options leave more battlefield visible. Real touch movement and paid training pass seven emulated screen sizes.
    +- Shared interface styles improve menu, custom setup, settings, field-guide, technology and room controls. Dialogs expose their titles, return focus to the opener and close with Escape from ordinary fields. Tab navigates keyboard-binding fields without overwriting their bindings; Escape still cancels capture.
    +- Cargo uploads only its used matrix prefix. Static stumps reuse terrain poses and unchanged instance matrices; their cache is bounded and pruned after removal. Gameplay, fog and authoritative positions are preserved.
    +
    +The overall quality goal remains active. This milestone does not establish AAA parity, universal device compatibility, 60 FPS or complete release readiness.
    +
     # Crafted battlefields (version 2.5)

    +An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js.     @@ -28,2 +28,12 @@
     
    +### Staging changes safely
    +
    +`npm run art:build -- --stage` writes a separate full candidate. `npm run art:build -- --stage --resources-only` authors only fourteen resource models in `.tools/art-candidate/resources`; partial builds cannot target the game's live catalogue. Staged Blender jobs use one thread and run at low process priority.
    +
    +For the current field-resources pass, run `node scripts/blender/validate-candidate.mjs --resources-only`, then `node scripts/blender/compose-candidate.mjs` and `node scripts/blender/validate-candidate.mjs`. The composer replaces twelve food/gold/stone variants in both complete catalogues while preserving unrelated compressed bytes and joint metadata. It handles separate Meshopt fallback buffers and uses patch hashes to avoid appending identical resources twice. Unreferenced superseded bytes remain until a full rebake; the complete Low file still fits its declared budget.
    +
    +Run background Blender with `scripts/blender/compose-editable.py` to produce the corresponding complete editable source. It checks all 126 keys, unchanged transforms and 114 unrelated model hierarchies before saving `.tools/art-candidate/full/raw/frontier-assets.blend`. The verified file is now promoted to `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`; `frontier-assets-previous.blend` preserves the preceding source. The resource-only file remains separate and never replaces the full source.
    +
    +`scripts/resource-candidate-qa.mjs` checks both detail levels, actual resource gathering clicks and seven emulated screen sizes, including paid training and touch movement. `scripts/interface-qa.mjs` covers desktop, small landscape and portrait menus, setup, settings, field guide, technology and multiplayer entry, with keyboard focus and target-size checks. Their diagnostic reports are in `artifacts` and are not deployment assets.
    +
     ## In-game behavior and budgets

     - Natural rock grain and normal/roughness detail replace masonry on ore deposits. Gold retains its separate metallic inclusions. Pebbles share the rock texture; building masonry stays separate.

Uneven settled ore has rounded corners, small scattered stones and erosion; High adds solid seams aligned to the gold-bearing rock surfaces, while Low keeps solid metallic inclusions. Open foliage gaps have a visibility-aware picking fallback; actual foreground meshes retain priority.
     - Covered civic arcades, front steps, facade arches, gable windows and civilization-specific roof details strengthen building silhouettes. Painted-plaster color, normal and roughness maps join the grass, wood and masonry sets.

    const compactAmount=new Intl.NumberFormat('en',{notation:'compact',maximumSignificantDigits:3});
    
    // Keep large late-game balances readable in the fixed resource bar. The UI
    // retains the exact balance in its accessible name and tooltip.
    export function resourceAmount(value){
      const amount=Math.floor(value);
      if(!Number.isFinite(amount))return '—';
      return Math.abs(amount)>=10000?compactAmount.format(amount):String(amount);
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {resourceAmount} from '../src/ui-format.js';
    
    test('resource balances keep early economy exact and bound late-game display width',()=>{
      assert.equal(resourceAmount(550.95),'550');assert.equal(resourceAmount(9999),'9999');assert.equal(resourceAmount(10000),'10K');assert.equal(resourceAmount(1234567),'1.23M');assert.equal(resourceAmount(987654321),'988M');assert.equal(resourceAmount(1234567890123),'1.23T');
    });
    test('resource display does not conceal negative or invalid balances',()=>{
      assert.equal(resourceAmount(-12),'-12');assert.equal(resourceAmount(-10000),'-10K');for(const value of [NaN,Infinity,-Infinity])assert.equal(resourceAmount(value),'—');
    });

    Use **Render Free Web Service** for the simplest complete deployment: one URL serves the game and its real-person multiplayer rooms. The included [render.yaml](render.yaml) fills in the build, start, free plan, and health-check settings.
    
    1. Put this project in its own GitHub repository, with `package.json` and `render.yaml` at the root. Do not upload `node_modules`, test artifacts, or local `.env` files.
    2. Sign in to Render, select **New > Blueprint**, and connect that repository.
    3. Confirm that the service plan is **Free**, then deploy. Share the resulting HTTPS `onrender.com` address with players. No separate multiplayer URL or database is needed.

    Add: C:\New\Age_Of_Emprire\src\offline-registration.js
    export function registerOfflineGame(runtime=globalThis){
      if(!runtime.navigator?.serviceWorker)return false;
      const install=()=>runtime.navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(()=>null);
      // Artwork decoding may finish after load. In that case waiting for another
      // load event would leave this page permanently without an offline cache.
      if(runtime.document.readyState==='complete')install();
      else runtime.window.addEventListener('load',install,{once:true});
      return true;
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {registerOfflineGame} from '../src/offline-registration.js';
    
    function environment(ready){const calls=[],window=new EventTarget();return {calls,runtime:{window,document:{readyState:ready},navigator:{serviceWorker:{register:async path=>{calls.push(path);return {};}}}}};}
    test('offline registration still occurs when artwork decoding outlasts page load',()=>{
      const {calls,runtime}=environment('complete');assert.equal(registerOfflineGame(runtime),true);assert.deepEqual(calls,['/sw.js']);runtime.window.dispatchEvent(new Event('load'));assert.equal(calls.length,1);
    });
    test('offline registration waits for the first load event when the page is still loading',()=>{
      for(const ready of ['loading','interactive']){const {calls,runtime}=environment(ready);registerOfflineGame(runtime);assert.equal(calls.length,0);runtime.window.dispatchEvent(new Event('load'));runtime.window.dispatchEvent(new Event('load'));assert.deepEqual(calls,['/sw.js']);}
    });

    function paletteMaterial(view){
      if(!view.materials.unitPalette){
        const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.9});
        const wood={value:view.materials.wood.map||null},teams={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.teamMaterials[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())},roofs={value:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>view.roofMaterials?.[i]?.color||new THREE.Color())};material.frontierUniforms={wood,teams,roofs};
        material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
          shader.uniforms.frontierUnitWood=wood;
          shader.uniforms.frontierTeamColors=teams;shader.uniforms.frontierRoofColors=roofs;
          shader.vertexShader='attribute vec3 unitSurface;\nattribute float unitTeamMask;\n#ifdef USE_INSTANCING\nattribute float instanceOwner;\n#endif\nuniform vec3 frontierTeamColors[8];\nuniform vec3 frontierRoofColors[8];\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
          shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <color_vertex>',`#include <color_vertex>
            vUnitSurface = unitSurface; vUnitTeamColor = vec3(1.0);
            #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
            int owner = int(clamp(instanceOwner, 0.0, 7.0) + 0.5);
            if(unitTeamMask > 1.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierRoofColors[owner];
            else if(unitTeamMask > 0.5) vUnitTeamColor = frontierTeamColors[owner];
            #endif`);
          shader.fragmentShader='uniform sampler2D frontierUnitWood;\nvarying vec3 vUnitSurface;\nvarying vec3 vUnitTeamColor;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>','#include <color_fragment>\ndiffuseColor.rgb *= vUnitTeamColor;\nif(vUnitSurface.z > 0.5) diffuseColor.rgb *= texture2D(frontierUnitWood, vUv).rgb;');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>','#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\nroughnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.x, 0.04, 1.0);');
          shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>','#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\nmetalnessFactor = clamp(vUnitSurface.y, 0.0, 1.0);');
        };
        // A shared UV channel is needed for the optional wood sampling above.

        view.materials.unitPalette=material;

      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){uniforms.teams.value[i]=view.teamMaterials[i]?.color||uniforms.teams.value[i];uniforms.roofs.value[i]=view.roofMaterials?.[i]?.color||uniforms.roofs.value[i];}
      return view.materials.unitPalette;
    }

    test('unit poses pack visible IDs despite freed slots, fog and embarked troops',()=>{
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,1,.1,200);camera.position.set(0,30,40);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
      const batch={ids:[41,null,73,84],free:[1],renderIds:[],parts:[new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial(),10)]};
      batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds=batch.renderIds;
      batch.parts[0].geometry.setAttribute('instanceOwner',new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(10),1));
      const view={camera,unitBatches:new Map([['troops',batch]]),clock:1};
      beginUnitFrame(view);
      assert.ok(nearViewport(view,0,0,0));assert.equal(nearViewport(view,800,0,0),false);
      assert.ok(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:73,owner:7},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(2,0,0),true));
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),false),false);
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:84},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(800,0,0),true),false);
      endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds,[73]);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,1);
      assert.equal(batch.parts[0].geometry.attributes.instanceOwner.getX(0),7);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.parts[0].instanceMatrix.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:16}]);
      const owner=batch.parts[0].geometry.attributes.instanceOwner;assert.deepEqual(owner.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:1}]);const version=owner.version;
      const pose=new THREE.Matrix4();batch.parts[0].getMatrixAt(0,pose);assert.equal(pose.elements[12],2);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.ids,[41,null,73,84]);assert.equal(view.unitRenderDiagnostics.allocated,3);
      beginUnitFrame(view);writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:73,owner:7},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(3,0,0),true);endUnitFrame(view);assert.equal(owner.version,version,'unchanged ownership does not upload every frame');
      beginUnitFrame(view);endUnitFrame(view);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,0);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,false);
      beginUnitFrame(view);writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),true);endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,true);assert.deepEqual(batch.renderIds,[41]);
      assert.equal(owner.getX(0),0);assert.ok(owner.version>version,'repacking a different owner refreshes team color');
    });

    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Keep rendering poses outside the authoritative simulation/save data. The
    // fixed 10 Hz simulation can then move smoothly between ticks at any frame rate.
    export class LocalMotion{
      constructor(){this.previous=new Map();this.point={x:0,z:0};this.clear();}
      clear(){this.previous.clear();this.time=-1;this.sequence=0;}
      capture(sim){
        const sequence=++this.sequence;
        for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='unit'&&e.hp>0){
          let pose=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!pose){pose={};this.previous.set(e.id,pose);}
          pose.x=e.x;pose.z=e.z;pose.sequence=sequence;
        }
        for(const [id,pose]of this.previous)if(pose.sequence!==sequence)this.previous.delete(id);
      }
      commit(sim){this.time=sim.time;}
      sample(e,blend,time){
        const previous=this.previous.get(e.id);if(!previous||this.time!==time)return e;
        const limit=Math.max(2,(UNITS[e.type]?.speed||4)*.5),dx=e.x-previous.x,dz=e.z-previous.z;
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz>limit*limit)return e; // Spawn/unload/teleport should appear at its real destination.
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,blend));this.point.x=previous.x+dx*t;this.point.z=previous.z+dz*t;return this.point;
      }
    }
    
    export function smoothHeading(node,target,dt){
      if(!node.userData.headingReady){node.userData.headingReady=true;return target||0;}
      const previous=node.rotation.y,delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin((target||0)-previous),Math.cos((target||0)-previous));
      return previous+delta*(1-Math.exp(-Math.max(0,dt)*14));
    }
    
    // Figures, cargo and related visuals sample the same frame position. The
    // authoritative simulation coordinates remain untouched.
    export function renderPosition(view,entity){
      const point=view.renderPoint??={x:0,z:0};
      if(entity.snapshotAt===undefined){const local=entity.kind==='unit'?view.localMotion?.sample(entity,view.localBlend??1,view.sim.time)||entity:entity;point.x=local.x;point.z=local.z;}
      else{
        const now=view.renderFrameAt??performance.now(),t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(now-entity.snapshotAt)/200));
        point.x=entity.renderFromX===undefined?entity.x:entity.renderFromX+(entity.x-entity.renderFromX)*t;
        point.z=entity.renderFromZ===undefined?entity.z:entity.renderFromZ+(entity.z-entity.renderFromZ)*t;
      }
      return point;
    }

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {animatePart,beginJointPose,endJointPose} from './world-polish.js';
    
    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.
    // Picking uses the packed IDs, never the allocator's potentially empty slots.
    export function beginUnitFrame(view){
      view.jointPoseDiagnostics={computed:0,reused:0};
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){batch.renderIds.length=0;for(const part of batch.parts)part.userData.ownerChanged=false;}
    }
    
    export function markInstancePrefix(mesh,count=mesh.count){
      if(!count)return;
      const attribute=mesh.instanceMatrix;attribute.clearUpdateRanges();attribute.addUpdateRange(0,count*16);attribute.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      beginJointPose(view,e,matrix);
      try{for(const part of batch.parts){
        part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner'),value=e.owner||0;
        if(owner&&owner.getX(index)!==value){owner.setX(index,value);part.userData.ownerChanged=true;}
      }}finally{endJointPose(view);}
      return true;
    }
    
    export function endUnitFrame(view){
      let drawn=0,allocated=0,activeBatches=0,matrixUploadBytes=0,ownerUploadBytes=0,capacityMatrixBytes=0;
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){
        const count=batch.renderIds.length;drawn+=count;allocated+=batch.ids.length-batch.free.length;
        if(count)activeBatches++;
        for(const part of batch.parts){part.count=count;part.visible=count>0;markInstancePrefix(part,count);part.boundingSphere=null;matrixUploadBytes+=count*16*4;capacityMatrixBytes+=part.instanceMatrix.array.byteLength;const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner');if(owner&&part.userData.ownerChanged&&count){owner.clearUpdateRanges();owner.addUpdateRange(0,count);owner.needsUpdate=true;ownerUploadBytes+=count*4;}}
      }
      view.unitRenderDiagnostics={drawn,allocated,activeBatches,matrixUploadBytes,ownerUploadBytes,capacityMatrixBytes};
    }

    test('unit poses pack visible IDs despite freed slots, fog and embarked troops',()=>{
      const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,1,.1,200);camera.position.set(0,30,40);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
      const batch={ids:[41,null,73,84],free:[1],renderIds:[],parts:[new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial(),10)]};
      batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds=batch.renderIds;
      batch.parts[0].geometry.setAttribute('instanceOwner',new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(10),1));
      const view={camera,unitBatches:new Map([['troops',batch]]),clock:1};
      beginUnitFrame(view);
      assert.ok(nearViewport(view,0,0,0));assert.equal(nearViewport(view,800,0,0),false);
      assert.ok(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:73,owner:7},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(2,0,0),true));
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),false),false);
      assert.equal(writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:84},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(800,0,0),true),false);
      endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.parts[0].userData.unitIds,[73]);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,1);
      assert.equal(batch.parts[0].geometry.attributes.instanceOwner.getX(0),7);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.parts[0].instanceMatrix.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:16}]);
      const owner=batch.parts[0].geometry.attributes.instanceOwner;assert.deepEqual(owner.updateRanges,[{start:0,count:1}]);const version=owner.version;
      const pose=new THREE.Matrix4();batch.parts[0].getMatrixAt(0,pose);assert.equal(pose.elements[12],2);
      assert.deepEqual(batch.ids,[41,null,73,84]);assert.equal(view.unitRenderDiagnostics.allocated,3);
      beginUnitFrame(view);writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:73,owner:7},new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(3,0,0),true);endUnitFrame(view);assert.equal(owner.version,version,'unchanged ownership does not upload every frame');
      beginUnitFrame(view);endUnitFrame(view);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].count,0);assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,false);
      beginUnitFrame(view);writeUnitPose(view,batch,{id:41},new THREE.Matrix4(),true);endUnitFrame(view);
      assert.equal(batch.parts[0].visible,true);assert.deepEqual(batch.renderIds,[41]);
      assert.equal(owner.getX(0),0);assert.ok(owner.version>version,'repacking a different owner refreshes team color');
    });

    import test from 'node:test';

    import {Simulation,distance} from '../src/simulation.js';

    const advance=(sim,seconds)=>{for(let i=0;i<seconds*10;i++)sim.tick(.1);};
    
    test('trees and mineral deposits block construction and movement until harvested',()=>{
      for(const type of ['wood','gold','stone']){
        const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',seed:512});sim.entities=sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind!=='resource');sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));sim.revision++;sim.visible.fill(1);sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));
        sim.grid(0);const source=sim.addResource(type,0,20,6),worker=sim.addUnit('villager',0,0,15),scout=sim.addUnit('scout',0,-8,20);
        assert.equal(sim.buildValid('house',0,20),false);assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,sim.grid(0),scout,{x:8,z:20}),false);
        const route=sim.pathTo(scout,{x:8,z:20});assert.equal(scout.pathStatus,'ready');assert.ok(route.some(point=>Math.abs(point.z-20)>=1));
        const bank=sim.players[0].resources[type];sim.command([worker.id],{type:'gather',target:source.id});advance(sim,30);
        assert.equal(source.hp,0);assert.ok(sim.players[0].resources[type]>=bank+5.99);assert.equal(sim.buildValid('house',0,20),true);assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,sim.grid(0),scout,{x:8,z:20}),true);
      }
    });
    
    test('harbor placement respects shoreline trees and starting harbors have clear footprints',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast'});for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='resource')e.hp=0;sim.revision++;sim.visible.fill(1);assert.equal(sim.buildValid('dock',-20,-60),true);
      const tree=sim.addResource('wood',-20,-60,300);assert.equal(sim.buildValid('dock',-20,-60),false);tree.hp=0;sim.revision++;assert.equal(sim.buildValid('dock',-20,-60),true);
      for(const mode of ['tides','custom']){const coast=new Simulation({mode,map:'coast',slots:battlePreset('4v4'),seed:512});for(const dock of coast.entities.filter(e=>e.type==='dock'))assert.equal(coast.entities.some(e=>e.hp>0&&e.kind==='resource'&&!e.water&&['wood','gold','stone'].includes(e.type)&&distance(e,dock)<e.r+dock.r+.8),false);}
    });
    
    test('straight navigation cannot cut diagonal corners or cross a thin wall',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'}),grid=new Uint8Array(sim.gridSize**2),from={x:1,z:21},to={x:5,z:25},cell=sim.cell(3,21);
      assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,from,to),true);grid[cell.z*sim.gridSize+cell.x]=1;assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,from,to),false);
      grid.fill(0);const wall=sim.cell(1,35);grid[wall.z*sim.gridSize+wall.x]=1;assert.equal(clearSegment(sim,grid,{x:1,z:21},{x:1,z:49}),false);
    });
    
    test('stable long orders keep their route when unrelated terrain changes',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast'});sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const ship=sim.addUnit('transport',0,0,-60),original=sim.pathTo.bind(sim);let searches=0;sim.pathTo=(...args)=>{searches++;return original(...args);};
      sim.command([ship.id],{type:'move',x:0,z:60});advance(sim,12);assert.ok(ship.z>-40);assert.ok(searches<=2,`stable route searched ${searches} times`);
      const before=searches;sim.revision++;advance(sim,.2);assert.equal(searches,before);assert.equal(ship.pathStatus,'ready');
    });
    
    test('a new obstruction invalidates an existing route and separated shores remain unreachable',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox'});sim.entities=sim.entities.filter(e=>e.kind!=='resource');sim.index=new Map(sim.entities.map(e=>[e.id,e]));sim.revision++;sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const unit=sim.addUnit('scout',0,-15,20),original=sim.pathTo.bind(sim);let searches=0;sim.pathTo=(...args)=>{searches++;return original(...args);};
      sim.command([unit.id],{type:'move',x:15,z:20});advance(sim,.5);const before=searches,house=sim.addBuilding('house',0,0,20,true);advance(sim,.2);assert.ok(searches>before);assert.equal(unit.pathStatus,'ready');house.hp=0;sim.revision++;advance(sim,8);assert.ok(distance(unit,{x:15,z:20})<2);
      const coast=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast'}),infantry=coast.addUnit('spearman',0,-25,30);assert.deepEqual(coast.pathTo(infantry,{x:25,z:30}),[]);assert.equal(infantry.pathStatus,'blocked');
    });
    
    test('a fishing boat delivers the final catch when no fish shoals remain',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast'});for(const e of sim.entities)if(e.kind==='resource')e.hp=0;sim.stop(sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const boat=sim.owned(0,'unit','fishingboat')[0],fish=sim.addResource('food',boat.x,boat.z,6);fish.water=true;fish.r=2.1;
      const before=sim.players[0].resources.food;sim.command([boat.id],{type:'gather',target:fish.id});advance(sim,20);assert.equal(fish.hp,0);assert.ok(sim.players[0].resources.food>=before+5.99);assert.equal(boat.carry,0);
    });
    
    test('AI intelligence can locate publicly revealed final buildings without revealing hidden troops',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'custom',slots:battlePreset('2v2'),seed:512});for(const tc of sim.owned(2,'building','towncenter'))tc.hp=0;sim.revision++;sim.checkVictory();assert.ok(sim.revealedOwners.includes(2));
      const house=sim.owned(2,'building','house')[0];assert.equal(sim.canSee(0,house),true);const hidden=sim.addUnit('scout',2,190,-190);assert.equal(sim.canSee(0,hidden),false);
    });
    
    test('spatial targeting finds enemies across bucket boundaries and includes large buildings',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'custom',slots:battlePreset('2v2'),seed:512});const archer=sim.addUnit('archer',0,7.95,30),enemy=sim.addUnit('spearman',2,15.95,30),tower=sim.addBuilding('keep',2,23.95,30,true);enemy.stance='hold';sim.tick(.1);
      assert.equal(sim.nearest(archer,e=>e===enemy,10),enemy);assert.equal(sim.nearest(archer,e=>e===tower,14),tower);assert.equal(sim.nearest(archer,e=>e===tower,2),null);
      const originalHP=enemy.hp;advance(sim,5);assert.ok(enemy.hp<originalHP);assert.ok(distance(archer,enemy)<20);
    });
    
    test('an AI attack continues across a large map while its next raid clock resets',()=>{
      const sim=new Simulation({mode:'custom',slots:battlePreset('2v2'),seed:512}),owner=2,tc=sim.owned(owner,'building','towncenter')[0],enemy=sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter')[0];
      sim.aiStates[owner]={known:{[enemy.id]:{id:enemy.id,owner:0,kind:'building',type:'towncenter',x:enemy.x,z:enemy.z,lastSeen:0}},phase:'attack',scoutIndex:0,lastOrders:-20,lastRebalance:0,decision:0,nextAttack:500};
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++)sim.addUnit('spearman',owner,tc.x+i,tc.z+15);sim.time=200;sim.tickAI(owner);
      assert.equal(sim.aiStates[owner].phase,'attack');assert.ok(distance(sim.aiStates[owner].target,enemy)<1);assert.ok(sim.owned(owner,'unit','spearman').every(unit=>unit.order?.type==='attackmove'));
    });

    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import path from 'node:path';
    import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
    import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    
    // Extract only the preceding release's src/*.js into artifacts/perf-baseline.
    // Alternate runs in one process; neither simulation overlaps a browser job.
    const baseline=process.env.BASELINE_SIMULATION||'artifacts/perf-baseline/src/simulation.js';
    const {Simulation:Before}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(baseline)));
    const fixture=fs.readFileSync(process.env.PROFILE_SAVE||'artifacts/blender-custom-battle-save.json','utf8');
    const ticks=Number(process.env.PROFILE_TICKS)||200,rounds=Number(process.env.PROFILE_ROUNDS)||6;
    const samples={before:[],after:[]};
    function run(Type){
      const sim=Type.restore(JSON.parse(fixture)),times=[];let predicates=0;
      const nearest=sim.nearest;sim.nearest=function(e,predicate,...args){return nearest.call(this,e,t=>{predicates++;return predicate(t);},...args);};
      for(let i=0;i<ticks&&!sim.ended;i++){const at=performance.now();sim.tick(.1);times.push(performance.now()-at);}
      return {times,predicates,state:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(sim.serialize())).digest('hex'),ended:sim.ended,time:sim.time};
    }
    for(let warm=0;warm<2;warm++){run(Before);run(Simulation);}
    for(let round=0;round<rounds;round++){
      const order=round%2?[['after',Simulation],['before',Before]]:[['before',Before],['after',Simulation]];
      const result={};for(const [key,Type]of order){result[key]=run(Type);samples[key].push(result[key]);}
      assert.equal(result.after.state,result.before.state,'the optimization must preserve deterministic battle state');
    }
    const summarize=runs=>{const times=runs.flatMap(run=>run.times).sort((a,b)=>a-b),totals=runs.map(run=>run.times.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0));return {runs:runs.length,ticks:times.length,medianTickMilliseconds:times[Math.floor(times.length*.5)],p95TickMilliseconds:times[Math.floor(times.length*.95)],totalMillisecondsByRun:totals,predicateCallsPerRun:runs.map(run=>run.predicates),state:runs[0].state};};
    const result={cpuOnly:true,renderedFPS:false,fixture:process.env.PROFILE_SAVE||'artifacts/blender-custom-battle-save.json',baseline,alternatingOrder:true,deterministicStateMatches:true,before:summarize(samples.before),after:summarize(samples.after)};
    fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/simulation-comparison.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));

    # Full game quality targets
    
    The goal is a compelling original 3D RTS comparable in overall experience to established games. The current beta has not reached that goal. The development laptop is one constrained test case, not the definition of acceptable graphics or frame rate.
    
    ## Frame rate and supported profiles
    
    | Candidate profile | Rendering target | Evidence required |
    |---|---|---|
    | Gaming desktop/laptop | High, 1920 x 1080, 60 FPS | Sustained early, crowded and late battles on defined CPU/GPU/RAM hardware, with frame-time spikes and input latency recorded. |
    | Integrated-graphics laptop | Low/Medium, 1280 x 720 or adaptive resolution, 60 FPS target | Sustained economy/army play, scene changes, camera input and long-session memory results. Declare a lower supported tier if measured hardware cannot sustain the target. |
    | Landscape phone/tablet | Adaptive resolution/detail, 30 FPS sustained; optional 60 FPS | Real Android/iOS devices, sustained temperature/memory behavior, touch precision, pinch/rotate, browser recovery, saves and network play. |
    
    These are acceptance targets, not measured achievements. Graphics quality and frame-rate target are separate settings. Low graphics must not force every desktop to 30 FPS. High retains its richer original meshes/surfaces; automatic quality responds to the player's selected frame budget.
    
    Test the default Huge 400 x 400, eight-kingdom battle and configurable populations up to 160 per kingdom, alongside smaller matches. Include armies in view, sieges, walls, fog, weather and simultaneous production. Publish the exact supported hardware/browser matrix and achieved results. A weak-laptop headless benchmark cannot prove broad deployment performance.
    
    Established RTS games publish hardware tiers and use scalable graphics. [Age of Empires IV's minimum/recommended requirements](https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849398804-What-are-the-minimum-requirements-for-Age-of-Empires-IV) and [its min-spec design article](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/min-spec-pc-aoeiv/) are references for this approach, not performance evidence for our game.
    
    ## Gaps to close across the whole experience
    
    | Area | Current implemented baseline | Required progress and proof |
    |---|---|---|
    | Art and lighting | Original Blender catalogue, photographed surfaces, elevated 3D terrain, shadows, weather, solid resources and figures | Stronger species/architecture identity, natural materials and foliage, readable silhouettes, richer terrain composition and consistent lighting. Review normal RTS zoom and close inspection, with no visibly crude detail transitions. |
    | Animation and effects | Nested procedural joints, worker tools, cavalry/siege parts, projectiles, cargo and remains | Natural task/combat poses, believable contact/recovery, distinct ranged/melee actions, death transitions and readable siege impacts. Inspect real combat rather than rely only on geometry counts. |
    | Economy and strategic depth | Paid resources/buildings/queues/upgrades/ages, civilization rosters, counters, walls/gates and fleets | Improve recovery, expansion, economy choices and army tactics; human tests must demonstrate meaningful alternatives and fair challenge. |
    | AI and custom battles | Eight allied/enemy kingdoms, selectable difficulty/pace, real reinforcement groups, home reserves and team victory | Reliable formations, route recovery, scouting/retreat/counter choices, stronger coordinated pressure and interesting long wars. Verify full matches across seeds, biomes, starting ages and player configurations. |
    | Campaigns and maps | Six staged chapters, checkpoints, journals, escort/defense/naval objectives and seven seeded biomes | More distinctive authored locations, mission events, varied encounters and pacing, plus completion/failure testing and human reviews on every difficulty. |
    | Controls and interface | Desktop edge scrolling, square radar/locator, production overview, hotkeys, landscape touch | Responsive, precise and readable control through crowded play; camera/selection/production remain reliable on real devices. Preserve the user's removal of movement lines. |
    | Audio and feedback | Synthesized ambience/music/combat/weather and bounded voices | More distinctive, coherent unit/impact/ambient layers and clear attack/order feedback; assess audibility and fatigue over full matches. |
    | Multiplayer and release | Authoritative mixed human/AI rooms, ownership/fog privacy, reconnect, static/Node builds and local saves | Hosted capacity/latency/loss/restart tests, version compatibility, durable operations where required, installation/update recovery, accessibility and external playtesting. Public matchmaking/persistent rooms remain unfinished. |
    
    The gaps are broader than frame rate. [Blizzard's Reforged development update](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23411981/warcraft-iii-reforged-developer-update) addresses art, gameplay and systems across campaign/custom/versus modes. [AoE IV's formation and allied-healing changes](https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/) provide concrete genre examples. These are historical design references, not claims that our implementation matches them.
    
    Green tests prove their covered scenarios. They do not prove AAA parity, human enjoyment, complete balance or compatibility with every possible device. Keep the full goal active until its requirements have appropriate evidence.
    
    ## Interface and experience acceptance
    
    The user's 13 October instruction explicitly includes UI/UX design and style throughout the system. Review the landing screen, all mode and campaign menus, custom human/AI battle setup, room lobby, settings, field guide, technology tree, objectives, radar, selection, construction, production, save/update/retry flows and victory/defeat screens. Consistent colors, typography, focus states and spacing must accompany understandable actions and readable feedback.

    function Write-GameArchive($taskName,$taskBase,$taskFiles) {

        try {
            foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
                $taskFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($taskFile.FullName)
                if (-not $taskFull.StartsWith($taskBase+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'An archive input is outside its allowed folder.' }
                $taskRelative=$taskFull.Substring($taskBase.Length+1).Replace('\','/')
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($taskArchive,$taskFull,$taskRelative,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
            }

        Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskDestination | Select-Object Name,Length
    }
