        return `<section class="production-card ${first?'':'idle'}"><button class="production-site" data-production-select="${b.id}" aria-label="Select and locate ${esc(BUILDINGS[b.type].name)}"><span>${ICONS[b.type]}</span><strong>${BUILDINGS[b.type].name}</strong><small>${first?`${Math.ceil(first.remaining)}s`:'Idle'}</small></button><div class="production-current">${esc(name)}</div><div class="production-progress"><i style="width:${progress}%"></i></div>${b.queue.length?`<div class="production-items">${b.queue.map((q,index)=>{const label=q.kind==='age'?AGES[sim.players[0].age+1]:(UNITS[q.type]||TECHS[q.type]).name;return `<button data-cancel-queue="${index}" data-building="${b.id}" aria-label="Cancel ${esc(label)} and refund its cost" title="Cancel ${esc(label)} and refund">${ICONS[q.type]||'âœ§'}<small>${index+1}</small></button>`;}).join('')}</div>`:''}</section>`;
      }).join(''):'<p class="production-empty">Complete a town center, military building, or research building to manage production here.</p>'}</div><p class="production-note">Select buildings to train. Shift-click a troop to queue five. Tap a queued item to cancel and refund.</p>`;
      restorePosition();
    }
    function renderSelection(){if(!playing)return;selection=selection.filter(id=>sim.get(id));view.selection=new Set(selection);const list=selected(),panel=$('#selection-panel');updateSelectionLive(panel,list);const key=JSON.stringify([sim.players[0].age,sim.players[0].tech,sim.players[0].formation,sim.players[0].agePending,list.map(e=>[e.id,e.maxHp,e.progress>=1,e.owner,e.order?.type,e.pathStatus,e.orders?.length,e.passengers?.length,e.queue?.map(q=>[q.kind,q.type])])]);if(key===selectionKey)return;selectionKey=key;
      const restorePosition=preservePanelPosition(panel);try{
      if(!list.length){panel.innerHTML=`<div class="empty-selection"><span class="empty-crest">â™œ</span><div><span class="eyebrow">YOUR KINGDOM, YOUR COMMAND</span><h3>Select a unit or building</h3><p>${touchDevice?'Tap your units. Drag to pan. Pinch to zoom.':'Click to select Â· Drag to select a group Â· Right-click to command'}</p></div></div>`;return;}
      const buildingGroup=list.length>1&&list.every(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='building');
      const first=list[0],data=first.water?{name:'Fish shoal',desc:'Fishing boats harvest this shoal and return food to a harbor.'}:UNITS[first.type]?{...UNITS[first.type]}:BUILDINGS[first.type]||{name:first.type,desc:first.kind==='shrine'?'Military units capture this shrine in 18 seconds. It generates gold while controlled.':'Assign villagers to gather this resource.'};
      if(first.displayName)data.name=first.displayName;
      const icon=ICONS[first.type]||'âœ§';const hp=Math.round(first.hp),max=Math.round(first.maxHp);const mine=first.owner===0;
      panel.innerHTML=`<div class="selection-title"><button data-action="inspect" class="selection-portrait ${mine?'':'enemy'}" title="Inspect this 3D model"><span id="model-portrait" data-entity="${first.id}">${icon}</span></button><div><span class="eyebrow">${list.length>1?`${list.length} ${buildingGroup?'BUILDINGS':'UNITS'} SELECTED`:mine?FACTIONS[sim.players[0].faction].name:first.owner>=0?`${esc(sim.players[first.owner].name||FACTIONS[sim.players[first.owner].faction].name)} Â· ${sim.allied(0,first.owner)?'ALLY':'ENEMY'}`:'THE FRONTIER'}</span><h3>${list.length>1?(buildingGroup?'Production group':'Your company'):data.name}</h3><div class="health-track"><span style="width:${first.hp/first.maxHp*100}%"></span></div><small data-live-health>${first.kind==='resource'?`${Math.round(first.amount)} remaining`:first.kind==='shrine'?`Control: ${first.owner<0?'Neutral':first.owner===0?'Yours':'Enemy'}`:`${hp} / ${max} HP${first.kind==='building'&&first.progress<1?` Â· Building ${Math.floor(first.progress*100)}%`:''}`}</small></div></div>`;
      if(list.length>1){const counts={};for(const e of list)counts[e.type]=(counts[e.type]||0)+1;panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="unit-tokens">${Object.entries(counts).map(([t,n])=>`<button data-select-type="${t}">${ICONS[t]} <span>${n}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>${buildingGroup?groupProduction(list):''}<p class="selection-desc">${buildingGroup?'Training goes to the shortest available queue. Select one building for research.':touchDevice?'Tap the battlefield to move; tap enemies to attack.':'Right-click to move or attack. Open Help for your attack-move key.'}</p>${list.every(e=>e.owner===0&&e.kind==='unit'&&e.type!=='villager')?tactics():''}${orderSummary(list)}`;refreshShortcutLabels();return;}
      if(first.kind==='building'&&mine&&first.progress>=1){
        const p=sim.players[0],train=Object.entries(UNITS).filter(([t,d])=>availableTo(d,p.faction)&&d.at.includes(first.type));
        const techs=Object.entries(TECHS).filter(([t,d])=>availableTo(d,p.faction)&&d.at.includes(first.type)&&p.tech[t]<d.max);
        panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="production-actions">${train.map(([t,d])=>`<button data-train="${t}" data-building="${first.id}" title="${esc(d.desc)} Â· ${costText(d.cost)}" ${p.age<d.age?'disabled':''}><span>${ICONS[t]}</span><strong>${d.name}</strong><small>${p.age<d.age?AGES[d.age]:costText(d.cost)}</small></button>`).join('')}${first.type==='towncenter'&&p.age<3?`<button class="age-up" data-research="age" data-building="${first.id}" ${p.agePending?'disabled':''}><span>âœ§</span><strong>${p.agePending?'Advancingâ€¦':AGES[p.age+1]}</strong><small>${costText(AGE_COSTS[p.age])}</small></button>`:''}${techs.map(([t,d])=>`<button data-research="${t}" data-building="${first.id}" title="${esc(d.desc)}" ${p.age<d.age||p.tech[t]>=Math.min(d.max,p.age+1)?'disabled':''}><span>${ICONS[t]||'âœ§'}</span><strong>${d.name} ${p.tech[t]+1}</strong><small>${costText(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.cost).map(([r,n])=>[r,n*(p.tech[t]+1)])))}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
        if(first.queue.length)panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="training-queue">${first.queue.map((q,i)=>`<button data-cancel-queue="${i}" data-building="${first.id}" title="Cancel and refund"><span>${ICONS[q.type]||'âœ§'}</span><small>${i===0?Math.ceil(q.remaining)+'s':i+1}</small><i style="width:${i===0?(1-q.remaining/q.total)*100:0}%"></i></button>`).join('')}<span>QUEUE Â· click to cancel</span></div>`;
        if(first.type==='market')panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="trade-actions">${['food','wood','stone'].map(r=>`<span>${ICONS[r]} <button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="true">Buy ${sim.players[0].tech.caravanLedger?110:100} Â· 130â—†</button><button data-trade="${r}" data-buy="false">Sell 100 Â· ${sim.players[0].tech.caravanLedger?90:70}â—†</button></span>`).join('')}</div>`;
      }else if(first.type==='villager'&&mine){panel.innerHTML+=`<div class="worker-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="build" title="Choose a building to construct">âŒ‚ Build</button><button class="secondary" data-action="auto-work" title="Assign nearby resource gathering">â™£ Auto gather</button></div><p class="selection-desc"><span data-live-carry>${first.carry?`Carrying ${Math.floor(first.carry)} ${first.carryType}. `:''}</span>${touchDevice?'Tap resources to gather, buildings to construct or repair.':'Right-click resources to gather, buildings to construct or repair.'}</p>`;}
      else panel.innerHTML+=`<p class="selection-desc">${data.desc||''}</p>${mine&&first.kind==='unit'?attributes(first)+tactics():''}${mine&&first.type==='transport'?`<div class="worker-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="unload">âš“ Unload ${first.passengers?.length||0} passengers</button></div>`:''}`;
      panel.innerHTML+=orderSummary(list);refreshShortcutLabels();
      if(mine&&first.kind==='building'&&(first.type!=='towncenter'||sim.owned(0,'building','towncenter').length>1))panel.innerHTML+=`<button class="demolish" data-demolish="${first.id}">${first.progress<1?'Cancel construction (70% refund)':'Demolish (20% refund)'}</button>`;
      }finally{updateSelectionLive(panel,list);restorePosition();}
    }
    function renderHUD(){if(!playing)return;const p=sim.players[0];$('#resource-bar').innerHTML=['food','wood','gold','stone'].map(r=>`<div class="resource" role="group" aria-label="${r}: ${Math.floor(p.resources[r])}" title="${r}: ${Math.floor(p.resources[r])}"><span class="resource-icon ${r}">${ICONS[r]}</span><strong>${resourceAmount(p.resources[r])}</strong><small>${r==='wood'?'TIMBER':r.toUpperCase()}</small></div>`).join('')+`<div class="resource population ${sim.population(0)>=sim.capacity(0)?'full-pop':''}"><span class="resource-icon">â™Ÿ</span><strong>${sim.population(0)}<i>/${sim.capacity(0)}</i></strong><small>POPULATION</small></div>`;

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {WorldView} from '../src/world.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {BUILDINGS,UNITS,MAPS} from '../src/data.js';
    import {Landscape} from '../src/landscape.js';
    import {buildingModel,unitModel,resourceModel,treeModel} from '../src/models-3d.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    import {cargoGeometry,WorldInteractions} from '../src/world-interactions.js';
    import {forestTransform} from '../src/realm-3d.js';
    import {LocalMotion} from '../src/motion-smoothing.js';
    
    function viewFixture(faction='alder'){
      const v=Object.create(WorldView.prototype);
      v.geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),sphere:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,10),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7)};
      const keys=['stone','stoneDark','plaster','wood','darkwood','gold','iron','leaf','leafDark','trunk','skin','soil','furrow','water','glass','timberEdge'];
      v.materials=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8d9580})]));v.materials.shadow=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial();
      v.teamMaterials=[0x397f8c,0x9a687d].map(color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color}));v.roofMaterials=v.teamMaterials.map(m=>m.clone());
      v.sim=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',map:'coast',faction,seed:512});return v;
    }
    function solidBounds(group){
      const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group,true),size=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());assert.ok(Number.isFinite(size.length()));assert.ok(size.x>.05&&size.y>.05&&size.z>.05,'model has width, height and depth');
      group.traverse(mesh=>{if(!mesh.isMesh)return;for(const value of mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array)assert.ok(Number.isFinite(value),'all vertices are finite');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal'),'model has surface normals');assert.ok(mesh.geometry.getAttribute('uv'),'model supports textured surfaces');});return bounds;
    }
    
    test('all maps have seeded elevated meshes and picking follows their triangulated surface',()=>{
      for(const map of Object.keys(MAPS)){
        const a=new Landscape(512,map),b=new Landscape(512,map),geometry=a.geometry(320,112),copy=b.geometry(320,112);
        assert.deepEqual(geometry.getAttribute('position').array,copy.getAttribute('position').array);
        assert.ok(geometry.boundingBox.max.y-geometry.boundingBox.min.y>10);
        for(const [x,z]of [[-37,30],[27,19],[-10,-22],[0,0],[52,43]]){
          const hit=a.rayPoint(new THREE.Ray(new THREE.Vector3(x,80,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)));
          assert.ok(hit);assert.ok(Math.abs(hit.y-a.surfaceHeightAt(x,z))<.002);
        }
        geometry.dispose();copy.dispose();
      }
    });
    test('naval basins sit below the water while bridge routes keep dry elevation',()=>{
      const coast=new Landscape(512,'coast');for(const z of [-65,-30,30,65])assert.ok(coast.heightAt(Math.sin(z*.03)*2,z)<0);
      for(const map of ['valley','rivers']){const land=new Landscape(512,map);for(const channel of land.channels()){assert.ok(land.heightAt(channel.center,0)>.5);const z=30,x=channel.center+Math.sin(z*channel.frequency)*channel.bend;assert.ok(land.heightAt(x,z)<0);}}
    });
    test('every building and troop has a solid model across all three civilizations',()=>{
      for(const faction of ['alder','sun','raven']){
        const v=viewFixture(faction);

        await page.goto(base,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);
        const click=locator=>mobile?locator.tap():locator.click();

          if(action==='settings'){const binding=page.locator('[data-keybind]').first(),key=await binding.getAttribute('data-key');await binding.focus();await page.keyboard.press('Tab');assert.equal(await binding.getAttribute('data-key'),key);assert.ok(await binding.evaluate(e=>document.activeElement!==e));await binding.focus();await page.keyboard.press('Escape');assert.equal(await page.locator('[role=dialog]').count(),1);await page.locator('#volume').focus();await page.keyboard.press('Escape');assert.equal(await page.locator('[role=dialog]').count(),0);assert.ok(await opener.evaluate(e=>document.activeElement===e));await click(opener);}
          await page.locator('.modal').evaluate(e=>e.scrollTop=0);await page.screenshot({path:`artifacts/interface-${name}-${action}.png`});await click(page.locator('.modal-close'));assert.ok(await opener.evaluate(e=>document.activeElement===e));
        }
        await page.evaluate(()=>{frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',seed:512});frontier.action('help');});if(mobile&&width<height&&await page.locator('[data-action=dismiss-rotate]').isVisible())await page.locator('[data-action=dismiss-rotate]').tap();await page.keyboard.press('Escape');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>frontier.paused),false);
        await page.evaluate(()=>{frontier.sim.stop(frontier.sim.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));Object.assign(frontier.sim.players[0].resources,{food:987654321,wood:123456789,gold:456789123,stone:765432198});});await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#resource-bar strong').textContent.includes('M'));await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);
        const balances=await page.evaluate(()=>{const bar=document.querySelector('#resource-bar'),food=bar.querySelector('.resource');return {inner:innerWidth,client:document.documentElement.clientWidth,scroll:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,barWidth:bar.clientWidth,barScroll:bar.scrollWidth,label:food.getAttribute('aria-label'),title:food.title,display:food.querySelector('strong').textContent};});report.screens.push({profile:name,lateEconomy:balances});
        assert.ok(balances.scroll===balances.client&&balances.barScroll<=balances.barWidth&&balances.label.includes('987654321')&&balances.title.includes('987654321'),'late economy balances fit and preserve exact accessible values');
        await page.screenshot({path:`artifacts/interface-${name}-late-economy.png`});
        await page.close();
      }
      assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);report.passed=true;console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,screens:report.screens.length,errors:report.errors}));
    }catch(error){report.failure=error.message;console.log(JSON.stringify(report));throw error;}
    finally{fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/interface-qa.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));await browser.close();}

    export {attachRooms} from './team-rooms.js';
    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    import {battlePreset} from '../src/custom-battle.js';
    const slots=battlePreset('4v4');for(const slot of slots)slot.difficulty='hard';
    const sim=process.env.BENCH_RESUME?Simulation.restore(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.BENCH_RESUME,'utf8'))):new Simulation({mode:'custom',map:process.env.BENCH_MAP||'highlands',mapSize:'huge',seed:512,slots,resourceLevel:'standard',populationLimit:80});
    // An AI controls the human slot only in this offline diagnostic, making it possible
    // to observe a complete economy-to-siege match without synthetic damage or income.
    sim.players[0].controller='ai';const seconds=Number(process.env.BENCH_SECONDS)||1200,samples=[],start=performance.now(),blocked={};let lastReport=0;
    const support=[];sim.on(event=>{if(event.type==='order-blocked')blocked[event.entity.owner]=(blocked[event.entity.owner]||0)+1;if(event.type==='ally-support')support.push({time:sim.time,owner:event.owner,ally:event.ally,count:event.count});});
    const summary=()=>sim.players.map((p,owner)=>({owner,age:p.age,defeated:p.defeated,units:sim.population(owner),buildings:sim.owned(owner,'building').length,resources:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p.resources).map(([key,value])=>[key,Math.round(value)])),phase:sim.aiStates[owner]?.phase,stats:p.battleStats}));
    while(sim.time<seconds&&!sim.ended){const before=performance.now();sim.tick(.1);samples.push(performance.now()-before);if(sim.time-lastReport>=60){lastReport=sim.time;console.log(JSON.stringify({time:Math.round(sim.time),elapsed:Math.round((performance.now()-start)/1000),ages:sim.players.map(p=>p.age),units:sim.players.map((p,i)=>sim.population(i)),dead:sim.players.filter(p=>p.defeated).length}));if(process.env.BENCH_SAVE)fs.writeFileSync(process.env.BENCH_SAVE,JSON.stringify(sim.serialize()));}}
    samples.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const at=percent=>samples[Math.min(samples.length-1,Math.floor(samples.length*percent))];
    const result={seed:512,map:sim.options.map,aiPace:sim.options.aiPace,simulatedSeconds:sim.time,ended:sim.ended,elapsedSeconds:(performance.now()-start)/1000,tickMilliseconds:{median:at(.5),p95:at(.95),p99:at(.99),max:samples.at(-1)},firstOffensives:sim.players.map((p,owner)=>({owner,land:sim.aiStates[owner]?.firstAttackAt,naval:sim.aiStates[owner]?.navalFirstAttackAt})),support,blocked,kingdoms:summary()};
    fs.mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(`artifacts/battle-benchmark-${sim.options.map}.json`,JSON.stringify(result,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
    # Crowns of the Frontier: quality roadmap
    
    Reviewed 13 October 2026 against the version 2.6 source and current verification scripts. The user's quality goal explicitly includes design, style and UI/UX throughout the system.
    
    This is an ordered development proposal, not a claim that its milestones have been implemented. The current game is a playable beta. A world-class assessment needs independent player feedback, reliable performance, strong content, and sustained quality across complete matches.
    
    ## Current baseline
    
    - Three.js world with elevated terrain, solid building/unit/resource models, articulated parts, animated water, and 3D selection portraits.
    - Resource gathering, construction, queues, upgrades, ages, unit counters, siege, healing, walls, gates, fleets, transports, fog, saves, and several victory conditions.
    - Nine modes, seven seeded maps, six campaign chapters, three civilizations, 19 building types, and 16 trainable types across the catalog plus sovereigns.
    - Two-to-eight-kingdom custom battles, AI allies/enemies with individual difficulties, human slots, huge maps and three elimination rules.
    - Classic two-player and custom mixed human/AI Wi-Fi rooms with authoritative commands, team perspectives, readiness and reconnection. Rooms are held in server memory; they are not a public matchmaking service.
    - Seeded volumetric weather, pooled effects, optional audio/lightning and quality budgets.
    - Rooted and wind-animated trees, winter snowcaps, harvested tree falls/stumps, batched carried supplies, ore depletion, and age-specific town-center architecture. Huge-map fog and grass cover the full playable area.
    - Free Render deployment configuration for one game/multiplayer service, plus optional Netlify static hosting and a separate secure multiplayer endpoint. Hosting variants have local browser coverage; no public deployment is active.
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.

    - Fruit picking fills open foliage gaps only after real meshes miss, respects visibility and preserves foreground picking. A center ray hitting an adjacent visible berry branch is legitimate; actual gathering orders are tested.
    - Cargo uploads only used matrices. Static stumps cache terrain poses and avoid unchanged matrix uploads; caches are bounded/pruned and packing follows visibility. Existing interpolation, felling, depletion, ownership and saves are preserved.
    - Offline registration now handles artwork decoding finishing after the page load event. A traced fresh page previously had a completed document but zero registrations. Registration runs immediately after load or once on the future event; both timings have regression coverage.

    # Crowns of the Frontier
    
    An original 3D browser RTS built with Three.js. Version 2.6, **Fieldcraft and controls**, integrates 126 original Blender models, branched fruit plants, weathered ore deposits, seven photographed CC0 surface sets, natural terrain transitions, solid ground cover and bounded battlefield remains. Custom battles support up to eight kingdoms, configurable human/AI slots, allies and enemies, individual difficulties, large maps, team multiplayer and changing 3D weather. Staged campaigns, checkpoints, naval warfare, civilization-exclusive troops and upgrades, a technology tree and laptop/phone controls remain available. Compact phone objectives, expandable portrait camera options, larger touch controls and consistent menu typography improve the interface. This remains a development beta; verification and open release requirements are recorded in [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).
    
    ## Play
    
    For a free online address with one service hosting the game and multiplayer, use the included Render deployment file. See [the short deployment guide](DEPLOYMENT.md). Netlify static hosting is also configured; it needs a separate running server for real-person multiplayer.
    
    ```powershell
    npm install
    npm run build
    npm start
    ```
    
    Open **http://localhost:4173** on the laptop. On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, open **http://YOUR_LAPTOP_WIFI_IP:4173**. Landscape is recommended. The laptop must keep the game server running. If the phone cannot reach it, check that the local network permits connections to port 4173.
    
    For development, `npm run dev` serves on port 5173. Use `npm start` for Wi-Fi multiplayer; the static Vite preview server does not host rooms.
    
    ### Play with a friend
    
    Both players open the same laptop's game URL. Choose **Play with friends**, enter a commander name, then create or join a room. Share the six-character room code with the second player. The host starts once both players join. Conquest, regicide, shrine control, wonder race, and naval conquest are supported.
    
    The server runs the simulation and checks command ownership. Each player sees their own economy and fog of war. Classic two-player rooms receive mirrored starting towns and armies. If a connection drops, the match pauses for a reconnect grace period of two minutes. Refreshing the page preserves a room credential in session storage; choose **Rejoin your previous network session**. The menu does not pause an otherwise connected network match. Leaving a started match concedes that kingdom. Restarting the laptop server ends its in-memory rooms.
    
    ### Custom battles with AI or real people
    
    Choose **Custom battle**. Enable two to eight kingdoms, set their civilizations and team numbers, and choose a difficulty for each AI. Matching team numbers are allies. Presets include 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, 1v3, and four/eight-way free-for-all. Without other people, all remaining enabled kingdoms are AI, including your allies.
    
    - Mouse edge scrolling, corner scrolling, cursor arrows, keyboard controls, camera inspection, and landscape touch input.
    - Square radar with a rectangular camera locator and mouse/touch dragging. Global production overview, selection across completed production buildings, balanced training batches, and cancel/refund controls.
    - Existing automated simulation/graphics/network checks and browser verification. Physical-device performance, balance, and extensive human playtesting remain unverified.
    
    ## Version 2.5 art, AI and performance progress
    
    - Integrated 126 original Blender models, near/low catalogues, photographed CC0 surfaces, adult figures with nested joints, task-specific worker tools, solid grass and bounded battlefield remains. The art pipeline and creator/source credits are documented.
    - Packed visible troops into shared team-colored batches with correct picking, merged static building surfaces and shared repeat geometry, while keeping flags, gates, mill rotors, harbor piers and construction effects. The updated live settlement fixture uses 218 draws, compared with 483 before batching. Used instance prefixes reduce recurring matrix uploads, and unchanged ownership avoids color uploads.
    - Added Balanced/Grand war/Aggressive custom pacing, paid army/economy buildup before major balanced attacks, allied land/naval support, home reserves and recall. Saved assignments and multiplayer notice privacy have regression coverage.
    - Spatial queries, resource drop-offs, fog circles and custom victory scans reduce CPU work. A full eight-Hard-AI Balanced highlands battle reached normal all-building victory after approximately 20 simulated minutes, with every kingdom reaching Imperial Age.
    - The full automated suite passes 156 checks, including shorelines, all-biome surface transitions and exact shared joint poses. Production checks cover the Blender roster, landscape touch, pooled effects, download retry, current artwork revisions, saved updates and real-room refresh guards. Civic arcades, field gear, species-shaped forests, photographed plaster, rolling terrain, natural roads/shore blends and textured resources improve the visible world. Seven CC0 sets provide 21 local maps. GPU water removes per-frame geometry uploads; joint-prefix reuse avoids repeated animation work, and cargo follows interpolated figures. Sustained device performance and independent player assessment remain open.
    - Performance remains open: short headless crowded-battle results vary and still miss the declared 60 FPS desktop target on this 4 GB Intel UHD laptop. It is a constrained diagnostic device, not the standard for all users. [QUALITY_TARGETS.md](QUALITY_TARGETS.md) preserves full art/gameplay/device acceptance targets; [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md) records actual measurements. Formation recovery reduced one saved replay's blocked orders from 23 to 1, but broad routing, sustained device performance and human playtests remain unfinished.

    // Simulation-only scratch storage. Reuse numeric cells and their arrays while
    // retaining entity order within each cell. Reset releases every entity reference.
    export class SpatialBuckets{
      constructor(cellSize){this.cellSize=cellSize;this.columns=new Map();this.active=[];}
      reset(){for(const bucket of this.active){bucket.length=0;if(bucket.combat)bucket.combat.length=0;}this.active.length=0;}
      add(entity,combat=false){
        const x=Math.floor(entity.x/this.cellSize),z=Math.floor(entity.z/this.cellSize);
        let column=this.columns.get(x);if(!column){column=new Map();this.columns.set(x,column);}
        let bucket=column.get(z);if(!bucket){bucket=[];column.set(z,bucket);}
        if(!bucket.length)this.active.push(bucket);bucket.push(entity);if(combat)(bucket.combat??=[]).push(entity);
      }
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {SpatialBuckets} from '../src/spatial-buckets.js';
    import {Simulation} from '../src/simulation.js';
    
    test('reused spatial cells retain insertion order, negative coordinates and release old entities',()=>{
      const index=new SpatialBuckets(4),a={id:1,x:-.01,z:3.99},b={id:2,x:-2,z:2},c={id:3,x:4,z:4};index.add(a,true);index.add(b);index.add(c,true);
      const cell=index.columns.get(-1).get(0);assert.deepEqual([...cell],[a,b]);assert.deepEqual(cell.combat,[a]);assert.equal(index.active.length,2);assert.equal(index.columns.get(1).get(1)[0],c);
      index.reset();assert.equal(cell.length,0);assert.equal(cell.combat.length,0);assert.equal(index.active.length,0);
      b.x=-3;index.add(b,true);assert.equal(index.columns.get(-1).get(0),cell,'array is reused');assert.deepEqual([...cell],[b]);assert.deepEqual(cell.combat,[b]);assert.equal(index.columns.get(1).get(1).length,0,'previous occupants do not remain candidates');
      index.reset();assert.equal(cell.length,0);assert.equal(cell.combat.length,0);
    });
    
    test('tick indexes follow moved, embarked, dead and restored troops without entering saves',()=>{
      const s=new Simulation({mode:'sandbox',seed:512});s.stop(s.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const e=s.addUnit('spearman',0,-20,30);e.stance='hold';s.tick(.1);
      const prior=s.unitBuckets.get(-5).get(7),storage=s.unitSpatial;assert.ok(prior.includes(e));
      e.x=40;e.z=-40;s.tick(.1);assert.equal(s.unitSpatial,storage);assert.ok(!prior.includes(e));assert.ok(s.unitBuckets.get(10).get(-10).includes(e));
      e.embarked=true;e.transport=null;s.tick(.1);assert.ok(!s.unitBuckets.get(10).get(-10).includes(e));assert.equal(s.get(e.id),null,'missing transport still applies the existing passenger-death rule');
      const save=s.serialize();for(const key of ['entitySpatial','unitSpatial','entityBuckets','unitBuckets'])assert.equal(save[key],undefined);
      const restored=Simulation.restore(save);assert.equal(restored.unitSpatial,undefined);restored.tick(.1);assert.ok(restored.unitSpatial instanceof SpatialBuckets);assert.ok([...restored.unitSpatial.active].every(bucket=>bucket.every(unit=>unit.hp>0&&!unit.embarked)));

    # Blender art and runtime rendering
    
    The deployed game includes both GLB catalogues and texture files. Playing or deploying it requires no Blender installation and no external asset service.
    
    The catalogue contains 126 models: 66 civilization/age building variants, 18 troop/ship/caravan types plus four worker task variants, 24 forest variants and 14 resource models. The models were made for this original game. They are not Age of Empires or Warcraft assets.
    
    ## Edit and regenerate
    
    The development installation uses Blender 4.5.14 LTS at `.tools/blender-4.5.14-windows-x64/blender.exe`. The editable generated project is `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`. Open the current catalogue showcase with:
    
    ```powershell
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/blender/start.ps1 -Visible -Showcase
    ```
    
    `scripts/blender/showcase.py` arranges the catalogue for inspection with material colors. The live browser applies the photographed surfaces, lighting, fog and weather. The lightweight Blender preview disables expensive viewport modifiers for this laptop.
    
    ```powershell
    npm run art:build
    npm run art:materials
    npm run build
    ```
    
    `art:build` exports the original model source, refines it in background Blender, creates adult-proportioned figures and solid worker tools, then compresses near/low GLBs with gltfpack. Bevels, baked vertex shading, normals, UVs and semantic material/joint metadata survive export. The builder runs jobs sequentially to limit memory pressure. Blender and gltfpack are development tools in `.tools`; they are excluded from deployment archives. Blender's [published minimum is 8 GB RAM](https://www.blender.org/download/requirements/), above this laptop's approximately 4 GB, so large art tasks need care.
    
    `art:materials` downloads seven CC0 surface sets using the published Poly Haven API and verifies file sizes and hashes, reusing only verified local files. Runtime uses local bundled JPEGs, with no asset API requests. Creator credits and source links are in [the texture license](src/assets3d/textures/LICENSE.md).
    
    On another computer, install Blender and gltfpack and set `BLENDER_BIN` and `GLTFPACK_BIN` to their executable paths before `art:build`. Normal deployment builds use the supplied GLBs and JPEGs directly.
    
    ### Staging changes safely
    
    `npm run art:build -- --stage` writes a separate full candidate. `npm run art:build -- --stage --resources-only` authors only fourteen resource models in `.tools/art-candidate/resources`; partial builds cannot target the game's live catalogue. Staged Blender jobs use one thread and run at low process priority.
    
    For the current field-resources pass, run `node scripts/blender/validate-candidate.mjs --resources-only`, then `node scripts/blender/compose-candidate.mjs` and `node scripts/blender/validate-candidate.mjs`. The composer replaces twelve food/gold/stone variants in both complete catalogues while preserving unrelated compressed bytes and joint metadata. It handles separate Meshopt fallback buffers and uses patch hashes to avoid appending identical resources twice. Unreferenced superseded bytes remain until a full rebake; the complete Low file still fits its declared budget.
    
    Run background Blender with `scripts/blender/compose-editable.py` to produce the corresponding complete editable source. It checks all 126 keys, unchanged transforms and 114 unrelated model hierarchies before saving `.tools/art-candidate/full/raw/frontier-assets.blend`. The verified file is now promoted to `.tools/art-refined/frontier-assets.blend`; `frontier-assets-previous.blend` preserves the preceding source. The resource-only file remains separate and never replaces the full source.
    
    `scripts/resource-candidate-qa.mjs` checks both detail levels, actual resource gathering clicks and seven emulated screen sizes, including paid training and touch movement. `scripts/interface-qa.mjs` covers desktop, small landscape and portrait menus, setup, settings, field guide, technology and multiplayer entry, with keyboard focus and target-size checks. Their diagnostic reports are in `artifacts` and are not deployment assets.
    
    ## In-game behavior and budgets
    
    - The near GLB is 16,237,168 bytes (15.49 MiB); the lower detail GLB is 3,928,668 bytes (3.75 MiB). Both contain the full 126-model catalogue. Twenty-one photographed surface maps total 15,684,309 bytes (14.96 MiB). The declared low-catalogue content budget is 4 MiB; this is a download budget, not an FPS achievement.
    - High uses near geometry and color/normal/roughness maps. Medium uses low geometry with color/normal maps. Low uses low geometry and color maps.
    - All seven biomes have stronger rolling relief, slope/altitude/shore/road transitions and grass/soil/rock blends at their documented physical scales. A small road mask keeps paths continuous on Low geometry. Solid seeded pebbles use one instanced draw, obey exploration and clear beneath foundations; the caps are 360 on High and 120 otherwise. These cosmetic stones do not change navigation.
    - Natural rock grain and normal/roughness detail replace masonry on ore deposits. Gold retains its separate metallic inclusions. Pebbles share the rock texture; building masonry stays separate.
    - Food clusters use branching canes, red fruits and closed three-leaflet volumes. Uneven settled ore has rounded corners, small scattered stones and erosion; High adds solid seams aligned to the gold-bearing rock surfaces, while Low keeps solid metallic inclusions. Open foliage gaps have a visibility-aware picking fallback; actual foreground meshes retain priority.
    - Covered civic arcades, front steps, facade arches, gable windows and civilization-specific roof details strengthen building silhouettes. Painted-plaster color, normal and roughness maps join the grass, wood and masonry sets.
    - Adult figures include villager field packs and armored visors. Local unit positions interpolate between simulation ticks and turn smoothly without changing authoritative positions or saves. Multiplayer interpolation is bounded to its snapshot interval.
    - Nested joint metadata drives runtime poses. The catalogue does not contain baked skeletal animation clips. Worker tools follow their actual gathering/building/repair task.
    - Reusable joint-prefix matrices avoid repeating torso/limb calculations within each rendered unit, with numerical coverage against the original poses. The cache stores joint definitions rather than unit history. Cargo samples the same interpolated positions and turns as figures, including bounded network snapshots.
    - Curved tapering trunks and branching bends support distinct oak, birch, elm and beech crown proportions. High includes sixteen smaller crown lobes with pointed closed leaf tips; the tips are excluded from the smaller phone catalogue. Winter forests have branched boughs and irregular snow patches. Bark grain and muted, varied canopy colors add surface detail. Runtime tree detail follows projected screen size.
    - Bows use distinct draw/release/recovery poses, melee uses a striking arm with a steadier off hand, and firing intervals come from each unit's real cooldown.
    - Arrows and siege shots start at terrain-aligned weapon heights and turn along their flight arc. Reusable meshes bound repeated combat allocation. Active cosmetic effects are released when changing scenes; they do not change simulation damage or attack timing.

    function jointAngle(view,m,e){
      const combat=combatJointAngle(e,m);if(combat!==null)return combat;
      const working=e.type==='villager'&&!e.moving&&['gather','build','repair'].includes(e.order?.type||e.activity);
      const phase=view.clock*8.5+e.id*.7,walk=Math.sin(phase)*m.side;
      if(m.type==='wheel')return e.moving?view.clock*5:0;
      if(m.type==='horseleg')return e.moving?walk*.5:0;
      if(m.type==='knee')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.035:0):e.moving?Math.max(0,-walk)*.65:0;
      if(m.type==='leg')return m.riding?(e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*5+e.id)*.025:0):e.moving?walk*.46:0;
      if(m.type==='torso')return e.moving?walk*.022:working?.04+Math.sin(view.clock*4+e.id)*.022:Math.sin(view.clock*1.7+e.id)*.009;
      if(m.type==='head')return e.moving?-.018:Math.sin(view.clock*1.4+e.id)*.012;
      if(m.type==='cape')return Math.sin(view.clock*2+e.id)*(.025+(view.weatherState?.intensity||0)*.035)+(e.moving?.07:0);
      if(m.type==='sail')return Math.sin(view.clock*1.5+e.id)*.035;
      if(m.type==='oar')return e.moving?Math.sin(view.clock*3+e.id)*.18*m.side:0;
      if(m.type==='ram')return 0;
      if(m.type==='siege')return e.cooldown>0?Math.sin(Math.min(1,(3.8-e.cooldown)/.7)*Math.PI)*1.15:0;
      if(m.type==='forearm'){
        if(working)return m.side<0?-.12:-.18+Math.sin(view.clock*(workerVisualTask(view,e)==='build'?8:6)+e.id)*.12;

    export function combatJointAngle(entity,joint){

      const aiming=definition.role==='ranged'&&entity.order?.type==='attack';if(!entity.cooldown&&!aiming)return null;
      const interval=definition.cooldown||1.2,phase=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-(entity.cooldown||0)/interval));

        if(joint.type==='forearm')return joint.side<0?-.06:-.25-draw*.65;
        if(joint.type==='torso')return -.018+draw*.028;
        if(joint.type==='head')return -.045;

      }

    function canonicalGeometry(geometry){
      for(const name of ['position','normal','uv','color']){
        const attribute=geometry.getAttribute(name);if(!attribute)continue;
        const size=name==='color'?3:attribute.itemSize;
        const values=new Float32Array(attribute.count*size);
        for(let i=0;i<attribute.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<size;k++)
          values[i*size+k]=attribute.getComponent(i,k);
        geometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(values,size));
      }
      const positions=geometry.getAttribute('position');
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('color'))geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(positions.count*3).fill(1),3));
      if(!geometry.getAttribute('uv')){
        const uv=new Float32Array(positions.count*2);
        for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){uv[i*2]=positions.getX(i)*.25;uv[i*2+1]=(positions.getY(i)+positions.getZ(i))*.25;}
        geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      }
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
    
    export function registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail='high',bytes=0,activate=true){
      const templates=new Map(),geometries=new Set();
      gltf.scene.traverse(node=>{
        if(node.userData.assetKey)templates.set(node.userData.assetKey,node);
        if(node.isMesh&&!geometries.has(node.geometry)){
          canonicalGeometry(node.geometry);geometries.add(node.geometry);
        }
      });
      const missing=manifest.models.filter(model=>!templates.has(model.key));
      if(missing.length)throw new Error('The 3D asset catalogue is incomplete: '+missing.map(model=>model.key).join(', '));
      const catalogue={templates,geometries,detail,bytes,source:'Blender'};
      if(activate)active=catalogue;
      return catalogue;
    }
    
    export async function loadAuthoredAssets(quality='high'){
      const serial=++loadSerial;
      const detail=quality==='high'?'high':'low';
      if(!pending.has(detail))pending.set(detail,(async()=>{
        const response=await fetch(sources[detail]);
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`3D asset request failed (${response.status}).`);
        const buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
        const loader=new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
        const gltf=await loader.parseAsync(buffer,'');
        return registerAuthoredAssets(gltf,detail,buffer.byteLength,false);
      })());

    import bpy

    import os
    from pathlib import Path

    from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
    
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    stage = os.environ.get("FRONTIER_ART_STAGE", "")
    if stage not in {"", "full", "resources"}:
        raise ValueError("Invalid art staging mode")
    source = project / (".tools/art-candidate/resources/source/catalogue.glb" if stage == "resources" else ".tools/art-source/catalogue.glb")
    out = project / (f".tools/art-candidate/{stage}/raw" if stage else ".tools/art-refined")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
    bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=str(source))
    roots = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.get("assetKey")]
    materials = {}
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type == "MESH" and obj.get("assetMaterial"):
            materials.setdefault(obj["assetMaterial"], obj.data.materials[0])
    if "leafDark" not in materials and "leaf" in materials:
        # A resource-only source has no forest mesh supplying this semantic surface.
        materials["leafDark"] = materials["leaf"].copy()
        materials["leafDark"].name = "leafDark"
        materials["leafDark"].diffuse_color = (.055,.14,.038,1)
    
    def descendants(root):
        result = []
        def visit(obj):
            result.append(obj)
            for child in obj.children:
                visit(child)
        visit(root)
        return result
    
    def make_mesh(root, role, vertices, faces, label):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(label)
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices, [], faces)
        mesh.update()
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(label, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
        obj.parent = root
        obj["assetMaterial"] = role
        obj.data.materials.append(materials[role])
        # Planar/organic primitives receive usable UVs even with no bitmap texture.
        uv = mesh.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
        for loop in mesh.loops:
            p = mesh.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
            uv.data[loop.index].uv = (p.x * .25, p.z * .25 + p.y * .1)
        return obj

    test('phone assets preserve the complete catalogue with smaller download and geometry budgets',async()=>{

    function fallenGeometry(view,e){
      const model=view.mergeModel(view.makeUnit({...e,moving:false,cooldown:0,order:null})),parts=[];
      model.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh||part.material.transparent)return;
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);
        if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        for(const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes))if(!['position','normal','uv','color'].includes(name))geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
        const position=geometry.attributes.position,existing=geometry.attributes.color,colors=new Float32Array(position.count*3),color=part.material.color.toArray();
        for(let i=0;i<position.count;i++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++)colors[i*3+k]=(existing?existing.getComponent(i,k):1)*color[k];
        geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));parts.push(geometry);
      });
      const result=mergeGeometries(parts);for(const part of parts)part.dispose();view.releaseNode(model);
      return result;
    }

    import {UNITS} from './data.js';
    
    // Rendering-only gait history follows travelled distance, not a fixed wall clock.
    // This keeps faster upgrades, slow siege and interpolated network motion coherent.
    export class UnitLocomotion{
      constructor(){this.states=new Map();}
      clear(){this.states.clear();}
      get(id){return this.states.get(id);}
      update(e,x,z,dt){
        let state=this.states.get(e.id);const definition=UNITS[e.type]||{},cavalry=definition.role==='cavalry',period=cavalry?3.4:2.05;
        if(!state){state={x,z,phase:(e.id*.7)%(Math.PI*2),wheel:0,blend:0,bob:0};this.states.set(e.id,state);return state;}
        const elapsed=Math.max(0,dt),distance=Math.hypot(x-state.x,z-state.z),teleported=distance>Math.max(3,(definition.speed||4)*elapsed*4);
        state.x=x;state.z=z;
        if(!teleported){state.phase=(state.phase+distance*Math.PI*2/period)%(Math.PI*2);state.wheel=(state.wheel+distance/.5)%(Math.PI*2);}
        const moving=!teleported&&e.moving&&distance>.0001,blend=1-Math.exp(-elapsed*14);state.blend+=(Number(moving)-state.blend)*blend;
        if(teleported)state.blend=0;
        state.bob=definition.naval||definition.role==='siege'||e.type==='cart'?0:(1-Math.cos(state.phase*2))*(cavalry?.027:.018)*state.blend;
        return state;
      }
      prune(sim){for(const id of this.states.keys())if(!sim.get(id))this.states.delete(id);}
    }

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import {UnitLocomotion} from '../src/locomotion.js';
    import {animatePart} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    
    test('gait cadence follows distance at different frame rates and never advances while blocked',()=>{
      const e={id:11,kind:'unit',type:'spearman',moving:true,x:0,z:0},sample=frames=>{const gait=new UnitLocomotion();gait.update(e,0,0,0);for(let i=1;i<=frames;i++)gait.update(e,0,i*4/frames,1/frames);return gait;};
      const a=sample(30),b=sample(60);assert.ok(Math.abs(a.get(e.id).phase-b.get(e.id).phase)<1e-10);assert.ok(Math.abs(a.get(e.id).blend-b.get(e.id).blend)<1e-10);
      const phase=a.get(e.id).phase;for(let i=0;i<30;i++)a.update(e,0,4,1/30);assert.equal(a.get(e.id).phase,phase);assert.ok(a.get(e.id).blend<.00001,'blocked movement settles rather than marching in place');
      a.update(e,80,80,1/60);assert.equal(a.get(e.id).phase,phase);assert.equal(a.get(e.id).blend,0,'teleports do not produce an enormous step');assert.equal(e.x,0);assert.equal(e.z,0,'render history never changes authoritative positions');
    });
    
    test('wheels preserve their stopped orientation, siege does not bounce and motion caches release removed units',()=>{
      const e={id:1,type:'ram',moving:true},gait=new UnitLocomotion();gait.update(e,0,0,0);const moved=gait.update(e,0,.2,.1);assert.equal(moved.bob,0);assert.equal(moved.wheel,.4);
      const view={clock:4,locomotion:gait},part={userData:{motion:{type:'wheel',pivot:[0,.5,0],side:1}}},matrix=new THREE.Matrix4();const before=animatePart(view,part,e,matrix).clone();e.moving=false;gait.update(e,0,.2,.1);assert.deepEqual(animatePart(view,part,e,matrix).elements,before.elements);
      gait.prune({get:()=>null});assert.equal(gait.states.size,0);gait.update(e,0,0,0);gait.clear();assert.equal(gait.states.size,0);
    });
    
    test('horse legs use diagonal pairs and troop strides keep rigid articulated transforms',()=>{
      const e={id:7,type:'knight',moving:true},gait=new UnitLocomotion();gait.update(e,0,0,0);gait.update(e,0,.3,.1);const view={clock:1,locomotion:gait},matrix=new THREE.Matrix4();
      const pose=(side,z)=>animatePart(view,{userData:{motion:{type:'horseleg',pivot:[0,1,z],side}}},e,matrix).clone();
      const rightRear=pose(1,-.5),leftFront=pose(-1,.5),leftRear=pose(-1,-.5);assert.ok(Math.abs(rightRear.elements[6]-leftFront.elements[6])<1e-10);assert.ok(Math.abs(rightRear.elements[6]+leftRear.elements[6])<1e-10);
      for(const result of [rightRear,leftFront,leftRear]){assert.ok(result.elements.every(Number.isFinite));assert.ok(Math.abs(result.determinant()-1)<1e-10);}
    });

    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';

    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true,args:['--enable-webgl','--ignore-gpu-blocklist']}),report={checks:[],errors:[],passed:false};
    try{
      const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1280,height:720}});page.setDefaultTimeout(90000);page.on('pageerror',e=>report.errors.push(e.message));page.on('console',message=>{if(message.type()==='error')report.errors.push(message.text());});
      await page.addInitScript(()=>localStorage.setItem('crowns-settings',JSON.stringify({quality:'low',autoQuality:false,weather:'clear',music:false,volume:0})));
      await page.goto(process.env.QA_URL||'http://localhost:4174/',{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.frontier?.view);
      const check=await page.evaluate(()=>{
        frontier.start({mode:'sandbox',map:'highlands',seed:512});frontier.action('pause');document.querySelector('#modal-root').style.visibility='hidden';
        const s=frontier.sim,v=frontier.view;s.stop(s.owned(0,'unit').map(e=>e.id));const worker=s.owned(0,'unit','villager')[0],horse=s.owned(0,'unit','scout')[0],ram=s.addUnit('ram',0,-44,46);
        worker.x=-40;worker.z=46;horse.x=-42;horse.z=46;s.revision++;s.updateFog();v.localMotion.clear();v.locomotion.clear();v.focus(-40,50);v.zoom=18;v.tilt=.65;v.render(0,false);
        for(const e of [worker,horse,ram])s.command([e.id],{type:'move',x:e.x,z:56});
        const trace=[];
        for(let tick=0;tick<10;tick++){
          v.localMotion.capture(s);s.tick(.1);v.localMotion.commit(s);
          for(const blend of [.25,.5,.75,1]){v.localBlend=blend;v.render(.025,false);trace.push({x:worker.renderX,z:worker.renderZ,phase:v.locomotion.get(worker.id).phase,blend:v.locomotion.get(worker.id).blend,ramBob:v.locomotion.get(ram.id).bob});}
        }
        const root=s.get(worker.id),authoritative=[root.x,root.z],before=v.locomotion.get(worker.id).phase,wheel=v.locomotion.get(ram.id).wheel;
        for(let i=0;i<45;i++)v.render(1/30,false);
        const result={models:v.artDiagnostics.models,trace,initial:{x:-40,z:46,phase:(worker.id*.7)%(Math.PI*2)},authoritative,after:[worker.x,worker.z],stopped:{phaseBefore:before,phaseAfter:v.locomotion.get(worker.id).phase,blend:v.locomotion.get(worker.id).blend,wheelBefore:wheel,wheelAfter:v.locomotion.get(ram.id).wheel},visible:[worker,horse,ram].map(e=>({type:e.type,packed:v.nodes.get(e.id).userData.batch.renderIds.includes(e.id)})),savedGait:s.serialize().locomotion};
        return result;
      });

      let travelled=0,phase=check.initial.phase,previous=check.initial;for(const pose of check.trace){travelled+=Math.hypot(pose.x-previous.x,pose.z-previous.z);phase=(check.initial.phase+travelled*Math.PI*2/2.05)%(Math.PI*2);assert.ok(Math.abs(pose.phase-phase)<1e-8,'the actual Blender rig advances by interpolated travel');assert.equal(pose.ramBob,0);previous=pose;}
      assert.ok(travelled>2);assert.equal(check.stopped.phaseBefore,check.stopped.phaseAfter);assert.equal(check.stopped.wheelBefore,check.stopped.wheelAfter);assert.ok(check.stopped.blend<1e-8);
      report.checks.push({models:check.models,travelled,frames:check.trace.length,visible:check.visible,stopped:check.stopped,authoritativePositionPreserved:true,saveHasNoGaitHistory:true});

    import {animatePart,beginJointPose,endJointPose} from '../src/world-polish.js';
    
    function fixture(){
      const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(),model=new THREE.Group(),body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry().toNonIndexed(),material),arm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.4,.7,.4).toNonIndexed(),material);
      body.geometry.translate(0,1,0);arm.geometry.translate(2,2,0);arm.userData.motion={type:'arm',pivot:[2,2.3,0],side:1,parent:{type:'torso',pivot:[0,1.3,0],side:1}};model.add(body,arm);model.updateMatrixWorld();
      const view={clock:.4},batch={capacity:64,renderIds:[7],ids:[7],free:[]},mesh=createRigidUnitPart(view,model,batch);return {view,batch,mesh,model,material,body,arm};
    }
    function cleanup(f){disposeRigidPart(f.mesh);f.mesh.geometry.dispose();f.mesh.dispose();f.body.geometry.dispose();f.arm.geometry.dispose();f.material.dispose();}
    
    test('one rigid draw preserves every source vertex and exact nested world poses for both color and shadow passes',()=>{
      const f=fixture(),e={id:7,type:'spearman',moving:true},root=new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationY(.8).setPosition(10,3,-5);beginJointPose(f.view,e,root);writeRigidPose(f.mesh,0,e,root);endJointPose(f.view);
      const rig=f.mesh.userData.rigidRig,p=f.mesh.geometry.attributes.position;assert.equal(p.count,f.body.geometry.attributes.position.count+f.arm.geometry.attributes.position.count);assert.equal(rig.joints.length,2);
      for(const [index,source]of [f.body,f.arm].entries()){
        const expected=animatePart(f.view,source,e,root).clone(),stored=new THREE.Matrix4().fromArray(rig.data,index*16),range=rig.joints[index];
        for(let vertex=range.start;vertex<range.start+range.count;vertex++){const a=new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p,vertex).applyMatrix4(stored),b=new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p,vertex).applyMatrix4(expected);assert.ok(a.distanceTo(b)<1e-6);}
      }
      const standard={vertexShader:THREE.ShaderLib.standard.vertexShader,fragmentShader:THREE.ShaderLib.standard.fragmentShader,uniforms:{}},depth={vertexShader:THREE.ShaderLib.depth.vertexShader,fragmentShader:THREE.ShaderLib.depth.fragmentShader,uniforms:{}};
      f.mesh.material.onBeforeCompile(standard);f.mesh.customDepthMaterial.onBeforeCompile(depth);assert.equal(standard.uniforms.frontierRigPoses,depth.uniforms.frontierRigPoses);assert.equal(standard.uniforms.frontierRigPoses.value,rig.texture);
      cleanup(f);

      writeRigidPose(f.mesh,0,e,root);const before=rig.data.slice(0,32);writeRigidPose(f.mesh,18,e,new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(-5,3,2));assert.equal(replaced,1);assert.equal(rig.rows,32);assert.deepEqual(rig.data.slice(0,32),before);

    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import {mergeGeometries} from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
    import {animatePart} from './world-polish.js';
    
    const rigShader=`attribute float unitJoint;
    uniform highp sampler2D frontierRigPoses;
    mat4 frontierRigMatrix() {
      int column = int(unitJoint + 0.5) * 4;
      int row = gl_InstanceID;
      return mat4(texelFetch(frontierRigPoses, ivec2(column, row), 0),
                  texelFetch(frontierRigPoses, ivec2(column + 1, row), 0),
                  texelFetch(frontierRigPoses, ivec2(column + 2, row), 0),
                  texelFetch(frontierRigPoses, ivec2(column + 3, row), 0));
    }`;
    
    export function applyRigShader(shader,uniform){
      shader.uniforms.frontierRigPoses=uniform;
      shader.vertexShader=rigShader+'\n'+shader.vertexShader;
      shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('void main() {','void main() {\nmat4 frontierPose = frontierRigMatrix();');
      shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <beginnormal_vertex>','#include <beginnormal_vertex>\nobjectNormal = mat3(frontierPose) * objectNormal;');
      shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>','#include <begin_vertex>\ntransformed = (frontierPose * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;');
    }
    
    function allocate(rig,rows){
      const data=new Float32Array(rows*rig.joints.length*16),roots=new Float32Array(rows*16);if(rig.data)data.set(rig.data);if(rig.roots)roots.set(rig.roots);
      const texture=new THREE.DataTexture(data,rig.joints.length*4,rows,THREE.RGBAFormat,THREE.FloatType);texture.needsUpdate=true;texture.generateMipmaps=false;
      rig.texture?.dispose();rig.texture=texture;rig.data=data;rig.roots=roots;rig.rows=rows;rig.uniform.value=texture;
    }
    
    // Merge rigid Blender joint groups into one opaque draw without removing a part.
    // Pose textures grow with visible instances instead of allocating the population
    // ceiling. The same stored matrices drive shading, shadow depth and CPU picking.
    export function createRigidUnitPart(view,model,batch){
      const geometries=[],joints=[];let vertex=0,sourceMaterial;
      model.traverse(part=>{
        if(!part.isMesh||part.material.transparent)return;
        sourceMaterial??=part.material;if(part.material!==sourceMaterial)throw new Error('Rigid unit surfaces require the shared palette.');
        let geometry=part.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(part.matrixWorld);if(geometry.index){const flat=geometry.toNonIndexed();geometry.dispose();geometry=flat;}
        const count=geometry.attributes.position.count;geometry.setAttribute('unitJoint',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count).fill(joints.length),1));
        joints.push({start:vertex,count,userData:{motion:part.userData.motion}});vertex+=count;geometries.push(geometry);
      });
      if(!joints.length)return null;
      const geometry=mergeGeometries(geometries);for(const part of geometries)part.dispose();if(!geometry)throw new Error('Rigid unit geometry could not merge.');
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();geometry.computeBoundingSphere();geometry.setAttribute('instanceOwner',new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(batch.capacity),1).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
      const rig={joints,uniform:{value:null},batch,view};allocate(rig,Math.min(16,batch.capacity));
      const material=sourceMaterial.clone(),paletteShader=sourceMaterial.onBeforeCompile;material.defines={...sourceMaterial.defines};material.onBeforeCompile=(shader,renderer)=>{paletteShader.call(sourceMaterial,shader,renderer);applyRigShader(shader,rig.uniform);};material.customProgramCacheKey=()=>sourceMaterial.customProgramCacheKey()+':rig-v1';
      const depth=new THREE.MeshDepthMaterial({depthPacking:THREE.RGBADepthPacking});depth.onBeforeCompile=shader=>applyRigShader(shader,rig.uniform);depth.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-rig-depth-v1';
      const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry,material,batch.capacity);mesh.count=0;mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.castShadow=mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.customDepthMaterial=depth;
      mesh.userData.rigidRig=rig;mesh.userData.unitIds=batch.renderIds;mesh.raycast=(raycaster,intersects)=>raycastRigidPart(mesh,raycaster,intersects);return mesh;
    }
    
    export function writeRigidPose(mesh,index,e,matrix){
      const rig=mesh.userData.rigidRig;if(index>=rig.rows)allocate(rig,Math.min(mesh.instanceMatrix.count,Math.max(index+1,rig.rows*2)));
      rig.roots.set(matrix.elements,index*16);const start=index*rig.joints.length*16;
      for(let joint=0;joint<rig.joints.length;joint++)rig.data.set(animatePart(rig.view,rig.joints[joint],e,matrix).elements,start+joint*16);
    }
    
    export function finishRigidFrame(mesh,count){const rig=mesh.userData.rigidRig;if(count)rig.texture.needsUpdate=true;return {used:count*rig.joints.length*64,uploaded:count?rig.data.byteLength:0,capacity:rig.data.byteLength,joints:rig.joints.length};}
    
    export function raycastRigidPart(mesh,raycaster,intersects){
      const rig=mesh.userData.rigidRig,geometry=mesh.geometry,root=rig.rootMatrix??=new THREE.Matrix4(),sphere=rig.pickSphere??=new THREE.Sphere(),dummy=rig.pickMesh??=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,mesh.material),hits=rig.pickHits??=[];

      }}finally{geometry.setDrawRange(previous.start,previous.count);hits.length=0;}
    }
    
    export function disposeRigidPart(mesh){const rig=mesh.userData.rigidRig;if(!rig||rig.disposed)return;rig.disposed=true;rig.texture.dispose();mesh.material.dispose();mesh.customDepthMaterial.dispose();}

    import {animatePart,beginJointPose,endJointPose} from './world-polish.js';
    import {writeRigidPose,finishRigidFrame} from './rig-batches.js';
    
    // Keep allocation slots stable while packing only the current visible poses.
    // Picking uses the packed IDs, never the allocator's potentially empty slots.
    export function prepareViewport(view){
      view.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const projection=view.frameProjection??=new THREE.Matrix4();
      (view.frameFrustum??=new THREE.Frustum()).setFromProjectionMatrix(projection.multiplyMatrices(view.camera.projectionMatrix,view.camera.matrixWorldInverse));
    }
    
    export function beginUnitFrame(view,refreshViewport=true){
      view.jointPoseDiagnostics={computed:0,reused:0};
      if(refreshViewport)prepareViewport(view);
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){batch.renderIds.length=0;for(const part of batch.parts)part.userData.ownerChanged=false;}
    }
    
    // Prepare the camera before any render extension samples contacts or cargo.
    export function installRenderFrame(WorldView){
      const render=WorldView.prototype.render;
      WorldView.prototype.render=function(dt,menu=false){this.renderFrameAt=performance.now();prepareViewport(this);return render.call(this,dt,menu);};
    }
    
    export function markInstancePrefix(mesh,count=mesh.count){
      if(!count)return;
      const attribute=mesh.instanceMatrix;attribute.clearUpdateRanges();attribute.addUpdateRange(0,count*16);attribute.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function nearViewport(view,x,y,z,radius=12){
      if(!view.frameFrustum)return true;
      const sphere=view.frameSphere??=new THREE.Sphere();sphere.center.set(x,y,z);sphere.radius=radius;
      return view.frameFrustum.intersectsSphere(sphere);
    }
    
    export function writeUnitPose(view,batch,e,matrix,shown){
      if(!shown)return false;
      const position=view.framePosition??=new THREE.Vector3();position.setFromMatrixPosition(matrix);
      if(!nearViewport(view,position.x,position.y,position.z))return false;
      const index=batch.renderIds.length;
      batch.renderIds.push(e.id);
      beginJointPose(view,e,matrix);
      try{for(const part of batch.parts){
        if(part.userData.rigidRig)writeRigidPose(part,index,e,matrix);else part.setMatrixAt(index,animatePart(view,part,e,matrix));const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner'),value=e.owner||0;
        if(owner&&owner.getX(index)!==value){owner.setX(index,value);part.userData.ownerChanged=true;}
      }}finally{endJointPose(view);}
      return true;
    }
    
    export function endUnitFrame(view){
      let drawn=0,allocated=0,activeBatches=0,matrixUploadBytes=0,ownerUploadBytes=0,capacityMatrixBytes=0,rigUploadBytes=0,rigUsedBytes=0,rigParts=0;
      for(const batch of view.unitBatches.values()){
        const count=batch.renderIds.length;drawn+=count;allocated+=batch.ids.length-batch.free.length;
        if(count)activeBatches++;
        for(const part of batch.parts){part.count=count;part.visible=count>0;if(part.userData.rigidRig){const rig=finishRigidFrame(part,count);rigUploadBytes+=rig.uploaded;rigUsedBytes+=rig.used;rigParts++;}else{markInstancePrefix(part,count);matrixUploadBytes+=count*16*4;}part.boundingSphere=null;capacityMatrixBytes+=part.instanceMatrix.array.byteLength;const owner=part.geometry.getAttribute('instanceOwner');if(owner&&part.userData.ownerChanged&&count){owner.clearUpdateRanges();owner.addUpdateRange(0,count);owner.needsUpdate=true;ownerUploadBytes+=count*4;}}
      }
      view.unitRenderDiagnostics={drawn,allocated,activeBatches,matrixUploadBytes,ownerUploadBytes,capacityMatrixBytes,rigParts,rigUploadBytes,rigUsedBytes};
    }

    import fs from 'node:fs';
    import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
    
    const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true});
    try{
      const page=await browser.newPage();
      const frames=['before','after'].map(name=>`data:image/png;base64,${fs.readFileSync(`artifacts/rig-high-${name}.png`).toString('base64')}`);
      const result=await page.evaluate(async sources=>{
        const images=await Promise.all(sources.map(src=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const image=new Image();image.onload=()=>resolve(image);image.onerror=reject;image.src=src;})));
        const width=images[0].width,height=images[0].height,canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=width;canvas.height=height;
        const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});ctx.drawImage(images[0],0,0);const first=ctx.getImageData(0,0,width,height);
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.drawImage(images[1],0,0);const second=ctx.getImageData(0,0,width,height),diff=ctx.createImageData(width,height);
        let changed=0,redder=0,darker=0;
        for(let i=0;i<diff.data.length;i+=4){const delta=Math.max(...[0,1,2].map(c=>Math.abs(first.data[i+c]-second.data[i+c])));if(delta){changed++;const brightness=[0,1,2].reduce((sum,c)=>sum+second.data[i+c]-first.data[i+c],0);if(brightness>0)redder++;else darker++;}diff.data[i]=Math.min(255,delta*8);diff.data[i+1]=delta?24:0;diff.data[i+2]=delta?16:0;diff.data[i+3]=255;}
        ctx.putImageData(diff,0,0);return {png:canvas.toDataURL('image/png'),width,height,changed,redder,darker};
      },frames);
      fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/rig-high-diff.png',Buffer.from(result.png.split(',')[1],'base64'));
      console.log(JSON.stringify({width:result.width,height:result.height,changed:result.changed,brighter:result.redder,darker:result.darker}));
    }finally{await browser.close();}

    // Keep the existing physical wave profile on the GPU. Analytical slope normals
    // give moving highlights without rewriting geometry or recalculating faces.
    export function configureWaterSurface(material){
      if(material.frontierWaveTime)return;
      const time=material.frontierWaveTime={value:0};
      const sky=material.frontierWaterSky={value:material.color.clone().setHex(0xc4d9df)};
      const ripples=material.frontierWaterRipples={value:.075};
      // The former colored stripe map exaggerated repetition across wide seas.
      if(material.map?.isCanvasTexture){material.map.dispose();material.map=null;}
      const previous=material.onBeforeCompile;
      material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        previous.call(material,shader);
        shader.uniforms.frontierWaterTime=time;
        shader.uniforms.frontierWaterSky=sky;
        shader.uniforms.frontierWaterRipples=ripples;
        shader.vertexShader='uniform float frontierWaterTime;\nvarying vec2 vFrontierWaterXZ;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
        shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <beginnormal_vertex>',`#include <beginnormal_vertex>
          float frontierWaveA = position.x * 0.9 + position.z * 0.36 + frontierWaterTime * 1.3;
          float frontierWaveB = position.z * 0.65 - frontierWaterTime;
          objectNormal = normalize(vec3(-0.0315 * cos(frontierWaveA), 1.0,
            -0.0126 * cos(frontierWaveA) + 0.013 * sin(frontierWaveB)));`);
        shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>',`#include <begin_vertex>
          transformed.y += 0.035 * sin(frontierWaveA) + 0.02 * cos(frontierWaveB);
          vFrontierWaterXZ = transformed.xz;`);
        shader.fragmentShader='uniform vec3 frontierWaterSky;\nuniform float frontierWaterTime;\nuniform float frontierWaterRipples;\nvarying vec2 vFrontierWaterXZ;\n'+shader.fragmentShader;
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <normal_fragment_maps>',`#include <normal_fragment_maps>
          float frontierRippleX = cos(vFrontierWaterXZ.x * 3.7 + vFrontierWaterXZ.y * 1.9 + frontierWaterTime * 2.3);
          float frontierRippleZ = sin(vFrontierWaterXZ.y * 4.1 - vFrontierWaterXZ.x * 1.2 - frontierWaterTime * 1.8);
          normal = normalize(normal + mat3(viewMatrix) * vec3(frontierRippleX, 0.0, frontierRippleZ) * frontierWaterRipples);`);
        shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <opaque_fragment>',`
          float frontierWaterFresnel = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(normal, normalize(vViewPosition)), 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
          outgoingLight = mix(outgoingLight, frontierWaterSky, 0.08 + 0.58 * frontierWaterFresnel);
          #include <opaque_fragment>`);
      };
      material.metalness=0;material.roughness=.22;
      material.customProgramCacheKey=()=> 'frontier-water-waves-v3';material.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    
    export function animateWaterSurface(view){
      const time=view.materials.water.frontierWaveTime;if(time)time.value=view.clock;
      const sky=view.materials.water.frontierWaterSky;if(sky&&view.scene.background?.isColor)sky.value.copy(view.scene.background);
      const ripples=view.materials.water.frontierWaterRipples;if(ripples)ripples.value=view.settings.quality==='low'?.035:.075;
      const diagnostics=view.waterDiagnostics??={animation:'GPU mesh displacement',geometryUploadsPerFrame:0};
      diagnostics.meshes=view.waterMeshes?.length||0;
    }
